Urushi tapping is the process of making cuts in the bark of the urushi tree and collecting the sap that oozes out.

description:
山の恵みを受け、豊な森とともに発展してきた、「森の京都」。
森の京都エリアの6つのまちで、森と人が育んできた伝統文化の魅力あふれる映像をぜひご覧ください。

■和知人形浄瑠璃（京都府京丹波町）

和知人形浄瑠璃のルーツは、今から150年ほど前のこと。
農家の閑散期に人形回しを嗜んだのが、はじまりといわれています。
通常は3人で扱う人形を、たった1人で操ることが特徴で、太夫・三味線・人形の三業一体となった芸は、地域の誇る伝統の技です。
和知伝統芸能常設館の定期公演で見ることができます。

title: [Kyotanba Town] #3 Wachi Puppet Joruri - A Cultural Heritage of the Region Awaits in the Forest-Grown Culture -
description:
Blessed by the mountains, and developed alongside rich forests, 'Forest Kyoto'.
Please enjoy the captivating videos showcasing the traditional culture nurtured by the forest and its people in the six towns of the Forest Kyoto area.

■Wachi Puppet Joruri (Kyotanba Town, Kyoto Prefecture)

The roots of Wachi Puppet Joruri date back about 150 years.
It is said to have begun when farmers engaged in puppet manipulation during their off-season.
What sets it apart is the ability to operate the puppet by just one person, instead of the usual three, and the art that combines the roles of tayu (narrator), shamisen player, and puppeteer is a proud traditional skill of the region.
You can see it at the regular performances at the Wachi Traditional Performing Arts Permanent Hall.

*This video was produced as part of the Agency for Cultural Affairs' project to promote the comprehensive utilization of regional cultural assets (Support Project for New Lifestyles to Inherit Intangible Cultural Heritage).

■Oso Shrine Tug-of-War (Yagi, Nantan City, Kyoto Prefecture)

This ritual has been passed down for over a thousand years, inspired by the story of a warrior who defeated a giant serpent that plagued the village. A net representing the serpent is pulled north and south across the torii gate, with the belief that if the south wins, rice will be abundant, and if the north wins, wheat will be abundant. The event is scheduled to be held on a Sunday in mid-January each year. Located in Yuki, Yagi Town, Nantan City, Kyoto Prefecture.

They are showcased at events such as the Ayabe Hatsu Ebisu Festival, the Oomoto Setsubun Festival, and the Ayabe Tan no Kuni Festival.

title: 2021 Forest of Kyoto Cultural Tourism Supporter Radio Episode 3: "Tamba's Lacquer Harvesting"
description:
This is the broadcast audio of the radio program "Forest of Kyoto presents Do You Know? Traditional Culture in Fukuchiyama" on Kyoto FM Tanba. The Forest of Kyoto Cultural Tourism Supporters will introduce the intangible cultural heritage of Fukuchiyama from the perspective of supporters once a month.

The third episode features 【Tamba's Lacquer Harvesting】. 
Yakuno Town in Fukuchiyama City, Kyoto Prefecture, has long been one of Japan's leading lacquer-producing areas known for "Tamba Lacquer." There, lacquer harvesting artisans work to protect and pass on Japan's traditional industries.

The first half of the program covers the basics of lacquer. 
Lacquer harvesting was thriving during the Edo period, and currently, 90% of the lacquer used is imported. 
We will introduce the amazing qualities of this precious domestic lacquer!

In the second half, we welcome Kousuke Yamauchi, a lacquer harvesting artisan and the public relations officer of the NPO Tamba Lacquer, as our guest to share his story. We asked him about his encounter with lacquer, the reasons for moving to Fukuchiyama, the challenges he faces, and the charm of lacquer. The supporters were moved by Yamauchi's passionate feelings towards lacquer, which left a refreshing impression!

今回は、オホーツク管内佐呂間町にある「サロマ湖展望台」をご紹介。

サロマ湖展望台は、日本で3番目に広い面積を誇るサロマ湖全体を見渡すことができる唯一の場所で、周囲に高い山がないため、ここでしか見られない壮大なパノラマをお楽しみいただけます。
展望台からは湖と海を仕切る「龍宮街道」とも呼ばれる砂州や、天気が良い日は遠く知床連山を見渡すこともできます。

展望台には３つの望遠鏡がついておりサロマ湖のすみからすみまで眺めることができ、その眺望は一級です。

詳しくはこちらから ▼
https://www.town.saroma.hokkaido.jp/kakuka/keizaika/tenboudai.html



This time, we will introduce the "Lake Saroma Observatory" in Saroma-cho, Okhotsk.

Lake Saroma Observatory is the only place where you can see the whole of Lake Saroma, which is the third largest lake in Japan, and there are no high mountains around, so you can enjoy a magnificent panorama that can only be seen here. 
From the observatory, you can also see the sandbar, also known as the "Ryugu Kaido" that separates the lake and the sea, and the Shiretoko mountain range in the distance on a clear day.

The observatory has three telescopes, and you can see every corner of Lake Saroma, and the view is first-class.

#ベスト北海道　#北海道観光　#北海道開拓の村

今回は、北海道開基百年を記念して1983年に開設された「Historical Village of Hokkaido」を紹介します。

明治から昭和初期にかけて建築された北海道各地の建造物を移築復元・再現した野外博物館です。
訪れる人たちに開拓当時の生活を体感的に理解してもらうことと、文化の流れを示す建造物を保存し、後世に永く伝えることを目的に開村しました。
村内は市街地・農村・山村・漁村の4エリアに分かれ、開拓当時にタイムスリップしたかのような景色が広がります。
開拓当時の文化を体験できる伝統遊具づくりやわら細工講習なども随時開催してます。

詳しくはこちらから！
https://www.kaitaku.or.jp/

BEST HOKKAIDO introduces attractive tourist spots and resources in Hokkaido.
We deliver superb views of Hokkaido from various angles through video.

#BestHokkaido #HokkaidoTourism #HistoricalVillageofHokkaido

This time, we will introduce the 'Historical Village of Hokkaido', which was established in 1983 to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the founding of Hokkaido.

It is an open-air museum that relocates and restores buildings built in various parts of Hokkaido from the Meiji to early Showa eras.
It was opened to help visitors understand the life during the pioneering days and to preserve buildings that show the flow of culture for future generations.
The village is divided into four areas: Town, Farm Village, Mountain Village, and Fishing Village, creating a landscape that feels like a time slip back to the pioneering days.
Workshops on making traditional playground equipment and straw crafts are also held from time to time.

For more information, click here! https://www.kaitaku.or.jp/en/

description:
北海道の魅力な観光スポットや観光資源を紹介するBEST HOKKAIDO。

#ベスト北海道　#北海道観光　#羊蹄山

今回は、別名”蝦夷富士”とも呼ばれる均整のとれた円錐形の成層火山「羊蹄山 」を紹介します。

札幌中心部から車で約2時間、後志地方南部に位置する羊蹄山の標高は1,898メートル。支笏洞爺国立公園に属しており、日本百名山にも認定されている名峰です。
登山スポットとしても人気で、4種類の登山コースがあり、頂上からは日本海や太平洋を見渡すことができます。

周囲には、羊蹄山に降った雨や雪が長い年月をかけて大地に染みこみ、ろ過されたミネラル成分たっぷりの湧き水が汲めるスポットもあります。

詳しくはこちらから！
https://www.visit-hokkaido.jp/spot/detail_10334.html

This time, we will introduce the well-proportioned cone-shaped stratovolcano "Mt. Yotei", also known as "Ezo Fuji".

About 2 hours by car from the center of Sapporo, Mt. Yotei is located in the southern part of Shiribeshi region and has an altitude of 1,898 meters.
It belongs to Shikotsu-Toya National Park and is a famous peak that has been certified as one of the 100 famous mountains in Japan.
It is also popular as a mountain climbing spot, and there are 4 types of climbing courses, and from the top you can overlook the Sea of ​​Japan and the Pacific Ocean.

In the surrounding area, there are spots where you can get spring water with plenty of mineral ingredients that has been filtered after the rain and snow that fell on Mt. Yotei soaked into the earth over many years.

For more information is here！

description: This time, we will introduce the 'Otaru Canal' of the port city 'Otaru' in Hokkaido. Completed in 1923 by the only offshore landfill method in Japan. The total length is 1,140 m, the width is 20 m along the harbor line, and the northern part (commonly known as the North Canal) is 40 m as it was at that time. In 1986, when a part of the canal was reclaimed and half the width became a road and a walking path was developed, it became a tourism resource for Otaru City. It has transformed into a tourist destination, including the surrounding area. 63 gas lights are installed on the walking path. The timber-framed stone warehouses along the canal retain their original appearance and are lit up from dusk. In addition, events such as 'Otaru Snow Light Path' and 'Otaru ☆ Asakusa Bridge Oldies Night' are held around the canal.

title: [Maizuru × SUNTORY] You love the 'Navy Hot Whisky' with a hint of spice, don't you?
description:
How about a 'Navy Hot Whisky Cocktail' on a cold night?
With a hint of spice, it warms you up. Please try this recipe associated with the Navy.
-------------------------------------------------------------

[Navy Retro Blend]
This is a reproduction of the 'Hot Whisky' described in the Navy's cooking textbook 'Navy Fourth Class Cook's Culinary Textbook' published in 1918. Please enjoy the retro flavor of the Showa era.
'Cooking Textbook of the Navy' - 3 volumes available: http://www.maizuru-kanko.net/120/chinjufu-menu1.html

**************************************

'Chapter 2: Cooking Methods, Section 3: Western Cuisine, Pages 179-180' from 'Navy Fourth Class Cook's Culinary Textbook'

Ingredients: A small amount of 'Nutmeg', 2 drops of 'Angostura Bitters', 1 lump of sugar, 2 'Cloves', 1 slice of 'Lemon', 1 cup of 'Brandy' (liqueur glass)

Method: In a glass, place the lump of sugar, 'Nutmeg', and 'Bitters', then pour in the 'Brandy' and stir. Add the 'Cloves' and pour hot water up to about 80% full, floating a slice of 'Lemon' on top to serve.
In this case, if you replace 'Brandy' with 'Whisky', it is called 'Hot Whisky'.
**************************************

Ingredients:
30ml of Torii Whisky (Suntory)
2 drops of Angostura Bitters
1 lump of sugar
2 Cloves
A pinch of Nutmeg
1 slice of Lemon

Instructions:
1. In a glass, place the lump of sugar, Nutmeg, and Angostura Bitters, then pour in the whisky and mix.
2. Add the Cloves, pour hot water into the glass up to 80%, and add the slice of lemon to finish.
-------------------------------------------------------------

[Hot Cardamom Beam]
A modern twist that allows you to enjoy the changing flavors as the spices infuse over time.

Ingredients:
15ml of Jim Beam (Suntory)
1 whole Cardamom
A small amount of Coriander Powder (about the size of a cotton swab)

Instructions:
1. Pre-warm a teacup with hot water.
2. Pour Jim Beam into the teacup and add the whole Cardamom with a slit in the middle.
3. Add the Coriander Powder.
4. Pour near-boiling water, stir, and finish.
-------------------------------------------------------------

[Midori Hot]
A modern twist that spreads the natural aromas of Yuzu, Ginger, and Green Tea in hot water, with the added scent of Clove vanilla.

Ingredients:
15ml of Midori (Suntory)
1 Clove
1 leaf of powdered tea (Tencha) (if available)

Instructions:
1. Pre-warm a teacup with hot water.
2. Pour Midori into the teacup and add the Clove and powdered tea leaf (if available).
3. Pour near-boiling water, stir, and finish.

Whether at home or in a shop, everyone please give it a try.

title: Kagoshima Prefecture Ibusuki City / Hiraki Shrine (Drone / iPhone 4K Shooting)
description: Hiraki Shrine is located in Kaimonju-cho, Ibusuki City, Kagoshima Prefecture. It is primarily dedicated to the deity Oohirume-muchi-no-mikoto, along with other ancestral gods of Amaterasu. Eight pillars of the imperial ancestors are also enshrined here. It has been deeply revered as a guardian deity of the southern Satsuma region and as the god of the ancestors who opened this area. Particularly, it is cherished by local fishermen as a guardian of traffic safety, maritime safety, and fishing. There is a statue of a divine horse in the precincts, and there are legends related to the divine horse. Additionally, you can see the symbol of Ibusuki, Mount Kaimon, behind the main shrine. Various types of ema (votive tablets) inspired by Mount Kaimon, the vermilion shrine, and the lush precincts are also available. It is said to bring benefits not only for traffic and maritime safety but also for warding off evil and bringing good fortune. Please visit Hiraki Shrine.

title: Ibusuki City, Kagoshima Prefecture / Matagoshima (Drone 4K Shooting)
description:
[Matagoshima] 
A rock formed by the sea and volcano located in the southern part of Yamakawa Port. 
Matagoshima is not a tourist spot and is known as a hidden gem by locals and nature lovers. 
To the southwest, you can see Mount Kaimondake, and in the foreground, you can see Takeyama. 
Depending on the angle, you can enjoy all three at the same time. 
From the land, it can be seen from the direction of Fushime Coast, but if you want to capture the stunning view towards the tunnel, the angle is important. 
The naturally formed tunnel due to marine erosion is called 'Kaishokudo'. The hole is large enough for a small boat to pass through. 
It is recommended to observe as much as possible from the sea.

description: 【Ikeda Lake】九州最大のカルデラ湖で、周囲約15km、水深最大233m。神秘的な自然の景観と、湖を取り巻くのどかな風景が魅力約5700年前から繰り返された火山の噴火活動によって地表が陥没して、長い年月をかけて今の湖になった体長1.5メートル以上にもなる「大うなぎ」が生息していて、天然記念物にも指定されている。また、謎の生物「イッシー」が棲むという伝説がある。湖畔には四季折々の花々が植栽され四季を彩る花々が咲き誇る。2022年10月7日には、カフェや水上デッキを併設した。施設「IKEDAKO PAX(いけだ湖パクス)」がオープンした。池田湖周辺で、ゆったりと観光してみてください。干潮時にだけ姿を現す砂の道ぜひ知林ヶ島に足を運んでみてください。※特別な許可を取って撮影をしております。

title: Kagoshima Prefecture Ibusuki City / Ikeda Lake (Drone 4K Shooting)
description: Ikeda Lake is the largest caldera lake in Kyushu, with a circumference of about 15 km and a maximum depth of 233 m. The lake is characterized by its mystical natural scenery and the tranquil landscapes surrounding it. It was formed over a long period due to volcanic eruptions that caused the ground to collapse about 5,700 years ago. The lake is home to the 'giant eel,' which can grow over 1.5 meters and is designated as a natural monument. There is also a legend that a mysterious creature called 'Issy' resides here. The lakeside is planted with flowers that bloom in every season, adding color to the scenery. On October 7, 2022, a facility called 'IKEDAKO PAX' was opened, featuring a café and a waterside deck. Please take your time to enjoy sightseeing around Ikeda Lake. At low tide, a sandy path appears, so be sure to visit Chirin Island. *Filming was done with special permission.

[Chiringashima]
Located in Ibusuki City, Kagoshima Prefecture, it is an uninhabited island with a circumference of about 3 km floating in Kinko Bay.
The island is surrounded by clear waters, and a rich natural landscape spreads out.
During low tide, a 'sandbar' appears, and during spring tides, this time lasts longer, allowing you to walk to the island.

title: Ichinose-yaki in Ukiha City, Fukuoka Prefecture
description:
This is an introduction video about Ichinose-yaki in Ukiha City, Fukuoka Prefecture.

Ichinose-yaki is said to have originated when Toyotomi Hideyoshi invited potters during the Korean draft. It reached its peak around 1840 and became the official kiln of the Arima Domain. Although it was later abandoned, it developed again due to the enthusiasm for reviving the local kiln, and now there are five kilns.

title: [Ukiha City, Fukuoka Prefecture] Ichinose-yaki
description:
This is an introduction video about Ichinose-yaki in Ukiha City, Fukuoka Prefecture.

Ichinose-yaki is said to have originated when Toyotomi Hideyoshi invited potters during the Korean draft. It reached its peak around 1840 and became the official kiln of the Arima Domain, but after being abandoned, it developed again due to the enthusiasm for reviving the local kiln, and now there are five kilns.

□■ May 3rd to May 7th, 2023 ■□
Ichinose-yaki Spring Pottery Festival is being held!

All five kilns will open for the spring kiln opening. Tours and sales will be conducted.

description:
なかなかうきはを訪れることができない方へ、「うきはの今」をお届けします。

#調音の滝
春の新緑、秋の紅葉と、滝は時々の自然と美しく調和し、訪れる人々にやすらぎを与えてくれます。夏はとりわけ心地よく、別天地の涼しさに我を忘れてしまうほど。カジカが鳴く清流では、そうめん流しの楽しみもあります。また、夏期限定で、地元住民によるお茶やしいたけ、手作りこんにゃくなど自然の恵み豊かな特産品を販売しています。四季を通して魅力に溢れたステキなところです。平成7年には林野庁の「水源の森百選」に選ばれました。

調音の滝公園園内には、十代有馬藩主の妻、清雲院が巡行の折、滝の水音が音を奏でるかのように聴こえたことに由来する「調音の滝」をはじめ、「魚返りの滝」「斧渕の滝」「三重（みしけ）の滝」の三つの滝があります。四季折々の景色を眺めながらの散策をお楽しみください。

title: Choonnotaki: The Current of Ukiha | UkihaDays
description:
For those who cannot visit Ukiha often, we bring you 'The Current of Ukiha'.

#Choonnotaki
In spring, the fresh greenery and in autumn, the colorful leaves harmonize beautifully with the waterfall, providing tranquility to visitors. Summer is particularly pleasant, making one forget the heat in this refreshing paradise. In the clear stream where the river stones sing, you can also enjoy the fun of flowing somen noodles. Additionally, during the summer season, local residents sell abundant local specialties such as tea, shiitake mushrooms, and handmade konnyaku, all gifts from nature. It is a wonderful place full of charm throughout the four seasons. In 1995, it was selected as one of the '100 Forests of Water Sources' by the Forestry Agency.

Within Choonnotaki Park, there are three waterfalls: 'Choonnotaki', named after the sound of the waterfall that was said to resemble music when the wife of the 10th lord of the Arima clan, Seiun-in, visited; 'Uo-kaeri no Taki'; and 'Ono-buchi no Taki'. Enjoy a stroll while taking in the seasonal scenery.

#Ukiha Inari Shrine (https://ukiha-inari.jp/)
Located within Jōgahana Park, Ukiha Inari Shrine enshrines three deities: Uga Mitama no Kami (commonly known as Inari Ōkami) from Fushimi Inari Shrine, Ōyama Kushi no Kami from Matsuo Taisha in Kyoto, and Sugawara no Michizane from Dazaifu Tenmangu. They are said to bless prosperity in business, abundant harvests, sake brewing and health, longevity, and academic success.
Climbing the red torii gates that continue along the mountain leads to a scenic viewpoint with a great view. On a clear day, you can see Harazuru Onsen and even as far as Amagi. It is also known as a famous cherry blossom spot in spring.
In recent years, it has become a popular spot on social media, attracting many visitors.

title: 【2025年】雫石よしゃれ祭【新生雫石町70周年記念】
description:
【よしゃれ祭とは？】毎年8月11日に開催される夏の雫石町の一大イベント。よしゃれ通り商店街をメイン会場に、神輿運行、よしゃれ踊りやさんさ踊りなど、各団体によって異なる彩り豊かなパレードが催され、最後はさんさとよしゃれの輪踊りで締め括られます。メイン会場の他、よさこい演舞、雫石郷土芸能競演、南部よしゃれ全国大会最優秀賞者競演なども開催されます。
8月11日は、「よしゃれの里 雫石町」へぜひお越しください！

　天正年間（１５７３〜９２）、南部信直が雫石城攻略の際に西山村（雫石町）の「五輪茶屋」（よしゃれ茶屋）で見せた「雫石女」の貞節と心意気を唄ったものといわれ、「南部牛追唄」と並ぶ岩手の代表的民謡の一つ。踊りが完成したのは藩政末期といわれるが、昭和の始めごろに現在の形に手直しされ、現在でも祝い事の宴席や舞台などでは紋付で踊られる格調高い民謡である。
（いわての文化情報大事典ホームページより引用）

title: [2025] Shizukuishi Yosharai Festival [70th Anniversary of the New Shizukuishi Town]
description:
[What is the Yosharai Festival?] A major summer event in Shizukuishi Town held every year on August 11. The main venue is the Yosharai Street shopping district, where various groups hold colorful parades featuring mikoshi (portable shrines), Yosharai dances, and Sansha dances, culminating in a circle dance of Sansha and Yosharai. In addition to the main venue, there are also performances of Yosakoi dance, Shizukuishi traditional performing arts competition, and a showcase of the winners of the Nanbu Yosharai National Competition.
Please come to 'Yosharai no Sato Shizukuishi Town' on August 11!

It is said that during the Tensho era (1573-1592), when Nanbu Nobunao attacked Shizukuishi Castle, he sang about the chastity and spirit of the 'Shizukuishi Woman' at the 'Gorin Chaya' (Yosharai Chaya) in Nishiyama Village (Shizukuishi Town). This song is one of Iwate's representative folk songs, alongside the 'Nanbu Ushio Uta.' The dance is said to have been completed at the end of the feudal era, but it was revised into its current form around the early Showa period and is still performed in formal attire at celebratory events and on stage as a dignified folk song.
(Quoted from the Iwate Cultural Information Encyclopedia website)

title: Shimanami Citrus Paradise#ShimanamiConnect #VisitShimanami
description: I started the day with some delicious homemade citrus jams. The Shimanami Kaido really is a citrus paradise! The Hassaku daifuku tasted amazing. I recharged with refreshing juices, saw eye-catching clothing with fun citrus designs, and picked fruit with friendly local farmers.

title: しまなみ柑橘パラダイス
description: 私は美味しい自家製の柑橘ジャムで一日を始めました。しまなみ海道は本当に柑橘の楽園です！はっさく大福は素晴らしい味でした。私はさわやかなジュースでリフレッシュし、楽しい柑橘デザインの目を引く衣服を見て、地元の農家と一緒に果物を摘みました。

title: People of Shimanami #ShimanamiConnect #VisitShimanami
description: I met residents who were born and raised on the islands, as well as those who have recently moved there. Each encounter deepened my understanding of the significance of the region to them. Seeing the region through the eyes of locals highlighted the strong sense of community that connects everyone across the various islands. Are you ready to write your own Shimanami story?

title: しまなみの人々
description: 私は、島で生まれ育った住民や、最近移住してきた人々に出会いました。各々の出会いは、彼らにとってこの地域の重要性を深く理解させてくれました。地元の人々の目を通して地域を見ることで、さまざまな島々をつなぐ強いコミュニティの感覚が際立ちました。あなた自身のしまなみの物語を書く準備はできていますか？

title: Shimanami Stays#ShimanamiConnect #VisitShimanami
description:
After spending the day exploring, I was ready to relax at one of the many cozy ryokan along the Shimanami Kaido. 

Thanks to the kindness of each innkeeper, I was able to learn more about the region and discover the places that locals frequent. 

Listening to their personal stories helped me build a deeper connection with the region.

title: しまなみステイ#ShimanamiConnect #VisitShimanami
description:
一日中探索した後、しまなみ海道沿いの多くの快適な旅館の一つでリラックスする準備ができました。

各宿の親切さのおかげで、地域についてもっと学び、地元の人々がよく訪れる場所を発見することができました。

彼らの個人的な話を聞くことで、地域とのより深い結びつきを築くことができました。

📍 住之江旅館、いくちじま島
📍 オーベルジュユガシラ & ル・ミエル・ドレ、尾道島
📍 塩見家、ゆげ島（夢島海道）

title: Sun, seas and sky, long the Shimanami Kaido Blue Line#ShimanamiConnect #VisitShimanami
description: I departed from Onomichi surrounded by other bikers eager to begin their journey. I followed the Blue Line along winding coastlines and through quaint villages, leisurely enjoying the sights along the way. The road led me to my final stop, Kirosan, just in time to see an unforgettable sunset.

title: 太陽、海、空、しまなみ海道の青いライン
description: 私は他のバイカーたちに囲まれて尾道を出発し、旅を始めることに興奮していました。青いラインに沿って曲がりくねった海岸線や素朴な村を通り抜けながら、道中の景色をゆっくり楽しみました。最終目的地のキロ山に到着したとき、忘れられない夕日を見ることができました。

title: Tastes of Shimanami #ShimanamiConnect #VisitShimanami
description: There was no shortage of delicious foods to keep me energized on my journey. I enjoyed all different types of flavors, from freshly brewed coffee, to sweet citrus desserts, to traditional rice balls. And of course no journey would be complete without some ice cream!

title: しまなみの味
description: この酸味のあるレモネードが私を活気づけ、自転車に乗る準備をさせてくれました！

title: Shimanami Cafe Society #ShimanamiConnect #VisitShimanami
しまなみカフェ社会 #ShimanamiConnect #VisitShimanami
description: どこをサイクリングしても、美味しいカフェから遠くない場所にいました。スタイリッシュなガレットから、島のおばあさんが愛情を込めて作ったシンプルなおにぎりまで、すべてのカフェには独自の料理と魅力的な雰囲気がありました。すべての立ち寄り先で、フレンドリーなカフェのオーナーたちの温かさを感じました。

title: Connect with the slow life of island life along the Shimanami Kaido
description: The 70km-long Shimanami Kaido in Japan is one of the world’s most beautiful and most accessible bike routes. Island-hopping across the Seto Inland Sea between Honshu and Shikoku via the route's famous bridges is one of Japan's most unforgettable experiences. With a large fleet of bikes available for rent and cycle terminals located all along a route that is clearly marked by the now iconic 'Blue Line,' spending a few days exploring this gorgeous part of Japan is stress-free and safe. And, of course, meeting and chatting with the people of Shimanami along the way is a highlight of any visit.

title: Explore Japan’s Inland Sea by bike on Japan’s best cycle route | Shimanami KaidoMobile
description: The Shimanami Kaido is, without doubt, Japan’s best cycle route and appears in many “World’s Best Bike Ride” lists. The 70 km island-hopping route across the Seto Inland Sea via some of the coolest bridges you will ever see is absolutely stunning. With unrivalled cycling infrastructure, a comprehensive, and reasonably-priced rental bike system, there is no better way to experience island life Japan’s “citrus islands” than by bicycle. Whether you are an avid cyclist or a complete beginner, the Shimanami Kaido is sure to be one of the most memorable parts of any trip to Japan.

title: 日本の最高のサイクルルートであるしまなみ海道を自転車で探検する
description: しまなみ海道は、間違いなく日本の最高のサイクルルートであり、多くの「世界の最高の自転車ライド」リストに登場します。70 kmの島を渡るルートは、瀬戸内海を横断し、見たこともない素晴らしい橋を通ります。比類のないサイクリングインフラと、手頃な価格のレンタル自転車システムが整っており、自転車で日本の「柑橘類の島々」の島の生活を体験するにはこれ以上の方法はありません。熱心なサイクリストでも初心者でも、しまなみ海道は日本旅行の最も思い出に残る部分の一つになること間違いなしです。

title: The biggest cycling event on Japan’s Shimanami Kaido
日本のしまなみ海道での最大のサイクリングイベント
description: 70kmのしまなみ海道は、世界で最も美しくアクセスしやすい自転車ルートの一つで、年間を通じて楽しむことができます。しかし、CYCLING SHIMANAMIイベントは真のサイクリングフェスティバルです。約7,000人のライダーが日本全国および世界中から集まり、アイコニックなルートを高速道路で走るという貴重な機会を楽しみます。素晴らしい景色、地元のホスピタリティ、リラックスした雰囲気が魅力です。2022年には、4年の休止の後にCYCLING SHIMANAMIが再開され、晴れ渡る青空の下、明るい日差しの中で開催されました。自転車での島巡りに最適な条件でした。島々は絶対に美しく、この短い映画があなた自身のしまなみ海道と夢島海道でのサイクリングアドベンチャーを計画するきっかけになることを願っています。しまなみを訪れることを楽しみにしています！

title: CYCLING SHIMANAMI 2022（サイクリングしまなみ2022）｜Japan’s biggest cycle event!｜しまなみ海道｜しまなみジャパン
description:
2022年10月30日（日）に開催された『サイクリングしまなみ2022』の模様を通して、しまなみ海道・ゆめしま海道の美しい景観とサイクリングの魅力を感じていただける動画を作成しました。地域住民やこの地の文化との触れ合いなど、しまなみ海道を楽しむためのヒントも随所にちりばめられています。この動画をご覧になって、ぜひ一度この地を訪れてみてください。皆さまのお越しをお待ちしています！

▼ English 　------------------------------------------

The 70km-long Shimanami Kaido in Japan is one of the world’s most beautiful and accessible bike routes, and is enjoyable at any time of the year. The CYCLING SHIMANAMI event, however, is a true festival of cycling. Around 7,000 riders come from all over Japan and around the world for the rare opportunity to ride the iconic route via the expressway, the awesome views, local hospitality and relaxed vibe.
In 2022, CYCLING SHIMANAMI returned after a 4 year hiatus and was held under clear blue skies, in bright sunshine – perfect conditions for island hopping by bike.
The islands look absolutely stunning and we hope that this short film will prompt you to start planning your own cycling adventure on the Shimanami Kaido and Yumeshima Kaido.
We are looking forward to welcoming you to Shimanami!

title: 空ノ里（四國， 德島）
description: 昔、徳島県市区に住む人々はこの高地を「空」と呼んでいました。空の夜空には、個人住宅の蛍が星空のように輝いています。Sora-no-satoは四国市中心の「西阿波・剣山・吉野川観光区」（美馬市、三好市、つるぎ町、東みよし町）に位置しています。自然、歴史と文化、伝説と伝承、独特の食文化と伝統芸能を代表する日本の主要な観光地の一つです。25年の歴史を持ち、地域には190の民宿があり、同時に400人を収容できます。Sora-no-satoの多くの教育民宿は山の斜面に密接に位置し、独特の文化的景観を形成しています。山地、小丘、石造りの家々などの独特の風景は日本の原始的な景観であり、桃原郷とも呼ばれています。学生たちは家族の一員として歓迎され、茶摘み、玉ねぎ、ジャガイモの収穫などの持続可能な自給自足の農業に共に従事します。収穫した季節の野菜や山菜を使って、共に田舎料理を作り、家族の食事を通じて心と心の交流を行います。日本の最も厳しい生活を豊かな生活に変える方法を学びます。

title: Sora-no-sato (Shikoku, Tokushima)
description: A long time ago, the people living in the urban area of Tokushima Prefecture referred to this high-altitude area as 'Sora'. In the night sky of Sora, the fireflies from private homes shine brightly like stars. Sora-no-sato is located in the 'Nishiawa-Tsurugisan-Yoshinogawa Tourist Area' in the center of Shikoku (Mima City, Miyoshi City, Tsurugi Town, Higashimiyoshi Town). It is one of Japan's leading tourist areas, representing nature, history and culture, legends and folklore, as well as unique food culture and traditional performing arts. With a history of 25 years, there are 190 private accommodations in the area that can accommodate 400 people at the same time. Many educational guesthouses of Sora-no-sato are located in villages close to the mountains, forming a unique cultural landscape. The unique scenery of mountains, small hills, stone houses, etc., is Japan's original landscape, also known as Momohara Village. Students are welcomed as family members and engage together in sustainable self-sufficient agriculture, such as tea picking, onion, and potato harvesting. Using the seasonal vegetables and wild vegetables harvested, we cook rural cuisine together and exchange hearts and minds through family meals. You will learn how to turn one of Japan's harshest lives into a prosperous life.

title: Mimakara Chili Pepper
description: Mimakara chili pepper is a fresh and flavorful product that is harvested at the peak ripeness of the mimakara chili pepper, carefully dried, and meticulously cleaned to remove impurities. Despite being very spicy, it has a rich flavor and is well-received as a seasoning and condiment for various dishes.

title: Globally Important Agricultural Heritage Systems , Nishi-awa , Sora no Sato, Sora no Sato
description: This video introduces the initiative created by “Sora no Sato”, which aim to pass on food, agriculture, and lifestyle culture in the Nishi-Awa area of Tokushima, a region with a declining birthrate and aging population. In order to increase the number of immigrants and farmers in the area and to sustain the community by turning agriculture into a business, the project includes teaching food and farming culture to students on educational trips from city schools and to local children.

title: 世界的に重要な農業遺産システム、仁尾地区、空の里、空の里

description: 近年人気の低山登山。気負わずに自然を身近に感じることが出来ます。周囲を山で囲まれた丹波山村ならではの活動です。また、この尾根道は「生活道として使われた道」や「水源管理の作業道」として当時の人々にとって大切なインフラでした。この道を人々がどう守り、歩いてきたのかに思いをはせてみましょう。

Let's think about how people have protected and walked this road.

It is said that during the era of Takeda Shingen, a gold mine magistrate was established in Tamabayama Village for the mining of the Kurokawa Gold Mine. Remnants of this can still be found within the village, and we will head to the gold mine site with a guide.
As you walk along the stream, which is also a source of water for Tokyo, please experience the blessings of water with all your senses.

title: TABAワークセンター紹介動画「たばやまワーケーション」
description:
声優・雨宮天さんに、自然豊かな丹波山村でワーケーションしていただきました！

2022年6月に営業開始予定のTABAワークセンター（山梨県丹波山村）は、コワーキングスペースや宿泊もできる個室を備えたテレワーク施設です。施設の詳細情報はTwitterなどで発信予定。

たばやま観光推進機構Twitter
https://twitter.com/tabayamaksk

◯丹波山村について
東京都と山梨県の県境に位置し、多摩川の上流域、奥多摩をさらに遡り、丹波川と名前を変えた美しい渓流が流れる丹波山村。日本百名山に数えられる雲取山をはじめ、飛龍山、大菩薩嶺など秩父多摩甲斐国立公園の険しい山々に囲まれ、トレッキングや渓流釣り、キャンプなどの人気スポットもたくさんあります。古くは大菩薩越えの宿場町として賑わい、江戸時代からの伝統行事が今も受け継がれている小さな村です。

お仕事や創作の合間に村のアウトドアアクティビティもぜひ楽しんでください！

title: TABA Work Center Introduction Video 'Tabayama Workation'
description:
Voice actor Sora Amamiya has experienced a workation in the nature-rich Tabayama Village!

The TABA Work Center (located in Tabayama Village, Yamanashi Prefecture) is scheduled to open in June 2022 and features coworking spaces and private rooms for accommodation, making it a telework facility. Detailed information about the facility will be shared on Twitter and other platforms.

Tabayama Tourism Promotion Organization Twitter
https://twitter.com/tabayamaksk

◯ About Tabayama Village
Located on the border between Tokyo and Yamanashi Prefectures, Tabayama Village is situated in the upper reaches of the Tama River, further upstream from Okutama, where the beautiful stream changes its name to the Tamagawa. Surrounded by the rugged mountains of Chichibu-Tama-Kai National Park, including Mount Kumotori, Hiryu Mountain, and Daibosatsu Ridge, it offers many popular spots for trekking, river fishing, and camping. Historically, it thrived as a post town on the Daibosatsu Pass, and traditional events from the Edo period are still passed down in this small village.

Please enjoy the village's outdoor activities during your work or creative breaks!

● Learning through experiencing the work of farmers that the rice we usually eat comes from small seedlings, and triggering gratitude for food and farmers.
● Experiencing that many living creatures inhabit the rice fields.
● Playing and becoming familiar with the rice fields we usually see, getting muddy.

However, this year, due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic during the rice planting season, participation was limited to staff only.
We filmed the rice planting process at that time.

title: 風になって、遊ぼう。～ジブリパークのある愛知～（フルバージョン）
description:
【「風になって、遊ぼう。」特設サイト】
https://www.aichi-now.jp/kaze/

【概要】
豊かな自然、モノづくりの伝統、多くの武将を生み出した歴史－－、
そんな魅力あふれる愛知県に、
2022年11月1日、「ジブリパーク」がオープンします。
「ジブリパークのある愛知」の魅力を、
スタジオジブリが観光動画として描き出しました。

作品を貫いているのは、ジブリ作品に通底する、
風や飛翔、走る喜びや、歴史を感じるノスタルジー。

ドローンによる空撮を中心とした映像を、
映画監督の中川龍太郎、
映像ディレクターのUssiy、
音楽の岩崎太整が、
愛知県を舞台に描き出します。

題字は鈴木敏夫プロデューサー、
作中に登場する版画は、版画家・宮崎敬介氏の作品です。

【ストーリー】
森の中で、旅人が残した鞄から、羽根の版画を見つけた少女。
その脇を「風」が飛び去っていく。
少女は、その「風」を追うままに、
愛知県内各地を駆けぬけ、
「サツキとメイの家」で、羽根を見つける……。

羽根を運ぶ風になって駆ける、少女の冒険物語。 

【メイキング映像】
本作の映像ディレクターを務めたUssiyが、
県内各地で行われたロケや
こだわりの編集の様子などを記録したメイキング映像。
「風になって、遊ぼう。」誕生までの日々をご覧ください。
https://youtu.be/drbaGIBw6GE

【キャスト･スタッフ】
監督：中川 龍太郎
映像ディレクター：Ussiy
音楽：岩崎 太整
出演：園原 らら（EXPG STUDIO）
プロデューサー：石井 朋彦
企画・題字：鈴木 敏夫
制作：スタジオジブリ
製作：愛知県

title: Let's Play in the Wind: Aichi with Ghibli Park (Full Version)
description:
【'Let's Play in the Wind' Special Site】
https://www.aichi-now.jp/kaze/

【Overview】
In Aichi Prefecture, rich in nature, traditional craftsmanship, and a history that has produced many warriors, the 'Ghibli Park' will open on November 1, 2022. The charm of 'Aichi with Ghibli Park' is depicted in a tourism video by Studio Ghibli.

What runs through the work is the wind, flight, the joy of running, and the nostalgia of feeling history, which are common themes in Ghibli works.

The film, centered on aerial shots taken by drones, is directed by Ryutaro Nakagawa, with video direction by Ussiy and music by Taisei Iwasaki, all set in Aichi Prefecture.

The title is by producer Toshio Suzuki, and the woodblock prints appearing in the film are by printmaker Keisuke Miyazaki.

【Story】
A girl finds a feather woodblock print from a bag left by a traveler in the forest. A 'wind' rushes by her. Following that 'wind', the girl runs through various places in Aichi Prefecture and finds the feather at 'Satsuki and Mei's House'...

An adventure story of a girl running as the wind carrying the feather.

【Making-of Video】
Ussiy, the video director of this work, recorded the locations and the meticulous editing process that took place across the prefecture in a making-of video. Please take a look at the days leading up to the birth of 'Let's Play in the Wind.'
https://youtu.be/drbaGIBw6GE

【Cast & Staff】
Director: Ryutaro Nakagawa
Video Director: Ussiy
Music: Taisei Iwasaki
Starring: Rara Sonohara (EXPG STUDIO)
Producer: Tomohiko Ishii
Planning & Title: Toshio Suzuki
Production: Studio Ghibli
Production: Aichi Prefecture

Please use this as a reference for your trip or sightseeing in Ishikawa Prefecture. It is said that a single white heron discovered the hot spring source, making it a historic hot spring area with a 1200-year history. During the feudal era, it became popular as a hot spring resort, and even in the present day, Wakura Onsen remains a popular hot spring town. You can enjoy foot baths while gazing at the tranquil Nanao Bay and Noto Island, as well as the Noto Island Bridge. Please use this as a reference for your trip or sightseeing in Ishikawa.
As it is said, "Kaga Hyakumangoku," Kanazawa has been a place rich in food and culture since ancient times, and its brilliance can still be seen everywhere today. Kanazawa is also one of the best places in Japan for delicious sushi. The reason is undoubtedly the environment. Ishikawa Prefecture, where Kanazawa is located, is surrounded by the Hakusan and Tateyama mountain ranges, providing delicious water that nurtures great rice. Additionally, the calm Toyama Bay and Noto Peninsula are fed by cold underground water and nutrient-rich streams. The Sea of Japan off the Noto Peninsula, where warm and cold currents meet, creates a rich feeding ground. Thanks to the diverse marine environment, a wide variety of fresh seafood gathers here. title: 【ドローン映像】大桑城跡 | 「戦国のメインステージ岐阜」
description:
大桑城は、室町時代から戦国時代にかけて権勢を誇った、美濃国の守護土岐氏の山城です。天文4（1535）年に発生した長良川の大洪水により、枝広（現在の岐阜市長良公園）にあった守護所は大きな被害を受けました。これを受けて土岐氏は、大桑に守護所を移し、城と城下町を整備したとされています。天文12（1543）年、勢力を増していた斎藤道三との間に大きな戦いが起こり、大桑城は落城したと考えられています。

title: [Drone Footage] Okuwa Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Sengoku Period in Gifu'
description:
Okuwa Castle is a mountain castle of the Toki clan, who held power in Mino Province from the Muromachi period to the Sengoku period. In 1535, a major flood of the Nagara River caused significant damage to the guardian's base located in Ebihiro (now Nagara Park in Gifu City). In response, the Toki clan moved their base to Okuwa and is said to have developed the castle and the castle town. In 1543, a major battle occurred between the Toki clan and the increasingly powerful Saito Dosan, leading to the fall of Okuwa Castle.

title: 【ドローン映像】小島城跡 | 「戦国のメインステージ岐阜」
description:
小島城跡は姉小路氏三家の一家・小島氏の居城です。高原郷と小島郷を結ぶ神原峠の峠道が脇を通る交通の要衝に位置し、高原郷からの敵の侵入を睨んでいます。姉小路氏城跡は古川城跡、小島城跡、野口城跡、向小島城跡、小鷹利城跡という5つの城跡の総称で、飛騨市古川町などにあります。令和6年2月21日、その歴史的価値が評価されて国史跡に指定されました。

title: [Drone Footage] Kojima Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Warring States in Gifu'
description:
The Kojima Castle Ruins are the residence of the Kojima clan, one of the three branches of the Anekoji clan. It is located at a strategic point along the mountain pass connecting Takahara and Kojima, overseeing the potential invasion of enemies from Takahara. The Anekoji clan castle ruins refer to a collective of five castle ruins: Furukawa Castle, Kojima Castle, Noguchi Castle, Mukokojima Castle, and Kotakatori Castle, located in places like Furukawa Town in Hida City. On February 21, 2024, its historical value was recognized, and it was designated as a national historic site.

description:
大垣城は、美濃守護・土岐一族の宮川吉左衛門尉安定により、天文4年（1535年）に創建されたと伝えられています。江戸時代の大垣城は、城郭絵図によると水堀を幾重にもめぐらせた大変規模の大きな城郭でした。関ケ原の戦いでは、西軍・石田三成の本拠地となりました。その後、戸田氏が入城し、大垣藩十万石を明治時代まで治めました。

description:
Ogaki Castle is said to have been founded in the 4th year of Tenbun (1535) by Miyakawa Yoshizaemon-no-Suke Yasutaka of the Toki clan, the guardians of Mino. According to Edo period castle maps, Ogaki Castle was a large fortress surrounded by multiple moats. During the Battle of Sekigahara, it became the base of the Western Army led by Ishida Mitsunari. Later, the Toda clan took control of the castle and governed the Ogaki Domain of 100,000 koku until the Meiji period.

title: [Drone Footage] Gifu Castle | 'The Main Stage of the Warring States Period in Gifu'
description:
It is said that the first fort was built on the summit of Kinka Mountain by Nikaido Yamashiro no Kami Yoshinari, who served the Kamakura Shogunate. During the Warring States period, it was also the residence of Saito Dosan. Particularly, the name of Gifu Castle was made known throughout the land when, in the 10th year of Eiroku (1567), Oda Nobunaga conquered this castle, renaming the place from 'Iguchi' to 'Gifu' and establishing it as the base for his unification of the country.

title: [Drone Footage] Iwamura Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Sengoku Period in Gifu'
description:
Iwamura Castle is considered one of Japan's three great mountain castles, alongside Takatori Castle in Nara Prefecture and Matsuyama Castle in Okayama Prefecture, and it has also been selected as one of Japan's 100 Famous Castles. The castle was built at the highest elevation (717m) among the various Edo period feudal lords' castles, utilizing the steep terrain with a height difference of 180m to create a formidable mountain fortress. The fog-prone weather has also been utilized in the castle's construction, earning it the nickname 'Kiri no Shiro' (Castle of Fog).

description:
永禄元年（1558年）、この地で権力を持っていた岩手氏を竹中重元と息子・重治（半兵衛）が攻め落とし、翌年菩提山に城を築いたとされています。
菩提山城は、竪堀や高低差の大きい堀切が複雑に組み合わさった大規模な山城です。塁はすべて土塁であり、石塁が見られないのが特徴で、最も完成型に近い土塁による城郭といわれています。

title: [Drone Footage] Bodaisan Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Warring States in Gifu'
description:
In the first year of Eiroku (1558), it is said that Takeuchi Shigemoto and his son Shigeharu (Hanbei) attacked the Iwate clan, who held power in this area, and built a castle on Bodaisan the following year.
Bodaisan Castle is a large mountain castle with a complex combination of vertical moats and significant elevation differences. The ramparts are all earthen mounds, and it is characterized by the absence of stone walls, being regarded as the most complete example of an earthen mound castle.

title: [Drone Footage] Naegi Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Sengoku Period in Gifu'
description:
Naegi Castle was built by the Naegi Toyama clan during the Sengoku period (around 1526). The stone walls constructed using natural giant stones are quite rare in the country. At places like Oyakura, you can see stone walls stacked in a way that embraces the rocks.
Additionally, one of the features is that the stone walls are built using different techniques depending on the era, and it has also been selected as one of the 100 Famous Castles of Japan.

description:

美濃金山城跡は、約400年前の石垣が当時の姿のまま残されており、戦国時代の息づかいを肌で感じることができる貴重な城跡で、平成25年に国史跡に指定され、続日本100名城にも選ばれています。

title: [Drone Footage] Mino Kanayama Castle Ruins | 'The Main Stage of the Warring States in Gifu'
description:
It is said that Kōfū Castle was built in 1537 (Tembun 6) on the summit of Kōjōyama in Kani City, which boasts one of the best views in the city, by Saitō Masayoshi, the adopted son of Dosan. Later, Mori Kanetaka received the castle from Nobunaga and became the lord, renaming it 'Kanayama Castle,' which served as the residence of the Mori clan for about 35 years.

The Mino Kanayama Castle Ruins preserve stone walls from about 400 years ago in their original form, making it a valuable site where one can feel the breath of the Warring States period. In 2013, it was designated as a national historic site and selected as one of the Continued 100 Famous Castles of Japan.

title: Cormorant Fishing on the Nagara River Promotion Video (short version)
description: In this video, we will show you what Gifu cormorant fishing on the Nagara River is like, including the trust that a cormorant fishing master has with his cormorants and the beautiful night scene of the six cormorant fishing boats moving across the river. Gifu cormorant fishing on the Nagara River, one of the 'Three Clear-Flowing Rivers in Japan', is the largest-scale cormorant fishing performed in Japan, and one of the best parts of experiencing it is enjoying great food on the viewing boats and the company of those around you. Of course, one also can’t forget the six cormorant fishing boats traveling across the river against the beautiful night landscape. The comedic icon, Charlie Chaplin, repeatedly remarked how wonderful the experience was when he viewed it. Come experience for yourself what Gifu cormorant fishing on the Nagara River is all about!

title: 長良川の鵜飼いプロモーションビデオ（短縮版）
description: このビデオでは、長良川での岐阜の鵜飼いがどのようなものか、鵜飼いの達人が鵜と持つ信頼関係や、川を横切る6隻の鵜飼いの船の美しい夜景を紹介します。長良川での岐阜の鵜飼いは、日本の「三大清流」の一つであり、日本で行われる最大規模の鵜飼いです。その体験の一番の魅力は、観覧船での美味しい食事と周りの人々との交流を楽しむことです。もちろん、美しい夜の風景の中を進む6隻の鵜飼いの船も忘れてはいけません。コメディのアイコン、チャーリー・チャップリンも、彼が見たときの素晴らしさを繰り返し語っていました。岐阜の長良川での鵜飼いがどのようなものか、ぜひ自分自身で体験してみてください！

title: ぎふ長良川の鵜飼プロモーションビデオ(ショートver.)
description: 「ぎふ長良川の鵜飼」の実際の鵜飼観光の様子、鵜匠と鵜の信頼関係、６艘が織りなす幽玄な世界をご紹介します。日本三大清流長良川において行われる岐阜市の鵜飼は、日本で最大規模であり、その醍醐味は観覧船での団欒や食事。そして何より目の前で６艘の壮大な風景を見ることにあります。かつて、喜劇王「チャールズ・チャップリン」が観覧し、「wonderful！」と連呼した「ぎふ長良川の鵜飼」を是非体験してください。

title: Gifu Nagaragawa Cormorant Fishing Promotion Video (Short Version)
description: This video introduces the actual cormorant fishing tourism of 'Gifu Nagaragawa Cormorant Fishing', the trust relationship between the cormorant master and the cormorants, and the ethereal world created by six boats. The cormorant fishing in Gifu City, held in the Nagara River, one of Japan's three major clear streams, is the largest in Japan, and its charm lies in the camaraderie and dining on the viewing boats. Above all, it is about witnessing the magnificent scenery of six boats right in front of you. Please experience the 'Gifu Nagaragawa Cormorant Fishing', which was once watched by the comedy king 'Charles Chaplin', who repeatedly exclaimed 'wonderful!'

title: 【岐阜市×東京カメラ部「岐阜城　千変万化」】プロモーションムービー
description:
【岐阜市×東京カメラ部「岐阜城　千変万化」プロモーションムービー】を公開中です！

岐阜市にある金華山（きんかざん）の頂上近くにそびえる岐阜城。岐阜市のシンボルであり、かつて斎藤道三や織田信長が居を構えたことでも知られています。

今回は東京カメラ部10選 小林淳氏とTatsuki Ito氏に、そんな岐阜城を写真と動画で撮影していただきました。

岐阜在住の写真家でも普段なかなか見ることができない角度からも岐阜城の魅力を捉えています。四季折々の風景もお楽しみいただけるインパクトのある映像になっていますので、ぜひ「岐阜城　千変万化」をご覧ください！

title: Gifu City x Tokyo Camera Club 'Gifu Castle: Ever-Changing'
description:
The promotional movie for 'Gifu Castle: Ever-Changing' by Gifu City and Tokyo Camera Club is now available!

Gifu Castle, towering near the summit of Mount Kinka in Gifu City, is a symbol of Gifu City and is known for being the residence of historical figures such as Saito Dosan and Oda Nobunaga.

This time, photographers Jun Kobayashi and Tatsuki Ito from the Tokyo Camera Club's top 10 have captured the charm of Gifu Castle through photos and videos.

They have captured the beauty of Gifu Castle from angles that even local photographers rarely see. The impactful visuals allow you to enjoy the seasonal landscapes, so please check out 'Gifu Castle: Ever-Changing'!

昨年のプロモーションムービー「WELCOME BACK」では「観光再開」を掲げ、地元の方達より皆様へ届ける「おかえり」を表現しました。

異国の食文化、地元の食産物。

title: 2025年度森の京都文化観光サポーターラジオ 第3回「丹波漆＆やくの木と漆の館」
description:
京都FM丹波のラジオ番組「森の京都presents どぅゆの～？伝統文化 in 福知山」の放送音声です。前シリーズ「知っとる？伝統文化 in 福知山」から2年、今シリーズはレギュラーゲストに福知山に住むアイルランド出身のカハルさんを迎え、福知山市の無形文化財や伝統文化を取り上げます。

第3回「丹波漆＆やくの木と漆の館」
前半は、日本の漆の歴史や海外では漆の代わりに何が使われていたかを紹介します。
後半は、福知山市夜久野町にある「やくの木と漆の館」から、館長の平岡 明子さんをゲストに迎えました。やくの木と漆の館では、丹波漆の紹介や漆かきに使われる道具が展示されている他、漆塗りや金継きの体験ができます。館ではどのような事をしているのか、また丹波漆のPRにも力を入れておられる館長にその想いを話していただきました。

【森の京都文化観光サポーター＆レギュラーゲスト Profile】 
近藤 美紀：サポーター5年目。福知山出身、3児の母でバリスタ、英語教室経営、英語ガイドなどいろいろな分野で働くマルチ人間。趣味は映画・ドラマ鑑賞、洞窟・廃墟の探検 。

公庄 美保子：サポーター3年目。福知山出身、2児の母。猟師。狩猟は誰だって出来る！をモットーに、福知山市有害駆除隊員として活動中。捕獲した鹿肉を使い犬用ジャーキーを加工販売(屋号　鹿鹿)、藍愛プロジェクトリーダー。

カハル・オカラハン：アイルランド出身で福知山市在住2年目で子供達に英語を教えています。日本の伝統文化や伝統芸能にとても興味があります。心の優しいスポーツマン。只今日本語猛勉強中です。

title: 2025 Forest Kyoto Cultural Tourism Supporter Radio Episode 3: 'Tamba Lacquer & Yaku Wood and Lacquer Museum'
description:
This is the broadcast audio of the Kyoto FM Tanba radio program 'Forest Kyoto presents Do You Know? Traditional Culture in Fukuchiyama.' Two years have passed since the previous series 'Do You Know? Traditional Culture in Fukuchiyama,' and in this series, we welcome our regular guest, Mr. Cahill from Ireland, who lives in Fukuchiyama, to discuss the intangible cultural assets and traditional culture of Fukuchiyama.

Episode 3: 'Tamba Lacquer & Yaku Wood and Lacquer Museum'
In the first half, we will introduce the history of Japanese lacquer and what has been used instead of lacquer overseas.
In the second half, we welcomed Ms. Akiko Hiraoka, the director of the 'Yaku Wood and Lacquer Museum' located in Yakuno Town, Fukuchiyama City, as our guest. The museum showcases Tamba lacquer and tools used for lacquer application, and offers experiences in lacquer painting and kintsugi. We discussed what activities are conducted at the museum and the director's efforts in promoting Tamba lacquer.

(Mori no Kyoto Regional Promotion Association) https://morinokyoto.jp/ 
Kyoto FM Tanba Broadcasting Fukuchiyama 79.0MHz http://fukuchiyama.fm-tanba.jp/

【Forest Kyoto Cultural Tourism Supporter & Regular Guest Profile】 
Miki Kondo: 5th year supporter. From Fukuchiyama, mother of three, barista, manages an English school, and works in various fields as a multi-talented individual. Hobbies include watching movies and dramas, and exploring caves and ruins.

Mihoko Kojo: 3rd year supporter. From Fukuchiyama, mother of two. Hunter. Active as a member of the Fukuchiyama City harmful wildlife control team with the motto 'Anyone can hunt!' Processes and sells dog jerky using captured deer meat (business name: Shikashika), and is the leader of the Ai Ai Project.

Cahill O'Callaghan: Originally from Ireland, now in his second year living in Fukuchiyama, teaching English to children. Very interested in Japanese traditional culture and performing arts. A kind-hearted sportsman. Currently studying Japanese intensively.

description:

『 侍う-SABURAU- 』プロジェクト

『 侍う-SABURAU- 』とは「侍」の語源です。当プロジェクトは「侍」をテーマとし、武芸、武具を始めとする伝統文化とポップカルチャーをコラボレーションさせることでその魅力を世界に伝え、尚且つ後世に繋いでゆくことを目的としています。

若者や子ども達、海外の人びとからは、敷居が高く難解なイメージを持たれる伝統文化を、マンガ、アニメ、ゲーム等ポップカルチャーを通じ、誰もが今昔を身近に感じ、楽しんでいただける内容となっております。

2022年3月開催の『 侍う-SABURAU-展 in 錦 』では、熊本県錦町に伝わる西の天下一といわれた古流剣術「兵法タイ捨流」と「侍」を題材としたマンガやアニメ作品、オリジナルアートや映像、武具等が多数展示されます。

5. 概要
錦町にゆかりある「兵法タイ捨流」。創始から450年を経過する今も脈々と受け継がれる歴史ある日本伝統古武道の一つ。国内外の門人と共に兵法タイ捨流と日本の伝統文化を伝える活動を続けています。

兵法タイ捨流（日本遺産構成文化財）
今から約450年前の戦国時代に流祖　丸目蔵人佐(まるめくらんどのすけ)が、実戦で培った経験を工夫研究研鑽し、自分を活かし相手も活かす活殺剣法を編み出した。
タイ捨流の「タイ」という言葉には、漢字にすると「体」（からだ）「待」（まつ）「対」（つい）「退」（さがる）など多くの漢字が当てはまる。「体」を使うことを捨てる、「待つ」ことを捨てる、「対峙」することを捨てる、「退がる」ことを捨てる。
即ち、考えずに動ける自然体。自然と共に在ること。「タイ捨」という言葉にはこのような意味が込められている。
熊本県錦町ゆかりの古武道である兵法タイ捨流は、第15代上原エリ子が宗家を務め熊本県八代市に本部を置き、国内に100人、海外に70人の門下生を持ち、伝統の継承はもとより世界に伝統文化を発信する活動を行っている。平成29年5月、日本遺産 人吉球磨「相良700年が生んだ保守と進取の文化」が認定を受け、兵法タイ捨流は構成文化財の一つとして名を連ねている。
兵法タイ捨流は、日本の伝統古武道として国外で注目されている。今年2022年には、イギリスでタイ捨流の本が出版予定で、発刊プロモーションとして熊本の伝統文化を中心とした50本以上の動画をYou Tubeにて配信する取り組みが行われている。
兵法タイ捨流 剣術道場 龍泉館 公式サイト　https://www.taisharyu.jp/

これまで兵法タイ捨流は、2014年よりヨーロッパの門下生と共にタイ捨流の稽古会セミナーを開始し年間500名程がセミナーを受講。2019年にはイタリア・ヴェネツィアで開催された世界空手大会において演武披露及び日本文化を紹介する展示会「Samurai Expo侍うin ITARY」には延べ6000人が来場した。　　


国内においては、同年、国宝青井阿蘇神社（熊本県人吉市）において「Samurai Expo侍う凱旋展」を一夜限り（4時間）で開催し、500人が来場したことで大きな注目を集めた。


侍(さぶら)う―SABURAU―展では、古武道とサブカルチャーの融合展示及びイベントが行われる。サブカルチャー作品のラインラップは、少年画報社「月間アワーズ」で連載中のドリフターズ、KADOKAWA『月刊少年エース』連載の武装少女マキャヴェリズムなどが中心となる。
これらの人気作品に登場するメインキャラクターが、タイ捨流の使い手であることから原画の提供など協力体制が実現した。

熊本県錦町との関係性
熊本県南部に位置し、梨、桃など農産物の生産が盛んであり、2018年には戦後70年を経て歴史が解明された「人吉海軍航空基地」を紹介する資料館がオープンした。
町のキャッチフレーズは「剣豪とフルーツの里」。
ゆかりの剣豪「丸目蔵人佐」を顕彰した剣道大会は、これまでに51回を数える。
これまでタイ捨流の海外活動を町のプロモーション活動としてとらえ支援を行っている。2017年には、日本の文化を紹介するタイ捨流の活動と共に錦町もイタリアトリノ市長より感謝状を受けている。

title: Samurai -SABURAU- Exhibition in Nishiki ~Return to the Origin~ Starting March 12, 2022!
description:
The Nishiki Town Tourism Association will hold the 'Samurai -SABURAU- Exhibition in Nishiki ~Return to the Origin~' for 31 days from March 12 (Saturday) to April 10 (Sunday), 2022.

' Samurai -SABURAU- ' Project

' Samurai -SABURAU- ' is derived from the word 'samurai.' This project aims to convey the charm of 'samurai' by collaborating traditional culture, including martial arts and weapons, with pop culture, and to pass it on to future generations.

Through manga, anime, and games, we aim to make traditional culture, which is often perceived as highbrow and difficult by young people, children, and foreigners, accessible and enjoyable for everyone.

At the 'Samurai -SABURAU- Exhibition in Nishiki' in March 2022, numerous displays will feature the ancient swordsmanship 'Heihō Taisharyū,' known as the best in the west, passed down in Nishiki Town, Kumamoto Prefecture, as well as manga and anime works themed around 'samurai,' original art, videos, and weapons.

1. Exhibition Name
Samurai -SABURAU- Exhibition in Nishiki ~Return to the Origin~
2. Exhibition Period
March 12, 2022 (Saturday) to April 10, 2022 (Sunday) for 31 days
9:00 AM to 4:00 PM (Admission until 3:30 PM) No closed days
Date and Time
March 12, 2022 (Saturday)
Reception starts at 9:30 AM
Opening ceremony at 10:00 AM

3. Venue
Nishiki Town Historical Museum of the Navy Air Base (Nishiki Secret Base Museum)
(2-107, Kinoshita Nishi, Nishiki Town, Kumamoto Prefecture, 868-0301)
4. Admission Fee
You can view the exhibition by entering the Nishiki Town Historical Museum of the Navy Air Base.
・Adults (high school students and above) 800 yen ・Elementary and junior high school students 500 yen ・Preschool children free

5. Overview
'Heihō Taisharyū,' which has ties to Nishiki Town, is one of Japan's traditional martial arts that has been passed down for over 450 years. We continue activities to convey Heihō Taisharyū and Japanese traditional culture with disciples from both Japan and abroad.
This exhibition has been held in nine locations domestically and internationally since responding to requests for an event in Italy in 2019, and it will be the first homecoming exhibition in Nishiki Town, Kumamoto Prefecture.
The exhibition will feature displays themed around Japan's 'samurai,' demonstrations of Heihō Taisharyū, swords, national treasures from Aso Shrine, and original works related to subculture such as 'Drifters,' 'Armed Girl Machiavellism,' and original merchandise sales.
・Exhibited works (approximately 200 pieces planned)

Heihō Taisharyū (Cultural Heritage of Japan)
About 450 years ago during the Warring States period, the founder, Marume Kurando no suke, developed a sword technique that utilizes both oneself and the opponent through practical experience and research. The word 'Tai' in Taisharyū can correspond to many kanji such as '体' (body), '待' (wait), '対' (confront), and '退' (retreat). It means to discard the use of 'body,' to discard 'waiting,' to discard 'confrontation,' and to discard 'retreat.'
In other words, it is a natural state of being that can move without thinking. It embodies being in harmony with nature. The term 'Taisharyū' carries this meaning.
Heihō Taisharyū, a traditional martial art with ties to Nishiki Town, is led by the 15th generation Uehara Eriko, with its headquarters in Yatsushiro City, Kumamoto Prefecture, having 100 disciples in Japan and 70 overseas, continuing activities to transmit traditional culture to the world. In May 2017, the cultural heritage 'Cultural Heritage of Sagara born from 700 years of conservatism and innovation' was certified as a Japanese heritage, and Heihō Taisharyū is listed as one of the cultural properties.
Heihō Taisharyū is gaining attention as a traditional martial art of Japan overseas. In 2022, a book on Taisharyū is scheduled to be published in the UK, and as part of the publication promotion, over 50 videos centered on Kumamoto's traditional culture are being distributed on YouTube.
Heihō Taisharyū Kenjutsu Dojo Ryūsenkan Official Website https://www.taisharyu.jp/

Since 2014, Heihō Taisharyū has started training seminars with disciples in Europe, with about 500 participants annually. In 2019, at the World Karate Championship held in Venice, Italy, 6,000 people attended the demonstration and exhibition introducing Japanese culture 'Samurai Expo SABURAU in ITALY.'

Domestically, in the same year, a one-night-only (4 hours) 'Samurai Expo SABURAU Homecoming Exhibition' was held at the National Treasure Aso Shrine (Hitoyoshi City, Kumamoto Prefecture), attracting 500 visitors and garnering significant attention.

The Samurai -SABURAU- Exhibition will feature a fusion of traditional martial arts and subculture displays and events. The lineup of subculture works will mainly include 'Drifters,' serialized in Shōnen Gahōsha's 'Monthly Hours,' and 'Armed Girl Machiavellism,' serialized in KADOKAWA's 'Monthly Shōnen Ace.'
The main characters in these popular works are practitioners of Taisharyū, leading to a collaborative effort such as providing original drawings.

Relationship with Nishiki Town
Located in the southern part of Kumamoto Prefecture, Nishiki Town is known for its production of agricultural products such as pears and peaches. In 2018, a museum introducing the 'Hitoyoshi Navy Air Base,' whose history was clarified after 70 years post-war, opened.
The town's catchphrase is 'The Land of Swordmasters and Fruits.'
A kendo tournament honoring the swordmaster 'Marume Kurando no suke' has been held 51 times to date.
Nishiki Town has supported Heihō Taisharyū's overseas activities as part of its promotional efforts. In 2017, Nishiki Town received a letter of appreciation from the mayor of Turin, Italy, for its activities introducing Japanese culture alongside Taisharyū.

description:
Hello everyone, it's been a while! This is 'Smile Walk'. The seasons pass quickly, and just the other day I thought we had just welcomed the New Year, but before I knew it, the plum blossoms were in full bloom.

February 15, 2022
Director Patissier AYA, Apprentice TKDN

title: 【いちき串木野市】令和三年太郎太郎祭【エアお散歩】
description: 2021年3月21日、羽島崎神社春の大祭『太郎太郎祭』が催行されました。『太郎太郎祭』は、旧暦2月4日に地域をあげて豊作と豊漁を祈る祭りです。神前では「五つの祝い」という、氏子が五つになった子どもたちが、漁家の子どもは「船持（ふなもち）」、農家の子どもは「田打（たうち）」の儀礼に参加します。船持には、船型の模型を持った子どもたちと一緒に、十数名の古老たちが特別な船歌を唄いながら境内を回ります。田打では、太郎とテチョ（父親）、コッテ牛（雄牛）が登場し、田植えの様子を方言で即興を交えながら、子どもたちや観客を巻き込んで、面白おかしく演じます。豊作と豊漁を同時に祈願する祭りは非常に珍しく、県指定無形民俗文化財に登録されています。

title: Taro Taro Festival in Ichiki-Kushikino City
description: On March 21, 2021, the spring festival 'Taro Taro Festival' was held at Hashimasaki Shrine. The 'Taro Taro Festival' is a festival where the community prays for a good harvest and a good catch on the 4th day of the 2nd month of the lunar calendar. At the shrine, children who have turned five participate in a ceremony called 'Five Celebrations,' where fishing families' children take part in 'Funamochi' and farming families' children in 'Tadauchi.' During Funamochi, children holding boat-shaped models walk around the shrine grounds with several elders singing a special boat song. In Tadauchi, Taro, Techo (father), and Kotte-ushi (bull) appear, and they perform the rice planting scene in a humorous way, incorporating local dialects and engaging children and spectators. It is very rare for a festival to pray for both a good harvest and a good catch simultaneously, and it is registered as an intangible folk cultural asset designated by the prefecture.

description:
＼Minato-iro, Roman Journey.／

The comprehensive tourism guide website for Ichiki Kushikino City has been renewed!

https://ichiki-kushikino.com

In addition, a promotional short movie that condenses the charm of our city has been completed.

Ichiki Kushikino City has a background as a port town, thriving with its core industry of tuna long-distance fishing and the city of Ikki Minato, which prospered as a post town about 200 years ago. It is also home to the 'Satsuma Domain British Student Memorial Museum' in the Hashima area, the 'Kankaku' and 'Kankakuen' related to the legend of Jofuku, and the newly recognized Japanese heritage site 'Kushikino Fumoto', among many other valuable historical and cultural heritage sites.

We express Ichiki Kushikino City, where one can feel the connection between the sea and history/culture in various scenes, as 'Minato-iro, Roman Journey.'

The central lighthouse is modeled after the 'Nagasaki Nose Lighthouse', which has been watching over the safety of Kushikino Port for over half a century since 1951.

Everyone, please take a look! We sincerely look forward to welcoming you to Ichiki Kushikino City!!

description: ＼見よ、川上の舞を！／川上踊は今からおよそ400年前、五穀豊穣と平和を祈念して創始されたものと伝えられています。毎年8月26日を踊りの日と定めて踊り続けられてきましたが、戦時中から一時期中断を余儀なくされます。その後昭和39年に復活して、現在では川上踊保存会によって毎年8月末の日曜日に踊られるようになりました。鉦や太鼓を打ち鳴らし踊る様はとても勇壮華麗です。※8月26日に近い日曜日に奉納・披露。今年は8月23日に開催予定だったが、新型コロナウィルスの影響で中止に。

title: Kawakami Dance in Ichiki-Kushikino City
description: Behold the dance of Kawakami! The Kawakami dance is said to have been founded about 400 years ago to pray for abundant harvests and peace. It has been performed every year on August 26, but was temporarily suspended during wartime. It was revived in 1964 and is now performed every year on the Sunday closest to the end of August by the Kawakami Dance Preservation Society. The sight of the dancers striking bells and drums is very majestic and splendid. *It is dedicated and performed on the Sunday closest to August 26. This year, it was scheduled to be held on August 23, but was canceled due to the impact of the COVID-19 virus.

□ Video Overview:
Starting with 'Can I borrow some soy sauce?',
a soy sauce variety show!
'Why is Kagoshima's soy sauce so sweet?'
This question arose from elementary school students,
who interact with local people through 'soy sauce',
learning about local food, culture, nature, and history,
and promoting the charm of Kagoshima!!
*The title comes from the fact that in the past,
borrowing and lending seasonings like soy sauce and miso was a common practice among neighbors.

Moreover, the tourism and food industries in the prefecture,
as well as the economy and society, have been severely impacted.
In such circumstances, the children themselves thought,
'What can we do now?'
They decided on themes such as Kagoshima's nature, history,
food, and sports to learn about,
and to promote the attractions they discovered both within and outside the prefecture,
creating a group called 'Kagoshima Children's Planner'.
During the school closure period, this group held study sessions and
planning meetings online using the Zoom app,
and decided to create a video themed around 'soy sauce'.

description: 『七夕踊』の起源は約４００年前に遡り島津義弘公の朝鮮の役での活躍を称え踊られたのが始まりと伝えられています。太鼓踊りを中心に牛・虎・鶴・鹿などの作り物や、大名行列、琉球王行列、薙刀行列、甲冑行列などの行列ものが繰り出します。踊りを奉納する場所も多く大里地区の様々な神や先祖霊に祈りを捧げることで豊作を願っています。国指定重要無形文化財に指定されていますが、近年の人口減少や高齢化などにより『七夕踊』の存続が困難になってきており、本年をもって休止するとの発表がありました。しかし、コロナ禍により今年の開催は中止となり、来年が『七夕踊』最後の開催となる予定です。

title: Tanabata Dance in Ichiki-Kushikino City
description: The origin of the 'Tanabata Dance' dates back about 400 years, said to have begun as a celebration of the achievements of Lord Shimazu Yoshihiro during the Korean campaign. The dance features a drum dance at its center, along with creations of cows, tigers, cranes, and deer, as well as parades such as the Daimyo procession, Ryukyu king procession, naginata procession, and armored procession. There are many places where the dance is dedicated, and prayers are offered to various gods and ancestral spirits in the Osato area for a bountiful harvest. It has been designated as an Important Intangible Cultural Asset by the country, but due to recent population decline and aging, the continuation of the 'Tanabata Dance' has become difficult, and it has been announced that it will be suspended this year. However, this year's event has been canceled due to the COVID-19 pandemic, and next year is expected to be the last performance of the 'Tanabata Dance.'

title: 【いちき串木野市】荒川びょうびょう祭【エアお散歩】
description: 2年に1度行われる『荒川びょうびょう祭』。長閑な田園劇ですが、どこかロックな雰囲気を感じてしまうのは、台本のない即興劇で繰り広げられる、演者の息の合った掛け合いと、「さつまことば」が生み出すグルーブではないかと、わたしは推察しています。と、小難しいこと抜きでとても楽しいお祭りですので、どうぞご覧ください♪「さつまことば（かごんま弁）」のヒアリング練習にもどうぞ！(笑)

title: Arakawa Byobyo Festival in Ichiki-Kushikino City
description: The 'Arakawa Byobyo Festival' is held every two years. It is a tranquil rural theater, but there is a rock-like atmosphere that I suspect comes from the improvised performances without a script, the well-coordinated exchanges between the performers, and the groove created by the 'Satsuma dialect'. It's a very enjoyable festival, so please take a look! Feel free to use it for hearing practice of the 'Satsuma dialect' (Kagoshima dialect)! (laughs)

title: 【燃ゆる感動】ゆめ〜KIBAIYANSE〜【かごしま国体】
description:
『燃ゆる感動かごしま国体・かごしま大会』
公式イメージソング、『ゆめ〜KIBAIYANSE〜』
のダンス動画です。
本市のスポーツ推進委員の皆さんにより、
昨年の市来祇園祭前夜祭で披露されたダンス
の様子を動画でお届けします！

KIBAIYANSE！（キバイヤンセ！）は、
鹿児島弁で「頑張れ！」の意味があります。
新型コロナウィルス感染拡大の影響で、
大変な状況になっていますが、
全ての皆さまへ、この想い届きますように。

チェスト！キバレー！！

title: Taro Taro Festival in Ichiki-Kushikino City
description: A spring festival held every year on the 4th day of the 2nd month of the lunar calendar at Hashimasaki Shrine. It is a rare festival that prays for both a good harvest and a good catch. This time, we will deliver the scene of 'Tachibuchi' praying for a good harvest! Enjoy a comical improvisational play by Techo (father), Taro, and Kotte-ushi!

description: 香川で過ごす、極上の休日。「世界の宝石」と称される瀬戸内海の島々を巡る旅に出かけませんか。多彩な魅力をもつ島々を巡り、香川にしかない美しい風景や人、アートなどに出会いながら、自分だけの“特別”を見つけてください。

title: Kagawa's Exquisite Holiday (Chū and Nishi San)
description: Spend an exquisite holiday in Kagawa. How about embarking on a journey to explore the islands of the Seto Inland Sea, known as the 'jewels of the world'? While touring the islands with diverse attractions, encounter the beautiful landscapes, people, and art unique to Kagawa, and discover your own 'special' experience.

description:

title: Kagawa's Ultimate Holiday: Awashima, Shishijima, Ibukijima, and Shonai Peninsula
description:
Awashima, where you can enjoy the art of artists as well as the my art created by the island's residents. Shishijima, where a 1200-year-old camphor tree tells the island's mysteries. Ibukijima, known for its lively fishermen and famous Ibuki iriko. Shonai Peninsula, which juts out into the deep blue Seto Inland Sea, allowing you to enjoy the beauty of multiple islands. Even among the islands of the same Seto Inland Sea, you can enjoy each unique charm.
Check out more videos here! → http://www.my-kagawa.jp/udon-ken/shimatabi.html

title: かがわ極上休日　本島・高見島
description:
昔ながらの趣が漂う町並みが残る本島。江戸時代の隆盛の歴史を残し、ゆっくりと歩いていると、ノスタルジックな風景に時間の流れを忘れてしまいそう。また、島のほとんどが山になっている高見島では、山の急斜面を利用して自然石を積み上げた石垣の集落を見ることができ、懐かしいひとときを感じさせます。
その他の映像はこちら！→http://www.my-kagawa.jp/udon-ken/shimatabi.html

title: Kagawa's Exquisite Holiday: Honjima and Takamijima
description:
Honjima, with its streets that retain the charm of bygone days. 
With a history of prosperity from the Edo period, as you stroll slowly, you might forget the passage of time in the nostalgic scenery. 
On Takamijima, where most of the island is mountainous, you can see villages with stone walls made of natural stones stacked on the steep slopes, evoking a sense of nostalgia.

title: 小豆島　極上のロマンチック
description: 大自然の迫力を目前に悠久の時間が流れる島。ここでは、時間の流れとともに姿を変えるアートや自然を見つめながら、ロマンチックな気分に浸ることができます。また、人の力だけではなし得ない自然のパワーが凝縮された食を味わうことができます。

title: Shodoshima: Exquisite Romance
description: An island where the grandeur of nature unfolds before you and time flows eternally. Here, you can immerse yourself in a romantic mood while gazing at the art and nature that change with the passage of time. You can also savor food that encapsulates the power of nature, which cannot be achieved by human effort alone.

title: 女木島　極上の風が吹く

title: Megijima: A Breeze of Perfection

At the port, art that captures the wind gently welcomes visitors. 
At the summit of the mountain located almost in the center of the island, there is a large cave, which is the origin of its nickname 'Oni Island.' 
From the observation deck, where you can enjoy a panoramic view of the Seto Inland Sea, the blowing wind lightens your heart.

The blessings of the island, enjoyed while feeling the flowing time and being close to nature and art, fill both the heart and the stomach.

title: 世界かんがい施設遺産　十石堀
description:
【十石堀の概要と特徴】
　農民自らの意志と計画により350年前の1669年に当時の松井村（現北茨城市中郷町松井）の庄屋沼田主計が中心となって建設した延長約13㎞のかんがい施設であり、集水域の異なる2つの沢を導水路「堀割」で繋いで水源開発を行ったことや、自然地形の沢を利用した用水路などが技術的特徴です。受益面積は78㏊で、その維持管理は建設以来、住民によって行われ、現在は、利水する3地域（北茨城市中郷町松井、日棚、粟野）の住民で構成される「十石堀維持管理協議会」が中心となり行っています。
　令和元年9月「世界かんがい施設遺産」に登録

参考
※世界かんがい施設遺産登録制度
ICID（国際かんがい排水委員会）によって2014年に創設された制度であり、かんがいの歴史・発展を明らかにし、理解醸成を図るとともに、かんがい施設の適切な保全に資するために、歴史的なかんがい施設を認定する制度

title: World Irrigation Heritage: Jikkohori
description:
[Overview and Features of Jikkohori]

It is an irrigation facility approximately 13 km long, constructed in 1669 by Numata Kakei, the village headman of Matsui Village (now Nakagou Town, Kitaibaraki City), based on the will and plans of the farmers themselves. The technical features include the development of water sources by connecting two streams with different catchment areas through a waterway called 'Horikiri' and the use of natural terrain streams for irrigation channels. The area benefiting from this facility is 78 hectares, and its maintenance has been carried out by the residents since its construction. Currently, the 'Jikkohori Maintenance Management Council,' composed of residents from three areas (Matsui, Hinata, and Awano in Nakagou Town, Kitaibaraki City), is primarily responsible for this maintenance.

Registered as a 'World Irrigation Heritage' in September 2019.

Reference
* World Irrigation Heritage Registration System
This system was established in 2014 by ICID (International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage) to clarify the history and development of irrigation, promote understanding, and contribute to the proper conservation of irrigation facilities by certifying historical irrigation facilities.

Phone: 0293-46-1086 (Reservation)

title: Trekking to the Famous Waterfall of 60m Drop - Nanatsutaki in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture
description:
※Currently, the approach to Nanatsutaki from the first parking lot of Hanazono Shrine is closed due to a landslide (no entry).

Nanatsutaki is an impressive waterfall boasting a drop of 60m, located in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
It is situated in the Hanazono Valley, created by the erosion of the 'Hanazono River' originating near 'Hanazono Mountain', and is accessible via the approach to the inner shrine of Hanazono Shrine.

Although the width of the waterfall is narrow, it cascades down in seven tiers from the first to the seventh waterfall.
There is a legend that the central pool of the waterfall connects to the sea off the coast of Tenpizuyama in Isohara, where seaweed grows and abalone are believed to inhabit.
In the past, the famous Tokugawa Mitsukuni (Mito Komon) is said to have ordered his retainers to enter the pool to confirm its depth, according to local folklore.

description:
茨城県北茨城市で“海上での安全”と“豊漁”を祈願するために、5年に1度開催される『常陸大津の御船祭』

大津町に鎮座する佐波波地祇（さわわちぎ）神社の大祭で、1726年頃から始まり、2017年には国指定重要無形民俗文化財に登録された歴史あるお祭りです。

御霊遷しの儀により、神様を神輿に宿し、全長約14ｍ幅約3ｍの祭事船に乗せます。

神輿が乗ったことで『神船』となった船を曳き手たちが曳き、陸路を走ります。

船には“車輪が付いておらず”、ソロバンと呼ばれる木桁の上を走ります。
このような形で神が宿った木造の祭事船が陸路渡御を行う祭りは、全国でも北茨城市だけと言われています。

最大の見せ場は、祭り2日目の本祭りで神船が直角に曲がるところ。
曳き手が神船を大きく左右に揺すり、約7トンの神船が向きを変えます。


船底と木桁との摩擦で白い煙が立ち上がり、集まった観衆から歓声と拍手が湧き起ります。

次回開催は、2024年5月2日（宵祭り）・3日（本祭り）

title: [Subtitles ON Recommended] A Festival Where Ships Run on Land!! Hitachi Otsu's Mikoshi Festival - Ibaraki Prefecture, Kitaibaraki City, Otsu Recommended Event Festival Next Time in 2024 -
description:
The 'Hitachi Otsu Mikoshi Festival' is held once every five years in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture, to pray for 'safety at sea' and 'bountiful catches.'

This grand festival is held at the Sawawachigi Shrine in Otsu Town and has a history dating back to around 1726. In 2017, it was registered as an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Asset by the national government.

During the ritual of transferring the spirit, the deity is enshrined in a portable shrine and placed on a ceremonial boat measuring approximately 14 meters in length and 3 meters in width.

With the portable shrine aboard, the boat becomes a 'divine ship' and is pulled by participants as it runs on land.

The boat does not have 'wheels' and runs on wooden beams called 'soroban.'
This type of festival, where a wooden ceremonial boat inhabited by a deity travels on land, is said to be unique to Kitaibaraki City in Japan.

The highlight of the festival is on the second day, during the main festival, when the divine ship makes a right-angle turn.
The participants sway the divine ship vigorously from side to side, changing the direction of the approximately 7-ton vessel.

White smoke rises from the friction between the bottom of the boat and the wooden beams, eliciting cheers and applause from the gathered crowd.

The next event will be held on May 2, 2024 (evening festival) and May 3 (main festival).
Please come and experience the powerful 'Hitachi Otsu Mikoshi Festival'!!

description: 茨城県北茨城市にある『和尚山』は、標高804mで茨城百名山の一つです。同じく茨城百名山に数えられる『栄蔵室』や『花園山』も北茨城市関本町才丸・小川に位置しています。北茨城ICから花園神社方面に車を進め、県道27号を走ります。花園オートキャンプ場や花園渓谷、亀谷地湿原入り口を通過し、関本町小川方面へ向かいます。亀谷地湿原入り口から約3キロ走ると、左側に駐車場（砂利敷き）、右側に登山口が見えてきます。和尚山は標高804mですが、登山口の標高も高いため、獲得標高は130m程度で、登山口から山頂までは約15分で到着するプチトレッキングコースです。花園オートキャンプ場でのキャンプ2日目にサクッと登れるおすすめの山です。山頂前の勾配はなかなかのものなので、小さいお子様（未就学児）には少し難易度が高いかもしれません。下山後は中郷温泉通りゃんせで汗を流し、旅の疲れを癒してください。

title: Ibaraki Hyakumeizan Osho Mountain: A Short Trekking Experience / Recommended Trekking in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture
description: Osho Mountain, located in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture, has an elevation of 804m and is one of the Ibaraki Hyakumeizan. Other mountains counted among the Ibaraki Hyakumeizan, such as Eizōmuro and Hanazono Mountain, are also located in the same area. Drive from Kitaibaraki IC towards Hanazono Shrine along Prefectural Road 27. Pass by Hanazono Auto Campground, Hanazono Valley, and the entrance to Kamegajichi Wetland, heading towards Sekimoto Town Ogawa. After about 3 kilometers from the entrance to Kamegajichi Wetland, you will see a parking lot (gravel) on the left and the trailhead on the right. Although Osho Mountain has an elevation of 804m, the elevation at the trailhead is also high, so the total elevation gain is about 130m, and it takes about 15 minutes to reach the summit from the trailhead, making it a short trekking course. It is a recommended mountain that can be easily climbed on the second day of camping at Hanazono Auto Campground. The slope before the summit is quite steep, so it may be a bit challenging for small children (preschoolers). After descending, please relax and refresh yourself at Nakago Onsen Toriyanse.

title: Let's Go See the Skunk Cabbage in Early April Every Year! Kameyachi Wetland [Recommended Tourist Spot in Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture]
description:
Kameyachi Wetland, located in the Ogawa area of Sekimoto Town, Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
About a 30-minute drive from Kitaibaraki IC towards Hanazono Valley. After passing Hanazono Valley, there is a parking area (roadside) along Prefectural Route 27. *See video for reference.
It is located within the Hanazono Hanakan Prefectural Natural Park and is a wetland developed in the mountainous area.
Sagi-suge, Mizuchidori, and Himeichige are growing here. In an effort to preserve this nature, 'Skunk Cabbage' was planted in the 1950s. Later, the city took over management, and in 1987, about 1,000 Skunk Cabbage plants were planted.
Even now, they sprout in late March, and flowers bloom from early to mid-April*1, attracting many tourists.
*1 Reference for best viewing: First week of April 2020, First week of April 2021 (In recent years, the best viewing period has been earlier.)

title: Ibaraki Prefecture, North Ibaraki, Noguchi Ujo Memorial Hall: Recommended Tourist Spot for 'Shabondama' and 'Nanatsu no Ko'
description:
Have you ever heard the children's songs 'Nanatsu no Ko' and 'Shabondama' that everyone has hummed at least once?
◆Nanatsu no Ko
  Crow, why do you cry? The crow is in the mountains
  Because there are seven lovely children...
◆Shabondama
  Shabondama flew, it flew up to the roof
  It flew up to the roof and broke and disappeared...

All of these were written by the children's song poet 'Noguchi Ujo' from Kitaibaraki City.
Ujo believed that 'It is fine if the author's name is not remembered; if the poems and songs created are loved and sung by people for a long time, that is my true wish,' and he left behind about 3,000 works.

Moreover, surpassing Ujo's belief, the children's songs and school songs he wrote continue to be sung along with Ujo's name even today.
The Noguchi Ujo Memorial Hall introduces the life of Noguchi Ujo while displaying valuable materials from that time.
Why not visit the 'Noguchi Ujo Memorial Hall,' where you can instantly return to your childhood when everyone hummed those songs?

description:
茨城県を代表する観光地『五浦六角堂』

近代日本美術の発展に尽力した岡倉天心ゆかりの地です。岡倉天心は、日本美術の発展や文化財保護、東洋文化の世界への発信など急激な西洋化の荒波が押し寄せた明治という時代の中で、日本美術発展のために尽力した人物です。岡倉天心は晩年の頃には、この五浦の地を気に入り、弟子たちとともに移住してきました。時に荒く、時に静かに打ち寄せる波を眺めながら、日本美術の将来を考え、この六角堂で瞑想にふけったとされています。

六角堂のある『五浦海岸』は大小異なる入江が連なりできた海岸。日本の渚百選にも選ばれたその景色は、まるで一幅の日本画のようで、来る人々はその景色に心を打たれます。

title: Ibaraki Prefecture, North Ibaraki City Tourist Attractions: Rokkakudo, a Place Related to Tenshin Okakura, Recommended Spot, Scenic View, North Kanto
description:
This is a representative tourist destination in Ibaraki Prefecture, 'Goura Rokkakudo'. It is a place related to Tenshin Okakura, who contributed to the development of modern Japanese art. Okakura worked for the development of Japanese art, the protection of cultural properties, and the dissemination of Eastern culture to the world during the Meiji era, a time when the waves of rapid Westernization were crashing in. In his later years, he came to love this area of Goura and moved here with his disciples. It is said that he meditated in this Rokkakudo while contemplating the future of Japanese art, gazing at the waves that sometimes crashed violently and sometimes quietly.

The 'Goura Coast' where Rokkakudo is located is a beach formed by a series of bays of different sizes. The scenery, selected as one of Japan's 100 best beaches, is like a variety of Japanese paintings, leaving a deep impression on visitors.

title: The Best Anko Nabe in Japan / Ibaraki Prefecture, Kitaibaraki City - Delicious Nabe Delivery
description:
**The Birthplace of Anko Nabe: Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture**
For two consecutive years, it has been recognized as the best in Japan at the Nabe 1 GP, a testament to its authenticity.

The rich “miso flavor” is characterized by sautéed anko liver!
It is said that the fishermen of 'Hirakata Port', located in the northern part of Kitaibaraki City, began eating “anko-dobu-jiru” as a dish that could be cooked on board while conserving water and keeping warm. Dobu-jiru is made solely from the moisture released by the anko and vegetables. When dashi broth is added, it becomes anko nabe, which is why it is referred to as the “root of anko nabe.”

Every year, Kitaibaraki City, the birthplace of anko nabe, holds the 'National Anko Summit' (official website: http://www.kitaibarakishi-kankokyokai.gr.jp/page/dir000777.html).
In 2021, the event was canceled due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, leading to disappointment from many, which is why we created this “anko nabe” video.

description:
Tenpizan and Otatachibana Hime Shrine (天妃山・弟橘媛神社) located in Isohara Town, Kitaibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.

A low mountain associated with the famous Tokugawa Mitsukuni (Mito Komon) and Tokugawa Nariaki.
If you climb further from the shrine, there is a stone said to be where Mitsukuni sat.
It is said that Ujo Noguchi, known for children's songs like 'Nanatsu no Ko' and 'Shabondama', often climbed Tenpizan to gaze at the scenery when he struggled with his lyrics.
When asked for his address, Ujo would reply, 'My address is Isohara Coast!' indicating his affection for Isohara Coast and Tenpizan.

When you visit Kitaibaraki City, be sure to enjoy the scenery of Isohara Coast that both of them loved!

title: 茨城県の絶景!!五浦岬公園/北茨城さんぽ【北茨城市 観光 おすすめスポット】茨城 観光 絶景 おすすめ
description:
茨城県北茨城市にある絶景スポット『五浦岬公園』です。
近代日本美術の発展に尽力した岡倉天心が愛した五浦の景色を一望できます。

五浦は『小五浦』、『大五浦』、『椿磯』、『中磯』、『端磯』の大小異なる5つの入り江からなる海岸です。
１年を通して穏やかな波が入り込みに絶壁に生える松の緑と青く澄んだ海が美しい、県内を代表する景勝地です♪

近代日本美術の発展に尽力した『岡倉天心』はこの地を気に入り、移住するとともに、明治39年には東京都谷中にあった日本美術院（第一部 絵画）をこの五浦に移しました。
天心はこの五浦で『没線描法（空気や光を描こうとした）』という描き方を研究、新たな日本画の描き方の確立に取り組みました。
時代が劇的に変わっていく明治時代。天心はこの五浦の景色を見て、日本美術の将来を考えていたのです。

公園内には竹中直人さん主演『映画 天心』で使用されたロケセットや太平洋を一望できる展望台などがあります。

また、周辺には『茨城県立天心記念五浦美術館』や『六角堂』、『岡倉天心の墓』、『黄門の井戸』などの観光スポットが点在しており、近代日本美術の歴史背景に触れながら、海岸沿いの絶景を堪能することができます。

title: Ibaraki Prefecture's Stunning Views!! Gutsu Cape Park / Kita-Ibaraki Stroll [Kita-Ibaraki City Tourist Recommended Spot] Ibaraki Tourism Stunning Views Recommendations
description:
This is the stunning spot 'Gutsu Cape Park' located in Kita-Ibaraki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
You can enjoy a panoramic view of the scenery of Gutsu, which was loved by Tenshin Okakura, who contributed to the development of modern Japanese art.

Gutsu consists of five bays of varying sizes: 'Kogutsu', 'Ogutsu', 'Tsubaki-iso', 'Naka-iso', and 'Hana-iso'.
Throughout the year, gentle waves come in, and the green pines growing on the cliffs against the backdrop of the clear blue sea create a beautiful representative scenic spot in the prefecture! 🎉

Tenshin Okakura, who dedicated himself to the development of modern Japanese art, loved this place and moved here. In 1906, he relocated the Nihon Bijutsuin (First Division Painting) from Yanaka, Tokyo, to this Gutsu.
At Gutsu, Okakura researched a painting method called 'Bosenbyōhō' (which aimed to depict air and light) and worked on establishing a new way of painting Japanese art.
During the dramatically changing Meiji era, Okakura looked at the scenery of Gutsu and contemplated the future of Japanese art.

Inside the park, there are filming sets used in the movie 'Tenshin' starring Naoto Takenaka and an observation deck that offers a view of the Pacific Ocean.

Additionally, nearby are tourist spots such as the 'Ibaraki Prefectural Tenshin Memorial Gutsu Art Museum', 'Rokkakudo', 'Tenshin Okakura's Grave', and 'Komon no Ido', allowing you to enjoy the stunning coastal views while touching on the historical background of modern Japanese art.
