Let's take a leisurely stroll around Kitaibaraki City.

This time, we visit Hachiman Shrine, which sits on a hill overlooking Hirakata Port.
Climbing the stone steps while listening to the sound of the waves. A luxurious moment. From the shrine grounds, you can enjoy a panoramic view of "Hirakata Port."
At Hirakata Port, many anglerfish and spear squid are caught. Fishing boats set sail, allowing you to enjoy various styles of fishing, such as tenya and slow jigging. You can target species like sea bream, flounder, red mullet, ribbonfish, and spear squid.

title: A Shrine with a Thousand-Year History: Bizen Kuni Sōja Shrine - Festival and Mikoshi Carrying Experience
description:
Founded in the Heian period, this shrine enshrines the deities of 128 shrines in Okayama Bizen. It is said that by visiting here, one has paid homage to all the shrines at once.

We introduce content that allows you to experience traditional Japanese performing arts and the essence of Okayama.

The hall of worship visible through the torii gate was rebuilt in 1992 after being destroyed by arson, restoring the original Heian period structure, making it a beautiful hall of worship unique in the country. Additionally, it is located at the foot of Mount Ryūnoguchi, making it one of Japan's renowned power spots.

Here, you can enjoy special experiences such as traditional cultural activities like carrying the mikoshi, lion dance offerings, and food stalls where you can taste Okayama's cuisine.

title: Okayama: A Beautiful Moment. 30ver.B
description:
※This video was produced in 2021 and is published on YouTube as an archive.

A promotional video filled with highlights of Okayama Korakuen and Okayama Castle throughout the seasons, including the Fantasy Garden and Ujo Togenkyo, has been completed! Please take a look!!

【Okayama Korakuen】
A large garden built by the second lord of the Okayama domain, Ikeda Tsunamasa, as a place of relaxation. The spacious garden, adorned with seasonal flowers, is like a different world reminiscent of the Edo period. In 1952, it was designated as a “Special Scenic Spot” as a historical cultural heritage and has received a three-star rating in the Michelin Green Guide Japan.
https://okayama-korakuen.jp/

【Okayama Castle】
Okayama Castle's main keep was built in 1597 by Ukita Hideie, one of the five elders of the Toyotomi clan. The magnificent three-story, six-story main keep is said to have been modeled after Oda Nobunaga's Azuchi Castle and features a rare irregular pentagonal base. Its black wooden exterior has earned it the nickname “Ujo (Crow Castle).”
Currently, a large-scale renovation of the main keep is underway as part of the “Reiwa Major Renovation.” The renewal opening is scheduled for November 2022.
https://kin-ujo.jp/

【Fantasy Garden & Ujo Togenkyo】
Every year, during the spring, summer, and autumn seasons, Okayama Korakuen and Okayama Castle are beautifully illuminated with lights, and are specially opened at night as the “Fantasy Garden” and “Ujo Togenkyo.”

title: Explanation about the history of Okayama Castle by Michifumi Isoda of a historian
description:
A clear explanation of Okayama Castle by historian Michifumi Isoda.
It explains the changes in the main keep, the moon-viewing turret, and the stone walls.
Here, we introduce a digest version, but the detailed content consisting of six parts can be viewed at the Okayama Castle main keep.
Part 1: Okayama Castle viewed from the opposite shore,
Part 2: The castle of Ishiyama,
Part 3: The stone walls on the east side of the main keep,
Part 4: The stone walls under the moon-viewing turret and the corridor gate,
Part 5: The middle level,
Part 6: The main hall and the main keep.

Under the direction of Hideie Ukita, a daimyo of the Sengoku Period, Okayama Castle was completed in 1597 after eight years of construction.
Because the castle was oriented to the west, Hideie undertook a major project to pull the nearby Asahigawa River to flow along the eastern end of the castle to ward off enemies from entering through the rear.
The architecture of the period is partly represented by the use of boards painted with black lacquer on the walls of the castle tower (Tenshukaku).
As such, the exterior is black, and in the later periods, the castle came to be known as the Crow Castle (Ujo).
Hideie not only used Okayama Castle as a military facility, but also called in merchants and craftsmen around the castle's domain to develop a castle town.

title: [Zōzan Kofun & Senjaku Kofun] ~Sky Travel Time~ A Skywalk to Experience Okayama City
description:
Famous landmarks in Okayama City and spots you may not have known about. 
Why not travel from the sky?

Zōzan Kofun is the largest burial mound in the prefecture, said to be the tomb of a chieftain of the ancient Kibi Kingdom, with a total length of about 350 meters, making it the fourth largest in Japan, following the Ōjin, Nintoku, and Fukuchū tombs. At the time of its construction, it was the largest in Japan, and its existence tells the story of the power of ancient Kibi, which stood alongside the Kinai political authority. From the circular mound with a diameter of 40 meters in the front, mirrors, grinding stones, bells, and a large number of iron tools have been excavated, some of which are housed in the Imperial Household Agency.

Senjaku Kofun is a keyhole-shaped burial mound located in Shinjo-shita, Kita Ward, Okayama City, positioned in front of the Zōzan Kofun and considered its accompanying mound. Senjaku Kofun is a nationally designated historic site, famous for having a stone barrier with carved straight-line patterns placed inside an early horizontal stone chamber of Kyushu origin in its round rear section. It is an important burial mound that provides insight into the close relationship between Kibi and Kyushu during the middle of the Kofun period. title: Kibitsu Shrine - Sky Travel Time - A Skywalk to Experience Okayama City
description:
The famous landmarks of Okayama City and those spots you may not have known about. 
Why not travel from the sky? 

Kibitsu Shrine is a grand shrine dedicated to Okibitsuhiko no Okami, and its main hall and worship hall are uniquely constructed in the 'Hiyoku Irimoya-zukuri' style, which is the only one of its kind in the country and designated as a national treasure. Additionally, the approximately 400-meter-long corridor (designated as a cultural property by the prefecture) connecting the main shrine to the southern main shrine, as well as the South and North Suijin Gates, the Okama-den, and the wooden lion and komainu, are designated as important cultural properties of the country.

description:

title: 髙橋庄太郎さんと土屋智哉さんが歩く みちのく潮風トレイル ～森 里 川 海　豊かな恵みを感じる道～
description: 宮城県出身のアウトドアライターの高橋庄太郎さんと、日本のロング・ディスタンス・トレイル文化を牽引してきた三鷹のウルトラライトハイキングギアのお店、ハイカーズ・デポのオーナー土屋智哉さん。北海道や西表島を共に旅し、共著もある仲の良い2人が、みちのく潮風トレイルを歩く旅に出かけました。庄太郎さんのゆかりのある南三陸志津川をスタートし、ゴールは絶対金華山！という庄太郎さんおすすめコースを歩いてもらいました。一度前線歩いたことのある土屋さんには、懐かしい再会の場面も！短い映像でその全ては紹介できませんが、ダイジェストで2人の歩き旅を、優しいナレーションと共にお届けします。

title: Takahashi Shotaro and Tsuchiya Tomoya Walk the Michinoku Tide Trail - A Path to Feel the Rich Blessings of Forests, Mountains, Rivers, and Seas -
description: Outdoor writer Shotaro Takahashi from Miyagi Prefecture and Tomoya Tsuchiya, the owner of Hikers Depot, a shop that has led Japan's long-distance trail culture, have embarked on a journey walking the Michinoku Tide Trail. Starting from Shizugawa in Minamisanriku, which is connected to Shotaro, they walked a course recommended by him, with the goal of absolutely reaching Kinkasan! There were also nostalgic reunion moments for Tsuchiya, who had walked this trail before. Although not all can be introduced in a short video, a digest of their walking journey is presented with gentle narration.

title: 岩間幸司写真展トークイベント〜1000キロ歩いた写真家が見て感じたMCTと三陸ジオパークの魅力〜
description: これまでいくつもの国境を越え、数えきれない街を歩いてきたカメラマンの岩間氏が2021年にMCT（みちのく潮風トレイル）全線を47日間かけてスルーハイクしながら撮影した写真展「みちのく3740～やってくる峠、遠ざかる港～」。撮影を目的とした旅ではなく、純粋に歩くことを目的とした旅。その旅の中で見て感じたMCTについて、また、MCTを歩くと同時に楽しめる三陸ジオパークの魅力について語る、岩間氏と三陸ジオパーク事務局長土澤氏のトークセッションです。

title: ハイカーの声を聞く／Interviews of Hikers | みちのく潮風トレイル
description:
「旅って人なんですよね、人との出会いこそ旅の醍醐味。だからこそロングトレイルって、ただ山の中を歩いているんじゃダメなんですよ。地域とか町とか人と密接に結びついているからこそのロングトレイルなんですよね。」－長谷川 晋 氏／MCTスルーハイカー(2018)　
「震災を経験した方と関わることはとても心に残るし、とても個人的なレベルで響くもの。ただ、悲しみに焦点を当てるのではなく、希望への物語や強靭さに関して聞くこと、人生を再生する人々が笑顔でいることなど、こういった東北の人たちとの出会いは魅力的な経験だったと思う。本当に人生を変える経験だった。」－ロビン・ルイス 氏／MCTスルーハイカー(2017)　
“Journeys are about the people. The true pleasure of travel is in meeting people. That’s why long distance trails aren’t just hiking in the mountains. Long distance trails are about close connections with local areas, towns and people.” --Shin Hasegawa, MCT thru-hiker (2018)
“When you interact with other human beings who have experienced such tragedy it really sticks with you and resonates with you on a personal level. Not just focusing on the sad side, but hearing the stories of hope and resilience, that people rebuilt their lives and have this huge smile. It’s really just a magical experience to have these interactions with people in Tohoku. It’s a really life-changing experience.” --Robin Lewis, MCT thru-hiker (2017)

title: 和食の魂「醤油」のルーツをたどる旅〜醤油づくりの歴史と伝統を継ぐ物語〜
description: 紀伊水道に面し、古くから海とともに生きてきた町・和歌山県湯浅町。ここは日本の「醤油醸造発祥の地」として知られ、今も古い町並みに、発酵の香りと職人の息づかいが漂います。おいしくてヘルシーと、世界で注目を集め、ユネスコの無形文化遺産にも登録されている「和食」。その礎を支えてきたのが、和歌山の人びとの知恵と自然が生み出した“醤油”です。和食文化の原点を訪ね、醤油のルーツをたどる旅へ出かけてみましょう。

title: A Journey to Trace the Roots of Soy Sauce, the Soul of Japanese Cuisine - A Story of the History and Tradition of Soy Sauce Making
description: Facing the Kii Channel, Yuasa Town in Wakayama Prefecture has lived with the sea since ancient times. Known as the birthplace of soy sauce brewing in Japan, the town still exudes the aroma of fermentation and the breath of artisans in its old streets. 'Washoku,' which is delicious and healthy, has attracted global attention and is registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage. The 'soy sauce' created by the wisdom of the people of Wakayama and nature has supported the foundation of Japanese food culture. Let's embark on a journey to trace the roots of soy sauce and visit the origins of washoku culture.

日本における観光のはじまりと言われる熊野御幸について紹介いたします。

title: A Journey Following the Footsteps of Kumano Gokō - Walking the Sacred Path 'Kumano Kodo' - [Pilgrimage to the Sacred Seals Related to Kumano Gokō]
description:
The Kumano Kodo is a pilgrimage route that connects various places, including Kyoto, to the three Kumano mountains (Kumano Hongu Taisha, Kumano Hayatama Taisha, Kumano Nachi Taisha and Nachi San Seiganto-ji). Parts of the Nakahechi and Ohechi routes are registered as a World Heritage site under 'Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range.'
The Kumano Kodo has long carried the prayers of people and led them to a place of rebirth, known as the 'Path of Resurrection.' The 'Kumano Gokō,' where noble individuals from the capital traveled towards Kumano, is the origin of this path!

A grand pilgrimage journey undertaken by emperors and priests from the capital, Kyoto, through Osaka, aiming for the three Kumano mountains (Kumano Hongu Taisha, Kumano Hayatama Taisha, Kumano Nachi Taisha and Nachi San Seiganto-ji).
We will introduce the Kumano Gokō, said to be the beginning of tourism in Japan.

description:
和歌山県南部の熊野エリアをまるごと楽しむ女子旅プランのご紹介です。

普段はあまり運動しないかも、、という女子や初心者にもおすすめの熊野古道「大門坂」を歩いて熊野那智大社・那智山青岸渡寺、那智の滝を参拝。歩いた疲れを足湯で癒やし、マグロ丼でパワーチジ。太平洋を望む絶景温泉が楽しめるお宿に宿泊。

2日目は、世界的にもめずらしい鯨類専門の博物館や、インスタ映えスポットとしても人気の橋杭岩までドライブし、熊野エリアの見どころをまるっと楽しむことができる１泊2日のおすすめモデルコースです。

title: Today is Wakayama Day - Girls' Trip -
description:
This is a recommended girls' trip plan to fully enjoy the Kumano area in the southern part of Wakayama Prefecture.

Recommended for girls who may not usually exercise much or beginners, walk the Kumano Kodo 'Daimon-zaka' to visit Kumano Nachi Taisha, Nachi San Seiganto-ji, and Nachi Falls. Relax your tired feet in a foot bath and recharge with a tuna bowl. Stay at an inn where you can enjoy a spectacular hot spring overlooking the Pacific Ocean.

On the second day, drive to the world-rare whale museum and the popular Instagram spot, Hashikui-iwa, to fully enjoy the highlights of the Kumano area in a recommended 1-night, 2-day model course.

The 'Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range' has been registered as a World Heritage Site for 20 years.

Koyasan, the sacred place opened by Kobo Daishi Kukai, still allows you to feel 'Kukai's prayers' at the temples and pilgrimage routes at its foot.

And Kumano, the sacred place of resurrection.
Following the Kumano Kodo, which ancient people also walked, leads to the Kumano Sanzan.
Walking the Kumano Kodo refreshes both body and mind.

Wakayama Prefecture offers healing hot springs, delicious local gourmet food, and fun activities, providing various ways to enjoy.

Why not visit Wakayama Prefecture in this memorable year of the 20th anniversary of World Heritage registration?

title: wakayama koyasan
description:
今こそ、パワーみなぎる世界遺産・高野山へ出かけよう
2023年は高野山を開いた弘法大師空海の御誕生1250年にあたり、普段は非公開の御本尊の特別公開や限定御朱印など、パワースポット旅として注目が高まっています。

いざ、遊休の歴史を紡ぐ高野山へ出かけよう！

title: Wakayama Koyasan
description:
Now is the time to visit the powerful World Heritage Site, Koyasan.

The year 2023 marks the 1250th anniversary of the birth of Kobo Daishi Kukai, who opened Koyasan. There is increasing attention on power spot travel, with special openings of the usually closed main deity and limited edition goshuin stamps.

Let’s head to Koyasan, where the history of leisure is woven!

title: 「wakayama shirahama」
description:
和歌山で”海外リゾートステイ”気分が味わえる！？
パノラマに広がる水平線を眺めながら海沿いサイクリング、無人島でラグジュアリーなグランピングやBBQ...
そんな海外リゾートステイが和歌山・白浜でできるんです！

title: Wakayama Shirahama
description:
Experience the feeling of an 'overseas resort stay' in Wakayama!?
Enjoy seaside cycling while gazing at the panoramic horizon, luxurious glamping and BBQ on a deserted island...
You can have such an overseas resort stay in Shirahama, Wakayama!

title: 「wakayama nachikatsuura」
description:
「人生で一度は行きたい」聖地・和歌山県熊野エリア。
今こそ行っておきたい”パワースポット”なんです。
熊野古道の神聖な空気を浴び、幻の”もち鮪”を堪能し、太平洋を望む絶景露天風呂に癒される、極上のネイチャリング体験をチェック！
”紀伊山地の霊場と参詣道”は、世界文化遺産に登録され、2024年で20周年を迎えます。

title: Wakayama Nachikatsuura
description:
A sacred place in the Kumano area of Wakayama Prefecture that you must visit at least once in your life.
Now is the time to experience this 'power spot'.
Bathe in the sacred air of the Kumano Kodo, savor the elusive 'mochi tuna', and enjoy a healing experience in an open-air bath with a breathtaking view of the Pacific Ocean. Check out this ultimate nature experience!
The 'Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range' is registered as a UNESCO World Heritage Site and will celebrate its 20th anniversary in 2024.

title: 紀州浪漫 2023春　日本とトルコ　友好の原点の地へ
description: 日本とトルコ、遠く離れた両国の固い絆。明治期に串本沖で起きたトルコ船籍「エルトゥールル号」の遭難事件を知ると、その理由が見えてくる。歴史に思いを馳せながら、美しい海景を心ゆくまで眺めたい。

title: Kishu Romance Spring 2023: To the Land of Friendship between Japan and Turkey
description: The strong bond between Japan and Turkey, two countries far apart. Understanding the shipwreck incident of the Turkish vessel 'Ertuğrul' that occurred off the coast of Kushimoto during the Meiji period reveals the reason behind it. While reflecting on history, I want to gaze at the beautiful seascape to my heart's content.

description: 田辺市本宮町にある熊野本宮温泉郷には3つの趣の異なる温泉があります。熊野詣での湯垢離場としての歴史がある湯の峰温泉、河原を掘ると温泉が湧き出る川湯温泉、広大な露天風呂が自慢のわたらせ温泉と、それぞれの魅力があります。温泉を最大限楽しむために、七越峰トレッキングや熊野古道歩きなど、自然の中でのアクティビティを楽しんでみませんか。

title: Kishu Romance Winter 2022 Issue: A Journey to Heal in Hot Springs and Feel the Earth
description: In the Kumano Hongu Onsen area located in Tanabe City, Hongu Town, there are three hot springs with different charms. There is Yunomine Onsen, which has a history as a purification place for Kumano Pilgrimage, Kawayu Onsen, where hot springs gush out when you dig the riverbed, and Watarase Onsen, which boasts a vast open-air bath. Why not enjoy activities in nature, such as trekking at Nanako Peak or walking the Kumano Kodo, to make the most of your hot spring experience?

title: Kumano Area
description: The sacred site of nature worship, 'Kumano', reveres nature itself, such as waterfalls, rocks, and rivers. In the 'Kumano Area', you can experience unique activities such as hot springs that heal pilgrims walking the Kumano Kodo, the pilgrimage path leading to the sacred site of Kumano, and rafting experiences in Japan's only detached village.

title: 有田・日高エリア　～和み、わかやま～
description:
「和み、わかやま」Longバージョンはコチラ → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Al8aE_zTeGI&t=936s
「和み、わかやま」Shortバージョンはコチラ → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gS86Dozo2os&t=15s
入り組んだ海岸部には風光明媚な景色が広がり、内地には深い山あいが広がる「有田・日高エリア」。自然の恵みを存分に受け、有田みかん、湯浅醤油、金山寺味噌、幻の魚クエ、南高梅といった和歌山の特産物も目白押しです。白い岩と青い海のコントラストが美しい絶景や、四季折々に表情を変える棚田など、写真映えスポットも見逃せません。

title: Arita and Hidaka Area - Harmony, Wakayama
description: The Arita and Hidaka area features scenic coastal views and deep mountains inland. It is rich in natural blessings, with many local specialties from Wakayama such as Arita mikan, Yuasa soy sauce, Kaneyama miso, the elusive fish Kue, and Nanko plum. The beautiful contrast of white rocks and blue sea creates stunning views, and the terraced rice fields that change with the seasons are also must-see photo spots.

title: 高野山エリア　～和み、わかやま～
description:
「和み、わかやま」Longバージョンはコチラ → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Al8aE_zTeGI&t=936s
「和み、わかやま」Shortバージョンはコチラ → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gS86Dozo2os&t=15s
弘法大師空海によって開かれた天空の聖地・高野山と、その麓の町に、弘法大師ゆかりの見どころが凝縮する「高野山エリア」。高野山に50以上もある宿坊では、精進料理や写経、瞑想を体験することもでき、自分を見つめ直す旅にも。武将・真田幸村ゆかりの寺院や、天野の里に佇む高野山ゆかりの神社も、併せて立ち寄りたいスポットです。

title: Koyasan Area - Harmony, Wakayama
description: The Koyasan area, a sacred place in the sky opened by Kobo Daishi Kukai, is condensed with attractions related to Kobo Daishi in the town at the foot of Koyasan. At the more than 50 shukubo (temple lodgings) in Koyasan, you can experience shojin ryori (Buddhist vegetarian cuisine), sutra copying, and meditation, making it a journey to reflect on yourself. Temples related to the warlord Sanada Yukimura and shrines associated with Koyasan in the village of Amano are also spots you want to visit.

title: 和歌山市近郊エリア　～和み、わかやま～

title: Wakayama City Suburban Area - Harmony, Wakayama
description: The Wakayama City Suburban Area, home to historical sites such as Wakayama Castle, the residence of the Kishu Domain, one of the three Tokugawa families, as well as Negoro-ji Temple and Koyakadera Temple. It features scenic spots mentioned in the Manyoshu, breathtaking views of uninhabited islands that look like anime settings, and Instagram-worthy locations. Additionally, it is an area where you can enjoy gourmet food such as Wakayama ramen and fruits, as well as activities for cyclists.

title: The Sacred Land in the Sky: Mount Koya
description:

This footage was taken in November during the late autumn season, with special permission to enter a sacred area that is completely off-limits for three months each year, from March to May.

title: 【冬の秘密の楽しみ方！】グランピング＆サウナで新たな冒険に出よう
description:
🌲 上富良野町で冬のアウトドア体験！🌲

冬の寒さも楽しんでしまおう！この動画では、北海道の美しい自然に囲まれた上富良野町で、東京の女子大生がグランピング、テントサウナ、そしてスノーシューを楽しむ様子をご覧ください。

🏕️ グランピングの贅沢な体験 🏕️

まずは、リッチなアウトドア体験としてグランピングをご紹介！山々の雪景色を望む快適なテントで、暖かいベッドでのんびり過ごしましょう。豪華なバーベキューや焚火も、自然の中での特別な時間を演出します。

🔥 テントサウナでリラックス 🔥

冷えきった身体を温めるために、贅沢なテントサウナ体験もお見逃しなく！自然の中で暖かさを楽しみながら、ストレスを忘れてリフレッシュしましょう。また、サウナの後には十勝岳の温泉で体を癒すこともできます。

この冬、自然とのふれあいと贅沢なアウトドア体験を求めるなら、上富良野町が最高の場所です！ぜひこの動画をチェックして、冬の冒険の準備を始めましょう！

❄️ スノーシューで雪山を探検 ❄️

次に、雪深い森林を探検するためにスノーシューを履いて冒険しましょう！専門ガイドが案内する中、あなたの足跡だけが雪に残る奥深い森の中を散策し、冬ならではの景色を満喫しましょう。

title: LIVE 35th北の大文字カウントダウン2021－2022 北海道上富良野町
description:
「北の大文字」は、年の暮れから年の初めである元旦午前0時、上富良野町内を一望する日の出公園の斜面に、縦70m・横50mの「大」の文字を描いた鉄杭300本に、かみふらの神社から採火した御神火を次々に灯し、雪一面の暗闇斜面に大文字を浮かび上がらせるという、雪国ならではの幻想的かつ雄大なイベントであり、今や上富良野町・富良野沿線の大晦日の風物詩として毎年、地域住民に定着しています。
　今年で35回を迎え、大の文字と花火で幻想的な中にも躍動感を演出し新しい年を祝い、共に誓いを行う機会とします。
　昨年に引き続き新型コロナウイルス感染症の一日も早い終息を合わせて願い、無観客での開催とします。また、その様子をライブ配信することにより、全世界へ上富良野町の魅力を配信いたします。

title: LIVE 35th Northern Daimonji Countdown 2021-2022 Kamifurano Town, Hokkaido
description:
"Northern Daimonji" is a spectacular event unique to snowy regions, where at midnight on New Year's Day, a 70m tall and 50m wide character 'Dai' is illuminated on the slope of Hinode Park, overlooking the town of Kamifurano. This is achieved by lighting 300 iron stakes with the sacred fire taken from Kamifurano Shrine, creating a stunning visual of the character glowing against the dark snowy slope. This event has become a traditional New Year's Eve spectacle for the local residents of Kamifurano and the Furano area. This year marks the 35th edition, where we will celebrate the new year with a dynamic display of the 'Dai' character and fireworks, providing an opportunity for a collective vow. In light of the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, we will hold the event without an audience, while live streaming the event to share the charm of Kamifurano Town with the world.

description: 上富良野町の十勝岳登山口から登り、上富良野岳、上ホロカメットク山、そしてカミホロ避難小屋で1泊。次の日は十勝岳、白銀荘に降りる登山に行ってきました。９月上旬で朝の気温は一桁でした。自分達他に宿泊されている方は１０人ほど。避難小屋に着くとすぐに雨が降ってきて雨漏り対策をして寝ました。次の日の朝は、知床の百名山、羅臼岳も見えるほどの絶景で、とても記憶に残る登山でした。

title: Tokachidake Traverse: Asahi and Sea of Clouds from Kamihoro Emergency Shelter
description: Climbed from the Tokachidake trailhead in Kamifurano Town, stayed overnight at the Kamihoro emergency shelter after climbing Kamifurano-dake and Kamihorokametokusan. The next day, we went down to Tokachidake and Shirogane-so. In early September, the morning temperature was in single digits. There were about ten other guests staying with us. As soon as we arrived at the emergency shelter, it started to rain, and we took measures against leaks and went to sleep. The next morning, the view was so spectacular that we could see Rausudake, one of the hundred famous mountains in Shiretoko, making it a memorable hike.

title: LIVE 34th北の大文字カウントダウン2020－2021 北海道上富良野町
description: 「北の大文字」は、年の暮れから年の初めである元旦午前0時、上富良野町内を一望する日の出公園の斜面に、縦70m・横50mの「大」の文字を描いた鉄杭300本に、かみふらの神社から採火した御神火を次々に灯し、雪一面の暗闇斜面に大文字を浮かび上がらせるという、雪国ならではの幻想的かつ雄大なイベントであり、今や上富良野町・富良野沿線の大晦日の風物詩として毎年、地域住民に定着しています。 今年で34回を迎え、大の文字と花火で幻想的な中にも躍動感を演出し新しい年を祝い、共に誓いを行う機会とします。 今回は新型コロナウイルス感染症の一日も早い終息を合わせて願い、無観客での開催とします。また、その様子をライブ配信することにより、全世界へ上富良野町の魅力を配信いたします。

title: LIVE 34th North Big Character Countdown 2020-2021 Kamifurano Town, Hokkaido
description: The 'North Big Character' is a fantastic and grand event unique to snowy countries, where at midnight on New Year's Day, a 'big' character measuring 70m vertically and 50m horizontally is drawn on the slope of Hinode Park, overlooking Kamifurano Town, using 300 iron stakes. The sacred fire, taken from Kamifurano Shrine, is lit one after another, illuminating the dark snowy slope with the big character. This event has become a New Year's Eve tradition for the local residents of Kamifurano Town and the Furano area. This year marks the 34th event, celebrating the new year with a dynamic display of the big character and fireworks. We will also wish for the early end of the COVID-19 pandemic and hold the event without an audience. The event will be live-streamed to showcase the charm of Kamifurano Town to the world.

title: 【4K空撮】2020夜明け前の富良野岳の紅葉と雲海
description: 北海道の中でも、一番早く紅葉を観ることの出来る十勝岳温泉。2020年の紅葉は、富良野岳方面の白樺やダケカンバの黄色が輝いて見えます。この日は上富良野町の盆地に雲海が出て、前富良野岳の斜面には朝日が差し込んで山頂から輝いてきました。いつもの年なら本当の見頃は数日で過ぎ去るのですが、今年は約2週間続きました。土曜・日曜日には十勝岳温泉の駐車場は常に満車状態で、道路脇にも長い駐車列ができていました。台風の影響も少なく、初雪も遅かったのと、山頂付近だけに降雪があり見事な紅葉が長い期間続きました。沢山の方が登山やカメラに写真を収めて見事な紅葉を楽しんでいたようです。皆さんを楽しませた凌雲閣からの紅葉もさすがに見納めです。これからは麓に向かってどんどん降りてくるでしょう。

title: 【4K Aerial】The Autumn Leaves and Sea of Clouds of Furano-dake Before Dawn in 2020
description: In Hokkaido, Tokachidake Onsen is the place where you can see autumn leaves the earliest. The autumn leaves of 2020 shine brightly with the yellow of the white birch and the daikamba towards Furano-dake. On this day, a sea of clouds appeared in the basin of Kamifurano Town, and the morning sun shone on the slopes of the front Furano-dake, shining from the summit. Usually, the peak viewing period lasts only a few days, but this year it continued for about two weeks. On Saturdays and Sundays, the parking lot of Tokachidake Onsen was always full, and there were long lines of parked cars along the roadside. There was little impact from typhoons, the first snow was late, and there was snowfall only near the summit, allowing the magnificent autumn leaves to last for a long time. Many people seemed to enjoy the beautiful autumn leaves while climbing and taking photos. The autumn leaves from the Ryounkaku, which entertained everyone, are finally coming to an end. From now on, they will continue to descend towards the foot of the mountain.

title: KAMIFURANO LIGHTING-UP & FIREWORKS ONLINE 2020

The lavender fields in Kamifurano Town are now in full bloom.

However... this year, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, many people are unable to visit Hokkaido, and many have applied to be "Lavender Owners" just to enjoy the scent of lavender.

title: Have you ever eaten soba that you made yourself?
description:
Have you ever eaten soba that you made yourself?

I heard that you can have a valuable experience at Toyohira Donguri Village in Kitahiroshima Town, so the tourism association staff is ready to go!

At the Donguri Lodge at the roadside station Toyohira Donguri Village, you can experience making soba in the Toyohira style.

You can experience it hands-free as the soba flour, water, all the tools, and aprons are available at the dojo!

Under the guidance of soba master Furuta, I started making soba right away. Kneading the soba flour with my bare hands feels great!

This cool sensation stays in your memory. Knead, roll, and cut with a knife.

While being praised with comments like "You're good!" and "Delicious!", you will be making it with support.

This experience will definitely be exciting for families, friends, and couples.

You might witness a moment of new talent blooming...👀✨️

Of course, it's also okay to come alone. You can experience it as a group (up to 30 people), so it can also be used for children's associations and various group recreation. *You can make soba starting from 5 servings.

If you're thinking, "I'm tired of regular dates... I want to do something special with friends! I want to have a memorable experience with my family..." then definitely try the soba-making experience in Kitahiroshima Town.

Soba that you made yourself is exceptional.

Even just eating the freshly made soba is great👌 at the authentic handmade soba specialty store [Soba Restaurant 'Donguri-an']
Weekdays 11:00~14:00, Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays 11:00~14:00~

description:
皆様、お待たせ致しました!! 11/13に放送されたひろしま満点ママ『地元っこに聞いてみた！』の取材の様子をお届けします💁🏻‍♀️✨️

場所は千代田インターから車で約5分の「古保利薬師」。平安時代に弘法大師が開いたとされる歴史ある薬師様。樹齢1000年を超える大ひのきも圧巻です。

神秘的な佇まいの古保利薬師(古保利山福光寺)に、重なる鮮やかな紅葉🍁 山門を守る仁王門の「木造金剛力士立像」も迫力があります。

取材日はまだ少し紅葉には早かったものの、先週でかなり進み、見頃は今週の半ばくらいで終わりそうです。

昨日(11/16)に職員が撮影した時も、何名かお客さんがいらっしゃって紅葉を楽しんでおられました。

取材に来てくださったのは ボールボーイ佐竹さん　高田萌子さん　

古保利薬師以外にも、コルビジェさん プチヘルメースさん を2週に渡り紹介して下さいました。

ド緊張でテンパっている私を優しくフォローしてくださり、時には鋭いツッコミで和ませてくださったお二人。

掛け合いも息ぴったりで更にお二人のファンになりました😊

ぜひ、また北広島町へ遊びに来て下さい!! 佐竹さん、高田さん、満点ママスタッフの方々、ありがとうございました!!

title: We will deliver the coverage of 'Ask the Locals!' aired on 11/13 in Hiroshima Manten Mama 💁🏻‍♀️✨️ #KitahiroshimaTown
description:
Thank you for your patience, everyone!! We will deliver the coverage of 'Ask the Locals!' aired on 11/13 in Hiroshima Manten Mama 💁🏻‍♀️✨️

The location is 'Kobori Yakushi', about 5 minutes by car from Chiyoda Interchange. It is a historical Yakushi said to have been opened by Kobo Daishi in the Heian period. The over 1000-year-old giant hinoki is also impressive.

The mystical appearance of Kobori Yakushi (Kobori San Fukkoji) is complemented by vibrant autumn leaves 🍁 The 'Wooden Kongorikishi Statues' guarding the mountain gate are also powerful.

Although it was still a bit early for the autumn leaves on the day of the coverage, they had progressed quite a bit last week, and the best viewing period seems to be ending around the middle of this week.

When the staff took photos yesterday (11/16), there were also several customers enjoying the autumn leaves.

The guests who came for the coverage were Mr. Satake from Ball Boy and Moeko Takada.

They also introduced Mr. Corbusier and Mr. Petit Hermes over two weeks, in addition to Kobori Yakushi.

They kindly supported me when I was extremely nervous and sometimes lightened the mood with sharp comments.

Their banter was perfectly in sync, and I became an even bigger fan of both of them 😊

Please come visit Kitahiroshima Town again!! Thank you, Mr. Satake, Ms. Takada, and the staff of Manten Mama!!

むさしどんぐり村豊平店に観光協会職員がレッツら モー‼️

広島県民みんな大好きむすびのむさし。
大人気の「若鶏むすび」のお弁当は、何度食べても「うんうん、これじゃ〜🥰✨」と染みる味。

広島県内には15店舗ありますが、その1つが北広島町にあるんです。
道の駅豊平どんぐり村はスポーツや蕎麦打ち、温泉など一日中楽しめる道の駅！

広島駅から下道で１時間、ゆったりドライブにもぴったりで広くて自然いっぱいです。

むさしのお店で食べるのはもちろん、近くの龍頭山の頂上でお弁当を食べるのもおすすめ。

標高928m⛰️山頂駐車場から徒歩約15分で頂上へ着くので、がっつり登山はキツイかも…と言う方にも🙆あずま屋もあるので、屋根の下でゆったり風を感じながら景色をお楽しみ頂けます。

たくさんの人に愛されるむすびのむさし。
北広島町豊平に遊びに来られた際にはぜひ食べに来てくださいね!!

title: Did you know that 'Musubi no Musashi' is also in Kitahiroshima Town? #KitahiroshimaTown #MusubiNoMusashi
description:
Did you know that 'Musubi no Musashi' is also in Kitahiroshima Town?
The staff from the tourism association are having a great time at Musashi Donguri Village Toyohira‼️

Everyone in Hiroshima loves Musubi no Musashi.
The popular 'Wakadori Musubi' bento is a flavor that resonates every time you eat it, saying 'Yes, this is it~🥰✨'.

There are 15 locations in Hiroshima Prefecture, and one of them is in Kitahiroshima Town.
The roadside station Toyohira Donguri Village is a place where you can enjoy sports, soba making, hot springs, and more all day long!

It's just an hour's drive from Hiroshima Station via local roads, perfect for a leisurely drive with plenty of nature around.

Of course, you can eat at the Musashi store, but I also recommend having a bento at the top of nearby Ryutozan.

At an elevation of 928m⛰️, it takes about 15 minutes on foot from the summit parking lot to reach the top, so it's suitable even for those who might find a strenuous hike challenging…🙆 There’s also a resting area where you can enjoy the scenery while feeling the breeze under a roof.

Musubi no Musashi is loved by many.
If you visit Toyohira in Kitahiroshima Town, be sure to come and try it out!!

一から自分たちで作り、野菜の粉末と米粉を合わせてもちもちに！お米の甘みもあるので子どもから大人まで食べやすい🤤

ショートパスタ加工しているのでパスタとして食べるだけでなく、スープやサラダ、グラタンなどアレンジ色々！

お米と野菜。同じ土壌で育まれた恵みをまるごと味わってください✨️

title: I heard there is 'pasta made with rice and vegetables' created by farmers, so the tourism association staff came to check it out!
description:
I heard there is 'pasta made with rice and vegetables' created by farmers, so the tourism association staff came to check it out!

I visited Nakahara Farm located in Toyohira. There are a lot of spinach in the vast area. This spinach is said to be easy to eat even for children who dislike it due to its lack of bitterness.

The guide was Mr. Takagawa, the representative of Nakahara Farm, along with his family. His second son, Haruto, taught us about the pasta. It's so soothing...

This colorful pasta was developed from Mr. Takagawa's desire for children to eat more vegetables.

They make it from scratch, combining vegetable powder and rice flour to create a chewy texture! It has a sweetness from the rice, making it easy to eat for both children and adults 🤤

Since it is processed as short pasta, it can be enjoyed not only as pasta but also in various arrangements like soups, salads, and gratins!

Enjoy the blessings of rice and vegetables grown in the same soil!✨️

title: Trial Stay Details in Kitahiroshima Town! #KitahiroshimaTown
description: Details about the 'Trial Stay' can be found here👇️🤷🏻 'I want to move to Kitahiroshima Town, but what should I do...' If you are thinking about living in Kitahiroshima Town, there is a great system! The 'Kitahiroshima Town Trial Stay' provides a lodging coupon of 2,000 yen per person per night (up to 10 nights) for those who stay at designated facilities to experience life in Kitahiroshima Town or look for work and housing, supporting the expenses incurred during the stay. This system can be used to experience 'life in Kitahiroshima Town' that you may not understand in a short stay. This time, we visited the designated accommodation facility for the 'Trial Stay', BlueArtGuesthouse, with staff from the tourism association and Nakatsu from the Kitahiroshima Town Office's town development promotion section. We were welcomed by the owners, the Inoue couple. They were inspired by their visit to Chefchaouen, Morocco, during their travels and created a guesthouse themed around the color blue. Art created by their family is displayed in the entrance. The space unified in blue is so refreshing. You can feel the warmth of wood while a relaxed time flows. It's a 5-minute walk to the supermarket and restaurants are also within walking distance, making access excellent. In the spacious tatami room, I couldn't help but roll around... the smell of tatami is also very pleasant. BlueArtGuesthouse is still evolving. If you wish, you can also experience painting and plastering. Conversations with the cheerful Inoue couple are enjoyable. The trial stay allows for interaction and relationship building with local people. Would you like to 'try' living in Kitahiroshima Town? description:

ぜひ一度は直接、近くで見て頂きたい！！きっと圧倒されると思います🔥

title: The Summer Tradition of Kitahiroshima Town, 'Yaeban' Festival was held on July 26 (Saturday) 🎉 #Kitahiroshima #Hiroshima
description:
The summer tradition of Kitahiroshima Town, 'Yaeban' Festival was held on July 26 (Saturday) 🎉

Arita venue, Tokkaichi venue, and Shinchi venue were all bustling with excitement.

Many stalls lined up, and children in yukata were having fun. This scene makes me feel that 'summer has come.'

As a staff member of the tourism association, I was in charge of the MC at the Shinchi venue, so I couldn't go to the Arita and Tokkaichi venues, but I was excited to see everyone's happy smiles and hear the music that was making all the venues lively✨️

The performers on stage were so powerful!! Singing, dancing, bands, and rakugo.

Seeing the children excitedly and a little nervously jumping onto the stage is perhaps a privilege of being the MC☺️

The three people who performed the familiar 'Let's go!' from the tourism association's reel video were singer caregiver 'Masashi Morimitsu,' 'Naoya Wakita,' and 'Airi.'

Their charming voices enveloped the three venues.

And the highlight of the Yaeban Festival, the 'Okabune' (land boat), is impressive and dazzling every time I see it. The 'Aritamaru,' 'Tokkaichimaru,' and 'Shinchimaru' sway up and down and side to side as if riding the waves.

I definitely want you to see it up close at least once!! You will surely be overwhelmed🔥

The grand summer event of Kitahiroshima Town, 'Yaeban Festival.' If you are interested in this video, please come next year!

title: Minamoa: A Co-Creation Hub Connecting Hiroshima, Setouchi, and the Future of the World 'miobyDoTS'
description: miobyDoTS is a permanent shop themed 'Let's Gift Setouchi' located on the 3rd floor of Minamoa West Building. It selects and sells local specialties and miscellaneous goods, and various styles of courses, workshops, and events are held day and night. It is a new co-creation hub with various faces. There is also a restaurant and café where you can enjoy a variety of dishes that allow you to feel like you are touring different regions, and the casual bistro offers rich dishes made from the abundant ingredients of Setouchi. The café, which is comfortable, is said to be very popular for its rich gelato made with milk from Sagotani Farm. The Mont Blanc is also delicious... No, I didn't come here to play! A shelf called 'Tsunagattari Shelf' that gathers the 'seasonal' of 23 cities and towns in Hiroshima and surrounding areas has been set up as part of the 'Okome no Wawawa' project, and North Hiroshima Town has also been installed! The traditional performing art 'Kagura' mask and the plush toy of the character Hanada Maito-kun, which North Hiroshima Town is proud of, make a big impact. We have also firmly attached a QR code so that you can check the tourism association's SNS. It is a blessing to have a space where we can PR our town in such a wonderful place. I hope everyone will be interested! This shelf is like a three-dimensional information magazine where you can learn about the town's specialties, recommended stores, key persons, festivals, and the 'seasonal' of the region, and the shelves of other towns were also very attractive. Please look for the North Hiroshima Town shelf at the new hub 'miobyDoTS' where the lifestyle, work style, and travel enjoyment of Setouchi intersect.

title: 新商品ができたと聞いて大朝にある漬物屋「西漬」さんに観光協会職員がレッツらもー‼️ #北広島町
description:
新商品ができたと聞いて大朝にある漬物屋「西漬」さんに観光協会職員がレッツらもー‼️

大朝にある西漬さんは創業1950年。広島で3代続く漬物屋。30年ほど前に新たな工場地と味の決め手となる美味しいお水を探し求めてこの大朝にたどり着きました。

西漬さんは新たに「地域と共に栄える」をミッションに掲げ、地元食材を活用した自社ブランドを構築するべく商品開発を行われたそう。

そして誕生したのが「広島菜」を新たな方法で製造した✨️北の舞漬✨️

1年以上漬け込む「古漬け」技法を用いて、牡蠣エキスで甘さを出し誰でも食べやすく、ご飯がモリモリ進む味に🍚お酒のアテにもぴったりです。

熟成発酵でたくさんの菌が味に奥行きを出すそう。

シャキシャキとした食感に、ぎゅっと詰まった酸味のコクとほんのり甘めの味わい。鼻に抜ける広島菜の香りに箸が止まりません。

「日本が誇る漬け物という食文化を守り、その価値をさらに高めながら未来へと受け継いでいきたい。」西漬の代表取締役 西村さんは目を輝かせながら漬け物の未来を語ってくれました。

「北の舞漬」の一つ一つの葉には、時間の積み重ねと作り手の想いが込められています。北広島町の名水で育った大朝米と、「北の舞漬」ぜひ一緒にお召し上がりください☺️

title: I heard that a new product has been made, so the tourism association staff went to the pickles shop 'Nishizuke' in Oasa!
description:
I heard that a new product has been made, so the tourism association staff went to the pickles shop 'Nishizuke' in Oasa!

Nishizuke, located in Oasa, was founded in 1950. It is a pickles shop that has been in Hiroshima for three generations. About 30 years ago, they searched for a new factory site and delicious water that would be the key to their flavor, and arrived in Oasa.

Nishizuke has newly set the mission of 'prospering together with the community' and has been developing products to build their own brand using local ingredients.

The result is 'Kita no Mai-zuke', made using a new method with 'Hiroshima greens'.

Using the 'old pickling' technique that involves pickling for over a year, they add oyster extract for sweetness, making it easy for anyone to eat and perfect for rice 🍚, as well as a great accompaniment to alcohol.

The fermentation process adds depth to the flavor with many bacteria.

With a crunchy texture, a rich acidity, and a slightly sweet flavor, the aroma of Hiroshima greens wafts through the air, making it hard to stop eating.

'We want to protect the food culture of pickles that Japan is proud of, while further enhancing its value and passing it on to the future.' Nishimura, the representative director of Nishizuke, spoke with shining eyes about the future of pickles.

Each leaf of 'Kita no Mai-zuke' is filled with the passage of time and the thoughts of the makers. Please enjoy 'Kita no Mai-zuke' together with Oasa rice grown in the famous water of Kitahiroshima Town ☺️.

(Currently, it can be purchased at the Michi no Eki Mai Road IC Chiyoda in Kitahiroshima Town and the Wasaru Direct Sales Center in Oasa. It is scheduled to be sold as a year-end gift product in 2025!)

description: Aino Sato Herb Garden is about a 10-minute drive from the Oasa IC. Over 100 types of herbs are planted in a 40,000 square meter area. title: 🐮Staff Challenges Hayato🐮 Let's Go to the Important Intangible Folk Cultural Asset 'Shinjou no Hayashida'‼️ #KitahiroshimaTown #Hiroshima #HiroshimaPrefecture #ShinjouNoHayashida #Oasa #Outdoor #Event
description:
🐮Staff Challenges Hayato🐮 Let's Go to the Important Intangible Folk Cultural Asset 'Shinjou no Hayashida'‼️

The 'Shinjou no Hayashida', an important intangible folk cultural asset of the country, was held on May 11 (Sunday) by the Shinjou Local Arts Preservation Society.

With the powerful Nanjou dance and a live performance by caregiver 🎤 Masashi Morimitsu.
His melodious voice resonates in the heart.

In this grand rice planting event, the tourism association staff also challenged themselves as Hayato!!
Feeling nervous, I went to the dressing room to get dressed... everyone was very welcoming✨️

Right away, elementary school girls asked me, 'Are you going into the rice field too, big sister? Let's do our best together!' with big smiles, which motivated me.

We checked each other to make sure our outfits were not coming undone and headed straight to the rice field.

My feet got swallowed up. This is tough.
While trying not to stumble, I received seedlings and started planting. The sense of unity is fun.

With advice from the senior Hayato, when we reached about the middle, it was break time. We all enjoyed 'Bokubamushi' together.

The smell of the rice field, the pleasant rice music, and the sound of cows.

Experiencing it firsthand, I felt the preciousness of the traditions being carefully passed down in the community, and the importance of it once again.

I hope this scene continues to be passed down forever.

Thank you for this valuable experience✨️

090-8718-5680 (Oobana Rice Planting Executive Committee Office)

Let's connect traditions together next year!!

併設されたガイダンスホールの建物は本堂の規模を原寸大に再現したもので、展示や休憩コーナー、トイレもあります。

title: Time Slip!? Experience a Steam Bath from the Warring States Period at 'Mantokuin Ruins Historical Park' - A Visit by a Tourist Association Staff Member✨️
description:
Time Slip!? Experience a Steam Bath from the Warring States Period at 'Mantokuin Ruins Historical Park' - A Visit by a Tourist Association Staff Member✨️

Kitahiroshima Town flourished as the territory of the Yoshikawa clan during the Middle Ages, with numerous historical sites such as the ruins of Okurayama Castle, Mantokuin, and Motoharakan, as well as associated shrines and traditional folk arts.

This time, we experienced the steam bath at 'Mantokuin Ruins Historical Park', which was established by Yoshikawa Motonaga (the grandson of Mouri Motonari).

We were guided by Mr. Sasaki from the Sengoku no Niwa Historical Museum, and off we went to the historical park!💨

First, we split firewood and lit a fire in the stove. The sight of blowing the fire-blowing bamboo was something I had only seen in movies, so I was moved...✨️

The bath is spacious enough for four adults to sit in, and it is said to reach 45 degrees inside! The mild steam and the scent of cypress fill the air, allowing you to sweat comfortably.

This time, the staff wore a white outfit called 'yukata-bira'. (You can enter in regular clothes too!)

I wondered if Motonaga-san also enjoyed the steam bath like this 450 years ago... as I experienced it while reflecting on history.

The adjacent guidance hall is a full-scale reproduction of the main hall, with exhibits, a resting area, and restrooms.

~Mantokuin Ruins Historical Park~ Reviving the wisdom and skills of the Middle Ages.
The pleasant breeze blowing through the beautiful garden must have been the same 450 years ago.

I highly recommend this experience for history enthusiasts🌞

title: 🍮 A Specialty Store for Smooth Pudding and Light Chiffon Cake 'Niwa no Niwatori' Visited by a Tourism Association Staff 🥚 #KitahiroshimaTown #Sweets
description:
🍮 Do you like sweets? 🍮

A staff member from the tourism association visited 'Niwa no Niwatori' in Kitahiroshima Town in search of sweets!!

'Niwa no Niwatori' is a specialty store for smooth pudding and light chiffon cake run by the Yokoyama couple.

As soon as you open the door, a sweet aroma wafts through the air. My heart leaps at the sight of the neatly arranged puddings and chiffon cakes.

Being a confectionery workshop run by an egg farm, the sweets do not use any flavoring, allowing the taste of the eggs to shine through.
They have reportedly won first place in the online pudding category! ✨️

The tourism association staff's recommendation is the 'Pudding Madonna.'
It's rich and smooth, a reward-worthy sweet.
The slightly bitter caramel is simply irresistible.

The adorable strawberry milk pudding is a limited-time offering, available until around May. The fresh chocolate pudding, featuring high-cocoa chocolate and eggs in a luxurious harmony, is also a popular item. 🍫

The chiffon cake is fluffy and cloud-like.
With a variety of flavors such as tea, chocolate, and cherry blossom, it's perfect for gifts.
The meringue cookies and chiffon cake rusk are also exquisite.

Throughout the filming, laughter filled the air, creating a warm atmosphere that reflects the Yokoyama couple's personality, even in this short video. 🌷

As a treat for yourself or a gift for someone special, be sure to enjoy these 'heartwarming' sweets.

title: Birthday Fair for Maitaro Hanada-kun is Held!!

title: Strawberry Picking in Hiroshima - The Place to Be!! 🍓🍓 #KitahiroshimaTown #Outdoor #Travel #Strawberry
description:
Hey strawberry loversーー!!! 🍓🍓

We visited the Toyohira Donguri Farm in Kitahiroshima Town with the staff of the Kitahiroshima Town Tourism Association and the first Hiroshima Tourism Assistant, Mr. Miyauchi from Hiroshima Kinsaito!!

Mr. Miyauchi from Hiroshima Kinsaito is a tourism assistant who promotes tourism and events in Hiroshima. He visited us last June for the 'Mibu Flower Rice Planting' and has a great love for Kitahiroshima Town!

Mr. Yahagahana from Toyohira Donguri Farm guided us, who are crazy about strawberries. Let's go in a three-person version! So fresh! 😁

It's about a one-hour drive from Hiroshima City. You can enjoy nine carefully cultivated varieties until late May. You can enjoy a 30-minute all-you-can-eat with toppings like condensed milk, chocolate sauce, and whipped cream allowed to be brought in!

The strawberries are so big that when you stuff them in your mouth, you can't talk, so everyone enjoys them in silence. So sweet. And juicy.

Strawberries enjoyed with plenty of whipped cream... the feeling of luxury is irresistible✨️

The spacious pathways in the farm allow for comfortable access with strollers and wheelchairs.

According to Mr. Yahagahana, this time of year when the strawberries are big and sweet is especially recommended! For reservations and inquiries about strawberry picking, please check the Toyohira Donguri Farm's website and social media!

title: 神秘的な「氷瀑ツアー」へ⛄⛄ #北広島町 #北広島市
description:
皆さんは雪山に登った事がありますか？？⛄️

季節限定！豊平にあるワイルドグランピングやキャンプ場「 りゅうずの森 」の藏田さん企画🧊神秘の氷瀑モニターツアー🧊に観光協会職員が行ってきました！！

真冬の龍頭山に登るのは２回目。雪をギュッギュと踏みしめながら進んでいきます。

各所で登山を飽きさせないよう、藏田さんが山の豆知識やクイズを出してくれます🏔️

少し息が切れてきたところで、見どころ１箇所目の「駒ヶ滝」に到着。タイミングが合えばカッチコチの滝を見ることができます🧊
この日は少し天気が良く溶けていましたが、ところどころ氷柱があったり地面の草木が凍っていて宝石のようでした💎

２箇所目の「黒滝」には、溶けて地面に突き刺さった氷柱が！！身長が167センチある職員と同じくらいの大きさって…自然の力の凄みを感じます。

そして太陽の光が降り注ぐ雪山の美しいこと！！
鳥のさえずりと風音しか聞こえない、静かで神秘的な空間でした。

下山したら登山口のそばにあるカフェ「Caf'e de la Richesses 六」でランチ🍽️

藏田さん特製スパイスキーマカレーと、手作りマーマレードティーで体がぽっかぽか！
暖炉で温まりながらツアーの感想をみんなで言い合うお喋りもゆったり贅沢な時間でした☺️

普段なかなか見られない冬の龍頭山をめいっぱい満喫できる、神秘的な氷瀑ツアーでした✨

title: Mysterious 'Ice Waterfall Tour' ⛄⛄ #KitaHiroshimaTown #KitaHiroshimaCity
description:
Have you ever climbed a snowy mountain??⛄️

Limited season! A special project by Mr. Kurata from the wild glamping and camping site 'Ryuzu no Mori' in Toyohira 🧊 Mysterious Ice Waterfall Monitor Tour 🧊 was attended by staff from the tourism association!!

This is my second time climbing Mount Ryuzudake in mid-winter. I advance while firmly stepping on the snow.

To keep the mountain climbing interesting, Mr. Kurata shares mountain trivia and quizzes along the way 🏔️

Just as I started to feel a bit out of breath, we arrived at the first highlight, 'Koma Falls.' If the timing is right, you can see the frozen waterfall in all its glory 🧊. On this day, the weather was a bit nice, causing some melting, but there were still icicles here and there, and the frozen grass and trees looked like jewels 💎.

At the second spot, 'Kuro Falls,' there were icicles that had melted and pierced into the ground!! They were about the same height as our staff member, who is 167 cm tall... you can really feel the power of nature.

And the beauty of the snowy mountain bathed in sunlight is breathtaking!! It was a quiet and mystical space where only the chirping of birds and the sound of the wind could be heard.

After descending, we had lunch at the nearby cafe 'Caf'e de la Richesses 六' 🍽️

Mr. Kurata's special spice keema curry and homemade marmalade tea warmed me right up! Chatting by the fireplace about our impressions of the tour was a leisurely and luxurious time ☺️.

This was a mysterious ice waterfall tour where we could fully enjoy the winter scenery of Mount Ryuzudake, which is not often seen✨.

🧊 This ice waterfall tour will also be held on ★2/8 (Sat) and ★2/11 (Tue)!!! If you're interested, please DM Ryuzu no Mori. (Please note that there is a possibility of the tour taking place in snowy conditions, so beginners in mountain climbing are advised to refrain.) Search for 'Ryuzu no Mori' 🔍

title: What are we drawing?
description:
🎨The drawing series on the blackboard is back!!🎨

Many people have asked, "Aren't you drawing on the blackboard anymore?" and so the drawing series has returned.

This time, we drew the popular performance of the traditional art of Kitahiroshima Town, "Kagura" 🦊The Tale of the Evil Fox (Akko-den)🦊

The beautiful woman "Tamamo-no-Mae" is actually the embodiment of an evil fox. This is a story from the Heian period where a master archer defeats the evil fox that continues its wicked deeds by transforming into various forms. (In a nutshell)

I depicted the scene of the monk and the evil fox enjoying a cozy winter together.
While drawing, I started craving rice cakes; I think I'll have some tonight...

I hope to create drawings that warm the hearts of visitors at the tourist information center!!

We are also accepting requests! Anything related to Kagura or Kitahiroshima Town is preferred!

title: 北広島町のスキー場が盛り上がっているらしい⛄⛄ #旅行 #北広島町#広島  #雪  #スキー#グルメ
description:
冬だー！！スキーだ！！北広島町だ！！　
ということで観光協会職員が町内のスキー場へ遊びに行ってきました⛷️　こちらはロングバージョンです!!

広島って雪積もるん？って未だに聞かれる事があります。自信満々に答えます。北広島町、積もります。

オープンしたてのゲレンデはなんだか特別感があります。太陽に反射する雪がキラキラと美しい。
スキーウェアを着るだけでワクワクします☺️

オープンを心待ちにしておられたお客様。皆さん楽しそうに爽快に滑る姿がかっこよかったです。

町内のスキー場は3カ所。
・芸北高原 大佐スキー場
国道186号線沿いに位置し、駐車場の目の前にゲレンデが広がる。ワイドで緩やかなコースは初心者でも十分に楽しめると大人気。山頂からは中国山地を見渡す絶景が広がり、上級者向けコースを一気に滑り降りられる。「雪ん子パーク ぷぷら」は、ソリ専用ゲレンデとなっており、子供向けのイベントや雪遊びを体験できる。島根から来るペンギン達がゲレンデを歩くイベントも！！🐧🐧

・ユートピアサイオト
そりを持ってラクラク運べるスノーエスカレーターや雪遊びアイテムが盛りだくさんのお子様向けキッズキングダム、そして隣接する黄色い建物ソフィーズにはこたつ付休憩スペースがあり、3世代で1日中スキー場を満喫できる。「西日本最大級」のスノーパークも魅力。 いつでも極上スノーが楽しめ、コンパクトにまとめられたバラエティー豊かなコース展開のスキー場。

北広島町八幡地域にあるスキー場。町内で一番雪が積もると言われる地域で、人工造雪機も完備しているので、期間内いつ行っても雪がある！味、ボリューム満点な食事や休憩室、更衣室、スキーレンタル、スノボーレンタルなど施設も超充実！コースは初級から上級まで幅広く、キッズスノーランドも完備。オール世代で楽しめるスキー場。

title: It seems that the ski resorts in Kitahiroshima Town are thriving⛄⛄ #Travel #Kitahiroshima #Hiroshima #Snow #Skiing #Gourmet
description:
It's winter!! It's skiing!! It's Kitahiroshima Town!!
So, the tourism association staff went to play at the ski resorts in the town⛷️ This is the long version!!

People still ask me if it snows in Hiroshima. I confidently answer, "Yes, it snows in Kitahiroshima Town."

The freshly opened slopes have a special feel to them. The snow reflecting the sun sparkles beautifully.
Just putting on ski wear makes me excited☺️

Customers who were eagerly waiting for the opening looked cool as they joyfully glided down the slopes.

There are three ski resorts in the town.
・Geihoku Kogen Osa Ski Resort
Located along National Route 186, the slopes spread out right in front of the parking lot. The wide and gentle courses are very popular, as even beginners can enjoy them. From the summit, there is a breathtaking view of the Chugoku Mountains, and advanced courses can be skied down in one go. The "Yukinko Park Pupura" is a dedicated sledding slope where children can experience events and play in the snow. There’s even an event where penguins from Shimane walk on the slopes!!🐧🐧

・Utopia Saioto
With a snow escalator that makes it easy to carry sleds and a kids' kingdom filled with snow play items, the adjacent yellow building, Sophie’s, has a resting area with kotatsu, allowing three generations to enjoy the ski resort all day long. The "largest snow park in western Japan" is also a charm. You can enjoy top-notch snow anytime, and the ski resort features a compact and diverse range of courses.

・Yawata Highland 191 Resort
A ski resort located in the Yahata area of Kitahiroshima Town. It is said to be the area with the most snow in the town, and with artificial snow machines in place, there is always snow whenever you visit! The facilities are super well-equipped with delicious and hearty meals, rest areas, changing rooms, ski rentals, and snowboard rentals! The courses range from beginner to advanced, and there is also a kids' snowland. A ski resort that can be enjoyed by all generations.

For those coming from afar, there are many accommodations and guesthouses nearby, so please take your time to enjoy the winter in Kitahiroshima Town🏠

title: 【古民家】洗礼された宿でた特別な時間を過ごす。 #旅行 #北広島町　#古民家 #宿泊
description:
✨️大朝にある1棟貸し古民家「hitaru石橋邸」へ観光協会職員がお邪魔してきました✨️こちらはロングバージョンです！

少し高台になっているところを上がっていくと、温かみのある光とともに古民家が現れます。　　

築200年。刀鍛冶(かたなかじ)職人の邸宅を「株式会社フム」さんがリノベーション。

中に入ると、ぱっと開けた空間に黒を基調としたシックな雰囲気が漂います。う……美しい。

キッチンを中心とした食のゲストハウス がテーマの石橋邸は、旬の食材を自分達で調達して楽しむのもあり、厳選されたシェフの出張料理を味わうのもまた格別です。

至福な食卓を囲むのはこの大きなまーるいテーブル。
こちらはなんと同じ大朝地域にある「福光酒造」さんの酒樽の蓋をリメイクしたもの🍶✨️

宿泊された方に『非日常』に浸ってもらうため、家具やインテリアには隅々までこだわっておられます。
(電化製品は全てBALMUDA😲)

これ使ってみたかった！憧れの家電も。
LEDライト付きの鏡もテンションが上がります🪞

お庭での楽しみは焚き火やBBQ。寒〜い日でもパチパチと揺らぐ火を見つめている時間は心に安らぎをもたらします。
街灯がなく、真っ暗な闇に目が慣れてきたら満天の星空が。星を眺めるなんていつぶりでしょうか…

日が昇ると目の前には「大朝富士」と呼ばれる寒曳山が真正面に。雄大な自然の中での鳥のさえずりは石橋邸ならではのBGMですね☺️

ベッドルームは2部屋あり、布団をしける部屋もあります。最大12名宿泊可能なのは中々珍しいそう。

広島市内から車で1時間の「非日常」。
大切な人たちとの、大切な時間。

「食う」「ねる」「ひたる」都会では味わえない贅沢な時間がここ「hitaru石橋邸」にありました。

title: [Old Folk House] Spend a special time at a refined accommodation. #Travel #KitahiroshimaTown #OldFolkHouse #Accommodation
description:
✨️We visited the one-house rental old folk house "Hitaru Ishibashi-tei" in Oasa, where the tourism association staff had a great time✨️ This is the long version!

As you ascend to a slightly elevated area, the old folk house appears with warm light.

Built 200 years ago. The residence of a swordsmith has been renovated by "Fumu Co., Ltd."

Upon entering, a spacious area with a chic atmosphere based on black greets you. Wow... it's beautiful.

The Ishibashi-tei, themed as a food guest house centered around the kitchen, allows you to enjoy seasonal ingredients that you procure yourself, or savor the exceptional dishes prepared by selected chefs.

Gathering around this large round table for a blissful dining experience. This table is actually remade from the lid of a sake barrel from "Fukumitsu Sake Brewery" located in the same Oasa region 🍶✨️

To immerse guests in the "extraordinary," every detail of the furniture and interior has been carefully considered. (All electrical appliances are BALMUDA 😲)

I wanted to try this! The appliances I've always admired. The mirror with LED lights also raises the excitement 🪞

Enjoying the garden with a bonfire or BBQ. Even on cold days, the time spent gazing at the crackling fire brings peace to the heart. When your eyes adjust to the pitch darkness without streetlights, a starry sky unfolds. When was the last time I gazed at the stars...

As the sun rises, right in front of you is the "Oasa Fuji," also known as Sanbaku Mountain. The chirping of birds in the majestic nature is the unique BGM of Ishibashi-tei ☺️

There are two bedrooms, and one room has futons. It's quite rare to accommodate up to 12 guests.

An "extraordinary" experience just an hour's drive from Hiroshima City. Precious time with your loved ones.

"Eat," "Sleep," and "Immerse" in luxurious moments that cannot be experienced in the city, right here at "Hitaru Ishibashi-tei."

【Access】
hitaru Guest House Ishibashi-tei
731-2104
Oasa 1913-1, Kitahiroshima Town, Yamagata District, Hiroshima Prefecture

title: 米フェス＆全日本お米グランプリin北広島町🌾が開催されました✨ #北広島町 #広島県  #グルメ #観光
description:
米フェス＆全日本お米グランプリin北広島町🌾が開催されました✨

まちづくりセンターの芝生広場で行われた米フェスの「おこめの"わわわ"」コーナーでは、開発コンテンツの産品の試食や購入もでき、たくさんのお客さんで賑わっていました。

この日は風が強い日でしたが、その風に乗って、美味しい香りがあちこちから漂っていました🤤

早くに完売しているブースもチラホラあり大盛況なのが伝わってきました。北広島町のお米で握ったおむすびは大きくて具がたっぷりで絶品。

町内のお米、というのがまた一段と美味しさを感じさせてくれます🍙

ステージでは、神楽や花田植、観光協会の観光PRやお笑い芸人の「メンバー」さんがどっかんどっかんと会場を盛り上げてくださいました！

メンバーさんのステージ中はお客さんの笑い声が途切れることなく聞こえていましたよ♪

観光PRでは、景品付きクイズ大会を開催。　お米にまつわる問題を出しました☝️

その中でも「今日の米フェスでも販売されている日本酒やどぶろくもお米から作られていますね。さて、お酒が登場する神楽の演目は3つのうちどれでしょう！①鐘馗②土蜘蛛③紅葉狩」という問題ではたくさんの子ども達が「えーめっちゃ簡単」と言っていて、さすが神楽どころの北広島町だなぁと職員はなんだか嬉しくなりました☺️👹

もっともっと北広島町の自慢のお米をたくさんの方に知って、食べて、感じていただくために。そして★北広島町は世界一おいしく楽しくお米が食べられる町★を目指し、これからも町全体で「おこめの"わわわ"プロジェクト」を開発、磨きあげて発信していきます！

title: The Rice Festival & All Japan Rice Grand Prix in Kitahiroshima Town 🌾 was held✨
description:
The Rice Festival & All Japan Rice Grand Prix in Kitahiroshima Town 🌾 was held✨

At the rice festival held at the grassy plaza of the town development center, the "Okome no 'Wawawa'" corner was bustling with many customers, where they could taste and purchase products from the developed contents.

Although it was a windy day, delicious aromas wafted through the air.

There were booths that sold out early, indicating the great success of the event. The rice balls made with rice from Kitahiroshima Town were large, filled with plenty of ingredients, and absolutely delicious.

The fact that it was made with local rice made it even more delightful.

On stage, there were performances of Kagura, Hanada-ue, tourism PR by the tourism association, and the comedian "Member" who energized the venue!

During Member's performance, the laughter of the audience was continuous!

In the tourism PR, a quiz contest with prizes was held, featuring questions related to rice.

Among them, a question about the sake and doburoku sold at the festival: "Which of the following three Kagura performances features sake? ① Shōki ② Tokumo ③ Momijigari" had many children saying, "Wow, that's super easy," which made the staff happy to see the knowledge of the local Kagura culture.

To let more people know, eat, and feel the pride of Kitahiroshima Town's rice. And aiming to be the town where you can enjoy the most delicious and fun rice in the world, we will continue to develop, refine, and promote the 'Okome no 'Wawawa' project throughout the town!

title: The 37th Soba Festival 2024 was held in Toyohira on November 16-17 🎉
description:
The 37th Soba Festival 2024 was held in Toyohira on November 16-17 🎉

The number of visitors to the event was about 18,000!!
The stage featured a variety of performances including Kagura, dance, wind orchestra, and Soran, among others (I should have filmed more videos...)
Visitors enjoyed the festival while eating delicious local food and street food, clapping their hands and singing along.

At the stage of singer and talent Shoun Tsukiyama, I was excited to hear my favorite song 'Hiroshima Oyster Song' 🔥

The tourism association also joined in promoting tourism, and I had a lot of fun dancing with many claps ✨

And the highlight of this festival is definitely the 'new soba'.
They prepare soba noodles early in the morning for the festival.
It must be a tough task, but everyone looks so happy!
I was captivated by their skilled hands.

As I entered the tent, I was greeted by the aroma of dashi.
The gentle dashi and freshly made soba made my body relax.
Tsukiyama-san and I said, 'Itadakimasu!!'

Just by looking at Tsukiyama-san's expression, you can tell how delicious it is ☺️
You can enjoy Toyohira soba all year round at the Toyohira Donguri Village roadside station.
The roadside station also has hot springs and souvenirs, so please come and visit! 

I am looking forward to next year's soba festival too!

title: The Oasa Wasanowa Stamp Rally was participated by the tourism association staff 🍂 #KitahiroshimaTown #HiroshimaPrefecture
description:
🍂 The Oasa Wasanowa Stamp Rally was participated by the tourism association staff 🍂

First, scan the QR code and log in to the stamp rally site!

Check the spots, and when you arrive at your destination, you can earn stamps on the spot. There are various ways to earn them, such as scanning 2D codes, obtaining location via GPS, and answering quizzes!

Once you collect stamps, you can apply for rewards! This time, I collected 8 stamps and got 3 go of rice!✨️ If you keep collecting stamps, you also have a chance to win 30 kg of rice!

Additionally, there are experience contents such as lumberjack experiences and cycling tours as rewards 🌳 Meal vouchers are also nice!

Exploring local spots that even locals may not know feels like an adventure♪ Perfect for autumn leaf viewing and driving! "By the way, since we are here, let's try the stamp rally!" Please feel free to join us 😁

The period is until December 9th!! There are still plenty of rewards available!

We are also holding the Oasa Wasanowa Photo Contest, where you can also have a chance to win 30 kg of rice! How luxurious...🍙

Please join the stamp rally and photo contest to "rediscover" the charm of Oasa!

description:
✨️「O.M.S大朝モビリティステーション」の秋のサイクリングツアーに観光協会職員が行ってきました✨️

バスの駅だった大朝駅をサイクリストや観光客が集える場所にしたのが大朝モビリティステーション『O.M.S』。

バスを利用される方はもちろん、サイクリストや大朝に遊びに来られた方も気軽にお立ち寄ることのできるスポットです。

ここではスポーツタイプの電動アシスト自転車（E-BIKE）で巡るツアーや、レンタサイクルができ

今回観光職員が案内してもらったのは今の時期だけの秋コース。

久しぶりの運動で少し息切れはしたものの、加計山からの眺めの爽快感に一気にリフレッシュ！！

頂上で食べる塩むすびはシンプルイズザベスト🍙

加計山の後は西教寺の銀杏とほとけばら遊園へ！
この動画は11/4に撮影したものですが、今週末が1番綺麗そうです✨️

このツアーはガイドの田川さんの豊富な知識と柔軟なコース展開、そしてなによりお客さんを全力で楽しませるという熱い想いが詰まっています。

お客さん1人1人に合わせてツアーをアレンジすることもでき、どんな方でもオリジナルのツアーで楽しんでいただく事ができます✨️

道中にも大朝地域の歴史や文化、豆知識など地元の方しかわからないコアな情報などもお話してくださり、楽しいだけじゃなく「学び」の要素もあります。

田川さんのおちゃめで温かいガイドで疲れを全く感じないサイクリングでした☺️

ぜひ大朝のプロフェッショナル田川さんに会いに来てくださいね！！

title: Autumn Cycling Tour in Kitahiroshima Town 🍂🍂
description:
✨️ A staff member from the tourism association visited the autumn cycling tour at 'O.M.S. Oasa Mobility Station' ✨️

The former Oasa bus station has been transformed into a gathering place for cyclists and tourists, known as the Oasa Mobility Station 'O.M.S'.

It is a spot where not only bus users but also cyclists and visitors to Oasa can easily stop by.

Here, you can join tours on sports-type electric assist bicycles (E-BIKES) or rent bicycles. 
Parking and bike parking are available, and they also provide bicycle maintenance and guidance on cycling routes.

The Kake-yama Hill Climb Challenge is also registered at O.M.S 🔥

The tour guided by the tourism staff featured an autumn course available only at this time of year.

Although I was a bit out of breath from the exercise after a long time, the refreshing view from Kake-yama instantly revitalized me!!

The salt rice balls eaten at the summit are simple yet the best 🍙

After Kake-yama, we headed to the ginkgo trees at Saikyo-ji Temple and the Hoko Bara Amusement Park! 
This video was filmed on November 4th, but it seems this weekend will be the most beautiful ✨️

This tour is filled with the extensive knowledge and flexible course development of our guide, Mr. Tagawa, and above all, his passionate desire to entertain the guests.

The tour can be arranged to suit each individual guest, allowing everyone to enjoy an original experience ✨️

Along the way, Mr. Tagawa shared core information about the history, culture, and trivia of the Oasa region that only locals would know, making it not only fun but also educational.

With Mr. Tagawa's charming and warm guidance, I didn't feel tired at all during the cycling ☺️

Please come and meet the professional of Oasa, Mr. Tagawa!!

title: 月山翔雲さんと花田舞太郎くんのコラボステージ！！ #北広島町
description:
10月12日（土）・13日（日）の2日間、道の駅舞ロードIC千代田「秋の大感謝祭」が開催されました✨

子ども神楽👹や千代田中学校の生徒さん達の吹奏楽、そして北広島町観光大使の月山翔雲さんのステージライブなど盛りだくさんの2日間でした！！

オープニングを盛大に飾ってくださった千代田中学校の吹奏楽部の皆さんは「広島県吹奏楽コンクール　中学生小編成部門　金賞」を受賞されたんです✨おめでとうございます！

子ども神楽は準備の段階でみーんな楽しそうで、たくさんの人に見てもらえる！という嬉しさが馴染み出ていました。子ども達は地域の「宝」ですね。

ステージの下ではたくさんの子ども達が月山さんの歌にノリノリ🕺♪お客さんは手拍子しながら心地良さそうに聞いておられました。

個人的には「ひろしま牡蠣のうた」が前々から好きで、生で聞けて感動しました🦪(すっごくポップで頭に残るリズムで踊りたくなる曲なんです‼︎)

最後には「おいでよ！キタひろ」を月山さんの生歌で花田舞太郎くんと踊りました。

歌いながらあのダンスを完璧に踊る月山さん…さすがです。月山さんアップの動画がうまく撮れてなく、悔しいので次の⭐️豊平そばまつりでリベンジします！

会場全体で大人も子どもも一緒にモーモーモーモー🐮と踊ってくださって、大盛り上がりのステージでした！動画では「レッツら モー‼️」も一緒にやっていただいてすごく光栄です✨

イベントの最後には毎年恒例の景品付き餅まき。たくさん「福」を持って帰ってくださいました。

たくさんの方に愛され続ける「道の駅舞ロードIC千代田」さんは千代田IC降りてすぐございますので秋のドライブ、観光の際にはぜひお立ち寄りください🍂

title: Collaboration Stage of Shoun Yatsuyama and Maitaro Hanada!! #KitahiroshimaTown
description:
On October 12th (Saturday) and 13th (Sunday), the 'Autumn Grand Thanksgiving Festival' was held at Michi no Eki Mai Road IC Chiyoda✨

It was a packed two days with children's Kagura👹, a brass band performance by students from Chiyoda Junior High School, and a stage live by Kitahiroshima Town Tourism Ambassador Shoun Yatsuyama!!

The brass band from Chiyoda Junior High School, who opened the event grandly, won the 'Hiroshima Prefecture Brass Band Competition - Junior High School Small Ensemble Division Gold Prize'✨ Congratulations!

The children’s Kagura looked like everyone was having fun during the preparation stage, and the joy of being able to show it to many people was evident. The children are the 'treasure' of the community.

Under the stage, many children were enjoying Yatsuyama's songs🕺♪ The audience seemed to be listening comfortably while clapping their hands.

Personally, I have loved 'Hiroshima Oyster Song' for a long time, and I was moved to hear it live🦪 (It's such a catchy and poppy song that makes you want to dance‼︎)

At the end, I danced with Maitaro Hanada-kun to Yatsuyama's live song 'Oideyo! Kita Hiro'.

Yatsuyama danced perfectly while singing that song... as expected. I couldn't capture a good video of Yatsuyama, and I'm frustrated, so I will take revenge at the next ⭐️ Toyohira Soba Festival!

The entire venue was lively, with both adults and children dancing together to 'Moo Moo Moo Moo'🐮, making for a very exciting stage! I was very honored to have everyone join in on the video for 'Let's Moo‼️'✨

At the end of the event, there was the annual tradition of a mochi throwing with prizes. Many people took home a lot of 'luck'.

The Michi no Eki Mai Road IC Chiyoda, which continues to be loved by many, is just off the Chiyoda IC, so please stop by during your autumn drive and sightseeing🍂

title: 県立広島大学の大学祭「紫苑祭」に行ってきました！！ #北広島町#旅行 　#大学　#観光
description:
🐮県立広島大学さんの大学祭「紫苑祭」に参加させていただきました🐮

ブースでは町内のスキー場さんとリフト券やカープグッズが当たるガラポン抽選会を行いました！

たくさんの方が参加してくれて、スキー場のリフト券を当てて大喜びしてくれる生徒さんの姿が印象的でした☺

ステージでの観光PRでは、北広島町の伝統芸能やスキー場情報をお話した後に✨景品付きクイズ大会✨を開催。

町内のクイズ三択問題を真剣に考えてくれる生徒さんたちがとってもかわいかったです💛

「おいでよ！キタひろ」ダンスはたくさんの生徒さんが一緒に踊ってくれて「おい！おい！おい！」と元気のいい（野太い）掛け声もあり、大盛り上がりでした。

title: I went to the Hiroshima Prefectural University Festival 'Shion Festival'!! #KitahiroshimaTown #Travel #University #Tourism
description:
🐮I participated in the Hiroshima Prefectural University's festival 'Shion Festival'🐮

At the booth, we held a lottery draw with lift tickets from the local ski resort and Carp merchandise!

Many people participated, and it was impressive to see students who won ski resort lift tickets rejoicing☺

During the tourism PR on stage, after talking about the traditional performing arts and ski resort information of Kitahiroshima Town, we held a quiz competition with prizes✨.

The students who seriously thought about the multiple-choice quiz questions from the town were so cute💛.

The 'Come on! Kita Hiro' dance had many students dancing together, and there were energetic (deep-voiced) cheers of 'Oi! Oi! Oi!' which created a lively atmosphere.

In the sudden 'Arm Wrestling Tournament', Maitaro-kun faced off against the champion🔥🔥.

Maitaro-kun lost easily and looked quite disappointed.

With stalls selling churros and meat-wrapped rice balls, as well as a haunted house and casino, it was truly a place of youth that represents a university festival, and I was very happy to promote tourism there.

Please come and visit the ski resort in Kitahiroshima Town this winter too⛄

You can enjoy all-you-can-eat grapes for 40 minutes, and you can eat as many ripe and sweet grapes as you want. Of course, you can take some home too!

title: ✨あの大人気の「ふりかけ」の原材料！紫色に広がる赤しそ畑に花田舞太郎と観光協会職員とが行ってきました✨ #北広島町
description:
あの大人気の「ふりかけ」の原材料！紫色に広がる赤しそ畑に花田舞太郎と観光協会職員とが行ってきました✨

8月初旬、早朝にも関わらずジリジリと日差しが照り付ける中、赤しそは太陽の光を受け輝いていました。

今回我々がお邪魔したのは「三島食品株式会社　北広島町農園事業『紫の里』」です。

高品質原料の研究開発や契約産地との栽培加工技術交流を強化され、2020年には赤しその水耕栽培も開始されたりと、日々品質向上を目指しておられます。

この赤しそ畑の刈り取りは6月頃～9月上旬まで。
新鮮な「わき芽」（若葉部分）だけを刈り取り機で収穫します。

特別に乗せて頂きましたが、ものすごい音と振動でビビりました💦

刈り取ったわき芽を嗅ぐと…爽やかな良い香り～！！これがあの「ゆかり🄬ふりかけ」になるんです。
なんだかお腹が減ってきました。☺

畑からはふりかけの資料館「楠苑」も見えます。
ここでは全国のふりかけメーカーの商品が展示され、ふりかけの起源や製造工程も学べちゃいます✎

赤しそ畑を見学した後は、工場へ！！
次回の工場編もお楽しみに！！

今回体験したのは、滑車を使って木々の間に張られたロープを滑り降りる「ジップライン」と、ゲレンデや林道を駆け巡る「バギーアドベンチャー」の２つ。

絶叫が苦手な職員はジップラインのスタート地点の高さにビビり、へっぴり腰でなんとかジャンプ。

title: ✨We experienced the limited-time 'Summer Activities' at Utopia Saioto Ski Resort in Kitahiroshima Town with Maitaro and the tourism association staff!!✨
description:
✨We experienced the limited-time 'Summer Activities' at Utopia Saioto Ski Resort in Kitahiroshima Town with Maitaro and the tourism association staff!!✨

This time, we tried two activities: the 'Zip Line,' where you slide down a rope stretched between trees using a pulley, and the 'Buggy Adventure,' which takes you racing through the slopes and forest roads.

One staff member, who isn't fond of screams, was scared by the height at the starting point of the zip line and managed to jump with a stiff back.

But once you take the plunge, you can just feel the wind all over your body and enjoy the refreshing sensation.

While enjoying the view from the air, I even had the luxury of thinking, 'Is this how birds feel?' ☺ There are a total of six courses, so next time, I’m going to conquer them all!!

And personally, the 'Buggy Adventure' was even more thrilling than the zip line.

After receiving thorough instructions on how to operate, we set off. Like chicks following their parent bird, we desperately kept up with the manager, Mr. Yamamoto.

The most popular course, 'Sky Buggy Adventure,' has a distance of 4,000m and climbs to an elevation of 1,000m, reaching the summit.

There, a breathtaking view that extends all the way to the Sea of Japan unfolded before us.

Taking a deep breath, I absorbed the power of nature with my whole body. I felt a sense of achievement and emotion as if I had leveled up myself.

This summer, let’s break out of our shells at Utopia Saioto.

title: 「株式会社広島電鉄」×「三島食品株式会社」コラボ✨「ひろし®」ふりかけのラッピングバスを花田舞太郎と観光協会職員が取材に行ってきました‼
description:
「株式会社広島電鉄」×「三島食品株式会社」コラボ✨「ひろし®」ふりかけのラッピングバスを花田舞太郎と観光協会職員が取材に行ってきました‼

三島食品さんの創業者の方は北広島町出身。北広島町の千代田地域にはふりかけの資料館「楠苑」と北広島農園事業・一次加工場があり、毎年夏には太陽光を浴びて生き生きと育つ赤しそ畑が一面に広がります。北広島町と深～い繋がりがある三島食品さんのふりかけ「ひろし®」は、広島を代表する食材「広島菜」の素材の良さを生かし、彩りよく仕上げられている混ぜごはんの素。この人気商品が、広島電鉄さんのバスのラッピングになり、市内を運行しています。動画に出演して頂いたのは広島電鉄さんの石田さんと西本さん、そして三島食品さんの新宅さん。ご多忙、そして猛暑の中にもかかわらず全面協力していただきました。「広島菜」を沢山の人に知ってもらうため、そして愛する広島の地元企業を応援するため、そんな広島電鉄さんと三島食品さんの熱い想いがこのラッピングに詰まっています。

title: Collaboration between Hiroshima Electric Railway Co., Ltd. and Mishima Foods Co., Ltd.✨ We went to interview the wrapped bus of 'Hiroshi®' furikake with Maita Hanada and the tourism association staff‼
description: The founder of Mishima Foods is from Kitahiroshima Town. In the Chiyoda area of Kitahiroshima Town, there is a furikake museum called 'Kusunoki-en' and a primary processing facility for the Kitahiroshima agricultural project, where fields of red shiso grow vigorously under the summer sun every year. The furikake 'Hiroshi®' from Mishima Foods, which has a deep connection with Kitahiroshima Town, is a mixed rice ingredient that beautifully utilizes the quality of 'Hiroshima-nama', a representative ingredient of Hiroshima. This popular product has been wrapped on Hiroshima Electric Railway's buses and is operating in the city. The video features Mr. Ishida and Mr. Nishimoto from Hiroshima Electric Railway, and Mr. Shintaku from Mishima Foods. Despite their busy schedules and the scorching heat, they fully cooperated. To let many people know about 'Hiroshima-nama' and to support local companies in beloved Hiroshima, the passionate thoughts of Hiroshima Electric Railway and Mishima Foods are packed into this wrapping.

title: I Went on a Factory Tour of Furikake.
description:
The other day, I had the opportunity to tour the factory!!

【The Connection with Mishima Foods, Famous for Yukari®︎】
Did you know that the roots of Yukari®, the big ace of furikake now known nationwide, are in Kitahiroshima Town?
If Mishima Foods has its roots in Kitahiroshima Town, then Yukari®︎ also has its connection there.
1. Mr. Tetsuo Mishima, who founded the company in 1949, is from Arita in Kitahiroshima Town.
2. The place where the founder, Mr. Tetsuo Mishima, was born is now a furikake museum called 'Kusunoki-en'.
3. The area in front of Kusunoki-en is filled with red shiso fields in a shiso color! They have their own farm, 'Murasaki no Sato', located in Kitahiroshima Town.
And so on... there is a deep connection.

In Kitahiroshima Town, from mid-May, a carpet of shiso color spreads all around, creating a unique scenery that can only be seen now.
*The photo was taken on June 13, 2023.

title: The Land Associated with the Yoshikawa Clan
description:
【Toyohira Area, Kitahiroshima Town】
Numerous historical sites of the Yoshikawa clan, who ruled this area during the Sengoku period, remain, allowing visitors to feel the footsteps of the samurai and the breath of the people.

【Yoshikawa Motoharu Residence Ruins Historical Park】
The ruins of a residence built as a retirement home for Yoshikawa Motoharu. Many building foundations, toilets, wells, and gardens have been discovered. In the restored kitchen building, cooking can be done using a kamado and a hearth.

【Sengoku Garden Historical Museum】
An exhibition facility that guides visitors through the entire site of the Yoshikawa clan's castle ruins. It features displays of artifacts unearthed from the site, exhibitions on medieval life, and armor displays, with the opportunity to try on armor.

title: 【北広島町】国の天然記念物～大朝のテングシデ群落～
description: 標高640ｍ、広さ約57アールのゆるやかな谷間に、イヌシデの変種が大小およそ１００本群生。枝や幹がクネクネと曲がりくねっためずらしい樹形をしており、天狗の伝説があることから、テングシデと呼ばれ地域の人たちから大切にされてきた。国の天然記念物に指定され、世界で唯一ここだけに自生しています。５月上旬の新緑は必見。※冬季は林道の除雪が行われないため、積雪時はスノーシューなどの装備がなければ見ることができない。非常に貴重な光景。

title: National Natural Monument - The Tengu Shide Grove in Oasa, Kitahiroshima Town
description: At an elevation of 640 meters, approximately 100 trees of a variant of the Japanese dogwood grow in a gentle valley covering about 57 ares. The branches and trunks have a rare twisted shape, and due to the legend of the Tengu, they are called Tengu Shide and have been cherished by the local people. Designated as a national natural monument, they are the only self-sustaining grove of this kind in the world. The fresh greenery in early May is a must-see. *In winter, snow removal on the forest road is not conducted, so without snowshoeing equipment, it cannot be seen during snowfall. It is a very precious sight.

description: 利尻島は、日本の北のてっぺん稚内市から西へ約52km。島の西側にある「利尻町」と東側にある「利尻富士町」の2つの町からなり、島の真ん中にそびえる利尻岳をぐるりと囲む海岸線で島人は生活しています。春から夏にかけてとりどりの高山植物が花開き、全国的にも有名な「利尻昆布」や「ウニ」など日本海の海の幸や天然の恵み・湧水に恵まれた、漁業と観光の島です。

title: Hokkaido Rishiri Island Guide Operators Introduction
description: Rishiri Island is located about 52 km west of Wakkanai City, the northern tip of Japan. It consists of two towns, Rishiricho on the west side and Rishirifuji Town on the east side, with the majestic Rishiri Mountain towering in the center, surrounded by a coastline where the islanders live. From spring to summer, various alpine plants bloom, and the island is blessed with marine products from the Sea of Japan, such as the nationally famous 'Rishiri Kelp' and 'Sea Urchin', as well as natural blessings and spring water, making it an island of fishing and tourism.

title: 加太春日神社
description: 加太春日神社の創建年代は明確ではないが、紀伊国造家旧記によると、神武天皇御東征の御代に、天道根命が二種を奉じて加太浦に上陸、頓宮を造営して天照大御神を祀ったことに始まるという。当地は海に面して漁業の盛んなところであるため、のちに航海安全と大漁を祈願する住吉神社を合祀したらしく、文保元年（一三一七年）六月二十九日付賀太庄住吉社への寄進状（向井家文書）が残されている。 当社の社名については、紀伊風土記によると日野左衛門藤原光福が地頭としてこの地を支配した嘉元年間（一三〇三～一三一七年）に、自分の祖先神である春日三神をあらたに祀り、総名として「春日社」と称したとあり、嘉吉２年（一四四二年）の記録に春日明神神事日記（向井家文書）がある。 紀伊名所図絵によると、社地はもと、現在地から東の山の中腹にあったが、天正年間（一五七三～一五九二年）に羽柴秀長の家臣で和歌山城代（当時、秀長は大和郡山に居城、大和、和泉、紀伊三国を領し、紀伊国は和歌山城代が支配）、桑山重晴によって現在地に遷したと記している。なお、棟札（重文）によって慶長元年（一五九六年）に大がかりな社殿の造作がなされたことも実証されている。 当神社は、明治時代まで神職はおかず、神社経営は宮座形式の当屋制によって運営されていた。そのため、神社には記録文書類は全く存在せず、他からの資料に頼らざるを得ないが、御神徳の篤い神社であることは、「紀伊国神名帳」に「正一位春日大神」と記されており、神格の高さを知ることが出来ると共に、役小角（飛鳥時代の山岳修業者で修験道の開祖者、役行者とも称す）が、友ヶ島を行場とし、当社を勧請して守護神とされた。そのため現在でも毎年四月、当社に聖護院門跡が大勢の山伏僧と共に参拝されていることからもわかる。 また、昭和五十六年、環境庁（現環境省）主催の第二十三回自然公園大会において、採火神社に指定され、聖火を献火すると共に、氏子有志による獅子舞が郷土芸能として披露された。 なお、加太春日神社の現在の社名は、太平洋戦争後、全国の神社が国家の保護を離れ、宗教法人による神社に切り替わったとき、用いられたものである。
