title: 2020年10月3日 国道57号（現道）開通
description:
国道57号線 立野区間 （通称:立野キャニオンロード）

遥か昔、健磐龍命が蹴破り阿蘇を拓いた伝説が残る立野峡谷。その壮大な景観を望みながら阿蘇へと続く国道57号線は、地元では“立野キャニオンロード”と呼ば親しまれてきました。
2016年熊本地震の大規模斜面崩落(数鹿流くずれ)により寸断されていたが、約4年半の時を経て2020年10月3日に開通します。

title: Opening of National Route 57 (Current Road) on October 3, 2020
description:
National Route 57 Line, the Tateyano section (commonly known as Tateyano Canyon Road)

Long ago, there is a legend that the deity Kenbanryu no Mikoto broke through and developed Aso in the Tateyano Gorge. The National Route 57 line, which continues to Aso while overlooking its magnificent scenery, has been affectionately called 'Tateyano Canyon Road' by locals. It was cut off due to a large-scale landslide (Suzukaryu collapse) caused by the Kumamoto earthquake in 2016, but it will open on October 3, 2020, after about four and a half years.

title: 【南阿蘇】レンタサイクルに乗ろう！絶景ロードを走って白川水源までver.
description: 【レンタサイクルに乗ろう！絶景ロードを走って白川水源までver.】南阿蘇の一番人気のアクティビティ、レンタサイクルの動画をご紹介！快適な電動アシスト付自転車にまたがり、雄大な阿蘇の大パノラマを感じながら白川水源まで。観光案内所スタッフのオススメコース、一本道の田園風景を走る「絶景ロード」や南阿蘇鉄道沿線沿いを走る「トレインロード」など地元に住むコーディネーターだからそこ知る南阿蘇を満喫できるスペシャルコースとなっています。車の通りも少ない田舎道を選び、なるべく安全なコース設定となっています。今回の目的地である「白川水源」は熊本を代表する南阿蘇湧水群の代名詞とも言える水源で一級河川白川の総水源。毎分60トンもの湧水が地底の砂とともに勢いよく湧き上がり、訪れる人々に大地の恵みを感じさせます。南阿蘇観光案内所ではe-sports bike（電動クロスバイク）、ママチャリ自転車(電動アシスト付)、子供用マウンテンバイク（※電動アシストなし）など様々な年齢に対応した自転車をご用意しております。南阿蘇に訪れた際は是非、ご利用ください。レンタサイクル料金などはみなみあそ観光局HPをご覧ください。

title: Let's Ride a Rental Bicycle in Minami Aso! Running on the Scenic Road to Shirakawa Springs ver.
description: This video introduces the most popular activity in Minami Aso, rental cycling! Hop on a comfortable electric assist bicycle and feel the magnificent panorama of Aso while heading to Shirakawa Springs. The recommended courses by the staff at the tourist information center include the 'Scenic Road' that runs through the picturesque rural landscape and the 'Train Road' along the Minami Aso Railway, making it a special course that allows you to fully enjoy Minami Aso, known by local coordinators. The course is set to be as safe as possible, choosing country roads with little traffic. The destination, 'Shirakawa Springs,' is a representative water source of Kumamoto, known as the symbol of the Minami Aso spring water group, and is the total water source of the first-class river Shirakawa. Every minute, 60 tons of spring water gushes up vigorously along with the underground sand, allowing visitors to feel the blessings of the earth. The Minami Aso Tourist Information Center offers various bicycles suitable for different ages, including e-sports bikes (electric cross bikes), mama-chari bicycles (with electric assist), and children's mountain bikes (without electric assist). If you visit Minami Aso, please make sure to use them. For rental bicycle fees and more, please check the Minami Aso Tourism Bureau website.

title: 東海大学農学部を卒業する皆さんへ～2020年 春～
description:
～東海大学農学部を卒業される皆様へ～

大学ご卒業おめでとうございます。

4年間の密度の濃い大学生活を経て、これから社会人としてそれぞれの道へと進むべく、皆様の心は今、期待や不安、そして覚悟でいっぱいかと存じます。

入学直後には熊本地震があり、皆様に大変な思いをさせてしまったことを申し訳なく思います。それでも若い皆さんが少しでも住んでくれて、またキャンパスが移った後も南阿蘇に関わってくれて、本当に嬉しかったです。

今回、残念ながら新型コロナの影響で卒業式も中止となり、別れを惜しむ時間も取れないまま見送ることとなってしまい、大変無念な気持ちでおります。そこで、皆様に向けたせめてものエールとして、南阿蘇村一同からお祝いと感謝の気持ちを込めたメッセージ動画をお届けします。南阿蘇村には皆様の居場所がいつでもあります。立派になった皆さんとまたお会いできる日を楽しみにしています。

夢に向かって元気に羽ばたく皆様のご多幸を心より祈念いたします。

title: To All Graduates of Tokai University Faculty of Agriculture - Spring 2020
description:
Congratulations on your graduation from university.

After four years of a dense university life, I believe your hearts are now filled with expectations, anxieties, and determination as you each embark on your respective paths as members of society.

I sincerely apologize for the difficulties you faced due to the Kumamoto earthquake shortly after your enrollment. Nevertheless, I was truly happy that you young people lived here even a little, and that you continued to be involved with Minami Aso after the campus moved.

Unfortunately, due to the impact of the new coronavirus, the graduation ceremony has been canceled, and we have had to send you off without the time to bid farewell, which is very regrettable. Therefore, as a small token of encouragement for you, we are delivering a message video filled with congratulations and gratitude from all of Minami Aso Village. There will always be a place for you in Minami Aso Village. We look forward to the day we can meet again with all of you who have become wonderful individuals.

I sincerely wish for your happiness as you energetically spread your wings toward your dreams.

title: 在地紀錄片【鄉野中的日本】EP01 | 修驗道行者隱居深山打造完美治愈空間 | 奈良縣宇陀市深野
description:
這次巡旅君前往拜訪的是位在奈良縣宇陀市深野，由一位修驗道行者松林哲司先生創辦的「笹百合庵」。
松林先生是一位有著奇特人生經歷的人物，大學時代孤身一人遊歷世界，雖被喜馬拉雅山脈的神秘與肅穆所折服，終究還是返回家鄉在大阪經營商社。而後為了追求自己理想的精神世界成為一名修驗道的僧人，改造深山村落裡的百年古宅，在這裡修行，經商，接待世界各地的旅人。
他自己所追尋的，同時也希望在現代都市生活中奔波的人們所體驗的究竟是一片怎樣的土地和居住空間呢？

********************

《鄉野中的日本》是一部在地紀錄片。我們聚焦位在鄉野經營小型精品旅舍的主理人，透過他們的理念，生活以及與當地人之間的聯繫，帶大家走進大都會以外的另一個日本。

********************

日本巡旅｜注重個性與本質的永續出行指南。

相較遊人交織、量化生產的觀光地，『日本巡旅』更多的著眼於仍然保留有在地淳樸風情的小地方。蘊含當地人念想的旅舍、料理店、茶館、藝術創作、個性店鋪，是一扇扇洞察在地文化與傳統的窗口。她們通過對當代生活方式的探索，在自然生態造就的古老營生和永續發展之間找到平衡。希望我們的小小努力能夠拓寬旅行的邊界，幫助構建起超越國界與文化的連接。

title: Local Documentary 【Japan in the Countryside】 EP01 | A Shugendo Practitioner Creates a Perfect Healing Space in the Deep Mountains | Fukano, Uda City, Nara Prefecture
description:
This time, we visit 'Sasayuri-an', located in Fukano, Uda City, Nara Prefecture, founded by Mr. Tetsuji Matsubayashi, a Shugendo practitioner.
Mr. Matsubayashi is a person with a unique life experience. During his university years, he traveled the world alone, captivated by the mystery and solemnity of the Himalayas, but eventually returned to his hometown to run a trading company in Osaka. Later, in pursuit of his ideal spiritual world, he became a Shugendo monk, transforming a century-old house in a mountain village into a place for practice, business, and welcoming travelers from around the world.
What kind of land and living space is he seeking, and what do people rushing through modern urban life hope to experience?

********************

'Japan in the Countryside' is a local documentary. We focus on the operators of small boutique inns in rural areas, bringing you into another Japan outside the metropolis through their philosophies, lives, and connections with local people.

********************

Japan Travel | A Sustainable Travel Guide that Values Personality and Essence.

Compared to tourist spots that are intertwined with visitors and mass production, 'Japan Travel' focuses more on small places that still retain the local rustic charm. Inns, restaurants, tea houses, art creations, and unique shops that embody the thoughts of local people are windows into local culture and traditions. Through exploring contemporary lifestyles, they find a balance between ancient livelihoods shaped by natural ecology and sustainable development. We hope our small efforts can broaden the boundaries of travel and help build connections that transcend borders and cultures.

【What We Do】

3. Convey thoughts rather than cold material

B. Local Inn Platform

We select small independent inns hidden in the mountains and countryside across Japan. They may be tucked away in the mountains, standing on islands, or even blending into the local village atmosphere. In principle, they are far from urban and popular tourist spots, with no more than 5 guest rooms. We exclude mass-produced inns; all are independently operated by the owners or local companies. As a travel base for deep local experiences, they possess strong personalities that can explain the unique ecological environment, cultural aesthetics, and the practice of sustainable tourism.

Through interviews with the operators, we deeply analyze the charm of local inns from various perspectives, including cultural ecology, local ingredients, operator stories, architectural design, and experiential exchanges.

It is a work that delivers 'the story of Ukushima' to audiences both domestically and internationally through distribution and other means.

title: Goto Islands' Northernmost Island 'Ukushima' Vertical Short Drama 'Gift (Tentative)'

Produced in a vertical format, it offers the SNS generation an experience of 'accidentally discovering Ukushima.'

description:

市内へと向かうトンネルを抜けると、
目の前には海と街が同時に現れる。
港をぐるりと取り囲む斜面には、家々がひしめいている。
かつてこの街には海の向こうからやってきた外国人と
海の向こうを目指す志士や幕臣が行き交っていた。
今も、ポルトガルのお菓子と、オランダの商館と、中華街と、
造船所と、うまい魚料理がごちゃまぜに同居している。
日本の西の端に位置する長崎市は、遠い。
その印象に反するように、海と街、人と人の距離は、近い。
街の人は言う。
すべてを受け入れる長崎市民の懐の広さが
この街を常に新しい街へと進化させてきた、と。
その意味を理解できるまで、あと何度か通うことになりそうだ。

title: Nearby in life, look, the world.
description:
https://etooto.jp/

As I pass through the tunnel heading into the city,
I am greeted by both the sea and the city at once.
On the slopes surrounding the port, houses are crowded together.
Once, this city was bustling with foreigners arriving from across the sea
and those who aspired to reach beyond the sea, including warriors and samurai.
Even now, Portuguese sweets, Dutch trading posts, Chinatown,
shipyards, and delicious fish dishes coexist in a delightful mix.
Nagasaki City, located at the western edge of Japan, feels distant.
Contrary to that impression, the distance between the sea and the city, and between people, is close.
The people of the city say,
the open-mindedness of Nagasaki citizens, who embrace everything,
has continually evolved this city into a new one.
It seems I will need to visit a few more times to fully understand that meaning.

title: THE ROOTS #09 回帰された土壌に根付くアスパラガス
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

北海道南西部、檜山郡厚沢部町。
80％以上を森林が占める農林業の町。
この地でアスパラガス専門農家を営むのは
長谷川博紀（はせがわひろき）さん。

彼がおこなう農業は、とても本質的。
その土地の土壌が形成された歴史・仕組みを
調べることからはじまり、地質が本来の姿を
取り戻すための努力を惜しまない。
大地に負荷を与えず、
昆虫や微生物にも負荷を与えない農業。

アスパラガスは多年草。
ひとつの株が収穫時期を終えても、
幹や枝葉を伸ばし、根に蓄えた養分で越冬する。
ここで育つアスパラガスは20年以上の古株も
珍しくなく、旨味はぐんぐん増していく。

そんな農園のアスパラガスが美味いのは
言うまでもなく、質の高さは都内を中心に
全国のシェフの声で証明されている。
長谷川さんがつくるアスパラ、通称ハセパラは
アスパラガスが持つ本来の甘み・渋み・旨みを
存分に味わえる。

そのまま生でもジューシーな味わいだが



火加減と火入れ時間によっては、
様々な


表情を見せてくれるハセパラ。






まずは一本、めしあがれ。

title: THE ROOTS #09 Asparagus Rooted in Reclaimed Soil
description:
WEB SITE
https://etooto.jp/

In the southwestern part of Hokkaido, in Atsubetsu Town, Hiyama District.
A town where over 80% is covered by forests, known for agriculture and forestry.
The asparagus specialist farmer here is Hiroki Hasegawa.

His approach to agriculture is very fundamental.
It begins with researching the history and structure of the soil formed in that land,
and he spares no effort in restoring the geology to its original state.
Farming that does not burden the earth,
or impose stress on insects and microorganisms.

Asparagus is a perennial plant.
Even when one stalk has finished its harvest season,
it continues to grow its stems and leaves, wintering with the nutrients stored in its roots.
Asparagus grown here often has roots that are over 20 years old,
and its flavor continues to intensify.

It goes without saying that the asparagus from this farm is delicious,
and its high quality is proven by the voices of chefs across the country, especially in Tokyo.
The asparagus made by Hasegawa, commonly known as Hasepara,
allows you to fully enjoy the natural sweetness, bitterness, and umami of asparagus.

It is juicy and flavorful even when eaten raw,
but depending on the heat and cooking time,
it shows various expressions.

First, enjoy one stalk.

description:

The title “Nichinichi kore Yoron” is an homage to the Zen phrase, “Nichinichi kore kojitsu” which means “Everyday is a good day so we appreciate every moment of our life and every moment is special. Live life just the way it is. “
We’ve learned how important it is to appreciate every moment of our life during the pandemic. 
Tourism is one of the sectors most affected by the COVID-19 pandemic. Yoron Island is no exception.
Every year, the island is suffers from severe typhoons which has an impact on the tourist economy. Yoron Island also survived the harsh realities of WWII. 
The theme of this film is to display the power and beauty of nature resilience as it accepts everything life throws at it.
We will tell the story of the strength and beauty of Yoron island through the use of personification.
We want to encourage the people of Yoron Island and other Islands suffering from depopulation.

タイトル「日々これよろん」は、禅の言葉「日々これ好日」に敬意を表したもので、「毎日が良い日であり、私たちの人生のすべての瞬間を感謝し、すべての瞬間が特別である。ありのままの人生を生きる。」という意味です。
私たちは、パンデミックの間に人生のすべての瞬間を大切にすることがどれほど重要であるかを学びました。
観光業はCOVID-19パンデミックの影響を最も受けたセクターの一つです。ヨロン島も例外ではありません。
毎年、島は観光経済に影響を与える厳しい台風に悩まされています。ヨロン島はまた、第二次世界大戦の厳しい現実を生き延びました。
この映画のテーマは、自然の力と美しさの回復力を示すことであり、自然は人生が投げかけるすべてを受け入れます。
私たちは、擬人法を用いてヨロン島の強さと美しさの物語を語ります。
私たちは、過疎化に苦しむヨロン島や他の島々の人々を励ましたいと考えています。

In this town, located almost in the center of the Seto Inland Sea,

Colorful and sweet bell pepper "Palermo"
Frilly "Carino Kale"
Spiky-headed "Romanesco"

Two years ago, through a connection made by friends living in Tajiri,

Not only chic Italian restaurants,

Start by enjoying them with salt and olive oil.

May her feelings and everyone's feelings reach them.

第3回 日本国際観光映像祭 ART&FACTORY JAPAN 最優秀賞受賞作品

［日々是与論 4K_Yoron Island,Nature moves on,as do we］
タイトルの「日々是与論＝にちにちこれよろん」は、禅語である「日々是好日」（その日一日に感謝し、ただありのままに生きる）をオマージュしたもの。2020年、コロナを経験した私たちはいま、「日常」こそが有難く「特別」な時間の重なりであることを知りました。
「与論島」は、観光の島であるという観点から、コロナ禍でのダメージはもちろん大きなことですが、それは世界中どこでも同じこと。
それどころか毎年の台風をはじめとする自然災害や戦争も乗り越えてきた島です。
この作品では、与論島に暮らすさまざまな「いのち」の擬人化を通して、大きな自然のサイクルを受け入れながら日々を繰りかえす、島の美しさやたくましさを表現します。（とはいえ、与論の日常はほかの街に住む人からみれば大いなる非日常ですが）。
与論島から、同じような問題を抱え悩む離島や、過疎の町、“今”を生きる
すべての人たちへのエールとなるように。

Winner of the Grand Prize at the 3rd Japan International Tourism Film Festival ART&FACTORY JAPAN

[Every Day is Yoron 4K_Yoron Island, Nature moves on, as do we]
The title "Every Day is Yoron = Nichinichi Kore Yoron" is an homage to the Zen phrase "Nichinichi Kore Kōjitsu" (to be grateful for each day and to live simply as it is). In 2020, after experiencing the pandemic, we have come to realize that "everyday life" is indeed a precious overlap of "special" moments.
Yoron Island, being a tourist destination, has certainly suffered greatly due to the pandemic, but this is true everywhere in the world.
Moreover, the island has overcome natural disasters such as annual typhoons and wars.
This work expresses the beauty and resilience of the island through the personification of various "lives" that inhabit Yoron Island, while accepting the great cycles of nature and repeating daily life. (That said, the daily life of Yoron may seem like a great non-everyday to those living in other cities).
From Yoron Island, we hope to send a message of encouragement to other remote islands and depopulated towns facing similar issues, and to all those living in the "now."

description:

瀬戸内海もほど近い、福山市熊野町。



田畑に囲まれた広い空を望めるこの場所で



狩猟、農業、さらには養蜂まで



地でサスティナブルな暮らしをしている



岡田臣司（おかだしんじ）さん。

「食べることは環境を考えることと同義」



僕らが毎日口に運ぶ、たくさんの食材は



それらを育んだ自然環境と一緒に食べている。



「海を汚さない」「農業は土作りから」



すべての答え合わせのようなお話だった。

そんな岡田さんが辿り着いた狩猟採集。



毎年11月15日からの可猟期間には、



猟銃を持って里山へ足を運ぶ。
すべては身体性を取り戻すため。

天候、気温、猟場によって日々変わる



鳥獣の行動パターンを読んで。



五感を頼りにその痕跡を追いかける。



里山を熟知し、鳥獣を熟知して成せる



流し猟という自然との対話。

グリコーゲンを多く含む鹿肉は



効果的にエネルギーへと変わる。

すなわち、猟師飯にはうってつけ。

しかし、“ジビエ”という響きは



猟師にとっては“命の循環”。

生を終えさせるということ。



今日もまた、静かに
祈りで己を律する。





山の神の恵みに感謝して



まずはひとくち、めしあがれ。

title: THE ROOTS #06 Blessed Game from the Mountain God
description:

Near the Seto Inland Sea, in Kumano Town, Fukuyama.

In this place where you can see the wide sky surrounded by fields,

hunting, agriculture, and even beekeeping

are part of a sustainable lifestyle.

Shinji Okada is living this way.

"Eating is synonymous with considering the environment."

The many ingredients we consume daily

are eaten together with the natural environment that nurtured them.

"Do not pollute the sea" and "Agriculture starts with soil preparation"

were all part of a conversation that felt like piecing together answers.

This is the hunting and gathering path that Okada has arrived at.

During the hunting season starting from November 15 each year,

he heads to the satoyama with a hunting rifle.

Everything is to regain a sense of physicality.

Reading the daily changing behavior patterns of birds and beasts

based on weather, temperature, and hunting grounds.

Chasing their traces relying on the five senses.

This is a dialogue with nature through the method of running game hunting,

which can only be achieved by being well-acquainted with the satoyama and the wildlife.

Deer meat, rich in glycogen,

is effectively converted into energy.

In other words, it is perfect for hunter's meals.

However, the sound of "game" for hunters

is about the "cycle of life."

It means bringing life to an end.

Today again, quietly,

he disciplines himself with prayer.

Grateful for the blessings of the mountain god,

first, take a bite and enjoy.

天真爛漫に育った「娘」たちは
雑味がなく、素直な味がする。
それは、ほかの野菜も同じこと。

素直な素材には、シンプルな調理を。
岡本さんオススメの食べ方は、
にんにくを塩こしょうだけで炒めること。

まずはひとかけ、めしあがれ。

description:
WEB SITE

Keiji Okamoto, who runs a farm in Kamo Town, Fukuyama.
He has been involved in agriculture for 20 years,
and started growing garlic three years ago.

No pesticides = not using herbicides.
As a result, weeds grow thick along the field's edge,
and insects gather as well.
Naturally, it takes effort, and worries never cease.

Even so, the 'daughter' that requires care is the most precious.

Receiving an abundance of overflowing love,
the 'daughters' have grown up carefree,
with a pure and straightforward taste.
The same goes for other vegetables.

For simple ingredients, simple cooking.
Mr. Okamoto's recommended way to enjoy it is
to sauté garlic with just salt and pepper.

First, try one clove.

いつか現地で、この味を、味わっていただける日を楽しみにしています！

title: 田舎館村 冬の田んぼアート２０２２「花時の日の出」
description: 「冬の田んぼアート２０２２」は、新型コロナウイルスの感染拡大を防止するため、やむを得ず、中止となりましたが、青森県では、田舎館村及びスノーアーティスト集団「It’s OK」の協力のもと制作したスノーアートの映像を公開します。スノーアートのテーマは「花時の日の出」です。「花時」とは、春にいろいろな花が咲き始める時期のことを指し、特に桜を指すことが多いそうです。そのように、桜が咲き始める頃までに新型コロナウイルス感染症が収束し、日の出のように未来が明るくなることを祈って制作しました。

title: Inakadate Village Winter Rice Field Art 2022 'Sunrise of Flower Time'
description: The 'Winter Rice Field Art 2022' has been unfortunately canceled to prevent the spread of the novel coronavirus. However, in Aomori Prefecture, a video of the snow art created in cooperation with Inakadate Village and the snow artist group 'It’s OK' will be released. The theme of the snow art is 'Sunrise of Flower Time.' 'Flower Time' refers to the time in spring when various flowers begin to bloom, often specifically referring to cherry blossoms. It was created with the hope that by the time the cherry blossoms begin to bloom, the COVID-19 pandemic will be over, and the future will be bright like the sunrise.

title: [AOMORI CYCLING] Okutsugaru Ride - OKUTSUGARU, JAPAN
description:
We will ride through Okutsugaru on a bicycle, aiming for the northernmost point of the Tsugaru Peninsula, "Cape Tappi." 
Starting from Ashino Park Station using the "Tsugaru Railway," which allows bicycles, we will visit various attractions such as the "Takayama Inari Shrine" with its thousand torii gates, the birthplace of the literary giant Osamu Dazai, "Shayokan," the beautiful golden rice fields of "Kome My Road," the dynamic scenery overlooking the Japan Sea on the "Ryuhoku Line," and charming fishing villages. Enjoy the long ride filled with sights and challenges. 

*Due to video editing reasons, there are sections of the route from Ashino Park Station to Cape Tappi that are not a continuous line. 

For diverse cycling information in Aomori, please refer to the following:

title: これが、青森県の本気のリンゴCMだ！「あおもりんご」CM
description: 青森県では、リンゴ試験場で約３００種、県内で約５０種のリンゴが栽培されており、日本一の生産量を誇ります。(そのうち、市場に出荷されているのは約４０種類程度) 本CMには本物の青森のリンゴ農家のみなさんが出演し、しりとりを繰り広げます。真冬の雪を溶かすような、素人とは思えない熱演を是非ご覧ください！さらに、CMの中にも登場する「リンゴのポスト」や「リンゴ型のつり革」、「リンゴ型のカーブミラー」、「リンゴ型の駅のホームの無線」など、街中の至るところにまでリンゴ愛があふれる青森県。この青森県の圧倒的なリンゴの種類の多さとあふれるリンゴ愛を知ってもらいたいとの思いから、今回のCMを制作いたしました。1月から3月にかけて、出荷量が最も多くなる青森県のリンゴ。スーパーで選ぶ際はぜひ、青森県産のリンゴをご賞味ください！

title: This is Aomori's Serious Apple Commercial! 'Aomorin' CM
description: In Aomori Prefecture, about 300 varieties of apples are cultivated at the Apple Research Station, and about 50 varieties are grown in the prefecture, boasting the highest production volume in Japan. (Of these, about 40 varieties are shipped to the market.) In this commercial, real Aomori apple farmers participate and engage in a game of shiritori. Please watch their impressive performances that melt the winter snow, which are hard to believe are from amateurs! Furthermore, Aomori is filled with love for apples, with apple-themed items such as 'apple post boxes', 'apple-shaped handrails', 'apple-shaped convex mirrors', and 'apple-shaped wireless stations' appearing throughout the city. This commercial was created to share the overwhelming variety of apples and the abundant love for apples in Aomori Prefecture. From January to March, Aomori apples have the highest shipping volume. When choosing apples at the supermarket, please enjoy Aomori-grown apples!

title: 漁師の一日　風間浦のアンコウ漁
description: 木村喜志雄さんが伝統的な「からばり」を使った唯一の漁師である青森県風間浦村のアンコウ漁。冬の津軽海峡での漁は厳しいですが、温泉や昔からの仲間たちが漁の疲れを癒してくれます。漁師の一日を通して、青森ならではの暮らしぶりを紹介します。

title: A Day in the Life of a Fisherman: Angler Fishing in Kazamaura
description: Kimura Kishiou is the only fisherman using the traditional 'karabari' in angler fishing in Kazamaura, Aomori Prefecture. Fishing in the Tsugaru Strait during winter is tough, but hot springs and old friends help relieve the fatigue of fishing. This introduces the unique lifestyle of Aomori through a fisherman's day.

title: DELISH AOMORI「津軽あかつきの会　古津軽伝承料理」vie
description: 弘前市石川地区。３０人ほどの「かっちゃ」が集まり、地域の伝承料理の復活と保存に取り組んでいるのが「津軽あかつきの会」です。使う食材のほとんどが地元産。雪に閉ざされる冬の季節には、発酵・乾燥・塩蔵といった伝承された技術を凝らした「古津軽伝承料理」でもてなしてくれます。訪れた人を温かく迎えてくれる「津軽あかつきの会」の雰囲気までお届けする、DELISH AOMORIのSpecial Movieです。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Tsugaru Akatsuki no Kai Ancient Tsugaru Traditional Cuisine'
description: In the Ishikawa district of Hirosaki City, about 30 'kaccha' gather to work on the revival and preservation of local traditional cuisine through the 'Tsugaru Akatsuki no Kai'. Most of the ingredients used are locally sourced. During the winter season, when snow covers the area, they welcome visitors with 'Ancient Tsugaru Traditional Cuisine' that incorporates traditional techniques such as fermentation, drying, and salting. This is a special movie from DELISH AOMORI that conveys the warm atmosphere of 'Tsugaru Akatsuki no Kai' that welcomes visitors.

title: DELISH AOMORI「風間浦村のあんこうのベーコン巻き」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「Delish Aomori」は今回の第１２弾でついに最終回。ラストを飾る食材は風間浦鮟鱇です。風間浦村は鮟鱇の漁場がとても近く、とびきり新鮮な鮟鱇が水揚げされます。鮟鱇といえば、まっ先に思い浮かぶのは鮟鱇鍋でしょうか。今回紹介するレシピは洋風に美味しくいただける「あんこうのベーコン巻き」。淡白な鮟鱇の身とベーコンの旨味と塩気の組み合わせが絶妙です。風間浦村で年に１度開催される風間浦鮟鱇感謝祭の賑わいの様子もお届けします。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Bacon-Wrapped Monkfish from Kazamaura Village'
description: The recipe video series 'Delish Aomori', brought to you by All Aomori, reaches its final episode with this 12th installment. The star ingredient for the grand finale is the monkfish from Kazamaura. Kazamaura Village is very close to the fishing grounds for monkfish, ensuring that the freshest monkfish is landed. When we think of monkfish, the first dish that comes to mind is probably monkfish hot pot. The recipe we are introducing this time is 'Bacon-Wrapped Monkfish', which can be enjoyed in a Western style. The combination of the mild monkfish flesh and the umami and saltiness of the bacon is exquisite. We will also share the lively atmosphere of the Kazamaura Monkfish Appreciation Festival, held once a year in Kazamaura Village.

title: DELISH AOMORI「ふかうら雪人参のポタージュ」
description:
まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第１１弾。今回の食材は深浦町で栽培される「ふかうら雪人参」。野菜とは思えないほどフルーティーな甘みを活かしつつ、人参そのものの風味を美味しく味わえるポタージュスープに仕上げています。ぜひお試しください。
「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Fukaura Snow Carrot Potage'
description:
The 11th installment of the recipe video series 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Marugoto Aomori. This time, the ingredient is 'Fukaura Snow Carrot' grown in Fukaura Town. We have created a potage soup that deliciously captures the fruity sweetness that is almost unthinkable for a vegetable, while also savoring the flavor of the carrot itself. Please give it a try.
'DELISH AOMORI' will be released periodically on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「津軽百年食堂　清おばあちゃん」
description: 黒石市の弘南鉄道黒石駅前に店を構える「すごう食堂」は大正時代から４代に渡って受け継がれ、「津軽百年食堂」の１店に数えられます。現在の店主、須郷清さんは８７歳となった今でも、調理担当として現役で店に立ち続けているおばあちゃんです。店とともに百年受け継がれる変わらない味と、どこか懐かしさを覚える店の雰囲気をお伝えする、DELISH AOMORIがお届けするSpecial Movieです。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Tsugaru Hyakunen Shokudo - Grandma Kiyo'
description: The 'Sugou Shokudo', located in front of Kōnan Railway Kuroishi Station in Kuroishi City, has been passed down through four generations since the Taisho era and is counted as one of the 'Tsugaru Hyakunen Shokudo'. The current owner, Grandma Kiyo Sugou, who is now 87 years old, still stands at the restaurant as the chef. This is a special movie brought to you by DELISH AOMORI, conveying the unchanged taste that has been inherited for a hundred years along with the nostalgic atmosphere of the restaurant.

title: DELISH AOMORI「大間マグロのマグロカツ」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」。第１０弾はあの有名食材、大間のマグロ。刺身で食べてももちろん最高に美味しいのは間違いないですが、カリッとサクサクの衣、中身はとろけるレアのカツに仕上げました。やっぱり大間のマグロは美味しいです！「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Tuna Cutlet from Oma'
description: This is a recipe video series 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Aomori. The 10th installment features the famous ingredient, Oma tuna. It's undoubtedly delicious when eaten as sashimi, but we've made it into a crispy, crunchy cutlet with a melt-in-your-mouth rare inside. Oma tuna is truly delicious! 'DELISH AOMORI' will be released on the Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「八戸前沖さばの洋風味噌煮」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第９弾。今回の食材は八戸前沖さば。さばの最も定番とも言える味噌煮を洋風にアレンジ。脂の乗ったさばの美味しさが詰まった一皿に仕上げました。いつもとはちょっと違った晩ごはんのおかずにどうぞ。 「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Western-style Miso Braised Hachinohe Mackerel'
description: This is the 9th installment of the recipe video 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Marugoto Aomori. The ingredient this time is Hachinohe mackerel. We have arranged the classic miso braised mackerel in a Western style. This dish is packed with the deliciousness of fatty mackerel. Enjoy it as a slightly different side dish for dinner. 'DELISH AOMORI' will be released on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「三沢の長芋アヒージョ」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」。第８弾の食材は三沢市で栽培されている長芋。今回のレシピは長芋を皮ごと使ったアヒージョです。皮ごと調理することで、手にはかゆみが起きず、栄養もしっかり摂れます。「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Misa's Nagaimo Ajillo'
description: A recipe video delivered by all of Aomori, 'DELISH AOMORI'. The 8th ingredient is nagaimo grown in Misawa City. This recipe is ajillo using nagaimo with the skin on. By cooking with the skin, you can avoid itching on your hands and get plenty of nutrients. 'DELISH AOMORI' will be released on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「ミサオおばあちゃんの笹餅」
description: 五所川原市金木町で、大人気の笹餅を作り続ける９０歳の元気なおばあちゃん、桑田ミサオさん。食べたひとを幸せな気持ちにしてくれる笹餅を作る風景と、その笹餅を作るミサオさんの温かい人柄。その両方に触れられる、DELISH AOMORIがお届けするSpecial Movieです。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Grandma Misao's Sasa Mochi'
description:
In Goshogawara City, Kanagi Town, the lively 90-year-old grandma, Misao Kuwata, continues to make the very popular sasa mochi. 
This is a Special Movie brought to you by DELISH AOMORI, showcasing the scene of making sasa mochi that brings happiness to those who eat it, along with the warm personality of Misao-san who makes it.

title: DELISH AOMORI「美味しい土鍋ごはんの炊き方」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第７弾。平川市で獲れた青森が誇る特A米、青天の霹靂を土鍋でふっくら炊き上げ、青森が誇るご飯のお供、筋子を添えました！「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI: How to Cook Delicious Donabe Rice
description: The 7th installment of the recipe video series "DELISH AOMORI" brought to you by Marugoto Aomori. We cooked the special A rice, Seiten no Hekireki, which is proudly produced in Aomori, in a donabe to make it fluffy, and served it with a local delicacy, salted salmon roe! "DELISH AOMORI" will be released periodically on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「十和田ごぼうの洋風きんぴら」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第６弾。とってもみずみずしいくて、獲れたては生でも食べられる十和田のごぼう。今回はきんぴらごぼうを洋風にアレンジしました！「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Western-style Kinpira with Towada Burdock'
description: This is the 6th installment of the recipe video 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Marugoto Aomori. The Towada burdock is very fresh and can be eaten raw when freshly harvested. This time, we have arranged the kinpira burdock in a Western style! 'DELISH AOMORI' will be published on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「南部太ねぎのグラタンスープ」
description:
まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第５弾。青森県南部地方の伝統野菜「南部太ねぎ」は驚くほどの太さと、とろけるような食感と甘さが特徴。その「南部太ねぎ」を使ったグラタンスープは絶品です。
「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。
https://www.facebook.com/marugotoaomori/

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Nanbu Tai Negi Gratin Soup'
description:
The fifth installment of the recipe video series 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Marugoto Aomori. The traditional vegetable 'Nanbu Tai Negi' from the southern region of Aomori Prefecture is characterized by its astonishing thickness, melt-in-your-mouth texture, and sweetness. The gratin soup made with 'Nanbu Tai Negi' is exquisite.
'DELISH AOMORI' will be released periodically on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook page.
https://www.facebook.com/marugotoaomori/

title: DELISH AOMORI「いたや毛豆のレアチーズムース」
description:
まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第４弾は、ほっくりしていて甘味の強い毛豆の特徴を生かしてスイーツに仕上げました。「いたや毛豆」は板柳町で栽培される青森在来の「毛豆」です。
「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。
https://www.facebook.com/marugotoaomori/

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Itaya Edamame Rare Cheese Mousse'
description:
The fourth installment of the recipe video series 'DELISH AOMORI', brought to you by Marugoto Aomori, features a dessert that highlights the characteristics of the sweet and fluffy Itaya edamame. 'Itaya edamame' is a local variety of edamame grown in Itayanagi Town, Aomori.
'DELISH AOMORI' will be released periodically on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook page.
https://www.facebook.com/marugotoaomori/

title: DELISH AOMORI「嶽きみのカラフルディップ」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第３弾。今回はとうもろこしの美味しさを引き立てるカラフルな４種のディップをご紹介。スルッとキレイに剥ける皮にもご注目ください。「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookで随時公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Colorful Dips of Dake Corn'
description: This is the third installment of the recipe video 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Marugoto Aomori. This time, we introduce four colorful dips that enhance the deliciousness of corn. Don't miss the skin that peels off smoothly and beautifully. 'DELISH AOMORI' will be published regularly on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook.

title: DELISH AOMORI「田舎館村のイチゴフィズ」
description:
まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画「DELISH AOMORI」の第２弾。今回は田舎館村産のいちごを使った、ちょっとおしゃれで甘酸っぱい「イチゴフィズ」をご紹介。

description:
The second installment of the recipe video series 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Marugoto Aomori. This time, we introduce a slightly stylish and sweet-sour 'Strawberry Fizz' made with strawberries from Inakadate Village.
'DELISH AOMORI' will be released periodically on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook page. https://www.facebook.com/marugotoaomori

title: DELISH AOMORI「蓬田村の冷やしトマト麺」
description: まるごと青森がお届けするレシピ動画と観光動画の新しい形「DELISH　AOMORI」。第１弾のメニューはトマトを使った冷やし麺。併せてご紹介する食材は蓬田村産のトマト「津軽の雫」です。「DELISH AOMORI」はまるごと青森Facebookにて順次公開します。

title: DELISH AOMORI 'Chilled Tomato Noodles from Yonda Village'
description: A new form of recipe and tourism video delivered by Marugoto Aomori, 'DELISH AOMORI'. The first menu features chilled noodles made with tomatoes. The featured ingredient is the Yonda Village tomato 'Tsugaru no Shizuku'. 'DELISH AOMORI' will be released sequentially on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook.

description: 尻屋崎灯台へ向かう途中、一時通行止めに遭遇しました。

description: On the way to Shiriya Cape Lighthouse, I encountered a temporary road closure.

又鬼（マタギ）
description: Kudo Kojiさんは銃を手放しました。それはマタギである彼にとっては苦渋の決断でした。しかし彼はいまでも毎日のように山を歩きます。そしてマタギがどのようにしてクマをとるのか、山の中でどのような生活をするのか、山の神とはなにかを語ります。

title: Matagi
description: Kudo Koji has put down his gun. This was a difficult decision for him as a Matagi. However, he still walks in the mountains almost every day. He talks about how Matagi catch bears, what life is like in the mountains, and what the mountain gods are.

title: 風間浦鮟鱇、めがった～（おいしかったー）
description: 作家・大岡玲さん、浦風親方、カメラマン・松隈直樹さん、紀行作家・山内史子さんの4人で行く「冬の青森旅」vol4.「風間浦鮟鱇」編その2です。

title: Kazamaura Anglerfish, it was delicious~
description: This is vol.4 of the 'Winter Aomori Trip' featuring four people: writer Rei Ooka, master of the Ura-kaze, photographer Naoki Matsukuma, and travel writer Fumiko Yamauchi. This is part 2 about 'Kazamaura Anglerfish'.

title: 下北の酒と風間浦鮟鱇、め～よ～（うまいよー）！
description: 作家・大岡玲さん、浦風親方、カメラマン・松隈直樹さん、紀行作家・山内史子さんの4人で行く「冬の青森旅」vol4.「風間浦鮟鱇」編その1です。

title: Delicious Sake from Shimokita and Kazamaura Anko, Yum Yum!
description: This is vol. 4 of the 'Winter Aomori Trip' featuring four people: writer Rei Ooka, master of Ura-kaze, photographer Naoki Matsukuma, and travel writer Fumiko Yamauchi. This is part 1 focusing on 'Kazamaura Anko'.

title: イサバのカッチャ（魚市場のかあちゃん）
description:
戦後より八戸の台所として人々の暮らしに根付いている「いさば」。いさばとは魚市場のこと。陸奥湊駅前朝市も毎朝多くの人々で賑わいます。イサバのカッチャは働き者。暗いうちから働き始めます。そんな浜
の暮らしぶりを、生まれてからずっと朝市で買い物をしているというカッチャを通して紹介します。

出演：中山　央子
監督：山中　有
製作：青森県観光国際戦略局観光企画課

title: Isaba no Katcha (Mother of the Fish Market)
description:
Since the post-war period, 'Isaba' has been rooted in the lives of people as the kitchen of Hachinohe. Isaba refers to the fish market. The morning market in front of Mutsu-Minato Station is bustling with many people every morning. The Katcha of Isaba is a hard worker. She starts working in the dark. Through Katcha, who has been shopping at the morning market since she was born, we introduce the lifestyle of the seaside.

Cast: Oko Nakayama
Director: Yu Yamanaka
Production: Aomori Prefectural Tourism International Strategy Bureau, Tourism Planning Division

title: べこもち
description:
青森県の下北半島に伝わる伝統郷土菓子「べこもち」。
昔は節句などの行事の際にふるまわれるものでしたが、現在は日常的に愛食されています。
この作品は、べこもちができるまでの工程を映像のみで語ります。
切り口に美しい花模様があらわれる様子を、ぜひご覧ください。

出演：こすもす生活改善グループ
監督：山中　有
製作：青森県観光国際戦略局観光企画課

title: Beko Mochi
description:
Beko Mochi is a traditional local sweet from the Shimokita Peninsula in Aomori Prefecture.
In the past, it was served during events such as festivals, but now it is enjoyed on a daily basis.
This work narrates the process of making Beko Mochi solely through visuals.
Please take a look at the beautiful floral patterns that appear on the cut surface.

Cast: Cosmos Lifestyle Improvement Group
Director: Yu Yamanaka
Production: Aomori Prefectural Tourism International Strategy Bureau, Tourism Planning Division

title: サナブリ
description:
青森県津軽地方では、田植えが終わると農休みに入り、集落の人々は安堵とともに豊作を願う儀礼として「サナブリ」と呼ばれる祭事を行います。
津軽地方の五所川原市相内の人々は、この祭事が昔から地域の人々の憩いのひと時であり、どれだけ心待ちにしていたかを語ります。苗を植えたばかりの田んぼに飛び込む場面も。

出演：三和　敏道
監督：山中　有
製作：青森県観光国際戦略局観光企画課

title: Sanaburi
description:
In the Tsugaru region of Aomori Prefecture, after the rice planting is completed, the farming community enters a break, and the people of the village hold a ceremony called 'Sanaburi' as a ritual to express their relief and wish for a good harvest.
The people of Aikawa in Goshogawara City, Tsugaru region, speak of how this event has been a moment of relaxation for the community for generations and how eagerly they have awaited it. There is also a scene where they jump into the rice fields just after planting the seedlings.

Featuring: Toshimichi Miwa
Director: Yu Yamanaka
Production: Aomori Prefectural Tourism International Strategy Bureau, Tourism Planning Division

title: ホワイトインパルス
description:
青森空港は全国でも有数の豪雪地帯にあり、雪の多い年では類型降雪量が１０ｍを超える空港です。
民間航空機定期便が利8直する空港の中で、累計降雪量が１０ｍを超える空港は、全国でも稀です。
このような豪雪の青森空港を支えているのが、複数社の共同企業体により編成される青森空港除雪帯「ホワイトインパルス」です。

title: White Impulse
description:
Aomori Airport is one of the most heavy snowfall areas in the country, with cumulative snowfall exceeding 10 meters in years with significant snow.
Among airports with regular commercial airline services, it is rare for cumulative snowfall to exceed 10 meters.
Supporting Aomori Airport, which experiences such heavy snowfall, is the Aomori Airport Snow Removal Group "White Impulse," formed by a consortium of multiple companies.

title: はるえさん最高！ by浦風親方
description: 作家・大岡玲さん、浦風親方、カメラマン・松隈直樹さん、紀行作家・山内史子さんの4人で行く「冬の青森旅」vol3.「青森市古川市場はるえ食堂」編です。

title: Haru-e is the best! by Coach Urakaze
description: This is the third volume of the 'Winter Trip to Aomori' featuring four people: writer Rei Ooka, Coach Urakaze, photographer Naoki Matsukuma, and travel writer Fumiko Yamauchi. This edition focuses on 'Haru-e Shokudo' at Aomori City Furukawa Market.

title: 酸ヶ湯温泉の湯治場
description: 昔から多くの湯治客に愛されている酸ヶ湯温泉。湯治棟に泊まり、温泉療養を楽しみ、自炊場で料理を作って食べる。昔と変わらない「湯治場」での過ごし方を紹介します。

title: Acid Hot Spring Healing Place
description: Acid Hot Spring has been loved by many healing guests since ancient times. Stay in the healing building, enjoy hot spring therapy, and cook and eat in the self-catering area. This introduces the way of spending time in the 'healing place' that has not changed since the past.

title: 高木恭造文学碑前にて by紀行作家・山内史子さん
description: 作家・大岡玲さん、浦風親方、カメラマン・松隈直樹さん、紀行作家・山内史子さんの4人で行く「冬の青森旅」vol2.今別町高野崎 高木恭造文学碑編

title: At Takagi Kyozo Literary Monument by Travel Writer Fumiko Yamauchi
description: A winter trip to Aomori by writer Rei Ooka, sumo wrestler Ura Kaze, photographer Naoki Matsukuma, and travel writer Fumiko Yamauchi, vol. 2. Takagi Kyozo Literary Monument in Imabetsu Town, Takayanosaki.

title: 酸ヶ湯温泉
description: 酸ヶ湯温泉は日本一の豪雪観測地点であり、周辺は一面の銀世界で息をのむほど美しい。手つかずの自然が多く残る小沼や湿原に囲まれた、昔懐かしい山の温泉宿です。

title: Acid Hot Springs
description: Acid Hot Springs is the number one heavy snowfall observation point in Japan. The area around Acid Hot Springs is a breathtaking silver world. It is an old-fashioned mountain hot spring inn surrounded by untouched nature, including small ponds and wetlands.

title: 高野崎よかネー！ byカメラマン・松隈直樹さん
Takanozaki is Great! by Photographer Naoki Matsukuma
冬限定「酒のあで雪見列車」運行
description: 星野リゾート青森屋は、青い森鉄道株式会社の協力のもと、2017年1月8日から2月26日までの毎週日曜日、三沢駅から出発して青森駅まで「酒のあで雪見列車」を運行します。「酒のあで雪見列車」では、青森の地酒と停車駅の名産珍味「あで」（※青森の方言で「つまみ」の意味）を味わいながら、祭囃子の生演奏を楽しむことができます。

title: Winter Limited 'Sake and Snow Viewing Train' Operation
description: Hoshino Resort Aomoriya, in cooperation with Aoi Mori Railway Co., will operate the 'Sake and Snow Viewing Train' from Misawa Station to Aomori Station every Sunday from January 8 to February 26, 2017. On the 'Sake and Snow Viewing Train', you can enjoy Aomori's local sake and the local delicacy 'ade' (meaning 'snack' in Aomori dialect) while enjoying live performances of festival music.

title: 古川市場のっけ丼
description:
のっけ丼は青森魚菜センターで、市場に並んでいるものをちょっとずつ買って食べる丼です。
自分の好きな具材を好きな量だけ買うことができるので、おひとりでも、仲間、カップル、家族でも楽しんでいただけます。

title: Furukawa Market Nokkedon
description:
Nokkedon is a bowl dish at the Aomori Fish and Vegetable Center, where you can buy and enjoy a little bit of what is available in the market.
You can purchase your favorite ingredients in your preferred amounts, making it enjoyable for individuals, friends, couples, and families.

title: ねぶたの家 ワ・ラッセ
description: 青森市文化観光交流施設「ねぶたの家 ワ・ラッセ」を紹介しています。ねぶた祭の歴史や魅力を余すことなく紹介し、ねぶたのすべてを体感することができる夢の空間です。

title: Nebuta House Wa Rasse
description:
Introducing the Aomori City Cultural Tourism Exchange Facility 'Nebuta House Wa Rasse.'
It fully showcases the history and charm of the Nebuta Festival, providing a dream space where you can experience everything about Nebuta.

description: 青森市の古川市場にある横山商店（通称「はるえ食堂」）の絶品焼きおにぎりです。

title: Harue Shokudo

title: 『EVで島をMOTTO元気にプロジェクト』 新入社員研修 in 式根島 【東日本三菱自動車販売株式会社】
description:
4月18日（木）～4月20日（土）の3日間、東日本三菱自動車販売株式会社（以下、東日本三菱）は、昨年に引き続き2024年4月に入社した新入社員研修を東京都新島村の式根島にて開催しました。

この活動は、台風などの自然災害による停電復旧までのインフラの不足が社会課題になっている島しょ地域の、BCP 対策の一環として、三菱自動車の中古電気自動車と外部給電装置を東京電力パワーグリッド株式会社（以下、東京電力パワーグリッド）と連携しながら普及させるために新島村と締結する『地域循環共生圏の実現に向けた共創に関する提携協定』に賛同した東日本三菱が参画し運営するものです。

プロジェクト名称：『EVで島をMOTTO元気にプロジェクト』

研修前日には新島村役場を表敬訪問。大沼村長さまに対する電動車導入状況や研修に関する説明のなかで自治体との連携を一層深めることができました。

研修では、東京電力パワーグリッドにも参加して頂き、島しょ地域の生活と、電気自動車の重要性に対する理解を深めました。また、環境省、東京電力パワーグリッド、新島村商工会のご協力のもとビーチクリーン活動を実施しました。

東日本三菱は、式根島がBCP強化に向けて三菱自動車の電気自動車を積極的に導入頂いていることに敬意を表して、島民の皆さまのお役に立てる様、新島村商工会式根島支部に対して外部給電器を寄贈しました。

東日本三菱は、更なる島民の皆さまの安全・安心に寄与すべく、電動車並びに外部給電器の普及を通じて社会にお役立てできる企業を目指して参ります。

title: ‘EV for a More Energetic Island Project’ New Employee Training in Shikine Island 【East Japan Mitsubishi Motors Sales Co., Ltd.】
description:
From April 18 (Thursday) to April 20 (Saturday), East Japan Mitsubishi Motors Sales Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as East Japan Mitsubishi) held new employee training for those who joined in April 2024 on Shikine Island in Niijima Village, Tokyo, continuing from last year.

This activity is part of the BCP measures for island regions, where the lack of infrastructure for restoring power outages due to natural disasters such as typhoons has become a social issue. East Japan Mitsubishi, which supports the 'Co-Creation Agreement for Realizing a Regional Circulation and Symbiotic Sphere' signed with Niijima Village, aims to promote the use of used electric vehicles from Mitsubishi Motors and external power supply devices in collaboration with Tokyo Electric Power Grid Corporation (hereinafter referred to as TEPCO Power Grid).

Project Name: ‘EV for a More Energetic Island Project’

On the day before the training, we paid a courtesy visit to the Niijima Village Office. During the explanation regarding the introduction of electric vehicles and the training to Mayor Onuma, we were able to deepen our collaboration with the local government.

During the training, TEPCO Power Grid also participated, enhancing our understanding of life in island regions and the importance of electric vehicles. Additionally, with the cooperation of the Ministry of the Environment, TEPCO Power Grid, and the Niijima Village Chamber of Commerce, we conducted a beach clean-up activity.

East Japan Mitsubishi expressed respect for the active introduction of Mitsubishi Motors' electric vehicles in Shikine Island for BCP enhancement and donated external power supply devices to the Shikine Branch of the Niijima Village Chamber of Commerce to be of service to the island residents.

East Japan Mitsubishi aims to be a company that contributes to society through the promotion of electric vehicles and external power supply devices to further ensure the safety and security of the island residents.

title: 【新島・式根島 】民宿ご飯　式根鯛平君で乾杯
description:
『あなたと いっしょに 育てタイ！』

平成2年（1990年）出荷スタートから30年以上が経過した新島村の養殖事業を、新島在住の人たちに、もっともっと知ってもらいたく、動画の制作を企画しました。

（背景）
島外への販売は、お客さまにとってコストも掛かり、１尾丸ごとの鯛は捌けないし、、など、売るのが難しい現実の中、、島の中で「育て」「調理し」「食べて」もらえる循環を作らないと、どうなるのか？って火を見るより明らか。

また島の課題の一つ、「島の魚が手に入らない」という、かなり残念な声を良く聴きます。。

その声に対する一つの解決策は、安定的に供給できる養殖の鯛「式根鯛平君」です。

30年前の飼育環境からアップデートを積み重ね、現在は独自にブレンドした配合飼料を開発し、ほどよく脂がのった美味しい鯛の味を実現することができました。

真鯛と言えば、粋で真っ赤な「めで鯛」をイメージしますが、式根鯛平君は無骨な色した「彩り鯛」

そんな身近にいる真鯛、あなた色に彩りを加えてみませんか。

『あなたと いっしょに 育てタイ！』

title: [Niijima & Shikinejima] Cheers with Shikine Taihei-kun at the Guesthouse
description:
'I want to grow with you!' 

More than 30 years have passed since the start of the aquaculture business in Niijima Village in 1990, and we planned to create a video to let the residents of Niijima know more about it. 

(Background) 
Selling outside the island incurs costs for customers, and it's difficult to sell whole fish, among other challenges. It is clear that if we do not create a cycle where we can 'grow,' 'cook,' and 'eat' within the island, the situation will only worsen. 

We often hear a rather disappointing voice regarding one of the island's issues: 'We can't get island fish.' 

One solution to that voice is the stable supply of farmed sea bream, 'Shikine Taihei-kun.' 

By updating the rearing environment over the past 30 years, we have developed a unique blended feed that allows us to achieve the delicious taste of sea bream with just the right amount of fat. 

When we think of sea bream, we often imagine the stylish and bright red 'medetai,' but Shikine Taihei-kun is a robustly colored 'irodori tai.' 

Why not add your own color to the sea bream that is so close to you? 

'I want to grow with you!'

description: 300年以上続く島の伝統食「くさや」をミライへ 島の暮らしを支えてきたキレイな海をミライへ 〜アルミ型洗濯バサミ #HOSSY を通じて海洋ゴミ問題を考える〜 【新島ミライプロジェクト】 新島では年間100トン以上という大量の海洋ゴミが流れ着き、ごみ処理はもちろん、島の美しい景観を損ねる大問題となっています。一方、魚の水揚げ量は年々減少し、漁業や水産加工業は今、苦境に立たされています。このまま海の環境が悪化していけば、海と共に生きてきた島の暮らしが立ち行かなくなるかもしれません。 そこで新島水産加工業協同組合は、海の恵みから生まれた伝統食「くさや」を受け継ぐ者として、海と共に生きる暮らしを未来へつないでいく活動を始めます。その第一弾として、アルミ製洗濯バサミ「HOSSY（ホッシー）」を新島のすべてのお宅へ配布（１家庭につき２０個）し、海を汚すプラゴミを少しでも減らしていくことを目指します。

description: A traditional island food 'Kusaya' that has continued for over 300 years towards the future. A beautiful sea that has supported island life towards the future. - Considering the marine debris problem through aluminum clothespins #HOSSY - 【Niijima Mirai Project】 Niijima faces a significant problem with over 100 tons of marine debris washing ashore each year, affecting waste disposal and damaging the island's beautiful scenery. Meanwhile, the catch of fish has been decreasing year by year, putting the fishing and seafood processing industries in a difficult position. If the marine environment continues to deteriorate, the island's way of life, which has lived in harmony with the sea, may not be sustainable. Therefore, the Niijima Fisheries Processing Cooperative will begin activities to connect the way of life living with the sea to the future as inheritors of the traditional food 'Kusaya' born from the blessings of the sea. As the first step, they aim to distribute aluminum clothespins 'HOSSY' to all households in Niijima (20 per household) to reduce plastic waste that pollutes the sea.

title: 【新島ミライプロジェクト】210402 CX Live News it!
description:
2021年春、東京の島　新島から島内全家庭のプラスティック洗濯バサミを、くさや型のアルミ製洗濯バサミ　”HOSSY" との交換を目指すプロジェクトです。

　紫外線で劣化し、すぐに壊れるプラスティック洗濯バサミを島のシンボルである”くさや型洗濯バサミ”に換えることにより、島の大切な産業である、くさやをより身近に感じてもらい、何より、もう壊れて捨てることのない洗濯バサミに交換することで、プラスティックのゴミを出さない生活へと変えていきたいと考えています。

海から恵みをいただき発展してきた島だから、「今こそ自然環境に対し、何ができるか？」を島の人たち一人一人が考える機会の創出です。

　今後は、東京宝島の力もお借りし、同時に企業様の力もお借りしたいと願っております。もちろん私たちでもクラウドファンディングを行い、少しでも多くの方にコミットいただきたいと考えています。

そして新島での取り組みを、東京諸島の全11島へ広げ、その先にこのアクションを日本の島々へ広めて行きたいと考えております。
狙いは2つ。

①日本の食文化への理解 “干物（くさや）”から、郷土への誇りを高めるとともに、
②難しく考えがちな “環境問題”をユニークな取組みで、気づきの連鎖につなげたい。

それは【新しい、でつながる島】だから。
海と生きるまち。海の環境問題に正面から取り組む「エコアイランド構想」への環境アクションです。

title: [Niijima Mirai Project] 210402 CX Live News it!
description:
In spring 2021, this project aims to exchange plastic laundry clips from all households on Niijima Island, Tokyo, for aluminum laundry clips shaped like kusaya, called 'HOSSY'.

By replacing plastic laundry clips, which deteriorate under UV light and break easily, with the island's symbol, the 'kusaya-shaped laundry clip', we hope to make the important industry of kusaya more familiar to everyone. Most importantly, by exchanging for laundry clips that won't break and be thrown away, we aim to transition to a lifestyle that produces no plastic waste.

As an island that has developed by receiving blessings from the sea, we want to create opportunities for each islander to think about 'What can we do for the natural environment now?'.

In the future, we hope to leverage the power of Tokyo's Treasure Island and also seek the support of companies. Of course, we plan to conduct crowdfunding ourselves, hoping to get as many people as possible to commit to this cause.

We also aim to expand our efforts on Niijima to all 11 islands of the Tokyo Islands, and ultimately spread this action to the islands of Japan.
There are two main objectives:

1. To enhance understanding of Japan's food culture through 'dried fish (kusaya)' and foster pride in our local heritage.
2. To connect the often complex topic of 'environmental issues' to a chain of awareness through unique initiatives.

This is because it is [a new island connected by innovation].
A town that lives with the sea. This is an environmental action towards the 'Eco-Island Concept', which directly addresses marine environmental issues.

description: 〜 A place to work, a place to play. 新しい「なつかしい」をつくる島 〜 働き方、休み方を変える。例えば、週末を、あるいは一週間を、仕事とバケーションを両立させる「ワーケーション」。そんな生活のシフトチェンジに絶好の島があります。東京からジェット船で、３時間。古き良き時代の懐かしも品格のあるたたずまい。そこに息づく穏やかな暮らしに、新しい時代のワークスタイルが融合する島、式根島。すぐそばには、紺碧の海と青い空、２４時間フリーな温泉、緑豊かな大自然が待っています。仕事に、生活に、本当に必要な情報は何か。人生の大事な時間や価値を洗い直すには、いま島が必要です。そんな思いを共にする人たちと島が一緒になって、どんな新しい暮らし方や働き方がつくれるか。さぁ、住んでよし、働いてよしの式根島へ。東京と島のデュアルライフ、移住・定住、大歓迎。式根島式、未来づくりに、あなたもご参加を。

title: 【Shikinejima Island】 A Trip to Shikinejima Island

Just three hours by jet boat from Tokyo, it has a nostalgic charm of the good old days with a dignified presence. The island of Shikinejima, where a peaceful way of life coexists with a new era of work style. Right nearby, the deep blue sea and sky, 24-hour free hot springs, and lush nature await. What is truly necessary information for work and life? To reassess the important time and value of life, we need the island now. Together with people who share this sentiment, what new ways of living and working can we create? Come to Shikinejima, where living and working are both great. A dual life between Tokyo and the island, migration and settlement are very welcome. Join us in creating the future in the Shikinejima way.

description:
雄物川が運んだ文化が花開く「新波」、秋にはこがね色の絨毯が広がる里「式田」。秋田市シティプロモーションモデル事業の一環として行ったワークショップを通し、地域住民が主体となってみつけたそれぞれの地区の『魅力』を詰め込んだ映像です。

雨が降れば「洗濯もの入れておいて」と頼めるお隣さんがいて、何があっても助け合える。
春になれば一面緑、秋になれば黄金の波に心が明るくなる。

This video is filled with the 'charm' of each area discovered by local residents through workshops conducted as part of the Akita City City Promotion Model Project.

When it rains, there's a neighbor to ask, 'Could you please take in my laundry?' and we can help each other no matter what happens.
In spring, everything turns green, and in autumn, the golden waves brighten our hearts.
In Akita City, Yuwa and Shinami, we found something important.

title: さくら便り　千秋公園
description:
秋田市民の憩いの場、千秋公園。
毎年春には、およそ700本もの桜が咲き誇ります。
園内のどんな場所でも見事にマッチする桜をお楽しみください。

title: Sakura Report - Senshu Park
description:
A place of relaxation for the citizens of Akita, Senshu Park.
Every spring, around 700 cherry blossom trees bloom beautifully.
Enjoy the stunning cherry blossoms that perfectly match any spot in the park.

title: 千秋公園「はちみつソフト」秋田美人が実食♪
description:
秋田駅前すぐそば、四季折々の自然が満喫できる千秋公園。秋田犬やあきた舞妓に会える観光スポットとしても人気の園内に、新名物「はちみつソフト」が登場しました。
早速、あきた観光レディーの３人が実食。
秋田市産のハチミツを使った甘すぎず、スッキリとした味わいで、この夏、話題沸騰間違いなしです！
是非、お試しあれ～♪

title: Senshu Park 'Honey Soft Serve' Akita Beauties Try It Out♪
description:
Right next to Akita Station, Senshu Park offers a chance to enjoy the beauty of nature throughout the seasons. 
As a popular tourist spot where you can meet Akita dogs and Akita maiko, a new specialty 'Honey Soft Serve' has appeared in the park. 
Immediately, three Akita tourism ladies tried it out. 
Using honey produced in Akita City, it has a refreshing taste that is not overly sweet, and it is sure to be a hot topic this summer! 
Be sure to give it a try~♪

title: 秋田美人が秋田フキをＰＲ
description: 秋田美人の代名詞「秋田おばこ」の衣装で、名物の秋田フキをＰＲする女子たちを紹介。秋田観光レディーの３人が、初めての蕗刈り体験と撮影会に登場。また、秋田市地域おこし協力隊で鹿児島県出身の重久愛さんは、地元の秋田おばこの皆さんと共に蕗刈りに挑戦。秋田市では、こんな秋田美人の皆さんが伝統を受け継いでいます。

title: Akita Beauties Promote Akita Fuki
description: Introducing girls promoting the local specialty Akita Fuki in the costume of the representative of Akita beauties, 'Akita Obako.' Three Akita tourism ladies appear for their first fuki harvesting experience and photo shoot. Additionally, Ai Shigehisa from Kagoshima Prefecture, part of the Akita City regional revitalization team, challenges fuki harvesting with local Akita Obako members. In Akita City, such Akita beauties are inheriting traditions.

title: 私は、まいこ
description: 女子高生「まいこ」が舞妓の修行に励み、秋田市の人や街を知って愛着を深めていくことで、あきた舞妓へと成長するストーリー。

title: I am Maiko
description: A story about a high school girl 'Maiko' who strives to become a maiko, deepening her affection for the people and streets of Akita City as she grows into an Akita maiko.

title: 平成最後の土崎港曳山まつり
description:
【市民リポーター あんどうさんの投稿】

7月20、21日の土崎港曳山まつり。クライマックスの戻り曳山では、いくつかの町内が交差点で勢いよく方向転換する『曳き回し』を行います。巨大な曳山を曳子たちが力を合わせて旋回させるシーンは、壮観の一言。ゲ・キ・ア・ツな平成最後の二日間でした！

撮影：あんどうさん

title: The Last Hiki-yama Festival of the Heisei Era
description:
[Citizen Reporter Andou's Post]

On July 20th and 21st, the Tsuchizaki Port Hiki-yama Festival takes place. During the climax of the returning Hiki-yama, several neighborhoods perform a 'Hiki-mawashi' where they vigorously change direction at intersections. The scene of the huge Hiki-yama being turned by the pullers working together is nothing short of spectacular. It was an intense two days marking the end of the Heisei era!

Photographed by: Andou

title: 秋田犬ふれあい処 in千秋公園オープン！
description:
秋田犬とふれあえるスポットが千秋公園二の丸にオープン！

隣接する売店では、秋田犬関連グッズも販売しますので、併せてお楽しみください！

・設置期間　平成３０年６月１６日（土）から１１月４日（日）までの毎日

・時　　間　１１：００から１５：００まで（６月１６日は１２：３０オープン）

・場　　所　千秋公園二の丸（秋田市中心市街地）

ふれあえる秋田犬は常時１頭。イベント開催時などは２頭でおもてなしします。

※犬の体調管理のため、直接触れることができない場合もありますのでご了承ください。

詳しくは
秋田市観光振興課
http://www.city.akita.akita.jp/wp/incm/topics/4935/

title: Akita Dog Interaction Spot Opens in Chuo Park!
description:
A spot where you can interact with Akita dogs has opened in the Ninomaru of Chuo Park!

In the adjacent shop, Akita dog-related goods will also be on sale, so please enjoy that as well!

・Installation Period: From June 16, 2018 (Saturday) to November 4, 2018 (Sunday), every day

・Time: From 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM (Opening at 12:30 PM on June 16)

・Location: Ninomaru, Chuo Park (Akita City Center)

There will always be one Akita dog available for interaction. During events, there may be two dogs to welcome you.

*Please note that due to the dogs' health management, there may be times when direct contact is not possible.

For more details, please contact:
Akita City Tourism Promotion Division
http://www.city.akita.akita.jp/wp/incm/topics/4935/

title: 秋田竿燈まつり【KANTO】　ナレーション無し
description:
秋田市の夏の夜空を彩る竿燈。
光の稲穂の輝き、竿燈を操る差し手の妙技、その美しさや迫力に圧倒されること間違いなし！
８月は是非、秋田竿燈祭りにお越しください。
（秋田市観光振興課制作）

title: Akita Kanto Festival【KANTO】 No Narration
description:
The Kanto, which colors the summer night sky of Akita City.
The brilliance of the light ears of rice, the skill of the performers manipulating the Kanto, you will surely be overwhelmed by its beauty and impact!
Please come to the Akita Kanto Festival in August.
(Produced by Akita City Tourism Promotion Division)

title: 千秋公園・秋田城跡歴史資料館・如斯亭
description:
秋田市の歴史と文化、自然の美しさを代表する３つの施設を紹介します。

（秋田市観光振興課制作）

title: Chūshū Park, Akita Castle Ruins Historical Museum, and Joshi-tei
description:
Introducing three facilities that represent the history and culture of Akita City, as well as the beauty of its nature.

(Produced by Akita City Tourism Promotion Division)

title: 太平山三吉梵天　BONDEN
description: 毎年１月１７日に行われる勇壮な秋田の冬の風物詩、三吉梵天祭り。邪気を祓い一年の幸を願う祭りで、力の神にあやかろうと激しい先陣争いが繰り広げられます。

title: Taiheizan Mikiyo Bonden
description: The magnificent winter tradition of Akita, the Mikiyo Bonden Festival, is held every year on January 17th. It is a festival to ward off evil spirits and wish for a year of happiness, featuring fierce competitions to emulate the power of the gods.

title: 雄物川花火大会
description:
秋田市の夏の夜空に浮かぶダイナミックな花火。
雄物川花火大会は、毎年８月に開催されています。

（秋田市観光振興課制作）

title: Omono River Fireworks Festival
description:
Dynamic fireworks floating in the summer night sky of Akita City.
The Omono River Fireworks Festival is held every August.

(Produced by Akita City Tourism Promotion Division)

title: 大正寺おけさ
description:
大正寺おけさは、九州地方で継承されてきた「ハイヤ節」を起源とし、北前船により伝播されたと言われる貴重な民謡文化です。

日本遺産に登録されたストーリー「荒波を越えた男たちの夢が紡いだ異空間～北前船寄港地・船主集落～」の中で、物語を構成する文化財としても位置づけられています。
（秋田市観光振興課制作）

title: Taisho-ji Okesa
description:
Taisho-ji Okesa is a precious folk culture that originated from the 'Haya-bushi' passed down in the Kyushu region, and is said to have been propagated by the Kitamae ships.

It is also positioned as a cultural asset that constitutes the story registered as a Japanese heritage, 'The Dream of Men Who Overcame the Rough Waves Weaving an Otherworldly Space - The Port Towns and Shipowners of Kitamae.'
(Produced by Akita City Tourism Promotion Division)

title: 伝統の技　秋田の竿燈　　KANTO
description:
国の重要無形民俗文化財で、東北三大祭りにも数えられる秋田市の夏の風物詩。秋田竿燈まつりは毎年８月３日から６日まで、竿燈大通りで行われています。力４、技６、竿燈を思いのまま操る差し手の妙技と、秋田市の夜空を黄金色に彩る光の稲穂の幻想的な風景を是非一度、秋田でご覧ください。

平成２５年度　広報広聴課制作

秋田竿燈まつり
http://www.kantou.gr.jp/index.htm

title: Traditional Craft: Akita Kanto
description: A summer tradition of Akita City, recognized as an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Asset of the country and counted among the three major festivals of Tohoku. The Akita Kanto Festival is held every year from August 3rd to 6th on Kanto Avenue. Experience the skillful techniques of the performers who manipulate the Kanto with strength and finesse, and witness the enchanting landscape of golden rice ears illuminating the night sky of Akita.

title: 秋田ノーザンブレッツＰＲムービー（2021年）～ショートver ～
description: 2021年の秋田ノーザンブレッツのPR動画です。

title: Akita Northern Bullets PR Movie (2021) - Short Version
description: This is a PR video of Akita Northern Bullets from 2021.

title: ダリアと菊の魅力をお届け！
description:
秋田中央地域地場産品活用促進協議会（通称「農家のパーティ」ネットワーク」では、JA秋田なまはげと管内の秋田市、男鹿市、潟上市が連携し、地場産品の活用促進と、3市の農林水産業と食品関連産業の振興を図ることを目的に、さまざまな活動を展開しています。

　このPRビデオは、3市で生産されるダリアと菊の生産現場の様子やその魅力を、3市の市長とJA秋田なまはげの組合長自らが皆さんにPRしています！

title: Delivering the Charm of Dahlias and Chrysanthemums!
description:
The Akita Central Region Local Products Utilization Promotion Council (commonly known as the 'Farmers' Party Network') collaborates with JA Akita Namahage and the cities of Akita, Oga, and Katagami to promote the utilization of local products and to enhance the agricultural, forestry, and fisheries industries as well as the food-related industries in the three cities through various activities.

This PR video showcases the production sites of dahlias and chrysanthemums grown in the three cities, with the mayors of the three cities and the chairman of JA Akita Namahage personally promoting their charm!

池田市観光PR動画第3弾は総合園芸店｢養庄園｣さんです！盆栽を中心に多くの植物や園芸用品を販売しております。「盆栽」と聞くと敷居が高く感じるかもしれませんが皆さんフレンドリーで親切に教えてもらえます。トリさんがチャレンジしている寄せ植え体験などの各種盆栽体験も行っております。
養庄園：http://www.yoshoen.com/

title: Discover Ikeda#003 Let's Experience Container Gardening in Ikeda City, Osaka
description:
The third installment of the Ikeda City tourism PR video features the comprehensive garden center 'Yoshoen'! They sell a wide variety of plants and gardening supplies, primarily focusing on bonsai. While the term 'bonsai' may seem intimidating, everyone is friendly and will teach you kindly. Various bonsai experiences, including the container gardening experience that the birds are trying, are also available.
Yoshoen: http://www.yoshoen.com/

title: Discover Ikeda#000『池田市』
description: 今回は動画番号 #000 ということで、Toriさんが池田のいろいろな場所をめぐる、池田市全体の紹介動画です！池田の豊かな自然や、歴史と文化に触れられる・体験できるスポットをたくさん見ることができますよ☆撮影地：五月平展望台、池田城跡公園、水月公園、養庄園、伊居太神社、呉服神社、都市緑化植物園、五月山動物園、久安寺それぞれのスポットについては池田市観光協会のHPをご確認ください。池田市観光協会HP：https://www.ikedashi-kanko.jp/spotlist

title: Discover Ikeda#000
description: This time, with video number #000, Tori will introduce various places in Ikeda City, showcasing the entire city! You can see many spots where you can experience and touch Ikeda's rich nature, history, and culture! Filming locations: Mayebira Observatory, Ikeda Castle Ruins Park, Suigetsu Park, Yoshoen, Iota Shrine, Gofuku Shrine, Urban Greening Botanical Garden, Mayasan Zoo, Kuanji. For more information about each spot, please check the Ikeda City Tourism Association's website. Ikeda City Tourism Association HP: https://www.ikedashi-kanko.jp/spotlist

title: STUNNING NAGOYA  A Unique and Exclusive Experience at Nagoya Castle
description: Nagoya has been the land of Samurais, giving it a rich history and unique cultural identity. Discover Nagoya's world-class meeting facilities, history, ancient traditions, and first-class dining, and be inspired by the cultural atmosphere of the city, in the heart of Japan.

title: 驚くべき名古屋 名古屋城でのユニークで特別な体験
description: 名古屋は侍の土地であり、豊かな歴史と独自の文化的アイデンティティを持っています。名古屋の世界クラスの会議施設、歴史、古代の伝統、そして一流のダイニングを発見し、日本の中心にあるこの街の文化的な雰囲気に触発されてください。

title: Spring in Nagoya
description:
コロナ禍により観光渡航が途絶する中、早春の名古屋の美しさを感じていただきたく、春の精に誘われるイメージで動画を作成しました。
乾杯のシーンでは、VYSA Tokai（在日ベトナム学生青年協会東海支部）のメンバーにご協力いただきました。

title: Spring in Nagoya
description:
Amidst the pandemic that has halted tourism, we created a video to convey the beauty of early spring in Nagoya, inspired by the spirit of spring.
In the scene of the toast, we received cooperation from members of VYSA Tokai (Vietnamese Youth and Student Association Tokai Branch).

title: 武將與喫茶文化
description: 名古屋と深い関係を持つ武将は古くから喫茶を好み、その影響を受けて江戸時代には平民も喫茶を楽しむようになりました。この精神文化は今でも受け継がれています。

title: Warlords and Tea Culture
description: Warlords with a deep connection to Nagoya have historically had a fondness for tea, and influenced by this, during the Edo period, common people also began to enjoy tea. This cultural spirit has been passed down to the present day.

title: 名古屋喫茶文化
description: 名古屋の喫茶店の朝食は、1杯の飲み物の価格で、他の特典も付いてきます。さらに、各店舗には独自の特色メニューがあり、さまざまな喫茶店を探索することができます。

title: Nagoya Coffee Culture
description: In Nagoya's coffee shops, breakfast is available at the price of just one drink, along with additional perks. Moreover, each shop has its own unique menu, so go explore different coffee shops!

title: 武将と喫茶文化
description: 名古屋ゆかりの武将たちのお茶を楽しむ文化は、江戸時代には庶民にまで広がりました。抹茶とお茶菓子で一服する習慣が、現代の喫茶店で一息つくというスピリッツにつながってるのでは！？といわれます。

title: Warlords and Tea Culture
description: The culture of enjoying tea associated with warlords from Nagoya spread to the common people during the Edo period. The custom of taking a break with matcha and tea sweets is said to connect to the spirit of taking a breather in modern tea shops.

title: 名古屋喫茶文化
description: 有名な「モーニング」は、ドリンク1杯の値段でおまけがついてくる。その他にも、お店ごとに特色のある喫茶メニューが豊富なので、喫茶店巡りを楽しんでみては？

title: Nagoya Coffee Culture
description: Famous for its 'morning' where you get a bonus with the price of a drink. Additionally, there are plenty of unique coffee shop menus at each store, so why not enjoy a coffee shop tour?

title: EEGANE! Come and Find, Your NAGOYA!  ~Shrines
description:
NAGOYA convention & visitors bureau has produced a video promoting Nagoya to Filipinos living in Japan.
The title is "EEGANE! Come and Find, Your NAGOYA!"
Megumi Marie Okada, a TV Aichi announcer born in Manila, Philippines, will be appointed to navigate the charm of Nagoya with two Filipinos living in Japan, Stephanie and Alisa.
（"EEGANE!” means ”NICE!” in Nagoya dialect.）
The video produced two patterns, "Nagoya food" and "Shrines ".
Tasting the food culture "Morning" unique to Nagoya, washing money at Yamada Tenmangu, etc. You can find your good luck in Nagoya!!
It was a video that conveys the charm of Nagoya with the theme of "experience".
Please check it out!

description:
名古屋観光コンベンションビューローは、日本に住むフィリピン人向けに名古屋を紹介する動画を制作しました。
タイトルは「EEGANE! あなたの名古屋を見つけに来て！」です。

title: 名古屋神社巡禮
description: 名古屋の神社を巡る旅は、その色とりどりの魅力に驚かされます。繁華な商業地区から静かで優雅な住宅街の隅々、のんびりとした農村から、到達するのに少し努力が必要な聖地まで、さまざまな場所がまるで日本全国を旅しているかのようです！変化に富んだ名古屋神社の旅は魅力に満ちており、出発したら止まらなくなること間違いなしです。

title: Nagoya Shrine Tour
description: Traveling around the shrines of Nagoya will amaze you with their vibrant and colorful nature. From bustling commercial areas to quiet and elegant corners of residential neighborhoods; from leisurely rural areas to sacred places that seem to require some effort to reach, various locations feel like a journey across Japan! The diverse Nagoya shrine tour is full of charm and will definitely keep you going once you set off!

title: Travel Around to Nagoya's Shrines
description: Japanese families have traditionally had a kamidana, or household Shinto altar, in their homes. Changes in lifestyles, such as the trend toward living in apartments, have led to the disappearance of these altars from many homes. However, when you venture outside, you will find many such shrines. We hope that you, coming from various parts of the world, will encounter deities in Nagoya, who always watch over us, in the belief that such an opportunity will bring you joy.

title: 名古屋の神社を巡る旅
description: 日本の家族は伝統的に家に神棚、または家庭用の神道の祭壇を持っていました。アパートに住む傾向など、ライフスタイルの変化により、これらの祭壇は多くの家庭から消えつつあります。しかし、外に出ると、そんな神社がたくさんあります。世界のさまざまな場所から来たあなたが、私たちを常に見守っている名古屋の神々に出会うことを願っています。このような機会があなたに喜びをもたらすと信じています。

title: 名古屋神社めぐり旅
description:
愛知県は神社仏閣の数が日本一だということはご存じでしょうか？
そんな神社仏閣の多いエリアにおいて、名古屋市内には700以上の「神社」が鎮座しています。
神社はその土地の歴史に縁が強く、いろいろな物語を楽しむことができます。
観光名所や施設以外に、名古屋の街中にある「神社」を巡ってみてはいかがでしょう。

title: Nagoya Shrine Tour
description:
Did you know that Aichi Prefecture has the highest number of shrines and temples in Japan?
In this area rich with shrines and temples, there are over 700 'shrines' located within Nagoya city.
Shrines are closely tied to the history of the land, and you can enjoy various stories.
How about exploring the 'shrines' scattered throughout the city of Nagoya, in addition to the tourist attractions and facilities?

description: 2021年1月17日に開催した「あなたの知らない名古屋オンラインツアー　名古屋城編」のアーカイブです。名古屋おもてなし武将隊の“徳川家康”、“前田慶次”、“加藤清正”、“踊舞”、“なつ”が、名古屋城の魅力を分かりやすくツアーガイドしています。ツアーでは、初心者向けの情報から玄人向けの情報に加え、今回のオンラインツアーのために特別に撮影した「藩主・将軍　着座目線」の映像をお楽しみいただくことができます。通常の一般観覧では立ち入ることができない「表書院上段之間」・「対面所上段之間」から、400年前の藩主や将軍しか見ることのできなかった景色をご堪能ください。

title: 【Archive】The Unknown Nagoya Online Tour: Nagoya Castle Edition
description: This is the archive of the 'Unknown Nagoya Online Tour: Nagoya Castle Edition' held on January 17, 2021. The Nagoya Hospitality Samurai Team, including 'Tokugawa Ieyasu', 'Maeda Keiji', 'Kato Kiyomasa', 'Odori Mai', and 'Natsu', guides you through the attractions of Nagoya Castle in an easy-to-understand manner. The tour offers information for beginners as well as advanced insights, and you can enjoy special footage shot specifically for this online tour, featuring the 'Lord and Shogun's Eye-Level View'. Experience the scenery that only the lords and shoguns of 400 years ago could see from the 'Upper Room of the Omote Shoin' and 'Upper Room of the Taimeisho', which are normally inaccessible to the public.

title: 日本の産業を巡る旅へ！Journey Through Japanese Industries
description:
From South Osaka to Wakayama, we offer two unique plans of Industrial Tourism: the Superior Plan, where you can engage in direct conversations with business owners, learning their secrets of business succession, sustainable manufacturing, and remarkable recovery from global financial crises; and the Standard Plan, which provides a behind-the-scenes look at traditional industries. 
Join us on a journey to discover the heart of Osaka’s craftsmanship and passion.

Please contact us from the URL below.
https://matcha-jp.com/jp/23218

What is Industrial Tourism?
★Discover the Hidden Side of Japan’s Manufacturing
Osaka is where products showcasing the skills of Japan’s proud craftsmen are created. You can experience a wide range of factories, from traditional crafts to metal processing. Take a step inside to the actual workshops.

★Learn from the Leaders of Long-Established Companies
Executives from companies with over 50 years of history will personally explain the secrets of their insights -environmentally friendly manufacturing, methods for training young talent, business succession strategies, and more.

The companies are located between Kansai Intl Airport and Namba, offering excellent access.

産業観光とは？

日本が誇る職人の技術がつまった製品が生み出されている場所ーそれが、関西です。
伝統工芸品からプラスチックや金属加工品まで、幅広いものづくりの現場を見学・体験いただけます。

title: 南海電鉄 鋼索線：新型高野山ケーブルカー運行開始！！
description:
2019年3月1日、4代目となる新型高野山ケーブルカーが運行を開始します。新型高野山ケーブルカーのコンセプトは「期待感」 「癒し・調和」 「安全・安心」。

「期待感」
客車部分はスイスのキャビンメーカーが手掛け、欧州風の流線型が特徴的なアルミ製の車体に、高野山・壇上伽藍の根本大塔を想起させる朱色をコンセプトカラーとして採用し、和洋折衷のデザインで高野山への「期待感」を醸成。

「癒し・調和」
内装は、全体に木目調の装飾を施し、調光式LEDを用いた間接照明を採用するなど「癒し・調和」を演出。

「安全・安心」
床面に滑りにくい材質を採用するとともに、車内段差部に足元灯を設置し、つまずきなどの事故防止対策を実施することで「安全・安心」を提供。

title: Nankai Electric Railway Cable Car: New Koyasan Cable Car Starts Operation!!
description:
On March 1, 2019, the fourth generation of the new Koyasan cable car will start operation. The concept of the new Koyasan cable car is 'Expectations', 'Healing and Harmony', and 'Safety and Security'.

'Expectations'
The passenger car is designed by a Swiss cabin manufacturer, featuring a European-style streamlined aluminum body, with a concept color of vermilion reminiscent of the main pagoda of Danjo Garan in Koyasan, creating an 'expectation' for Koyasan with a blend of Japanese and Western design.

'Healing and Harmony'
The interior is decorated with wood grain throughout, and indirect lighting using dimmable LEDs is adopted to create 'healing and harmony'.

'Safety and Security'
Non-slip materials are used for the floor, and footlights are installed at the steps inside the car to implement accident prevention measures such as tripping, providing 'safety and security'.

description: Koyasan Cable Carは、Koyasanの聖地である高野山駅と極楽橋駅を結ぶ路線です。ケーブルカーは、法律上「鋼索鉄道」として分類され、当社では『鋼索線』と呼ばれています。1930年に開通し、高野山への参拝客や住民の交通手段として重要な役割を果たしてきました。全長0.8Km、高低差328mで、東京タワーとほぼ同じ高さを約5分で昇ります。

title: Nankai Electric Railway Cable Car: Koyasan Cable Car
description: The Koyasan Cable Car connects the terminus of the Koyasan Line, Gokurakubashi Station, with Koyasan Station, the gateway to the sacred site of Shingon Buddhism, Koyasan. The cable car is classified as a 'cable railway' under the law, and we refer to it as 'Kousakusen'. Opened in 1930, it boasts a long history and has served as a means of transportation for both visitors to Koyasan and residents. It covers a distance of 0.8 km and a height difference of 328 m, ascending to a height similar to that of Tokyo Tower in about 5 minutes.

傾城阿波の鳴門 巡礼歌の段

徳島は玉木家の家宝、名刀「国次」を探すため、十郎兵衛、お弓の夫婦は三歳の娘お鶴を国許に残し、諸国を巡るが、じきに金銭も尽き、悪事を重ね尋者となってしまいます。九歳になったお鶴は、両親に会いたい一心から、巡礼姿で諸国遍路の旅に出ていました。ある日、大阪に身を隠すお弓の元に、偶然、巡礼姿のお鶴が訪れます。お弓は話を聞くうちに、間違いなく我が娘、お鶴であることに気がつきます。今すぐに抱きしめ、母と名乗りたい思いを抑え、娘に罪が及ぶことを恐れて、国へ帰るよう諭すお弓ですが、お鶴は「どうやら母さんのように思われて」と泣き、ここにおいてほしいと頼むのでした。同演目を岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会が獅子芝居で、島文楽保存会が文楽で上演しました。

Shima Bunraku Preservation Society (Ichinomiya City, Aichi Prefecture)

The section of the pilgrimage song from the play 'Keisei Awa no Naruto'

In Tokushima, in search of the family heirloom, the famous sword 'Kunisuke', the couple Jurobe and Oyu leave their three-year-old daughter Otsuru at home and travel around the country. Soon, their money runs out, and they resort to wrongdoing, becoming fugitives. At the age of nine, Otsuru, longing to see her parents, sets out on a pilgrimage journey. One day, Oyu, hiding in Osaka, unexpectedly encounters Otsuru in her pilgrimage attire. As Oyu listens to her story, she realizes that this is undoubtedly her daughter Otsuru. Suppressing her desire to embrace her immediately and introduce herself as her mother, Oyu advises Otsuru to return home, fearing that her daughter might be implicated in her troubles. However, Otsuru, crying, says, 'I feel like I might be my mother,' and pleads to stay here. The same play was performed by the Ginan Town Fushiya Shishimai Preservation Society as a lion theater and by the Shima Bunraku Preservation Society as bunraku.

【あらすじ】
「月も朧に白魚の…」「こいつぁ春から、縁起がいいわぇ」の名ぜりふで有名な、河竹黙阿弥の世話物作品。　
　節分の夜、お嬢吉三は隅田川の河畔で夜鷹の女から金百両を奪うが、それをお坊吉三が見とがめ、二人は金を巡って争う。通りかかった和尚吉三が争いを仲裁し、互いの正体をあかしあった同じ名の三人は義兄弟の契りを結ぶ。和尚は百両を父の伝吉に貢ぐが、悪銭は要らぬと投げ捨てられる。百両はお坊の手に渡り、伝吉はお坊に殺されてしまう。
　お嬢とお坊は、和尚と再会、そこでお坊は初めて自分が和尚の父を殺したことを知り、お嬢は夜鷹の女が和尚の妹だということを知る。二人は罪を悔いて死のうとするが…

Lion Play 'Koyasan'

【Synopsis】
Ishido Maru, longing to meet his father, Shigeuji (Karakaya Doshin), leaves his ailing mother behind and walks alone to Koyasan. By chance, he encounters his father, Karakaya Doshin, on the mountain path and innocently asks, "Where is Imado Shin?" Karakaya Doshin replies, "Those who have just become monks are all called Imado Shin," and advises him to return. When Ishido Maru mentions his mother's illness, tears well up in Karakaya Doshin's eyes. Seeing this, Ishido Maru questions if he might be his father, but Karakaya Doshin says, "Shigeuji Nindō is currently traveling for training in various regions, and his whereabouts are unknown," urging him to hurry down the mountain and care for his mother.

岐阜県にて令和6年度開催される、第39回国民文化祭 第24回全国障害者芸術・文化祭 「『清流のぎふ』文化祭2024」のプレイベントのひとつとして、今年も「岐南地芝居公演」を開催しました。「伏屋の獅子芝居」と県内の他の獅子芝居や地歌舞伎が同時にみられる公演で、今年は岐南町伏屋獅子舞保存会、関市獅子舞保存会と美濃歌舞伎保存会が出演しました。

【あらすじ】
　徳島は玉木家の家宝、名刀「国次」を探すため、十郎兵衛、お弓(獅子)の夫婦は三歳の娘お鶴を国許に残し、諸国を巡るが、じきに金銭も尽き、悪事を重ね尋者となってしまう。
　九歳になったお鶴は、両親に会いたい一心から、巡礼姿で諸国遍路の旅に出ていた。ある日、大阪に身を隠すお弓の元に、偶然、順礼姿のお鶴が訪れる。お弓は話を聞くうちに、間違いなく我が娘、お鶴であることに気がつく。今すぐに抱きしめ、母と名乗りたい思いを抑え、娘に罪が及ぶことを恐れて、国へ帰るよう諭すお弓だが、お鶴は「どうやら母さんのように思われて」と泣き、ここにおいてほしいと頼むのであった。

description:
September 10, 2023 (Sunday)
Ginan Local Theater Performance @ Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Hall

As one of the pre-events for the 39th National Cultural Festival and the 24th National Arts and Culture Festival for Persons with Disabilities, "'Seiryu no Gifu' Cultural Festival 2024" to be held in Gifu Prefecture in the 6th year of Reiwa, the "Ginan Local Theater Performance" was held again this year. This performance featured the "Fushiya Lion Theater" alongside other lion theaters and local kabuki from within the prefecture, with appearances by the Ginan Town Fushiya Lion Dance Preservation Society, the Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society, and the Mino Kabuki Preservation Society.

　　Road Journey
　　Visit
　　Demon Exorcism
　　Lion Theater 'Keisei Awa no Naruto: Pilgrimage Song Scene'

【Synopsis】
In search of the family heirloom, the famous sword "Kunitsugi" of the Tamaki family in Tokushima, Jurobei and his wife Oyu (the lion) leave their three-year-old daughter Otsuru at home and travel through various countries. However, soon their money runs out, and they resort to wrongdoing, becoming fugitives. At the age of nine, Otsuru, with a strong desire to see her parents, sets out on a pilgrimage journey dressed as a pilgrim. One day, Oyu, who is hiding in Osaka, unexpectedly encounters Otsuru, who is in pilgrimage attire. As Oyu listens to her story, she realizes without a doubt that this is her daughter, Otsuru. Suppressing her desire to embrace her immediately and introduce herself as her mother, Oyu advises Otsuru to return home, fearing that her daughter might be implicated in her troubles. However, Otsuru, crying, says, "It seems I am thought to be like my mother," and pleads to stay here.

title: Ayabe Minatsuki Festival 2023
description: The Ayabe Minatsuki Festival was held again this year. Many people visited that day, and it was exciting everywhere in the city. I made this video with gratitude to everyone who supported this festival and will be looking forward to next year.

title: 綾部みなつき祭り2023
description: 今年も綾部みなつき祭りが開催されました。多くの人々がその日訪れ、街中がどこも賑わっていました。この祭りを支えてくれた皆さんに感謝の気持ちを込めてこの動画を作りました。来年も楽しみにしています。

title: NOTO - KANAZAWA Sustainable Nature & Life  - Cinematic travel film
description: The Noto Peninsula and Kanazawa, areas of traditional and sustainable living, the place teaches the woven tapestry of nature & life and how we are all connected together. I would be happy if you could feel the sustainability and gentleness from this film.

title: NOTO - 金沢の持続可能な自然と生活 - シネマティック旅行映画
description: 能登半島と金沢、伝統的で持続可能な生活の地域で、自然と生活の織りなすタペストリーと私たちがどのように繋がっているかを教えてくれる場所です。この映画から持続可能性と優しさを感じていただければ幸いです。

title: TOKYO | Japan Cinematic travel film
description: - A glimpse of emotion in the bustling days - Tokyo, the capital of Japan, continues to develop at a rapid pace. The glimple image of emotion amidst the hustle and bustle of a metropolis where people are constantly passing by.

title: 東京 | 日本の映画的旅行フィルム
description: - 喧騒の中の感情のひとしずく - 東京、日本の首都は急速に発展し続けています。人々が絶えず行き交う大都市の喧騒の中での感情のひとしずくのイメージ。

title: TOKYO with Lumix GH6 / Japan Travel cinematic vlog
description: Finally Japan border will be opened from 10th June as government announced and we are so excited to welcome our guests from overseas again! This time we made a cinematic travel Vlog of Tokyo, I stayed 3 days in Tokyo with my gear LUMIX GH6 in end of May. I hope you enjoy our video and catch a latest atmosphere of Tokyo!

title: TOKYO with Lumix GH6 / 日本旅行シネマティックVlog
description: ついに日本の国境が6月10日から開かれると政府が発表し、海外からのゲストを再びお迎えできることに興奮しています！今回は東京のシネマティック旅行Vlogを作成しました。5月末にLUMIX GH6を持って東京に3日間滞在しました。私たちのビデオを楽しんで、東京の最新の雰囲気を感じていただければ幸いです！
