title: My summer moment in Kyoto - Fukuchiyama Sky Lantern - Cinematic travel Vlog
description: This is our summer moment in Kyoto. Let us share a record of sky Lantern event, which is held in 15th Aug 2021 in Fukuchiyama city of Kyoto. Organizer has been held this event few years but unfortunately this year will be the last. So we would like to share our moment in this video, I hope you enjoy beautiful lanterns in the sky!

title: 私の夏の瞬間 - 福知山のスカイランタン - シネマティック旅行Vlog
description: これは私たちの京都での夏の瞬間です。2021年8月15日に福知山市で開催されたスカイランタンイベントの記録を共有します。このイベントは数年前から開催されていますが、残念ながら今年が最後となります。この動画で私たちの瞬間を共有したいと思います。空に浮かぶ美しいランタンを楽しんでいただければ幸いです。

title: Japanese cooking class in a rural old farm house feat. Woodland Kyoto (Fukuchiyama City / Miwa Town)
description: Continuing from the previous edition of Kyotamba, we went to Miwa-cho, Fukuchiyama City with photographer Yasuto Shimizu. In this video, we challenged a Japanese cooking class at an old private farm house in Fukuchiyama. Please take a look at the many charms of old folk houses. If you have a chance, please come and visit us!

title: 日本の料理教室 - 田舎の古い農家での体験 (福知山市 / 美和町)
description: 前回の京丹波から続き、私たちは福知山市美和町に写真家の清水康人と共に行きました。このビデオでは、福知山の古い私有農家での日本料理教室に挑戦しました。古民家の多くの魅力をぜひご覧ください。機会があれば、ぜひお越しください！

title: A day in  KYOTAMBA city. Woodland Kyoto - shooting session with photographer
description: Last spring, we spend a great time in Kyotamba city, located in the central of Kyoto prefecture. Here is the video about photo session with Shimizu-san, professional photographer from Kyoto. These photos were taken to be used on website of Woodland Kyoto or any related advertisement for inbound tourism in Woodland Kyoto, at the same time we enjoyed a lot of videography as well. We hope you will like this lovely places and visit them if you have chance!

title: 京丹波市での一日。ウッドランド京都 - 写真家との撮影セッション
description: 昨春、私たちは京都府の中央に位置する京丹波市で素晴らしい時間を過ごしました。ここでは、京都のプロの写真家清水さんとの写真セッションに関するビデオを紹介します。これらの写真は、ウッドランド京都のウェブサイトや関連する観光広告に使用されるために撮影されました。同時に、私たちは多くのビデオ撮影も楽しみました。皆さんがこの素敵な場所を気に入って、訪れる機会があればいいなと思っています！

title: Sanin Kaigan coast - Digest of Kansai Plus One Trip - Japan Travel Cinematic Vlog
description: We have compiled a video of the trips to the Sanin coast area, Tottori / Tajima / Yumura / Kinosaki / Kyoto of the sea area, which we traveled from February to March. A trip to the Sanin coast is full of gourmet experiences and historical attractions. It is close to the center of Osaka and Kyoto and easily accessible by train or rental car. Please take a look!

title: 山陰海岸 - 関西プラスワン旅行のダイジェスト - 日本旅行シネマティックVlog
description: 私たちは、2月から3月にかけて旅行した山陰海岸エリア、鳥取/但馬/湯村/城崎/京都の海エリアの旅行の動画をまとめました。山陰海岸への旅行は、グルメ体験や歴史的な観光名所で満ちています。大阪や京都の中心部から近く、電車やレンタカーで簡単にアクセスできます。ぜひご覧ください！

title: Tajima - Yumura onsen - Tottori - Kansai Plus One Trip Vol.2
description: Continuing from the previous video, we would like to introduce a new destination on the Sanin Kaigan seacoast that we will visit in 3 days. This time we traveled to Tajima, Yumura Onsen, and Tottori prefecture.

title: タジマ - 湯村温泉 - 鳥取 - 関西プラスワン旅行 Vol.2
description: 前回の動画に続き、3日間で訪れる新しい目的地を紹介します。今回は、タジマ、湯村温泉、鳥取県を訪れました。

title: Kyoto by the sea, Kinosaki, Izushi - Kansai Plus One Trip Vol.1
description: This time we traveled a little further from the center of Kansai to Kyoto by the Sea, Izushi, and Kinosaki. This is a video about our journey to a new destination on the Sanin Kaigan sea coast, which takes 3 nights and 4 days.

title: 海の京都、城崎、出石 - 関西プラスワン旅行 Vol.1
description: 今回は関西の中心から少し離れ、海の京都、出石、城崎を旅しました。これは、山陰海岸での3泊4日の新しい目的地への旅の動画です。

title: KAGOSHIMA - Best Highlight / Beautiful Nature & Rich Food Culture - Japan Cinematic Travel Vlog
description: Kagoshima prefecture, located at the southernmost part of Kyushu, has many attractive points which has been protected by locals such as historical cultural assets left by the warlords of the Sengoku Period, food culture, and superb landscape of beautiful nature including Sakurajima. The video is about highlights of sightseeing spots and some activities at local farm. This is a 3-minutes video. Please enjoy it!

title: 鹿児島 - 最高のハイライト / 美しい自然と豊かな食文化 - 日本のシネマティック旅行ブログ
description: 鹿児島県は九州の最南端に位置し、戦国時代の武将たちが残した歴史的文化財、食文化、桜島を含む美しい自然の素晴らしい景観など、地元の人々によって守られてきた多くの魅力的なポイントがあります。このビデオは観光スポットのハイライトと地元の農場でのいくつかのアクティビティについてです。これは3分間のビデオです。お楽しみください！

title: Kanazawa city vol.1 SAMURAI Spirits & Food Culture – Japan Cinematic Vlog
description: Kanazawa is a city where you can experience the history, where historic buildings and quaint streets still remain. Significant historical sites such as Kenrokuen garden and the samurai residence are the heritage of the samurai have been passed down to the present day. And here you can not only see, but also hold a real Japanese sword. Surrounded by mountains and the sea, Kanazawa is also known as a treasure trove of essential ingredients. We really enjoyed the freshest seafood sushi and Japanese sake, which is also a local specialty! And, of course, we recommend making your own original sushi rolls using your favorite ingredients. We invite you to visit the Kanazawa city, the place where samurai culture and food culture originated. In our next video, we will introduce you to the traditional handicrafts inherited from the Kanazawa city. See you soon!

title: 金沢市 vol.1 SAMURAI スピリッツと食文化 - 日本のシネマティックVlog
description: 金沢は、歴史を体験できる街であり、歴史的な建物や趣のある街並みが今も残っています。兼六園や武家屋敷などの重要な歴史的名所は、武士の遺産が現在まで受け継がれています。そして、ここでは本物の日本刀を見て、触れることができます。山と海に囲まれた金沢は、食材の宝庫としても知られています。私たちは新鮮な海鮮寿司や地元の特産品である日本酒を心から楽しみました！もちろん、お気に入りの食材を使ってオリジナルの寿司ロールを作ることをお勧めします。武士文化と食文化が生まれた場所、金沢市を訪れてみてください。次の動画では、金沢市に受け継がれる伝統工芸をご紹介します。またお会いしましょう！

title: KOBE⇌NAGANO by FDA airlines/ highlight of Nagano trip - Nature & History Japan Cinematic Travel Vlog
description: We transferred by direct flight from Kobe Airport to Shinshu Matsumoto Airport and stayed in Nagano prefecture for 2 nights this time. During the trip, we visited stateliness historical buildings such as Matsumoto castle and enjoyed magnificent landscape and delicious local food. Please come and visit Nagano prefecture.

title: KOBE⇌NAGANO by FDA airlines/ 長野旅行のハイライト - 自然と歴史の日本シネマティック旅行ブログ
description: 私たちは神戸空港から信州松本空港への直行便で移動し、今回は長野県に2泊しました。旅行中、松本城などの歴史的な建物を訪れ、壮大な景色と美味しい地元の食べ物を楽しみました。ぜひ長野県に訪れてください。

title: FUKUI  Mikata Five lakes & Tsuruga /Beautiful nature & Fresh seafood - Japan Cinematic Travel Vlog
description: Our journey continues in Fukui prefecture. We visited quaint machiya accommodation and Kehi shrine in Tsuruga city. Also, we enjoyed the beautiful scenery from Mikata Five lake rainbow line and had delicious seafood from the Sea of Japan at one of the biggest fish markets that locals are proud of. Hopefully, everyone enjoyed our videos about Shiga and Fukui prefecture. Please come and visit those prefectures filled with warmth and charm of people ♪

title: 福井 美方五湖と敦賀 / 美しい自然と新鮮な海の幸 - 日本のシネマティック旅行ブログ
description: 私たちの旅は福井県で続きます。私たちは敦賀市の趣のある町家宿泊施設と慶雲寺を訪れました。また、五湖の虹ラインからの美しい景色を楽しみ、日本海の新鮮な海の幸を地元の人々が誇る最大の魚市場の一つで味わいました。皆さんが滋賀県と福井県に関する私たちの動画を楽しんでいただけたら幸いです。温かく魅力的な人々がいるこれらの県をぜひ訪れてください♪

title: FUKUI Wakasa & Obama / Historical Seafood Road and Sacred Places - Japan Travel Vlog
description: Our journey continues from Shiga to Fukui by train and bus. At first, we visited Kumagawa-juku in Fukui prefecture where the old town scenery remains. The Saba kaido was used for transporting seafoods which were caught from the Sea of Japan to Kyoto, capital city at that time. There are many historical temples and shrines in Obama city. We hope you’d enjoy its mysterious atmosphere. We will continue introduce delicious food and nice machiya in Vol.4. Please look forward to our next video.

title: 福井 若狭 & 小浜 / 歴史的海産物の道と聖地 - 日本旅行Vlog
description: 私たちの旅は、滋賀から福井へ電車とバスで続きます。最初に、福井県の熊川宿を訪れました。そこには古い町の風景が残っています。鯖街道は、日本海で捕れた海産物を当時の首都京都に運ぶために使われていました。小浜市には多くの歴史的な寺院や神社があります。その神秘的な雰囲気を楽しんでいただければ幸いです。次回の動画では、美味しい食べ物や素敵な町家を紹介します。次の動画をお楽しみに。

title: Shigaraki Pottery & Hikone History Japan Travel Cinematic Vlog / Shiga & Fukui Tour vol.2 Earthen Pot Rice and Shigaraki Pottery Workshop Visit & Hikone Sightseeing
description:
Our travel in Shiga is continuing from our last video.
We visited a restaurant where they serve rice in earthen pots of Shigaraki ware which is one of Japanese pottery and a workshop.

We learned about Shigaraki ware and how to cook delicious rice from potter.
Also, we visited Taga Taisha where locals has been visited for long time and Hikone castle which is designated a national treasure.

Shiga prefecture is full of spots where you can see Shigaraki ware which has been created using traditional methods, visit shrines and castles related to Japanese history and follow the tracks of locals’ lives.
We will be visiting our next destination Fukui prefecture in our next video, vol.3. Please look forward to it!

title: Maizuru Repatriation Memorial Museum in KYOTO
description: This time we visited the Maizuru Repatriation Memorial Museum, which is registered in the UNESCO Memory of the World register. Here you can learn about the history of Siberian prisoners of war and people who found themselves outside Japan after World War II. It has been 75 years since the end of the war, and many have begun to forget it. We invite you to remember it once again. There is an observation deck on the hill above the museum with a view of the bay. If you are in Maizuru, be sure to visit this place.

title: 【観光客のいない嵐山・京都】竹林散策と祇王寺 4K動画 by iphone 11pro(2020年7月10日撮影）
description:
皆さんこんにちは。今日は嵐山の景色を映像と音楽で紹介していきます。
京都・嵐山は京都でも代表的な観光名所、特に竹林が人気のスポットで毎年多く観光客が国内外から訪れています。桜や紅葉のシーズンでは毎年人が溢れかえるほど人気のエリアです。
日本では新型コロナウィルスが発生した直後の4月から5月までは政府より緊急事態宣言が発令され、人々は旅行しなくなり家にこもる日々が続きました。
緊急事態宣言が解除となった6月以降も、感染を恐れて移動を控える人が多く、日本各地の観光地は大きな打撃を受けました。

私達が嵐山を撮影した7月10日は、緊急事態宣言解除直後、また梅雨シーズンにより雨が長く続いた時期でもあり、人がほとんどいませんでした。今この動画を公開した9月現在では、政府がGO TO キャンペーンなど旅行者向けのお得なキャンペーンを促進したり、夏休みを過ごしたこともあり、以前より観光地に旅行客が戻りつつあります。

おそらく、これだけ人のいない嵐山を今後しばらく撮影する事はないかもしれません。
ぜひともこの貴重な、静けさと雨に包まれた嵐山をお楽しみください。
コロナが一日も早く終息することを祈り、また一日も早く観光客がにぎわう日を私たちも楽しみにしています。

Arashiyama in Kyoto is one of the most famous tourist spots in Kyoto, especially popular for its bamboo grove, attracting many tourists from both domestic and international locations every year. During the cherry blossom and autumn foliage seasons, this area is so popular that it is overflowing with people every year.

In Japan, from April to May, right after the outbreak of the novel coronavirus, the government issued a state of emergency, and people stopped traveling, leading to days of staying at home.

Even after the state of emergency was lifted in June, many people refrained from traveling due to fear of infection, and tourist spots across Japan suffered significant blows.

On July 10, when we filmed Arashiyama, it was just after the state of emergency was lifted, and it was also a time when the rainy season had continued for a long time, resulting in almost no people around. As of September, when this video is being released, the government has been promoting campaigns like the GO TO campaign for travelers, and with the summer vacation having passed, tourists are gradually returning to tourist spots.

It is likely that we will not have the opportunity to film Arashiyama with so few people for a while.
Please enjoy this precious, quiet, and rain-soaked Arashiyama.
We pray for the swift end of the coronavirus and look forward to the day when tourists will once again fill the area.

title: Farm House Stay in Japan-Kyoto Ayabe / Ночь в сельском доме Покапока Ноэн. Киото, Аябэ. Travel Vlog
description: 綾部市は京都府の北部に位置する小さな町で、人口は33,000人です。「ポカポカ農園」は、東京から綾部に移住した串田さんが運営しています。「ポカポカ農園」は、100年以上の歴史を持つ古民家を改装したものです。串田さんは、自然に囲まれた田舎で、農薬や肥料を使わずに米や野菜を育てています。また、2019年からは、ゲストが自分で火を入れることができる伝統的な「五右衛門風呂」を楽しむことができます。自然の中でリラックスしたい方や農業体験をしたい方に最適な宿です。今回は、マキシムによる宿泊体験の動画を紹介します。

title: 日本の農家宿 - 京都の綾部 / Poka Poka Nouenの農家宿
description: Ayabe City is located in the northern part of Kyoto Prefecture, it's a small town with a population of 33,000. The “Poka Poka Nouen(Farm)” operated by Mr. Kushida, who has moved from Tokyo to Ayabe. "Poka Poka Nouen(farm)" is a renovation of an old folk house over 100 years old. Mr. Kushida grows rice and vegetables that are pesticide-free and fertilizer-free in the countryside where is full of nature. Also, from 2019, guests can enjoy the traditional "Goemon" style open-air bath which they can set the fire on their own. It is a perfect inn for those who want to relax in nature and who want to experience farming. This time, we introduce a video of lodging experience by Maxim.

title: Традиционные ремесла и искусства Японии – Японская бумага Васи из деревни Куротани / КИОТО-АЯБЭ
description: 今日は、京都府北部での日本の伝統的な和紙の製造について紹介します。私たちは、あやべ市の黒谷村を訪れ、800年以上の伝統を持つ和紙が今でも伝統的な技術で作られています。黒谷村は京都府の無形文化遺産として認識されています。この地域は多くの人にとって未開の地ですが、手作りの和紙の伝統技術を守ることで知られています。

title: Traditional Crafts and Arts of Japan – Japanese Paper Washi from Kurotani Village / KYOTO-AYABE
description: Today we will get acquainted with the traditional production of Japanese Washi paper in the north of Kyoto Prefecture. We will visit Kurotani village in Ayabe city, where paper has been made for over 800 years using traditional technologies. Kurotani village is recognized as an intangible heritage of Kyoto Prefecture. It is an unexplored area for many people, but it is well known for preserving traditional methods of making Washi.

With this film, I hope to not only promote the Nagoro “Scarecrow” Village but also somehow reach out to her. This poem expresses my feelings towards her after our trip. At the same time, it conveys my desire for people from afar to see the Nagoro “Scarecrow” Village.

I would like to promote the Nagoro “Scarecrow” Village in Tokushima Prefecture. When I visited this place with my friend, there were no tourists other than us. The local people we met were very friendly, and their desire for more people to visit their beautiful hometown and its surroundings was palpable. Some of my foreign friends have heard of this place, but very few have actually seen it. Most have never even heard of it. However, after showing them the film, they expressed a desire to visit this place. They also asked about the directions and the costs needed to get there. I hope that after watching this film, they will visit the village in Iya Valley and other places, just like my friend did.

title: 【EXILE橘ケンチのSAKE JAPAN】山下健二郎と約束の福井市へ！前編・定置網漁&釣り【コラボ】
description: ライフワークである日本酒への愛情はもちろん、酒とも密接に関わる第一次産業や多様な日本文化の魅力を〈橘〉流に発信する『EXILE橘ケンチのSAKE JAPAN』第35回。2022年元日に配信してから早1年。今年を締めくくる&新年を迎えるSP回としてEXILE TRIBEから三代目 J SOUL BROTHERS山下健二郎が再登場！あの日約束した福井市での定置網漁&釣り体験がついに実現──さらに『YAMASHITA BASE』とのコラボが今回も決定！LDH随一の釣り&アウトドアの巧者を迎えて橘ケンチ&山下健二郎それぞれの釣果は──？CL『ケンチのイッテキ』で近日公開する定置網漁の模様も乞うご期待！そして2人の旅は後編へと続く!!

title: EXILE Kenchi Tachibana's SAKE JAPAN: Promised Fukui City with Kenjiro Yamashita! Part 1 - Fixed Net Fishing & Fishing Collaboration
description: Of course, the love for Japanese sake, which is a life work, and the charm of primary industries closely related to sake and diverse Japanese culture are transmitted in the Tachibana style. This is the 35th episode of 'EXILE Kenchi Tachibana's SAKE JAPAN'. It has been a year since it was distributed on New Year's Day 2022. As a special episode to conclude this year and welcome the new year, Kenjiro Yamashita from EXILE TRIBE's Sandaime J Soul Brothers makes a reappearance! The promised fixed net fishing and fishing experience in Fukui City has finally been realized── Furthermore, collaboration with 'YAMASHITA BASE' has also been decided this time! Welcoming the best fishing and outdoor expert in LDH, what are the catches of Kenchi Tachibana and Kenjiro Yamashita──? Please look forward to the upcoming fixed net fishing footage to be released on CL 'Kenchi's Ittekki'! And the journey of the two continues to the next part!!

title: FUKUI Style Soba Feast Edition
description:
Fukui City Image Up PR Video
1st Anniversary of the Release of the 'FUKUI Style' Series!
Starting from Tuesday, October 14, 2025, at LDH kitchen THE TOKYO HANEDA,
what's the exciting content of the 'Fukui Good! Autumn Lunch Fair'?

So──

In this 'FUKUI Style Soba Feast Edition',
Kenchi Tachibana (EXILE/EXILE THE SECOND),
the PR ambassador for Fukui City's food,
will welcome Yuta Nakatsukasa (GENERATIONS),
who has a two-day performance at Sandome Fukui on December 6 (Saturday) and 7 (Sunday),
to enjoy the fair menu items:
'Special Echizen Oroshi Soba',
'Sauce Katsu Don',
'Plum Juice using Fukui Prefecture Plums'.

Actually──

The recipe created and won in the program
'Achikochi Kenchi - The Ultimate Showdown with GENERATIONS and Echizen Oroshi Soba',
recorded in Fukui City in the summer of 2025,
was developed by Kenchi Tachibana,
and the head chef of THE TOKYO HANEDA has brushed it up as 'Special Echizen Oroshi Soba',
making this autumn lunch fair a reality.

During the lunch fair period,
from October 14 (Tuesday) to November 24 (Monday),
please enjoy it when you visit nearby.

Furthermore──

The runner-up,
GENERATIONS' Special Echizen Oroshi Soba,
will also be featured on the menu,
and before the GENERATIONS performance at Sandome Fukui,
it will be offered as a limited-time fair
from November 28 (Friday) to December 8 (Monday)
at Fukui City Tourism and Product Center Fuku Fuku Kan and Echizen Soba Club.

title: 【夏紋別】JNO（実は夏も面白い）MOMBETSU観光プロモーション動画（英語表記版）
description: 【夏紋別】流氷の街 北海道紋別市は実は夏も面白い。 「オホーツク」観光といえば「流氷」を思い浮かべる方が多いのではないでしょうか？実は紋別の夏は東京と比較して湿度が高いにも関わらず、平均気温が8.7℃低い（2020年8月の気象庁統計より）ことで爽やかで過ごしやすいことをご存じでしょうか？ そんな紋別で、アザラシとのふれあい、夜景や星空を楽しめるナイトクルーズ、紋別の海の幸が満載のBBQ、そして地元民がおすすめする絶景のスポット巡りをしませんか？ この動画は、紋別商工会議所が2019年に実施した「ＪＮＯ ＭＯＭＢＥＴＳＵモニターツアー」を基に構成した、夏の紋別の魅力に特化した観光プロモーション動画です。

title: 【Summer Mombetsu】JNO (Actually, Summer is Fun) Mombetsu Tourism Promotion Video (Japanese Version)
description: The city of Mombetsu in Hokkaido, known for its drift ice, is actually fun in the summer too. When thinking of 'Okhotsk' tourism, many might picture 'drift ice.' However, did you know that Mombetsu's summer is refreshing and comfortable, with an average temperature 8.7°C lower than Tokyo, despite having higher humidity? In Mombetsu, you can enjoy interactions with seals, night cruises with beautiful night views and starry skies, BBQs filled with local seafood, and visits to recommended scenic spots by locals. description: 「サイクリングターミナルりんりん」をスタート・ゴール地点とするルート。南さつま市、日置市、鹿児島市、指宿（いぶすき）市、南九州市、枕崎市、それぞれの特徴的な風景を次々に楽しめます。リアス式の海岸線を背に沈みゆく夕日が美しい東シナ海、さらには桜島、開聞（かいもん）岳が聳え立つ錦江湾の美しさが格別です。武家屋敷群や薩摩焼窯元、焼酎酒蔵、鰹本枯れ節工場など魅力に満ち溢れたエリアです。

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: A Ride Through the Streets Filled with the History and Splendid Culture of the Satsuma Clan! South Satsuma Route ver2
description: This route starts and ends at the 'Cycling Terminal Rinrin'. You can enjoy the distinctive landscapes of Minamisatsuma City, Hioki City, Kagoshima City, Ibusuki City, Minamikyushu City, and Makurazaki City one after another. The beautiful sunset over the East China Sea against the backdrop of the ria coastline, as well as the stunning views of Sakurajima and Kaimondake towering over Kinko Bay, are exceptional. This area is filled with attractions such as samurai residences, Satsuma ware kilns, shochu distilleries, and katsuobushi factories.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】ダイナミックな自然、豊かなグルメを楽しむ！大隅（おおすみ）ルートver2
description: 垂水港を拠点として8の字に周遊する壮大なルート。大隅半島は、豊かな自然に恵まれ農業をはじめ漁業、畜産など第一次産業が盛んな地域です。地域の資源を活用した体験や学習コンテンツに加えて、近海の鮮魚、黒毛和牛の産地ならではのグルメも揃います。緑深い高隈連山を背景に大平原が広がる、ダイナミックという言葉がよく似合う自然豊かなエリアです。

title: [Kagoshima Cycle Tourism] Enjoy Dynamic Nature and Rich Gourmet! Osumi Route ver2
description:
A grand route that loops in a figure-eight from Tarumizu Port.
The Osumi Peninsula is blessed with rich nature and is an active region for primary industries such as agriculture, fishing, and livestock farming.
In addition to experiences and learning content utilizing local resources, you can also enjoy gourmet food unique to the area, such as fresh seafood from nearby waters and black-haired wagyu beef.
With the lush Takakuma mountain range in the background, it is a nature-rich area that truly embodies the word dynamic.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】美しい名峰と癒やしの温泉で身も心もあたたまる！霧島・姶良ルートver2
description: 鹿児島空港を拠点として8の字に周遊するルート。神話や伝説に彩られ、火山の息吹を目の前に感じさせる霧島連山の名峰、清流は四季折々に神秘的な表情を見せ、その自然美は感動的でさえあります。また、鹿児島の中央に位置し、文化史跡が溶け込む街並みのある姶良とともに、緑鮮やかな山々と輝く錦江湾や温泉まで楽しめるルートです。

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: Warm Your Body and Soul with Beautiful Peaks and Healing Hot Springs! Kirishima-Aira Route ver2
description: A route that circles in an 8 shape centered around Kagoshima Airport. The majestic peaks of the Kirishima mountain range, colored by myths and legends, allow you to feel the breath of the volcano right before your eyes. The clear streams show mysterious expressions throughout the seasons, and their natural beauty is even moving. Additionally, this route allows you to enjoy the lush green mountains, the sparkling Kinko Bay, and hot springs, along with Aira, which is centrally located in Kagoshima and has streets blended with cultural historical sites.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】霧島連山を背景に豊かに流れ出す川沿いの風景を楽しむ！川内川（せんだいがわ）流域ルートver2
description: 吉松駅をスタートし、川内川沿いに高速船ターミナル（川内港）へ向かって走るルート。随所に溢れだす湧水池、東洋のナイアガラと呼ばれるダイナミックな曽木の滝、夏の風物詩の「ほたる」、東シナ海につながる河口まで川沿いに楽しみます。霧島山系の豊富な水に支えられる稲穂の田園、銘茶を産出する茶畑の風景がどこまでも広がります。

title: Kagoshima Cycle Tourism: Enjoy the Scenic Views Along the Sendai River with the Kirishima Mountain Range in the Background! Sendai River Basin Route ver2
description: Starting from Yoshimatsu Station, this route runs along the Sendai River towards the high-speed boat terminal (Sendai Port). Enjoy the abundant spring water pools, the dynamic Sogi Falls known as the Niagara of the East, the summer tradition of 'fireflies', and the river leading to the estuary connected to the East China Sea. The landscape of rice fields supported by the rich waters of the Kirishima mountain range and tea fields producing fine tea stretches endlessly.

title: 世界自然遺産　奄美大島
description: 2021年7月に世界自然遺産に登録された奄美大島。鹿児島県は「屋久島」と合わせて２つの世界自然遺産を有する唯一の都道府県となりました。世界レベルの手つかずの自然風景が連続し、訪れる人を癒します。

title: World Natural Heritage Amami Oshima
description: Amami Oshima was registered as a World Natural Heritage site in July 2021. Kagoshima Prefecture is the only prefecture in Japan to have two World Natural Heritage sites, along with Yakushima. The world-class untouched natural scenery continues to heal visitors.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】癒やしの自然で深呼吸！屋久島ルートをサイクリング！
description:
その豊かな自然が世界からも注目を集めている屋久島。原生林が生い茂るマイナスイオンの森に生命力を感じたり、野生のヤクシカ・ヤクシマザルとひょっこり出合ったり。ここでしかできない貴重な体験があなたを待っています。

#鹿児島 #サイクリング

title: [Kagoshima Cycle Tourism] Breathe Deeply in the Healing Nature! Cycling the Yakushima Route!
description: Yakushima, with its rich nature, is attracting attention from around the world. Feel the vitality in the negative ion forest of primeval forests, and you might unexpectedly encounter wild Yakushima deer and Yakushima macaques. A unique experience that can only be had here is waiting for you.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】宇宙を身近に感じる！種子島ルートをサイクリング！
description:
種子島ルートでは、宇宙をより身近に感じられるエリアがあったり、南の島らしいサトウキビ畑が両側に広がる風景を見ながらサイクルできたりと、美しい海を臨むアイランドロードを存分に楽しめます。種子島の豊かな自然を満喫できるサーフィンやヨガなどのアクティビティも、一緒に体験してみてはいかがでしょうか。

title: [Kagoshima Cycle Tourism] Feel Closer to Space! Cycling the Tanegashima Route!
description: The Tanegashima Route offers areas where you can feel closer to space, and you can cycle while enjoying the scenery of sugarcane fields typical of southern islands on both sides, fully experiencing the island road with beautiful views of the sea. How about also trying activities like surfing and yoga to enjoy the rich nature of Tanegashima?

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】歴史ロマンあふれる！甑島ルートをサイクリング！
description: 上甑島・中甑島・下甑島といちき串木野市を周遊するルート。サイクリングの醍醐味である、橋を渡る爽快感を存分に味わうことができます。古くは8000万年前の地層が残る甑島の断崖、日本遺産に認定された、薩摩の武士が生きた町～武家屋敷群「麓」を歩く～の構成資産「里麓」「手打麓」、日本の近代化に貢献した薩摩スチューデントに学ぶ「薩摩藩英国留学生記念館」など、歴史ロマンあふれる旅をぜひ。

title: Koshikijima Route: A Cycling Adventure Full of Historical Romance!
description: A route that circles around Kamikoshikijima, Nakakoshikijima, and Shimonoshikijima, as well as Ichiki-Kushikino City. You can fully enjoy the refreshing feeling of crossing bridges, which is one of the delights of cycling. Experience a journey full of historical romance, including the cliffs of Koshikijima, which retain geological layers from 80 million years ago, and the historical sites recognized as a Japanese heritage, such as the samurai town where Satsuma warriors lived - the samurai residence group 'Roku', and the 'Satsuma Domain British Student Memorial Hall' that learned from the Satsuma students who contributed to Japan's modernization.

title: 【かごしまサイクルツーリズム】日本の原風景を走る！北薩ルートをサイクリング！
description:
熊本県との県境に位置する北薩は、懐かしい里山の風景や風光明媚な温泉が楽しめる場所。白い砂浜が続く美しい海岸線では、東シナ海に沈むオレンジ色の夕日に癒されます。海の幸山の幸が豊かな北薩地域のご当地グルメも楽しみのひとつ！

The beautiful coastline with its white sandy beaches offers a soothing view of the orange sunset sinking into the East China Sea. One of the highlights is enjoying the local gourmet food from the North Satsuma region, rich in both seafood and mountain delicacies!

果肉も緻密で雪のように白いことから、漬け物、煮物、デザートなど、幅広い用途に使うことができるんです！

今回は、食素材研究会の生徒たちが、生産者から贈られた｢桜島大根｣を使って、オリジナルレシピを考案。出来上がった料理を生産者さんに届けるまでを描く心温まるストーリーです。

title: 【Vol.6】Kibare Kagoshima Project - Energizing Kagoshima with Young Power - Sakurajima Daikon × Kagoshima Women's Junior College
description:
The 6th edition of the Kibare Kagoshima Project was created in collaboration with the Food Material Research Club of Kagoshima Women's Junior College, which aims to widely promote the charm of local ingredients, and local influencer Kaisei Nakamura, a university student active in the prefecture!

This time, we introduce the 'Sakurajima Daikon,' which has been recognized by Guinness as the heaviest radish in the world (waist circumference 119 cm, weight 31.1 kg)!!

The characteristics of Sakurajima Daikon are...
It is resistant to breaking down when boiled, absorbs flavors easily, and has a sweetness.
Its flesh is dense and as white as snow, making it suitable for a wide range of uses, including pickles, boiled dishes, and desserts!

This time, the students of the Food Material Research Club devised original recipes using the 'Sakurajima Daikon' gifted by producers. It is a heartwarming story depicting the process of delivering the completed dishes to the producers.

title: 【Vol.5】キバレかごしまプロジェクト～若い力で鹿児島を元気に～薩摩焼×鹿児島情報高校！！
description:
今回のキバレかごしまプロジェクト動画第5弾は，県内事業者を応援することを目的に，高校生の目線で鹿児島の魅力をＳＮＳにより発信する鹿児島情報高校「鹿児島盛り上げ隊」やローカルインフルエンサーとして活躍する県内の大学生（中村海晟さん）と連携し，制作しました。

今回ご紹介するのは，国の伝統的工芸品にも指定されている「薩摩焼」。豊臣秀吉公の命を受け文禄・慶長の役に出陣した島津義弘公が，朝鮮半島から陶工を連れ帰ったことが起源といわれています。

白薩摩は薩摩藩の管理の基に生産され，黒薩摩は、庶民のための器として自由に作られ庶民の日常使いの器として用いられました。

420年以上にわたる伝統を基礎に，常に新しい作品が生み出されています。薩摩焼の工程は，陶土作り→土練り→成形→乾燥→素焼→釉薬がけ→本焼→上絵つけ→上焼き→焼きあがり，とありますが，今回は，高校生の皆さんが，白薩摩の小物に絵付け体験をしました。

鹿児島伝統の技を薩摩焼の職人さんから学び，高校生がそれぞれに思いを込めながら作品を制作する様子を，中村さんが大学生ならではの目線で切り取り，仕上げてくれた渾身の動画となっています。ぜひ，ご覧ください。

title: 【Vol.5】Kibare Kagoshima Project - Energizing Kagoshima with Young Power - Satsuma Ware × Kagoshima Information High School!!
description:
The fifth installment of the Kibare Kagoshima Project video aims to support local businesses by showcasing the charm of Kagoshima from the perspective of high school students through social media. It was produced in collaboration with the Kagoshima Information High School's 'Kagoshima Cheer Squad' and local influencer Kaisei Nakamura from a university.

This time, we introduce 'Satsuma Ware,' which is designated as a traditional craft of the country. It is said to have originated when Yoshihiro Shimazu, under the orders of Toyotomi Hideyoshi, brought back potters from the Korean Peninsula during the Bunroku and Keicho campaigns.

Shiro-Satsuma was produced under the management of the Satsuma domain, while Kuro-Satsuma was freely made for the common people and used as everyday utensils.

Based on over 420 years of tradition, new works are constantly being created. The process of Satsuma Ware includes clay preparation, kneading, shaping, drying, bisque firing, glazing, main firing, painting, second firing, and completion. This time, high school students experienced painting on Shiro-Satsuma small items.

Learning the traditional techniques of Kagoshima from Satsuma Ware artisans, the students created their works with their own thoughts and feelings, captured by Nakamura from a university student's perspective, resulting in a heartfelt video. Please take a look.

今回のキバレかごしまプロジェクト動画第４弾は，県内事業者を応援することを目的に，高校生の目線で鹿児島の魅力をＳＮＳにより発信する鹿児島情報高校「鹿児島盛り上げ隊」やローカルインフルエンサーとして活躍する県内の大学生（中村海晟さん）と連携し，制作しました。

今回ご紹介するのは，国の伝統的工芸品にも指定されている「川辺仏壇」。南九州市川辺町の川辺仏壇は，豪華さと堅牢さとあわせもつ仏壇として定評があります。

木地，宮殿，彫刻，金具，蒔絵，塗り，仕上げという７工程に分類され，ほとんどが手作業で行われます。この素晴らしい技術を後世に残すために，仏壇制作の他に７工程の技術を活かした様々な製品が日々試行錯誤の上，生み出されています。

高校生の皆さんが，川辺仏壇７工程のうち，“蒔絵”の技術を使ったアクセサリー作りを行いました！鹿児島伝統の技を川辺仏壇の職人さんから学び，高校生らしいアート作品を生み出す様子を，中村さんが大学生ならではの目線で切り取り，仕上げてくれた渾身の動画となっています。ぜひ，ご覧ください。

title: 【Vol.4】Kibare Kagoshima Project - Energizing Kagoshima with Young Power - Kawanabe Butsudan x Kagoshima Joho High School!!
description:
This is the fourth video of the Kibare Kagoshima Project, created in collaboration with the Kagoshima Joho High School 'Kagoshima Morigae Team', which aims to promote the charm of Kagoshima from the perspective of high school students through social media, and local influencer Kaisei Nakamura, a university student active in the prefecture.

This time, we introduce 'Kawanabe Butsudan', designated as a traditional craft of the country. Kawanabe Butsudan in Kawabe Town, Minamikyushu City, is known for its luxurious and sturdy altars.

It is classified into seven processes: woodwork, palace, carving, metal fittings, maki-e, painting, and finishing, most of which are done by hand. To preserve this wonderful technique for future generations, various products utilizing the skills of the seven processes are being created daily through trial and error, in addition to altar production.

High school students created accessories using the 'maki-e' technique from the seven processes of Kawanabe Butsudan! They learned the traditional techniques of Kagoshima from the craftsmen of Kawanabe Butsudan and created art pieces characteristic of high school students, which Nakamura captured from a university student's perspective, resulting in a heartfelt video. Please take a look.

title: 美食編【どんどん味わいたくなる　かごしまのグルメ】
description: 農業＆畜産王国の鹿児島県は，安心・安全，ヘルシーで美味しいバラエティ豊かな食材の宝庫です。動画では，鹿児島出身のスポーツキャスターで、薩摩大使も務める、宮下純一氏が，鶏の旨味と醤油の甘味を味わうことができる鳥刺しと焼酎の無限ループで，鹿児島を代表するグルメを思う存分味わう模様を描き、鹿児島の食材の魅力を伝えています。温暖な気候で育まれた鹿児島のグルメをたくさん味わって，心も身体も健康になりましょう！

title: Gourmet Edition: Kagoshima's Cuisine That Makes You Want to Taste More
description: Kagoshima Prefecture, an agricultural and livestock kingdom, is a treasure trove of safe, healthy, and deliciously diverse ingredients. In the video, Junichi Miyashita, a sports caster from Kagoshima and also a Satsuma ambassador, showcases the experience of savoring Kagoshima's representative gourmet dishes, including chicken sashimi that allows you to enjoy the umami of chicken and the sweetness of soy sauce, along with an endless loop of shochu. Let's indulge in the deliciousness of Kagoshima's cuisine, nurtured by its warm climate, and become healthy in both mind and body!

title: 温泉編【どんどん癒されたくなる　かごしまの温泉】
description: 鹿児島県は100の温泉地があり，温泉の源泉数は2700カ所以上の全国2位，1日に2億2,500万リットル以上もの温泉が湧出する全国屈指の温泉王国です。世界的にも珍しい砂むし温泉のほか，県内各地に魅力的な温泉がたくさんあり，様々な泉質を楽しむことができるのも鹿児島の温泉の特徴です。動画では，鹿児島出身のスポーツキャスターで、薩摩大使も務める宮下純一氏が霧島温泉郷で癒されている模様を描き，鹿児島の温泉の魅力を伝えています。鹿児島の温泉でゆっくりして、心も身体も健康になりましょう！

title: Onsen Edition: The More You Want to Heal, the More You’ll Love Kagoshima's Hot Springs
description: Kagoshima Prefecture has 100 hot spring areas, ranking second in the nation with over 2,700 hot spring sources. It boasts one of the top hot spring kingdoms in Japan, with more than 225 million liters of hot spring water gushing out daily. In addition to the rare sand bath hot springs, there are many attractive hot springs throughout the prefecture, allowing visitors to enjoy a variety of water qualities, which is a characteristic of Kagoshima's hot springs. The video features Junichi Miyashita, a sports caster from Kagoshima and also an ambassador for Satsuma, as he experiences relaxation in the Kirishima hot spring area, conveying the charm of Kagoshima's hot springs. Let's take a break in Kagoshima's hot springs and become healthy in both mind and body!

title: 絶景編【どんどん行きたくなる　かごしまの絶景】
description: 鹿児島県には豊かな自然がいっぱいです。動画では、その一つである，佐多岬公園の絶景を鹿児島出身のスポーツキャスターで、薩摩大使も務める、宮下純一氏が紹介します。紺碧の大海原の先には日本最古の灯台，屋久島や種子島をはじめとした離島も見渡すことができます。そのほかにも，一度足を運ぶだけでは回り切れないほどの絶景ポイントが盛りだくさんです。鹿児島の景勝地をウォーキングして，心も身体も健康になりましょう！

title: Scenic Edition: The Breathtaking Views of Kagoshima That Make You Want to Go
description: Kagoshima Prefecture, stretching 600 kilometers from north to south, is full of rich nature. In the video, Junichi Miyashita, a sports caster from Kagoshima and also the Satsuma ambassador, introduces the breathtaking views of Sata Misaki Park, one of them. Beyond the deep blue ocean, you can see Japan's oldest lighthouse and the islands of Yakushima and Tanegashima. There are many scenic spots that you can't fully explore in just one visit. Let's walk through Kagoshima's scenic areas to become healthy in both mind and body!

By welcoming one group a day with the catchphrase 'If you stay once, you will be a distant relative, if you stay ten times, you will be a true relative.' It deepens the exchange of hearts and makes you want to come back again. Why don't you experience 'NOUHAKU' in the slow nature, space and time of the countryside?

description: 農泊とは、農村民泊の略称であり、グリーンツーリズムの中心を成すものです。農泊発祥の地である宇佐市安心院町では他では味わえない体験や、ここにしかない景色がたくさんあり、日本全国から教育旅行や修学旅行として、農泊体験に訪れております。「一回泊まれば遠い親戚、十回泊まれば本当の親戚」をキャッチフレーズにまごころ込めて１日１組をお迎えし、受け入れ家庭と一緒に過ごしながら、家庭のあたたかさや人のやさしさに触れることで、また帰ってきたいと思える大きな感動を呼んでいます。田舎のゆっくりとした自然・空間・時間の中で農泊を体験してみてはいかがでしょうか？

title: First Agricultural Stay (Educational Travel Edition) [~ Birthplace of Agricultural Stay ~ Usa City, Oita Prefecture]
description: Agricultural stay is an abbreviation for rural lodging and is at the center of green tourism. In Usa City, Ajimu Town, the birthplace of agricultural stays, there are many experiences and unique landscapes that cannot be found elsewhere, attracting educational trips and school excursions from all over Japan. With the catchphrase 'Stay once and you become a distant relative, stay ten times and you become a true relative,' we warmly welcome one group per day, allowing guests to spend time with host families and experience the warmth of family and kindness of people, creating a great emotion that makes them want to return. How about experiencing agricultural stays in the slow nature, space, and time of the countryside?

title: 「４大グルメ美力のまち」大分県宇佐市～女子旅編～
description: 大分県宇佐市には美味しいグルメがたくさんありますが、なかでも特におすすめしたい4つのグルメがあります。それは、「宇佐からあげ」、「大分味一ねぎ」、「安心院すっぽん」、「宇佐どじょう」です。美味しいことはもちろん、ヘルシーで美肌に嬉しい栄養素がたっぷりなので、女性には特におすすめです！宇佐グルメのおかげで昔から宇佐市に美人が多いと言われているとかいないとか・・・

title: 「4 Major Gourmet Towns」Usa City, Oita Prefecture - Women's Travel Edition
description: Usa City in Oita Prefecture has a lot of delicious gourmet food, but there are four dishes that I particularly recommend. They are 'Usa Karaage', 'Oita Ajiichi Negi', 'Anshin-in Suppon', and 'Usa Dojo'. Not only are they delicious, but they are also healthy and packed with nutrients that are great for beautiful skin, making them especially recommended for women! It is said that thanks to Usa gourmet, there have been many beauties in Usa City since ancient times...

title: 宇佐市お花見(Usa city Cherry Blossom Viewing)
description: 宇佐市のお花見スポットの映像をお届けします。外出が限られる状況が続く中、お家でお花見気分を満喫してみませんか？肉眼では見ることのできないドローンによる映像もお楽しみください。新型コロナウイルス感染症により油断できない状況が続いていますが、皆さんで協力して感染防止の取り組みを続けていきましょう。

title: Usa city Cherry Blossom Viewing
description: We deliver videos of cherry blossom viewing spots in Usa City. In a situation where going out is limited, why not enjoy the cherry blossom feeling at home? Enjoy drone footage that cannot be seen with the naked eye. Although the situation remains precarious due to the COVID-19 pandemic, let’s continue our efforts to prevent infection together.

title: うさからくんと宇佐からあげの出会い
description: うさからくんはからあげのかぶりものを被っているニワトリの男の子です。うさからくんが「ようこそ宇佐市へ」のサインボードを持ってガイドをしています。休憩時間になり、休んでいると、“サクサク”っとからあげを食べている音が聞こえてきました。周りを見てみると、みんなからあげを食べています。うさからくんは不可解な思いをしました。そうしていると、近くの子どもがからあげをくれました。実はうさからくんはからあげが苦手です。でもその子どもがとてもかわいくて断れなくなり、ついもらってしまいました。しかし食べてみると、とてもおいしくて感動しました。それからうさからくんは大好きな『宇佐からあげ』を世界中の人たちに食べてもらうためにがんばってPRをしています。

title: Usakara-kun and the Encounter with Usa Karaage
description: Usakara-kun is a boy chicken wearing a karaage costume. He is guiding with a signboard that says 'Welcome to Usa City.' During a break, he heard the sound of 'saku saku' from someone eating karaage. When he looked around, everyone was eating karaage. Usakara-kun felt puzzled. Then, a nearby child gave him some karaage. Actually, Usakara-kun is not good at eating karaage. But the child was so cute that he couldn't refuse and ended up accepting it. However, when he tried it, he was very impressed by how delicious it was. Since then, Usakara-kun has been working hard to promote his favorite 'Usa Karaage' so that people all over the world can taste it.

title: "A day in Usa City" (宇佐市の一日)　　※APUの学生団体「Shutter」の撮影によるもの
description: 宇佐市の楽しいところを知っていますか？皆さんの想像以上に楽しいところがたくさんあります！息を飲むほど美しい景色から、イチゴやブドウなどフルーツもたくさん！「見て、感じて、好きになって」さあ、宇佐市で特別な一日を過ごしてみませんか？

title: A day in Usa City
description: Wondering how to enjoy a day in Usa City? Don't worry because there are more than meets the eye. From the breathtaking scenery to picking strawberries, you name it. Enjoy the unique experience in Usa City. "See it, feel it, love it"

title: 東椎屋の滝
description:
日本の滝百選に選ばれた東椎屋の滝は、日光華厳の滝に似ているところから、「九州華厳」と称されています。高さ85mの断崖を落下する様は圧巻でマイナスイオンもいっぱいです。
　また、高貴端麗な名瀑で、滝つぼから流れ出る清流の渓谷、渓流の見事さもこの滝の特色です。清水に新緑の映える春、紅葉の秋ともに素晴らしい景観を誇っています。

title: Higashi Shiuya Falls
description:
Higashi Shiuya Falls, selected as one of Japan's top 100 waterfalls, is referred to as 'Kyushu Kegon' due to its resemblance to Kegon Falls in Nikko. The sight of the water cascading down the 85-meter cliff is breathtaking, and it is filled with negative ions.
Additionally, it is a noble and beautiful waterfall, characterized by the clear stream flowing from the waterfall basin and the stunning beauty of the mountain stream. It boasts wonderful scenery in both spring, when the fresh greenery shines in the clear water, and autumn, when the leaves change color.

title: 千財バラ園
description: 四日市ＩＣを下り、本耶馬溪に抜ける樋田四日市線に入るとすぐに小倉池があり、その周囲を望む丘陵地の茶畑が千財農園です。ゴールデンウィークに見頃を迎えたフジの花につづき、本年より新たにバラ園がオープンしました。見頃を迎えた約２，０００本のバラが色鮮やかに咲き誇り、５，０００平方メートルの広大な敷地が気品ある香りに囲まれています。

title: Chizai Rose Garden
description: As you exit the Yokkaichi IC and enter the Hida Yokkaichi Line leading to the Hon-Yabakei, you will soon find Ogura Pond, surrounded by hilly tea fields of Chizai Farm. Following the wisteria flowers that reached their peak during the Golden Week, a new rose garden has opened this year. About 2,000 roses are in full bloom, filling the vast 5,000 square meters with their elegant fragrance.

title: 長洲神社葵祭り
description:
長洲葵祭りは、毎年5月3日～5日まで行われる、長洲地区加茂神社のお祭りで、山の幸と海の幸の祭りです。
期間中は、コンコンチキリン♪の太鼓や笛の音にあわせて山車が長洲の町を練り歩きます。
宝暦11年(1761)豊前の国に疫病が起こり、それを鎮めるため、踊車として山車を奉納したのが起源とされています。
全盛期には、７基の山車があったそうで、現在は近年復活した「大西車組」と江戸時代からの伝統を受け継ぐ「上町車組」が山車２基を引き回し、無病息災や五穀豊穣を願います。

title: Nagasu Shrine Aoi Festival
description:
The Nagasu Aoi Festival is held every year from May 3rd to 5th at the Kamo Shrine in the Nagasu area, celebrating the blessings of the mountains and the sea.
During the festival, floats parade through the town of Nagasu to the sounds of drums and flutes playing 'Konkontikirin♪'.
The origin of the festival dates back to the 11th year of the Horeki era (1761), when a plague occurred in the Buzen province, and floats were dedicated as a form of dance to appease the spirits.
At its peak, there were said to be seven floats, and currently, two floats are pulled by the 'Onishi Float Group', which was revived in recent years, and the 'Uemachi Float Group', which carries on the traditions from the Edo period, wishing for good health and bountiful harvests.

title: 世界かんがい施設遺産 宇佐のかんがい用水群(平田井路・広瀬井路） World Heritage Certification of Irrigationthe Usa Irrigation system
description: モロッコにて令和３年11 月26 日に開催された第72 回国際かんがい排水委員会理事会で「宇佐のかんがい用水群（平田井路・広瀬井路）」が世界かんがい施設遺産に登録されました。市と宇佐土地改良区が共同で申請したもので、国内では44 番目、大分県内では初の登録となります。国際機関での登録認定となり、今までの施設の保全だけでなく、地域振興や情報発信に役立てていきます。今後、2つのかんがいシステムの検証を続けながら、地域活動に積極的に関与し、観光資源や教育資源として活用・発展させていきます。

title: World Heritage Certification of Irrigation the Usa Irrigation system
description: On November 26, 2022, the Usa Irrigation system (Hirata Irrigation System & Hirose Irrigation System) was registered and certified as a World Heritage Irrigation Structure at the International Commission on Irrigation & Drainage’s 72nd International Executive Council (IEC) meeting, held in Marrakesh, Morocco. In the future, while continuing to verify the two irrigation systems, we will actively engage in local activities and utilize and develop them as tourism resources and educational resources.

description:
宇佐高等学校では、総合的な探求の時間において、これからの時代に求められる創造力を生かした課題解決の手法「デザインシンキング」について学んでおり、その一環としてショート動画の制作が行われました。

description:

Among the various videos that convey the charm of Usa City and Usa High School, there are some related to Ichirohei Minami. They received materials from the NHK morning drama 'Ichirohei Minami Promotion Council' and learned about the history of Usa while producing the videos.
It has turned out to be a very enjoyable video, so please take a look!

title: 足湯めぐり
description: 白浜町内にあります足湯を思う存分堪能してください！足先から体を癒やして下さい！

title: Foot Bath Tour
description: Please enjoy the foot baths located in Shirahama Town to your heart's content! Heal your body from your feet!

title: 崎の湯
description: 万葉の昔から「湯崎七湯」の中で唯一残っている歴史ある湯壷で、雄大な太平洋が間近にせまる露天風呂です。湯船から海はほぼ一体、岩に打ち寄せる波を感じながら入浴できます。温泉にたちこめる、硫黄と潮の香り、波の音、太平洋をゆっくりと渡る船・・・お湯だけでなく、大自然にどっぷり浸かった開放感にひたれます。

title: Saki no Yu
description: This is a historic hot spring that has remained since ancient times as one of the 'Yuzaki Seven Springs', featuring an open-air bath close to the majestic Pacific Ocean. You can feel the waves crashing against the rocks while bathing in the almost unified sea from the hot spring. The scent of sulfur and sea, the sound of waves, and ships slowly crossing the Pacific... You can immerse yourself not only in the hot water but also in the liberating feeling of being surrounded by nature.

title: 白浜温泉 献湯祭＜お湯の恵みに感謝する＞
description:
町内に源泉を持つ温泉会社8社と町の観光関係者が
朝一番に源泉からくみ上げた「一番湯」を入れた樽を担いで温泉街を練り歩き、山神社に移動します。神社では、巫女から神職へと順番に手渡して神社に奉納する神事を行います。

令和６年度の第38回献湯祭では
奈良時代の衣装を参加希望者が着て行列が行われます。
衣装を身にまとって白浜温泉街から山神社まで歩きます。
神事の最後には和歌山名物「餅まき」もあります。地元のお祭りに参加することは、その地域の文化をより深く理解し、地元の人々とのつながりを感じる素晴らしい機会となります。

#南紀白浜  #白浜観光  #白浜観光  #献湯祭 #温泉

title: Shirahama Onsen Kentyōsai <A Celebration of Gratitude for the Blessings of Hot Springs>
description:
Eight hot spring companies with their own sources in the town and local tourism officials
will carry a barrel filled with the "first hot spring water" drawn from the source early in the morning
and parade through the hot spring town to Yamajinja Shrine. At the shrine, a ritual will be conducted
where the water is handed over in turn from the shrine maidens to the priests for dedication.

In the 38th Kentyōsai of the 6th year of Reiwa,
participants wishing to join will wear costumes from the Nara period and form a procession.
They will walk from Shirahama Onsen town to Yamajinja Shrine in their costumes.
At the end of the ritual, there will also be a traditional "mochi-maki" (rice cake throwing),
a local specialty of Wakayama. Participating in this local festival is a wonderful opportunity
to gain a deeper understanding of the region's culture and feel a connection with the local people.

#NankiShirahama  #ShirahamaTourism  #ShirahamaTourism  #Kentyōsai #Onsen

title: くえ料理
description: クエは本州中部以南に生息するハタ科の魚で、成魚は1m、30～50kgにもなります。荒磯を悠然と泳ぐ孤高の巨大魚であり、水揚げが少なく「幻の魚」と呼ばれており、そのグロテスクな見かけとは違い、脂の乗った美しい白身は、上品で深みのある味わい。ゼラチン質がたっぷり含まれた皮やアラの味は一度食べると忘れられない味と言われています。

title: Kue Cuisine
description: Kue is a fish belonging to the grouper family that inhabits the area from central Honshu to the south, with adults reaching up to 1 meter and weighing 30 to 50 kg. It is a solitary giant fish that swims gracefully in rocky shores and is called the 'phantom fish' due to its low catch rate. Contrary to its grotesque appearance, its beautifully fatty white flesh has a refined and deep flavor. The taste of its gelatinous skin and bones is said to be unforgettable once tasted.

title: フィッシャーマンズワーフ白浜
description:
地元の漁師の方々が運営する施設です。１階が鮮魚市場で２階がレストラン、屋上には季節限定のビアガーデンがあります。
併設した桟橋から直接水揚げされた新鮮な食材を、ふんだんに使用した和食とイタリアンを堪能ください。

title: Fisherman's Wharf Shirahama
description:
This facility is operated by local fishermen. The first floor is a fresh fish market, and the second floor is a restaurant, with a seasonal beer garden on the rooftop.
Please enjoy Japanese and Italian cuisine that makes abundant use of fresh ingredients directly landed from the pier attached to the facility.

title: とれとれ市場 後編
description: 西日本最大級の海鮮マーケット「とれとれ市場」！！日本全国の新鮮なお魚をその場で食べたり、和歌山のお土産をショッピングしたり、楽しいBBQコーナーまで盛りだくさん！たった一日では回りきれない、大満足な市場です。

title: Toretore Market Part 2
description: The largest seafood market in western Japan, 'Toretore Market'!! You can eat fresh fish from all over Japan on the spot, shop for souvenirs from Wakayama, and enjoy a fun BBQ corner! It's a market that you can't fully explore in just one day, and it's very satisfying.

title: とれとれ市場 前編
description: 西日本最大級の海鮮マーケット「とれとれ市場」！日本全国の新鮮なお魚をその場で食べたり、和歌山のお土産をショッピングしたり、楽しいBBQコーナーまで盛りだくさん！たった一日では回りきれない、大満足な市場です。

title: Toretore Market Part 1
description: The largest seafood market in western Japan, 'Toretore Market'! You can eat fresh fish from all over Japan on the spot, shop for souvenirs from Wakayama, and enjoy a fun BBQ corner! It's a market that you can't fully explore in just one day, providing great satisfaction.

title: ウツボ料理
description: 「うつぼ」は、グロテスクな顔形と小骨が多いため、一般的にはなじみが薄い魚です。しかしその美しい白身は癖がなく淡白で、表皮にはゼラチン質やコラーゲンが多く、料理して良べると「これがうつぼか！」と皆が疑うほどの美味であります。うす造り、タタキ、しゃぶしゃぶ鍋、すき焼き、唐揚げ、照焼き等と料理方法も豊富。

title: Eel Cuisine
description: The eel, with its grotesque face and many small bones, is generally not well-known. However, its beautiful white flesh is mild and bland, and the skin is rich in gelatin and collagen, making it so delicious that when cooked, everyone doubts, 'Is this really eel?' There are many cooking methods such as sashimi, tataki, shabu-shabu, sukiyaki, fried, and teriyaki.

title: マグロ解体ショー　フィッシャーマンズワーフ白浜
description: 南紀白浜にあります、漁師直営海鮮市場フィッシャーマンズワーフ白浜にて開催されました『冬のお魚祭り The まぐろ』でまぐろの解体ショーが行なわれました！この至近距離から見る解体ショーはとても迫力があります！フィッシャーマンズワーフ白浜では季節ごとにお魚祭りを開催しています！施設の情報やイベント情報等はこちらのホームページをご覧ください！フィッシャーマンズワーフ白浜HP https://fw-sh.com/ #南紀白浜 #イベント #お魚祭り #フィッシャーズマンズワーフ白浜 #まぐろ #まぐろ解体ショー

title: Maguro Dismantling Show at Fisherman's Wharf Shirahama
description: The 'Winter Fish Festival The Maguro' was held at the Fisherman's Wharf Shirahama, a seafood market directly operated by fishermen located in Nanki Shirahama, where a tuna dismantling show took place! The dismantling show viewed from such a close distance is very powerful! Fisherman's Wharf Shirahama holds fish festivals every season! For facility information and event details, please visit the website! Fisherman's Wharf Shirahama HP https://fw-sh.com/ #NankiShirahama #Event #FishFestival #FishermansWharfShirahama #Tuna #TunaDismantlingShow

title: 円月島
description: 白浜のシンボルとして親しまれている円月島。正式には「高嶋」といい、臨海浦の南海上に浮かぶ南北130m、東西35m、高さ25mの小島ですが、島の中央に円月形の海蝕洞がぽっかり空いていることから「円月島」と呼ばれ親しまれています。円月島に沈む夕陽は「日本の夕陽１００選」に選ばれており、陽の沈む夕景の美しさは格別で、夏は6時30分頃、冬は4時30分頃。

title: Engetsu Island
description: Engetsu Island, known as a symbol of Shirahama, is officially called 'Takahima'. It is a small island floating in the southern sea of Rinkaiura, measuring 130m north-south, 35m east-west, and 25m high. It is affectionately called 'Engetsu Island' because of the circular sea erosion cave in the center of the island. The sunset over Engetsu Island has been selected as one of the '100 Best Sunsets in Japan', and the beauty of the sunset is exceptional, occurring around 6:30 PM in summer and 4:30 PM in winter.

title: 白良浜
description: 延長620mの遠浅の浜。９０％の珪酸を含む石英砂は、文字通り真っ白でサラサラの砂。夏にはカラフルなパラソルが咲きみだれ、弧を描く浜辺にそって並ぶ椰子の葉パラソルが、トロピカルムードをより一層盛り上げています。

title: Shirarahama
description: A 620m long shallow beach. The quartz sand, which contains 90% silica, is literally pure white and fine. In summer, colorful parasols bloom, and palm leaf parasols lined along the arc-shaped beach enhance the tropical mood even more.

title: 千畳敷
description: Senjōjikiは、その名のとおり広い岩畳を思わせる大岩盤。瀬戸崎の先端から太平洋に向けて突きだしたスロープ状になった白く柔らかい岩は第3紀層の砂岩からなる大岩盤で、打ち寄せる荒波に浸食され壮大な景観を創っています。

title: Senjōjiki
description: Senjōjiki, as its name suggests, is a large rock formation reminiscent of a wide rock pavement. The white, soft rocks that slope out towards the Pacific Ocean from the tip of Setozaki are a large rock formation made of Tertiary sandstone, sculpted by the crashing waves into a magnificent landscape.

title: 三段壁
description: 千畳敷の南海岸にそそり立つ高さ50m～60mの断崖。その昔、漁師たちが通りゆく船や魚の群れを見張った場所「見壇」に由来するといわれるこの大岩壁は、南北2kmにわたって展開され、岩肌に打ち寄せる黒潮が激しくぶつかり合うダイナミックな光景には、自然の迫力を感じずにいられません。2016年4月、恋人の聖地｢南紀白浜/三段壁｣として選定されました。

title: Sandanbaku
description: A cliff standing 50m to 60m high on the southern coast of Senjojiki. It is said to derive from the place 'Midan' where fishermen once watched over passing ships and schools of fish. This massive rock wall extends for 2 km north and south, and the dynamic sight of the Kuroshio crashing against the rock face is truly awe-inspiring. In April 2016, it was designated as a 'Sacred Place for Lovers' in Nanki Shirahama/Sandanbaku.

title: 南紀白浜　日本の滝１００選　八草の滝
description:
日置川中流の山腹に２２メートルの高さから七色の飛沫をあげて流れ落ちる美しい滝です。

新緑に包まれた初夏は最も美しい見ごろとなります！
雨量によって滝の流水量が変わるため幻の滝とも呼ばれています！

撮影日が雨が少なく、滝の流水量が少ないタイミングでした。
また、流水量が多いタイミングの際にあらためて紹介したいと思います。

title: Nanki Shirahama: Selected as one of Japan's 100 Waterfalls - Yagusa Falls
description: This beautiful waterfall flows down from a height of 22 meters, creating a rainbow of spray in the midstream of the Hioki River in Nanki Shirahama. The early summer, wrapped in fresh greenery, is the most beautiful time to visit! Due to varying rainfall, the flow of the waterfall changes, earning it the nickname 'phantom waterfall.' title: 静岡県浜松市 プロモーション動画　Hamamatsucity Promotion Video
description:
Thank you for Watching !!
Music: Tobu - Cruel
http://youtube.com/tobuofficial
ーーー
　Follow Me  My account
　Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/shunpei.backpacker/?hl=ja
　twitter : https://twitter.com/shunpeikawai
ーーー
浜松の魅力を1分半で作成しました
同時に1ヶ月間の浜松の素晴らしさを発信するプロジェクトも終了しました
改めて浜松が素晴らしい場所だと実感することができました
自然が多くて人も暖かくてとても住みやすい街です
.
このプロジェクトを通して一番の変化は日本の素晴らしさをもっと知りたい
そして世界の人に伝えたいと思う気持ちが強くなりました
今年の7月に2.3ヶ月かけて自転車で日本縦断をします
その際に日本の素晴らしさを発信するために映像作成しながら縦断することに決めました
.
旅を始めてから色々なことに挑戦してきました
その中で多くの方からありがたいことに「舜平を見ていると勇気を貰える」と言っていただけます
自分が面白いと思って挑戦していることが誰かの挑戦する1歩目を踏み出すきっかけになっていると思うと自分はとても嬉しいです
「後悔なき生き方を」
僕が大切にしている言葉です
しかし僕だけでなく全世界の人が後悔のない生き方を送れるように僕の挑戦を写真や動画を通して発信します
そして僕を見て挑戦しようと思っていただけたら僕はとても幸せです
.
日本縦断前の6月にクラウドファンディングにも挑戦します
少しでも応援していただけたらありがたいです🙏
.
この動画を気軽にシェアしてください！
そしてより一層多くの方に浜松の魅力を知っていただけたら僕はこのプロジェクトを心からやってよかったと思うことができます！
気軽にコメントやアドバイスなども待っています😆
.
最後まで読んでくださりありがとうございます！
来月からまた面白い旅を再開します
5月は自転車で琵琶湖一周と自転車で四国一周します
是非楽しみにしていてください！

title: Hamamatsu City Promotion Video
description:
Thank you for Watching !!
Music: Tobu - Cruel

ーーー
　Follow Me  My account

　twitter : https://twitter.com/shunpeikawai
ーーー
I created the charm of Hamamatsu in one and a half minutes.
At the same time, the project to promote the wonderfulness of Hamamatsu for a month has also ended.
I was able to realize once again that Hamamatsu is a wonderful place.
It is a city with a lot of nature, warm people, and is very easy to live in.
.
The biggest change through this project is that I have a stronger desire to know more about the wonders of Japan
and to convey that to people around the world.
In July of this year, I will cycle across Japan over 2-3 months.
During that time, I decided to create videos to promote the wonders of Japan while traveling.
.
Since I started my journey, I have taken on various challenges.
Many people have kindly told me, "Watching Shunpei gives me courage."
I am very happy to think that what I find interesting and challenging can be a trigger for someone to take their first step in their own challenges.
"Live without regrets"
This is a phrase I hold dear.
However, not just for myself, but for people all over the world to live without regrets, I will share my challenges through photos and videos.
And if my journey inspires someone to take on their own challenges, I will be very happy.
.
In June, before my journey across Japan, I will also challenge crowdfunding.
I would be grateful for any support you can give me.🙏
.
Please feel free to share this video!
And if more people can learn about the charm of Hamamatsu, I can truly say that I am glad to have done this project!
I also welcome any comments or advice! 😆
.
Thank you for reading to the end!
I will resume my interesting journey starting next month.
In May, I will cycle around Lake Biwa and around Shikoku.
Please look forward to it!

I wanted to hear the true feelings of the island revitalizers!
Challenging the possibilities of island matters in the Amami Islands!!
A presentation-style talk event of struggles by the islanders connecting to the next generation!?

▶︎ What is Shima Saba Creative GCD?
The Amami Islands Human Resource Development Achievement Presentation "Shima Saba Creative GCD (Gashido)" focuses on those who are challenging themselves in the Amami Islands, inviting individuals who are tackling the possibilities of island matters in the Amami Islands to speak about their current efforts, the struggles they have faced in the process, and their feelings towards Amami in a talk show format.

▶︎ Amami Islands Challenge Product Exhibition and Sales
・Turtle Bay Brewing Co., Ltd.
Collaborating with sake manufacturers from Amami, Kagoshima, and Okinawa, we produce soda mixed shochu, awamori, and canned highballs.
・Pudding Specialty Store che ~ Pudding Revolution ~
We create a special pudding using Amami ingredients, inspired by the firm pudding we had in Latin America.
・General Incorporated Association E-Yoron
We have started upcycling marine plastic waste that has washed ashore and waste plastic consumed on the island.
・General Incorporated Association Okinoerabu Island Tourism Association
We have a souvenir shop with one of the largest selections on the island.
The cutting edge of Okinoerabu is gathered here!
・Amami Islands Promotion and Development Fund
As a policy financial institution supporting the industrial promotion of the Amami Islands, we passionately demonstrate our activities both inside and outside the organization.

奄美大島 Amami Island, Japan in 8K
description: 奄美大島は、鹿児島市から南へ約380キロメートルに位置する、周囲およそ461kmの島です。多様性と稀少性を併せ持つ自然は日本で2番目に広いマングローブ林や、アマミノクロウサギなどの絶滅が危惧される固有種など、世界に誇る豊かさを持っています。また島唄や八月踊りなどの伝統文化、本場奄美大島紬などの伝統産業があり古来から島人たちが大切にしてきた島の風景や情景をみることができます。東京や大阪、福岡などの主要空港からアクセスでき、奄美大島から飛行機やフェリーなどを乗り継ぎ奄美群島へのアクセスも可能です。

title: Amami Island, Japan in 8K
description: Amami Island is located approximately 380 kilometers south of Kagoshima City and is an island with a circumference of about 461 km. Its nature, which combines diversity and rarity, boasts the second largest mangrove forest in Japan and endemic species such as the Amami rabbit, which is at risk of extinction. The island also has traditional cultures such as island songs and August dances, as well as traditional industries like authentic Amami Oshima textiles, allowing visitors to see the landscapes and scenes that the islanders have cherished since ancient times. It is accessible from major airports in Tokyo, Osaka, and Fukuoka, and connections to the Amami Islands can be made via flights and ferries from Amami Island.

title: 沖永良部島 Okinoerabu Island, Japan in 8K
description: 沖永良部島は、鹿児島市から南へ約552km場所に位置する周囲約55.8kmの隆起サンゴ礁の島です。年間平均気温23度という温暖な気候に恵まれ四季を通じて熱帯、亜熱帯の花々が咲き、エラブユリ、スプレーキクなどの栽培も盛んです。地下には多数の鍾乳洞が存在し「花と鍾乳洞の島」の異名をとっています。澄みきった青い海と空、まばゆい太陽、素朴で厚い人情は、あなたにとって忘れ得ぬ旅の思い出を演出することでしょう。

title: Okinoerabu Island, Japan in 8K
description: Okinoerabu Island is an uplifted coral reef island located approximately 552 km south of Kagoshima City, with a circumference of about 55.8 km. Blessed with a warm climate with an average annual temperature of 23 degrees, tropical and subtropical flowers bloom throughout the seasons, and the cultivation of Erabu lily and spray chrysanthemum is also active. The island is known as 'the island of flowers and limestone caves' due to the numerous limestone caves underground. The clear blue sea and sky, dazzling sun, and simple yet deep human connections will create unforgettable travel memories for you.

title: 与論島 Yoron Island, Japan in 8K
description: 与論島は、奄美群島の最南端にあり沖縄本島まで約23kmの場所に位置する周囲約23.8kmの島です。サンゴ礁が隆起してできた島で、白い砂浜と透明度の高い海は「東洋の真珠」ともいわれています。また、条件が揃った時にしか姿を現さない「百合ヶ浜」は、辺り一面がエメラルドグリーンに輝き、海の色と白い砂浜は地球の楽園を感じさせ、訪れた多くの方々を魅了しています。沖縄県との関係も深く、薩摩と琉球を融合した独自の文化を楽しむことができます。

title: Yoron Island, Japan in 8K
description: Yoron Island is located at the southernmost tip of the Amami Islands, about 23 km from Okinawa Island. It is an island formed by the uplift of coral reefs, and its white sandy beaches and clear waters are known as the 'Pearl of the Orient.' Additionally, 'Yuriga-hama,' which only appears under certain conditions, shines emerald green all around, and the colors of the sea and the white sandy beach evoke a sense of paradise on Earth, captivating many visitors. The island has a deep connection with Okinawa, allowing visitors to enjoy a unique culture that blends Satsuma and Ryukyu.

title: 徳之島 Tokuno Island, Japan in 8K
description: 徳之島は、鹿児島市から南へ約468kmの場所に位置する、周囲およそ89kmの島です。主要な産業はサトウキビ、ジャガイモ、果樹などの農業や、近海漁業、黒糖を原料とした菓子、黒糖焼酎製造などがあります。闘牛が盛んな島としても有名で、年に数回大きな大会が開催されます。豊かな自然と素朴な南の島の文化が楽しめる奄美群島で2番目に大きな島です。

title: Tokuno Island, Japan in 8K
description: Tokuno Island is located approximately 468 km south of Kagoshima City and is an island with a circumference of about 89 km. The main industries include agriculture such as sugarcane, potatoes, and fruit trees, as well as coastal fishing, confectionery made from brown sugar, and the production of brown sugar shochu. The island is also famous for its active bullfighting, with large tournaments held several times a year. It is the second largest island in the Amami Islands, where you can enjoy rich nature and the simple culture of a southern island.

title: 喜界島 Kikai Island, Japan in 8K
description: 喜界島は、奄美大島の東へ位置する周囲約48.7kmの島です。島の大半が隆起サンゴ礁で年間数ミリずつ隆起し続けています。主な産業は農業で島一面にサトウキビ畑が広がり、サトウキビから作られる黒糖、黒糖焼酎は島の特産品となっています。また国内最大のゴマの産地としても知られています。島内はオオゴマダラやアサギマダラなどの蝶が舞い飛び、近年ではダイビングスポットとしても注目されつつあります。

title: Kikai Island, Japan in 8K
description: Kikai Island is an island located to the east of Amami Oshima, with a circumference of approximately 48.7 km. Most of the island is made up of raised coral reefs that continue to rise a few millimeters each year. The main industry is agriculture, with sugarcane fields spreading across the island, and the brown sugar and brown sugar shochu made from sugarcane are local specialties. It is also known as the largest producer of sesame in Japan. The island is home to butterflies such as the Oogomadara and Asagimadara, and in recent years, it has been gaining attention as a diving spot.

title: 中津川【富士見台高原】Fujimidaikogen, Nakatsugawa
description:
富士見台高原は、中央アルプスの南端、恵那山系にある標高1,739mの笹に覆われた美しい山です。

山の中腹まで車で行けるため手軽なハイキングスポットとして人気があります。

晴れた日には一面、緑色の笹に覆われた山肌と抜けるような青空とのコントラストが楽しめます。
山頂では恵那山、北アルプス、南アルプス、中央アルプスを見渡す壮大な360度の大パノラマが待ち受けています。

7月には日本原産で希少植物のササユリ、10月中旬から11月上旬ごろには燃え上がるような真っ赤な山並みを楽しむことができます。

登山シーズンは、4月末から11月中旬まで。

撮影日：2021年7月18日

富士見台高原や中津川の観光については、中津川観光協会までお問い合わせください。

title: Fujimidaikogen, Nakatsugawa
description:
Fujimidaikogen is a beautiful mountain covered in grass at an elevation of 1,739 meters, located at the southern end of the Central Alps in the Ena mountain range.

It is a popular hiking spot due to the accessibility of driving up to the mountainside.

On clear days, you can enjoy the contrast between the green grass-covered slopes and the bright blue sky.
At the summit, a magnificent 360-degree panorama awaits, offering views of Ena Mountain, the Northern Alps, the Southern Alps, and the Central Alps.

In July, you can see the rare native plant, Sasayuri, and from mid-October to early November, you can enjoy the fiery red mountain ranges.

The climbing season is from late April to mid-November.

Date of photography: July 18, 2021

For information about tourism in Fujimidaikogen and Nakatsugawa, please contact the Nakatsugawa Tourism Association.

description: 『冬の下呂温泉花火物語』、2月１１日（土）はその名もずばり、『バレンタイン花火』がテーマとなっています。女性を応援する、情熱的な花火が夜空に打ち上がる予定です。バレンタインデーの歴史は古く、古代ローマ帝国の時代、兵士の婚姻を守るために行動した、ウァレンティヌス司祭にちなんでいるとも言われています。古代ローマと言えば温泉、意外なところで下呂温泉とも馴染みのある日ですね。ぜひ、カップルで花火をご覧になり、一足早いバレンタインデーをお祝いください。今後とも、下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします。

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: The 'Winter Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' on February 11th (Saturday) features the theme 'Valentine's Fireworks'. 三寒四温といいますが、少しづつ暖かい日が増えてきたように思えます。

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 1月２８日（土）の『冬の下呂温泉花火物語』の様子です。この日は、雪の降る中での花火となりました。寒さもかなり強かったものの、花火の打ち上げ時刻には多くのお客様が集まってくださいました。さて、この日のテーマは「健康祈願・節分花火」でした。赤鬼・青鬼・豆まきを表現した花火で、皆様の一年の健康を祈願します。健康のために、ぜひ下呂温泉の湯に浸かっていってください。美容にも多大な効果があると言われています。今週末、２月に入った４日（土）にも花火は打ち上がりますので、ぜひご覧にいらっしゃってください。今後とも、下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします。

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: This is the scene of the 'Winter Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' on January 28th (Saturday). On this day, the fireworks took place amidst falling snow. We appreciate your continued support for Gero Onsen.

title: けふの下呂温泉

description:

description:

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 『天壌無窮　悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火物語』も終盤です。この日のテーマは「父の日花火」。父の日に感謝を込めて家族の愛情や尊厳を表す、黄色を基調とした花火が打ち上がりました。ダイナミックな花火の勢いに、感嘆の声が各所から聞こえてきました。花火をご来場の皆様と共有しているようで、不思議な高揚感に包まれました。『天壌無窮　悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火物語』も残すところあと3回（6月25日、7月2日、9日）、ぜひ、そのすべてをご覧いただければと思います！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

Fireworks based on yellow were launched to express family love and respect, filled with gratitude for Father's Day. The dynamic fireworks drew exclamations of awe from various places. It felt like sharing the fireworks with everyone present, enveloped in a strange sense of exhilaration. There are only three more shows left for 'Tenjo Mukyu, Banish Evil, Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' (June 25, July 2, and 9), and I hope you can see all of them! title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 金山町菅田桐洞地内の菅田川へ、ホタルの大群を求めて再訪しました。が、今年はホタルが出てくるのが2週間ほど遅れているようで、来週こそ最盛期であろうと同じくホタルを見に来ていた方に教えていただきました。実際に、やはりまだホタルはあまりおらず、来週こそはと決意を固めました。その代わり、かどうかはわかりませんが、オオサンショウウオに出会いました。川の主で、鮎を食べに出てくるそうです。生きているオオサンショウウオを見るのは初めてだったので、とても嬉しかったです。さて、来週こそホタルの群れをお届けできるでしょうか？　また、オオサンショウウオにも再会できるでしょうか？どうかお楽しみに。下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: I revisited the Sugata River in Kanayama Town, Sugata Kirido, in search of a large group of fireflies. However, it seems that the fireflies are about two weeks late this year, and I was informed by another visitor that next week should be the peak season. Indeed, there were still not many fireflies, and I resolved to come back next week. Instead, I encountered a giant salamander. It is said to be the master of the river and comes out to eat sweetfish. I was very happy to see a living giant salamander for the first time. Now, will I be able to deliver a swarm of fireflies next week? Will I also be able to reunite with the giant salamander? Please look forward to it. Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: げるぐんくんの呟きで、ゲンジボタルが見ごろと知って金山町菅田桐洞地内の菅田川へ、ホタルを見に行ってみました。ところが、当日はやや寒く、ホタルがいっぱい出てくる条件である、蒸し暑くて風の穏やかな気候に合致しなかったためか、あまりホタルが飛んでいませんでした。それでも、葉っぱに止まったホタルを間近で見れて嬉しかったです。現地で会った方によると、むしろ今週が見ごろではないかとのことでしたので、暖かく風のない日を狙い、もう一度行ってみようと思います。今度こそ、夜空を舞うホタルの群れを見てみたいですね。下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: I learned from Gerogle-kun's tweet that the Genji fireflies are in full bloom, so I went to the Sugata River in Kanayama Town, Sugata Kirido. However, it was a bit cold on the day, and perhaps because it did not meet the conditions for many fireflies to come out, which are humid and calm weather, there weren't many fireflies flying around. Still, I was happy to see the fireflies resting on the leaves up close. According to someone I met there, this week might actually be the best time to see them, so I plan to go again on a warm, windless day. I want to see a swarm of fireflies dancing in the night sky this time. Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
５月14日（土）、『天壌無窮　悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火』が久しぶりに開催されました。

やや肌寒い夜風が吹いていましたが、多くのお客様が花火を見に集まってくださいました。
躍動感あふれる『こいのぼり花火』に歓声があがり、下呂温泉の夜が活気に満ちていました。

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
On May 14th (Saturday), the 'Eternal Heaven and Earth, Epidemic Dispersal, Gero Onsen Fireworks' was held for the first time in a while.

Although a slightly chilly night breeze was blowing, many guests gathered to watch the fireworks.
Cheers erupted at the dynamic 'Koinobori Fireworks,' filling the night of Gero Onsen with excitement.

The weather has been unstable lately, but we hope to enjoy the fireworks next week without being caught in the rain.

Of course, don’t forget to enjoy the hot springs after watching the fireworks.
Soaking in the foot bath at the 'Funsen Pond' in Shirakagi Green Park is also a nice option.

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
下呂温泉、しらさぎ緑地公園の桜の様子です。

天候にも恵まれて、暖かい風に包まれながら桜を堪能できました。
満開の桜を眺めながら散策するのは格別です。
甘く爽やかな花の香りには、リラックスする効果があるようです。

さらなるリラックスを求めて、温泉に浸かるのもいいですね！
桜を見物したあとは、ぜひ温泉へお入りください！

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
This is the cherry blossom view at Gero Onsen and Shirakawa Green Park.

Blessed with good weather, I was able to enjoy the cherry blossoms wrapped in a warm breeze.
Strolling while gazing at the fully bloomed cherry blossoms is exceptional.
The sweet and refreshing scent of the flowers seems to have a relaxing effect.

It’s also nice to soak in the hot springs in search of further relaxation!
After enjoying the cherry blossoms, please be sure to enter the hot springs!

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
４月2日（土）の、『新生活応援花火』がテーマの『天壌無窮　悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火』の様子です。

新年度となって初めての花火は、見事にお客様たちを魅了していました。
これから始まる新生活への、応援であったかのようでした。
気温もぐっと春めいてきていて、そろそろ暖房ともお別れの時期かもしれませんね。

暖房とはお別れしても、温泉とは四季を通してお付き合いしたいものです！
生活が変化するこの時期こそ、温泉に浸かって体調を整えましょう！

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！


#下呂温泉 #日本三名泉 #下呂市 #下呂観光 #下呂花火

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
On April 2nd (Saturday), the 'Heaven and Earth Eternal, Epidemic Extermination, Gero Onsen Fireworks' themed 'New Life Support Fireworks' took place.

The first fireworks of the new fiscal year beautifully captivated the guests.
It felt like a support for the new life that is about to begin.
The temperature has also become quite spring-like, and it might be time to say goodbye to heating soon.

Even if we part ways with heating, we want to maintain our relationship with the hot springs throughout the seasons!
During this time of change in life, let's soak in the hot springs to keep our health in check!

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

#GeroOnsen #Japan'sThreeFamousHotSprings #GeroCity #GeroTourism #GeroFireworks

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 3月19日（土）～21日（月）にかけ、3夜連続で花火で夜空を彩った『天壌無窮　悪疫退散　下呂温泉花火』です。ぐっと冷え込んだ夜でしたが、『卒業・旅立ちの応援花火』をテーマに、337拍子等で期待に夢膨らむお祝いの花火を見に、大勢にお客様がいらしてくださいました。見事な花火に歓声があがり、寒さを吹き飛ばす勢いです。今週末の26日（土）、27日（日）。そして、4月2日（土）～7月9日（土）にかけての毎週土曜日にも、花火が打ち上がる予定です！絶え間なく夜空に花火が咲く下呂温泉！花火を見ながら温泉を堪能するのも格別です！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: From March 19 (Saturday) to 21 (Monday), the 'Heaven and Earth Eternal, Epidemic Dispersal, Gero Onsen Fireworks' illuminated the night sky with fireworks for three consecutive nights. It was a chilly night, but many customers came to see the celebratory fireworks themed 'Graduation and Departure Support Fireworks,' filled with expectations and dreams. The magnificent fireworks drew cheers, blowing away the cold. This weekend, on the 26th (Saturday) and 27th (Sunday), and every Saturday from April 2 (Saturday) to July 9 (Saturday), fireworks are scheduled to be launched! Gero Onsen, where fireworks bloom endlessly in the night sky! Enjoying the hot springs while watching the fireworks is exceptional! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: お待たせしました！『天壌無窮悪疫退散下呂温泉花火物語』がついに再開しました！3月12日（土）・13日（日）に打ち上がったのは『ホワイトデー花火』。多くのお客様の前で、男性から女性への感謝の気持ちを込めた、白を基調とした花火が夜空を彩りました。久しぶりの花火は感無量ですね！夜風もすっかり温かくなり、防寒具なしでも過ごせそうなくらいです。こんな陽気の日は、温泉に浸かるに限りますね！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします。

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: Thank you for waiting! The 'Tenjo Mukyu Akueki Taisan Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' has finally resumed! The 'White Day Fireworks' were launched on March 12 (Saturday) and 13 (Sunday). Against the backdrop of many customers, fireworks based on white, expressing gratitude from men to women, colored the night sky. It's overwhelming to see fireworks after such a long time! The night breeze has become quite warm, and it seems we can spend time without winter clothing. On such a pleasant day, soaking in the hot springs is the best! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen.

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
1月15日（土）の『花餅花火』の様子です。

紅白の花火が打ち上がり、花餅を表現していました。
ちょうど雪が降った後の開催であったので、雪に反射する紅白の光がとても綺麗でした。
夏に開催することが多い花火ですので、雪の中で打ち上がる様はまた格別です！

さて、1月22日（土）の花火ではまた雪の中の花火が楽しめるでしょうか？

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
This is the scene of the 'Hanamochi Hanabi' on January 15th (Saturday).

Red and white fireworks were launched, expressing the flower rice cakes.
Since it was held just after the snow fell, the red and white lights reflecting on the snow were very beautiful.
Fireworks are often held in summer, so the sight of them launching in the snow is exceptional!

Now, will we be able to enjoy fireworks in the snow again on January 22nd (Saturday)?

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
まれにみる大雪の下呂温泉、雪化粧をした合掌村を見に行こうと向かってみました。

いつも見慣れたはずの合掌村は一面の銀世界。
まるで別の場所のようにも見えます。
手湯と足湯で体を暖めながら、雪道を歩いてみました。

雪で覆われた合掌家屋は雰囲気抜群で、いつも以上に堪能できました。
さすがにすべり台は使用できませんでしたが、これから毎日……というには雪かきが大変ですが、
たまにはこうした姿の合掌村に触れるのも楽しいものですね。

こんな雪の日には温泉が一番！
下呂温泉の湯船に浸かって新年への英気を養いましょう！

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

#下呂温泉 #日本三名泉 #下呂市 #下呂観光 #合掌村

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
Gero Onsen, covered in rare heavy snow, I headed out to see the gassho village dressed in snow.

The gassho village, which I usually see, is a world of silver.
It looks like a completely different place.
I walked along the snowy path while warming my body in the hand and foot baths.

The gassho houses covered in snow have an exceptional atmosphere, and I was able to enjoy it more than usual.
Although the slide was not usable, it would be quite a task to shovel snow every day...
But it’s fun to experience the gassho village in this form once in a while.

On a snowy day like this, hot springs are the best!
Let’s soak in the Gero Onsen and recharge our spirits for the new year!

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

description:

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
On November 20th (Saturday), the "Tenjo Mukyu - Epidemic Extermination - Gero Onsen Fireworks Story" was held, themed "Labor Thanksgiving Fireworks".

This event was a prelude to Labor Thanksgiving Day on November 23rd (Tuesday), where we express gratitude for the labor and production that support our lives (3 and 9).

A grand display of fireworks was launched in celebration. It is said that this day originally stems from the Niiname-sai, a festival to give thanks for the bountiful harvest of grains.

Now, what better way to reward ourselves for our labor than with a hot spring!

I hope we can enjoy the next fireworks while soaking in the hot springs!

description:

名前にもある『がんだて』は、県指定天然記念物にもなっている溶岩でできた絶壁で、

森林浴も一緒に楽しめ、秋の風情を満喫できました。

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
I heard that the autumn leaves are at their best at 'Gandate Park' in Hida Kosaka, so I decided to head there.

The 'Gandate' in the name refers to the sheer cliffs made of lava, which have been designated as a natural monument by the prefecture, and I was overwhelmed by their grandeur.
The mountains are adorned with red and yellow foliage, and I enjoyed the scenery while walking along the promenade.

There are also waterfalls along the way, and seeing the sunlight streaming through the waterfall up close is incredibly impressive.
I was able to enjoy forest bathing as well, fully savoring the autumn atmosphere.

Now is the perfect time to enjoy the autumn leaves, so if you want to experience them, please come early.

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: 紅葉が見ごろということで、合掌村と初矢峠へ行ってみました。少し前まではまだまだかなと思っていた木々が、見事に赤くなっていました。自然の作用だけで、ここまできれいな赤色に染まったことを思うと、なんだか感動してしまいます。比較的寒さも厳しくなかったので、しばし散策をして紅葉を堪能しました。数日は晴天が続くようなので、もっともっと紅葉を撮影していきたいと思います。合掌村には足湯があるので、紅葉と温泉を一度に楽しむことができます！とても風情がありますね！下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description: Since the autumn leaves are at their best, I went to Gassho Village and Hatsuyatoge. The trees, which I thought would take a while to change, have beautifully turned red. Thinking that such a beautiful red color was achieved solely by nature is quite moving. The cold wasn't too harsh, so I enjoyed a stroll and took in the autumn leaves. It seems that sunny weather will continue for a few days, so I want to take more photos of the autumn leaves. Gassho Village has a foot bath, so you can enjoy both the autumn leaves and the hot springs at once! It's very picturesque! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉

けふは日差しも強く、夏が戻ってきたような陽気の下呂温泉です。
なんだか冷たいものが欲しくなりますね。

山道ではまだまだ葉が青く、蝉の声も聞こえてきて夏の気候です。

とはいえ、みはらし台への途中の道に栗のイガが落ちているなど、

下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen
description:
Just the other day, we felt the coolness of autumn's arrival, but today, Gero Onsen is under strong sunlight, as if summer has returned.
Somehow, I feel like having something cold.

It took about 30 minutes to walk from Jomon Park to the historical Mori Mihara Shidai.
On the mountain path, the leaves are still green, and the sound of cicadas can be heard, giving it a summer climate.
The breathtaking view of the town and mountains from Mihara Shidai still reflects the essence of summer.

That said, on the way to Mihara Shidai, there were chestnut burrs fallen on the path, indicating that the scent of autumn is steadily approaching.
I’m looking forward to the autumn foliage.

After enjoying the stunning views, let’s indulge in the hot springs!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

さて、秋の到来を感じながら入る温泉もまた格別です！

春夏秋冬いつでも極上の湯！
下呂温泉をよろしくお願いいたします！

title: Today’s Gero Onsen

Anytime throughout the year, enjoy the finest hot springs!

けふも、『にゃらんグルメ』を探しに下呂温泉を散策しましょう！

下呂温泉に初めてオープンした、プリン専門店の『下呂プリン』 さん！
そちらで販売している、下呂牛乳と、選りすぐりの卵やバニラビーンズで、たんねんに手作りしたプリンにたっぷりのソフトクリームが加わった、『にゃらんプリンソフト』が今回の逸品！

なめらかで上品な甘さのプリンに、ひんやりソフトクリームがベストマッチ！
にゃらんの顔と手を模した米粉の焼き菓子も、とってもかわいらしくサクサクとした食感で味も最高！
まさに、たまら“にゃ”い贅沢なスイーツです！

1日先着５食限定、お値段は￥600です。

『にゃらんグルメ』の販売期間は今年の11月30日（火）までなので、お見逃しなく！

『下呂プリン』さんのすぐそばにある、『鷺の足湯』につかりながら、『にゃらんプリンソフト』をほおばるのも乙な気分になりますね！

グルメと温泉のコラボレーション！

title: Today's Gero Onsen
description:
Today, let's take a stroll around Gero Onsen in search of 'Nyarang Gourmet'!

The newly opened 'Gero Pudding' shop, specializing in pudding, has arrived in Gero Onsen!
The highlight is the 'Nyarang Pudding Soft', made with Gero milk, carefully selected eggs, and vanilla beans, combined with a generous serving of soft serve ice cream!

The smooth and elegantly sweet pudding pairs perfectly with the cool soft serve ice cream!
The rice flour baked goods shaped like Nyarang's face and hands are also incredibly cute, with a delightful crunch and amazing flavor!
It's truly an irresistible luxury dessert!

Limited to the first 5 servings per day, priced at ¥600.

The 'Nyarang Gourmet' sales period is until November 30th (Tuesday) this year, so don't miss out!

Indulging in 'Nyarang Pudding Soft' while soaking in the 'Sagi Foot Bath' right next to 'Gero Pudding' is a delightful experience!

A collaboration of gourmet food and hot springs!
Thank you for supporting Gero Onsen!
