title: #Hida Takayama SPLASHActivity
description:
Takayama City in Gifu Prefecture is an area surrounded by mountains with beautiful nature.
It offers a variety of refreshing activities perfect for hot summer days.
In the rich natural environment, activities like shower climbing, river climbing, river play, and fish catching can be enjoyed by both children and adults, providing a popular experience to refresh while becoming one with nature.
Why not indulge in an exciting experience that is not found in everyday life and enjoy nature with all your senses?

title: 寒冷な気候と昼夜の寒暖差が大きい飛騨エリアで栽培されるため、甘みが強く、濃厚な味わいが特徴の「飛騨ほうれん草」。飛騨エリアは、日本でも有数のほうれん草の産地です。#飛騨高山

Hida Spinach, characterized by its strong sweetness and rich flavor, is cultivated in the Hida area, known for its cold climate and significant temperature differences between day and night. The Hida area is one of Japan's leading spinach-producing regions.
秋の高山祭の例祭の場所として有名な「櫻山八幡宮」で「桜山風鈴まつり」が開催中です。絵馬殿に約2,000個の風鈴が飾られ手水舎に生花が浮かび涼しげな雰囲気。涼を感じる音色が鳴り響きます。#飛騨高山
The 'Sakurayama Wind Chime Festival' is currently being held at 'Sakurayama Hachiman Shrine', famous for its location as a festival site of the Takayama Autumn Festival.
description: The 'Sakurayama Wind Chime Festival' is currently being held at 'Sakurayama Hachiman Shrine', famous for its location as a festival site of the Takayama Autumn Festival. About 2,000 wind chimes are decorated in the Ema Hall, and fresh flowers float in the water basin, creating a refreshing atmosphere. The sound of the wind chimes resonates, bringing a sense of coolness.

title: 早朝7時から営業している「ダルマベーカリー」。子供から大人まで楽しめる幅広い商品ラインナップが人気のパン屋。期間限定のパンなど80~90種類のパンが並び、どれにしようか迷ってしまいそう♡#飛騨高山
Daruma Bakery, open from 7 AM. A popular bakery with a wide range of products that can be enjoyed by children and adults alike.
description: Daruma Bakery, open from 7 AM. A popular bakery with a wide range of products that can be enjoyed by children and adults alike. A variety of 80 to 90 types of bread, including limited-time offerings, are available, making it hard to choose which one to get! #HidaTakayama

title: 飛騨地方では節句の行事を旧暦で行うため、七夕祭りは8月7日。毎年この時期に古い町並の軒先に笹の葉を飾り、七夕を祝います。サラサラと揺れる笹と七夕飾りが涼しげな雰囲気です。#飛騨高山
In the Hida region, the festival is held according to the old calendar, so Tanabata is on August 7.
description: Every year at this time, bamboo leaves are decorated on the eaves of the old town streets to celebrate Tanabata. The swaying bamboo and Tanabata decorations create a refreshing atmosphere.

title: ~飛騨高山夏の風物詩～打ち上げる者、観る者の厄払いを願い、毎年8（や）月9（く）日に開催される「飛騨高山手筒花火打上げ」。竹筒に仕込んだ花火を手で持ち、火の粉をあびながら行う勇壮な花火。#飛騨高山
Hida Takayama Summer Tradition - Fireworks Display
description: Held every August 9th to wish for the safety of those who launch and watch the fireworks, the 'Hida Takayama Handheld Fireworks Display' features a brave display of fireworks held in bamboo tubes, showering sparks on the participants.

title: 久々野町にある「下本農園」ではトマト狩り体験ができます。糖度を上げると水分量が減り、水々しさが失われるため、絶妙なバランスが保たれた、甘さを抑えて酸味が効いた水々しいトマトを育ています。#飛騨高山
You can experience tomato picking at 'Shimamoto Farm' in Kuzuyama Town.
description: At 'Shimamoto Farm' in Kuzuyama Town, you can experience tomato picking. By increasing the sugar content, the water content decreases, and the juiciness is lost, so we grow juicy tomatoes with a perfect balance, suppressing sweetness and enhancing acidity.

title: 高山市江名子町で飛騨メロンを栽培している「林農園」。#飛騨高山 の寒暖差のある気候だからこそできる、コクのある上品な甘さとみずみずしい果肉が特徴。
Hayashi Farm, cultivating Hida melons in Ena-ko Town, Takayama.
description: Due to the temperature differences in Takayama, Hida, it features a rich, elegant sweetness and juicy flesh.

title: #飛騨高山  里山サイクリング
description: 日本一面積が広い高山市。山々に囲まれ、その90％以上が森林で占められた自然豊かなスポット。美しい自然、歴史と文化、温泉、グルメなど、多彩な魅力にあふれた飛騨高山。どこか懐かしく心温まる日本の原風景が広がります。飛騨高山の大自然を満喫できるオススメのアクティビティが「e-bike(イーバイク)」。澄んだ空気と北アルプス(飛騨山脈)の壮大な風景の中を駆け抜ければ、気分も爽快！イーバイクは電動アシスト機能が付いているため、体力に自信がない方や普段自転車に乗り慣れていない方でも、気軽にサイクリングを楽しむことができます。坂道も軽々と登れるので、高山の起伏の多い地形でも安心！イーバイクで飛騨高山を散策してみませんか？？イーバイクレンタル詳細は公式サイトの特集をご確認ください。

title: Hida Takayama Satoyama Cycling
description: Takayama City, the largest city in Japan by area, is surrounded by mountains and over 90% of its area is covered by forests, making it a nature-rich spot. Hida Takayama is full of diverse attractions such as beautiful nature, history and culture, hot springs, and gourmet food. A nostalgic and heartwarming Japanese landscape unfolds. A recommended activity to enjoy the great nature of Hida Takayama is 'e-bike'. Riding through the clear air and the magnificent scenery of the Northern Alps (Hida Mountains) will refresh your spirit! The e-bike has an electric assist function, so even those who are not confident in their physical strength or are not used to riding bicycles can easily enjoy cycling. It can easily climb hills, so you can feel safe even in the hilly terrain of Takayama! Why not explore Hida Takayama with an e-bike? For details on e-bike rentals, please check the special feature on the official website.

title: 今から約330年前に一之宮町に伝えられたという「宮笠」。代々、宮村で暮らす問坂義一さん・和彦さんは親子でこの伝統技術を守っている。 #飛騨高山
The 'Miyagasa' that was passed down in Ichinomiya Town about 330 years ago. The father and son, Yoshikazu and Kazuhiko Monzaka, have been preserving this traditional technique in Miyamura.
梅雨があけて、飛騨高山も夏本番！真っ青な空、白い雲、夏にしか見ることができない絶景。#takayama #飛騨高山 #岐阜県 #高山 #旅行 #takayamagram #japan #travel
The rainy season has ended, and Takayama is in full summer! A clear blue sky, white clouds, and breathtaking views that can only be seen in summer.

The bamboo craft 'Koyana Shouke' passed down in the Koyana district of Hida Takayama City.
description: The beautiful weave of the Suzutake, intricately woven vertically and horizontally, is a finely crafted piece with tightly packed patterns.

title: 日本で一番大きな市の高山市は、90％以上が森林に占められている自然豊かなエリア。彩り豊かな滝の森も多く、川のせせらぎ、森の匂い、木々の感触など、心を開放するリフレッシュ体験ができます。#飛騨高山

There are many colorful waterfall forests, and you can experience a refreshing experience that opens your heart with the sound of the river, the scent of the forest, and the touch of the trees.

title: 水温が年間14℃前後に保たれる清流でのみ生息する貴重な植物「#梅花藻(バイカモ)」。飛騨一宮水無神社前の常泉寺川の下流にかかる橋から約500ｍにわたって白く小さな花を見ることができます。#飛騨高山
A precious plant 'Baikamo' that lives only in clear streams where the water temperature is kept around 14°C throughout the year.
description: A precious plant 'Baikamo' that lives only in clear streams where the water temperature is kept around 14°C throughout the year. You can see small white flowers along about 500 meters from the bridge over the Jousenji River downstream in front of Hida Ichinomiya Minashi Shrine.

title: 丹生川町にある千光寺でアジサイが見頃を迎えています。参道沿いには約1000株のアジサイが咲き誇り華やかな雰囲気です。撮影:7月5日　#飛騨高山

郡上市八幡町から高山市清見町三日町を結ぶ「飛騨美濃せせらぎ街道」。爽やかな風と新緑が楽しめるドライブにぴったりのルートです。#飛騨高山 #岐阜県
The 'Hida-Mino Seseragi Road' connecting Hida City, Yachiyo Town to Takayama City, Kiyomi Town, is a perfect route for a drive where you can enjoy refreshing winds and fresh greenery.
飛騨高山ジャズフェスティバル。大自然の中、心踊る音楽と美味しいお酒と美食で最高のひととき。#飛騨高山　#hidatakayama #岐阜県　#高山　#takayama
Hida Takayama Jazz Festival. In the great nature, the best time with exciting music, delicious sake, and gourmet food.
良質な #飛騨牛 を味わえる「#肉の匠家　安川店」。元祖飛騨牛まぶしは、甘辛いタレが染みこんだをお肉を1杯目はそのまま、2杯目は飛騨ネギとわさびで、3杯目はお出汁をかけて♪#飛騨高山

Delicious #Hida Beef at 'Niku no Takumiya Yasukawa'. The original Hida beef mabuushi is enjoyed in three ways: the first bowl as is, the second with Hida green onions and wasabi, and the third with dashi poured over it. #Hida Takayama
飛騨一之宮の田園風景。 田んぼに水が張られ、いよいよ田植えの季節です。水田に空が映り込む日本の原風景。#飛騨高山　#hidatakayama #岐阜県　#高山　#takayama　　#Japan

合掌造りなど日本の美しい原風景と飛騨人の暮らしや文化を体験できる「飛騨の里」では、全長９m50cmの巨大な和紙の鯉のぼりと五月人形が展示されています。巨大な鯉のぼりは迫力満点！#飛騨高山

Hida Ichinomiya has not only the Garyu Sakura, but beautiful cherry blossoms bloom all over the town.
description: Miyagawa Tsutsumi has had cherry blossom trees lined up since the 1940s, with Kasumizakura, Edohigan, and Shidarezakura in full bloom.

The Kobano Mitsuba Tsutsuji, which is also the flower of Takayama, is in full bloom.

Hida Shokawa no Sato, where traditional houses such as the 'Yarimune-style Irimoya Gassho-zukuri' are preserved and relocated.
description: In the midst of cherry blossoms in full bloom, the landscape reminiscent of old tales creates a fantastical atmosphere. *Past photo #Hida Takayama

title: 青屋神明神社のライトアップ。県外からも多くの方が訪れるフォトスポットです。大きな枝垂れ桜目の前に水田が広がり、映りこむ逆さの桜は圧倒的な美しさ♡鏡に映る別世界が広がります。#飛騨高山
Aoyakami Shrine's Light Up. A photo spot that attracts many visitors from outside the prefecture.

カンカコカンでおなじみの「闘鶏楽(とうけいらく」。白地に色鮮やかな鳳凰の衣装が目を惹きます。鳴り響く鐘の音色が祭りの雰囲気を盛り上げます。#飛騨高山 #高山祭
Toukeiraku, known for Kankakokan
description: The colorful phoenix costume on a white background catches the eye. The ringing of the bells enhances the festive atmosphere.

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　一之宮町
description:
飛騨一之宮観光協会会長　稲子盛雄さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
一之宮町は、高山市の南部に位置する歴史と伝統が息づく地域。美しい自然に囲まれており、その環境を活かした農業体験や地元の人たちとのふれあい体験ができるグリーンツーリズムが盛んな地域です。なかでも、飛騨一宮水無神社は飛騨の国で最も格式高い神社とされ、地域に住む人たちの信仰を集め敬われています。他にも内閣府認定のどぶろく特区、樹齢1,100年の臥龍桜、分水嶺が見られる位山の散策やウィンタースポーツなど様々なジャンルを見て感じることができます。
一之宮町に是非お越しください。
（高山市街地から車で約２０分）

Morio Inako, chairman of the Hida Ichinomiya Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town.
Ichinomiya Town is located in the southern part of Takayama City and is an area steeped in history and tradition. Surrounded by beautiful nature, it is a popular area for green tourism, where you can experience farming that takes advantage of the environment and interact with local people. Among them, Hida Ichinomiya Mizunashi Shrine is considered to be the most prestigious shrine in Hida, and is worshiped and revered by the people living in the area. You can also see and experience a variety of other genres, such as the Cabinet Office-certified Doburoku Special Zone, the 1,100-year-old Garyu Cherry Tree, a walk on Mt. Iyama where you can see the watershed, and winter sports.
Please come to Ichinomiya Town.
(About 20 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　高根町
description:
飛騨高根観光協会会長　小坂守さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
高根町は高山市の南東に位置し、乗鞍岳と御嶽山を望み大自然に囲まれた高地にあります。長野県木曽地域に隣接しているため、歴史や文化、風俗に至るまで木曽の影響を色濃く受けており、飛騨の中でも異郷の地として知られています。高根町は木曽馬の産地だったことでも有名であり、馬の供養のために作られた石仏には、人と馬との物語が込められています。高根町では発酵食品に力を入れており、廃校を再利用したウイスキー蒸溜所は大きな話題を集めています。また、塩を一切使わず乳酸菌で漬けられた「すな」や、飛騨の郷土料理によく使われる田舎味噌なども盛んに作られています。この地域特有の涼しい夏と寒冷な冬の環境が、これらの発酵食品の育成に役立っています。その他には火畑そばやタカネコーン、野麦峠や御嶽山など様々な見どころがあるユニークな場所になっています。
高根町に是非お越しください。
（高山市街地から車で約５０分）

Mamoru Kosaka, chairman of the Hida Takane Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town.
Takane Town is located in the southeast of Takayama City, on a highland surrounded by nature overlooking Mt. Norikura and Mt. Ontake. Because it is adjacent to the Kiso region of Nagano Prefecture, its history, culture, and customs are strongly influenced by Kiso, and it is known as a foreign place even within Hida. Takane Town is also famous for being a production area for Kiso horses, and the stone Buddha statues made for memorial services for horses are filled with stories between people and horses. Takane Town is putting a lot of effort into fermented foods, and its whiskey distillery, which was repurposed from an abandoned school, is attracting a lot of attention. In addition, suna, which is pickled with lactic acid bacteria without using any salt, and country miso, which is often used in Hida's local cuisine, are also actively produced. The region's unique cool summers and cold winters are conducive to growing these fermented foods. It is also a unique place with many other attractions such as Hibata Soba, Takane Corn, Nomai Pass, and Mt. Ontake.
Please come to Takane Town.
(Approximately 50 minutes by car from Takayama city center)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　久々野町
description: 株式会社MGN 代表取締役 桐山淳一さんが町の魅力をご紹介。久々野町は、高山市の南部に位置し、美しい自然の風景が広がる地域です。この町は果物や野菜の生産が盛んで、「ひだ桃源郷」とも呼ばれるほどです。春になると、果物の花が咲き誇り、まるで夢のような風景が広がります。特に「飛騨りんご」や「飛騨もも」、「飛騨なし」、「飛騨メロン」などが特産品として有名です。なかでも、飛騨りんごを使った「アップルパイ」は大変人気で、発売するとすぐに完売してしまうほど。久々野町随一の名産品にまで成長しました。また、アルコピアスキー場跡地では毎年8月にひまわり園がオープンします。約20万本のひまわりが一面に咲き誇り、久々野町の新たな観光スポットとして注目を集めています。さらに、8月中旬にはくぐの納涼夏まつりが開催され尺玉が夜空を飾り、山々に轟音を響かせる必見のイベントになっています。久々野町に是非お越しください。（高山市街地から車で約３０分）

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Kuguno Town
description: Junichi Kiriyama, CEO of MGN Co., Ltd., will introduce the charms of the town. Kuguno Town is located in the southern part of Takayama City and is an area with beautiful natural scenery. This town is famous for its fruit and vegetable production, and is even called the 'Hida Peach Source Village.' In spring, the fruit flowers bloom, creating a dream-like landscape. Particularly famous are 'Hida apples,' 'Hida peaches,' 'Hida pears,' and 'Hida melons.' In particular, the 'Apple Pie' made with Hida apples is extremely popular and sells out as soon as it goes on sale. It has grown to become one of Kuguno Town's most famous products. Additionally, a sunflower garden opens every August on the site of the former Alcopia Ski Resort. Approximately 200,000 sunflowers are in full bloom, attracting attention as a new tourist spot in Kuguno Town. Furthermore, in mid-August, the Kugu Summer Summer Festival is held, where shakudama floats decorate the night sky and their roars echo through the mountains, making it a must-see event. Please come to Kuguno Town. (About 30 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

description: The mountain is covered with trees and plants, and encountering nature is one of the pleasures. Walking the hiking trail reveals many giant rock formations, creating a mystical atmosphere.

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　奥飛騨温泉郷上宝町
description: Okuhidaの宿 故郷 女将 中野梓さんと台湾から移住されたリャオさんが町の魅力をご紹介。奥飛騨温泉郷・上宝町は高山市の北東部に位置しています。旧上宝村が高山市と合併した際、村を東と西に分け、東部は奥飛騨温泉郷、西部は上宝町としました。奥飛騨温泉郷は、北アルプス（飛騨山脈）の麓に広がる、平湯、福地、新平湯、栃尾、新穂高の5つの温泉地。100以上の露天風呂があり、その数は日本一といわれています。上宝町は北アルプスの裾野、標高650mの高冷地にあり自然に育まれ農業と林業が盛んな場所です。奥飛騨温泉郷上宝町に是非お越しください。（奥飛騨温泉郷は高山市街地から車で約６０分／上宝町は平湯バスターミナルから車で約３０分）

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Okuhida Onsen Town Kamitakara
description: Okuhida Inn Hometown Landlady Azusa Nakano and Ms. Liao, who immigrated from Taiwan, will introduce you to the charms of the town. Okuhida Onsenkyo/Kamiho Town is located in the northeastern part of Takayama City. When the former Kamitokara Village merged with Takayama City, the village was divided into east and west, with the eastern part becoming Okuhida Onsenkyo and the western part Kamitakara Town. Okuhida Onsenkyo is a five hot spring resort located at the foot of the Northern Alps (Hida Mountains): Hirayu, Fukuchi, Shin-Hirayu, Tochio, and Shinhotaka. There are over 100 open-air baths, said to be the most in Japan. Kamitakara Town is located at the foot of the Northern Alps, at an altitude of 650 meters, and is a place where agriculture and forestry are flourishing, nurtured by nature. Please come to Okuhida Onsengo Kamitakaracho. (Okuhida Onsenkyo is approximately 60 minutes by car from downtown Takayama/Kamitaka Town is approximately 30 minutes by car from Hirayu Bus Terminal)

title: ReVIEW!#飛騨高山 国府町
description:
こくふ観光協会会長　北村家光さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
国府町は高山市の北部に位置する歴史と自然が息づく地域です。千数百年前、斐陀国の政治の中心地「国府」があった地と推測されるような数多くの文化財をみることができ、古くから栄えた地でした。この町では多くの古墳や石器時代の出土品をはじめ、安国寺経蔵（国宝）や清峯寺に伝わる円空仏など数々の文化財や歴史的建造物をみることができ、「日本遺産」を構成する文化財も含まれています。これらのものを通じて、懐かしさや、ぬくもりを感じることができるでしょう。また、周囲を美しい山々に囲まれており、四季折々の風景を楽しむことができます。特に春には、桜野公園の桜が見事に咲き、山里沿いの道が桃の花でピンクに染まり、美しい風景が広がります。この風景は「ピーチロード」として知られ、地元の人々にも親しまれています。さらに、標高1,200mの水源を持つ宇津江四十八滝に、数々の滝が点在し、清流や森林の中でトレッキングやピクニックを楽しむことができます。ここでの時間は心を癒してくれることでしょう。
国府町に是非お越しください。
（高山市街地から車で約20分）

Mr. Iemitsu Kitamura, chairman of the Kokufu Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town.
Kokufu Town is located in the northern part of Takayama City and is an area rich in history and nature. It has been a prosperous area since ancient times, with many cultural assets that can be seen, suggesting that it was the site of the Kokufu, the political center of Hidanokuni, over a thousand years ago. In this town, you can see many cultural assets and historical buildings, including many ancient tombs and excavated items from the Stone Age, as well as the Ankoku-ji Kyozo (national treasure) and the Enku Buddha handed down at Seiho-ji Temple, and is designated as a ``Japanese Heritage Site.'' It also includes the cultural assets that make up the area. Through these things, you will feel a sense of nostalgia and warmth. It is also surrounded by beautiful mountains, allowing you to enjoy the scenery of each season. Especially in spring, the cherry blossoms in Sakurano Park are in full bloom, and the roads along the mountain village are dyed pink with peach blossoms, creating a beautiful scenery. This scenery is known as "Peach Road" and is loved by locals. Furthermore, there are many waterfalls dotted around the Utsue Shijuhachi Falls, which have a water source at an altitude of 1,200m, and you can enjoy trekking and picnicking among the clear streams and forests. Your time here will soothe your soul.
Please come to Kokufu Town.
(About 20 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　朝日町
description: 鈴蘭高原カントリークラブ　松下瑛大さん、森本翔太さん、山川ひなさんが町の魅力をご紹介。朝日町は高山市の南東部に位置し、美しい自然環境が魅力の地域です。町内にはアウトドア初心者から楽しめるキャンプ場が多く点在しており、美しい自然を背景に様々なタイプのキャンプ場があるのが魅力。ここでは、普段の生活では味わえない自然を直接感じることができるため、最近注目を集めています。さらに、朝日町には御嶽山と乗鞍岳を望むことができる鈴蘭高原や美女高原など、美しい自然が広がっています。春には水芭蕉が咲き誇り、秋神川ではアマゴやイワナ釣りが楽しめます。また、冬には氷点下の森では幻想的なライトアップが行われ、人々を魅了しています。訪れた際には、道の駅ひだ朝日村で特産品である「よもぎ」も味わってみてください。春一番に収穫される「よもぎ」を使った豊富なメニューがあり、朝日町ならではの味を楽しむことができます。朝日町に是非お越しください。（高山市街地から車で約３０分）

title: ReVIEW! #Asahi Town, Hida Takayama
description: Suzuran Kogen Country Club Eidai Matsushita, Shota Morimoto, and Hina Yamakawa will introduce the charms of the town. Asahi Town is located in the southeastern part of Takayama City and is an attractive area with a beautiful natural environment. There are many campgrounds scattered around the town that can be enjoyed by those who are new to outdoor activities, and the appeal is that there are various types of campgrounds set against the backdrop of beautiful nature. It has been attracting a lot of attention recently because you can experience nature directly here, something you can't experience in your daily life. Furthermore, Asahi Town is home to beautiful nature, such as Suzuran Kogen and Bijo Kogen, where you can see Mt. Ontake and Mt. Norikura. Skunk cabbage is in full bloom in spring, and you can enjoy fishing for amago and char in the Akigami River. In addition, in winter, the sub-zero forest is lit up with fantastical lighting, which attracts people. When you visit, be sure to try the local specialty, mugwort, at the roadside station Hida Asahi Village. There is a wide variety of menu items that use mugwort, which is harvested first in spring, and you can enjoy the unique flavors of Asahi Town. Please come to Asahi Town. (About 30 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　荘川町
description: 荘川観光協会会長　渡邉武志さんと旅館経営　道下智恵さんが町の魅力をご紹介。荘川町は、高山市の西部に位置し、町の中心部の標高は約800mと高所にあり、1日の寒暖差は20℃以上になることもあります。この気候を活かして高冷地野菜が育まれ、清流の水を活かしたそばの栽培も盛んです。また、春には桜の花が咲き乱れ、色々な場所で美しい景色を見ることができます。なかでも、荘川桜と呼ばれる樹齢500年の桜は、「キセキの桜」として知られ、地域のシンボルとして親しまれています。また、荘川町には他にも魅力的なスポットが点在しています。飛騨地域の伝統的な家屋を見学できる荘川の里、さらには日本最大級の五連水車や巨大な石臼を見ることができるそばの里荘川など、歴史的な建造物や文化財が魅力的です。訪れた際には、ぜひ地元の名物である「荘川そば」も味わってみてください。荘川町の気候風土と清らかな庄川源流が育むこの蕎麦は、自然の恵みを受けた美味しさがあります。飛騨荘川の旅を心と体で満喫することができるでしょう。荘川町に是非お越しください。

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Shokawa Town
description: Takeshi Watanabe, chairman of the Shokawa Tourism Association, and Chie Michishita, an inn manager, will introduce the charms of the town. Shokawa Town is located in the western part of Takayama City, and the center of the town is located at a high altitude of approximately 800 meters, and the daily temperature difference can be more than 20 degrees Celsius. Taking advantage of this climate, high-temperature vegetables are grown, and buckwheat is also popularly grown using the clear water of the river. Also, in spring, cherry blossoms bloom profusely and you can see beautiful scenery in various places. Among them, the 500-year-old cherry tree called Shokawa Sakura is known as the 'Kiseki no Sakura' and is a beloved symbol of the region. Additionally, Shogawa Town is dotted with other attractive spots. Historic buildings and cultural properties are attractive, such as Shogawa no Sato, where you can see traditional houses from the Hida region, and Soba Sato Shogawa, where you can see Japan's largest five-wheeled water wheel and a huge stone mill. When you visit, be sure to try the local specialty, 'Shokawa Soba.' This soba is grown in the climate and natural features of Shogawa Town and the pure headwaters of the Shogawa River. It has a delicious taste that comes from the blessings of nature. You will be able to fully enjoy your trip along the Hidasho River with your mind and body. Please come to Shokawa Town.

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　丹生川町
description:
千光寺住職　大下真海さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
丹生川町は、高山市の北東部に位置する山岳地帯がある地域です。町を象徴するのが、日本百名山のひとつである乗鞍岳。標高3,000ｍ級の山にも関わらず、2,702mの畳平まで路線バスで行くことができるため、厳しいといわれる山岳の世界を子どもや女性でも気軽に体感することができます。７月から８月中旬にかけてバスターミナルのすぐ近くには天空のお花畑が広がり、希少な高山植物を観察できます。運が良ければ天然記念物のライチョウにも出会えるかもしれません。乗鞍岳の裾野に広がる五色ヶ原の森、観光鍾乳洞としては日本一標高が高い900ｍに位置する飛騨大鍾乳洞、
飛騨の英雄・両面宿儺伝説、神社めぐり豊かな田園風景が残る里山など乗鞍岳に抱かれる町、丹生川町には多様な見どころがあります。荘川町に是非お越しください。
（丹生川町は高山市街地から車で約15分／乗鞍岳山頂までは畳平から徒歩約90分）

Although the mountain is 3,000 meters above sea level, you can take a bus to Tatamidaira, which is 2,702 meters high, so even children and women can easily experience the harsh world of mountains. From July to mid-August, a field of flowers spreads out in the sky right next to the bus terminal, and you can observe rare alpine plants. If you're lucky, you might even come across a grouse, a natural monument. Goshikigahara Forest spreads out at the foot of Mt. Norikura, Hida Great Limestone Cave is located at 900m, the highest tourist limestone cave in Japan,
Nyukawa-cho, a town nestled in Mt. Norikura, has a variety of attractions, including the legend of Hida's hero, Ryōshuku-na, shrine visits, and a rural village with rich rural scenery. Please come to Shokawa Town.

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　高山市街地
description: 一般社団法人 飛騨・高山菅コンベンション協会　藤原一也さんが町の魅力をご紹介。高山市のほぼ中央に位置する高山市街地は歴史と文化が息づく町。江戸時代からの歴史的な建物が数多く保存され訪れた人がまるで江戸時代にタイムスリップしたような感覚が味わえる古い町並。日本三大朝市のひとつ、「宮川朝市」と「陣屋前朝市」では地元の農産物や工芸品などが並び、賑やかな朝の光景が特徴的です。毎年春と秋に行われる日本三大美祭のひとつとして知られる重厚な屋台や華やかな祭り装束に魅了される高山祭など数多くの観光スポットを併せ持つ地域になります。日本の原風景が感じられるこの地域は国際的にも有名で、多くの外国人観光客も訪れる人気のスポットです。高山市街地に是非お越しください。

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Takayama City Area
description: Kazuya Fujiwara of the Hida/Takayama Suga Convention Association will introduce the charms of the town. Takayama City, located almost in the center of Takayama City, is a town steeped in history and culture. The old townscape has many historic buildings from the Edo period preserved and visitors can feel as if they have traveled back in time to the Edo period. Miyagawa Morning Market and Jinya-mae Morning Market, one of Japan's three major morning markets, are characterized by a lively morning scene with local agricultural products and crafts lined up. The area is home to many tourist attractions, including the Takayama Festival, which is known as one of Japan's three most beautiful festivals and is held every spring and fall, with its stately stalls and gorgeous festival costumes. This area, where you can feel the original Japanese scenery, is internationally famous and is a popular spot visited by many foreign tourists. Please come to Takayama city area.

title: 御岳山と乗鞍岳を望む #飛騨高山 「高根町」
description:
明治から大正時代、貧しい飛騨から遠く信州へと糸引き稼ぎに行く娘たちが通った野麦街道を擁する「飛騨高根」。御岳山の北端、継子岳と乗鞍岳を望む、自然豊かなエリアです。大自然を生かしたキャンプ場も多く、秋には美しい紅葉が楽しめます。
夏でも涼しい高地の環境を生かし、アスリートたちがトレーニングに訪れる地として注目されています。また、その気候を活かして栽培される在来の品種「火畑そば」も人気！ぜひ、飛騨高根を訪れてみてはいかがでしょうか。

title: Mt. Ontake and Mt. Norikura View #Hida Takayama 'Takane Town'
description:
In the Meiji to Taisho era, 'Hida Takane' was a place where poor girls from Hida traveled far to Shinshu to earn a living along the Nomugi Highway. It is a nature-rich area that offers views of Mt. Ontake's northern edge, Mt. Kegusuko, and Mt. Norikura. There are many campsites that take advantage of the great outdoors, and in autumn, you can enjoy beautiful autumn leaves.
Taking advantage of the cool highland environment even in summer, it has gained attention as a place where athletes come to train. Additionally, the indigenous variety 'Hibata Soba' cultivated in this climate is also popular! Why not visit Hida Takane?

title: 秘境と神話が眠る町　#丹生川
description:
北アルプスの南端・乗鞍岳に抱かれる丹生川町。ライチョウが棲む乗鞍岳は、山岳の世界を気軽に体感させてくれます。その麓、五色が原には原生林が広がり、秘境の森が守られています。丹生川町は、トマトやホウレンソウの生産が盛んで、北アルプスから生まれる水で育った野菜はどれも滋味に溢れています。また、サイクリストが訪れる地でもあり、農山村の風景と乗鞍岳の絶景が魅了し、ペダルをこぐ脚には活力を与えます。四季の移ろいを魅せる農山村の風景はどこか懐かしく未来へと残したい宝物です。

title: A Town Where Hidden Realms and Myths Sleep #Niu River
description:
Niu River Town, nestled at the southern end of the Northern Alps, Mount Norikura. 
Mount Norikura, home to the Japanese rock ptarmigan, allows you to easily experience the world of mountains. 
At its foot, the Goshikigahara area is covered with primeval forests, protecting a hidden realm of woods. 
Niu River Town is known for its active production of tomatoes and spinach, and the vegetables grown with water from the Northern Alps are all rich in flavor. 
It is also a destination for cyclists, where the picturesque rural landscape and the breathtaking views of Mount Norikura captivate, energizing the legs that pedal. 
The changing scenery of the rural landscape through the seasons is a nostalgic treasure that we want to preserve for the future.

title: 城下町の面影薫る歴史と文化を凝縮した町　#飛騨高山
description:
城下町としての面影が色濃く残る高山市街地。江戸時代の風情が漂う古い町並や、国内に唯一現存する徳川幕府の遺構・高山陣屋、日下部民芸館など、高山市街には歴史を重ねた建物が数多く残されています。また、城下町を築き、高山城を拠点に藩政を行った武将・金森長近ゆかりの地を巡り、想いを馳せるのも趣があります。

title: A Town Condensed with History and Culture of the Castle Town #HidaTakayama
description: The city of Takayama retains a strong resemblance to its past as a castle town. The old streets exude the atmosphere of the Edo period, and numerous historical buildings remain in the city, including the Takayama Jinya, the only existing structure from the Tokugawa shogunate in Japan, and the Kusakabe Folk Museum. Additionally, exploring the sites associated with the samurai Kanamori Nagachika, who established the castle town and governed the domain from Takayama Castle, adds to the charm.

title: せせらぎが聴こえる町　#飛騨清見
description:
森に囲まれたおしゃれなカフェやレストランが点在する清見町は、洗練された雰囲気とのどかな自然が共存。町の中央を南北に縦断する全長64㎞の「飛騨美濃せせらぎ街道」は、格好のドライブルート。清流沿いで、初夏には新緑が輝きます。また、秋には紅葉の名所として知られ、標高差によって色づく場所が移り変わることで長期に渡り目を楽しませてくれます。

title: The Town Where You Can Hear the Murmuring Stream #HidaKiyomi
description:
Kiyomi Town, dotted with stylish cafes and restaurants surrounded by forests, is a place where a sophisticated atmosphere coexists with tranquil nature.
The 'Hida-Mino Seseragi Road,' which runs north-south through the center of the town for a total length of 64 km, is an ideal driving route.
Along the clear stream, fresh greenery shines in early summer.
In autumn, it is known as a famous spot for autumn leaves, and the changing colors due to the elevation differences provide a long-lasting visual delight.

#飛騨高山　#荘川蕎麦
description: 樹齢500年荘川桜が見守る歴史と自然が紡ぐ「荘川町」。山々に囲まれ、桜、新緑、紅葉、雪景色と季節ごとに美しい四季折々の絶景を楽しむことができます。清流の水を生かした蕎麦の栽培が盛んで、東京・名古屋方面から高山に向かう途中に立ち寄れるエリアです。清流庄川が流れる荘川町ではそばの花の栽培が盛んで、そばの里として有名。味、香り、のど越しが良く一口ごとに感じる風味と食感が絶品。荘川エリア内の飲食店などで味わうことができます。

title: Hida Takayama - Shokawa Soba
description: In 'Shokawa Town', where the 500-year-old Shokawa cherry blossoms watch over, history and nature weave together. Surrounded by mountains, you can enjoy beautiful seasonal views throughout the year, including cherry blossoms, fresh greenery, autumn leaves, and snowy landscapes. This area is known for its active cultivation of soba, utilizing the clear stream water, and is a stopover on the way to Takayama from Tokyo and Nagoya. Shokawa Town, where the clear Shokawa River flows, is famous for its soba flower cultivation. The taste, aroma, and texture are excellent, and you can savor it at restaurants in the Shokawa area.

title: #飛騨高山 帰りたくなる郷　#奥飛騨温泉郷
description: 平湯、福地、新平湯、栃尾、新穂高の５つの温泉地からなる奥飛騨温泉郷は、飛騨山脈(北アルプス)の麓に広がる歴史ある温泉郷。秘湯的な温泉地あり、賑やかな温泉地ありと多彩で、それぞれ野趣溢れる露天風呂があり、湯めぐりの醍醐味を感じさせてくれます。厳冬の雪国でもある奥飛騨では、雪見風呂をはじめ、白銀世界や氷のライトアップなど幻想的な冬の絶景を楽しむことができます。ぜひお越しください。

title: Hida Takayama: A Home You Want to Return To - Okuhida Onsen Village
description: Okuhida Onsengo is a historic hot spring town that is made up of five hot spring areas: Hirayu, Fukuchi, Shin-Hirayu, Tochio, and Shinhotaka, and is located at the foot of the Hida Mountains (Northern Alps). There are a variety of hot spring resorts, some hidden, some lively, and each has an open-air bath with a rustic feel, allowing you to experience the real pleasure of touring the hot springs. Okuhida is a snowy region with severe winters, and you can enjoy fantastic winter scenery such as snowy baths, the silver world, and ice illuminations. Please come by all means.

#Hirayu Onsen in #Okuhida Onsen Village

title: #飛騨高山　#氷点下の森
description: 幻想的な氷の世界♡冬ならではの絶景が楽しめる「氷点下の森」。昭和４６年から氷点下１０度の冬の自然を逆手に取り、制作を始め出来上がった氷の森は、昼間はブルー、夜は青、赤、緑とライトアップされ30年以上続く人気のイベントです。大自然の氷は、吸い込まれそうになるほど美しく、最高に癒しの空間♡特に寒い日には、シャボン玉が空中でどんどん白く凍っていき、地面に落ちても割れないという現象がおきるのだとか♪毎年2月の第二土曜には、「氷点下の森 氷祭り」が行われ、大勢の人でにぎわいます。ライトアップはもちろん、ミニコンサート等のイベントも盛りだくさん！今しか見ることができない絶景を見に、お出かけしてみてはいかがでしょうか。

title: 陣屋前で毎朝開催されている朝市が年末の期間限定で「年の瀬市」として､しめ縄･松飾りなど縁起物のお正月飾りが販売されます。木の枝に紅白のお餅を巻き付けた「花もち」などお正月準備に地元の方も多く訪れます。

The morning market held every morning at Jinya-mae will be held as 'New Year's Market' for a limited time at the end of the year, selling auspicious New Year's decorations such as shimekazari and pine decorations. Many locals visit for New Year's preparations, including 'Hanamochi,' which is rice cake wrapped around a branch.

ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　丹生川町
description:
千光寺住職　大下真海さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
丹生川町は、高山市の北東部に位置する山岳地帯がある地域です。町を象徴するのが、日本百名山のひとつである乗鞍岳。標高3,000ｍ級の山にも関わらず、2,702mの畳平まで路線バスで行くことができるため、厳しいといわれる山岳の世界を子どもや女性でも気軽に体感することができます。７月から８月中旬にかけてバスターミナルのすぐ近くには天空のお花畑が広がり、希少な高山植物を観察できます。運が良ければ天然記念物のライチョウにも出会えるかもしれません。乗鞍岳の裾野に広がる五色ヶ原の森、観光鍾乳洞としては日本一標高が高い900ｍに位置する飛騨大鍾乳洞、
飛騨の英雄・両面宿儺伝説、神社めぐり豊かな田園風景が残る里山など乗鞍岳に抱かれる町、丹生川町には多様な見どころがあります。荘川町に是非お越しください。
（丹生川町は高山市街地から車で約15分／乗鞍岳山頂までは畳平から徒歩約90分）

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　高山市街地
description: 一般社団法人 飛騨・高山菅コンベンション協会　藤原一也さんが町の魅力をご紹介。高山市のほぼ中央に位置する高山市街地は歴史と文化が息づく町。江戸時代からの歴史的な建物が数多く保存され訪れた人がまるで江戸時代にタイムスリップしたような感覚が味わえる古い町並。日本三大朝市のひとつ、「宮川朝市」と「陣屋前朝市」では地元の農産物や工芸品などが並び、賑やかな朝の光景が特徴的です。毎年春と秋に行われる日本三大美祭のひとつとして知られる重厚な屋台や華やかな祭り装束に魅了される高山祭など数多くの観光スポットを併せ持つ地域になります。日本の原風景が感じられるこの地域は国際的にも有名で、多くの外国人観光客も訪れる人気のスポットです。高山市街地に是非お越しください。

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Takayama City Area
description: Kazuya Fujiwara of the Hida/Takayama Suga Convention Association will introduce the charms of the town. Takayama City, located almost in the center of Takayama City, is a town steeped in history and culture. The old townscape has many historic buildings from the Edo period preserved and visitors can feel as if they have traveled back in time to the Edo period. Miyagawa Morning Market and Jinya-mae Morning Market, one of Japan's three major morning markets, are characterized by a lively morning scene with local agricultural products and crafts lined up. The area is home to many tourist attractions, including the Takayama Festival, which is known as one of Japan's three most beautiful festivals and is held every spring and fall, with its stately stalls and gorgeous festival costumes. This area, where you can feel the original Japanese scenery, is internationally famous and is a popular spot visited by many foreign tourists. Please come to Takayama city area.

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　奥飛騨温泉郷上宝町
description: Okuhidaの宿 故郷 女将 中野梓さんと台湾から移住されたリャオさんが町の魅力をご紹介。奥飛騨温泉郷・上宝町は高山市の北東部に位置しています。旧上宝村が高山市と合併した際、村を東と西に分け、東部は奥飛騨温泉郷、西部は上宝町としました。奥飛騨温泉郷は、北アルプス（飛騨山脈）の麓に広がる、平湯、福地、新平湯、栃尾、新穂高の5つの温泉地。100以上の露天風呂があり、その数は日本一といわれています。上宝町は北アルプスの裾野、標高650mの高冷地にあり自然に育まれ農業と林業が盛んな場所です。奥飛騨温泉郷上宝町に是非お越しください。（奥飛騨温泉郷は高山市街地から車で約６０分／上宝町は平湯バスターミナルから車で約３０分）

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Okuhida Onsenkyo Kamitakaracho
description: Okuhida Inn Hometown Landlady Azusa Nakano and Ms. Liao, who immigrated from Taiwan, will introduce you to the charms of the town. Okuhida Onsenkyo/Kamiho Town is located in the northeastern part of Takayama City. When the former Kamitokara Village merged with Takayama City, the village was divided into east and west, with the eastern part becoming Okuhida Onsenkyo and the western part Kamitakara Town. Okuhida Onsenkyo is a five hot spring resort located at the foot of the Northern Alps (Hida Mountains): Hirayu, Fukuchi, Shin-Hirayu, Tochio, and Shinhotaka. There are over 100 open-air baths, said to be the most in Japan. Kamitakara Town is located at the foot of the Northern Alps, at an altitude of 650 meters, and is a place where agriculture and forestry are flourishing, nurtured by nature. Please come to Okuhida Onsengo Kamitakaracho. (Okuhida Onsenkyo is approximately 60 minutes by car from downtown Takayama/Kamitaka Town is approximately 30 minutes by car from Hirayu Bus Terminal)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　朝日町
description: 鈴蘭高原カントリークラブ　松下瑛大さん、森本翔太さん、山川ひなさんが町の魅力をご紹介。朝日町は高山市の南東部に位置し、美しい自然環境が魅力の地域です。町内にはアウトドア初心者から楽しめるキャンプ場が多く点在しており、美しい自然を背景に様々なタイプのキャンプ場があるのが魅力。ここでは、普段の生活では味わえない自然を直接感じることができるため、最近注目を集めています。さらに、朝日町には御嶽山と乗鞍岳を望むことができる鈴蘭高原や美女高原など、美しい自然が広がっています。春には水芭蕉が咲き誇り、秋神川ではアマゴやイワナ釣りが楽しめます。また、冬には氷点下の森では幻想的なライトアップが行われ、人々を魅了しています。訪れた際には、道の駅ひだ朝日村で特産品である「よもぎ」も味わってみてください。春一番に収穫される「よもぎ」を使った豊富なメニューがあり、朝日町ならではの味を楽しむことができます。朝日町に是非お越しください。（高山市街地から車で約３０分）

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Asahi Town
description: Suzuran Kogen Country Club Eidai Matsushita, Shota Morimoto, and Hina Yamakawa will introduce the charms of the town. Asahi Town is located in the southeastern part of Takayama City and is an attractive area with a beautiful natural environment. There are many campgrounds scattered around the town that can be enjoyed by those who are new to outdoor activities, and the appeal is that there are various types of campgrounds set against the backdrop of beautiful nature. It has been attracting a lot of attention recently because you can experience nature directly here, something you can't experience in your daily life. Furthermore, Asahi Town is home to beautiful nature, such as Suzuran Kogen and Bijo Kogen, where you can see Mt. Ontake and Mt. Norikura. Skunk cabbage is in full bloom in spring, and you can enjoy fishing for amago and char in the Akigami River. In addition, in winter, the sub-zero forest is lit up with fantastical lighting, which attracts people. When you visit, be sure to try the local specialty, mugwort, at the roadside station Hida Asahi Village. There is a wide variety of menu items that use mugwort, which is harvested first in spring, and you can enjoy the unique flavors of Asahi Town. Please come to Asahi Town. (About 30 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: ReVIEW!#飛騨高山 国府町
description: こくふ観光協会会長　北村家光さんが町の魅力をご紹介。国府町は高山市の北部に位置する歴史と自然が息づく地域です。千数百年前、斐陀国の政治の中心地「国府」があった地と推測されるような数多くの文化財をみることができ、古くから栄えた地でした。この町では多くの古墳や石器時代の出土品をはじめ、安国寺経蔵（国宝）や清峯寺に伝わる円空仏など数々の文化財や歴史的建造物をみることができ、「日本遺産」を構成する文化財も含まれています。これらのものを通じて、懐かしさや、ぬくもりを感じることができるでしょう。また、周囲を美しい山々に囲まれており、四季折々の風景を楽しむことができます。特に春には、桜野公園の桜が見事に咲き、山里沿いの道が桃の花でピンクに染まり、美しい風景が広がります。この風景は「ピーチロード」として知られ、地元の人々にも親しまれています。さらに、標高1,200mの水源を持つ宇津江四十八滝に、数々の滝が点在し、清流や森林の中でトレッキングやピクニックを楽しむことができます。ここでの時間は心を癒してくれることでしょう。国府町に是非お越しください。（高山市街地から車で約20分）

title: ReVIEW!#Kokufu Town, Takayama
description: Mr. Iemitsu Kitamura, chairman of the Kokufu Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town. Kokufu Town is located in the northern part of Takayama City and is an area rich in history and nature. It has been a prosperous area since ancient times, with many cultural assets that can be seen, suggesting that it was the site of the Kokufu, the political center of Hidanokuni, over a thousand years ago. In this town, you can see many cultural assets and historical buildings, including many ancient tombs and excavated items from the Stone Age, as well as the Ankoku-ji Kyozo (national treasure) and the Enku Buddha handed down at Seiho-ji Temple, and is designated as a 'Japanese Heritage Site.' It also includes the cultural assets that make up the area. Through these things, you will feel a sense of nostalgia and warmth. It is also surrounded by beautiful mountains, allowing you to enjoy the scenery of each season. Especially in spring, the cherry blossoms in Sakurano Park are in full bloom, and the roads along the mountain village are dyed pink with peach blossoms, creating a beautiful scenery. This scenery is known as 'Peach Road' and is loved by locals. Furthermore, there are many waterfalls dotted around the Utsue Shijuhachi Falls, which have a water source at an altitude of 1,200m, and you can enjoy trekking and picnicking among the clear streams and forests. Your time here will soothe your soul. Please come to Kokufu Town. (About 20 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　久々野町
description: 飛騨舟山スノーリゾートアルコピアひまわり園代表　桐山淳一さんが町の魅力をご紹介。久々野町は、高山市の南部に位置し、美しい自然の風景が広がる地域です。この町は果物や野菜の生産が盛んで、「ひだ桃源郷」とも呼ばれるほどです。春になると、果物の花が咲き誇り、まるで夢のような風景が広がります。特に「飛騨りんご」や「飛騨もも」、「飛騨なし」、「飛騨メロン」などが特産品として有名です。なかでも、飛騨りんごを使った「アップルパイ」は大変人気で、発売するとすぐに完売してしまうほど。久々野町随一の名産品にまで成長しました。また、アルコピアスキー場跡地では毎年8月にひまわり園がオープンします。約20万本のひまわりが一面に咲き誇り、久々野町の新たな観光スポットとして注目を集めています。さらに、8月中旬にはくぐの納涼夏まつりが開催され尺玉が夜空を飾り、山々に轟音を響かせる必見のイベントになっています。久々野町に是非お越しください。（高山市街地から車で約３０分）

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Kuguno Town
description: Junichi Kiriyama, representative of Hida Funayama Snow Resort Alcopia Sunflower Garden, will introduce the charms of the town. Kuguno Town is located in the southern part of Takayama City and is an area with beautiful natural scenery. This town is famous for its fruit and vegetable production, and is even called the 'Hida Peach Source Village.' In spring, the fruit flowers bloom, creating a dream-like landscape. Especially 'Hida apple', 'Hida peach', 'Hida no', 'Hida melon', etc. It is famous as a specialty product. In particular, the 'Apple Pie' made with Hida apples is extremely popular and sells out as soon as it goes on sale. It has grown to become one of Kuguno Town's most famous products. Additionally, a sunflower garden opens every August on the site of the former Alcopia Ski Resort. Approximately 200,000 sunflowers are in full bloom, attracting attention as a new tourist spot in Kuguno Town. Furthermore, in mid-August, the Kugu Summer Summer Festival is held, where shakudama floats decorate the night sky and their roars echo through the mountains, making it a must-see event. Please come to Kuguno Town. (About 30 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　高根町
description:
飛騨高根観光協会会長　小坂守さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
高根町は高山市の南東に位置し、乗鞍岳と御嶽山を望み大自然に囲まれた高地にあります。長野県木曽地域に隣接しているため、歴史や文化、風俗に至るまで木曽の影響を色濃く受けており、飛騨の中でも異郷の地として知られています。高根町は木曽馬の産地だったことでも有名であり、馬の供養のために作られた石仏には、人と馬との物語が込められています。高根町では発酵食品に力を入れており、廃校を再利用したウイスキー蒸溜所は大きな話題を集めています。また、塩を一切使わず乳酸菌で漬けられた「すな」や、飛騨の郷土料理によく使われる田舎味噌なども盛んに作られています。この地域特有の涼しい夏と寒冷な冬の環境が、これらの発酵食品の育成に役立っています。その他には火畑そばやタカネコーン、野麦峠や御嶽山など様々な見どころがあるユニークな場所になっています。
高根町に是非お越しください。
（高山市街地から車で約５０分）

Mamoru Kosaka, chairman of the Hida Takane Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town.
Takane Town is located in the southeast of Takayama City, on a highland surrounded by nature overlooking Mt. Norikura and Mt. Ontake. Because it is adjacent to the Kiso region of Nagano Prefecture, its history, culture, and customs are strongly influenced by Kiso, and it is known as a foreign place even within Hida. Takane Town is also famous for being a production area for Kiso horses, and the stone Buddha statues made for memorial services for horses are filled with stories between people and horses. Takane Town is putting a lot of effort into fermented foods, and its whiskey distillery, which was repurposed from an abandoned school, is attracting a lot of attention. In addition, suna, which is pickled with lactic acid bacteria without using any salt, and country miso, which is often used in Hida's local cuisine, are also actively produced. The region's unique cool summers and cold winters are conducive to growing these fermented foods. It is also a unique place with many other attractions such as Hibata Soba, Takane Corn, Nomai Pass, and Mt. Ontake.
Please come to Takane Town.
(Approximately 50 minutes by car from Takayama city center)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　荘川町
description: 荘川観光協会会長　渡邉武志さんと旅館経営　道下智恵さんが町の魅力をご紹介。荘川町は、高山市の西部に位置し、町の中心部の標高は約800mと高所にあり、1日の寒暖差は20℃以上になることもあります。この気候を活かして高冷地野菜が育まれ、清流の水を活かしたそばの栽培も盛んです。また、春には桜の花が咲き乱れ、色々な場所で美しい景色を見ることができます。なかでも、荘川桜と呼ばれる樹齢500年の桜は、「キセキの桜」として知られ、地域のシンボルとして親しまれています。また、荘川町には他にも魅力的なスポットが点在しています。飛騨地域の伝統的な家屋を見学できる荘川の里、さらには日本最大級の五連水車や巨大な石臼を見ることができるそばの里荘川など、歴史的な建造物や文化財が魅力的です。訪れた際には、ぜひ地元の名物である「荘川そば」も味わってみてください。荘川町の気候風土と清らかな庄川源流が育むこの蕎麦は、自然の恵みを受けた美味しさがあります。飛騨荘川の旅を心と体で満喫することができるでしょう。荘川町に是非お越しください。（高山市街地から車で約５０分）

title: ReVIEW! #Hida Takayama Shokawa Town
description: Takeshi Watanabe, chairman of the Shokawa Tourism Association, and Chie Michishita, an inn manager, will introduce the charms of the town. Shokawa Town is located in the western part of Takayama City, and the center of the town is located at a high altitude of approximately 800 meters, and the daily temperature difference can be more than 20 degrees Celsius. Taking advantage of this climate, high-temperature vegetables are grown, and buckwheat is also popularly grown using the clear water of the river. Also, in spring, cherry blossoms bloom profusely and you can see beautiful scenery in various places. Among them, the 500-year-old cherry tree called Shokawa Sakura is known as the 'Kiseki no Sakura' and is a beloved symbol of the region. Additionally, Shogawa Town is dotted with other attractive spots. Historic buildings and cultural properties are attractive, such as Shogawa no Sato, where you can see traditional houses from the Hida region, and Soba Sato Shogawa, where you can see Japan's largest five-wheeled water wheel and a huge stone mill. When you visit, be sure to try the local specialty, 'Shokawa Soba.' This soba is grown in the climate and natural features of Shogawa Town and the pure headwaters of the Shogawa River. It has a delicious taste that comes from the blessings of nature. You will be able to fully enjoy your trip along the Hidasho River with your mind and body. Please come to Shokawa Town. (Approximately 50 minutes by car from Takayama city center)

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　一之宮町
description:
飛騨一之宮観光協会会長　稲子盛雄さんが町の魅力をご紹介。
一之宮町は、高山市の南部に位置する歴史と伝統が息づく地域。美しい自然に囲まれており、その環境を活かした農業体験や地元の人たちとのふれあい体験ができるグリーンツーリズムが盛んな地域です。なかでも、飛騨一宮水無神社は飛騨の国で最も格式高い神社とされ、地域に住む人たちの信仰を集め敬われています。他にも内閣府認定のどぶろく特区、樹齢1,100年の臥龍桜、分水嶺が見られる位山の散策やウィンタースポーツなど様々なジャンルを見て感じることができます。
一之宮町に是非お越しください。
（高山市街地から車で約２０分）

Among them, Hida Ichinomiya Mizunashi Shrine is considered to be the most prestigious shrine in Hida, and is worshiped and revered by the people living in the area. You can also see and experience a variety of other genres, such as the Cabinet Office-certified Doburoku Special Zone, the 1,100-year-old Garyu Cherry Tree, a walk on Mt. Iyama where you can see the watershed, and winter sports.
Please come to Ichinomiya Town.
(About 20 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

title: #飛騨高山 #飛騨国府　#里山　#サイクリング で田園風景を駆け抜ける
description: ～田園風景や飛騨国府の大自然をサイクリングで巡る～ 日本の原風景が色濃く残る飛騨国府。山々に囲まれ宇津江四十八滝など自然の名所や絶景ポイントが点在し、見どころ満載のエリアです。いつもの観光とはちょっと違うサイクリングツアーが体験ができる「Flying Peaks」。自動車が通れない道を走り、森林の香りや鳥のさえずり、爽快な風など五感で飛騨高山の魅力を満喫できます。飛騨高山を愛する地元ガイドと一緒に電動自転車『E-bike』で巡るので安心♪都会にはない美しい景色を駆け抜ける感動はここでしかできない体験です。

title: #Hida Takayama #Hida Kokufu #Satoyama #Cycling through the countryside
description: Cycling through the countryside and nature of Hida Kokufu. Hida Kokufu is a place where the original scenery of Japan remains. Surrounded by mountains and dotted with natural attractions and scenic spots such as the Utsue 48 Falls, it is an area full of things to see. 'Flying Peaks' allows you to experience a cycling tour that is a little different from the usual sightseeing. You can enjoy the charm of Hida Takayama with all five senses, such as the scent of the forest, the chirping of birds, and the refreshing breeze as you drive along roads that are closed to cars. You can feel at ease as you will be touring around Hida Takayama on an electric bicycle 'E-bike' with a local guide who loves Hida Takayama. The thrill of riding through beautiful scenery that cannot be found in the city is an experience that can only be found here.

title: #飛騨高山 #安国寺 #日本遺産
description: Ankokujiは飛騨エリア唯一の国宝建造物です。室町幕府を開いた足利尊氏とその兄弟直義によって、1345年に国土の平穏を願って建立されました。安国寺の経典は日本遺産構成文化財の一つです。内部の八角輪蔵は日本で現存する最古の輪蔵であり、明から入手した元版大蔵経（現存2000帖余り）が納められています。仏を念じながら八角輪蔵を回転させると、一切経を全部読んだのと同じご利益があると言われており、ここでしか見ることができない貴重な文化財です。

title: Hida Takayama Ankokuji Japan Heritage
description: Ankokuji is the only national treasure building in the Hida area. It was built in 1345 by Takauji Ashikaga, who founded the Muromachi Shogunate, and his brother Tadayoshi in hopes of bringing peace to the country. The scriptures of Ankokuji Temple are one of the cultural assets that constitute Japan Heritage. The octagonal rinzo inside is the oldest existing rinzo in Japan, containing the original version of the Tripitaka (more than 2,000 chapters in existence) obtained from the Ming Dynasty. It is said that if you rotate the Octagonal Rinzo while remembering the Buddha, you will receive the same benefits as if you read all the sutras, and it is a valuable cultural property that can only be seen here.

title: #飛騨高山 #宇津江四十八滝 を #トレッキング

``Utsue 48 Falls'' is a healing spot filled with negative ions, surrounded by countless waterfalls large and small. This natural park has been selected as one of Gifu Prefecture's top 50 famous waters. In the midst of rich nature, you can listen to the sound of water and take a leisurely stroll around 13 waterfalls. Among them, "Otaki" is 18.8m high, and the white water falling down the rock face is very impressive! It takes about an hour from the starting point of the waterfall tour to the goal point, Shijuhachitaki Plateau. You can see the Northern Alps from the observation deck along the way. Please enjoy the beauty of nature that can only be enjoyed in Kokufu Town.

description: 郡上市八幡町から高山市清見町三日町を結ぶ「飛騨美濃せせらぎ街道」。夏は新緑、秋は紅葉と季節の美しい景色を楽しむことができるドライブルートです。西ウレ峠やおおくら滝遊歩道など道沿いには、自然を満喫できる遊歩道も整備されており気軽に散策できるのも嬉しいポイント♪五平餅や雰囲気抜群のカフェが道中に点在しているので立ち寄りながらのドライブがオススメです。これからの時期は爽やかな風を感じながら、美しい山々と森林の絶景が楽しめます。

title: Hida-Mino Seseragi Kaido Drive
description: Hida-Mino Seseragi Kaido connects Yahata-cho, Gujo City to Mikkamachi, Kiyomi-cho, Takayama City. This is a driving route where you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of each season, with fresh greenery in the summer and autumn leaves in the fall. Along the way, there are promenades where you can fully enjoy nature, such as the Nishiure Pass and Okura Falls Promenade, so you can easily take a walk. Stop by at Gohei Mochi and cafes with a great atmosphere dotted along the way. We recommend driving while doing so. From now on, you can enjoy the breathtaking views of the beautiful mountains and forests while feeling the refreshing breeze.

title: 文化と民話が根付く飛騨のふるさと#岐阜県  #飛騨高山 「国府町」
description:
日本一面積が広い市である高山市は、町のすみずみまでたくさんの見どころに溢れています。飛騨高山を織りなすエリアにフォーカスしご紹介！
知られざる逸話やその場所でしか味わえない体験など、飛騨高山ならではの多彩な魅力を掘り下げます。私たちの町、飛騨高山へようこそ

飛騨国府は、千数百年前、斐陀国(ひだのくに）の中心地「国府」として栄えました。風が香り、風が色づく、風の郷。土が香り、土が色づく、土の郷。季が香り、季が色づく、季の郷。飛騨路を北へたどると、なつかしい、ぬくもりに満ちた郷「飛騨国府」があります。初めて訪れた地なのに、なぜか不思議と懐かしさに包まれます。日本の原風景が色濃く残る歴史、民俗、自然をたずねて、この地になぜ「国府」が置かれたのかを実感できる旅となることでしょう。

title: #飛騨高山 #新伝統工芸 #iPhone ケース制作
description:
飛騨高山に今も息づく匠の技。木を知り、漆を操り、土石を生活に活かす「技」として受け継がれ、やがて「匠」として呼ばれるようになったその技は今日も継承され磨かれつづけています。 さらに、現代のライフスタイルに合わせ、飛騨の匠の技を継承した新しいカタチで創り出される「新伝統工芸」。流行や目新しさに留まらない、伝統工芸の新しい可能性を秘めています。

「飛騨の匠」の技と魂を現代のライフスタイルに合わせて提案する飛騨新伝統工芸「ノクターレ」。
ノクターレは、飛騨春慶や一位一刀彫、山中和紙などの伝統工芸を今の時代に、現代のライフスタイルに合わせた商品を従来の概念にとらわれず作り出し、新しいユーザー層を獲得しています。中でも一押しは、鷲塚彫刻とコラボレーションした一位一刀彫のデザインが手に馴染むスマートフォンケース(iPhone14)。天然木を使用し、木目を活用したデザインが特徴です。スマートフォン本体の形状に究極まで沿わせたケース設計にこだわり、薄く忠実に削りだすノクターレの木工技術と一位一刀彫の匠の技が歪みなくスマートフォンをケースに装着することができます。永く使い込むほどに美しさや味わいが増すスマートフォンケースで、新伝統工芸を生活に取り入れてみてはいかがでしょうか。

title: #Hida Takayama #New Traditional Crafts #iPhone Case Production
description:
The craftsmanship that still thrives in Hida Takayama. 
The knowledge of wood, the manipulation of lacquer, and the utilization of clay and stone have been passed down as 'techniques' and eventually came to be known as 'craftsmanship.' This skill continues to be inherited and refined today. 
Furthermore, in line with modern lifestyles, 'New Traditional Crafts' are created in a new form that inherits the techniques of Hida's artisans. It holds new possibilities for traditional crafts that go beyond trends and novelty.

Introducing Hida's craftsmanship and spirit in a way that aligns with modern lifestyles, Hida's New Traditional Craft 'Nocturne.' 
Nocturne creates products that align with contemporary lifestyles, breaking away from conventional concepts, using traditional crafts such as Hida Shunkei, Ichii Ittobori, and Yamanaka Washi, and has gained a new user base. 
Among them, the highlight is the smartphone case (iPhone 14) designed in collaboration with Washizuka Sculpture, featuring the Ichii Ittobori design that fits comfortably in hand. 
Using natural wood, it features a design that utilizes the wood grain. 
The case design is committed to closely following the shape of the smartphone body, and Nocturne's woodworking techniques and the craftsmanship of Ichii Ittobori allow for a distortion-free attachment of the smartphone to the case. 
As you use it over time, the beauty and character of the smartphone case will increase. Why not incorporate New Traditional Crafts into your life?

title: #Hida Takayama Autumn #Takayama Festival (#Hachiman Festival)
description:
The Autumn Takayama Festival (Hachiman Festival) is the annual festival of Sakurayama Hachiman Shrine, held on October 9th and 10th each year. Additionally, the Spring Takayama Festival (Sanno Festival) is the annual festival of Hie Shrine, held on April 14th and 15th each year. The Takayama Festival refers to these two festivals collectively and is recognized as one of Japan's three great beautiful festivals, cherished and preserved by the people of Takayama.

During the Autumn Takayama Festival, 11 'Yatai' (festival floats), also known as the moving Yomeimon, are paraded, showcasing their splendid and extravagant appearance. Furthermore, a festival procession consisting of hundreds of participants dressed in traditional costumes, including Tokeiraku (a traditional performance) and Kamishimo (formal attire), moves through the festival area, led by music, gagaku (Japanese classical music), and lion dances. At night, each float lights up with approximately 100 lanterns, beautifully illuminating the darkness. The Takayama Festival, where the spirit of the Hida people rises, is an unwavering pride of Takayama.

title: #Hida Takayama #Ookura Falls
description: A comfortable driving route that runs north and south through the center of Kiyomi Town, where you can feel the breath of nature, the Hida Seseragi Road. Along this road is the 'Ookura Falls Forest Park.' In the deciduous broadleaf forest, you can see natural forests of Mizunara and beech trees. title: #乗鞍スカイライン を電動自転車でサイクリング
description: 平湯峠と乗鞍岳畳平を結ぶ延長14.4キロメートルの山岳観光道路「乗鞍スカイライン」。乗鞍岳のバスターミナルは標高2702ｍ、バスで走れる標高としては日本一の高さを誇ります。乗鞍スカイラインはバスだけでなく自転車で登ることができる絶景ロード。奥飛騨の玄関口の平湯バスターミナルから徒歩2分にある「モビリティステーション奥飛騨」で電動アシスト付自転車をレンタルして出発♪どこか神秘的な山間を走り抜け、ひんやりとした空気を感じながらどんどん登ります。雲上の絶景を眺めながらのサイクリングは気分も最高♡ゴールまでラスト5キロ地点は標高2400ｍ以上と空気も薄くなり、ダイナミックで雄大な九十九折りのロードが続きます。バスでは体験できない乗鞍の空気、絶景を楽しみながら乗鞍畳平を目指してみてはいかがでしょうか。

title: #Cycling on the Norikura Skyline with an Electric Bicycle
description: The Norikura Skyline is a scenic mountain road that connects Hirayu Pass and Norikura-dake Tatamidaira, extending 14.4 kilometers. The bus terminal at Norikura-dake is at an elevation of 2702 meters, making it the highest point in Japan accessible by bus. The Norikura Skyline is not only accessible by bus but also offers a breathtaking road for cycling. Rent an electric assist bicycle at 'Mobility Station Okuhida', just a 2-minute walk from the Hirayu Bus Terminal, and set off! Ride through the mystical mountain valleys, feeling the cool air as you ascend. Cycling while enjoying the breathtaking views above the clouds is an incredible experience! The last 5 kilometers to the goal is above 2400 meters, where the air becomes thin, and a dynamic and grand series of switchbacks continues. Why not aim for Norikura Tatamidaira while enjoying the unique air and stunning views that you can't experience by bus?

title: 2022 Spring Takayama Festival - Sanno Festival
description:
The Spring Takayama Festival (Sanno Festival) is the annual festival of Hie Shrine, the guardian deity of the southern half of the old Takayama castle town, held on April 14 and 15 each year. The origins of the festival date back to the time of the Hida feudal lord Kanamori, and the beginnings of the floats are said to be around 1718. The festival showcases the skillful movements of karakuri puppets and features mechanisms such as the returning wheel, highlighting the craftsmanship of artisans.
The 2022 Spring Takayama Festival unfortunately experienced rainy weather, but during breaks in the rain, the floats could be seen coming out of the storehouses and passing through the old town streets.

title: Hida Takayama's Local Cuisine: Red Turnip Pickles
description: In the Hida region, where winters are extremely cold, people cannot grow fresh vegetables. Therefore, locals like to eat pickles, the preserved vegetables, in winter. Due to the large temperature difference in Takayama, the turnips grown here are sweet, juicy and have plenty of umami. The salt-based red turnip that has been aged for a long time by lactic acid fermentation is characterized by the umami and slight acidity of fermentation. Only the skin of the freshly harvested red turnip is red and it is basically white inside, therefore Takayama people intentionally dye the color to red and finally it become the famous Red Turnip Pickles in Takayama, a traditional food of Hida region from the Edo period.

title: 長岡市「和島」観光PR動画　～そのぬくもりにあいに行く。～
description:
歴史・美しい景色・芸術・美味が集まり、長岡市の和島地域の中で隣り合う観光スポット「はちすば通り」と「道の駅 良寛の里わしま」をご紹介します。

良寛ゆかりの史跡が点在し、貞心尼と歩いたであろう板塀の小路をはじめ、紅葉が美しいかえで林や茶室、ロダンや高村光太郎などの作品を展示する美術館、特産のガンジーミルクを使ったソフトクリームや郷土料理を味わえる道の駅などが、1kmあまりの距離にあり歩いて巡ることができます。

title: Nagaoka City 'Washima' Tourism PR Video - Come to Experience Its Warmth.
description:
This video introduces the tourist spots 'Hachisuba Street' and 'Road Station Ryochan no Sato Washima' located next to each other in the Washima area of Nagaoka City, where history, beautiful scenery, art, and delicious food come together.

You can walk around and visit various historical sites related to Ryoan, including the narrow path with wooden fences that was likely walked by Teishin-ni, beautiful maple forests with autumn leaves, a tea room, an art museum displaying works by Rodin and Takamura Kotaro, and a road station where you can enjoy soft serve ice cream made with local Ghandi milk and regional cuisine, all within a distance of just over 1 km.

title: 湯あかり10周年記念動画
description: 黒川温泉の竹害対策として始まった湯あかりは今年（2022年）で10周年。今では南小国町全体に湯あかりが広がり、里山の風景を優しく灯しています。仄かな灯りと自然の風景、そして温泉を楽しみに南小国町に遊びに来ていただけますと幸いです。

title: Yuuakari 10th Anniversary Video
description: Yuuakari, which started as a bamboo damage countermeasure in Kurokawa Onsen, celebrates its 10th anniversary this year (2022). Now, Yuuakari has spread throughout Minamioguni Town, gently illuminating the satoyama landscape. We hope you will come to Minamioguni Town to enjoy the soft lights, natural scenery, and hot springs.

title: 人が、時間が、きよらかな郷。南小国（long ver.）
description:
熊本県の阿蘇郡にある南小国町。黒川温泉をはじめ、多くの温泉地が点在する里山です。
そんな里山で観光業に携わる方々の働く想いを動画でご紹介させていただいております。
住んでいる、働いている人からみた南小国町の魅力を知っていただけますと幸いです。

title: A Clear Village of People and Time: Minamioguni (long ver.)
description:
Minamioguni Town, located in Aso District, Kumamoto Prefecture. It is a rural area dotted with many hot springs, including Kurokawa Onsen.
In this rural area, we are introducing the thoughts and efforts of those involved in the tourism industry through video.
We hope you can learn about the charm of Minamioguni Town from the perspective of those who live and work here.

title: KIYORA STYLE2
description:
何もない町だけど、大切なものに気づかさせてくれる場所。
朝起きて、深く息を吸い込むと気持ちい風が体の中に、
生きていることを実感できる自然が溢れる南小国町に遊びにいらしてください。

title: KIYORA STYLE2
description:
It's a town with nothing, but it's a place that makes you realize what's important.
Come visit Minamioguni Town, where you can feel the refreshing breeze fill your body when you wake up in the morning,
and nature overflows, allowing you to truly experience being alive.

title: 人が、時間が、きよらかな郷。南小国
description: 黒川温泉を初め、田の原温泉、小田温泉など多くの温泉地を誇る阿蘇郡の南小国町。里山の風景を守る人々、お客様をお迎えする人々の姿を紹介する動画です。人が作り出す懐かしくてあったかい雰囲気。ほっと落ち着く時間を過ごしにいらして下さい。

title: A Clear Village of People and Time: Minamioguni
description: Minamioguni Town in Aso District boasts many hot spring areas, including Kurokawa Onsen, Tanahara Onsen, and Oda Onsen. This video introduces the people who protect the satoyama landscape and those who welcome guests. A nostalgic and warm atmosphere created by people. Please come and spend a relaxing time.

description:

Located at the western end of the Shimane Peninsula, about 7km northwest of Izumo Taisha, this shrine has been said to be a shrine that protects the night.  At this sunset festival (Hinomisaki Shrine annual festival, Shinko Shinto ritual), we pray once a year to the setting sun from Fumishima, a sanctuary where only priests can set foot.

description:
冬の坂戸山をハイキングすることは、雪国の晴れた日に新鮮な空気と素晴らしい景色を楽しむための素晴らしいアクティビティです！

山の頂上は634メートル（東京スカイツリーと同じ高さ）で、JR六日町駅からわずか20分の距離です。坂戸城跡は日本の封建時代の歴史的な重要性を持ち、今日では町からのアクセスが良く、季節ごとに変わる美しい景色のおかげで、最も人気のあるハイキングスポットとなっています。

多くの地元住民は、天候に関係なくここを毎日ハイキングします。その結果、冬でも人々の足跡から山を登るための明確なハイキング道が作られ、坂戸山は冬のハイキングを試すのに最適な場所となります！

*南魚沼を訪れる際は、ソーシャルディスタンスを守り、混雑した場所や閉じられた空間ではマスクを着用して他の人に配慮してください。ありがとうございます。

title: ヌカガマ：日本の釜炊きご飯 | 雪国の冒険 | 南魚沼
description: 新鮮なコシヒカリを伝統的な「ヌカガマ」釜で炊くことは、その素晴らしい味を引き出すための最良の方法かもしれません！その後、美味しいご飯は天ぷら丼や塩おにぎりで存分に楽しむことができます！

title: Harvesting Koshihikari Rice | Adventures in Yukiguni | Minamiuonuma
description: The autumn rice harvest in Minamiuonuma City, Niigata, the birthplace of Japan's famous Koshihikari rice variety! The Koshihikari rice variety was developed in the early 1950s but was very weak and susceptible to rice blight so it could not be reliably cultivated. However, thanks to the efforts of a handful of persistent farmers living in the Uonuma & Minamiuonuma areas the crop was enhanced and has become the most popular rice variety grown in Japan today. While the Koshihikari variety can now be found in markets around the world, the rice grown in its original climate here in the Yukiguni region is regarded as some of the finest produce Japan has to offer. The harvest usually occurs in September (or early October) and gives the town a new energy that is appreciated by both locals and visitors coming to purchase this fresh rice in droves.

title: コシヒカリ米の収穫 | 雪国の冒険 | 南魚沼
description: 新潟県南魚沼市での秋の米の収穫、日本の有名なコシヒカリ米の発祥地！コシヒカリ米は1950年代初頭に開発されましたが、非常に弱く、稲の病気にかかりやすかったため、安定して栽培することができませんでした。しかし、魚沼・南魚沼地域に住む数人の粘り強い農家の努力のおかげで、作物は改良され、今日では日本で最も人気のある米の品種となりました。コシヒカリ品種は今や世界中の市場で見られますが、雪国地域の元の気候で育てられた米は、日本が提供する最高の生産物の一つと見なされています。収穫は通常9月（または10月初旬）に行われ、町には新たな活気が生まれ、地元の人々や新鮮な米を求めて訪れる観光客に感謝されています。

title: Biking in the Japanese Countryside with Satoyama Minicle | Adventures in Yukiguni | Minamiuonuma
description:
There's no better way to explore the Japanese countryside than by cycling! And Minamiuonuma City has just set-up a new bike rental service: Minicle! 

Autumn in Minamiuonuma City and the rest of Yukiguni is characterized by the harvesting of delicious crops like the region's famous Koshihikari rice. In addition to enjoying the city's abundant fresh ingredients with all sorts of local cuisine the leaves begin to change color and the surrounding mountains become a beautiful panorama of vibrant reds, oranges, and yellows. To appreciate as many views as possible and also enjoy a more engaging form of sightseeing, grabbing a rental bike and taking to the country roads of Minamiuonuma is a foolproof approach. 

This year the Snow Country Cycle Tourism guide map published will help you navigate the area and discover hidden gems around every corner. 

Minicle bicycle rentals can be reserved at Muikamachi Station in the Muikamachi Sightseeing Information Center. 

Snow Country Cycle Tourism Guide Maps can be obtained at any of the City Tourist Association offices or at the Minamiuonuma City Hall. The map can also be accessed online here: http://mixpaper.jp/scr/viewer.php?id=5f6454674827f

title: 日本の田舎でのサイクリングと里山ミニクル | 雪国の冒険 | 南魚沼
description:
自転車に乗ることで日本の田舎を探検する方法は他にありません！南魚沼市では新しい自転車レンタルサービス「ミニクル」が設立されました！

南魚沼市と雪国の秋は、地域の名物であるコシヒカリ米の収穫によって特徴づけられます。新鮮な食材を使った地元料理を楽しむだけでなく、葉が色づき、周囲の山々は鮮やかな赤、オレンジ、黄色の美しいパノラマになります。できるだけ多くの景色を楽しみ、より魅力的な観光を楽しむために、レンタルバイクを借りて南魚沼の田舎道を走るのは間違いのないアプローチです。

今年発行された雪国サイクル観光ガイドマップは、地域をナビゲートし、隠れた宝物を見つけるのに役立ちます。

ミニクルの自転車レンタルは、六日町駅の六日町観光情報センターで予約できます。

雪国サイクル観光ガイドマップは、市の観光協会のオフィスや南魚沼市役所で入手できます。地図はオンラインでもアクセスできます。

title: Hiking in Japan - Sacred Peak Mt. Hakkai 八海山 | Adventures in Yukiguni | Minamiuonuma
description:
Climbing Mt. Hakkai (1778 m) of the Echigo Sanzan Mountains.
Using the Hakkaisan Ropeway the hike took about 7 hours round-trip.

Many tourists flock to Snow Country in the winter months to hit the slopes, but many of these snow resort grounds continue to attract visitors seeking outdoor adventures through mountain climbing in the summer as well.

Mt. Hakkai is a famous mountain in Minamiuonuma that boasts a long history of dedicated climbers coming from all across the country.
There are two impressive shrines dedicated to the mountain at each trail-head, and the mountain's delicious spring water and impressive shape are part of the reason its name has become one of Japan's most reputable sake brands: Hakkaisan.
The mountain is very popular for tourists hiking on summer break and its lookout decks offer beautiful views of the varicolored Uonuma Basin in autumn once the leaves begin to change too.
The mountains in this region are said to bless the locals with many gifts and in the green season these are manifested in the landscape's breathtaking scenery.

Hakkaisan Ropeway Info: https://www.tohokukanko.jp/en/attractions/detail_1784.html

title: Cherry Blossoms and Wildflowers in Minamiuonuma | Adventures in Yukiguni | Minamiuonuma
description:
The special Yukiguni climate helps produce not only delicious rice and sake, but also spectacular cherry blossoms and many beautiful wildflowers every spring!

We visited some popular spots in Minamiuonuma City for the seasonal activity of hanami, or flower-viewing, this past April along with our friends at the Minamiuonuma Resort Tourist Association. After seeing numerous beautiful flowers at Zenibuchi Park (in Muikamachi) and learning about some exciting hanami events, we paid a visit to the Nonohanakan Wildflower Art Gallery. Here, artist Yasuo Toyama arranges seasonal displays of the region's wildflowers including his masterful watercolor paintings and samples of the living plants themselves. We were lucky enough to ask him a handful of questions on the variety of wildflowers blooming in Minamiuonuma and hear how many of these remarkable plants are able to exist specifically because of Minamiuonuma's snowy climate.

title: 南魚沼の桜と野花 | 雪国の冒険 | 南魚沼
description:
特別な雪国の気候は、美味しい米や酒だけでなく、毎春の壮大な桜や美しい野花も生み出します！

私たちは、南魚沼市の人気スポットを訪れ、友人たちと一緒に花見の季節活動を楽しみました。善渕公園（六日町）で数多くの美しい花を見た後、興味深い花見イベントについて学び、野花アートギャラリー「ののはな館」を訪れました。ここでは、アーティストの豊山康夫が地域の野花の季節ごとの展示をアレンジしており、彼の見事な水彩画や生きた植物のサンプルが展示されています。私たちは幸運にも、南魚沼で咲いている野花の種類についていくつかの質問をし、これらの素晴らしい植物の多くが南魚沼の雪の多い気候のおかげで存在できることを聞くことができました。

title: Snow Refinement of Echigo Jofu | Adventures in Yukiguni | Minamiuonuma
description:
Trying out the UNESCO Intangible World Heritage fabric making process 'Yukizarashi' with Nakadaya Orimono in Minamiuonuma, Japan!

For the 4th installment of Adventures in Yukiguni we joined some local textile makers to learn about the region’s famous weaving techniques and try performing a special step in the Echigo Jofu making process, Yukizarashi. Translating to 'snow refinement', this process involves placing these precious hemp textiles out on the snow to clean them and enhance the fabric’s quality. With records of these fabrics existing from over 1000 years ago, the weaving process and snow refinement techniques have been passed down and perfected among locals for centuries. A perfect example illustrating the connections between local trades and the heavy snowfall, this is a piece of the unique local culture that can only be discovered here in Minamiuonuma!

title: 越後上布の雪精製 | 雪国の冒険 | 南魚沼
description:
日本の南魚沼で、UNESCO無形文化遺産の織物製作プロセス「雪晒し」を中田屋織物と共に体験しました！

雪国の冒険の第4弾では、地元の織物職人と共にこの地域の有名な織り技術について学び、越後上布の製作過程の特別なステップである雪晒しを体験しました。雪で精製することを意味するこのプロセスでは、貴重な麻の織物を雪の上に置いて清掃し、布の質を向上させます。これらの織物の記録は1000年以上前から存在し、織りのプロセスと雪精製技術は何世代にもわたって地元の人々に受け継がれ、完璧にされてきました。地元の商業と重い降雪とのつながりを示す完璧な例であり、南魚沼でしか発見できない独特の地域文化の一部です！

title: Snow Country Ski and Snowboarding | Adventures in Yukiguni | Minamiuonuma
description: With 10 different ski resorts in town, Minamiuonuma is a paradise for all sorts of winter sports! This time we visited local favorite Ishiuchi Maruyama. Popular among both skiers and snowboarders as well as wintertime sightseers, this mountain is a favorite spot not only for locals but visitors from all over the country and globe! With a host of newly developed facilities and a variety of trails ranging from beginner to expert, this resort is a spot to enjoy the snow sport appeals of the Yukiguni region. For more casual skiers or those taking a jaunt out of the city the rental gear service can get you set up for a great day on the slopes in no time!

title: 雪国のスキーとスノーボード | 雪国の冒険 | 南魚沼
description: 南魚沼には10の異なるスキーリゾートがあり、冬のスポーツの楽園です！今回は地元の人気スポットである石打丸山を訪れました。スキーヤーやスノーボーダー、冬の観光客に人気のこの山は、地元の人々だけでなく、全国や世界中からの訪問者にも愛されています。初心者から上級者まで様々なトレイルと新しく開発された施設が揃っており、このリゾートは雪国地域のスノースポーツの魅力を楽しむためのスポットです。カジュアルなスキーヤーや都市からの小旅行を楽しむ方には、レンタルギアサービスがあり、すぐに素晴らしいスロープでの一日を楽しむことができます！

title: Snow Viewing Onsen | Adventures in Yukiguni | Minamiuonuma
description:
Onsen are a unique part of Japanese culture and are a must-try for any traveler to Japan. Here are a few tips that'll help you to fully enjoy these hot springs!

Minamiuonuma, known for its prominent ski tourism and premium sake brands, has a special appreciation for its remarkably snowy climate. This snow that piles meters high every winter eventually melts and becomes a mountain spring water unrivaled for growing delicious crops. This particularly pure water is also used for hot springs throughout the city, clustered in the central Muikamachi area. Known for their spectacular views of the snow-covered Uonuma basin and luxurious outdoor rotenburo, we visited Hotel Kinomezaka to try out yukimi "snow-viewing" onsen for ourselves.

title: 雪見温泉 | 雪国の冒険 | 南魚沼
description:
温泉は日本文化の独特な一部であり、日本を訪れる旅行者には必見です。これらの温泉を最大限に楽しむためのいくつかのヒントを紹介します！

南魚沼は、著名なスキー観光と高級酒のブランドで知られ、特に雪の多い気候に対する特別な感謝があります。この冬に数メートルも積もる雪は、最終的に溶けて美味しい作物を育てるために比類のない山の湧き水になります。この特に純粋な水は、市内の温泉にも使用されており、中心部の六日町エリアに集まっています。雪に覆われた魚沼盆地の壮大な景色と贅沢な露天風呂で知られる私たちは、ホテル木の芽坂を訪れて、雪見温泉を自分たちで体験しました。

title: Octagon Tunnel - Kumanobe Railway Ruins - Octagonal Tunnel - Misato Town Tourism PR Video with English Subtitles
description:
This is a Misato Town tourism PR video created in 2025.

It is one of the remains of the Kumanobe Railway, which opened in April 1912 in Minami Kumamoto Station (Kumamoto City) and later extended to Toyo, Shimomashiki District (Misato Town), running for a total length of 28.6 km.
The line was discontinued in 1962, but even now, about 60 years later, this octagonal tunnel, which was built to prevent the rocks on both sides of the track from collapsing, still welcomes many tourists as an industrial ruin.
A leading theory is that the reason why the seven towers are connected, with gaps between them, making it an imperfect shape for rockfall protection, is to reduce construction costs. It is a ruin with many mysteries.
Also, nearby are the piers of the Tsurugawa Bridge, which are also the remains of the Kumanobe Railway, and are valuable remains of the Kumanobe Railway, which supported industrial development in the past.

title: Japan's tallest stone steps, 3333 steps
description:
This is a Misato Town tourism PR video created in 2025.

These stone steps were built in Misaka, the main approach to the historic Shaka-in Temple (Izumi-cho, Yatsushiro City), which has a history of 1,200 years, and are the largest in Japan.
They will be preserved for future generations as a century-old cultural heritage and will revitalize the town.
It was built with the aim of creating a tourist attraction and a symbol of town revitalization.
Construction of the stone steps began in January 1980, and in November 1986, it surpassed the 2,446 steps of Mt. Haguro in Yamagata Prefecture to become the number one in Japan in both name and reality, and was completed at the end of March 1986.
In addition to famous stones from all over the country, these stone steps use granite from countries around the world such as China, South Korea, India, the former Soviet Union, Brazil, the United States, and South Africa.
They are used to build international goodwill and friendship, and to promote historical exploration and health.
It is used as a tourist and recreational facility.
Additionally, Attack the Nihon Ichi is held every November using the stone steps.
Some early climbers may take less than an hour to complete the climb, but for the general public, please expect it to take about 3 hours, including 2 hours for the ascent and 1 hour for the descent.

Construction of the stone steps began in January 1980, and in November 1986, it surpassed the 2,446 steps of Mt. Haguro in Yamagata Prefecture to become the number one in Japan in both name and reality, and was completed at the end of March 1986.
In addition to famous stones from all over the country, these stone steps use granite from countries around the world such as China, South Korea, India, the former Soviet Union, Brazil, the United States, and South Africa.They are used to build international goodwill and friendship, and to promote historical exploration and health. It is used as a tourist and recreational facility.
Additionally, Attack the Nihon Ichi is held every November using the stone steps.

令和５年度に作成した美里町観光PR動画です。

　この石段は、１２００年の歴史を秘めた由緒ある釈迦院（八代市泉町）の表参道である御坂に日本一の石段(美里町）を建設し、世紀の文化遺産として後世に残すとともに町の活性化を図るための観光の目玉づくり、町おこしのシンボルづくりを狙って建設されたものです。
　石段建設は、昭和５５年１月から着手し、昭和６０年１１月には山形県羽黒山の２４４６段を抜いて名実とも日本一の座につき、昭和６３年３月末に完成しました。
　この石段には、全国各地の名石のほか、中国、韓国、インド、旧ソ連、ブラジル、アメリカ、南アフリカなど世界各国の御影石を使用し、国際親善並びに友好の絆を結ぶとともに歴史の探究及び健全な観光レクレーション施設として利用されています。
　また、毎年１１月には、石段を利用して、アタック・ザ・日本一が開催されています。
　早い方は登り終えるまで１時間を切られる方もおられますが、一般の方の場合、上りに２時間、下りに１時間、合計３時間程度とお見込みください。

大正４年４月に南熊本駅（熊本市）開業、その後、下益城郡砥用（美里町）まで延線して総延長２８．６キロ間を走っていた熊延鉄道の遺構のひとつです。
　昭和３９年に廃線となりましたが、約６０年たった今でも、線路の両側の岩が崩れるのを防ぐために作られた洞門であるこの八角トンネルは、産業遺構として今も多くの観光客を迎えています。
　７基が連なり、間が空いている、落石よけとしては不完全な形になった理由として、建設費削減のためとする説が有力ですが、なぜ八角形なのかなど、形も構造も謎が多い遺構です。
　また、近くには、同じく熊延鉄道の遺構である津留川橋梁の橋脚も残っており、かつての産業発展を支えた「熊延鉄道」の貴重な遺構です。

title: Kumonobu Railway Ruins: Hakkaku Tunnel - Misato Town Tourism PR Video
description:
This is a tourism PR video for Misato Town created in the 5th year of Reiwa.

Opened in April 1915 at Minami Kumamoto Station (Kumamoto City), the Kumonobu Railway extended to Toyo in Shimomashiki District (Misato Town), running a total length of 28.6 kilometers. This is one of the ruins of the Kumonobu Railway.

Although it was abandoned in 1964, even after about 60 years, this Hakkaku Tunnel, which was built to prevent the rocks on both sides of the railway from collapsing, still welcomes many tourists as an industrial heritage site.

There are seven tunnels in a row with gaps in between, and a prevailing theory suggests that the incomplete shape as a rockfall prevention measure was due to cost-cutting during construction. However, the reasons for its octagonal shape and other structural mysteries remain.

Additionally, nearby, the piers of the Tsuru River Bridge, another ruin of the Kumonobu Railway, still remain, representing the valuable heritage of the "Kumonobu Railway" that once supported industrial development.

title: カンパチロウ物語
description:
カンパチロウ物語とは・・・

　鹿児島県鹿屋（かのや）市（人口10万人）では、特産である「カンパチ」による「まちおこし」がおきている。
　この現象を元に、主人公である半魚人「かのやカンパチロウ」の過去・現在・未来を描いたミュージカルショートフィルムを制作。

＜制作背景＞
　鹿屋市の名産である”かのやカンパチ”は、５年ほど前まで市民を含めて認知度が低く、カンパチの値段も低迷していたことで、かつては栄えた”鹿屋市漁業協同組合”も経営難に苦しんでいた。

　そんな中、危機感を募らせた若手漁師達は、”かのやカンパチ”の知名度向上・販路拡大等を目指し、自らの手で半魚人である”かのやカンパチロウ”を誕生させ、PRを行うことにした。

　ところが、カンパチロウ誕生後もその見た目からか簡単には受け入れてもらえず、もがき苦しむ時期があった。

　しかし、漁師を始め、仲間たちと共に、カンパチソング・カンパチダンスを開発し、鹿児島県内外によるカンパチのPRと併せてひたむきに踊り続けた。

　その結果、理解してくれる仲間が少しづつ増え、認めて応援してくれるマチの人が増え、カンパチロウ・カンパチダンスは鹿屋全体に認知されるほどになった。

　このような鹿屋市漁協青年部を中心としたPR活動が功を奏し”かのやカンパチ”の知名度の上昇・国内における販路拡大に繋がったことで、漁協も経営難から抜け出し現在は軌道にのりつつある。

　また、鹿屋市漁協の市民を巻き込んだ一連のPR活動は内閣総理大臣表彰を受賞。

　現在、鹿屋市では「カンパチソング」「カンパチダンス」はほとんどの保育園や小学校の運動会や文化祭等をはじめ、忘年会での余興や式典、かのや夏祭りでも正式な踊りとして踊られる等、一つの文化になっている。

　さらに、漁協も国内のみならず国外に向け”かのやカンパチ”を積極的にPRしていこうとしている・・・。

title: The Story of Kanpachirou
description:
The Story of Kanpachirou is about...

In Kanoya City, Kagoshima Prefecture (population 100,000), a revitalization effort is underway centered around the local specialty, "Kanpachi."
Based on this phenomenon, a musical short film depicting the past, present, and future of the protagonist, a half-fish man named "Kanoya Kanpachirou," has been produced.

<Production Background>
The local specialty, "Kanoya Kanpachi," had low recognition among citizens until about five years ago, and the price of Kanpachi was also stagnant, causing the once-thriving "Kanoya City Fisheries Cooperative" to struggle financially.

Amidst this, young fishermen, feeling a sense of crisis, aimed to raise awareness and expand sales channels for "Kanoya Kanpachi" by creating their own half-fish man, "Kanoya Kanpachirou," and conducting PR activities.

However, even after the birth of Kanpachirou, he was not easily accepted due to his appearance, leading to a period of struggle.

Nevertheless, together with fellow fishermen, they developed the Kanpachi song and Kanpachi dance, and diligently continued to dance while promoting Kanpachi both within and outside Kagoshima Prefecture.

As a result, the number of friends who understood them gradually increased, and more people in the community began to recognize and support Kanpachirou and the Kanpachi dance, leading to widespread recognition throughout Kanoya.

The PR activities led by the Kanoya City Fisheries Cooperative Youth Division proved successful, resulting in increased awareness of "Kanoya Kanpachi" and expanded sales channels domestically, allowing the cooperative to recover from its financial difficulties and get back on track.

Additionally, the series of PR activities involving the citizens of Kanoya City received an award from the Prime Minister of Japan.

Currently, in Kanoya City, the "Kanpachi Song" and "Kanpachi Dance" are performed at most kindergartens and elementary schools during sports festivals and cultural events, as well as at year-end parties and ceremonies, becoming a part of the local culture.

Furthermore, the fisheries cooperative is actively promoting "Kanoya Kanpachi" not only domestically but also internationally...

description: 平成30年2月9日（金）・10日（土）・11日（日）の3日間、久留米高良大社や水天宮と共に、筑後地方三大祭りの一つに数えられる風浪宮大祭を斎行致します。久留米高良大社や水天宮と共に、筑後地方の三大祭りの一つに数えられる風浪宮例大祭は通称「おふろうさん」と呼ばれ、九日より十一日まで盛大に行なわれ十五万余りの参拝客で賑わいます。大祭の三日間は潮井まいり、御神幸、流鏑馬、等の古式豊かな神事がくり拡げられまた、境内には露店が連ね、古来より食べると風邪をひかないといわれる無病息災の縁起物、干し柿の串柿市の他、海と山との物々交換の名残でもある八女物産市なども開催致します。どうぞご家族おそろいでお参りください。なお、大祭日程・無料シャトルバスなど詳細につきましては下記HP内リンクよりご覧ください。http://www.ofurousan.or.jp/event/taisai.html大祭の3日間は、大川中学校など風浪宮周辺で合計300台が収容可能な臨時駐車場を設置しております。※大川中学校は10日夜、11日のみ駐車可。

title: Furou Shrine Grand Festival Naked Procession
description: From February 9 (Friday) to 11 (Sunday), 2018, the Furou Shrine Grand Festival, one of the three major festivals in the Chikugo region, will be held together with Kurume Takara Shrine and Suitengu. The Furou Shrine Grand Festival, commonly known as 'Ofurou-san', will be grandly held from the 9th to the 11th, attracting over 150,000 worshippers. During the three days of the festival, traditional Shinto rituals such as Choi Mairi, Mikoshi Parade, and Yabusame will be performed, and stalls will line the precincts. There will also be a market for dried persimmons, a good luck charm said to prevent colds, and a Yame product market, a remnant of the exchange between the sea and the mountains. Please come with your family to worship. For details on the festival schedule and free shuttle buses, please refer to the link on the website below. http://www.ofurousan.or.jp/event/taisai.html During the three days of the festival, temporary parking for a total of 300 vehicles will be set up around Furou Shrine, including Okawa Junior High School. *Okawa Junior High School is available for parking only on the night of the 10th and the 11th.

Hiroyuki Nakano 
Video creator, film director, and producer 
Born in 1958 in Fukuyama City, Hiroshima Prefecture. Graduated from Fukuyama Seiryu High School and Waseda University, Faculty of Commerce. After working at Yomiuri Television, he established Tyrell Corporation, producing visual art and music videos, directing numerous MVs for music artists in Japan and around the world. In 1993, he established Peace Delic, directing many contents that make viewers happy. His activities span a wide range, including film, advertising, web videos, signage, and event direction. 
In 1998, he won the Grand Prix at the Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival in South Korea for the film 'SF SAMURAI FICTION.' In 2006, he won the Young Critics Award at the Cannes International Film Festival's Critics' Week for the short film 'Iron.' In 2015, he won the Grand Prix at the Okinawa Children's Film Festival for 'Flying Bodies.' In 2018, he released the film 'Peace Nippon,' depicting the beautiful landscapes and spiritual history of Japan captured over eight years. He is currently continuing the Peace Nippon Project to convey Japan to the future. 
MVs: Tomoyasu Hotei, Miki Imai, Mr.Children, GLAY, AKB48, SKE48, STU48, etc. 
CMs: Suntory, Sumitomo Life, Pioneer, TOYOTA, Takeda Pharmaceutical, Mitsubishi Motors, POLA, Meiji Seika, KOSE, Yakult, Seven & I, Hitachi, etc.

Films: Directed 'SF SAMURAI FICTION,' script and direction for 'SF Stereo Future,' production, script, and direction for 'SF Short Films,' directed 'Red Shadow Akakage,' produced, scripted, and directed the short film collection 'Poems of Men,' directed 'TAJOMARU,' directed 'FLYING BODIES,' a documentary film on Aomori University Men's Rhythmic Gymnastics planned by Issey Miyake, and 'FOOL COOL ROCK / ONE OK ROCK DOCUMENTARY FILM,' a documentary film on the rock band One OK Rock. 
-- 
Hirokazu Ogura 
(Guitarist, songwriter, arranger) 
Involved in numerous Japanese music works, including Keisuke Kuwata, Southern All Stars, Masaharu Fukuyama, Ryoko Moriyama, Taeko Onuki, Noriyuki Makihara, JUJU, Bank Band, and kokua. Formed the guitar instrumental duo Yamagen, releasing five albums. In 2014, released the solo album 'GOLDEN TIME,' in 2016 'Summer Guitars,' and in 2019 'Sketch Song' and 'Sketch Song 2.' His high technique, wide musicality, and heartfelt music & guitar play are supported across genres. He serves as a radio DJ for FM COCOLO's MARTIN CLUB JAPAN Presents 'Hirokazu Ogura's FRIDAY, Sound of Strings.' He is from Takamatsu City (Tourism Ambassador of Takamatsu City).
