description: EXILE／EXILE THE SECONDの橘ケンチさんが自然に囲まれた三重県菰野町の湯の山温泉の麓に佇む宿「湯の山 素粋居」をご紹介します。各棟ごとに雰囲気、内装や間取りが異なっており、まるで居心地の良い美術館のようです。しかも各部屋に源泉かけ流しの温泉露天風呂付きです。お食事は炭や薪などの直火を使った料理が楽しめるレストラン「HINOMORI」で、席のすぐ目の前で厳選された熟成牛がじっくりと火入れされていく様子や盛り付けの様子を目で見ても楽しむことができるのが特徴です。ぜひみなさんも五感で三重の旅を楽しんでくださいね！

title: EXILE Kenchi Tachibana's Trip in Mie Enjoyed with All Five Senses - Yuno-yama Suisui
description: Introducing 'Yuno-yama Suisui', an inn located at the foot of Yuno-yama Onsen in Komono Town, Mie Prefecture, surrounded by nature, featuring Kenchi Tachibana from EXILE/EXILE THE SECOND. Each building has a different atmosphere, interior, and layout, resembling a comfortable art museum. Additionally, each room comes with a natural hot spring open-air bath. Dining is available at the restaurant 'HINOMORI', where you can enjoy dishes cooked over direct flames using charcoal and firewood. You can also enjoy watching the carefully aged beef being cooked right in front of you and the plating process. Be sure to enjoy your trip to Mie with all five senses!

description:

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
Mie Prefecture, located almost in the center of the Japanese archipelago, stretches long from north to south.
Facing the Ise Bay and Kumano-nada Sea, it is blessed with nature of sea, mountains, and rivers, with the Suzuka Mountains and Kii Mountains.

Furthermore, it is home to the 'Ise Jingu,' the heartland of the Japanese people with a history of two thousand years, and the 'Ama' of Toba and Shima, which are traditions and cultures inherited from ancient times that Mie takes pride in.

The term 'sustainable' has become more common in recent years, but the nature, history, and culture of Mie are precious treasures that have been 'naturally' preserved until today.

'We want to protect Mie's beautiful nature and esteemed traditions and connect them to the future.'
Why not visit Mie, a 'Sustainable Tourism Destination,' filled with the hopes of our ancestors?

A workshop by Koji Baba, the owner of 'Baba Joinery', a representative craftsman of Mie Prefecture with qualifications such as a first-class wooden joinery craftsman!

💡 You will create a lantern called 'Komorebi', which won the Excellence Award in the furniture and interior category of the 'Mie Wooden Products Contest 2023', featuring a pattern like a mesh called 'Twisted Kumiko'.
💡 The venue is the Akai Family Residence, a samurai house in Ueno Shinobucho, Iga City, designated as a national registered tangible cultural property (building).
💡 An experience to touch the craftsman's skills and enjoy lively talks!
💡 For one hour until the completion of the work, you will go for a walk in the town guided by a craftsman who knows Iga inside and out.
💡 You can fully enjoy Iga with ninja experiences, Iga gourmet food, souvenirs, and more.

title: 【みえのイマココ旅】きもも堂
description:
#Mie no Imakoko Tabi

関宿を伊勢木綿の着物で散策♪
着付け体験「きもも堂」OPEN

〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜・〜

【内容】
💡東海道の宿場町、関宿。今も残る江戸時代の街並みをレンタル着物で散策できます。
💡心地よい肌触りと素朴な風合いの三重の伝統工芸品、伊勢木綿の着物が揃います。
💡カラフルな格子柄、粋な雰囲気の縞模様など、カジュアルなシーンで、老若男女を問わず誰にでも馴染みます。
💡お友達と一緒に予約して、お揃いや色違いを着たり、男性用もあるので、カップルでリンクコーデのデートを満喫したり。お気に入りの一着を選んだら、着付け体験スタートです！
💡足袋と草履、バッグまでレンタルできるので、手ぶらで体験可能！
💡暑い季節は、レトロ浴衣の着付けつきレンタルがあります。
💡なんと、体験時間は無制限。お店が閉まる16時までに返却すればOKで、早い時間から借りる方がほとんど。
💡着物のまま飲食もOK！写真を撮るだけではなく、お店に入ってランチしたり、カフェに行ったり、ゆっくりと関宿観光を楽しめます。

【料金】
おひとり¥5,500～

【住所】

title: [Breaking News] The wisteria at #KazahayanoSato is in full bloom!
description:
The wisteria at Kazahayano Sato in Tsu City, Mie Prefecture, is one of the representative wisteria spots in Mie Prefecture.

Ten varieties of wisteria, including "Shirakouhitan Fuji," "Murasakikouhitan Fuji," "Benifuji," "Kuchibeni Fuji," "Rokushaku Fuji," "Kyushaku Fuji," "Nagasaki Isai Fuji," "Yaekokuryu Fuji," "Kokuryu Fuji," and "Shiranoda Fuji," totaling 1,800 plants, will bloom from late April to early May across 10,000㎡ of 10 different wisteria trellises and 58,000㎡ of standing trees in the garden 💜

Depending on the variety of wisteria, some early bloomers have already started to drop their flowers, and there are many buds that will bloom soon ☺

The seasonal flower water offerings are sure to be a hit for photos!

📅 April 13, 2024 (Saturday) to May 6, 2024 (Monday) *Open every day

title: とこしえの祈りを込めて　～「持続可能な観光地」三重～
description:
【とこしえの祈りを込めて　それは、未来にやさしい旅。】
https://www.kankomie.or.jp/special/sustainable/

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
日本列島のほぼ中央に位置し、南北に長い三重県。
伊勢湾や熊野灘の海に面し、鈴鹿山脈、紀伊山地などの
山々が連なる、海、山、川の自然に恵まれた環境です。

さらには、二千年の歴史を有する日本人の心のふるさと
「伊勢神宮」や、鳥羽志摩の「海女」など、
太占より受け継がれてきた伝統・文化も三重の誇るべきもの。

「持続可能」という言葉を近年耳にするようになりましたが、
三重のそうした自然、歴史・文化は、
“当たり前”に今日まで守られてきた大切な宝物です。

“三重の美しい自然や由緒ある伝統を守り未来へと繋ぎたい”
先人たちの想いが込められた、
「持続可能な観光地」三重に訪れてみませんか？
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

title: With Eternal Prayers - 'Sustainable Tourism Destination' Mie
description:
[With Eternal Prayers, it is a journey that is kind to the future.] https://www.kankomie.or.jp/special/sustainable/

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
Mie Prefecture, located almost in the center of the Japanese archipelago, stretches long from north to south.
Facing the Ise Bay and Kumano-nada Sea, it is blessed with nature of sea, mountains, and rivers, with the Suzuka Mountains and Kii Mountains.

Furthermore, it is home to the 'Ise Jingu,' the spiritual home of the Japanese people with a history of over two thousand years, and the 'Ama' of Toba and Shima, which are traditions and cultures inherited from ancient times that Mie takes pride in.

The term 'sustainable' has become more common in recent years, but the nature, history, and culture of Mie have been precious treasures that have been 'naturally' preserved until today.

'We want to protect Mie's beautiful nature and esteemed traditions and connect them to the future.'
Why not visit Mie, a 'Sustainable Tourism Destination,' filled with the hopes of our ancestors?
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

title: 大丹倉【ドローン撮影】(熊野市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: Oonigura (大丹倉) in Kumano City is a large rock mass that stands 300 meters high and 500 meters wide on a cliff, designated as a cultural property of Kumano City. It is also known as a sacred place where ascetics have undergone rigorous training since ancient times. The reddish hue on some parts of the rock surface is due to the oxidation of iron contained in the rock as it weathers. Standing at the top, you will be overwhelmed by the magnificent view of the Kii Mountains spread out before you.

description: 「日本さくら名所100選」に選ばれている津市美杉町の三多気の桜並木をドローンで撮影いたしました。古木が多く歴史を感じさせるヤマザクラ500本余りの並木道が、伊勢本街道から真福院までの参道に1.5km続きます。まるで桜のトンネルをくぐるかのようです。

title: Santake Cherry Blossoms [Drone Photography] (Tsu City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Travel Information
description: We captured the cherry blossom avenue of Santake in Misugi Town, Tsu City, which has been selected as one of the '100 Famous Cherry Blossom Spots in Japan,' using a drone. The avenue, lined with over 500 ancient Yamazakura trees that evoke a sense of history, stretches 1.5 km from Ise Honkaido to Shinpukuin, creating a tunnel of cherry blossoms.

title: 宮川堤の桜【ドローン撮影】(伊勢市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報

title: Miyagawa Tsutsumi Cherry Blossoms [Drone Photography] (Ise City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Tourism and Travel Information
description: We filmed the cherry blossom avenue of Miyagawa Tsutsumi, which is also selected as one of the '100 Famous Cherry Blossom Spots in Japan,' using a drone. The cherry blossom avenue, known as 'Ichimoku Senbon,' stretches for 1 kilometer north and south along Miyagawa Tsutsumi Park.

title: Recommended for a night date! Winter limited light park that you can enjoy for free
description: A relaxing place in the city gets a makeover in winter! The entire park will be illuminated with approximately 50,000 light bulbs. Illuminations are a winter feature [Suwa Park]. It is very popular because it creates a fantastic space ✨. 5 minutes walk from Kintetsu Yokkaichi Station! Another great thing is that you can see the illuminations for free 😊. description:

title: Healing Retro Garden Rokkaen
description:
【Popular spot that I don't want to tell you about! Healing retro garden】

Rich nature spreads out in the garden [Rokkaen]✨

It is also known as the setting for numerous dramas and movies.
Lots of sights to see!

The Western-style building, which has been designated as a national important cultural property, is a truly stylish space!
Actually, the heart motif is hidden.
Please look for it ❤􀀀

title: 開運を導く神様が宿る！　#椿大神社
description:
【開運を導く神様が宿る！パワースポット】

森の中にそびえる日本最古の神社⛩
古くから「椿さん」の愛称で親しまれている【椿大神社】は
開運みちびきの神様として知られる猿田彦大神を祀り、
多くの方が交通安全や無病息災、商売繫昌などを祈願されます。

参道は木々が生い茂り神聖な空気が流れ、
冬には境内のあちこちで椿の花がほころび、
四季折々に見られる自然美も大きな見どころのひとつ。

境内には縁結びの神社や恋愛成就のパワースポットも！
新たな年の始まりに参拝したいですね😌🙏

【A god who guides good luck dwells! Power spot】

Japan's oldest shrine rising in the forest⛩
[Tsubaki Shrine] has been affectionately known as "Tsubaki-san" since ancient times.
It enshrines Sarutahiko Okami, known as the god of good luck.
Many people pray for traffic safety, good health, and good business.

The approach is lined with trees and a sacred atmosphere flows through it.
In winter, camellia flowers bloom all over the temple grounds.
The natural beauty that can be seen throughout the seasons is also one of the major attractions.

There is also a matchmaking shrine and a power spot for fulfillment in love within the precincts!
I would like to visit the shrine at the beginning of a new year 😌🙏

description: 自家製豆腐に約1000日間 熟成された味噌を塗り炭火でじっくりと香ばしく焼き上げる創業200年以上の老舗「田楽座 わかや」✨店内は高い天井と大きな梁があり小粋な雰囲気で、食欲を誘う香ばしい味噌の香りが漂います。朱塗りの木箱に並んだ豆腐田楽はあっという間にペロリと食べちゃう一口サイズ！ご飯の上に乗せて食べるのがお店のオススメなのだそう😋

title: Even the Michelin Guide recognized it! Healthy charcoal grilled dengaku
description: Homemade tofu is coated with miso that has been aged for about 1000 days. Grilled slowly and fragrantly over charcoal, 'Dengakuza Wakaya' is a long-established store with over 200 years of history✨ The interior of the store has a stylish atmosphere with high ceilings and large beams. There is a fragrant miso scent that stimulates your appetite. Tofu dengaku lined up in vermilion wooden boxes are bite-sized pieces that you can gobble up in no time! Apparently, the restaurant recommends eating it on top of rice 😋

Bath, sauna, gourmet... 💞 Introducing the popular 'Bath Café' especially among the younger generation❣ With about 6,000 comic books and magazines, free-flowing freshly brewed coffee for users, and the only self-roule sauna in the area (men's bath only), there are plenty of services that make you want to spend all day in the facility. Furthermore, from November, the in-house restaurant menu has been renewed to be even more delicious‼👏 Menu items like 'Tokai Retro Café Menu' that are sure to be Instagram-worthy have appeared✨ Why not spend a relaxing time with family and friends♪

description: In Mie Prefecture, there are many must-visit spots for sauna lovers, including tent saunas right in front of waterfalls, saunas at an onsen café with plenty of services, and saunas where you can enjoy breathtaking views!

title: 滝つぼでサウナ✨テントサウナの聖地
description:
＼✨“テントサウナの聖地”として話題✨／

高さ30ｍ幅12ｍの美しい滝が敷地内にある、珍しいキャンプ場。

滝の目の前には、3種類のテントサウナが❣😲
サウナでしっかり温まったあとは、水風呂として
滝つぼに入ることが出来る、サウナー必見のスポット💞

title: Waterfall Pool Sauna✨The Sacred Place of Tent Sauna
description:
This is a rare campsite with a beautiful waterfall that is 30m high and 12m wide on the premises.
In front of the waterfall, there are three types of tent saunas! After warming up in the sauna, you can take a dip in the waterfall pool as a cold bath, making it a must-visit spot for sauna lovers.
The facility also includes tent sites, cottages, and barbecue areas! The cottages are equipped with heating and cooling, allowing you to enjoy camping in any season.

title: 大自然の絶景と忍者体験🏞️
description:
美しい大自然のエネルギーを感じられる、赤目四十八滝。日本の滝百選、森林浴の森百選などにも選ばれるほどの絶景が広がっています…🏞️

秋から冬にかけてはライトアップも実施中です✨

さらに、赤目四十八滝のふもとの山の中にある「忍者の森」では、伊賀流忍術の様々な修行が体験できて、子どもから大人まで楽しめる人気スポットなんです！🥷✨全ての修業をクリアすると「秘伝の書」がゲットできる⁉️

大自然の絶景と忍者体験を楽しんでみてはいかが♪

title: Spectacular Nature and Ninja Experience🏞️
description:
Feel the energy of beautiful nature at Akame Shijuhachi Falls. It is selected as one of Japan's top 100 waterfalls and one of the top 100 forests for forest bathing, showcasing breathtaking scenery...🏞️

From autumn to winter, there is also a light-up event✨

Furthermore, in the 'Ninja Forest' located at the foot of Akame Shijuhachi Falls, you can experience various training of Iga-ryu Ninjutsu, making it a popular spot for both children and adults!🥷✨ If you clear all the training, can you get the 'Secret Scroll'⁉️

How about enjoying the spectacular nature and ninja experience♪

description:
鈴鹿げんき花火大会が2023年9月9日に開催されました🎆

花火会場は白子港緑地公園近辺。近鉄 白子駅から徒歩15分ほどの距離にある場所です✍

19時半から打ち上げがスタートし約50分間に渡って3000発もの花火が披露されました✨

夜空が黄金色に染まる連発花火や色とりどりの小さな花火が一度にたくさん打ち上げられる彩色千輪菊、フィナーレには世界最大級の４尺玉海上自爆が披露されるなど、内容の濃い50分間でした😊

今年も感動をありがとうございました。

title: Suzuka Genki Fireworks 2023🎆 Thank you for the emotions this year✨
description:
The Suzuka Genki Fireworks Festival was held on September 9, 2023 🎆

The fireworks venue is near the Shiroko Port Green Park. It is about a 15-minute walk from Kintetsu Shiroko Station ✍

The launch started at 7:30 PM and lasted for about 50 minutes, showcasing 3,000 fireworks ✨

The 50 minutes were filled with spectacular displays, including rapid-fire fireworks that dyed the night sky golden, colorful small fireworks launched all at once, and the grand finale featuring one of the world's largest 4-shaku-dama (40-inch) fireworks launched from the sea 😊

Thank you for the emotions this year.

title: 丸山千枚田【ドローン撮影】(熊野市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: 「日本の棚田100選」にも選ばれている丸山千枚田をドローンで撮影いたしました。山深い熊野市紀和町丸山地区の斜面に折り重なるようにして造られた棚田の数は1340枚にもなり、国内では最大規模と言われています。平成5年に地元住民たちが中心となって丸山千枚田保存会が結成され、農耕文化の伝統と四季折々に異なる光景を後世に残そうと、手厚い保全活動が続けられています。

title: Maruyama Senmaida [Drone Photography] (Kumano City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Tourism and Travel Information
description: We filmed Maruyama Senmaida, which has been selected as one of the '100 Best Terraced Rice Fields in Japan,' using a drone. The number of terraced fields, built on the slopes of the Maruyama district in Kumano City, Kii Town, is said to be the largest in the country, with 1,340 fields layered on top of each other. In 1993, the Maruyama Senmaida Preservation Society was formed, led by local residents, and they continue to engage in extensive conservation activities to preserve the traditions of agricultural culture and the changing scenery of the four seasons for future generations.

title: 六華苑（旧二代諸戸清六邸）【ドローン撮影】(桑名市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: 桑名の大実業家だった二代諸戸清六の新居として、大正２年（1913年）に完成した六華苑。4層の塔屋を持つ特徴的な洋館は、あの有名な鹿鳴館を手掛けたイギリス人の建築家ジョサイア・コンドルの設計によるもの。洋館に連結して建つ和館、蔵、池泉回遊式庭園など、創建時の姿がほぼそのまま残されており、洋館と和館は国の重要文化財に指定されています。

title: Rikkaen (Former Residence of the Second Generation Moroto Seiroku) [Drone Photography] (Kuwana City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Travel Information
description: Rikkaen was completed in 1913 as the new residence of the prominent businessman Moroto Seiroku, the second generation. The distinctive Western-style building with a four-story tower was designed by the British architect Josiah Conder, who also worked on the famous Rokumeikan. The Japanese-style building, storehouse, and pond-style garden connected to the Western-style building have largely retained their original appearance, and both the Western and Japanese buildings are designated as Important Cultural Properties of the country.

title: 七里御浜【ドローン撮影】(熊野市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報里御浜
description: 世界遺産熊野古道「浜街道」としても知られる七里御浜をドローンで空撮しました！熊野市から紀宝町に至る約22Ｋｍ続く日本で一番長い砂礫海岸。これまでに「日本の渚百選」や「21世紀に残したい自然百選」など全国の景勝地と並んで選ばれています。荒々しい黒潮をおおらかに受けとめるこの浜には、熊野灘の荒波に磨かれた丸い小石が敷き詰められた美しい海浜です。

title: Shichiri Mihama [Drone Photography] (Kumano City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Travel Information
description: We captured Shichiri Mihama, also known as the World Heritage Kumano Kodo 'Hama Kaido', with a drone! This is the longest gravel beach in Japan, stretching approximately 22 km from Kumano City to Kiho Town. It has been selected alongside other scenic spots nationwide, such as 'Japan's Top 100 Beaches' and 'Top 100 Natural Sites to Preserve for the 21st Century'. This beautiful beach, which gracefully embraces the rough Kuroshio Current, is adorned with round pebbles polished by the rough waves of Kumano-nada.

title: 木津呂【ドローン撮影】(熊野市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: 「日本の秘境」「奥熊野のパワースポット」と言われる木津呂をドローン撮影いたしました。和歌山県から熊野市へと流れる北山川河口付近の大蛇行によって丸く突き出たようなユニークな形状になっています。風水では「瀧穴」と呼ばれるパワースポットとされており、気がみなぎる特別な場所として、数々のテレビ番組でも取り上げられるなど、近年になって注目を浴びています。

title: Kizuro [Drone Photography] (Kumano City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Tourism and Travel Information
description: We conducted drone photography of Kizuro, known as 'Japan's hidden gem' and 'a power spot in the Oku Kumano region.' It has a unique shape that juts out roundly due to the meandering of the Kitayama River near the mouth flowing from Wakayama Prefecture to Kumano City. In feng shui, it is referred to as a power spot called 'Taki Ana,' and it has gained attention in recent years as a special place where energy is abundant, being featured in various television programs.

title: Fish Flying Valley [Drone Photography] (Kihoku Town)
description: In the valley woven with numerous giant rocks and strange rocks, you can see the sight of many fish flying around, known as the Flying Fish Valley. The fish swimming in the clear flow called 'Choshi River Blue' can be seen clearly, even down to the bottom of the river. The Choshi River, known as a 'natural aquarium' and 'miraculous clear stream', boasts one of the highest levels of transparency in the country and is known as a treasure trove of sweetfish, amago, and freshwater shrimp.

title: 全身で大自然を体感！奥伊勢アウトドア旅【大台町】

title: 熊野古道伊勢路で最古の「波田須の道」は歩きやすくて初心者にもぴったり。海が見える秘境駅、絶景スポットなど魅力満載です。
description: 「波田須（はだす）の道」は、鎌倉時代に作られた世界遺産・熊野古道伊勢路最古の「道」。距離が３００メートルほどしかなく傾斜も緩やかなので、初めて熊野古道を歩く方にもぴったり！そのほかにも”波田須”エリアは、海が見える秘境駅や、太古からの伝説が残る「徐福の宮」、テラスから絶景が望める「徐福茶屋」など素敵なスポットがたくさんあります。

title: The Oldest 'Hadatsu no Michi' on the Kumano Kodo Ise Road is Easy to Walk and Perfect for Beginners. A Hidden Station with a Sea View, Scenic Spots, and More Attractions.
description: The 'Hadatsu no Michi' is the oldest path on the World Heritage Kumano Kodo Ise Road, created during the Kamakura period. It is only about 300 meters long and has a gentle slope, making it perfect for those walking the Kumano Kodo for the first time! Additionally, the 'Hadatsu' area is filled with wonderful spots, including a hidden station with a sea view, 'Jofuku no Miya' which has legends from ancient times, and 'Jofuku Chaya' where you can enjoy a spectacular view from the terrace.

description:
Magose Pass is known for its beautiful stone pavement and Owase Hinoki forest, making it one of the highlights of the World Heritage Kumano Kodo Ise Road. It is a popular course that beginners can easily hike.

We filmed the heavy stone pavement and Owase Hinoki forest in a 360-degree video, allowing you to enjoy the immersive visuals that photos cannot convey.

title: 【３６０度動画】熊野古道伊勢路　松本峠　～鉄砲傷の地蔵様～
description:
「松本峠」は、世界遺産・熊野古道伊勢路の中でも、標高１３５メートルと低めで、山登り初心者や小学生など小さいお子様連れでも安心して登れる峠です。

松本峠の頂上付近には、大きなお地蔵様が立っています。お地蔵様の足元には大きな穴が開いていますが、これは、元禄（1700年）の頃、鉄砲猟師の大馬新左衛門が夜中に峠を通った際、お地蔵様を、妖怪や獣と見間違えて撃ってしまって付いた鉄砲傷だそう。写真では伝えきれない、臨場感あふれる映像を【３６０度動画】でお楽しみください。

title: Matsumoto Pass - The Jizo with Bullet Wounds in Kumano Kodo Ise Road [360-degree Video]
description:
Matsumoto Pass is a low pass at an elevation of 135 meters within the World Heritage Kumano Kodo Ise Road, making it a safe climb for beginners and families with small children.

Near the top of Matsumoto Pass stands a large Jizo statue. At the base of the statue, there is a large hole, which is said to have been caused by a bullet wound when a hunter named Ouma Shinzaemon mistook the Jizo for a monster or beast and shot it during the night in the Genroku era (around 1700). Enjoy the immersive video experience that cannot be captured in photographs with this 360-degree video.

title: 【３６０度動画】天狗倉山
description: Tengurayama (てんぐらさん) can be reached by progressing along the hiking course that continues from the top of the beautiful stone pavement and Owase cypress forest at the Makigoshi Pass, which boasts one of the most beautiful sceneries along the World Heritage Kumano Kodo Ise Route. When you climb up to just before the summit of Tengurayama, there is a huge rock that you can climb on. Enjoy the immersive video that captures the breathtaking view from the summit overlooking the city of Owase!

title: 「楯ヶ崎」　海に突き立てられた巨大な楯のような大岩壁は圧倒的な迫力です！
description:
三重県の名勝天然記念物に指定されている「楯ヶ崎（たてがさき）」は、　海に突き立てられた巨大な楯のような大岩壁！（高さ約80m、周囲約550）

無数の柱が連なったように見える「柱状節理（ちゅうじょうせつり）」は、約1400万年前の大規模な火山活動で発生した大量のマグマが冷却固結されてできたもの。柱状節理自体は熊野の海岸の至る所に見られますが、この「楯ヶ崎」は独立してそびえ立って存在し圧巻の風景です！

ハイキングコースしても最適で、楯ヶ崎園地には遊歩道が整備されており、遊歩道入り口の国道311号から楯ヶ崎までは片道40分の道のりで、途中には海からつながる参道が珍しい阿古師（あこし）神社もあります。熊野ならではの植物が遊歩道沿いにあり、特別な植物には解説付の樹木ラベルが設置されていて、森林浴も兼ねて植物の学習をしながら適度なハイキングが楽しめます。

なお、よりダイナミックな景色を楽しみたい人のためには、観光遊覧船もあります。

title: Tategasaki: A massive cliff resembling a giant shield thrusting into the sea is truly overwhelming!
description:
Tategasaki, designated as a scenic natural monument in Mie Prefecture, is a massive cliff that looks like a giant shield thrusting into the sea! (Approximately 80m high, about 550m in circumference)

The 'columnar jointing' that appears to be a series of countless pillars was formed by the cooling and solidification of a large amount of magma from a massive volcanic activity about 14 million years ago. While columnar jointing can be seen all along the coast of Kumano, Tategasaki stands independently and presents a breathtaking landscape!

It is also ideal as a hiking course, with a well-maintained promenade in the Tategasaki Park. The one-way journey from the entrance of the promenade on National Route 311 to Tategasaki takes about 40 minutes, and along the way, there is the rare Akoshi Shrine, which connects to the sea. Unique plants native to Kumano line the promenade, and special plants have explanatory tree labels installed, allowing for a moderate hike while enjoying forest bathing and learning about the plants.

For those who want to enjoy a more dynamic view, there are also sightseeing boats available.

When you reach speeds of 70 km/h, you’ll be so focused on not being thrown off that you won’t even be able to scream. title: 高田本山 専修寺 (三重県津市)
description:
専修寺は、全国に600余ヶ寺ある真宗高田派の本山寺院です。開山親鸞聖人のみ教えをまっすぐに受け継ぐ寺院で、境内の御廟にはご遺骨をお守りしています。三重県津市一身田町に位置し、親しみを込め高田本山と呼ばれています。
2017年11月三重県初の国宝建造物に指定された、如来堂・御影堂（みえいどう）に加え、国宝の法宝物や国指定の重要文化財を数多く抱えています。境内ではお浄土に咲くとされる蓮の花を、35種類100鉢以上楽しむことができます。また毎年１月９日から１６日まで、真宗最大の法会“報恩講”を行っています。

※令和2年度文化財多言語解説整備事業の補助を受けて作成した動画です。

title: Takada Honsan Senshuji (Tsu City, Mie Prefecture)

Located in Ichinada Town, Tsu City, Mie Prefecture, it is affectionately called Takada Honsan.
In November 2017, it was designated as the first national treasure building in Mie Prefecture, along with the Nyorai-do and Mieido, and it houses numerous national treasures and important cultural properties designated by the country. title: Oyodo Fureai Campground (Meiwa Town, Mie Prefecture) | Official Tourism Mie
description:
Located along the coast in Meiwa Town, Mie Prefecture, Oyodo Fureai Campground is a recommended leisure spot where you can enjoy beautiful nature and outdoor activities, including sea fishing!
In addition to tents, there are bungalows equipped with air conditioning and car sites, making it easy for outdoor beginners to enjoy camping.
In summer, swimming in the bright blue sea right in front of the campground is very popular! With shallow waters and calm waves, it’s perfect for families with children.
You can also reserve barbecue ingredient sets.
Close to popular tourist destinations in Mie Prefecture such as Ise, Toba, and Shima, this campground is recommended for creating family memories.

title: 伊勢神宮から生中継した「介護施設向けオンラインツアー」アーカイブ動画
description: 2021年2月25日（木）、伊勢神宮の内宮前から介護施設向けオンラインツアーが生中継されました。ツアーの企画・開催は、三重県が東京トラベルパートナーズ株式会社と協力して実現したものです。ツアー当日は、北は北海道から南は沖縄まで、7000名以上のご参加者様に、生中継・高画質・参加型のモニター越しの「旅」をお届けしました！※伊勢神宮(内宮)編は収録映像を交えて配信。当日は専用視聴システムのチャットを利用し、参加者からの質問やコメントにリポーターが答えたり、「どのおみくじを引きますか？」などのアンケートを取ったりと、「参加できる」オンラインツアーを配信させていただきました。

title: Live Broadcast of Online Tour for Nursing Facilities from Ise Jingu - Archive Video
description: On February 25, 2021 (Thursday), an online tour for nursing facilities was broadcast live from in front of Ise Jingu. The tour was planned and held in cooperation with Mie Prefecture and Tokyo Travel Partners Co., Ltd. On the day of the tour, over 7,000 participants from Hokkaido in the north to Okinawa in the south enjoyed a live, high-quality, participatory 'journey' through their monitors! *The Ise Jingu (Inner Shrine) edition was broadcast with recorded footage. On that day, we used a dedicated viewing system's chat to answer questions and comments from participants, and conducted surveys such as 'Which omikuji would you like to draw?' to provide a 'participatory' online tour.

title: Experience the Flavor, Sweetness, and Aroma of Aged Matsusaka Beef at 'Ganso Niku no Mizutaki Mukai'. A Traditional Taste Born in 'Tokaido Kameyama-juku'. (Kameyama City, Mie Prefecture) | Official Mie Tourism
description:
The Ise Kameyama specialty 'Niku no Mizutaki' was born in Tokaido's Kameyama-juku. The first-generation couple who came from Shimonoseki to Mie in 1935 developed this traditional hot pot dish, inspired by 'Tecchiri', during a time when meat dishes were mostly limited to sukiyaki.

title: クライミングジム キャニオン　岩場体験会【ドローン撮影】
description: 東京五輪の追加種目にも採用されたことから最近注目されているクライミング。朝日町にあるクライミングジム キャニオンでは、インドアでのボルダリングはもちろん、岩場スポットへ出かけての岩場体験など、アウトドアでのクライミングの楽しさも教えてくれます。今回は人生初の岩場体験に挑戦してきました！

title: Climbing Gym Canyon - Rock Climbing Experience Event [Drone Photography]
description: Climbing has recently gained attention as it was adopted as an additional event in the Tokyo Olympics. At Climbing Gym Canyon in Asahi Town, you can enjoy indoor bouldering as well as outdoor climbing experiences at rock spots, teaching you the fun of climbing in nature. This time, I challenged myself to my first-ever rock climbing experience!

title: 熊野古道 馬越峠・天狗倉山～尾鷲セラピストガイド～【ドローン撮影】
description: 世界遺産 熊野古道 伊勢路の中でも、石畳の美しさで人気の馬越峠とそこから延びる天狗倉山への山登り。尾鷲市には、登山初心者でも、安全に、楽しく、より健康的に歩けるようガイドをしてくれる心強い「尾鷲セラピスト」のみなさんがいます。豊かな自然に囲まれた尾鷲の熊野古道で心と身体を癒すヘルスツーリズムを体験してきました！

title: Kumano Kodo: Bakoshitoge and Tengakurayama - Owase Therapist Guide - [Drone Shooting]
description: A mountain climbing experience to Bakoshitoge, known for its beautiful stone pavement, and Tengakurayama, part of the World Heritage Kumano Kodo Ise Route. In Owase City, there are supportive 'Owase Therapists' who guide even beginners to walk safely, enjoyably, and healthily. I experienced health tourism that heals the mind and body in the rich nature surrounding the Kumano Kodo in Owase!

title: SUNNY COAST KAYAKS　シーカヤックツーリング【ドローン撮影】観光三重
description: 伊勢神宮のあるお伊勢さんから車で30分。まちの半分以上が伊勢志摩国立公園の中にあり、海と山の豊かな自然に恵まれた南伊勢町にあるSUNNY COAST KAYAKSでは、壮大なリアス式海岸が続く五ヶ所湾をフィールドに爽快なシーカヤックが楽しめます。

title: SUNNY COAST KAYAKS Sea Kayak Touring [Drone Shooting] Sightseeing Mie
description: Located 30 minutes by car from Ise Jingu, in Minamiise Town, which is blessed with rich nature of sea and mountains, more than half of the town is within Ise-Shima National Park. At SUNNY COAST KAYAKS, you can enjoy refreshing sea kayaking in the magnificent ria coast of Gokasho Bay.

title: かぶとの森テラス　キャンプ＆ローカルフィットネス【ドローン撮影】観光三重
description: 鈴鹿川源流にある山と川に囲まれた自然豊かなキャンプ場「かぶとの森テラス」。ここではキャンプはもちろん、合わせて森林ヨガやサイクリングなどアウトドアでのアクティビティが体験できる「ローカルフィットネス」が人気です。健康にも良く、心も体もリフレッシュ！

title: Kabutono Mori Terrace Camp & Local Fitness [Drone Shooting] Tourism Mie
description: Kabutono Mori Terrace is a nature-rich campsite surrounded by mountains and rivers at the source of the Suzuka River. Here, you can enjoy not only camping but also popular outdoor activities such as forest yoga and cycling, known as 'local fitness.' It's good for your health and refreshes both your mind and body!

'Ise Sea Paradise', which continues to be loved in the aquarium battleground, is a pioneering presence among such unique aquariums. We will introduce unique initiatives that you cannot experience elsewhere.

title: 伊勢型紙おおすぎ「伊勢型紙」(鈴鹿市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: 友禅、ゆかた、小紋などの柄や文様を着物の生地を染めるのに用いる「伊勢型紙」は、千有余年の伝統を誇る伝統的工芸品(用具)です。和紙を柿渋で加工した型地紙に彫刻刀等などで掘り抜くことで手づくりならではの温かみと繊細な柄や模様が織りなす伊勢型紙。その美しい作品は美術工芸品や身近なインテリアまで幅広く親しまれています。

title: Ise Katagami Oosugi "Ise Katagami" (Suzuka City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Tourism and Travel Information
description: The 'Ise Katagami' used for dyeing kimono fabrics with patterns and designs such as Yuzen, yukata, and komon is a traditional craft with a history of over a thousand years. The Ise Katagami, created by carving into paper made from washi processed with persimmon tannin, embodies warmth and delicate patterns unique to handmade items. Its beautiful works are widely appreciated as art crafts and familiar interior decorations.

title: Kumano Kodo Center (Owase City, Mie Prefecture) - A facility that conveys the charm of the World Heritage Kumano Kodo - | [Official] Tourism Mie
description:
The Kumano Kodo Center, located in Owase City, Mie Prefecture, exhibits the charm of the World Heritage "Kumano Kodo" in an easy-to-understand manner.
The permanent exhibition room is filled with actual materials and replicas related to the history, nature, and culture of the Kumano Kodo and its surroundings.
There is also a "Video Hall" that screens the history and seasonal landscapes of the Kumano Kodo, as well as a "Special Exhibition Room" that hosts themed exhibitions, art exhibitions, and work exhibitions, allowing visitors to learn about the Kumano Kodo from various angles.

〇 With the theme "People and Roads Here, Here, and From Here," we provide information related to nature, history, and culture. The facility "Kumano Kodo Center" conveys the charm of the World Heritage Kumano Kodo.

description: 三重県応援キャラクター「兎の助」が紹介する三重の動画シリーズ。三重県四日市市にある鳥出神社で行われる、鯨船行事。ユネスコ無形文化遺産に指定された行事で、豪華な彫刻や刺繍の施された鯨船山車と、大漁や富貴の象徴に見立てた鯨との攻防が繰り広げられます。最期には見事鯨を仕留め、神に奉納して豊穣を祈願する勇壮なお祭りです。

title: Whale Ship Festival at Toride Shrine (Yokkaichi City, Mie Prefecture)
description: A video series introducing Mie by the Mie Prefecture support character 'Usanosuke'. The whale ship event held at Toride Shrine in Yokkaichi City, Mie Prefecture. This event, designated as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, features a magnificent whale ship float adorned with intricate carvings and embroidery, showcasing a battle between the whale, symbolizing a bountiful catch and prosperity. In the end, the whale is successfully captured and offered to the gods in a grand festival praying for abundance.

title: 海の乗馬倶楽部エル カバージョ　絶景ビーチライド【ドローン撮影】観光三重
description: 異国情緒漂う「マリーナ河芸」に隣接した「海の乗馬倶楽部 エル カバージョ」。2019年にオープンしたこの乗馬クラブは、東海初、1200mも続くビーチを一望しながら乗馬が楽しめる乗馬クラブです。本格的に乗馬をはじめたい方はもちろん、初心者でも乗馬が楽しめるコースもあり、誰でも気軽に乗馬を体験することができます。

title: Ocean Riding Club El Caballo - Spectacular Beach Ride [Drone Footage] Tourism Mie
description: Adjacent to the exotic Marina Kawai, the 'Ocean Riding Club El Caballo' opened in 2019. This riding club is the first in the Tokai region where you can enjoy horseback riding while overlooking a 1200m long beach. Whether you are serious about starting horseback riding or are a beginner, there are courses available for everyone to easily experience riding.

title: 御城番屋敷（三重県松阪市）｜三重県大好き"兎の助"動画｜【公式】観光三重
description: 三重県応援キャラクター「兎の助」が紹介する三重の動画シリーズ。松阪市にある御城番屋敷（ごじょうばんやしき）は、江戸末期に紀州藩士が松坂城警護のため移り住んだ武家屋敷。なんと、今も人が住んでいるんですよ！

title: Gojōban Residence (Matsusaka City, Mie Prefecture)
description: A video series introducing Mie by the Mie Prefecture support character 'Usanosuke'. The Gojōban Residence in Matsusaka City is a samurai residence where a Kishu clan samurai moved in during the late Edo period to guard Matsusaka Castle. Surprisingly, people still live there!

title: 四日市のきらめく工場夜景｜三重県大好き"兎の助"動画｜【公式】観光三重
description: 三重県応援キャラクター「兎の助」が紹介する三重の動画シリーズ。三重県四日市市の美しいコンビナート工場の夜景は、「工場夜景の聖地」とも言われるほど。見事な絶景写真が撮影できるということで、カメラマンにも人気です。海から工場夜景が楽しめる、大型遊覧船のコンビナート夜景クルーズもオススメですよ。

title: Shining Factory Night View in Yokkaichi | Mie Prefecture Favorite 'Usa no Suke' Video | Official Mie Tourism
description: The Mie Prefecture support character 'Usa no Suke' introduces a video series about Mie. The beautiful factory night view in Yokkaichi City, Mie Prefecture, is said to be a 'sacred place for factory night views.' It is popular among photographers for capturing stunning scenic photos. A large sightseeing boat cruise to enjoy the factory night view from the sea is also recommended.

title: 熊野大花火大会（三重県熊野市）｜三重県大好き"兎の助"動画｜【公式】観光三重
description: 三重県応援キャラクター「兎の助」が紹介する三重の動画シリーズ。三重県熊野市の「熊野大花火大会」は、全国でも有名な花火大会。直径600mに広がる三尺玉海上自爆は圧巻の大迫力です！

title: Kumano Grand Fireworks Festival (Kumano City, Mie Prefecture) | Mie Prefecture's Favorite 'Usa no Suke' Video | Official Tourism Mie
description: The video series introduced by Mie Prefecture's support character 'Usa no Suke'. The 'Kumano Grand Fireworks Festival' in Kumano City, Mie Prefecture, is a famous fireworks festival in Japan. The three-foot shell's self-detonation spreading 600 meters in diameter is an overwhelming spectacle!

title: 熊野市の絶景・観光スポット｜三重県大好き"兎の助"動画｜【公式】観光三重
description: 三重県応援キャラクター「兎の助」が紹介する三重の動画シリーズ。三重県熊野市の絶景・観光スポットのドローン映像です。撮影スポット：七里御浜、獅子岩、楯ヶ崎、花の窟神社、鬼ヶ城

title: Kumano City's Scenic Views and Tourist Spots | Mie Prefecture's Favorite 'Usanosuke' Video | Official Tourism Mie
description: A video series introduced by Mie Prefecture's support character 'Usanosuke'. This is drone footage of the scenic views and tourist spots in Kumano City, Mie Prefecture. Filming spots: Shichiri Mihama, Shishi Rock, Tategasaki, Hananoiwaya Shrine, and Onihaka.

title: 伊勢忍者キングダムの安土城（三重県伊勢市）｜三重県大好き"兎の助"動画｜【公式】観光三重
description: 三重県応援キャラクター「兎の助」が紹介する三重の動画シリーズ。伊勢忍者キングダム内の「安土城」は、織田信長が築城した「安土城」を原寸大で再現したものです。※現在改修工事のため、入館はできません。（2020年8月時点）

title: Ise Ninja Kingdom's Azuchi Castle (Ise City, Mie Prefecture) | Mie Prefecture's Favorite 'Usa no Suke' Video | Official Tourism Mie
description: A video series introducing Mie by the Mie Prefecture support character 'Usa no Suke'. The 'Azuchi Castle' within the Ise Ninja Kingdom is a full-scale reproduction of the 'Azuchi Castle' built by Oda Nobunaga. *Currently, admission is not possible due to renovation work (as of August 2020).

title: ビン玉ロード（三重県志摩市）｜三重県大好き"兎の助"動画｜【公式】観光三重
description: 三重県応援キャラクター「兎の助」が紹介する三重の動画シリーズ。夕暮れ時、志摩市の浜島の旅館街からつづくビン玉ロードがライトアップされ、散歩する方の道しるべや癒しのスポットとなっています。

title: Bin Tama Road (Shima City, Mie Prefecture)
description: A video series introducing Mie by the Mie Prefecture support character 'Usa no Suke'. At dusk, the Bin Tama Road, which continues from the ryokan district of Hamajima in Shima City, is illuminated, serving as a guide and healing spot for those taking a stroll.

title: 滝を浴びる豪快アドベンチャー！飛雪の滝キャンプ場の滝ダッキー（三重県紀宝町）｜【公式】観光三重
description: 「飛雪（ひせつ）の滝」の滝つぼで「ダッキー」に乗ってみよう！「ダッキー」は空気で膨らますタイプのカヌー。安定性に優れているため初心者や小学生にも安心して乗ることができます。ダッキーに乗って滝に打たれてみたり、ダッキーの上で立ったり寝転んだりと、色々な遊びができますよ。

title: A Grand Adventure Under the Waterfall! Hisetu no Taki Campground's Waterfall Duckie (Kihō Town, Mie Prefecture)
description: Let's ride a 'Duckie' in the plunge pool of 'Hisetu no Taki'! The 'Duckie' is an inflatable canoe that offers excellent stability, making it safe for beginners and elementary school students. You can experience various activities such as getting splashed by the waterfall while riding the Duckie, standing, or lying down on it.

title: しろんご祭（三重県鳥羽市）｜三重県大好き"兎の助"動画｜【公式】観光三重
description: 三重県応援キャラクター「兎の助」が紹介する三重の動画シリーズ。しろんご祭は海女の祭典で、ホラ貝の合図で磯着姿の海女たちが海にもぐり、つがいのあわびの初採りを競います。最初に採れたあわびを神社に供え、豊漁と海上安全を祈願します。

title: Shirongo Festival (Toba City, Mie Prefecture)
description: A video series introducing Mie by the Mie Prefecture support character 'Usanosuke'. The Shirongo Festival is a festival of ama (female divers), where the ama dive into the sea at the signal of a conch shell and compete to catch the first pair of abalone. The first abalone caught is offered at a shrine to pray for a good catch and safety at sea.

title: 神島【ドローン撮影】(鳥羽市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: 神島は伊勢湾口に浮かぶ小島で、三島由紀夫の小説『潮騒』の舞台となり、恋人の聖地とも呼ばれています。また日本で唯一の渡りをする蝶であるアサギマダラや鷹の一種であるサシバが訪れる自然の宝庫で、雄大な海の景観を島時間でのんびり満喫できます。

title: Kamisima [Drone Photography] (Toba City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Travel Information
description: Kamisima is a small island floating at the mouth of Ise Bay, known as the setting for Yukio Mishima's novel 'The Sound of Waves' and is also called a sacred place for lovers. It is a treasure trove of nature where the only migratory butterfly in Japan, the Asagimadara, and a type of hawk called the Sashiba visit, allowing you to leisurely enjoy the magnificent ocean scenery in island time.

title: 青山高原【ドローン撮影】(津市・伊賀市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: 室生赤目青山国定公園の中心にある、起伏のゆるやかな高原で四季折々の自然が楽しめます。高原北端の笠取山から青山峠まで、約10Kmのワインディングが続く絶好のドライビングスポット。頂上付近には、約89基（令和2年6月1日現在）の白い風車がゆったりと羽根を回している壮大な景色が楽しめます。

title: Aoyama Plateau [Drone Shooting] (Tsu City, Iga City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Tourism and Travel Information
description: Located in the center of the Muroo Akame Aoyama Quasi-National Park, this gently undulating plateau offers seasonal nature experiences. A perfect driving spot with about 10 km of winding roads from Kasatori Mountain at the northern end of the plateau to Aoyama Pass. Near the summit, you can enjoy a magnificent view of about 89 white wind turbines leisurely turning their blades (as of June 1, 2020).

Gozaisho Mountain, the main peak of the Suzuka Mountains, stands at an elevation of 1,212 meters. At the foot of the mountain is Yunoyama Onsen, and a world-class ropeway connects to the summit, offering a wonderful aerial walk. title: 親子大橋　バイク×ドローン映像（三重県南伊勢町）｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: 二つの橋が手をとり合っているように見えることから、親子大橋と呼ばれるようになりました。大きい方が南島大橋、小さい方が阿曽浦大橋です。入り組んだ地形の為、通常は一方の橋しか見ることができませんが、「鵜倉園地」の「あけぼの展望台」より、両方の橋が同時に見ることができます。

title: Parent-Child Bridge: Bike × Drone Footage (Minamiise Town, Mie Prefecture)
description: The two bridges are called the Parent-Child Bridge because they look like they are holding hands. The larger one is the Minamishima Bridge, and the smaller one is the Asoura Bridge. Due to the complicated terrain, usually only one bridge can be seen at a time, but both bridges can be viewed simultaneously from the 'Akebono Observatory' in 'Ugura Park'.

description:
In Toba City, Mie Prefecture, the recommended specialty during the winter season is oysters! This video showcases the oysters from the Urakamura area of Toba City, which have become famous through television and other media. The picturesque Urakamura area, which has been celebrated in many songs since ancient times, is home to numerous oyster farms. Thank you to Yamayasu Fisheries for their cooperation in the filming!

title: I visited the national scenic spot and natural monument 'Oni no K城' (Kumano City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture Travel Information
description:
I visited Oni no K城 in Kumano City. This time, I walked to the Oku no Kido. (Photo taken on 2019.4.10)

It is a natural art created by uplift, weathering, and wave erosion, stretching endlessly for 1 km facing the Kumano Sea, designated as a national scenic spot and natural monument. At the summit, there are the ruins of a castle from the Sengoku period, and a hiking course is developed that connects to the Kumano Kodo and Matsumoto Pass. From the observation deck known as Oni no Mihara, you can get a panoramic view of the Kumano Sea.

The hiking course leading to the summit is lined with cherry blossoms, and in spring, four types of cherry blossoms bloom one after another, delighting the eyes of tourists who visit for an extended period.

description: 360°海に囲まれた自然豊かな離島のレジャー施設。イルカやアシカのショーはもちろん、イルカタッチや餌やりなど間近でイルカにふれあえます。ほかにもイルカ島内には、知多・渥美半島まで望むことができる展望台やスタンプラリーが楽しめます。

description: A leisure facility on a nature-rich island surrounded by the sea 360°. You can enjoy dolphin and sea lion shows, as well as touch and feed dolphins up close. Additionally, there are observation decks where you can see the Chita and Atsumi Peninsulas and enjoy stamp rallies on Dolphin Island.

description: 大迫力の炎と洪水、アクロバティックなパフォーマンスが織りなす「ロストレジェンド~シルコ・デ・ディエラ~」や氷点下の世界を体感できる「氷の城」、夏のグルメイベント「トマトまつり」などを開催します！

description: Experience the powerful flames and floods, and acrobatic performances of 'Lost Legend ~Circo de Diera~', the 'Ice Castle' where you can experience a world below freezing, and the summer gourmet event 'Tomato Festival'!

title: 鳥羽水族館 「海獣の王国リニューアルオープン」(鳥羽市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: アシカやアザラシ達が泳ぐ水面を佐久保できるチューブ水槽が登場し、今まで以上に間近で海獣たちを観察でき、まるで水面を歩いているような体験ができます。また記念イベントとして海獣たちとのふれあいや餌やり、普段は行くことができないバックヤードツアーなどのイベントも盛りだくさんです。

title: Toba Aquarium 'Renewal Open of the Kingdom of Marine Beasts' (Toba City) | Tourism Mie | Mie Prefecture's Tourism and Travel Information
description: A tube tank where you can observe seals and sea lions swimming at the water's surface has been introduced, allowing you to observe marine animals up close like never before, creating an experience as if you are walking on the water's surface. Additionally, there are plenty of events such as interactions with marine animals, feeding, and a backstage tour that is usually not accessible as commemorative events.

title: Spring Akame Shijuhattaki Pilgrimage: Mountain Entry Safety Prayer Ceremony
description: A mountain entry safety prayer ceremony will be held at Akame Shijuhattaki in Nabari City, Mie Prefecture. It will include a goma fire ritual by ascetic practitioners, a water purification ritual by entering the Senju Falls, and a fire-walking ritual where participants walk barefoot over burning logs.

遊んだ後は、ミネラル豊富な天然温泉でリフレッシュできますよ。

title: 御在所ロープウエイ（三重県菰野町）
description: 全長2,161ｍ、高低差780ｍ、所要時間12分の空中散歩が楽しめる世界有数の規模を誇るロープウエイ。春はツツジの花が咲き誇り、夏は納涼とアカトンボ、秋の紅葉は10月中旬から11月下旬まで楽しめ、赤・黄・褐色の濃淡の色彩が山を彩ります。冬は美しい「樹氷と氷ばく」、県内唯一のスキー場に多くのスキーヤーが集まります。四季折々に楽しめるスポットです。

title: Gozaisho Ropeway (Komono Town, Mie Prefecture)
description: A ropeway boasting a world-class scale of 2,161 meters in length, a height difference of 780 meters, and a travel time of 12 minutes, offering a sky walk experience. In spring, azaleas bloom beautifully, in summer, you can enjoy coolness and red dragonflies, autumn foliage can be enjoyed from mid-October to late November, painting the mountains in shades of red, yellow, and brown. In winter, beautiful 'frosted trees and ice falls' attract many skiers to the only ski resort in the prefecture. A spot to enjoy throughout the four seasons.

title: 松阪もめん手織りセンター
description: 越後屋三井家跡に建つ松阪もめんの伝承施設。三井高利や松阪商人が江戸で大流行させた三重県松阪市の松阪もめんの魅力に出会えるところです。鞄やＴシャツ、ぬいぐるみなど現代風にアレンジされた商品の販売をはじめ、松阪木綿の手織り体験も楽しめます。

title: Matsusaka Momen Handweaving Center
description: A facility for the tradition of Matsusaka Momen located at the site of the Echigoya Mitsui family. It is a place where you can encounter the charm of Matsusaka Momen from Matsusaka City, Mie Prefecture, which was popularized in Edo by Mitsui Takatori and Matsusaka merchants. In addition to selling modern-style products such as bags, T-shirts, and stuffed animals, you can also enjoy a hand-weaving experience of Matsusaka cotton.

title: 松浦武四郎記念館
description: 北海道の名付け親として知られる松浦武四郎。2018年には生誕200年を迎え、様々な催しを予定しています。三重県松阪市にある松浦武四郎記念館では、武四郎の功績を伝える重要文化財を1505点収蔵し、展示室ではさまざまな武四郎の姿を紹介しています。

title: Matsuura Takeshiro Memorial Museum
description: Matsuura Takeshiro, known as the namer of Hokkaido, celebrated his 200th birthday in 2018, with various events planned. The Matsuura Takeshiro Memorial Museum in Matsusaka City, Mie Prefecture, houses 1,505 important cultural properties that convey Takeshiro's achievements, and the exhibition room introduces various aspects of Takeshiro.

title: 本居宣長記念館
description: 三重県松阪市にある宣長が暮らした旧宅「鈴屋」に隣接する記念館です。宣長の私生活や、人柄までも楽しみながら学べるクイズをはじめ、来館された方も思わず足を止める宣長が描いた迫力満点の日本地図など、本居宣長の自筆稿本や遺愛の品など約1万6千点を収蔵しています。

title: Hon'no Norinaka Memorial Museum
description: This is a memorial museum adjacent to the former residence 'Suzuya' where Norinaka lived, located in Matsusaka City, Mie Prefecture. It houses about 16,000 items, including Norinaka's handwritten manuscripts and cherished belongings, as well as a powerful map of Japan drawn by Norinaka, and quizzes that allow visitors to learn about his private life and personality in an enjoyable way.

title: 海女小屋はちまんかまど　20170527動画
description: 海女さんが目の前で新鮮な魚介類を焼いてくれることで外国人観光客に大人気の海女小屋。三重県鳥羽市相差（おうさつ）の海女小屋「はちまんかまど」で海女さん達が踊りを披露してくれました！

title: Amagoya Hachiman Kamado - Video from 20170527
description: The ama hut is very popular among foreign tourists because ama-san grill fresh seafood right in front of them. At the ama hut 'Hachiman Kamado' in Ousatsu, Toba City, Mie Prefecture, the ama-san performed a dance!

title: ミキモト真珠島　20170527動画
description: ミキモト真珠島で行われている海女さんの潜水作業の実演です！

title: Mikimoto Pearl Island 20170527 Video
description: This is a demonstration of the diving work performed by ama (female divers) at Mikimoto Pearl Island!

title: 円座・佐八かんこ踊り
description:
かんこ踊りは白馬の尾で作ったじゃぐまをかぶり、太鼓を叩いて篝火の周りを輪になって踊るお盆の行事(県指定無形民俗文化財)です。胸に抱えた太鼓をたたきながら松明の周りを舞う姿に魅せられます。

詳細については、HP観光三重をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Enza - Sahachi Kanko Dance
description:
The Kanko Dance is a Bon Festival event where participants wear a jaguma made from the tail of a white horse, beat drums, and dance in a circle around a bonfire (designated as an intangible folk cultural asset by the prefecture). The sight of dancers performing around the torches while beating the drums they hold in their arms is captivating.

For more details, please visit the HP Tourism Mie.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: 桑名石取祭
description: 「山・鉾・屋台行事」としてユネスコ無形文化遺産に登録された祭車数十台が鉦や太鼓を盛大に打ち鳴らしながら市内を練り歩きます。その様相から日本一やかましい祭とも呼ばれています。

title: Kuwana Stone Festival
description: Dozens of festival floats registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage as 'Yama, Hoko, and Yatai Events' parade through the city, ringing bells and beating drums loudly. It is also called the loudest festival in Japan.

title: 植木神社祇園祭
description:
宵宮祭と遷幸祭からなる祭りで、勇壮に練る神輿と江戸時代から大切に使われている豪華な楼車が町内を巡行する。神輿を傾けながら回る「クネリ」や祇園花の行列が中心となる華やかな祭りは、多くの見物客が訪れます。

詳細については、ＨP「観光三重」をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Ueki Shrine Gion Festival
description:
A festival consisting of the Yoimiya Festival and the Senkou Festival, featuring a magnificent procession of portable shrines and luxurious floats that have been cherished since the Edo period. The vibrant festival, centered around the 'Kuneri' where the portable shrines are tilted and the Gion flower parade, attracts many spectators.

For more details, please visit the HP 'Tourism Mie'.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: ざるやぶり神事
description:
約450年の伝統を受け継ぐ祭り。ふんどし姿の青年たちが神前に供えたお饌米の入っていた直径約90㎝のざるを奪い合います。からだをぶつけ合いもみ合いながら、ざるをやぶる姿は迫力満点です。

詳細については、HＰ「観光三重」をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Zaru Yaburi Festival
description:
A festival that has inherited a tradition of about 450 years. Young men in fundoshi compete to snatch a zaru, a basket with a diameter of about 90 cm that contains rice offerings presented before the deity. The sight of them colliding and grappling to tear the zaru apart is truly spectacular.

For more details, please visit the HP 'Kankou Mie'.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: ミキモト真珠島
description:
明治26年、御木本幸吉が世界で初めて真珠の養殖に成功した島。夏休みは、真珠のティアラをつけて、お手持ちのｶﾒﾗで記念撮影ができる「真珠のティアラで華麗に変身」や淡水真珠を使った「ストラップ工房」や「万華鏡工房」など開催します。

詳細については、ＨＰ「観光三重」をご覧ください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Mikimoto Pearl Island
description:
In 1893, Kokichi Mikimoto succeeded in the world's first pearl cultivation on this island. During the summer vacation, you can participate in events such as 'Transform into Elegance with a Pearl Tiara' where you can wear a pearl tiara and take commemorative photos with your own camera, as well as workshops like 'Strap Workshop' and 'Kaleidoscope Workshop' using freshwater pearls.

For more details, please visit the HP 'Tourism Mie'.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: 伊雑宮御田植祭
description: 勇壮な男達による「竹取神事」、古式ゆかしい装束に身を包んだ役人らによる「御田植神事」、一の鳥居へと向かう「踊込み」の3つの神事から構成されます。伝統と歴史を感じさせる荘厳な時代絵巻の再現は一見の価値ありです。

title: Iza Shrine Rice Planting Festival
description: The festival consists of three rituals: the 'Take-tori Shinto Ceremony' performed by brave men, the 'Otaue Shinto Ceremony' conducted by officials dressed in traditional attire, and the 'Odori-komi' heading towards the first torii gate. The solemn recreation of this historical pageant is worth seeing.

title: 伊勢・安土桃山文化村
description:
安土城を丸々使ったお化け屋敷はここだけ!業火の責め苦に喘ぎ、逃げ惑う阿鼻叫喚の地獄絵図です。来場者には、指令が下され、怨魂蠢く安土城からあなたは無事脱出できるかな?

description:
The haunted house that fully utilizes Azuchi Castle is unique to this place! It is a hellish scene of agony and despair, where people are tormented by raging flames and flee in panic. Visitors will receive a command, and will you be able to escape safely from the haunted Azuchi Castle where vengeful spirits lurk?

For more details, please visit the website 'Kankou Mie'.

description:

description:
約10000発もの大迫力の花火が打ち上がります。フィナーレを飾る鬼ヶ城大仕掛けは、鬼ヶ城の岩場や洞窟から仕掛花火が打ち上がり、爆発音が岩場で共鳴する大迫力の演出に魅せられます。

詳細については、HP「観光三重」をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

description:
About 10,000 spectacular fireworks will be launched. The grand finale features a large-scale display from the cliffs and caves of Onigajo, where the fireworks are launched, creating a powerful performance as the explosive sounds resonate off the rocks.

For more details, please visit the HP 'Tourism Mie'.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

description: 園内では、イルカやアシカのショーをはじめ、おでこタッチやおやつをあげるなどイルカたちとふれあい体験が楽しめます。絆がテーマのイルカのモニュメントの鐘を鳴らして大切な人との関係を深めてはいかがでしょうか。

description: In the park, you can enjoy interactive experiences with dolphins, including shows featuring dolphins and sea lions, as well as opportunities to touch their foreheads and feed them. How about ringing the bell of the dolphin monument, which is themed around bonds, to deepen your relationship with someone special?

description: At the signal of the conch shell, ama (female divers) compete to catch pairs of abalone. The first ama to catch them is revered as the head ama for a year, and it is said that a bountiful catch is promised.

title: きいながしま港市
description: 紀伊長島港に新鮮な鮮魚や干物、とらまき、みかんなど郷土の自慢品が勢ぞろいします。

title: Kiinagashima Port City
description: At Kii Nagashima Port, you can find fresh seafood, dried fish, toramaki, and local specialties such as mikan, boasting one of the highest catch volumes in the prefecture.

title: 横山展望台
description: リアス海岸特有の複雑な海岸線と大小60の島々が織りなす英虞湾の絶景に魅せられます。展望台までは多くの遊歩道があり、ゆっくり景色を眺めながら散策できます。

title: Yokoyama Observatory
description: You will be captivated by the spectacular view of Ago Bay, characterized by the complex coastline unique to the ria coast and the 60 islands of various sizes. There are many walking paths to the observatory, allowing you to stroll while enjoying the scenery.

title: 御在所ロープウエイ
description: 春の御在所岳は新緑が芽吹きアカヤシオやシロヤシオなどの花をはじめ、たくさんの花が咲き誇ります。登山はもちろん山頂までロープウェイで登って、ふもとでは見られない、山ならではの花が間近で楽しめる山上公園の散歩もオススメです。

title: Gozaisho Ropeway
description: In spring, Mount Gozaisho is adorned with fresh greenery and a variety of flowers, including Akayashio and Shiroyashio. Climbing is certainly an option, but taking the ropeway to the summit and enjoying the flowers unique to the mountain up close in the mountaintop park is also recommended.

title: 三反帆
description: 風の力ただけで進む三反帆(川船)に乗って、水の流れる音や鳥が羽ばたく音などを聞きながら、自然と一体となったような感覚でゆっくりと熊野川めぐりを楽しみませんか。

title: Three-sail boat
description: Would you like to enjoy a leisurely tour of the Kumano River while riding on a three-sail boat (kawafune) that moves solely by the power of the wind, listening to the sounds of flowing water and birds flapping their wings, feeling as if you are one with nature?

title: 史跡斎宮跡
description:
天皇に代わり伊勢神宮の天照大神に支えた斎王が暮らした斎宮。その史跡周辺には、平安時代の斎宮寮庁の建物三棟を復元した「さいくう平安の杜」など、幻の宮とされた斎宮の世界にスポットが点在します。

詳細については、ＨP観光三重をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Historical Site of Saiku
description:
The Saiku where the priestess lived, supported by the goddess Amaterasu of Ise Jingu on behalf of the Emperor. Around this historical site, there are spots scattered throughout the world of Saiku, which was considered a phantom palace, including 'Saiku Heian no Mori,' which has restored three buildings of the Saiku Ryocho from the Heian period.

For more details, please visit the HP of Kankou Mie.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: 湯元山荘湯ノ口温泉
description: 豊富な湯量と良質な源泉かけ流しの温泉で体の芯まで温まった後は、熊野杉を使った温泉棟で木の香りに癒されよう。入鹿温泉ホテル瀞流荘からトロッコ電車での湯めぐりもオススメです。

title: Yumoto Sanso Yunokuchi Onsen
description: After warming your body to the core in the abundant hot spring with high-quality flowing source, let the scent of wood from the hot spring building made of Kumano cedar heal you. A hot spring tour by trolley train from Iruka Onsen Hotel Toriryuso is also recommended.

title: 道の駅紀宝町ウミガメ公園
description:
ウミガメを飼育研究しているウミガメ保護・啓発活動の拠点。ウミガメや紀宝町周辺にすむ生きものたちとのふれあいが楽しめる。ウミガメ達に餌をあげる餌やり体験も人気です。

詳細については、ＨP観光三重をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Michi-no-Eki Kihō Town Sea Turtle Park
description:
A base for sea turtle protection and awareness activities, where sea turtles are raised and researched. Visitors can enjoy interactions with sea turtles and other creatures living around Kihō Town. The feeding experience, where you can feed the sea turtles, is also popular.

For more details, please visit the HP Kankō Mie.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: 夢古道おわせ
description: 尾鷲のお母ちゃんたちがおもてなしするバイキング。ここだけ・これだけ・いまだけの尾鷲の旬の魚や新鮮な野菜を使った料理はもちろん、元気いっぱいのお母ちゃんたちとのふれあいも魅力です。

title: Yume Kodo Owase
description: A buffet hosted by the mothers of Owase. The dishes made with seasonal fish and fresh vegetables unique to Owase, as well as the interaction with the lively mothers, are certainly appealing.

title: イベント情報紙「観光三重」98号特集　ほのぼの春の自然散歩
description: 三重県観光連盟発行のイベント情報紙「観光三重」98号特集　ほのぼの春の自然散歩にて紹介したスポットです。

title: Event Information Paper 'Kankou Mie' Special Feature: Heartwarming Spring Nature Walk
description: This is a spot introduced in the event information paper 'Kankou Mie' issue 98 special feature: Heartwarming Spring Nature Walk published by the Mie Prefectural Tourism Federation.

title: レッドヒルヒーサーの森
description: 世界一のっぽの木と呼ばれる「センベルセコイア」の木が植えられた里山を散歩しよう。ダイナミックな「森のエリア」と、ローズガーデンやスイレン池が魅力の「花エリア」があります。

title: Red Hill Healer's Forest
description: Let's take a walk in the satoyama where the tree called 'Giant Sequoia', the tallest tree in the world, is planted. There is a dynamic 'Forest Area' and a charming 'Flower Area' with a rose garden and a lily pond.

title: 世界遺産 巡礼路「熊野古道伊勢路」 ～ダイジェスト版
description: 「神々をご紹介しましょう。」そう言って、語り部は私の足を止めた。「自然の神様、というのが私たち日本人の感じる神様なのね。岩にも神様がいる、木にも神様がいる、水の流れにも神がいる。神様からの力、パワーををいただいているっていう風に…」

title: World Heritage Pilgrimage Route 'Kumano Kodo Ise Road' - Digest Version
description: Let's introduce the gods. So said the storyteller, stopping my feet. 'The natural gods are what we Japanese feel as gods. There are gods in rocks, gods in trees, and gods in the flow of water. We receive power from the gods...'

title: 世界遺産 巡礼路「熊野古道伊勢路」 ～映像シリーズ１
description:
古より日本人は万物に神が宿ると信じ、自然を神と崇めてきた…。

太陽の神、天照大御神がお祀りされている伊勢神宮。
ここで旅の無事を祈り、熊野への旅を始めます。
伊勢路は、伊勢から熊野までおよそ170キロ。
様々な顔、様々な表情をした峠をいくつも越えて行きます。
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
熊野古道とは、日本の各地から和歌山県にある熊野三山（熊野速玉大社、熊野那智大社、熊野本宮大社）を目指した巡礼者が歩いた古道のこと。
伊勢神宮と熊野三山という日本の二大聖地をむすぶ世界遺産である巡礼の道「熊野古道伊勢路」の歴史と魅力を紹介します。

title: World Heritage Pilgrimage Route 'Kumano Kodo Iseji' - Video Series 1
description:
Since ancient times, the Japanese have believed that gods reside in all things and have revered nature as divine...

Ise Jingu, where the sun goddess Amaterasu Omikami is enshrined.
Here, we pray for a safe journey and begin our pilgrimage to Kumano.
The Iseji route stretches approximately 170 kilometers from Ise to Kumano.
We will cross many mountain passes, each with its own unique face and expression.
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
The Kumano Kodo refers to the ancient paths walked by pilgrims aiming for the three Kumano shrines (Kumano Hayatama Taisha, Kumano Nachi Taisha, and Kumano Hongu Taisha) located in Wakayama Prefecture from various parts of Japan.
We will introduce the history and charm of the World Heritage pilgrimage route 'Kumano Kodo Iseji,' which connects the two major sacred sites of Japan, Ise Jingu and the Kumano Sanzan.

title: 世界遺産 巡礼路「熊野古道伊勢路」 ～映像シリーズ２
description:
巡礼の道には、祖先を敬い、自然を大切に守る人々の暮らしがある…。

手をあわせて旅の無事を願ってくれる、年を召した里の人。
木の精霊と話して、舟を作る人。
「耕して天に至る」と称される棚田を耕す人。
自然と、神々と、共存する人々が暮らします。
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
熊野古道とは、日本の各地から和歌山県にある熊野三山（熊野速玉大社、熊野那智大社、熊野本宮大社）を目指した巡礼者が歩いた古道のこと。

title: World Heritage Pilgrimage Route 'Kumano Kodo Iseji' - Video Series 2
description:
On the pilgrimage path, there are lives of people who respect their ancestors and cherish nature...

An elderly villager who prays for the safety of travelers with hands together.
A person who talks to the spirits of trees and builds boats.
A person who cultivates terraced rice fields, known as 'plowing to the heavens.'
People live in harmony with nature and the gods.
－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
The Kumano Kodo is an ancient path walked by pilgrims aiming for the Kumano Sanzan (Kumano Hayatama Taisha, Kumano Nachi Taisha, Kumano Hongu Taisha) in Wakayama Prefecture from various parts of Japan.
This is an introduction to the history and charm of the World Heritage pilgrimage route 'Kumano Kodo Iseji,' which connects the two major sacred sites of Japan, Ise Jingu and Kumano Sanzan.

title: 世界遺産 巡礼路「熊野古道伊勢路」 ～映像シリーズ３
description: 神々の棲む場所。人はここで自分と向き合い、生まれ変わる。一滴の雨露が、流れとなり、海となり、天に昇り、雨となって戻ってゆくように…。自然の中に神様と仏様が共に棲む世界、それが熊野。人はここで魂のよみがえりを願うといいます。何かに向かい、心新たに一歩を踏み出す誓いなのです。

title: World Heritage Pilgrimage Route 'Kumano Kodo Ise Road' - Video Series 3
description: A place where gods reside. Here, people confront themselves and are reborn. Just as a drop of dew becomes a stream, then the sea, rises to the heavens, and returns as rain... In a world where gods and buddhas coexist in nature, that is Kumano. It is said that people wish for the resurrection of their souls here. It is a vow to step forward anew towards something.

description: 三重をオトクに、楽しく満喫するツール、「みえ食旅パスポート」のもらい方、使い方を詳しく紹介しています！山村みるくがっこうや、志摩地中海村で「みえ食旅パスポート」を実際に使った様子も収録されているので、三重県に観光へ来る方は必見です！公式サイトはコチラ → https://www.kankomie.or.jp/miesyokutabi/index.html

It also includes footage of using the 'Mie Food Travel Passport' at Yamamura Milk School and Shima Mediterranean Village, making it a must-see for those visiting Mie Prefecture!

title: 四日市コンビナート夜景クルーズ
description: 日本を代表する工場夜景の聖地・四日市。ベテランのガイドさんが同乗し、宝石のような工場夜景はもちろん、遠くは中部国際空港セントレアの夜景まで、特に、第一コンビナートの幻想的な夜景は息を飲む美しさです。

title: Yokkaichi Industrial Complex Night View Cruise
description: Yokkaichi, a sacred place for Japan's representative factory night views. A veteran guide will accompany you, showcasing not only the jewel-like factory night views but also the distant night view of Chubu Centrair International Airport. In particular, the fantastical night view of the First Complex is breathtakingly beautiful.

title: イベント情報紙「観光三重」97号特集　みえのメモリアルタイム
description: 三重県観光連盟発行のイベント情報紙「観光三重」97号特集　みえのメモリアルタイムにて紹介したスポットです。

description: This is a spot introduced in the special feature of the event information paper 'Kankou Mie' No. 97, Mie Memorial Time, published by the Mie Prefecture Tourism Federation.

title: ナガシマスパーランド
description: ギネス認定のコースターなど、約50種以上のアトラクションが揃う遊園地です。

title: Nagashima Spa Land
description: This amusement park features over 50 attractions, including Guinness World Record coasters.

title: アクアイグニス
description: 湯の山温泉にある「癒し」と「食」の総合リゾート。トップレベルのシェフたちの料理に魅了されます。

title: Aqua Ignis
description: A comprehensive resort of 'healing' and 'food' located in Yunoyama Onsen. You will be captivated by the dishes of top-level chefs.

title: パラミタミュージアム
description: パラミタミュージアムにて、萬古の優美な世界に出会える魅力たっぷりの北勢萬古名品展が12月25日まで開催中です。

title: Paramita Museum
description: The North Sei Banko Masterpieces Exhibition, full of charm where you can encounter the elegant world of Banko, is being held at the Paramita Museum until December 25.

title: 御在所ロープウエイ
description:
御在所岳山上からの夜景も感動的です。期間限定で御在所ロープウエイがナイター運転を行います。昼間とは違ったちょっぴりロマンティックな空中散歩にお出かけください。

詳細については、HP観光三重をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Gozaisho Ropeway
description:
The night view from the summit of Gozaisho Mountain is also breathtaking. For a limited time, the Gozaisho Ropeway will operate night rides. Please enjoy a slightly romantic aerial walk that is different from the daytime.

For more details, please visit the HP Kankou Mie.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: 志摩地中海村
description: 地中海へ来たような感動に出会える体験＆滞在型リゾート。本場スペインのデザイナーが手がけた街並みは、日本にいることを忘れてしまう美しさです。

title: Shima Mediterranean Village
description: An experience and stay-type resort where you can encounter the emotion of being in the Mediterranean. The streets designed by a designer from Spain are so beautiful that you will forget you are in Japan.

title: 湯元榊原舘
description: お伊勢さん湯ごりの地として名を馳せる榊原温泉。お肌をやさしくしっとりと包み込む、まるで美容液のようなお湯は、昔から美人の湯として親しまれています。

title: Yumoto Sakakibarakan
description: Sakakibara Onsen, known as a place of hot springs for Ise Shrine, has waters that gently envelop the skin, resembling a beauty serum, and has been cherished as a beautiful hot spring since ancient times.

title: 里創人熊野倶楽部
description:
世界遺産熊野古道をはじめ、熊野の大自然にふれるリゾート施設です。

詳細についてはHP観光三重をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Sato Soujin Kumano Club
description:
A resort facility where you can experience the great nature of Kumano, including the World Heritage Kumano Kodo.

For more details, please visit the HP Kankomie.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: 鈴鹿の森庭園
description:
カメラマンも魅了する梅の名所。八重咲き品種を代表する呉服枝垂を中心に名人とよばれる職人が仕立てた200本ものしだれ梅の名木が揃っています。

詳細については、HP観光三重をご覧ください。
https//www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Suzuka no Mori Garden
description:
A famous plum blossom spot that captivates photographers. It features 200 weeping plum trees crafted by master artisans, centered around the representative variety of double-flowered plums, the Gofuku Shidare.

For more details, please visit the HP Kankou Mie.
https//www.kankomie.or.jp

description: The NINJA～What is a Ninja!?～は、三重県総合博物館MieMuで2016年10月25日(火)から2017年1月9日(月)まで開催されている展示です。

description: The NINJA～What is a Ninja!?～ is an exhibition held at the Mie Prefectural Museum MieMu from October 25, 2016 (Tuesday) to January 9, 2017 (Monday).

description: The NINJA～What is a Ninja!?～のシーンです。

title: The NINJA～What is a Ninja!?～
description: This is a scene from 'The NINJA～What is a Ninja!?～'.

title: 伊賀の里　モクモク手づくりファーム
description: 自然・農園・手づくりをテーマにしたファクトリーファーム。実りの秋を祝う収穫祭をH28/10/8～10/10に開催します。

title: Iga no Sato Mokumoku Handmade Farm
description: A factory farm themed around nature, agriculture, and handmade products. A harvest festival celebrating the fruitful autumn will be held from 10/8 to 10/10 in H28.

title: 伊賀流忍者博物館
description:
伊賀上野城や俳聖殿など名所が多い上野公園内にある忍者博物館です。忍者やくノ一がどんでん返しなどの忍者屋敷の仕掛けからくりを案内します。忍術体験広場では、迫力の忍術実演ショーも楽しめます。

詳細については、HP観光三重をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Iga-ryu Ninja Museum
description:
This is a ninja museum located in Ueno Park, which is home to many famous sites such as Iga Ueno Castle and the Haisei Hall. Ninja and kunoichi guide visitors through the tricks and mechanisms of the ninja house, including surprise elements. In the Ninja Experience Plaza, you can also enjoy thrilling ninja performance shows.

For more details, please visit the HP Kankou Mie.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: 伊賀のかくれ宿　湯元赤目温泉隠れの湯　対泉閣
description:
赤目四十八滝まで歩いて5分という赤目渓谷の入り口にある旅館です。地下1000ｍから湧く日本療養温泉規定認定の良質のアルカリ性単純温泉や伊賀牛をはじめとした郷土料理が満喫できます。

詳細についてはHP観光三重をごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Iga's Hidden Inn Yumoto Akame Onsen Kakenoyu Taisenkaku
description:
This ryokan is located at the entrance of Akame Valley, just a 5-minute walk from the Akame Forty-eight Waterfalls. You can enjoy high-quality alkaline simple hot springs certified by the Japanese therapeutic hot spring regulations, which spring from 1000 meters underground, as well as local cuisine featuring Iga beef.

For more details, please visit the HP Kankomie.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: 赤目四十八滝渓谷保勝会
description: 美しい名瀑や渓谷に織り成す樹木、渓流、生きている化石と呼ばれるサンショウウオなど、大自然が生み出した芸術に出会えます。秋にはイロハモミジやカエデ類などが紅葉し、素晴らしい渓渓谷美が楽しめます。

title: Akame Shijuhachidaki Keikoku Preservation Association
description: You can encounter the art created by nature, such as beautiful waterfalls, trees woven into the valleys, streams, and the salamander known as a living fossil. In autumn, the Irohamomiji and maple trees turn red, allowing you to enjoy the wonderful beauty of the valleys.

title: まつもとの來來憲
description: Yokkaichi名物大とんてき元祖の店、なんと250gもの分厚い豚肉を使用しています。柔らかく焼き上げた肉のうまみとにんにくエキスが凝縮された特性ダレとの相性は抜群です。

title: Matsumoto no Rairaiken
description: The original store of Yokkaichi's famous large tonteki, using a thick 250g pork. The combination of the tenderly grilled meat's flavor and the special sauce concentrated with garlic extract is outstanding.

title: はまぐりプラザ
description: 桑名のはまぐりは木曽三川の淡水と海水がほどよく混じる恵まれた水で育ち、ふっくらと柔らかくて甘いのが特長です。食堂はまかぜでは、焼きはまぐりをはじめ、はまぐり丼、はまぐりうどんなど様々な食べ方が楽しめます。

title: Hamaguri Plaza
description: The hamaguri (clams) of Kuwana are grown in blessed water where fresh water from the Kiso Three Rivers and seawater mix just right, characterized by their plumpness, tenderness, and sweetness. At the restaurant Hamakaze, you can enjoy various ways of eating hamaguri, including grilled hamaguri, hamaguri rice bowl, and hamaguri udon.

title: 賛急屋(さんきゅうや)
description: こだわりの和風出汁で伊賀牛や地元産の野菜を使用した牛汁には、自慢のだし巻き卵が入るのが特徴です。定食では、牛汁と伊賀米コシヒカリのおにぎり、からあげ、地元食材の3点盛りが楽しめます。

title: Sankyuya
description: The beef soup made with carefully selected Japanese-style dashi, using Iga beef and locally sourced vegetables, features a proud dashimaki tamago (rolled omelette). In the set meal, you can enjoy beef soup, onigiri made with Iga rice (Koshihikari), fried chicken, and a three-item platter of local ingredients.

title: 新玉亭
description: 炭火焼による関西風の蒲焼は、パリッと表面は香ばしく、中はふわふわです。ご飯の甘味と食感がうなぎの味を引き立てるため、伝統のタレをかけた時に、ちょうど良い食感になるよう炊き方も工夫しています。

title: Shintamatei
description: The Kansai-style grilled eel, cooked over charcoal, has a crispy surface that is fragrant and a fluffy interior. The sweetness and texture of the rice enhance the flavor of the eel, and the cooking method is carefully crafted to achieve the perfect texture when the traditional sauce is applied.

title: おわせお魚いちば　おとと
description: 尾鷲港で水揚げされた魚介類や、ぶり、まぐろ等が所狭しと並ぶ地場産品直売所です。店内の食堂では、水産会社が経営する店だからこそできる新鮮な魚介類を使った料理が楽しめます。

title: Owaso Fish Market Ototo
description: This is a local product direct sales store where seafood caught at Owase Port, such as yellowtail and tuna, is lined up closely. In the restaurant inside, you can enjoy dishes made with fresh seafood, thanks to the fact that it is run by a seafood company.

title: 松阪まるよし（三重県松阪市）
description:
牛一頭約600㎏から10㎏程度しか取れない極上ロースを使用した柔らなか肉質と甘みがたまらない松阪牛ロースステーキをはじめ、あっさり食べたいというご要望から誕生した松阪牛モモステーキなどが堪能できます。

title: ふるさと味工房アグリ
description: 玉城豚の特徴は、何といっても鮮度の良さです。新鮮だからこそ臭みがなく、甘みのある脂身が特徴です。その魅力を一番シンプルに味わえるしゃぶしゃぶは、ジューシーで甘みのある玉城豚を贅沢にお召し上がりいただけるおすすめ料理です。

title: Furusato Flavor Workshop Aguri
description: The characteristic of Tamaki pork is its freshness. Because it is fresh, it has no odor and features sweet fat. The shabu-shabu, which allows you to enjoy this charm in the simplest way, is a recommended dish where you can indulge in the juicy and sweet Tamaki pork.

title: ありすえ
description:
伊勢まぐろの刺身、血合のフライ、赤身のユッケ、心臓の佃煮といった食感や味わいの違う食べ方で南伊勢ブランドの伊勢まぐろが楽しめます。なかなか食べられない心臓など、地元ならではの味に出会えるのも嬉しいです。

詳細については、観光三重HPをごらんください。
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: Arisue
description:
You can enjoy the Ise tuna brand from Minami-Ise in various textures and flavors, such as sashimi of Ise tuna, fried bloodline, red meat yukhoe, and heart tsukudani. It's also delightful to encounter local flavors like the heart, which are hard to find elsewhere.

For more details, please visit the Mie Tourism website.
https://www.kankomie.or.jp

title: First Autumn Leaves
description: I went to the Kawachi Valley in Tsu with my 4-month-old daughter. She was wide-eyed at the autumn leaves for the first time☆ The autumn leaves were very beautiful, and the air was clear and refreshing.

title: 輪中の郷の収穫体験
description: 桑名市長島町の輪中の郷で収穫体験をしました。サツマイモ、大根、ジャガイモの３種類を、子どもたちと楽しみながら収穫できました。大根は子どもでは抜き取るのが難しいくらい大きなものでした。サツマイモやジャガイモも、大きなものから小さなものまでたくさん取れて満足です。

title: Harvest Experience at Wajun no Sato
description: I had a harvest experience at Wajun no Sato in Nagashima-cho, Kuwana City. We enjoyed harvesting three types of vegetables: sweet potatoes, radishes, and potatoes, with the children. The radishes were so big that it was difficult for the children to pull them out. We were satisfied with the many sweet potatoes and potatoes we harvested, ranging from large to small.

title: ぐるぐる鬼ヶ城

description: The weather was nice, so I drove along the Shichiri Mihama coast and went around Onigajo. The large rocks were impressive, and the Kumano Sea was beautiful.

description:
2011年11月18日、津市芸濃町にある河内渓谷へ家族でお出かけしました。紅葉が素晴らしく、もみじが真っ赤に染まってました。観光ボランティアの方が見所など教えてくださりました。

title: 志摩市ともやま公園キャンプ場

title: Shima City Tomoyama Park Campground
description: On October 6th, with the lingering summer heat, we went to the 'Rurururu Satoumi Cultural Festival' at the Tomoyama Park Campground in Shima City with our family of three plus my older sister. We had a great time immersed in nature, fascinated by lizards and red dragonflies. P.S. I was moved by the warm response from Mr. Makita of the Mie Prefectural Tourism Federation. Thank you very much.

title: Red Dragonfly Hometown Search Operation!
description:
I went to Mount Gozaisho and participated in the Red Dragonfly Hometown Search Operation. Although there was sunshine, the breeze made the shade of the trees very refreshing. It was said that the number of dragonflies was low that day, possibly due to the wind from the previous day, but the children ran around and managed to catch 9 dragonflies and mark them with a 'G'. It became a fun summer memory.
