title: 日本遺産ツーリズム（長浜編）～水と祈りの文化 竹生島を訪ねて～
description: 【⛩日本遺産・水遺産「竹生島」🏞】琵琶湖の中で２番目に大きい竹生島は、古くから航海の神様が祭られてきた神聖な島です。⛩✨日本遺産・水遺産にも認定されたこの島は、古くから「神が宿る島」として信仰を集めてきました。観光船で竹生島港に到着すると、宝厳寺へと続く165段の「いのりの階段」から竹生島の旅が始まります。「日本三弁才天」の一つとされる宝厳寺本堂の本尊・大弁才天や豪華絢爛な国宝・宝厳寺唐門や西国三十三所観音霊場の第三十番札所・宝厳寺観音堂など見どころが満載です。🚤国宝の本殿を持つ都久夫須麻神社では、絶景の拝殿からかわらけ投げを楽しむことができます。刺激的な歴史と信仰の旅路を、ぜひ映像でお楽しみください。

title: Japan Heritage Tourism (Nagahama Edition) - Visiting the Sacred Island of Chikubushima
description: Chikubushima, the second largest island in Lake Biwa, is a sacred island where the god of navigation has been worshipped since ancient times. Recognized as a Japan Heritage and Water Heritage site, this island has long been revered as a 'sacred island where gods reside.' Upon arriving at Chikubushima Port by sightseeing boat, the journey begins with the 165-step 'Inori no Kaidan' leading to Hōgon-ji Temple. The temple is home to Daibenzaiten, one of Japan's three Benzaiten, and features the splendid national treasure, Hōgon-ji Karamon, as well as the 30th temple of the Saigoku 33 Kannon pilgrimage, Hōgon-ji Kannon Hall, among many other attractions. At Tsukubusuma Shrine, which has a national treasure main hall, you can enjoy throwing 'kawarake' from the scenic hall. Please enjoy this exciting journey through history and faith in the video.

title: 日本遺産ツーリズム（彦根編）～彦根城玄宮園と外堀跡を訪ねて～
description: 【🏯日本遺産・水遺産「彦根城とその水の物語」🌿】彦根城🏯は、関ヶ原の戦い直後に天下普請で築城された、大坂城包囲網の要となる軍事拠点で、江戸時代には、城を守る三重のお堀、そして、北は松原内湖、西は琵琶湖、南は付け替えられた善利川と、水に囲まれた水城でした。今回は、水を巧みに利用した池泉回遊式大名庭園『玄宮園』と、その水源であり、敵からの防御を担うとともに、人々の暮らしに密接に関わってきた『外堀跡』を訪ねる様子をぜひ映像でお楽しみください。特に「玄宮園の池に映る国宝の天守」と「明治時代以降全域埋め立てられた外堀跡に残る土塁遺構」は必見です。

title: Japan Heritage Tourism (Hikone Edition) - Visiting Hikone Castle Genkyu-en and the Outer Moat Ruins
description: Hikone Castle is a military base that was built shortly after the Battle of Sekigahara and was a key point in the siege of Osaka Castle. During the Edo period, it was surrounded by three moats protecting the castle, with Lake Matsubara to the north, Lake Biwa to the west, and the re-routed Zenriki River to the south, making it a water castle. This time, please enjoy the video of our visit to the 'Genkyu-en', a daimyo garden that skillfully utilizes water, and the 'Outer Moat Ruins', which are closely related to people's lives and served as a source of water and defense against enemies. The 'National Treasure of the Main Keep reflected in the pond of Genkyu-en' and the 'earthen ramparts remaining in the outer moat ruins, which were completely reclaimed after the Meiji era' are particularly noteworthy.

title: 日本遺産ツーリズム（東近江編）～水と暮らしの文化 永源寺を訪ねて～
description:
【🍁日本遺産・水遺産「永源寺」⛩】
滋賀県東近江市に佇む「永源寺（えいげんじ）」は、650年以上の歴史を誇る臨済宗永源寺派の大本山です。

境内には、国内屈指の大きさを誇るヨシ葦屋根の方丈（本堂）や県指定有形文化財があります。

深い自然に抱かれた幽境に栄える伽藍は四季折々の姿を楽しむことができ、秋に見られる境内を埋め尽くすほどの真っ赤な紅葉🍁は関西有数の紅葉の名所として全国から多くの参拝者が訪れます。

普段は一般の方の立ち入りを禁止している場所もボランティアガイドと一緒なら特別に見学することができます。紅葉が古刹に映える永源寺の魅力を、ぜひ映像でお楽しみください。

title: Japan Heritage Tourism (Higashiomi Edition) - Visiting Eigenji, a Culture of Water and Life
description:
【🍁Japan Heritage & Water Heritage 'Eigenji'⛩】
'Eigenji' (永源寺), located in Higashiomi City, Shiga Prefecture, is the head temple of the Rinzai sect Eigenji branch, boasting a history of over 650 years.

The temple grounds feature a main hall (Hōjō) with a thatched roof made of reed, one of the largest in the country, as well as designated tangible cultural properties of the prefecture.

Nestled in deep nature, the temple complex offers a picturesque view throughout the seasons, and the vibrant red autumn leaves 🍁 that blanket the grounds attract many visitors from across the country, making it one of the top spots for autumn foliage in the Kansai region.

While certain areas are usually off-limits to the public, special tours can be arranged with volunteer guides. Enjoy the charm of Eigenji, where the autumn leaves beautifully contrast with the ancient temple, through our video.

title: "Extraordinary" is "everyday" Fukui Prefecture【「非日常」が「日常」福井県】
description:
「幸福度日本一」の福井県。自然良し、人良し、文化良し。
そんな魅力あふれる福井県ですが、福井を訪れる外国人観光客の数は、まだまだ「日本一」には届きません。
どうすれば海外の人に福井の魅力が伝わるのか？
目を付けたのは「福井在住の外国人」。福井で暮らし、福井の良さを肌で感じてくれている彼らなら、その魅力を上手く伝えてくれると確信し、ナレーション、ロケ地の選定、出演まで、お手伝いいただきました。
私たちも知らなかった福井の魅力満載の映像（全3部作）に仕上がりました。
目指すは「訪日外国人客数＝全国1位」です。

title: "Extraordinary" is "everyday" Fukui Prefecture
description:
Fukui Prefecture, known for being the "happiest" in Japan. 
Great nature, great people, great culture. 
Despite the many attractions of Fukui, the number of foreign tourists visiting is still far from being the "number one" in Japan. 
How can we convey the charm of Fukui to people overseas? 
We focused on "foreign residents in Fukui." 
Living in Fukui and experiencing its goodness firsthand, we were confident they could effectively communicate its charm, and they helped us with narration, location selection, and appearances. 
We created a video full of the charms of Fukui that even we didn't know about (a total of three parts). 
Our goal is to achieve "the highest number of foreign visitors to Japan."

description:
Full version: https://youtu.be/em01VJ-Ep00

Ako City, which is famous worldwide for its Chushingura story, celebrated its 70 year anniversary in 2021. In commemoration of this, we created a video recording the current state of Ako as a starting point for the future, looking back on the history of Ako City. Enjoy beautiful images with drones and the latest 4K cameras.

However, even with the latest technology, it is impossible to depict all the attractions of Ako City. Please visit Ako City and experience the charm of Ako City. We always welcome you.

description: 日本の食文化をはじめ、様々な分野で使用される『塩』。赤穂塩にまつわる歴史や製法、伝統的な製法によってできた塩に着目した新たな試みなど、塩の未来・可能性を表現しています。

title: [Hyogo Prefecture Ako City PR Video] 'AKO SALT OF THE SEA'

Salt, used in various fields including Japanese food culture.
This expresses the future and possibilities of salt, focusing on the history and production methods related to Ako salt, as well as new initiatives based on traditional production methods.

title: TAKAYAMA JAPAN | Cinematic Travel Film
description: I traveled to one of the most beautiful areas in Japan, Takayama. Norikura-dake and other breathtaking scenes awaited me. Feel the spectacular nature of Takayama and the excitement of the Takayama Festival.

title: 高山 日本 | シネマティック旅行映画
description: 私は日本の最も美しい地域の一つ、高山に旅行しました。乗鞍岳や他の息をのむような景色が私を待っていました。高山の壮大な自然と高山祭りの興奮を感じてください。

title: OKINAWA JAPAN | Cinematic Travel Film
description: Okinawa is one of the most beautiful islands in Japan, with many unspoiled and magnificent natural wonders. I have seen many incredible sights with my own eyes and wanted more people to get to know this island. So glad to share some highlights with you all.

title: 沖縄 日本 | シネマティックトラベルフィルム
description: 沖縄は日本で最も美しい島の一つで、多くの手つかずの素晴らしい自然の驚異があります。私は自分の目で多くの素晴らしい光景を見てきましたが、もっと多くの人々にこの島を知ってもらいたいと思いました。皆さんといくつかのハイライトを共有できることを嬉しく思います。

title: OKAYAMA JAPAN -Kurashiki, Soja and Takahashi- | Cinematic Travel Film
description: I explored the Okayama Japan in autumn. Beautiful autumn foliage, fantastic mountain castles and night views of factories, and mysterious cityscape where Western and Japanese cultures are blended... There is much worth you visiting this region.

title: 岡山 日本 - 倉敷、総社、高梁 - | シネマティック旅行映画
description: 秋の岡山を探索しました。美しい秋の紅葉、素晴らしい山の城、工場の夜景、そして西洋と日本の文化が融合した神秘的な街並み... この地域を訪れる価値がたくさんあります。

title: SUO OSHIMA JAPAN | Cinematic Travel Film
description: This summer I explored Suo Oshima in Japan. This island is a sister city of Hawaii. Hula dance festivals are held here every week during the summer. I also enjoyed the beautiful ocean and hiking in the scenic mountains. Now, let's go on a tropical adventure!

title: 須尾大島日本 | シネマティックトラベルフィルム
description: この夏、私は日本の須尾大島を探検しました。この島はハワイの姉妹都市です。フラダンスフェスティバルは夏の間、毎週ここで開催されます。美しい海や風光明媚な山々でのハイキングも楽しみました。さあ、トロピカルな冒険に出かけましょう！

title: SUWA JAPAN | Cinematic Travel Film
description: This summer I explored the Suwa area of Japan. There are the Japanese Alps and other majestic mountains, mysterious forested areas, and historic sites around Lake Suwa in this area. The hearts of the people of Suwa lie with their faith in nature and the Suwa-taisha shrine. I was also impressed by their culture when I hiked through those mountains and historical sites. Hope you all enjoy this adventure together.

title: SUWA JAPAN | シネマティックトラベルフィルム
description: この夏、私は日本の諏訪地域を探索しました。そこには日本アルプスや他の壮大な山々、神秘的な森林地帯、そして諏訪湖周辺の歴史的な場所があります。諏訪の人々の心は自然への信仰と諏訪大社にあります。私はその山々や歴史的な場所をハイキングすることで彼らの文化にも感銘を受けました。皆さんもこの冒険を楽しんでいただければ幸いです。

title: NAGAHAMA JAPAN | Cinematic Travel Film
description: In the Nagahama area of Japan, I visited beautiful mountains, a mysterious isolated island on the largest lake in Japan, and an emotional castle town that has existed since the Middle Ages. Those were truly special experiences for me. I hope you all enjoy this video. And a special thanks to the 'Samurais' for their willingness to be filmed.

title: 長浜 日本 | シネマティックトラベルフィルム
description: 日本の長浜エリアでは、美しい山々、最大の湖にある神秘的な孤立した島、そして中世から存在する感情的な城下町を訪れました。それらは私にとって本当に特別な体験でした。このビデオを楽しんでいただければ幸いです。また、撮影に協力してくれた「サムライ」に特別な感謝を捧げます。

title: 『City in Blue』 "OUR STORIES : from OTARU"
description: Distant echoes of the tide. Blue waves lap the shore and the cloudy sky stretches out beyond the horizon. The blue color of the landscape, like a jewel, is a mirror that absorbs the seasons. The people of the port town, living in the seasons as they turn. Those tranquil moments day to day the passing of generations linked together by the town of Otaru. The silhouettes that emerge from the crowd are the truth of this city and its allure. Everything is connected to the ocean.

title: 『青の街』
description: 潮の遠い響き。青い波が岸に打ち寄せ、雲の多い空が地平線の向こうに広がっている。風景の青色は宝石のようで、季節を吸収する鏡である。季節が移り変わる中で生きる港町の人々。世代を超えてつながる穏やかな日々の瞬間、これが小樽の町である。群衆から浮かび上がるシルエットは、この街とその魅力の真実である。すべては海とつながっている。

title: Vol.2 - PRODUCT 「Historical and Cultural Gifts」 "OUR STORIES : from OTARU"
description: Many people visited Otaru during the pioneering period of Hokkaido, bringing with them many goods and culture. At the same time, 'manufacturing' flourished, and some long-established companies have continued to operate since the Meiji era. Today, new Otaru-like products are being created one after another, making the most of Otaru's history.

title: Vol.2 - PRODUCT 「歴史的・文化的な贈り物」
description: 多くの人々が北海道の開拓時代に小樽を訪れ、多くの品物や文化を持ち込みました。同時に「製造業」が栄え、明治時代から続く老舗企業もあります。今日では、小樽の歴史を生かした新しい小樽らしい商品が次々と生まれています。

title: Vol.1 - CITYSCAPE 「Next Hundred Years」 "OUR STORIES : from OTARU"
description: Otaru is celebrating 100 years since its municipal organization was established. What Otaru has gained and lost in the past 100 years through its shift to a logistics port will provide food for the next 100 years. Otaru has many historical and cultural legacies. A new heartbeat is now beating from the port that was the foundation of this city's development. 'Harbor to the Public'

title: Vol.1 - CITYSCAPE 「次の百年」
description: 小樽は市制施行100周年を迎えています。物流港への移行を通じて、小樽が過去100年間に得たものと失ったものは、次の100年間の糧となるでしょう。小樽には多くの歴史的および文化的遺産があります。この街の発展の基盤であった港から新たな鼓動が響き始めています。「市民のための港」

title: Teppan Spaghetti
description: "Teppan Spaghetti," sizzling on a hot iron plate, is a soul food of Kushiro! Not only is there a meat sauce version, but also a salt-flavored spaghetti! Be sure to savor this dish, which has been loved by locals for a long time, right here in Kushiro!

title: Cycle Adventure Akan
description:
Experience the rich nature of Akan, a town where you can fully enjoy the abundant nature of Akan Mashu National Park.

The rich nature woven by volcanoes, forests, and lakes, the Ainu culture that still thrives in the Akan Lake hot springs,
and various activities such as cycling and canoeing to thoroughly enjoy the great outdoors.

We will introduce ways to enjoy the famous hot spring area of Hokkaido, Akan Lake Onsen!

title: 草津温泉の感染症対策～安心で快適な旅行をひとつになって～
description: 草津温泉は感染症対策の基礎として「スタッフのマスク着用等の咳エチケット」や「施設内への消毒液の設置」「飛沫感染防止への工夫」などの８つの指標を制定しました。この８つの指標を基にさらなる感染症対策に努め、皆様をお迎えする準備をしております。また、感染症の拡大防止には、皆様のご協力がどうしても必要です。この動画には、８つの指標と皆様へのちょっとしたお願いが掲載されております。旅まえにちょっとだけご覧になってみてください！～安心で快適な旅行をひとつになって～

title: Kusatsu Onsen Infection Control Measures - Together for a Safe and Comfortable Trip
description: Kusatsu Onsen has established eight indicators as the basis for infection control measures, including 'staff wearing masks and cough etiquette,' 'installation of disinfectants within facilities,' and 'measures to prevent droplet infection.' Based on these eight indicators, we are working hard on further infection control measures and preparing to welcome everyone. Additionally, your cooperation is essential for preventing the spread of infections. This video includes the eight indicators and a small request to everyone. Please take a moment to watch it before your trip! - Together for a safe and comfortable trip.

title: 「Re ・・・」 草津温泉 -KusatsuOnsen-
description: 「ある家族の物語」結婚する前、草津温泉を訪れたカップル。時が経ち夫婦となり家族となり日常を過ごしています。そんな家族はある「こと」がきっかけで草津温泉へ訪れます。そこにはたくさんの笑顔があふれ、２人で訪れたあの頃とはまた違う幸せな時間・・・大切な人と、家族と新たな思い出を刻むことができる場所・・・時を超えて、世代を超えて、繰り返しても、その一瞬はまた別のもの・・・

title: Re ・・・
description: A family story. A couple visited Kusatsu Onsen before getting married. As time passed, they became a couple and then a family, living their daily lives. This family visits Kusatsu Onsen again due to a certain 'event'. There are many smiles, and the happy moments are different from when they visited as a couple... A place where you can create new memories with loved ones and family... Across time and generations, even if repeated, that moment is something different...

title: 『草津温泉の温泉力』　コロナ不活化編
description: 草津温泉の最大の魅力はなんといっても温泉そのもの。昔から多くの方の心と身体を癒してきました。草津温泉の泉質は酸性泉で、含まれる温泉成分が絶妙なバランスとなっており、強力な殺菌力を持つと、以前より研究されてきました。その温泉力の高い草津の温泉は新型コロナウイルスにどのような効果をもたらすのか。その研究結果を動画にしました。「温泉力」温泉プラスアルファの”背景”を少し覗いてみましょう。研究：草津町 研究機関：群馬大学（板橋英之教授）動画著作：草津温泉観光協会 制作：COOTS。※撮影のため、マスクを外しているシーンがあります。※この研究は、コロナウイルスに感染しない、治癒すると証明されるものではありません。

title: Kusatsu Onsen's Hot Spring Power: COVID-19 Inactivation Edition
description: The greatest charm of Kusatsu Onsen is undoubtedly the hot springs themselves. They have been healing the hearts and bodies of many people for a long time. The quality of Kusatsu Onsen is acidic, and the balance of the contained hot spring components has been studied for its strong antibacterial properties. What effects does the highly effective hot spring of Kusatsu have on the novel coronavirus? We have made a video of the research results. Let's take a peek at the 'hot spring power' and the 'background' that adds to it. Research: Kusatsu Town Research Institution: Gunma University (Professor Hidetaka Itabashi) Video Copyright: Kusatsu Onsen Tourism Association Production: COOTS. *There are scenes where masks are removed for filming. *This research does not prove that one will not be infected with the coronavirus or that one will be cured.

title: 草津温泉の「歴史と進化」　今までとこれから～進化を続ける温泉街～
description: 草津温泉は開湯後、古くから、訪れた方の心と体を癒し続けてきました。歴史を礎とし、近年では、湯畑、西の河原公園を中心に、官民一体となってまちづくりを行って参りました。更には、裏草津地蔵エリア再開発が完成され、これからは温泉門の建設も計画されています。草津温泉の魅力は、温泉そのもの、温泉と共生する文化、自然、そして、まち歩きの楽しい温泉街と、「定番の温泉旅行+αを満喫できること」。草津温泉は、いつでも、訪れるたびに何か「違う顔」をおみせできるようこれからも常に進化を続けています。草津温泉のこれからにもご期待ください。

title: Kusatsu Onsen: History and Evolution - The Evolving Hot Spring Town
description: Kusatsu Onsen has been healing the hearts and bodies of visitors since its opening. Based on its history, in recent years, town development has been carried out with a focus on Yubatake and Nishi-no-Kawara Park, in collaboration between the public and private sectors. Furthermore, the redevelopment of the Ura-Kusatsu Jizo area has been completed, and plans for the construction of a hot spring gate are underway. The charm of Kusatsu Onsen lies in the hot springs themselves, the culture that coexists with the hot springs, nature, and the enjoyable hot spring town that allows you to enjoy 'a standard hot spring trip + α.' Kusatsu Onsen continues to evolve so that it can show something 'different' every time you visit. Please look forward to the future of Kusatsu Onsen.

title: Aventure Kusatsu Onsen -French-
description: 草津温泉は、旅行の専門家によって選ばれた人気の温泉地ランキングで22年連続1位にランクインしています。また、オンライン旅行代理店の調査による旅行者のランキングでも1位に選ばれました。さらに、日本のテレビ番組でも外国人に人気の温泉地として1位に選ばれました。多くの方が「草津温泉」という名前を初めて聞いたかもしれません。多くのフランス人が将来草津温泉を訪れることを期待しています。草津温泉は温泉のテーマパークと考えることができます。温泉の他にも、温泉街には宿泊施設、レストラン、浴衣を着て歩ける歩行者専用の通り、そして豊かな自然が溢れています。私たちは、日本人が温泉旅行で想像するすべてを持っていると考えています。

title: アヴァンチュール草津温泉
description: Kusatsu Onsen has been ranked number one for 22 consecutive years in the ranking of popular hot spring destinations selected by travel professionals. We have also been ranked first in a traveler ranking, based on a survey by the largest online travel agencies. We have also been ranked first in a Japanese television program as the favorite hot spring source of foreigners. Many of you may have heard the name 'Kusatsu Onsen' for the first time. We hope that many French people will visit Kusatsu Onsen in the future. We can consider Kusatsu Onsen as a theme park of hot springs. In addition to hot springs, the hot spring town is also full of accommodations, restaurants, pedestrian streets for yukata, and lush nature. We believe we have everything that Japanese people imagine when traveling to hot springs.

title: KusatsuOnsen toB in English
description: Kusatsu Onsen is one of Japan’s three most famous hot springs. It boasts the highest natural output of hot spring water in Japan, with over 32,300 liters gushing out every minute — enough to fill approximately 230,000 oil drums in a single day. Thanks to this abundant flow, many ryokan (traditional inns) and hot spring facilities in Kusatsu are able to offer 'free-flowing hot spring water' directly from the source. You can witness the impressive volume of hot water at famous spots like Sai no Kawara Park and Yubatake, but you’ll also experience it firsthand at each hot spring inn. Please enjoy the pure, natural hot spring water to your heart’s content.

title: 草津温泉について
description: 草津温泉は日本三大名湯の一つです。毎分32,300リットル以上の温泉水が湧き出ており、1日で約230,000本のオイルドラムを満たすことができます。この豊富な流れのおかげで、草津の多くの旅館や温泉施設では、源泉から直接「かけ流しの温泉水」を提供することができます。草津の有名なスポットである西の河原公園や湯畑でその印象的な湧出量を目にすることができますが、各温泉宿で直接体験することもできます。ぜひ、純粋で自然な温泉水を心ゆくまでお楽しみください。

description: 日常に追われる私たち・・・自分に向き合いゆったりと考える時間。慌ただしさをすべて忘れていつもと違う温泉旅行。新しい自分に生まれ変わる旅。そんな旅行もおススメです。

title: Recommendation for Retreat - Kusatsu Onsen -
description: We are busy in our daily lives... A time to face ourselves and think leisurely. Forget all the hustle and enjoy a different kind of hot spring trip. A journey to be reborn as a new self. Such a trip is also recommended.

title: 草津温泉 Web movie ｜『 3650＋』
description: 子どもが成長するにつれて、いつのまにか無くなっていたこと。一緒にお風呂に入る時間、子供を抱き上げる瞬間、何気ない会話、肩を並べて笑ったあの感覚。それは、特別な区切りじゃなくて、ただ静かに終わっていく。でも温泉には、その続きをそっと差し出してくれる力がある。親子で並んで湯に浸かる、ただそれだけの時間が、なぜか忘れられない。無くなってたものが、ふと戻る。そんな場所が、温泉。

title: Kusatsu Onsen Web Movie ｜ '3650+'
description: As children grow up, there are things that quietly disappear without us noticing. The time spent bathing together, the moments of lifting the child, the casual conversations, and the feeling of laughing side by side. It's not a special milestone; it just quietly comes to an end. But hot springs have the power to gently offer the continuation of those moments. The simple time spent soaking in the water side by side as a parent and child is somehow unforgettable. What was lost can suddenly return. That is the essence of a hot spring.

Okubo Terraced Tea Garden

Located in the western part of Shizuoka Prefecture, where Mount Fuji is, this town is home to people who cherish beautiful nature and traditions, and is called the small Kyoto of Enshu.

In the northern part of Morimachi, in the Mikura district, lies the 'Okubo Settlement'.

The road that bustled with Akihama pilgrimage and salt trade winds through steep tea gardens, creating a three-dimensional space where agriculture and daily life thrive.

Historical sites that evoke thoughts of the Warring States period. A village in the air where many people's interactions were born.

title: Nature tourism IN Hida-Osaka
description:
Hida-Osaka is a quiet mountain village located in the central part of Gifu Prefecture, exactly halfway between the large tourist destinations of Gero Onsen to the south and Hida Takayama to the north. Although it is a small town, it boasts three different hot springs (Yuyama Onsen, Shimojima Onsen, and Dakkagawa Onsen) thanks to the blessings of the active volcano, Mt. Ontake. It is also the town with the most waterfalls in Japan, featuring 216 waterfalls with a drop of over 5 meters carved deeply into the valleys. Hida-Osaka offers many activities to enjoy its abundant natural resources, which are among the best in the country. In spring, you can cycle along the Hanamomo flowers blooming by the roadside with an E-Bike, and in autumn, you can enjoy a stylish café while swaying in a hammock amidst the colorful forest. In winter, you can enjoy a sauna surrounded by snow or take a winter waterfall tour to visit frozen waterfalls (ice falls). Summer is packed with activities such as stream fishing, camping, shower climbing, and waterfall tours. You can enjoy it in your own way. It is a 30-minute drive from Gero and 40 minutes from Takayama. It is not a place with convenient transportation, so we recommend staying overnight rather than just a day trip. Once you visit, you will surely become addicted to it.

title: BIRD'S EYE3「１　雄川堰がおりなす風景」｜建設企画課｜群馬県
description:
群馬テレビで平成31年4月6日・7日に放映したものです。

私達の生活に欠かせない土木施設。県内には重要文化財に指定されたもの、最新の技術を駆使したものなど、将来に語り継ぐ価値のある土木施設が数多く存在します。これら土木施設の役割や魅力を広く伝え、また将来を担う子どもたちに興味を持ってもらうため、県内の土木施設を紹介する番組を制作し放送することとなりました。ドローンで撮影した映像などを駆使し、土木施設ならではのスケール感・ダイナミック感をお伝えします。

群馬県甘楽町にある雄川堰は世界かんがい施設遺産となっており、水路沿いには四季の花々や紅葉を楽しめる遊歩道が整備されています。また県道下高尾小幡線は、城下町の情緒ある風景を演出するため、石畳風に仕上げた舗装と御影石の縁石が、サクラ並木と協調して歴史的な雰囲気をかもしだしています。今回は、桜の季節を待ち侘びる雄川堰とその周辺の風景をお届け致します。

title: BIRD'S EYE3 '1. The Landscape Created by the Ougawa Dam'
description:
This was broadcasted on Gunma TV on April 6th and 7th, 2019.

Civil engineering facilities are essential to our lives. In the prefecture, there are many civil engineering structures that are designated as important cultural properties and those that utilize the latest technology, all of which have value to be passed down to future generations. To widely convey the roles and attractions of these civil engineering facilities and to spark interest in the children who will bear the future, we have produced and broadcast a program introducing civil engineering facilities in the prefecture. We will convey the scale and dynamism unique to civil engineering facilities using drone footage and other techniques.

The Ougawa Dam in Kanra Town, Gunma Prefecture, is a World Irrigation Heritage site, and along the waterway, a promenade has been developed where visitors can enjoy seasonal flowers and autumn leaves. Additionally, the Ken-do Shitakao Obata Line is paved in a cobblestone style and features granite curbs to create a historical atmosphere in harmony with the cherry blossom trees, enhancing the picturesque scenery of the castle town. This time, we will deliver the scenery of the Ougawa Dam and its surroundings, eagerly awaiting the cherry blossom season.

title: BIRD'S EYE3「２　金精峠を開く壮大な除雪風景」｜建設企画課｜群馬県
description: 群馬テレビで平成31年4月13日・14日に放映したものです。私達の生活に欠かせない土木施設。県内には重要文化財に指定されたもの、最新の技術を駆使したものなど、将来に語り継ぐ価値のある土木施設が数多く存在します。これら土木施設の役割や魅力を広く伝え、また将来を担う子どもたちに興味を持ってもらうため、県内の土木施設を紹介する番組を制作し放送することとなりました。ドローンで撮影した映像などを駆使し、土木施設ならではのスケール感・ダイナミック感をお伝えします。国道120号の金精道路は、積雪や路面凍結により道路が危険な状態になるおそれがあるため、交通の安全が確保できない区間を冬期閉鎖しています。利根郡片品村の栃木県境・金精トンネルから丸沼スキー場入口までは、平成30年12月25日（火）以降、雪に覆われた世界となっていました。冬の閉ざされた世界から新たな季節を迎える春、平成31年4月25日（木）の開通前には12.1kmの区間で除雪を行います。雪に覆われた金精峠を除雪車で力強くかき分け、一筋の道を切り開いていきます。

title: BIRD'S EYE3 '2 Opening the Grand Snow Removal Scenery at Kinsei Pass'
description: This was broadcasted on Gunma TV on April 13 and 14, 2019. Civil engineering facilities are essential to our lives. There are many civil engineering facilities in the prefecture that are designated as important cultural properties and those that utilize the latest technology, all of which have value to be passed down to future generations. To widely convey the roles and attractions of these civil engineering facilities and to spark interest in the children who will bear the future, we have decided to produce and broadcast a program introducing civil engineering facilities in the prefecture. We will convey the scale and dynamism unique to civil engineering facilities using drone footage and other techniques. The Kinsei Road on National Route 120 is closed during winter due to the risk of dangerous road conditions caused by snow and road surface freezing. From the Kinsei Tunnel at the Tochigi Prefecture border in Katashina Village, Tone District, to the entrance of Marunuma Ski Resort, the area has been covered in snow since December 25, 2018. Before the opening on April 25, 2019, we will conduct snow removal over a distance of 12.1 km, cutting a path through the snow-covered Kinsei Pass with powerful snowplows.

Showa Bridge is a 659-meter-long bridge spanning the Tone River, connecting Hanyu City in Saitama Prefecture and Meiwa Town in Gunma Prefecture along National Route 122. In the Edo period, this route was also known as the Nikko Ura Kaido, and a checkpoint was established on the Tone River. The remains of the checkpoint have sunk underwater due to river improvements, but a monument marking the historic site has been erected at the bridgehead on the Hanyu City side. The current bridge is the fourth generation, built between 2006 and 2014, and it is expected to alleviate traffic congestion and improve pedestrian safety, which were issues with the previous bridges.

title: 【石狩市公式動画】観光プロモーション映像（第６回 日本国際観光映像祭(JWTFF) 北海道部門 創造賞(Creative Award)受賞作品）
description:
北海道石狩市の観光プロモーション映像です。
本映像では、①Adventure　②Time Travel　③Gourmet Huntの３テーマで構成しています。
シネマ風の美しい映像で本市の魅力をお楽しみください。
ご来訪を心よりお待ちしております。



石狩市は、道都・札幌市に隣接し、札幌中心部から車で40分の距離に位置します。
札幌からのアクセス性が高い中、海・山・川など雄大な自然を有しており、海水浴やキャンプなどのアウトドアを筆頭に、乗馬やスノーシュー、果物狩りなどの自然を満喫することができます。

また、日本遺産に認定されている北前船構成文化財など、歴史的・文化的観光地も多数あります。

そのほか、港朝市や地物市場とれのさとで購入できる朝採れの農水産物や、この新鮮な食材を用いた美味しい食事も自慢の一つです。

*****************************************************************************************************************************************************
本映像は、日本国際観光映像祭実行委員会が主催する「第６回日本国際観光映像祭（JWTFF）」北海道部門で創造賞（Creative Award)を受賞しました。
　https://jwtff.world/archives/4781​

■日本国際観光映像祭（JWTFF）とは
UNWTO（国連世界観光機構）が認定する国際観光映像祭ネットワークに加盟し、アジア唯一の構成映像祭として、日本を始めとしたアジアの観光映像を世界に紹介している映像祭です。令和元年から始まり、今回で６回目の開催となり、第６回映像祭の応募総数は1,278本で、うち日本映像部門への応募数は242本でした。
****************************************************************************************************************************************************

title: [Ishikari City Official Video] Tourism Promotion Video (Awarded Creative Award at the 6th Japan International Tourism Film Festival (JWTFF) Hokkaido Division)
description:
This is a tourism promotion video for Ishikari City, Hokkaido.
The video is composed of three themes: ① Adventure ② Time Travel ③ Gourmet Hunt.
Enjoy the charm of our city through beautiful cinematic visuals.
We sincerely look forward to your visit.

Ishikari City is located adjacent to Sapporo City, the capital of Hokkaido, and is a 40-minute drive from downtown Sapporo.
With high accessibility from Sapporo, it boasts magnificent nature including the sea, mountains, and rivers, allowing for outdoor activities such as swimming, camping, horseback riding, snowshoeing, and fruit picking.

Additionally, there are many historical and cultural tourist sites, including the Kitamaebune Cultural Heritage, which has been designated as a Japan Heritage.

Furthermore, we take pride in the fresh agricultural and marine products available at the Port Morning Market and the local market, Torenosato, as well as delicious meals made from these fresh ingredients.

*****************************************************************************************************************************************************
This video received the Creative Award at the 6th Japan International Tourism Film Festival (JWTFF) Hokkaido Division, organized by the Japan International Tourism Film Festival Executive Committee.
https://jwtff.world/archives/4781​

■ What is the Japan International Tourism Film Festival (JWTFF)?
It is a film festival that is part of the international tourism film festival network recognized by UNWTO (United Nations World Tourism Organization) and is the only film festival of its kind in Asia, introducing tourism films from Japan and other Asian countries to the world. It started in the first year of the Reiwa era and is now in its sixth edition, with a total of 1,278 entries for the sixth festival, of which 242 were submitted in the Japan film category.
****************************************************************************************************************************************************

description: 昔々、石狩（特に厚田地区、浜益地区）はニシン漁で栄えた街です。衰退していた時代もありましたが、近年、回復の兆しを見せています。沖合いに出て網を仕掛け漁師さんが力強く網を引き上げると、次々と獲れるニシン！今日も大漁で漁師さんも心なしか嬉しそうです。実際のニシン漁を間近で見ることができる貴重な映像、大漁の様子をぜひご覧ください。動画後半ではニシン料理も紹介しています。

title: Ishikari Herring Fishing Official Video
description: Once upon a time, Ishikari (especially the Atsuta and Hamamasu areas) was a city that thrived on herring fishing. There were times of decline, but in recent years, signs of recovery have appeared. As fishermen go out to sea and set their nets, they pull them up with strength, catching herring one after another! Today, it seems the fishermen are also happy with a good catch. This is a rare video that allows you to see actual herring fishing up close, so please enjoy the scenes of a bountiful catch. In the latter part of the video, herring dishes are also introduced.

国内で唯一、県の全域が亜熱帯地域に属している沖縄県は、海や空の青、世界自然遺産の森の深い緑、大海原に落ちる夕日の茜色など、色鮮やかな魅力に包まれています。まだ知らない沖縄の魅力をあなたへ。

Okinawa is the only prefecture in Japan where the entire prefecture belongs to the subtropical zone. The blue of the ocean and sky, the deep green of the World Natural Heritage forests, and the madder colors of the sunset over the ocean are just a few of the vivid colors that surround you. Discover Okinawa you have not yet known.

--------------------
Cinematographer
totty（cinevixion）

Creative Director
Osamu Miyajima

Producer
Takuma Yoshiyama

Location
沖縄本島、渡嘉敷島、石垣島、西表島

description:
秋・冬・夏と3シーズン、計1ヶ月撮影した「Akan Soul」。北海道阿寒湖温泉地域とアイヌ文化の日常を追ったノンバーバルドキュメンタリーです☺️非言語で、説明なしで人々の日常が紡ぐ物語が伝えられるか、とても挑戦的な試みでした。この作品を通して多くの人と関われ、文化の深いところまで勉強させて頂きました。

title: 結氷-Keppyo- 神々が宿る。摩周湖・屈斜路湖。
description: 結氷（けっぴょう）とは、海、湖、池、沼、河川などの水面、あるいは滝などの流水が凍結する現象を指し、湖などでは全体が結氷することを全面凍結ないし全面結氷と表現されます。弟子屈町が有する、摩周湖・屈斜路湖は、毎年2月頃に、湖全体が氷結する「全面結氷」なる現象が起こります。ただし近年は、その年の気候や天候をはじめ、温暖化など様々な理由から、全面結氷は毎年起こる現象ではなくなり、数年に一度の奇跡とも言われます。そんな中、摩周湖の結氷を研究している、北見工業大学の亀田貴雄教授によると、摩周湖に最も近い川湯アメダスの気象データを基に、2023年に摩周湖は全面結氷すると予測しています（2022年9月1日時点）。全面結氷すれば、摩周湖は2年ぶりの全面結氷。2023年にその奇跡が起こるかが期待されます。

title: Keppyo - The Gods Reside. Lake Mashu and Lake Kussharo.
description: Keppyo refers to the phenomenon of freezing of water surfaces such as seas, lakes, ponds, marshes, and rivers, and in lakes, the complete freezing is expressed as 'full freezing' or 'full ice formation'. In Teshikaga Town, Lake Mashu and Lake Kussharo experience a phenomenon called 'full ice formation' around February each year. However, in recent years, due to various reasons such as climate, weather, and global warming, full ice formation has not occurred every year and is said to be a miracle that happens once every few years. In this context, Professor Takao Kameda of Kitami Institute of Technology, who studies the ice formation of Lake Mashu, predicts that Lake Mashu will fully freeze in 2023 based on the weather data from the nearest Kawayu AMeDAS (as of September 1, 2022). If full ice formation occurs, it will be the first time in two years. There is hope for this miracle to happen in 2023.

同時に、豊かな自然の中で育まれる感性のすばらしさを、
実感させてもらったような気がします。

description:
The "Akaezomatsu Forest" located in Akan Mashu National Park, Hokkaido.
In August 2022, 29 first-year students from the local Teshikaga Junior High School took a walk.

The theme of the comprehensive learning that sparked this was, "Rediscovering Teshikaga from the perspective of ecotourism."

At the presentation held after experiences and research, fresh impressions and straightforward opinions emerged one after another, reflecting on the local nature.
It became a valuable opportunity to think about what true ecotourism is.

At the same time, I feel like I was able to truly appreciate the wonderfulness of the sensitivity nurtured in rich nature.

title: 三谷昌登 しがらき火まつりを体感する！
description: 「しがらき火まつり」のPVを制作しました。連続テレビ小説「スカーレット」に出演された2番さんこと三谷昌登さんと、料理指導を担当された広里貴子先生にご参加いただきました。三谷さんはドラマの火まつりのシーンにも出演されています！！令和５年7月22日に開催されたしがらき火まつりです。「陶器づくり(信楽焼)に欠かせない火」「生活や文化に欠かせない火」への感謝と火に関わる安全を願って行われるまつりです。まずはこの動画で火まつりをお楽しみいただき、ぜひ次回開催の「しがらき火まつり」へお越しください！

title: Mitsutaka Mitani Experience the Shigaraki Fire Festival!
description: We produced a PV for the 'Shigaraki Fire Festival'. Mitsutaka Mitani, who appeared in the NHK morning drama 'Scarlet', and Takako Hirozato, who was in charge of cooking guidance, participated. Mr. Mitani also appeared in the fire festival scene of the drama!! The Shigaraki Fire Festival was held on July 22, 2023. It is a festival held to express gratitude for the 'fire' essential for pottery making (Shigaraki ware) and for the 'fire' that is indispensable for life and culture, and to wish for safety related to fire. First, enjoy the fire festival with this video, and please come to the next 'Shigaraki Fire Festival'!

title: しがらきやきものモノがたり
description: 甲賀映像祭2023【甲賀市民部門】準グランプリ『ええとこ甲賀』ということで、生まれ育った信楽を、と思いました。やきもののまち信楽、というのが当たり前すぎて、子どものころはピンとこなかったけれど、大人になって、あらためてエエなぁと感じることが多くなりました。単に、地場産業や伝統工芸というだけでなく、信楽という場所が、次々とモノが生みだされていく、クリエイティブで活気のあるまちです。いつも作家さんや窯元さんたちからパワーをいただき、『私ももっとがんばらなあかんなぁ』思わせられます。私にとってはパワースポットでもあります。この動画を通じて、そんな信楽の良さを垣間見ていただき、たくさんの方が『ええとこ』と感じていただければ幸いです。

title: Shigaraki Pottery Story
description: The 2023 Koka Film Festival [Koka Citizen Division] Semi-Grand Prix. I thought about my hometown Shigaraki, as it is a great place in Koka. The town of Shigaraki, known for pottery, was something I took for granted as a child, but as an adult, I have come to appreciate it more and more. It is not just a local industry or traditional craft; Shigaraki is a creative and vibrant town where new things are constantly being produced. I always receive energy from the artists and potters, which makes me think, 'I need to work harder too.' For me, it is also a power spot. Through this video, I hope many people can catch a glimpse of the goodness of Shigaraki and feel that it is a 'great place.'

title: JOINKOKA
description:
甲賀映像祭2023【クリエーター部門】水口青年会議所理事長賞
矢川神社、水口岡山城、庚申山など。見るもの自体はもちろん、伝えてくれる忍者たちが大きな魅力です。そして、見るだけじゃなく参加して、忍者になれる。
やってるほうが本当に楽しいと思う事を繰り出して「集え」と仲間にさそってくれているような、聞いてるだけ見てるだけじゃなく、仲間に入って体感できる魅力を、タイトルの「JOINKOKA」に込めました。

title: JOINKOKA
description:

The title 'JOINKOKA' embodies the charm of being able to experience it firsthand, inviting friends to join in on the fun of what truly feels enjoyable, rather than just listening or watching.

title: 忍者好きが巡るええとこ甲賀
description:
Koga Film Festival 2023【Creator Division】Koga City Mayor's Award
子供の頃から忍者が好きで、甲賀へは何度も遊びに行って楽しい時間を過ごしていました。大人になり、忍者になってからは度々訪れていますが、来るたびに新たな発見があったり、忍者についてより深く知ることができる場所だということを実感しています。甲賀には色々な魅力がありますが、今回私は『忍者の里 甲賀』をもっとたくさんの人に紹介したいと思い、忍者好き目線はもちろん、ママ目線でも子供と一緒にも楽しめる、オススメの『ええとこ甲賀』をセレクトして映像作品にしました。

title: A Great Place in Koga for Ninja Lovers
description:
Koga Film Festival 2023【Creator Division】Koga City Mayor's Award
Since I was a child, I have loved ninjas and have visited Koga many times, spending enjoyable times there. As an adult, I have visited frequently as a ninja, and each time I come, I realize that it is a place where I can discover new things and learn more about ninjas. Koga has various attractions, and this time I wanted to introduce 'Ninja Village Koga' to more people, selecting recommended 'Great Places in Koga' that can be enjoyed from a ninja lover's perspective as well as from a mom's perspective with children.

description: Oita City, adjacent to Beppu and Yufu, offers convenient access for touring within the prefecture. Additionally, visitors can savor local delicacies like Seki mackerel and Seki horse mackerel, as well as enjoy hot springs boasting one of the highest numbers of sources in the prefecture, making it a city rich in various attractions despite being an industrial hub.

■ What is Midnight Oita?
When it comes to hot springs, it's Oita Prefecture.
But Oita Prefecture is not just about hot springs.
Here, from dusk to midnight,
you can find the best spots to relax and enjoy.
You'll surely understand when you come, "a city you can enjoy until midnight."
For first-timers and those who have been here before,
we will delve into the nighttime charm of Oita Prefecture that you might be 'a little curious' about.

https://midnight.visit-oita.jp/

■ Midnight Oita x Music
Dinoji and Mark Panther guide you through a digest of the journey in Onsen Prefecture Oita.
After enjoying the hot springs and magnificent nature, you can indulge in Oita gourmet and head out into the neon-lit night city! Or you can relax at a hot spring inn!
Featuring two groups of artists, we introduce the charm of Oita Prefecture with an upper tune that you won't forget once you hear it.
[Midnight Oita] Onsen Prefecture Oita MV feat. Mark Panther full [Official/Oita Prefecture]
https://youtu.be/X2J676UAh6Y

[Midnight Oita] Onsen Prefecture Oita MV feat. Dinoji full [Official/Oita Prefecture]
https://youtu.be/SGiJvyDBRZo

■ Midnight Oita x Culture
We will introduce the unseen nighttime charm of Onsen Prefecture Oita, focusing on people, places, and food in a documentary style.
The streets as the sun sets, the bustling crowds of people, the illuminated drinking streets... then, the lively voices of people enjoying the night in Oita Prefecture come in.
What does 'the night of Oita Prefecture' mean to them, why is it unique, and why should tourists experience it?
The charm of Oita Prefecture that has yet to be seen is something that overflows from the people...!
Whether you have been to Oita Prefecture or not, you will surely fall in love with the unseen charm of Oita Prefecture.

The charm of Oita that remains unseen is something that overflows from its people...!

title: 令和３年度ツーリズム商談会プレゼンテーション動画 ③(中津市）
description: 中津市は、山国川の源流から河口まで続く渓谷美と城下町の歴史が織り成す魅力あふれるところです。軍師黒田官兵衛・福澤諭吉ゆかりの中津城下町や、奇岩の渓谷が美しい絵巻物のような風景をつくる日本遺産、名勝耶馬渓などがあります。メイプル耶馬サイクリングロードは耶馬渓の景色と歴史を体感できる人気スポットです。

title: Presentation Video of the 2021 Tourism Business Meeting ③ (Nakatsu City)
description: Nakatsu City is a place full of charm, woven together by the beautiful gorge that stretches from the source to the mouth of the Yamakuni River and the history of its castle town. There are attractions such as Nakatsu Castle Town, associated with strategist Kuroda Kanbei and Yukichi Fukuzawa, and the Japan Heritage site, Yabakei, known for its stunning landscapes created by bizarre rock formations. The Maple Yaba Cycling Road is a popular spot where you can experience the scenery and history of Yabakei.

title: 【京都府八幡市】男山散策動画　|　石清水八幡宮と豊かな自然
description:

・

title: [Yawata City, Kyoto] Otokoyama Walking Video | Iwashimizu Hachimangu Shrine and Rich Nature
description:
We have produced a video introducing the Otokoyama walking trail, historical sites, and stone walls located within the grounds of Iwashimizu Hachimangu Shrine.
・
Otokoyama, which is home to Iwashimizu Hachimangu Shrine featured in Buratamori, has walking trails where you can feel nature amidst bamboo groves, as well as numerous ruins of temples known as 'Otokoyama Shijuhachibo,' which once numbered nearly 48. Many of the temple ruins still have stone walls, allowing you to feel the history.

Would you like to take a stroll through Otokoyama, where you can experience nature and history?

title: 浜田の石見神楽 伝統文化体験プレミアムツアー
description:
～浜田の人々の熱に触れ、時を超えた物語に心奪われる、唯一無二の旅路～

島根県の西部に位置し、日本海に面する豊かな自然と伝統産業が息づく街・浜田。この地には、古くから大切に守り伝えられ、発展を遂げてきた伝統芸能があります。迫力あふれる奏楽と舞、思わず見とれてしまうほどの豪華な衣装うや面。地域の住民たち、そして、訪れた人々の心を一度つかむと離さない。それが浜田の石見神楽です。

石見地方の多くの社中や職人たちの手によって受け継がれてきた石見神楽の中でも、とりわけその継承と発展に尽力してきたのが浜田の人々だと言われており、この「石見神楽を創り出したまち」に暮らす若者やお年寄り、そして小さな子どもたちが、学業や仕事など日々の生活を送りながら、自らの強い意志で技の鍛錬に励んでいるのです。

彼らを突き動かすものとは。その情熱の源となっているものとは。このツアーでのみ楽しめる特別公演や社中との交流、衣装や面なふどの工房めぐりを経て明らかになる、時を超えて”浜田人”の心に宿る石見神楽にかける想い。長年の物語に心を奪われる唯一無二の旅路の果てには、知られざる新しい世界が広がっています。

title: Hamada's Iwami Kagura Traditional Culture Experience Premium Tour
description:
A unique journey that allows you to touch the passion of the people of Hamada and be captivated by timeless stories.

Hamada, located in the western part of Shimane Prefecture and facing the Sea of Japan, is a city rich in nature and traditional industries. This area is home to traditional performing arts that have been cherished and developed over the years. The powerful music and dance, along with the stunning costumes and masks, captivate the hearts of local residents and visitors alike. This is the Iwami Kagura of Hamada.

Among the many groups and artisans who have inherited Iwami Kagura in the Iwami region, it is said that the people of Hamada have particularly dedicated themselves to its preservation and development. Young people, the elderly, and small children living in this "town that created Iwami Kagura" are diligently honing their skills with strong determination while balancing their studies and daily work.

What drives them? What is the source of their passion? Through special performances exclusive to this tour, interactions with local groups, and visits to workshops for costumes and masks, the feelings that reside in the hearts of the "people of Hamada" for Iwami Kagura will be revealed. At the end of this unique journey, captivated by years of stories, a new and unknown world awaits.

title: Sayaka Yamaguchi | A Relaxed Spring Trip in Kawaminami Town, Miyazaki Prefecture
description:
▼Check out the video article here: https://is.gd/wW4MlY
Kawaminami Town, located along the coast in the central part of Miyazaki Prefecture, is rich in nature, surrounded by the Hyuga-nada Sea to the east and the Kyushu Mountains to the west, and is one of the leading food production bases in Japan. It is also known for its excellent surfing spots, attracting many migrants. Sayaka Yamaguchi, who visited the town, was so impressed by the local specialties that she bought many souvenirs and expressed a desire to eventually 'move here.'

▼Sayaka Yamaguchi
Born on February 14, 1980, from Fukuoka Prefecture. She made her acting debut in the drama 'Wakamono no Subete' (Fuji TV). Known for her reliable acting skills in a wide range of challenging roles, she starred in her first leading role in a serial drama in 2018 with 'Black Scandal' (Nippon TV). She also starred in the next season's 'Zettai Seigi' (Fuji TV) and has continued to appear in popular works such as 'Moto Kare Mania' (Fuji TV), 'Yuganda Hamon' (NHK BS Premium), and 'In a World Where There is No Black or White, Pandas Laugh' (Nippon TV). She is also set to appear in the movie 'Ito,' scheduled for release on April 24, 2020.

1981年生まれ、奈良県出身。1997年、映画『萌の朱雀』主演で俳優デビュー。同作で、第10回シンガポール国際映画祭主演女優賞、第12回高崎映画祭最優秀新人女優賞を受賞した。その後、『Mother』（日本テレビ系）、連続テレビ小説『カーネーション』（NHK総合ほか）、『最高の離婚』（フジ系）、映画『そして父になる』（2013年）、『茜色に焼かれる』（2021年）などに映画やドラマなどに出演。これまでに日本アカデミー賞、報知映画賞、日刊スポーツ映画大賞、TAMA映画賞、山路ふみ子映画賞ほか数々の賞を受賞。現在は、2024年度前期連続テレビ小説『虎に翼』での語り役が注目を集めているほか、日本・フィリピン合作映画『DitO』が7月26日より全国順次公開予定。

title: Machiko Ono | A Place Connecting the 'Sky' and 'Sea' - Goto Islands, Shin-Kamigotō Town【Tabiiro Movie】
description:
At the westernmost tip of Kyushu, the Goto Islands float in the East China Sea. I traveled to Shin-Kamigotō Town in Nagasaki Prefecture, which consists of seven inhabited islands and over 60 other islands in the northern part. The beautiful gradient of blue where the sky and sea blend together, along with the rich nature and precious cultural heritage, makes this town known as a holy land for fishermen. ┈┈Machiko Ono Profile┈┈
Born in 1981 in Nara Prefecture. She made her acting debut in 1997 starring in the film 'Moeru Suzaku.' For this role, she won the Best Actress Award at the 10th Singapore International Film Festival and the Best New Actress Award at the 12th Takasaki Film Festival. Since then, she has appeared in films and dramas such as 'Mother' (Nippon Television), the morning drama 'Carnation' (NHK), 'The Best Divorce' (Fuji TV), the film 'Like Father, Like Son' (2013), and 'Burned by the Akane Color' (2021). She has received numerous awards including the Japan Academy Prize, Hochi Film Award, Nikkan Sports Film Award, TAMA Film Award, and Yamaji Fumiko Film Award. Currently, she is gaining attention for her narration role in the 2024 morning drama 'Tora ni Tsubasa,' and the Japan-Philippines co-produced film 'DitO' is scheduled for nationwide release starting July 26.

description:

1991年7月27日生まれ。愛知県出身。2008年からSKE48として活動し、2015年に卒業。その後は役者として活躍し、2018年にはNHK連続テレビ小説「まんぷく」に出演、2021年11月公開の映画「幕が下りたら会いましょう」で映画作品単独初主演を務める。2023年9月に公開された映画「緑のざわめき」で主演を務め、同年10月スタートの「たとえあなたを忘れても」に出演中。2023年12月からはNHK　BSプレミアムドラマ「仮想儀礼」に出演。作家としての一面もあり、2018年に文芸誌「小説すばる」で小説家デビューし、2019年に初の単行本「カモフラージュ」を出版。「小説すばる」にて新連載「カット・イン／カット・アウト」が12/15よりスタート。

title: Rena Matsui | A Fortune Trip to Kanzaki City, Saga, a Town Filled with Mysterious Powers【Tabiiro Movie】
description:
Rena Matsui visited Kanzaki City, where ancient history comes alive. Surrounded by rich nature, there are plenty of historical and fortune spots, such as the Yoshinogari Ruins, which vividly convey life in the Yayoi period, a bridge for matchmaking, and a shrine with sacred water for wishes. ┈┈Rena Matsui Profile┈┈
Born on July 27, 1991, in Aichi Prefecture. Active as a member of SKE48 since 2008, she graduated in 2015. After that, she has been active as an actress, appearing in the NHK morning drama "Manpuku" in 2018, and taking her first lead role in a film with "Let's Meet When the Curtain Falls," released in November 2021. She starred in the film "The Whisper of Green" released in September 2023 and is currently appearing in "Even If I Forget You," which started in October of the same year. From December 2023, she will appear in the NHK BS Premium drama "Virtual Ritual." She is also a writer, making her literary debut in 2018 with a novel in the literary magazine "Shousetsu Subaru," and published her first book, "Camouflage," in 2019. A new series titled "Cut In / Cut Out" will start in "Shousetsu Subaru" from December 15.

title: 溝端淳平｜爽やかな水と歴史あるまち並みが残る 場所いざ、知られざる松江へ【旅色Movie】
description: Junpei Mizobataさんが旅したのはShimane PrefectureのMatsue City。まちのシンボルである国宝Matsue Castleの天守を見学したり、Matsue Cityにゆかりのある文豪が暮らしていた場所を見て周ったりといった歴史探訪が楽しめます。さらに、日本酒の飲み比べや海上アクティビティなど、水が豊かなMatsue Cityならではの旅体験も。いざ、知られざるMatsueの魅力を探す旅に出かけましょう。

title: Junpei Mizobata | A Journey to Discover the Hidden Charms of Matsue, a Place with Refreshing Water and Historic Townscapes
description: Junpei Mizobata traveled to Matsue City in Shimane Prefecture. You can enjoy historical exploration by visiting the symbol of the city, the National Treasure Matsue Castle, and seeing the places where literary figures associated with Matsue City lived. Additionally, you can experience unique travel activities in Matsue City, rich in water, such as sake tasting and marine activities. Let's embark on a journey to discover the hidden charms of Matsue.

title: 中村 蒼｜歴史の舞台を訪ね歩く 岡山市タイムトリップ【旅色Movie】
description: 俳優の中村 蒼さんが訪れたのは、桃太郎像が出迎える「岡山桃太郎空港」から、車で約40分の岡山市。全国でも快晴の日が多く「晴れの国」といわれている街で、戦国〜江戸時代のロマンを感じられる史跡や美しい風景、岡山でしか食べられないグルメを味わい尽くしました。

title: Nakamura Ao｜Exploring Historical Sites in Okayama City Time Trip【Tabiiro Movie】
description: Actor Nakamura Ao visited Okayama City, about 40 minutes by car from Okayama Momotaro Airport, where a statue of Momotaro welcomes visitors. Known as the 'Land of Sunshine' for its many clear days, the city offers historical sites and beautiful scenery that evoke the romance of the Sengoku to Edo periods, as well as local gourmet food that can only be enjoyed in Okayama.

title: 安斉星来｜日本の秘境を新発見 岡山・新見市で“自然ステイ”【旅色Movie】
description: 安斉星来さんが岡山県新見市で1泊2日の旅へ。大小200余りの鍾乳洞、300種もの珍しい植物が自生する湿原といったダイナミックな絶景を見て、特産グルメを味わい、森に囲まれたグランピング施設や天然温泉で身体を癒す……自然の恵みをあらゆる形で享受できます。

title: Seira Anzai | Discovering Japan's Hidden Gems: Nature Stay in Niimi City, Okayama
description: Seira Anzai embarks on a 1-night, 2-day journey in Niimi City, Okayama. She experiences dynamic scenic views, including over 200 limestone caves and wetlands with 300 species of rare plants, enjoys local gourmet food, and relaxes in a glamping facility surrounded by forests and a natural hot spring... She can enjoy the blessings of nature in various forms.

title: 鈴木ちなみ｜大阪でおとなの街歩き【旅色Movie】
description:
▼動画の記事はこちら　https://is.gd/i3QvEY
たこ焼き、串カツ、道頓堀のイメージだったけど、それは他に大阪の切り取り方を知らなかっただけ。こんなに大人の旅ができる街なんだなって今回知ることができました。

高校の卒業旅行はユニバーサル・スタジオ・ジャパンで、それ以降も大阪は何度も来てるんですけど、今回行ったのは初めてのところばかり。特に新発見だったのは、古着屋さんがあった中崎町ですね。リノベーションしてる建物がいっぱいで、店員さんも若い方が多くて。古い町並みを若者が再生しているような雰囲気がよかったです。あと歴史的な建造物が多かった北浜も新鮮でした。旅行者というより、地元の人が遊んでいる場所なんだろうなって感じて、とってもおもしろかった。

title: Suzuki Chinami | Adult City Walk in Osaka【Tabiiro Movie】
description:
▼Check out the video article here: https://is.gd/i3QvEY
I used to think of takoyaki, kushikatsu, and Dotonbori when I thought of Osaka, but that was just because I didn't know other ways to experience the city. I learned that this city can offer such an adult travel experience.

My high school graduation trip was to Universal Studios Japan, and I've been to Osaka many times since, but this time I visited all new places. One of my new discoveries was the vintage shops in Nakazakicho. There are many renovated buildings, and the staff are mostly young. The atmosphere of young people revitalizing the old town was great. Also, Kitahama, with its many historical buildings, felt fresh. It seemed more like a place where locals hang out rather than tourists, which was very interesting.

description: I visited Itakura Town, the closest town to the city center in Gunma Prefecture, about an hour from the city. description:

title: Hinako Sakurai | A Travel Destination in the East of Chiba That You Want to Share. Togane, the Best Place【Tabiiro Movie】
description:
This year marks the 10th anniversary of Hinako Sakurai's debut, and she embarked on a two-day, one-night trip to explore Togane City, located in the eastern part of Chiba Prefecture. Togane City is just about an hour's drive or train ride from the city center. Many may be surprised to find such rich nature that makes you want to take a deep breath, intriguing history that piques intellectual curiosity, and exquisite gourmet options all in such a close location. 2024 is a commemorative year marking the 70th anniversary of the city's establishment, so be sure to pay attention to the various events and commemorative goods planned throughout the year.

┈┈Hinako Sakurai Profile┈┈
Born in Okayama Prefecture. In 2014, she won the Grand Prix in the Okayama Beautiful Girl and Beauty Contest, gaining attention as the 'Miracle of Okayama.' This year marks her 10th anniversary, and she is breaking new ground with the release of her first photo book 'Tokiiro,' which features her first swimsuit shoot. She also appeared in the TV drama 'Mahi no Mitsuko-san' (Nippon Television) aired in the summer of 2024. It has been decided that she will star as the heroine in the stage play '138 Billion Years or Less,' which will be held in Tokyo and Osaka starting November 22. She will also appear in the popular film series 'Kingdom: The Return of the General' and the upcoming release 'Saint☆Oniisan: Holy Men vs. Demon Army' scheduled for December.

description:

時代に合わせて、目まぐるしく変わり続ける、いわば“未完のまち”東京。人もモノも圧倒的で、新しい文化をどんどん吸収しながら、変化していくまち。でも、みんなが知っている東京は、まだまだほんの一部。ブームをけん引する一方で、しっかりと歴史情緒も残す、懐が深くて、奥行きがあるまち。まだまだ、知らないコトがたくさんある東京の今と昔を知って、自分の好きな東京を見つけましょう。

title: Rie Mimura: Searching for My Tokyo
description:
▼Digital magazine here: https://is.gd/Re8ACd
Tokyo, a city that continues to change rapidly with the times, is an 'unfinished town.' It is overwhelming in terms of people and things, constantly absorbing new cultures and evolving. However, the Tokyo that everyone knows is still just a small part of it. While leading trends, it also retains a rich historical atmosphere, making it a deep and layered city. Let's learn about both the present and past of Tokyo, which still has many unknowns, and find the Tokyo that you love.

description:

In 2020, Tokyo is undergoing redevelopment and is being reborn. There are many essential places to know Tokyo, from locations where modern architecture from the Meiji to Showa eras is still loved to newly transformed spots that offer a glimpse into the past and present.

▼Ryoko Yonekura
Born on August 1, 1975, from Kanagawa Prefecture. After working as a model, she transitioned to acting. She has appeared in many popular works, including the dramas 'Matsumoto Seicho's Black Leather Notebook' and 'Doctor X - Surgeon Michiko Daimon' (both aired on TV Asahi). After starring in the Japanese version of the musical 'CHICAGO' in 2008, she became the first Japanese actress to perform in the Broadway production of the same work three times in 2012 and 2019. It has been decided that she will voice the character 'Natasha Romanoff,' played by Scarlett Johansson, in the movie 'Black Widow' (Walt Disney Japan), which will be released simultaneously in Japan and the U.S. on November 6 (Friday).

title: 藤原紀香｜金沢・加賀で日本ならではの美を再発見する旅【旅色Movie】
description:

北陸随一の観光都市・金沢と歌舞伎の町・小松などがある自然豊かな加賀。歴史と文化の薫り漂う情緒あふれるふたつの地域で五感を研ぎ澄ませ、日本ならではの美を再発見する旅。

昔は海外に憧れて、いろんなところに行きました。それも素晴らしい経験。そんな旅を経験し思うこともありました。もっと日本のことをちゃんと知らなきゃと。日本を知ることは、日本を元気にすることに繋がります。旅先では、酒造りや菓子作り、紙漉や漆塗り、そして着物工房など、日本の伝統工芸の体験をすることも大好きです。伝統の技を継ぐ世代がどんどん減っているから、多くの世代が旅をすることで各地の古き良きものを見直すきっかけになるのではないかと。「日本文化を楽しむ旅」が、今こそ熟していくときなのではないかと感じています。1日でも早くコロナが収束して、たくさん旅ができるようになればいいですね。

▼藤原紀香
兵庫県生まれ。神戸親和女子大学英米文学科在学中にミス日本コンテストグランプリを受賞。卒業後、モデルを経て女優へ。CM、テレビドラマや映画、舞台をはじめ、音楽番組の司会や声優として幅広く活躍。カリスマセラピスト役を演じた映画『癒しのこころみ～自分を好きになる方法～』が、現在、全国公開中。

title: Fujiwara Norika | A Journey to Rediscover Japan's Unique Beauty in Kanazawa and Kaga
description:
▼Video article here https://is.gd/CnsauV
Kanazawa, the top tourist city in Hokuriku, and Kaga, a town of Kabuki, are rich in nature. In these two regions, filled with the fragrance of history and culture, we sharpen our senses and rediscover the unique beauty of Japan.

In the past, I longed for overseas travel and went to various places. Those were wonderful experiences. After experiencing such travels, I thought that I needed to know more about Japan. Knowing Japan leads to revitalizing Japan. I also love experiencing traditional Japanese crafts such as sake brewing, confectionery making, paper making, lacquerware, and kimono workshops during my travels. As the generations inheriting traditional techniques are decreasing, I believe that many generations traveling can become an opportunity to reconsider the good old things in various regions. title: Naho Toda | A Colorful Journey Awaits. Exploring the Colors of Eniwa, the Flower Town【Tabiiro Movie】
description:
Eniwa City, blessed with access to both sky and land, boasts a rich natural environment with the foothills of Mount Eniwa. Currently known as the 'Flower Town,' it is one of the leading producers of flower seedlings in Hokkaido. Join actress Naho Toda as we travel through Eniwa City, adorned with colorful flowers throughout the year. There, a plethora of excitement awaits, including flowers, gourmet food, sightseeing, and experiences...

┈┈Naho Toda Profile┈┈
Born in Hiroshima Prefecture. She made her entertainment debut after winning the Grand Prix at the 15th Horipro Talent Scout Caravan. She gained attention for her role as Yuki Usami, the heroine in the 1993 NHK morning drama 'Ee Nyobo.' Since then, she has been active in various television dramas, films, and stage performances, including major historical dramas like 'Yoshitsune' and 'Gunshi Kanbee,' as well as doing narration. She is set to appear in the 2025 NHK morning drama 'Anpan' as Chiyoko Yanai, the aunt of the protagonist, Takashi Yanai.

title: 工藤美桜｜海と大地の神秘を巡る 未知なる室戸アドベンチャー【旅色Movie】
description:

title: Mio Kudo | An Unknown Muroto Adventure Exploring the Mysteries of the Sea and Earth【Tabiiro Movie】
description:
Kochi Prefecture's Muroto City is filled with dynamic nature, recognized as a 'UNESCO Global Geopark.'
The strata at Cape Muroto record the history of the seabed that has undergone repeated uplift, and its scale is magnificent.
Deep within the forest formed by subtropical plants, there are mystical giant trees brimming with power.
With deep connections to whales, dolphins, and deep-sea fish, there is an abundance of rare gourmet experiences.
Shall we embark on an adventure trip to experience the unknown on a global scale?

┈┈Mio Kudo Profile┈┈
Born on October 8, 1999, in Tokyo, Japan.
She made her official acting debut in 2015 with 'Kamen Rider Ghost' and gained attention for her role as Kiramei Pink in 'Mashin Sentai Kiramager' in 2020, appearing in both the Rider and Sentai series.
In 2021, she appeared as Kiyokawa Shizu in the drama 'TOKYO MER: Running Emergency Room.'
She reprised the same role in the movie 'TOKYO MER: Running Emergency Room - Nankai Mission,' released in August 2025.
She starred in her first television drama in 'Call Me by No Name,' which aired in January 2025.
She is set to appear as the lead character Riko Yamamoto in the Yomiuri TV drama 'It's Your Fault' in the October 2025 season.

title: 藤原紀香｜海と醤油が香る町 和歌山県湯浅町に誘われて【旅色Movie】
description:
醤油醸造発祥の地として知られる和歌山県湯浅町（ゆあさちょう）は、わずか20平方㎞とコンパクト。歴史ある町並みが残り、海もすぐそこ。小さいながら見どころがたっぷりある湯浅町を、藤原紀香さんがレンタサイクルで探索します。

┈┈藤原紀香Profile┈┈
兵庫県出身。神戸親和女子大学英米文学科在学中に「ミス日本グランプリ大会」でグランプリを受賞。卒業後、モデルを経て女優へ転身し、数多くのドラマで主演を務めるほか、CM、司会、声優など幅広い分野で活躍。映画『翔んで埼玉 ～琵琶湖より愛をこめて～』では夫婦共演でも話題に。近年は舞台出演が続き、『キャッツ・アイ』の舞台化、『サザエさん』、朗読活劇『細雪』、『怪談・牡丹灯籠』などに出演。2025年12月からは、堤幸彦演出による舞台『忠臣蔵』全国公演で、上川隆也演じる大石内蔵助の妻・大石りく役を務めることが決定している。芸能活動のみならず、社会貢献活動にも積極的に取り組む。NPO法人「Smile please藤原紀香 世界子ども基金」の発起人として、世界の子どもたちの教育や環境改善を目的とした支援事業を20年以上継続中。現在開催中の大阪・関西万博では日本館名誉館長を務め、国内外の賓客を迎える役割を果たしている。

title: Norika Fujiwara | Invited to the Town of Yuasa, Wakayama Prefecture, Fragrant with the Sea and Soy Sauce【Tabiiro Movie】
description:
Yuasa Town in Wakayama Prefecture, known as the birthplace of soy sauce brewing, is compact at just 20 square kilometers. The town retains its historic streets, and the sea is just nearby. Norika Fujiwara explores the small yet full of attractions Yuasa Town by rental bicycle.

┈┈Norika Fujiwara Profile┈┈
Born in Hyogo Prefecture. While attending Kobe Shinwa Women's University majoring in English and American Literature, she won the Grand Prix at the 'Miss Japan Grand Prix Contest.' After graduating, she transitioned from modeling to acting, starring in numerous dramas, and has been active in a wide range of fields including commercials, hosting, and voice acting. She gained attention for her on-screen couple performance in the movie 'Ton de Saitama - With Love from Lake Biwa.' In recent years, she has continued to appear in stage productions, including the stage adaptation of 'Cat's Eye,' 'Sazae-san,' the reading play 'Sosui,' and 'Kaidan: Botan Doro.' Starting in December 2025, she has been confirmed to play the role of Oishi Riku, the wife of Oishi Kuranosuke played by Takaya Kamikawa, in the national tour of the stage 'Chushingura' directed by Yukihiko Tsutsumi. In addition to her entertainment activities, she is also actively involved in social contribution activities. As the founder of the NPO 'Smile Please Norika Fujiwara World Children's Fund,' she has been continuing support projects aimed at improving education and the environment for children around the world for over 20 years. Currently, she serves as the honorary director of the Japan Pavilion at the ongoing Osaka-Kansai Expo, welcoming domestic and international guests.

title: 真矢ミキ｜熊本・和水町で深呼吸。心やすらぐ旅日和【旅色Movie】
description:
「九州が本当に好きなんです」という真矢ミキさんと訪れたのは、美しい自然のなかに、日本の歴史と文化が息づく熊本県和水町。約1500年前に造られた豪族の古墳を散策したり、緑に囲まれたキャンプ場でのんびりとした時間を過ごしたり。古代に思いを馳せながら、緑のなかで思いっきり深呼吸して、心も体もリフレッシュする旅へ。

title: Miki Maya | Deep Breaths in Kumamoto, Wamizu Town. A Relaxing Travel Day【Tabiiro Movie】
description:
Accompanying Miki Maya, who says, "I really love Kyushu," we visited Wamizu Town in Kumamoto Prefecture, where Japan's history and culture thrive amidst beautiful nature. We strolled around ancient burial mounds built about 1500 years ago and spent leisurely time at a campsite surrounded by greenery. While reflecting on ancient times, we took deep breaths in the greenery, refreshing both our minds and bodies on this journey.

┈┈Miki Maya Profile┈┈
Born on January 31, 1964, in Toyonaka City, Osaka Prefecture. Former top star of the Takarazuka Revue's Hanagumi male role. Known as the "Revolutionary of Takarazuka" for her unique ideas and wide-ranging activities, she built an era. After leaving the troupe, she made her acting debut in 1999, appearing in numerous dramas, films, and stage productions. She consistently ranks high in surveys for "ideal boss" and "ideal mother," gaining popularity among a wide demographic. In June 2024, she will appear as Kyoko Sugiyama in Shochiku's "Ninety Years Old. What's Worth Celebrating?" In November 2024, she will appear in "Angry Squad: Public Servants and Seven Swindlers." Her hobbies include traveling and painting.

title: 川瀬良子｜農業とリゾートを融合させた新しい旅スタイル“アグリツーリズモリゾート”【旅色】HOTEL STYLE BOOK
description: 東京駅から新幹線に乗ること１時間10分、那須塩原駅に到着。そこからホテルまでは送迎バスにゆられて約40分に位置する「星野リゾート リゾナーレ那須」。栃木県北部・那須岳の山裾に立ち、大自然に囲まれたリゾートホテルのコンセプトは、“アグリツーリズモリゾート”。アグリツーリズモとは、イタリア語のアグリクルトゥーラ（農業）とツーリズモ（観光）を合わせた造語。つまり、その土地ならではの自然を楽しみながら農体験や土地の文化をリゾートホテルで楽しめる、新しいホテルのカタチといったところ。畑好きの私としては“農業”の響きだけで胸が高鳴るものの、聞きなれないそのコンセプトについては、正直まだピンときていない。泊まってみてその正解を見つけてみたい。

title: Ryoko Kawase | A New Travel Style Combining Agriculture and Resort: 'Agritourism Resort'【Tabiiro】HOTEL STYLE BOOK
description: It takes about 1 hour and 10 minutes by Shinkansen from Tokyo Station to arrive at Nasushiobara Station. From there, it takes about 40 minutes by shuttle bus to reach 'Hoshino Resort Risonare Nasu'. Located at the foot of Mt. Nasu in northern Tochigi Prefecture, the concept of this resort hotel surrounded by nature is 'Agritourism Resort'. Agritourism is a coined term combining the Italian words 'Agricoltura' (agriculture) and 'Turismo' (tourism). In other words, it is a new type of hotel where you can enjoy the unique nature of the area while experiencing agriculture and the local culture at a resort hotel. As someone who loves fields, just the sound of 'agriculture' makes my heart race, but to be honest, I still don't quite grasp this unfamiliar concept. I want to find the answer by staying there.

title: 【夏菜】福生（ふっさ）で日帰り“ハシゴ酒蔵”＜飲み旅本。＞

title: マコンデ美術館　タンザニアに開花した芸術文化
description: アフリカ大陸の東にタンザニアという国がある。日本人にとっては、なじみの薄い国かもしれない。キリマンジャロがあったり、マサイ族のいる国と言ったほうがイメージしやすいかもしれない。この国に、マコンデ族という部族がおり、彼らの生み出す芸術がとても美しい。マコンデ族は昔から、そこでよく採れる黒檀を素材に、様々な彫刻を生み出してきた。彼らがモチーフにするのは、人や動物または、抽象的な作品もある。決して経済的に豊かではない彼らが黒檀から掘り出す作品たちは、表現されている感情が豊かである。怒りや、悲しみ、あきらめ、喜び、恐怖などが読み取れ、しかも、そのすべてがどことなく滑稽で、命の肯定が前提にされているような気がする。いや、もっと、深く読み取るなら、怒りとあきらめの混ざったような、悲しみと笑いの混ざったような、生きる困難とそれを受け入れる覚悟のような、様々な感情が混在し表現されている。それは、太古から人間の抱く感情などというものは、それほど進化しておらず、現代に生きる我々と全く変わりないことを教えてくれ、アフリカの大地に住む人間が抱く感情も、物質的には発展した日本という国の人間が抱く感情も異なりはしないことも告げているような気がする。それは、彼らの生きる社会では、「大地と命」が結びつきあって、「過去と現在」が一直線上に配置されており、「死者と生者」が同じ世界に住み、「神と人」がきちんと向き合っているということを物語っている。遠く離れたこの日本という国にも多くの示唆を与えてくれているような気がする。マコンデ美術は土着の伝統的な単なる工芸品ではなく、れっきとしたアートである。しかも、我々人類が忘れかけている普遍的なテーマを多く含んだ最先端のアートである。１つの作品の前で、３０分は考え込んでしまう。しかもマコンデ美術館には約４００点の作品がある。１度足を運んだからといってわかったような気になってはいけない。何かにつまづいたとき、新しい発想がほしいとき、何度も訪れるべきだ。マコンデ族の中にその答えが見つかるかも知れない。しかし、なぜ、この「マコンデ美術館」なるものが、この伊勢志摩にあるのか。その謎を知りたければ、実際訪れてみるしかない。答えはマコンデのなかにいつもある。

title: Makonde Museum: The Blossoming of Artistic Culture in Tanzania
description: There is a country called Tanzania in the east of the African continent. It may be a country that is not very familiar to Japanese people. It might be easier to imagine it as a country with Mount Kilimanjaro and the Maasai tribe. In this country, there is a tribe called the Makonde, and the art they create is very beautiful. The Makonde have been creating various sculptures from ebony, which is abundant in their region, for a long time. The motifs they use include people, animals, and even abstract works. The pieces they carve from ebony, despite not being economically wealthy, are rich in emotional expression. Anger, sadness, resignation, joy, and fear can be read from them, and all of these emotions seem somewhat comical, as if the affirmation of life is a premise. If we read deeper, we can see a mixture of anger and resignation, a blend of sadness and laughter, and a readiness to accept the difficulties of life, with various emotions intertwined and expressed. This teaches us that the emotions humans have harbored since ancient times have not evolved much, and that the emotions of people living in Africa are not fundamentally different from those of people in Japan, a country that has developed materially. It tells us that in their society, 'the earth and life' are interconnected, 'the past and present' are aligned in a straight line, 'the dead and the living' coexist in the same world, and 'the divine and humans' face each other properly. It seems to provide many insights to this distant country of Japan as well. Makonde art is not merely traditional indigenous crafts; it is a legitimate form of art. Moreover, it is cutting-edge art that contains many universal themes that humanity has begun to forget. One can ponder in front of a single piece for at least 30 minutes. Furthermore, the Makonde Museum has about 400 pieces of art. One should not think they understand it just because they have visited once. When one stumbles upon something or seeks new ideas, they should visit multiple times. The answers may be found within the Makonde. However, why is this 'Makonde Museum' located in Ise-Shima? If you want to know that mystery, you must visit in person. The answer is always within the Makonde.

description:
Nishi-Awa Tourism Area
Within the embrace of lofty mountains, time stands still.
Nishi-Awa is a pure land of unchanging patterns and human warmth.
When you arrive here, you’re struck by a sense of unexplored seclusion. It’s a place where one valley leads into another, disappearing into the mist. Little hamlets with patches of farmland cling to the steep mountainsides. There’s nowhere else in Japan like it.

Pathways wind their way right beside the farmhouses of these close-knit communities, where total isolation and limited resources have fostered indissoluble bonds and a spirit of cooperation. From the Heian period, the people of Nishi-Awa have welcomed strangers warmly, accepting them as hospitably as one of their own.
The unique culture that arose on these high mountain slopes fascinated scholar of eastern culture Alex Kerr, who saw the valleys of Iya as a Japanese Shangri-La. Today, many visitors from around the world come to experience its peaceful charm.

西阿波は変わらぬパターンと人間の温かさの純粋な土地です。
ここに到着すると、未踏の孤立感に圧倒されます。霧の中に消えていく一つの谷が別の谷へと続く場所です。急な山肌にしがみつく小さな集落と農地があります。日本には他にない場所です。

道は、これらの密接なコミュニティの農家のすぐそばを winding しています。完全な孤立と限られた資源が、解消不可能な絆と協力の精神を育んできました。平安時代から、西阿波の人々は、見知らぬ人を温かく迎え入れ、自分たちの仲間のように受け入れてきました。
高い山の斜面で生まれた独特の文化は、東洋文化の学者アレックス・カーを魅了し、彼は祖谷の谷を日本のシャングリラと見なしました。今日、世界中から多くの訪問者がその平和な魅力を体験しに来ています。

〈70年続く、磯部温泉大花火大会〉
2024年8月15日に開催予定。16日には仕掛け花火・灯籠流しも。
開催情報→https://www.isobeonsen.com/isobeonsenmatsuri_oshirase_2024

群馬県内で最も開催回数が多く、古い歴史を誇る

この花火大会は地元へ愛が深い、多くの企業や商店、市民の寄付から成り立ってきた。

磯部温泉は「温泉マークの発祥の地」

万治4年（1661年）、今から350年以上前の江戸時代。
農民たちの土地の争いをおさめるため、当時の江戸幕府が判決文に添えられた地図に、磯部温泉を示す記号が描かれていた。
この記号こそが日本最古の温泉マークであると言われている。

天明3年（1783）の浅間山大噴火のときに湧出量を増したと言われている。

泉質は、塩化物・炭酸水素塩強塩温泉。
泉温は52.6℃。入浴すると肌がツルツルする、美肌の湯。

磯部温泉組合は昭和25年（1950年）に、磯部温泉街の振興のために発足。
源泉の管理や、お祭り、観光PRなど様々な事業に取組んでいる。
お祭りは観光で訪れた人をもてなすだけでなく、暮らす人たちも楽しみにしている。

まちのひとが中心になって、温泉街でのお祭りの文化を後世に残すために多くの人たちの協力を得ている。

「磯部温泉大花火大会」は8月15日の夜に開催する打上げ花火。

新型コロナウイルスの影響で地域経済が衰退しているなか、従来通りに寄付を集めるのは困難だと考え、2021年はクラウドファンディングを実施。

雨上がりの夏の日に、暮らす人にも観光で訪れた人にも、地域を思う明るい気持ちが広がった。


〈磯部簗〉
1964年から続く、夏の風物詩。
第一回東京オリンピック開催の年であり、碓氷峠のアプト式が廃止になり、スピードアップされ、列車運行本数も増えた頃でもあります。
碓氷川のほとりで「川魚の女王」と称される鮎を
職人達が鮎の美味しさを引き出し一匹一匹、丁寧に焼き上げます。
2024年は6月8日〜9月23日まで営業です。
花火大会の8月15日は予約制です。ぜひ、特等席でご覧ください。
WEBサイト→https://isobeyana.com/


〈群馬県立松井田高等学校 硬式野球部〉
チームスローガンは「率先垂範」人の先頭に立って物事を行い、模範を示すこと。
早朝練習、放課後の練習と並行して、最寄駅の松井田駅と通学路の清掃活動を行っています。
「地域に応援される野球部」になること、恵まれた環境で部活動を取り組めることをPRすることを目的に、野球部の公式アカウントを作り、SNSで投稿開始してから、1日も休むことなく発信しています。
https://twitter.com/CC0mFGr5euDruq7

松井田高校野球部の取組が紹介された記事を、阪神タイガースの青柳選手がSNSに投稿し、話題を呼びました。
https://twitter.com/tiger50yagi/status/1545716805364518912?s=20&t=mRY9F_bDjdQU00lsOYNl3A

地域の中での持続可能な取り組みとしてタッグを組み、さまざまなボランティア活動にも力を入れています。

『Ｓｅｅｄｅｒ ～笑顔のタネをまく人～』【TBS】
松井田高校野球部監督の庄司治人さん。
どんな生徒でも気軽に野球を始められるよう、生徒の負担を減らす野球部運営を行っている。
庄司さんは野球部運営を通して、高校球児の未来に、どんな笑顔の花を咲かせるのか・・・？
https://youtu.be/5Bib2RvNqcs

〈〜伝えたいこと〜2022年に記載した内容〉
コロナ禍での自粛や制限、時間は待ってくれず、子どもたちは大人に近づきます。
暮らす地域の中で楽しみを見つけること、知ってもらうことで生活が豊かになるように、前向きな気持ちになれるような映像をつくりたいと思って制作しました。
観光で訪れる人にも、地域での暮らしぶりや、前向きな取り組みが伝わった方が旅行に行くのが楽しみになるはずです。それだけでなく、出かけられない人が映像を見て少しでも明るい気持ちになれるように。画面の向こうを想像して制作しています。
安中市出身の若手ロックバンドの楽曲を使用しました。
旅の思い出、暮らしのなかで印象に残る景色を色濃くするのが音楽。
映像は文字の何倍もの情報量を持ちます。
コロナ禍の2021年の取り組みを契機に、映像やデジタル技術を活かした情報発信を強化していきます。
安中市内の四季の美しさを映像に加えて、音楽でも彩ります。

〈70 Years of the Isobe Onsen Grand Fireworks Festival〉
Scheduled to be held on August 15, 2024. On the 16th, there will also be display fireworks and lantern floating.
Event information → https://www.isobeonsen.com/isobeonsenmatsuri_oshirase_2024

This fireworks festival boasts the most frequent events and a long history in Gunma Prefecture.

This festival has been supported by many local businesses, shops, and citizens' donations, reflecting a deep love for the community.

Isobe Onsen is known as the "Birthplace of the Onsen Mark."

In the 4th year of Manji (1661), over 350 years ago during the Edo period,
to settle land disputes among farmers, the Edo Shogunate included a symbol indicating Isobe Onsen on a map attached to a judgment document.
This symbol is said to be the oldest onsen mark in Japan.

It is said that the amount of hot spring water increased during the great eruption of Mount Asama in the 3rd year of Tenmei (1783).

The water quality is a strong saline hot spring with chloride and bicarbonate.
The spring temperature is 52.6°C. Bathing in it leaves the skin smooth, making it a beauty hot spring.

The Isobe Onsen Association was established in 1950 to promote the Isobe Onsen area.
They are engaged in various projects, including managing the hot spring source, festivals, and tourism PR.
The festival is not only a way to welcome tourists but also something that local residents look forward to.

The people of the town are working together to preserve the culture of the festival in the hot spring town with the cooperation of many.

The "Isobe Onsen Grand Fireworks Festival" features a fireworks display on the night of August 15.

Due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, the local economy has been declining, making it difficult to collect donations as usual. Therefore, in 2021, crowdfunding was implemented.

On a summer day after the rain, a bright feeling of community spread among both residents and visitors.

〈Isobe Yana〉
A summer tradition that has continued since 1964.
It was the year of the first Tokyo Olympics, and the Abt system on the Usui Pass was abolished, leading to faster trains and an increase in train operations.

By the banks of the Usui River, craftsmen carefully grill ayu, known as the "Queen of River Fish," to bring out its deliciousness, one by one.
In 2024, it will be open from June 8 to September 23.
Reservations are required for the fireworks festival on August 15. Please enjoy it from the best seats.
Website → https://isobeyana.com/

〈Gunma Prefectural Matsuidahigh School Baseball Club〉
The team slogan is "Leading by Example," which means to take the lead in doing things and setting an example.
In addition to early morning practices and after-school practices, they also engage in cleaning activities along the route to Matsuidah Station.

The goal is to become a "baseball club supported by the community" and to promote the opportunity to engage in club activities in a blessed environment. They created an official account for the baseball club and have been posting on social media without missing a day since.
https://twitter.com/CC0mFGr5euDruq7

An article introducing the efforts of the Matsuidah High School baseball team was posted on social media by Hanshin Tigers player Aoyagi, creating a buzz.
