title: 【安中市 -秋-】ANNAKA CITY - Autumn -〈群馬県 観光PR〉
description:
〈碓氷峠 廃線ウォーク〉
2018年10月14日に開始したガイド付きウォーキングツアー。
年間1000名以上の方が参加してくれるツアーになりました。

秋の紅葉シーズンが人気です。11月上旬がおすすめ。
11月になると日没時間も早くなって17時に軽井沢に着く時には、夕陽が西の空を赤く染めます。

〈Trail Running〉
日本のマラソンのルーツ、安政遠足。
中山道の碓氷峠区間でトレイルランニングを楽しむ人が増えてきました。
途中、峠の力餅で栄養補給したり、歴史と景色を楽しみながら走ってみてください。
走ったあとは、ぜひ日帰り温泉施設で汗を流していってください。

〈EL・SLぐんまよこかわ〉2023年

10月1日、14日、28日、29日
※28日は「EL/SL群馬県民の日」号で運行

ELレトロぐんま 横川/D51復活35周年横川
11月4日
「信越線みんなで手を振ろうプロジェクト」
→https://www.antrip.jp/event/el1104/


〈秋の運動会・体育祭〉
群馬県の運動会は上毛三山でチーム分けが定番です。
妙義・榛名・赤城がベーシックですが、生徒数の多いところでは浅間もあるそうです。
今年4月に統合となった松井田南中学校の最後の体育祭を撮影させていただきました。
赤、白、黄、青、赤、さまざまな色を鮮明に残せるように、思い出してもらえるようにという想いを込めています。

〈碓氷湖〉
碓氷湖には歌碑があります。童謡の「紅葉」は碓氷峠を舞台につくられたとされています。紅葉を楽しむポイントとしてだけでなく、湖畔を周遊できる遊歩道もおすすめです。
1周1200m、ゆっくり歩いて30分ほどです。美しさの象徴でもある橋にも注目してもらいたいです。碓氷峠の鉄道遺産をイメージしてつくられたそうです。「ほほえみばし」という名前も付けられているように、ゆっくり過ごして微笑みが生まれる様な場所です。


〈めがね橋 碓氷第三橋梁〉
今度、訪れる方は橋を見上げる時に煉瓦の色に注目してみてください。
橋を支える橋脚の部分は少し、黒い煉瓦が使われています。
焼き時間を長くした煉瓦を使っているそうで、橋の力強さが強調されているようにも見えます。

2022年の10月14日で鉄道開業150周年を迎えました。
鉄道遺産を観光することで、身近な鉄道にも親しみを持ってもらえたらと思っています。

ぜひ、家族で鉄道を使って旅行に出かけたり、鉄道に関する思い出を身近な人に聞いてみてください。

title: ANNAKA CITY - Autumn -〈Gunma Prefecture Tourism PR〉
description:
〈Usui Pass Abandoned Line Walk〉
A guided walking tour that started on October 14, 2018.
It has become a tour that more than 1,000 people participate in each year.

The autumn foliage season is popular. Early November is recommended.
In November, the sunset time becomes earlier, and when arriving in Karuizawa at 5 PM, the sunset paints the western sky red.

〈Trail Running〉
The roots of marathon running in Japan, the Ansei Hiking.
More people are enjoying trail running in the Usui Pass section of the Nakasendo.
Along the way, replenish your energy with the power rice cakes at the pass, and enjoy running while taking in the history and scenery.
After running, be sure to wash off your sweat at a day-use hot spring facility.

〈EL・SL Gunma Yokokawa〉2023

October 1, 14, 28, 29
*On the 28th, it will operate as the "EL/SL Gunma Prefecture Citizen's Day" train.

EL Retro Gunma Yokokawa/D51 Revival 35th Anniversary Yokokawa
November 4
"Shinetsu Line Let's Wave Together Project"
→https://www.antrip.jp/event/el1104/

〈Autumn Sports Festival〉
In Gunma Prefecture, sports festivals are typically divided into teams based on the Jomo Three Mountains.
Myogi, Haruna, and Akagi are the basics, but in places with a large number of students, Asama is also included.
I was able to photograph the last sports festival of Matsuidaminami Junior High School, which was integrated in April this year.
With red, white, yellow, blue, and red, I hope to preserve various colors vividly, so that memories can be recalled.

〈Usui Lake〉
Usui Lake has a monument for a song. The children's song "Momiji" is said to have been created based on the Usui Pass. It is recommended not only as a point to enjoy the autumn leaves but also for the walking path that allows you to stroll around the lakeside.
One lap is 1,200 meters, and it takes about 30 minutes to walk slowly. I also want you to pay attention to the bridge, which is a symbol of beauty. It is said to have been created with the image of the railway heritage of Usui Pass. As it is named "Hohoemi Bridge," it is a place where you can spend time slowly and smiles are born.

〈Megane Bridge Usui Third Bridge〉
Next time you visit, please pay attention to the color of the bricks when looking up at the bridge.
The part of the bridge that supports the piers uses slightly black bricks.
It is said that bricks with a longer baking time are used, which emphasizes the strength of the bridge.

On October 14, 2022, we celebrated the 150th anniversary of the railway's opening.
By touring the railway heritage, I hope people can develop a fondness for the nearby railways.

Please take a trip with your family using the railway, or ask those close to you about their memories related to the railway.

title: 【安中市 -冬- 】ANNAKA CITY - Winter -〈群馬県 観光PR〉
description:
【鉄道のまち　横川】
1885年に高崎一横川間、明治21年(1888)には直江津(新潟県)一軽井沢間が開通しました。
横川(群馬県)一軽井沢(長野県)間11.2kmは、明治26年(1893)にわずか1年半の工事期間で開通。
横川のまちは峠を越える旅人たちの玄関口になりました。
「峠の釜めし」は、昭和33年(1958)2月1日、信越線横川駅で発売開始し、これまでに約1億7000万個発売している駅弁を代表する商品です。
峠の釜めし誕生のきっかけになった陶器の容器は、長い列車の旅で疲れたお客様の「温かい弁当を食べたい」という声から、陶器の器を採用したことにあります。益子焼の土釜にあたたかいご飯が入り、鶏肉・筍・椎茸・ごぼう・栗・杏子など9種類の具材が彩ります。季節やイベントによって中身も掛紙も変わり、観光客と地元の人たちを楽しませくれます。
横川駅と軽井沢駅の「駅そば・駅うどん」もオススメです。

https://youtu.be/8_tahbfUlHk?si=ZRgQIaeCNdNgEGy3
さっほーの日本全国駅弁の旅 ＃16「雨の碓氷峠で廃線ウォーク体験と荻野屋の駅そば食レポ！（信越本線・横川駅「峠の釜めし」前編）

https://youtu.be/fnzIwcyJOUo?si=aYXaT0E0Ygao55OB
「さっほーの日本全国駅弁の旅」#17 信越本線・横川駅「峠の釜めし」（おぎのや）

こちらも、是非ご覧ください！


【のってたのしい列車 運行日】

EL/DL横川ナイトパーク
12月16日

EL湯けむり碓氷横川/SL湯らりーといそべ
2月24日

詳しくはこちらから→https://www.jreast.co.jp/railway/joyful/slgunma.html


【霧積温泉 金湯館】
〜明治憲法草案も作成され、近代日本の夜明けを支えた歴史の宿〜
森村誠一の小説（人間の証明）原作の宿です。
詳しくは・・楽しく学べるこちらの動画をご覧ください→https://youtu.be/TlS4eqRssyI


【めがね橋と遊歩道アプトの道】
通称「めがね橋」として親しまれている煉瓦アーチ橋で径間数４、長さ９１ｍ、高さ３１ｍでわが国最大の煉瓦づくりアーチ橋です。１８９３（明治２６）年、横川―軽井沢間の碓氷峠に鉄道が開通。標高差５５２.５メートル、距離１１・２キロの区間に２６のトンネルと１８の橋が造られました。
古くから交通の難所だった碓氷峠。その急勾配を上り下りするためにドイツの山岳鉄道の技術「アプト式」が採用されました。線路に歯形のあるレールを敷き、列車下部の歯車とかみ合わせる。谷を渡す「めがね橋」は18の橋のうちの一つでした。
　この区間の開通で繭や生糸の流通量は飛躍的に増え、日本の産業発展の要を担った。複線の新線の開通に伴い1963年に役目を終えました。
1993年には、近代化に貢献した「近代化遺産」として初めて国の重要文化財に登録されています。駅があった熊ノ平から横川駅まで、めがね橋や10のトンネルを通る約６キロを、遊歩道「アプトの道」として整備され、人気の観光スポットとなっています。
撮影地としても使われる人気スポットです→https://youtu.be/nBwT2Sgb1yY


【碓氷峠廃線ウォーク】
「碓氷峠 廃線ウォーク」は、ガイド付きのウォーキングツアーです。　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　

「峠の鉄道の歴史は人の歴史だった」
群馬県と長野県を結ぶ、碓氷峠を鉄道で越えた104年の歴史。
1893年開通、明治期以降の日本経済発展に大きく貢献した。
鉄道開通によって栄えた、このまちには人の記憶と想いが残っている。
行き止まりのレールの先を、次の世代につないでいく。
1997年9月30日まで、運行された日本一の急勾配区間。　　　　
保全と活用を目的に、「サポーター制度」がスタートしました。
信越本線新線 横川−軽井沢区間、通称「碓氷線」
「峠の鉄道の歴史はこれからも人の歴史だ」　

サポーター制度詳細はこちら→https://camp-fire.jp/projects/view/474873


【碓氷峠鉄道文化むら】
旧碓氷線の歴史を伝え、小さなお子様から鉄道ファンまで楽しめる、鉄道テーマパークです。鉄道模型や、子どもが楽しめる遊具、大人が通い詰める本格的な機関車の運転体験などが楽しめます。「碓氷鉄道文化むら」で、1世紀を超える鉄道の歴史を、見て触れて体験してください。ホームページはこちら→https://www.usuitouge.com/bunkamura/


【磯部温泉マークまつり】
2022年は2月25日に開催♨︎
お祭り中は半額で提供される「温泉マークカレー」商品化の背景には「温泉マークの危機」がありました。経済産業省が2016年、東京五輪・パラリンピックに向けて、外国人には「現在の温泉マークでは、温かい料理に見えてわかりにくい」として、入浴者の姿を加えた記号へ変えようと議論になりました。「伝統のマークを変えないで欲しい！」と磯部温泉の関係者らが反対。マークは併存することで落ち着き、「温泉マーク愛」に火がついたというストーリーがあります。そんな、愛の詰まったカレーを食べて、旅の思い出が増えたら嬉しいです。

磯部温泉の情報はこちらのホームページがおすすめです→https://www.isobeonsen.com/

title: ANNAKA CITY - Winter -〈Gunma Prefecture Tourism PR〉
description:
【The Town of Railways, Yokokawa】
In 1885, the line between Takasaki and Yokokawa opened, and in 1888, the line between Naoetsu (Niigata Prefecture) and Karuizawa was completed.
The 11.2 km section between Yokokawa (Gunma Prefecture) and Karuizawa (Nagano Prefecture) opened in just a year and a half in 1893.
The town of Yokokawa became the gateway for travelers crossing the mountain pass.
"Toge no Kamameshi" was first sold at Yokokawa Station on the Shin'etsu Line on February 1, 1958, and has since become a representative product of station bento, with approximately 170 million sold to date.
The ceramic container that inspired the birth of Toge no Kamameshi was adopted in response to the voices of tired customers wanting to eat "warm bento" during long train journeys. Warm rice is served in a Mashiko-yaki earthenware pot, accompanied by nine types of ingredients such as chicken, bamboo shoots, shiitake mushrooms, burdock, chestnuts, and apricots. The contents and wrapping change with the seasons and events, delighting both tourists and locals.
The "station soba and udon" at Yokokawa Station and Karuizawa Station are also recommended.

https://youtu.be/8_tahbfUlHk?si=ZRgQIaeCNdNgEGy3
Sappho's Journey Across Japan's Station Bento #16 "Experience the Abandoned Line Walk at Usui Pass in the Rain and Food Report on Ogino-ya's Station Soba! (Shin'etsu Main Line, Yokokawa Station 'Toge no Kamameshi' Part 1)

https://youtu.be/fnzIwcyJOUo?si=aYXaT0E0Ygao55OB
"Sappho's Journey Across Japan's Station Bento" #17 Shin'etsu Main Line, Yokokawa Station 'Toge no Kamameshi' (Ogino-ya)

Please take a look at this as well!

【Fun Train Operation Days】
EL/DL Yokokawa Night Park
December 16

EL Yukemuri Usui Yokokawa/SL Yurarito Isobe
February 24

For more details, click here → https://www.jreast.co.jp/railway/joyful/slgunma.html

【Kirishima Onsen Kintokan】
~ A historical inn that supported the dawn of modern Japan, where the draft of the Meiji Constitution was also created ~
This is the inn based on Seichi Morimura's novel (Proof of Humanity).
For more details, please watch this enjoyable and educational video → https://youtu.be/TlS4eqRssyI

【Megane Bridge and Apt Path】
The brick arch bridge, affectionately known as "Megane Bridge," has a span of four, a length of 91 m, and a height of 31 m, making it the largest brick arch bridge in Japan. In 1893, the railway opened between Yokokawa and Karuizawa at Usui Pass. A total of 26 tunnels and 18 bridges were constructed over a distance of 11.2 km with an elevation difference of 552.5 meters.
Usui Pass has long been a difficult transportation point. To navigate its steep gradients, the German mountain railway technology known as the "Abt system" was adopted. Rails with teeth were laid on the tracks, which meshed with gears on the underside of the train. The "Megane Bridge" was one of the 18 bridges that spanned the valley.
The opening of this section dramatically increased the distribution of silk and raw silk, playing a key role in Japan's industrial development. It was decommissioned in 1963 with the opening of a new double-track line.
In 1993, it was registered as a national important cultural property for its contribution to modernization as a "modernization heritage." The approximately 6 km path from Kumano-daira Station to Yokokawa Station, passing through the Megane Bridge and 10 tunnels, has been developed as a walking path called "Apt Path," becoming a popular tourist spot.
It is also a popular filming location → https://youtu.be/nBwT2Sgb1yY

【Usui Pass Abandoned Line Walk】
The "Usui Pass Abandoned Line Walk" is a guided walking tour.

"The history of the mountain pass railway was the history of people."
A 104-year history of crossing Usui Pass by railway, connecting Gunma Prefecture and Nagano Prefecture.
Opened in 1893, it greatly contributed to Japan's economic development after the Meiji period.
This town, which flourished due to the opening of the railway, holds the memories and thoughts of its people.
Connecting the end of the dead-end rails to the next generation.
The steepest section of railway in Japan operated until September 30, 1997.
To promote preservation and utilization, a "Supporter System" was launched.
Shin'etsu Main Line New Line, the Yokokawa-Karuizawa section, commonly known as the "Usui Line."
"The history of the mountain pass railway will continue to be the history of people."

For details on the Supporter System, click here → https://camp-fire.jp/projects/view/474873

【Usui Pass Railway Culture Village】
A railway theme park that conveys the history of the old Usui Line, enjoyable for children and railway fans alike. You can enjoy railway models, playground equipment for children, and authentic locomotive driving experiences that adults will love. Experience the history of over a century of railways at the "Usui Pass Railway Culture Village." Here is the website → https://www.usuitouge.com/bunkamura/

【Isobe Onsen Mark Festival】
In 2022, it was held on February 25♨︎
During the festival, the "Onsen Mark Curry" is offered at half price, and the background of its commercialization lies in the "crisis of the Onsen mark." In 2016, the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry discussed changing the current Onsen mark to a symbol that includes bathers, as it was deemed unclear for foreigners, especially in preparation for the Tokyo Olympics and Paralympics. Those involved with Isobe Onsen opposed this, saying, "Please do not change the traditional mark!" The mark was settled by coexisting, and a story emerged about the "love for the Onsen mark." I hope that eating this curry filled with love will create more travel memories.

For information on Isobe Onsen, I recommend this website → https://www.isobeonsen.com/

【秋間梅林】
ぐんま三大梅林のひとつで、観光梅林として約60年の歴史があります。
約50ヘクタールの広大な丘陵に約35,000本の紅白梅が咲き誇ります。
秋間梅林祭を2月中旬から3月末にかけて毎年開催しています。
梅農家のお母さんたちが笑顔で営業する売店が11軒連なり、地元のごはんやおやつを味わう事が出来ます。
秋間梅林は観て、食べて、体験できる梅のふるさとです。
安中駅からバスに乗っても行けます。
詳しくはこちらから→https://akimabairin.com/access/

【碓氷 横川の旅】
碓日のお宿 東京屋 https://oyado-tokyoya.com/
横川駅を降りて、徒歩3分。おいしいご飯と旅館のおもてなし。
鉄道で栄えたまちで過ごす夜、列車の動き出す朝の雰囲気。
もう一度、横川に来たくなること間違いなしです。

横川周辺の桜の見頃は4月1週目あたりです。
かつての鉄道員たちの角打ちスポット

お花見用のお酒はこちらでどうぞ。
アプトの道を歩いた後の乾杯にもおすすめです。

【後閑城址公園】
戦国時代に西上州の要城として存在した「後閑城」をもとに、堀切、郭、虎口門、櫓　台など、当時の形状を生かした広場が配置された公園です。
それぞれの広場を遊歩道で結び、草花や樹木の中を散策しながら、四季折々の移り変わりが楽しめます。特に春は、浅間山と奇勝妙義山を借景に、本丸跡に植栽された桜が満開になる様は一見の価値があります。
2024年3月31日開催、桜まつり花火大会。
600発の大輪の花火とライトアップで照らされたサクラが春の夜空に咲き誇る。

【安中市立臼井小学校・九十九小学校】
2022年3月31日をもって閉校となり、松井田小学校へ統合となりました。
桜が咲く校庭で子どもたちが元気に遊ぶ姿を記録に残すことができました。
タイムカプセルを開ける時に、この映像を見てくれたらうれしいです。

【妙義山】
妙義山は上毛三山の1つで、日本三奇勝の1つにも数えられております。奇岩怪石の妙義山には、自然の造形美ともいえるアーチ状の石門群や、日暮れまで見ていても飽きない「日暮らしの景」などの名所が幾つもあります。秋は、モミジやカエデなどの紅葉が見事で、多くの人々が登山や紅葉狩りに訪れます。


【横川ナイトパーク】
碓氷峠鉄道文化むらが20:00までナイトミュージアムに。

title: 「碓氷峠 廃線ウォーク」〜行き止まりのレールの先を、次の世代に〜
description: 1893年に開通した、信越本線の横川-軽井沢区間。その碓氷峠区間のほとんど区間が群馬県側にあるにもかかわらず長野県歌に登場する。以下、長野県歌「信濃の国」の6番。「吾妻はやとし日本武　嘆き給いし碓氷山　穿つ隧道二十六　夢にもこゆる汽車の道　みち一筋に学びなば……」外貨獲得のため、碓氷峠を越えて東京・横浜方面へ、蚕糸・製糸製品を運ぶために、鉄道の開通が切望されていた。そんな、信越本線の横川-軽井沢区間（通称、碓氷線）は電化から新線への切り替えを経て、1997年に最終運行を迎え、現在は廃線となっている。普段は立ち入り禁止区間をガイド付きで約11kmを歩き、歴史的価値と峠越えの困難さを体感できるウォーキングツアーを2018年から定期的に開催している。そのツアーガイドの祖父は、碓氷峠を走る機関車の運転をしていた。私たちは、使われていなかった廃線跡を「観光資源」として捉えました。峠を越えるために、新しい観光ルートをつくるとなると「破壊」がともないます。壊して新しいものをつくると文化と景観が失われてしまいます。「碓氷峠 廃線ウォーク」はスポーツミックスの文化観光であり、持続可能な観光コンテンツとして融合した取り組みです。この5年間で6000名以上が参加して続いています。歩くために廃線跡を覆う草刈りをするサポーターチームも立ち上げました。草を刈り、木を切ることが、空を飛ぶクマタカが地上の獲物を捉える為のひらけた場所として、役立つかもしれません。人だけでなく、動物の生態系維持につながるように想いを馳せ、持続可能な循環を生み出していく。訪れた人たちは、自らのアクションが保全と活用の両輪であること体感できることが特色です。そして何より、大切なのは「いまあるものを大事にする」ということです。「なくなってしまった痛みを知る」私たちは、いま走る列車を大切にしています。その想いを知ってもらうことを、この映像は目的としています。このウォーキングツアーをはじめて5年。いままでの取り組みが評価されて、スポーツ文化ツーリズムアワード「文化ツーリズム」賞を授賞しました。

title: Usui Pass Abandoned Line Walk - Beyond the Dead End of the Rails, for the Next Generation
description: The section of the Shin'etsu Main Line between Yokokawa and Karuizawa, which opened in 1893. Despite most of the Usui Pass section being located on the Gunma Prefecture side, it appears in the Nagano Prefecture song. Below is the sixth verse of the Nagano Prefecture song 'Shinano no Kuni': 'Azuma is a land of Japan's warriors, lamenting over Usui Mountain, with twenty-six tunnels piercing through, a train path that even dreams of...'. To earn foreign currency, there was a strong desire for the railway to open to transport silk and silk products to Tokyo and Yokohama via the Usui Pass. The Yokokawa-Karuizawa section of the Shin'etsu Main Line (commonly known as the Usui Line) underwent electrification and a switch to a new line, ultimately concluding its final operation in 1997, and is now abandoned. Since 2018, a walking tour has been regularly held, allowing participants to walk approximately 11 km through normally restricted areas with a guide, experiencing the historical value and the difficulties of crossing the pass. The grandfather of the tour guide operated locomotives running through the Usui Pass. We have viewed the unused abandoned railway as a 'tourism resource'. Creating a new tourist route to cross the pass would involve 'destruction'. Destroying to create something new would lead to the loss of culture and scenery. The 'Usui Pass Abandoned Line Walk' is a cultural tourism initiative that blends sports and sustainable tourism content. Over the past five years, more than 6,000 people have participated. A support team has also been established to mow the grass covering the abandoned railway for walking. Mowing grass and cutting trees may help create open spaces for the flying Kumataka to catch prey on the ground. We hope to maintain not only human ecosystems but also animal ecosystems, creating a sustainable cycle. Visitors can experience that their actions are both conservation and utilization. Above all, what is important is to 'cherish what we have now'. Knowing the pain of 'what has been lost', we cherish the trains that are currently running. This video aims to convey that sentiment. After five years of this walking tour, our efforts have been recognized, and we received the 'Cultural Tourism' award at the Sports Culture Tourism Awards.

■ What is Kikai Island?
Kikai Island is located about 380 km south of Kagoshima and 25 km east of Amami Oshima. It is an uplifted coral reef island floating in the ocean where the Pacific Ocean and the East China Sea meet. Most of the island is made up of uplifted coral reefs, which continue to rise at an average rate of 2 mm per year, making it a scientifically valuable island. The island is covered with sugarcane fields, and the brown sugar and brown sugar shochu made from sugarcane are local specialties. It is also known as the largest producer of white sesame in Japan. Within Kikai Island, there are numerous attractions, including Hyakunodai Park, one of the Amami Ten Scenic Views, beautiful Sugirabeach, Hawaii Beach, and ancient coral stone walls. In recent years, it has also gained attention as a diving spot.

奄美大島からわずか20分のフライトで到着する喜界島。サンゴでできたこの島は、美しい海の青と大地の緑が織りなす豊な自然環境を誇ります。また、優しい島民との交流は笑顔が溢れる旅の体験をお届けします。

■喜界島とは
喜界島は鹿児島から南に約380km・奄美大島の東25km。太平洋と東シナ海のぶつかる洋上に浮かぶ隆起珊瑚礁の島です。島の大半が隆起サンゴ礁で、今でも年間平均2mmずつ隆起し続けている学術的にも貴重な島です。島一面にサトウキビ畑が広がり、サトウキビから作られる黒糖、黒糖焼酎は島の特産品となっています。また国内最大の白ゴマの産地としても知られています。喜界島島内には奄美十景の１つ、百之台公園を始め、美しいスギラビーチやハワイビーチ、古くから残るサンゴの石垣など数々の名所があります。近年はダイビングスポットとしても注目をされています。

title: Kikai Island, Japan
description:
Official website: https://bit.ly/3iOB1lS
Official Instagram: https://bit.ly/3XgZuzh

Kikai Island, just a 20-minute flight from Amami Oshima, is a coral island that boasts a rich natural environment woven together by the beautiful blue of the sea and the green of the land. Additionally, interactions with the kind islanders provide a travel experience filled with smiles.

■ About Kikai Island
Kikai Island is located approximately 380 km south of Kagoshima and 25 km east of Amami Oshima. It is an uplifted coral reef island floating in the ocean where the Pacific Ocean and the East China Sea meet. Most of the island is made up of uplifted coral reefs, which continue to rise at an average rate of 2 mm per year, making it a scientifically valuable island. The island is covered with sugarcane fields, and the brown sugar and brown sugar shochu made from sugarcane are local specialties. It is also known as the largest producer of white sesame in Japan. Within Kikai Island, there are numerous famous spots, including Hyakunodai Park, one of the Amami Ten Scenic Views, as well as the beautiful Sugirabeach and Hawaii Beach, and ancient coral stone walls. In recent years, it has also gained attention as a diving spot.

【動画制作者からのコメント】
私たちは、福井市のセブンディという映像制作会社で、高島と今城の２人で運営しております。2016年より、YouTubeにチャンネルを開設し、現在まで、福井のなんでもない景色をテーマに動画をアップしてきました。動画を制作するにあたり、地味にすごいとは何か、そして、福井の素晴らしさは何かを考えました。福井の素晴らしさは、景色、風景にあると思います。豊な水がもたらす大自然は、大きく変わる時代の流れの中でも普遍である雄大さがあります。それは、誰もが知っている観光地や名所だけではなく、なんでもないところにも溢れていて、その景色というのはきっと、福井に住む人の数、福井に訪れた人の数、福井を思う人の数あるのではないでしょうか。動画では、みなさんが知っている観光地はもちろん、私たちが見つけた素晴らしい景色や自然をで織り交ぜ、動画をご覧になった方に、どうか皆さんのそれぞれのとっておきの景色を見つけに福井へ来てほしいというストーリーにしています。タイトルは、雲海ではっきり見えない福井の景色に、鋭い視線を切り込み、未だ見ぬ世界（ふくい）にあなたの視点を入れて欲しいという思いを込めました。動画は４Kになっています。美しい福井をどのように再現できるかに苦労しました。どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

title: The Unseen World (Fukui)【Award-winning Work of the Subtly Amazing Fukui Video Contest】
description:
This work is an award-winning entry in the video contest conducted by Fukui Prefecture, themed "Subtly Amazing, Fukui." 
【Comment from the Video Creators】 
We are a video production company called Seven D, based in Fukui City, operated by Takashima and Imajo. Since 2016, we have been uploading videos themed around the ordinary landscapes of Fukui on our YouTube channel. In creating this video, we contemplated what it means to be subtly amazing and what makes Fukui wonderful. We believe the beauty of Fukui lies in its scenery and landscapes. The abundant nature brought by rich water possesses a grandeur that remains constant even amidst the changing tides of time. This beauty is not only found in well-known tourist spots and landmarks but also overflows in the most ordinary places. The scenery reflects the number of people living in Fukui, those who visit, and those who think of Fukui. In the video, we weave together not only the tourist spots you know but also the wonderful landscapes and nature we have discovered, creating a story that encourages viewers to come to Fukui and find their own special scenery. The title expresses our desire for you to cut through the obscured views of Fukui's landscapes in the sea of clouds and to bring your perspective into the unseen world (Fukui). The video is in 4K. We struggled to recreate the beauty of Fukui. Thank you for your support. 

#Fukui #ふくい

title: [Live] Ogaki Festival (R4.5.15)
description:
The Ogaki Festival's float events have been passed down as a representative festival of the Mino region, celebrated in the castle town of Ogaki. The coexistence of the floats bestowed by the Ogaki feudal lord and those of the townspeople is rare nationwide.

Additionally, the karakuri puppets show a strong influence from the float events of the Chukyo region, while the performing arts on the floats reflect the traditions of the Kinki region, indicating a cultural exchange between the East and West. This festival is considered important for understanding the transmission and evolution of float, hoko, and yatai events in Japan.

It takes place on the weekend closest to May 15 each year.
The sight of thirteen floats (yama) parading for approximately 8.8 km is breathtaking. In 2015, it was designated as an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Asset of Japan, and in 2016, the 'Ogaki Festival's Yamaboko Float Events' were registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

~This is the official channel of the Ogaki Tourism Association~
We introduce various attractions of Ogaki, including nature, history, and culture, through videos.

[Introduction to Ogaki City]
Located in the western part of Gifu Prefecture, in the center of Nishi-Mino, Ogaki is a city with a population of 160,000, blessed with abundant underground water, and has long been referred to as 'the Water City of Ogaki.'
It is known as the endpoint of Matsuo Basho's travelogue 'The Narrow Road to the Deep North,' and features historical sites such as Ogaki Castle, which served as the base for Ishida Mitsunari of the Western Army during the Battle of Sekigahara, and the Sumiyoshi Castle, said to have been built by Toyotomi Hideyoshi in a single night. The city is a place where nature and history coexist.
From late March to May, the city is bustling with tourists due to activities like boat rides, tarai boats, and the Ogaki Festival, which was registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2016.

[Japanese website] https://untouchedhokkaido.jp
[English website] https://untouchedhokkaido.jp/en/

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido

The area of East Hokkaido where you'll find the Kushiro Shitsugen Wetland, Lake Akan and Lake Mashu is a shining jewel of natural beauty. The indigenous Ainu people believe that Kamuy (deity) dwells in everything, and treasure a symbiotic relationship with the waters' natural bounty.
This belief continues to thrive in this historically and geographically unique land, which is home to countless species of wildlife, including the incredibly rare Blakiston's fish owl. Visit in winter to see red-crowned cranes, Steller's sea eagles and white-tailed eagles.
Welcome to Untouched Hokkaido, a land of natural beauty that has been preserved since ancient times.
歴史的・地理的に、ユニークな場所である東北海道は、⽇本でありながら北⽶プレートに位置するため、その植⽣はとてもに珍しい種類で溢れている。この⼟地だからこそ出逢える希少な野⽣⽣物、そして多くの⽣き物が暮らす⽇本の国⽴公園はその⾃然と共⽣する地元の⼈々がずっと昔から守りぬいてきた『⾃然が⼿付かずで残る場所（Untouched
Hokkaido）』。 東北海道、この地域は豊かな清流でつながっており、日本の特別天然記念物でもある、優雅で美しいタンチョウが住んでいる。北海道の先住民族であるアイヌの言葉で、タンチョウはサロルンカムイ（湿原に住む神）と呼ばれていた。
水は生命を育みながら、魔法をかけられたようにさまざまなカタチに変化する。

title: Sea of Clouds Over Lake Mashu in the Early Morning / 摩周湖早朝雲海
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido/?hl=en

Around 20 minutes by car from Kawayu Hot Springs is Lake Mashu Viewpoint No. 3. Arrive here between sunrise and around 8:00 AM and you might see an incredible sea of clouds. The clouds covering the sky change from one movement to the next - you won't be able to tear your eyes away! The scene is completed by waves of clouds that flow over Lake Mashu from the surrounding mountains. June to September is the best time to see the sea of clouds in Teshikaga Town. Lake Mashu Viewpoint No. 3 is the best vantage point, at over 100m higher than Viewpoint No. 1. If you're lucky, you'll see a "double sea of clouds" around you, with clouds covering both Lake Mashu and Lake Kussharo! Make sure you check the best time of morning and viewing conditions in advance, as it changes depending on the season and the weather.

川湯温泉から摩周第３展望台までは車で約20分。日の出前から朝8時ぐらいまでが雲海の見頃だ。空を覆う雲海は、刻一刻と姿を変え、見る者の心を奪う。雲の波が外輪山から摩周湖に流れ込むように湖面を覆う、その様は圧巻の一言。弟子屈町で雲海を見るなら6月から9月がベストシーズン。摩周第3展望台の標高は、第1展望台よりも100メートル以上高く、雲海スポットとしては第３展望台がおすすめ。運が良ければ、360度見渡す限り雲海に埋め尽くされた摩周湖と、屈斜路湖両方の雲海、通称「ダブル雲海」を見ることができる！ 雲海の見ごろの時間帯は、季節や気象条件などにより異なるので事前の確認を。

title: Kagami no Ma Cruise in the Headwaters of the Kushiro River / 釧路川源流クルーズ・鏡の間
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido/?hl=en

The Kushiro River is the only river that flows out of Lake Kussharo. It runs through Kushiro Shitsugen Wetland and out to sea. A short distance to the side of the Kushiro River is a magical spot called Kagami no Ma. Kagami no Ma is Japanese for "mirror room" and you'll see why as soon as you see how clear this spring is. The water remains below 10°C all year round, and the area offers a vastly different scene from the Kushiro River nearby. With its cool air, crystal-clear water and lush greenery, Kagami no Ma will captivate you.

屈斜路湖から流れ出る唯一の川、釧路川。川は釧路湿原へとつながり最後は海へ流れ出る。釧路川から少しだけ脇にはいったところに「鏡の間」と呼ばれる神秘のスポットがある。湧き水から成る「鏡の間」は、その名に相応しく透明度が抜群に高い！水温は四季を通して10度以下で触るとひんやり冷たい。釧路川との違いをしっかり感じることができる。清涼な空気、鏡面の水面、澄んだ緑、訪れる者を魅了する神秘の空間。

title: Canoe Cruise around Wakoto Peninsula / 和琴半島一周カヌークルーズ
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido/?hl=en

Wakoto Peninsula is a peninsula that is about 3km around, jutting into a lake with a circumference of 57km. Its name comes from the Ainu phrase "wakkochi", which means "the narrow part of a fish's tail". The peninsula is a fascinating volcanic area, with hot springs everywhere and an area called Oyakotsu Jigoku (Oyakotsu Hell) at the tip of the peninsula, where plumes of smoke rise from the ground. Covered with deep forest, Wakoto Peninsula offers new natural splendor with each season: North Japanese hill cherry blossoms in spring, new greenery in early summer, colorful foliage in autumn. On a sunny day, Lake Kussharo is at its clearest, offering a view that will take your breath away. After you paddle around the peninsula, Mrs. Hiratsuka will serve you a hearty homemade lunch near the stunning Oyakotsu Jigoku. Made with local ingredients from Teshikaga and the surrounding area, every option will have you smacking your lips in satisfaction. The heartfelt hospitality you'll receive will make this the best canoe cruise you've ever been on.

周囲57kmの湖に突き出た和琴半島、半島1週は約3kmになる。和琴の名前の由来は、アイヌ語のワッコチ、「魚の尾のくびれた所」が語源。至る所で温泉が沸き、半島先端部には「オヤコツ地獄」と呼ばれる噴煙を上げる場所もあり、火山の島であることを実感できる。深い森におおわれた和琴半島は、春はエゾヤマザクラ、初夏の新緑、秋は紅葉など、その豊かな自然が季節様々の表情を見せてくれる。天気が良いと、屈斜路湖の透明度は最高の演出となり感動ものだ。カヌーガイドの平塚さんの奥さんの手作りランチは、オヤコツ地獄に上陸していただく最高のご馳走。弟子屈近郊の食材を使って用意されたランチはどれをとっても絶品！心優しい地元への想いが詰まったランチと絶景で、カヌークルージングは最高潮になる。

Kazuaki and Ai Hiratsuka
This husband and wife duo are guides at Northeast Canoe Center, Ltd.
After encountering Canadian canoeing in 1986, they decided to recreate the experience on the beautiful Lake Kussharo and Kushiro River, and began working as tour guides to share the spectacular nature of their hometown through exciting canoe tours.
After a leisurely canoe trip with the Hiratsukas where you’re surrounded by the natural marvels of Lake Kussharo and the Kushiro River, you’ll be treated to a hearty homemade lunch made by Ai.

平塚 一明・愛
有限会社ノースイーストカヌーセンター　ガイド。
1986年にカナディアンカヌーと出会い、屈斜路湖と釧路川の魅力を再発見。ふるさとの素晴らしい自然を、カヌーを通じて知ってもらいたいとツアーガイドをスタート。屈斜路湖と釧路川の豊かな自然の中で過ごす贅沢な時間を、のんびりと優雅に過ごしていただくために、夫婦でカヌーツアーを行う。愛さんの手作りランチは地元食材にこだわった最高のごちそう。

title: Fishing in Lake Akan and the Akan River / 阿寒湖・阿寒川フィッシング
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido/?hl=en

Lake Akan is famous for is marimo moss balls and is surrounded by untouched nature. It's also home to an abundance of native trout species, making it a beloved spot for fly fishing and lure fishing enthusiasts. Fishing is banned until April 30 each year to protect the fish population, but the period from May 1 until autumn is an angler's paradise! Even beginners will find it easy to catch rainbow trout, Japanese char and kokanee in Lake Akan. Be aware that the area from the mouth of the Akan River at Lake Akan to the Yukan Bridge is a catch-and-release area - the first in Hokkaido (designated in 2003). A recreational fishing charge of JPY1,500 per day applies (to be paid in advance).

マリモの生息で有名な阿寒湖には、手つかずの自然の姿がそのまま残る。そして阿寒湖はネイティブトラウトの宝庫で、多くのアングラー（釣り人）のあこがれの地でもあり、フライフィッシングやルアーフィッシングの聖地とも呼ばれる。5月1日の解禁日から秋にかけては、釣り三昧の休日を過ごせるベストシーズン！ニジマス・アメマス・ヒメマス釣りなどは初心者でも手軽に楽しめる。 ちなみに2003年に北海道で初めてキャッチ＆リリース（再放流）を遊漁規則化したことにより、阿寒川湖流出口から雄観橋下流端はキャッチ＆リリースエリアに設定されている。遊漁料1日.1,500円が必要（事前支払い）。

title: Chikurouen Flagship Store / 竹老園東家総本店
description:
Website: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhok...
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_h...

Chikurouen's flagship store is one of the oldest soba noodle restaurants in Hokkaido. With a history of over 140 years, this specialist restaurant has honed its skills and is still striving to improve on its authentic local noodles. Kushiro soba noodles stand out from the rest - they're green! That's because they're made from new buckwheat. The founder of Chikurouen is said to have wanted every customer to enjoy soba noodles made from new buckwheat, and that tradition is still alive today.

北海道で最も古い蕎麦屋のひとつとされる老舗蕎麦屋「竹老園東家総本店」。明治創業から140年余り、そばひと筋。歴史を積み重ねるごとに磨かれてきた技で、今なお本物の味を追い求め続けている。釧路のそばの特徴は緑色。そばが緑色なのは新そばで作られているから。緑色のそばが出来上がった理由は諸説あるが、お客様に常に新そばを食べている気分を味わっていただけるよう、出されるようになったといわれている。創業当時からの主の想いは今も受け継がれている。

〒085-0824
北海道釧路市柏木町3-19 
Tel. 0154-41-6291
http://chikurouen.com/


歴史的・地理的に、ユニークな場所である東北海道は、⽇本でありながら北⽶プレートに位置するため、その植⽣はとてもに珍しい種類で溢れている。この⼟地だからこそ出逢える希少な野⽣⽣物、そして多くの⽣き物が暮らす⽇本の国⽴公園はその⾃然と共⽣する地元の⼈々がずっと昔から守りぬいてきた『⾃然が⼿付かずで残る場所（Untouched
Hokkaido）』。 東北海道、この地域は豊かな清流でつながっており、日本の特別天然記念物でもある、優雅で美しいタンチョウが住んでいる。北海道の先住民族であるアイヌの言葉で、タンチョウはサロルンカムイ（湿原に住む神）と呼ばれていた。
水は生命を育みながら、魔法をかけられたようにさまざまなカタチに変化する。

title: Mt. Io: Untouched Hokkaido/硫黄山
description:
Teshikaga Town: Mt. Io

Stand inches away from the pulse of the earth
With the distinctive smell of sulfur and alpine plants at much lower altitudes than they usually grow, Mt. Io is like a scene from another planet. Mt. Io is located around 3km from Kawayu Hot Springs, and is called Atosa-nupuri (bare mountain) in Ainu. To this day, sulfur plumes rise from various areas of the mountain, with an incredible rumbling sound. Large-scale sulfur mining once took place here, which played a significant role in Teshikaga Town's development.
Parking is free during the winter (late November to early April).
Parking fees apply during summer: ¥200 for a motorcycle, ¥500 for a car, ¥1,000 for a minibus, ¥2,000 for a large bus
*Mt. Io is currently closed to the public for safety reasons, as there is currently a risk of falling rocks.

title: Lake Mashu:Untouched Hokkaido
摩周湖：手つかずの北海道
description:
テシカガ町：摩周湖
摩周ブルーと呼ばれる独特の青色を持つ摩周湖は、まるで別世界にいるかのような感覚を与えてくれます。

摩周湖はテシカガ町から11km、川湯温泉から12kmの場所に位置しています。湖の表面は海抜351mで、周囲は約20km、面積は19.2km2、最深部の深さは211.4mです。世界で最も透明度の高いカルデラ湖として知られています。湖は300-400mの高さの崖に囲まれており、平均勾配は45度で、他の湖では見られない急勾配です。摩周湖は霧で有名で、川が流入したり流出したりしないにもかかわらず、水位が神秘的に一定に保たれています。ほとんど不純物がない摩周湖の水は、インディゴで染められたかのように見えます。その深い青色は「摩周ブルー」と呼ばれるほど独特です。摩周湖周辺は、素晴らしい自然を保護するために、国立公園基準でも特別保護地域に指定されています。人の手が加わっていないこの美しく険しい神秘的な湖は、近くのさまざまな展望台から眺める人々を驚かせます。

title: Hike along the Akan River: Untouched Hokkaido/阿寒川リバーサイドハイク
description:
You’ll be hard-pressed to find a more beautiful hiking spot than this tranquil river surrounded by forest with natural hot springs along the way
The pure waters of the Akan River are home to rainbow trout and whitespotted char. In winter, you can hike on snowshoes through the snow-covered forest by the river. Hot springs can be found along the river, making the perfect end point for your hike. If the timing is right, you might even see wildlife such as foxes, raccoon dogs (tanuki) and Yezo deer, which drink from the hot springs to get minerals.

"Where water kamuy and fire kamuy meet"
The indigenous Ainu people of Hokkaido place great importance on coexisting with nature, where they believe that deities reside. There are two types of deities in nature – the deity of fire (apefuchi-kamuy) and the deity of water (wakkaushi-kamuy). The Akan River is a holy ground where the two meet, and the two types of kamuy are believed to provide the nutrients that the forest wildlife lives on.

title: Kotan no Yu: A free open-air hot spring by Lake Kussharo/Untouched Hokkaido/コタンの湯
description:
This natural open-air hot spring bath will make you feel like you’re bathing in Lake Kussharo itself
This hot spring bath surrounded by stones is just 5m from Lake Kussharo, creating the illusion that you are bathing in Lake Kussharo itself. In winter, the warm water runs into the lake, attracting swans that you can see right before your eyes. As you look out over the lake, you'll feel as if the swans are bathing in the hot spring with you. This vast natural paradise is stunningly beautiful no matter what time of day you visit, with incredible sunsets over the mountains beyond the lake and stars as far as the eye can see at night. Admission is free and free parking is available. Basic men's and women's changing facilities are available. The bath is surrounded by stones. While there is a large stone in the center dividing the bath in two, each side is visible from the other side, so bathing is basically mixed. Swimwear is OK.

description:

In winter, you can explore a freezing natural environment where it is not uncommon for early morning temperatures to reach -20°C. The winter chill creates magical natural beauty. You can walk across the completely frozen Akan lake to its island in around 10 minutes. You can also see the sunrise over Mt. Oakan and beautiful natural phenomena such as frost flowers, rime and diamond dust. The tour meets at 6:20, early mornings from late January to mid-March.
In summer, this island can only be reached by boat.

title: Untouched Hokkaido Digest (Winter)
description:
Welcome to Eastern Hokkaido, an incredibly beautiful area filled with rare wildlife and natural wonders.
The area is blessed with an abundance of pure, natural water that transforms the landscape throughout the seasons.

Sarorun Kamuy
The Kushiro area is home to the natural habitat of the red-crowned crane, a designated special natural monument that was once called “sarorun kamuy”, which means “spirits that live in the marshlands”, by the native Ainu people.

Cape Kirakotan
Cape Kirakotan is a designated national natural monument area, and its name originates from when the marshland was still part of the ocean, 6 thousand years ago. It was found to be a natural breeding ground of the red crowned crane that was previously thought to be extinct.

Sunset Cruise
Kushiro is said to have one of the three most beautiful sunsets in the world, and the best place to see it is from a boat.

Robatayaki
Robatayaki is a style of cooking that is unique to the port town of Kushiro, and these restaurants are the perfect place to enjoy amazing food and delicious sake with friendly locals.

Sake : Fukutsukasa
Established in 1919, Fukutsukasa sake brewery blends delicious local spring water with the finest natural ingredients to create a wide variety of sakes.

Snowshoeing
Snowshoeing along the banks of Akan River brings you to a natural oasis that attracts many wild animals, a mystical place where the Ainu believed the spirits of fire and water coexist.

Ainu Culture
Ainu are the indigenous people of Hokkaido, who believe that spirits exist in nature. The culture and customs of the Ainu people remain strong in the Akan region.

Lake Kussharo
Lake Kussharo is the largest caldera lake in Japan and is home to a large number of wild swans that keep warm through the harsh winter near the natural hot springs.

Mt. Iou
Mt. Iou vents plumes of sulfurous steam through volcanic craters in the mountain side, creating a strong smell of sulfur in the surrounding area.

Kawayu Hot Spring
Hotels in Kawayu Onsen area draw their hot spring water from the same pure source, so abundant that even the river that flows through the town stems from natural volcanic springs.

Lake Mashu
The lake water is so pure it is said to be the second clearest water in the world, and the lake surface has a distinctively beautiful color known as Mashu blue.

title: The Beauty and Craft of Stone-Piled Thatched Roofs | Aerial Tour of Watanabe Residence, Important Cultural Property
description:
This video introduces the Watanabe Residence, a historic estate built by the Watanabe family during the Edo period, which features Japan's largest stone-piled thatched roof. Through aerial drone footage and views of the interior, storehouses, and gardens, we showcase the history and beauty spread across the vast 3000 tsubo grounds.

Highlights include:
- The largest stone-piled thatched roof in Japan
- Spaces where the craftsmanship of pillars, beams, earthen floors, irori (hearth), and shoin-zukuri (traditional Japanese architecture) come alive
- The Enshu-style garden designated as a national scenic spot
- The legacy of repairs passed down from the Edo period through the Meiji, Taisho, Showa, and Heisei eras.

description:
Located in the southern part of the Kii Peninsula, the Nanki Kumano Geopark. This land at the bottom of the sea, which boasts the world's northernmost large-scale coral reef, has been pushed up to the surface over a long period of time. A land etched with the memories of the ocean's depths and traces of large-scale volcanic activity. Such 'past' creates the 'present' life and the livelihoods of the people in Nanki Kumano, and is being conveyed to the 'future' through the initiative of the geopark.

title: The Road to Nanki Kumano: Tradition, Nature and the Land in Rural Japan
description: Nanki Kumano is a rural area in Japan, home to the renowned Kumano Kodo Pilgrimage Routes. Over the past ten centuries, people from commoners to the emperors, have made their ways from Kyoto to Kumano. And now, visitors can still trace the footprints of those pilgrims. People of this area have inherited the traditional rituals, festivals, cuisine, and livelihoods for a long period of time, together with the rugged surface of the Earth and its gifts, which accommodates the visitors from all over the world. Nanki Kumano Geopark is the crossroads of tradition, nature, and the land from the distant past to now.

title: 南紀熊野への道: 伝統、自然、そして日本の田舎の土地
description: 南紀熊野は、日本の田舎地域であり、著名な熊野古道の巡礼路の故郷です。過去十世紀にわたり、一般市民から天皇まで、多くの人々が京都から熊野へと向かいました。そして今、訪問者はその巡礼者たちの足跡をたどることができます。この地域の人々は、長い間、伝統的な儀式、祭り、料理、そして生業を受け継いできました。険しい地形とその恵みが、世界中からの訪問者を受け入れています。南紀熊野ジオパークは、過去から現在までの伝統、自然、そして土地の交差点です。

title: フロッタージュで絵本を作りました
description: 南紀熊野ジオパークでは地域の民話をもとにした絵本を作っています。この絵本の「橋杭岩の立岩伝説」では、大地の素晴らしさを伝えるために、実物の橋杭岩の上に紙を置いて、鉛筆で凸凹をこすり写すフロッタージュという技法を一部用いて描いています。絵本は和歌山県立図書館やジオパークエリア内の各市町村図書館及び南紀熊野ジオパークのホームページからご覧いただけます。ぜひ一度ご覧ください。

title: I Created a Picture Book with Frottage
description: In the Nanki Kumano Geopark, we are creating picture books based on local folklore. In this picture book, 'The Legend of the Standing Rock of Hashikuiiwa', we use a technique called frottage, where we place paper on the actual Hashikuiiwa and rub it with a pencil to convey the greatness of the earth. The picture book can be viewed at the Wakayama Prefectural Library, various municipal libraries within the geopark area, and on the Nanki Kumano Geopark website. Please take a look.

title: Enjoy a stroll in this historic downtown arcade
この歴史的なダウンタウンアーケードを散策しよう
description:
天神橋筋商店街（アーケード散策）

大阪天満宮を訪れることは、最長の天神橋筋商店街を歩くことを意味します。このアーケードは江戸時代に神社のために発展し、今でも古き良き時代のダウンタウンの雰囲気を保っています。全長2.6km、約600店舗があり、果物や野菜、着物、食器、中古本、判子など、生活に必要なものがすべて揃っています。自由に散策し、有名なスナック（まんじゅうやポテトコロッケなど）を買ったり、大阪の商人たちのユーモアを楽しんだりしてください。また、天満ガラス製品や満月ポンせんべいなど、大阪の独自の品を販売するニッチな店も見つかります。贈り物にも最適です。

title: Sense the individuality of living things
生き物の個性を感じる
description: この博物館で芸術作品のように美しい生き物を鑑賞してください。7つのテーマゾーンを通じて、生き物の神秘と驚きを発見しましょう。1階には、色彩豊かな魚が魅了する「Colors」、生き残るために知恵を使う生き物がいる「Abilities world」、ギャラリーのように多様な形の生き物を楽しめる「Shapes world」があります。2階には、驚くべき活発な生き物が揃う「Behavior」と、ホワイトタイガーや絶滅危惧種のミニヒポがいる「Waterside」があります。また、1階と2階にまたがる「WONDER MOMENTS」アートスペースも必見です。自然の驚きと美しさを表現した巨大な地球儀に魅了されることでしょう。さらに、「食べられる水」を販売するピクニックカフェや、人々が触れ合うときに写真が撮られるフォトサービスなど、ユニークな体験もあります。

title: Tour ancient cultural heritage by bike
description:
This electric cycle rental service allows you to pick up and drop off anywhere in Sakai, Fujiidera or Habikino. By returning the cycle to the same place you picked it up, you can enjoy a day of sight-seeing for 500 yen.
If you pick up your bike at the Daisen Park Tourist Information Center, we would recommend visiting Nintoku-tennō-ryō Kofun, one of the three biggest burial mounds in the world, and the symbol of Sakai. Get up close to the giant burial mound, a total length of 486m, and feel the solemn and holy atmosphere. A place of worship is located on the south facade, so feel free to use it. Close to the park is the Sakai City Museum, which houses a virtual reality experience of the inside of the mound, as well as an observation deck with views of the round end of the Emperor Richu burial mound.
A little further to the east you'll find the Furuichi Tombs in Fujiidera and Habikino, the main attraction being that of Emperor Ojin, the father of Emperor Nintoku, and to the west the streetcar and knife-making quarter.

title: 自転車で古代文化遺産を巡る
description:
MOZU-FURU レンタサイクル（遺産ツアー）

この電動自転車レンタルサービスでは、堺、藤井寺、羽曳野のどこでも自転車を借りて返却できます。同じ場所に自転車を返却することで、500円で観光を楽しむことができます。

大泉公園観光案内所で自転車を借りた場合は、世界三大古墳の一つであり、堺のシンボルである仁徳天皇陵古墳を訪れることをお勧めします。全長486mの巨大な古墳に近づき、荘厳で神聖な雰囲気を感じてください。南側のファサードには礼拝の場があるので、自由に利用できます。公園の近くには、古墳の内部を体験できるバーチャルリアリティ体験や、天皇リチュウの古墳の丸い端の眺望が楽しめる展望デッキを備えた堺市博物館があります。

さらに東に進むと、藤井寺と羽曳野に古市古墳群があり、主な見どころは仁徳天皇の父である応神天皇の古墳です。西には路面電車と刃物作りの地区があります。

title: Enjoy a day bursting with greenery in Okukawachi
奥河内で緑にあふれた一日を楽しむ
description:
奥河内黒丸村（自然散策）

この休憩所は、河内長野の魅力をすべて伝えています。この地域には、新鮮で地元で栽培された農産物のファーマーズマーケット、地元の食材を使ったビュッフェレストラン、収穫体験ができる畑があります。

また、奥河内エリアの豊かな自然を巡るサイクリングをレンタルすることもできます。近くには、森林サテライトの金根館や、河内長野の歴史を学びながら体験できる村の歴史館があります。大阪河内の木を使ったカトラリー作り体験（箸セット600円、スプーンとフォーク1,200円/人）や、家族繁栄を願うお守りや古代の小物を作る宝石作り体験（300円/人）を試すことができます。短い30〜40分のドライブで、河内長野の八景の一つである滝畑ダムに到着します。自然に囲まれた湖の壮大な景色と輝く美しさに感動してください。

title: 鳥取山中に眠る天空の要塞「若松鉱山」紹介Ｍｏｖｉｅ
description:
若松鉱山は、わずか30年前まで採掘が行われていた日本有数のクロム鉱山。産出されたクロムは耐火煉瓦の原料となり、この地域一帯で日本のクロム需要のほとんどを賄っていた時代もありました。
1995年の閉山となりましたが、今も採掘、選鉱、破砕が行われていた当時の様子がそのまま残る日本では数少ない鉱山跡で平成21年（2009年）に、経済産業省「近代化遺産群 続33」に選定されています。

title: The Sky Fortress 'Wakamatsu Mine' Sleeping in the Tottori Mountains Introduction Movie
description:
Wakamatsu Mine is one of Japan's leading chrome mines, where mining was conducted until just 30 years ago. The extracted chrome was used as a raw material for fireproof bricks, and there was a time when it supplied most of Japan's chrome demand in this region.
Although it closed in 1995, it remains one of the few mine sites in Japan where the conditions of mining, sorting, and crushing from that time are still preserved. In 2009, it was selected as part of the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry's 'Modernization Heritage Group Continued 33'.

description:
TOKAMACHI SNOW FESTIVAL Web Site／十日町雪まつりホームページ
http://snowfes.jp/wp/

In Tokamachi such a heavy snowfall area, we have “Tokamachi Snow Festival” that started by a enthusiasm of local residents “delight to play with snow as a friend” .

It is a big event in midwinter light up Tokamachi with variety of events and entertainments such as “festival field” located everywhere in the city, artistic snow sculptures made by citizen’s hands, “Snow carnival” unfolded various performances in sequence on the magnificent snow stage, and etc.

豪雪地帯である十日町において、あえて「雪を友とし、雪を楽しむ」という地元住民の想いから生まれた『十日町雪まつり』。
市内のあちこちに設置された「おまつりひろば」でのイベントやおもてなし、市民の手による芸術性の高い雪像、そしてすべて雪で作られたステージで繰り広げられる「雪上カーニバル」など、真冬の十日町を彩る一大イベントです。

title: TOKAMACHI SNOW FESTIVAL / Tokamachi Snow Festival Promotional Movie
description:
TOKAMACHI SNOW FESTIVAL Web Site / Tokamachi Snow Festival Homepage
http://snowfes.jp/wp/

In Tokamachi, a heavy snowfall area, we have the "Tokamachi Snow Festival" that started from the enthusiasm of local residents who have a "delight to play with snow as a friend".

It is a big event in midwinter that lights up Tokamachi with a variety of events and entertainments such as "festival fields" located everywhere in the city, artistic snow sculptures made by citizens' hands, and the "Snow Carnival" that unfolds various performances in sequence on the magnificent snow stage, and more.

In the heavy snowfall area of Tokamachi, the "Tokamachi Snow Festival" was born from the local residents' desire to "make snow a friend and enjoy it". It is a major event that colors midwinter Tokamachi with events and hospitality at the "festival fields" set up throughout the city, highly artistic snow sculptures created by citizens, and the "Snow Carnival" that unfolds on a stage made entirely of snow.

title: 第１回新潟ふるさとCM大賞　十日町市CM作品
description:
第１回新潟ふるさとCM大賞に応募した十日町市の作品「＃あちこたねーよ！」です。
太古の昔から脈々と受け継がれている十日町市の生活文化や里山の自然など、雪国の魅力を30秒にぎゅっと詰め込みました。

●新潟ふるさとCM大賞とは
新潟県内の各市町村が地元愛あふれるCMを制作し、地域の一体化醸成を図るとともに、県内外への発信を通じて地域の活性化に資することを目的に、UX新潟テレビ21・新潟県・新潟県市町村振興協会が主催で行う事業です。各市町村がエントリーしたCM作品は、令和２年11月19日(木)に審査会が行われました。
新潟ふるさとCM大賞開催概要はこちらから
http://www.uxtv.jp/furusato-cm/ （UX新潟テレビ21ホームページ）

title: 1st Niigata Furusato CM Award - Tokamachi City CM Works
description:
This is the work from Tokamachi City titled "#Achikotaneyo!" submitted for the 1st Niigata Furusato CM Award.
We have packed the charm of the snow country, including the living culture and the natural beauty of the satoyama that have been passed down since ancient times, into a 30-second video.

● What is the Niigata Furusato CM Award?
This project is organized by UX Niigata Television 21, Niigata Prefecture, and the Niigata Prefecture Municipal Promotion Association, aiming to promote regional revitalization through the production of local love-filled commercials by each municipality in Niigata Prefecture, fostering community integration, and disseminating information both within and outside the prefecture. The judging for the CM works submitted by each municipality took place on November 19, 2020.
For details on the Niigata Furusato CM Award, click here:
http://www.uxtv.jp/furusato-cm/ (UX Niigata Television 21 website)

title: 第２回新潟ふるさとCM大賞　十日町市応募作品【🏆 第３位受賞】
description: 第２回新潟ふるさとCM大賞に応募した十日町市の作品「ＩＴ（会いてぇ）キモチ、ツナグＳＮＳ」です。コロナ禍の都会の生活に疲れた孫と、孫に会える日を楽しみに待つ祖母とのストーリーで、タイトルには、田舎（Inaka）と都会（Tokai）で離れている２人の会いたい（会いてぇ）気持ちは、スマホ(IT)、そしてSNSを通じて繋がっているという思いを込めました。令和３年11月２日（火）に行われた審査会では、全30市町村の作品の中で、第３位を受賞しました。ぜひご覧ください。

title: 2nd Niigata Furusato CM Award - Tokamachi City Entry [🏆 3rd Place Award]
description: This is the entry from Tokamachi City for the 2nd Niigata Furusato CM Award, titled 'IT (Aite) Feelings, Connecting SNS'. It tells the story of a grandchild tired of urban life during the COVID-19 pandemic and a grandmother eagerly waiting for the day she can meet her grandchild. The title conveys the feelings of longing to meet (Aite) between the two, who are separated by the countryside (Inaka) and the city (Tokai), and how they are connected through smartphones (IT) and SNS. The judging session held on November 2, 2021, awarded it 3rd place among the works from all 30 municipalities. Please take a look.

新潟県十日町市・津南町からなる越後妻有地域。2000年からこの地で始まった「大地の芸術祭」。
その祭りの舞台となるのは、その地域で生活を営む人々の暮らしと、四季を通じて豊かな大自然が織りなす様々な表情の大地。

この映像作品は、地域をキャンバスと捉え、そこで暮らす人々や自然・文化の魅力を再認識し、大地の芸術祭で訪れたアーティストが作品のインスピレーションとなる地域の魅力へ迫る、地域の暮らしが主役のドキュメンタリーです。

クリエーティブディレクター：引地央行
企画・プロデュース：酒井隆光

【大地の芸術祭の里】
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/

【新潟県十日町市】
https://www.tokamachishikankou.jp/

▼大地の芸術祭
新潟県越後妻有地域を舞台に、地域に内在するさまざな価値を、アートを媒介として掘り起こし、その魅力を高めて世界に発信し、地域再生の道筋を築くことを目指す世界最大級の国際芸術祭。越後妻有は、縄文期からの豪雪という厳しい条件のなかで、米づくりをしてきた土地です。人々は、切り離すことができない人間と自然の関わり方を探りながら、濃密な集落を営んできました。そこから「人間は自然に内包される」という基本理念が生まれ、すべてのプログラムに貫かれています。人間と自然がどう関わっていくか――。その可能性を示すモデルになろうと、越後妻有の地域づくりは進められています。

▼蓮池もも「山の奥 海の底」※公開終了
作家は、大地の芸術祭での作品制作サポート活動の縁もあり、2016年に家族で越後妻有に移住してきた。今回の作品は、当地での日々の様子を、子どもの成長や地域の歳時を軸に、10mの絵巻に物語るように描いたもの。展示会場の「やぶこざきキャンプ場」の建屋は、山々の眺望がすばらしい場所で、絵巻が風景へと連なっていくような印象が楽しめる。
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/art/artwork/depth_of_mountain_bottom_of_ocean/

https://www.tokamachishikankou.jp/
十日町市にはアート、自然、グルメなどの見どころが満載です。
アート作品と出会ってじっくり思考を巡らせたり、大自然が織りなす造形美に心を癒されたり…ここでしか味わえないグルメや温泉もあります。
たくさんのスポットの中から、おすすめのコースを巡ったり、行きたい場所だけをぎゅっと集めて自分だけの旅をつくることもできます。
十日町市で「私だけの旅」を楽しもう。

Negaiiri Settlement, Tokamachi City, Niigata Prefecture, Matsuno Komiyama
Narration: Hikari Yamaguchi (Resident of Tokamachi City / Tokamachi City Yoshida Junior High School)

The Echigo-Tsumari region, consisting of Tokamachi City and Tsunan Town in Niigata Prefecture. The "Art Festival of the Earth" began in this area in 2000.
The stage for this festival is the lives of the people who live in the region and the various expressions of the rich nature that unfolds throughout the seasons.

This video work captures the region as a canvas, re-recognizing the charm of the people, nature, and culture that live there, and approaches the allure of the region that inspires the artists who visit during the Art Festival of the Earth, making the local life the main focus of the documentary.

Director: Yasuhito Bunbe
Creative Director: Hiroyuki Hikichi
Planning and Production: Takamitsu Sakai

【Art Festival of the Earth】
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/

【Tokamachi City, Niigata Prefecture】
https://www.tokamachishikankou.jp/

▼ Art Festival of the Earth
Aiming to excavate various inherent values of the region through art as a medium, enhance its charm, and communicate it to the world, this is one of the largest international art festivals in the world. Echigo-Tsumari is a land that has cultivated rice under harsh conditions of heavy snowfall since the Jomon period. People have built dense communities while exploring the inseparable relationship between humans and nature. From this, the fundamental philosophy that "humans are encompassed by nature" was born, which permeates all programs. How humans and nature interact—Echigo-Tsumari's community development is progressing to become a model that shows this possibility.

▼ Tomoko Fuse "Ubusuna no Shiro" *Closed to the public
Expressing respect for the spirit residing in "Ubusuna no Ie" by folding white paper. In the "Wind Tea Room" and "Dark Tea Room," a central exhibition features white paper works using "infinite folding," where one piece splits into two, and then splits again, endlessly dividing. In the "Wind Tea Room," works resembling spiral droplets are also suspended. In the "Light Tea Room," origami "containers (boxes)" using colors are arranged to express human activities.
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/art/artwork/ubusuna-house/

▼ Ubusuna no Ie
A 100-year-old thatched-roof farmhouse has been transformed into a museum of ceramics, with potters setting up an irori (hearth), stove, bath, and washroom. The first floor serves as a restaurant where lively women serve compassionate dishes made with local ingredients. The second floor features new works displayed in three tea rooms.
https://www.echigo-tsumari.jp/art/artwork/ubusuna_house/

You can encounter art works and ponder deeply, or be healed by the sculptural beauty created by nature... There are also gourmet foods and hot springs that can only be experienced here.
You can explore recommended courses from many spots or create your own unique trip by gathering only the places you want to visit.

title: 羽州街道を往く～歩いて発見！秋田市・歴史文化遺産～
description: 現在の福島県の桑折から、宮城県を経て山形県、秋田県を北上し、青森県の油川に至る羽州街道は、江戸時代、多くの人やものが行き交う大動脈でした。秋田市の羽州街道の沿線には、文化財に指定されている古い建物や文化施設などが点在しており、今もその名残を感じとることができます。また、秋田藩士・荻津勝孝の筆と伝えられる「秋田街道絵巻」には、往時の街道の風景や人々の様子が活き活きと描かれています。このたび、秋田市では、そうした魅力を歴史ストーリーで結び、“秋田市ならでは”の街道歩きをお楽しみいただけるように、ＰＲ映像を制作しました。様々な角度から、羽州街道の魅力をたっぷりとご紹介いたします。

title: Traveling the Ushu Highway - Discovering Akita City’s Historical and Cultural Heritage on Foot
description: The Ushu Highway, which runs from present-day Koori in Fukushima Prefecture, through Miyagi Prefecture, Yamagata Prefecture, and Akita Prefecture, and reaches Aburakawa in Aomori Prefecture, was a major artery during the Edo period, bustling with people and goods. Along the Ushu Highway in Akita City, there are many old buildings and cultural facilities designated as cultural properties, where you can still feel the remnants of the past. Additionally, the 'Akita Kaido Emaki,' attributed to Akita samurai Katsutaka Ogitsu, vividly depicts the scenery and people of the highway in those times. This time, Akita City has produced a PR video to connect these attractions with historical stories, allowing you to enjoy a unique walking experience along the highway. We will introduce the charm of the Ushu Highway from various angles.

title: [Kyoto Kamigamo Shrine] Kasakake Shinto Ritual - Third Sunday of October
description:
One of the oldest shrines in Kyoto, Kamigamo Shrine
The entire precinct is registered as a World Heritage site, preserving its appearance unchanged since the Heian period.

Kasakake Shinto Ritual - Third Sunday of October
Kasakake is one of the mounted archery events mentioned in the Nihon Shoki.
It requires a higher level of skill than yabusame, as archers must shoot at not only horizontal targets but also targets set low to the ground on the right and left sides, making it a more practical form of equestrian archery.
At this shrine, records show that Emperor Go-Toba performed Kasakake during the Kamakura period, and since 2005, it has been held annually with the service of the Dai Nippon Kyuba Kai Takeda School.

title: [Kyoto Kamigamo Shrine] Kagura and Bugaku
description:
One of the oldest shrines in Kyoto, Kamigamo Shrine
The entire precinct is registered as a World Heritage site, preserving the appearance unchanged since the Heian period.

[Kagura and Bugaku]
In Japan, since ancient times, rituals have been performed in front of the deities, playing music, singing songs, and dancing to soothe the hearts of the gods.

"Kagura" refers to the traditional Japanese performing arts dedicated to the deities, originating from the dance performed by Ame-no-Uzume-no-Mikoto in the myth of the opening of the Heavenly Rock Cave, praying for the appearance of Amaterasu Omikami. The miko kagura in the video is "Urayasu no Mai."

"Bugaku" is believed to have originated from dance music brought from the Asian continent and the Korean Peninsula, developing uniquely in Japan and becoming one of the gagaku forms that flourished around the Heian period. The bugaku in the video is "Genjōraku."

At Kamigamo Shrine, kagura and bugaku are performed in front of the deities during various ceremonies and prayers, starting with the New Year’s celebration on January 5.

description:

title: 日本国際映像祭2025オフィシャルコレクション作品【時を旅する北山川筏下り】
description:
★日本国際映像祭2025オフィシャルコレクション作品

「時を旅する」筏。
かつて林業として栄えた筏（いかだ）流しの文化は、時代とともにカタチを少し変えて現在も同じ北山川の風景の中を筏師の櫂さばきひとつで下っていく。
夏のあいだ丸太筏に乗って急流を下る体験アクティビティとしての筏下りに、この小さな村に世界中から珍しい体験を求める旅行者が訪れる。
　筏師は昔ながらのエンジンも使わない筏で川筋を読み櫂を漕ぎ、また自然の地形を利用して筏を前へと進ませる。
北山川の夏の風物詩となった観光筏下りは、林業から観光へと産業転換をし現在も昔と変わらぬ風景をみせてくれ、まるでタイムマシーンに乗ったかのう様なかつての日本の現風景を見せてくれる。

title: Official Collection Work of the Japan International Film Festival 2025: Traveling Through Time on the Kitayama River Raft
description: Official Collection Work of the Japan International Film Festival 2025: A raft that travels through time. The culture of rafting, which once thrived as a forestry industry, has slightly changed its form over time and continues to flow through the same scenery of the Kitayama River, guided by the skillful strokes of the raft master. During the summer, tourists from around the world visit this small village seeking the unique experience of rafting down the rapids on a log raft. The raft master uses no engines, reading the river's flow and paddling, while also utilizing the natural terrain to propel the raft forward. The tourist rafting on the Kitayama River, which has become a summer tradition, has transformed from forestry to tourism, showcasing a landscape that remains unchanged from the past, almost like a time machine revealing the current scenery of Japan as it once was.

title: 北山川観光筏下り
description: 日本で唯一、丸太を組んだ筏で川下りが楽しめるのは、和歌山県北山村だけ！🌊🍃 主に付加体の地層からなる大地の急激な隆起と北山川の下方浸食により、標高差600mに及ぶV字状の大峡谷が形成されました。この地域の付加体は、ジオパーク地域内で最も古い竜神付加体で、7000万年前に堆積した地層です。この壮大な景色を、北山川観光筏下りで直接体験することができます！ 筏師が手作りした全長約30mの筏に乗り、600年も続いた筏師の技術を引き継ぐ伝統的な川下りが楽しめます！ 特に入り組んだ岩肌と激しい流れが織り成す壮大な景色を堪能しながら、筏師の熟練の技術による水上アクティビティを体験できます！ 全国でここだけの体験をしてみませんか‼️ 実施期間: 5月土・日・祝日　6月土・日 7・8・9月は木曜を除く毎日（木曜が祝日の場合は運航） 所要時間 2時間（筏乗船時間約1時間10分） 対象年齢 満10～満75才までの健康・健脚な方

title: Kitayama River Sightseeing Rafting
description: The only place in Japan where you can enjoy rafting on a raft made of logs is Kitayama Village in Wakayama Prefecture! 🌊🍃 The rapid uplift of the land mainly composed of accretionary complex strata and the downward erosion of the Kitayama River have formed a V-shaped gorge with an elevation difference of 600m. The accretionary complex in this area is the oldest Ryujin accretionary complex within the geopark, with strata deposited 70 million years ago. You can directly experience this magnificent scenery through Kitayama River sightseeing rafting! You can enjoy traditional rafting that inherits the techniques of raft masters that have continued for 600 years on a handmade raft about 30m long! While enjoying the magnificent scenery created by the intricate rock faces and fierce currents, you can experience water activities through the skilled techniques of the raft masters! Why not try this unique experience available only here nationwide‼️ Implementation period: Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays in May, Saturdays and Sundays in June, and every day except Thursdays in July, August, and September (operating on Thursdays if it is a holiday). Duration: 2 hours (about 1 hour and 10 minutes of rafting time). Target age: Healthy and fit individuals aged 10 to 75.

description: 伊勢湾最大の離島である答志島。島内には３軒の温泉宿があり、九鬼水軍を率いた九鬼嘉隆の首塚や胴塚、太平洋の絶景を楽しめる希望の丘などの散策スポットが多く点在。２～4月頃にはこの島の風物詩となっている和具浦漁港での塩ワカメ作りの風景が楽しめます。また、答志島と菅島で水揚げされる一本釣りの鰆（さわら）のうち、秋と冬に獲れた脂肪分の高いものが「答志島トロさわら」とブランド化されています。

title: Toba Onsen District - Doshi Island Area
description: Doshi Island, the largest remote island in Ise Bay, has three hot spring inns. There are many sightseeing spots, including the tomb of Kuki Yoshitaka, who led the Kuki navy, and Kibo Hill, where you can enjoy the spectacular view of the Pacific Ocean. From February to April, you can enjoy the scenery of salt wakame making at Waguura Fishing Port, which has become a local tradition. Additionally, the high-fat 'Doshi Island Toro Sawara' is branded from the saury caught by pole-and-line fishing in Doshi Island and Sugashima during autumn and winter.

title: 鳥羽温泉郷　相差エリア
description: 三重県の伊勢志摩国立公園に位置する鳥羽市。このうち太平洋に面した相差（おうさつ）エリアは、南鳥羽では最も人口が集まった海女と漁師の港町で、１７の温泉宿があります。ここでは、現役海女さんの話を聞きながら、新鮮な魚貝類が食べられる海女小屋体験や、「女性の願い事なら必ず一つは叶えてくれる」という神明神社の参道にある石神さんなどの人気スポットが楽しめます。

title: Toba Onsen District, Osatsu Area
description: Located in the Ise-Shima National Park in Mie Prefecture, Toba City. The Osatsu area, facing the Pacific Ocean, is a port town with the largest population of ama (female divers) and fishermen in southern Toba, featuring 17 hot spring inns. Here, you can enjoy experiences such as listening to stories from active ama divers and tasting fresh seafood at ama huts, as well as popular spots like Ishigami-san on the approach to Shinmei Shrine, which is said to grant at least one wish for women.

こんにちは！宮崎県えびの市観光商工課ＰＲ担当のみなほです。
皆さんえびの市を知っていますか？
ポテンシャルは高いのに中々知名度が上がらないこの町。
観光地や綺麗な景色、特産品もあるのに知ってもらえないこの町。
そんなポテンシャル満載の魅力たっぷりなこの町をもっと色んな人に知ってもらいたい、従来の情報発信だけでは伝わらないこのご時世。
そこで、みなほ、動画配信始めます。

新型コロナウイルス感染症によりアウトドア人気が高まった時、えびの高原にある「えびの高原キャンプ村」が大盛り上がりしたのは地元の人しか知らない…。

今回の動画で紹介するえびの高原はキャンプやトレッキングするには最適の場所。
えびの高原の四季折々の景色に囲まれて体験するアウトドアアクティビティは非日常感にあふれていて、仕事や私生活のストレスを発散するには最高のデトックス効果抜群の場所です！

この動画を見て少しでも魅力を感じたそこのあなた！

えびの市は皆さんを迎える準備はいつでも出来ていますよ！

是非、えびの市へおじゃったもんせ（お越しください）~！

description: 岐阜の小京都と言われる飛騨高山の隠れた名店3傑をご紹介致します。まずは「TEPPAN たなか」 目の前で焼き上げるＡ５等級のみの飛騨牛ステーキは、五感を通して味わえる最高のご馳走です。次にご紹介するのは緑に囲まれ静かで自然豊かな隠れ家、「オーベルジュ飛騨の森」季節の厳選食材をふんだんに使用したシェフ自慢のイタリアンと自然派ワインをご堪能ください。最後に「ゲストハウス&カフェSOY」築100年を超える古民家を再生し創られたゲストハウスです。日本古来の醤油・味噌・納豆・豆腐・・・全てのもとは「大豆」からとのコンセプトの基、地元の素材を活かした発酵食品をベースにした料理は素朴な味わいが特徴です。飛騨高山に行ったらこ３店舗に足をお運びください！

title: 熊野神社 伊邪那美(イザナミ)の道 - KUMANO Shrine The road of IZANAMI
description:
広島県庄原市、熊野神社。旧比婆大社。創建年は不詳。比婆山山麓に位置するこの場所は日本最古とされる歴史書『古事記』の伝承を現代に伝える場所です。
神々の母伊邪那美命(イザナミノミコト)は、立烏帽子山に伊邪那岐(イザナギノミコト)が訪ねてきた際、夜になったので自分の櫛に火をつけて灯りとして、この山道を歩き、天から火の雨が降り注いだ際に途中の岩穴に身を隠し難を逃れたという逸話が残されています。
また、後に火の神を産んだ伊邪那美は、この道の岩穴で亡くなり、黄泉の国に旅立ったとも伝えられています。

Kumano Shrine, Shobara City, Hiroshima Prefecture.  Former Hiba Ohyashiro Shrine.  The year of foundation is unknown.  Located at the foot of Mt. Hiba, this place is a place to convey the tradition of Japan's history book said that oldest history book "Kojiki" to the present day.
 The mother of the gods, Izanami Nomikoto When Izanagi Nomikoto visited her, Mt. Tateeboshi, It's night, so she lit her comb and used it as a light. There is an anecdote that she hid herself in a rock hole on the way and escaped the difficulty when it rained on fire from the sky.
 It is also reported that Izanami, who later gave birth to the god of fire, died in a rock hole on this road, and she left for heaven.

title: 山陰海岸 - Sanin(mountain’s yin) Coast
description:
日本の中国地方では古くから中国山地の北を山陰、南を山陽と呼んできました。

地名をつけるとき、山の北と南を陰と陽、川の北と南を陽と陰で表現することは古代中国の考えに基づいています。

これは、南天に太陽が昇る北半球では、山の北が影になり、南が太陽に当たるからです。

 川の場合、洛陽（洛水と呼ばれる川の北の地域）と淮陰（淮水と呼ばれる川の南）のように川の北と南で陰陽と表現する土地が中国にあります。

川の場合では、南から指した光が川面に跳ね返り、川の北を照らし、南の物体が川面に影を落とすことから、そう呼ばれるようになりました。

中国山地を挟んで北側の山陰地方の海岸は日本海に面しています。
大陸から吹く風により発生する日本海の荒波により形成された山陰の海岸の風光明媚な景観をお楽しみ下さい。

In the Chugoku region of Japan, the north of the Chugoku Mountains has been called Sanin(mountain’s yin) and the south has been called Sanyo(mountain’s yang) for a long time.

When naming a place, it is based on the idea of ​​ancient China that the north and south of the mountain are represented by yin and yang, and the north and south of the river are represented by yang and yin.

This is because in the northern hemisphere, where the sun rises in the southern sky, the north of the mountain is in the shadow and the south is in the sun.

In the case of rivers, there are lands in China that are described as Yinyang in the north and south of the river, such as Rakuyo (the area north of the river called Luoyang) and Huaiyin (south of the river called Huai’an).

In the case of rivers, the light from the south bounces off the surface of the river, illuminating the north of the river, and objects in the south cast shadows on the surface of the river.

The coast of the San'in(mountain’s yin) region on the north side of the Chugoku Mountains faces the Sea of ​​Japan.
 Enjoy the scenic landscape of the San'in coast formed by the rough waves of the Sea of ​​Japan generated by the wind blowing from the continent.

description:
The enshrined deity is Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto.
A long time ago, Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto thought,
'Izumo Province is like a long strip of cloth; at first,
I made the country too small. So let's make it and make it
bigger.'
After completing the land dragging four times at Kiduki's cape,
Sada's country, Kurami's country, and Miho's cape,
Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto was enshrined in Nagahama
as the god of land dragging, the general guardian of Izumo Province,
who had completed the creation of the land.
Due to the story of the Kunibiki myth, Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto
is widely worshiped as a great god who attracted the country,
attracted people, and attracted happiness,
and a god who attracted victory.

かつて、奇稲田姫命は八岐大蛇(ヤマタノオロチ)の生贄になっていたところを素戔嗚尊によって助け出さ
れ、後に素戔嗚尊の妻となりました。大国主命は、お二人の御子孫にあたられ、国造の神様として出雲大社
の主祭神でもあられます。

ヤマタノオロチ退治の舞台となった出雲国の簸川(ひかわ)が由来とされ、951年に東国遊行中だった蓮
林僧正が現在の赤坂4丁目で一夜を過ごした際に夢中でお告げを受け、この地にお祀りしたしことに始まり
ます。

その後、江戸幕府第八代将軍、徳川吉宗によって建立された御社殿はかつての震災、戦災を免れ、鳥居、
狛犬、灯籠に建立当時の面影を現在に伝えます。

description: Isakijiは滋賀県の近江八幡市の琵琶湖の湖畔に聳え立つ天台宗の修験の三大聖地とされる寺院です。比叡山延暦寺の支院でもあるこの寺院では、毎年8月に伊崎の棹飛と呼ばれる行事が行われています。行者が琵琶湖の絶壁から突き出した長さ13mに及ぶ棹から7m下の水面に飛び込む千年以上の歴史ある伝統行事です。初秋の近江八幡に琵琶湖の美しい景観と伊崎寺の荘厳な世界がありました。

title: Isakiji, a temple standing at the tip of Lake Biwa
description: Isakiji is a temple that stands on the shores of Lake Biwa in Omihachiman City, Shiga Prefecture, and is considered to be one of the three major sanctuaries of the Tendai sect. At this temple, which is also a branch of Hieizan Enryakuji Temple, an event called Saotobi of Isaki is held every August. It is a traditional event with a history of more than 1000 years, in which the performer jumps into the water surface 7 m below the 13 m long rod protruding from the cliff of Lake Biwa. In early autumn, Omihachiman had a beautiful landscape of Lake Biwa and the majestic world of Isakiji Temple.

title: [Yamagata - Tohoku / Japan travel] The Kaneyama path, one hundred years of light
description:
The Kaneyama path, one hundred years of light
Kaneyama Town 100th Anniversary Commemorative Video

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

Kaneyama Town, Yamagata Prefecture, marked the 100th anniversary of its town administration on January 1, 2025.

Over these hundred years, some things were born and some were lost; some remain unchanged, while others continue to shift with each passing moment.

What kind of hundred years have the mountains, the forests, and the clear, flowing rivers witnessed?
Have the mythical creatures of this land watched over this century?
Standing where people reflect on Kaneyama’s hundred years, what winds do they feel, and what skies do they see?

In the autumn of 2024, we held the “Centennial Festival” to celebrate Kaneyama’s hundred years.

Leading up to that day, we traced Kaneyama’s four seasons and its changing townscape, explored the work and history of forestry and other local industries, and encountered the lives and words of the people connected to this town.

Join us as we look back with gratitude and forward with hope—carrying the light of a hundred years into the years to come.

title: The Road of Kaneyama, A Century of Light. 【Yamagata - Tohoku / Japan travel】
description:
Kaneyama Town, Yamagata Prefecture - Commemorative video for the 100th anniversary of town establishment

"The Road of Kaneyama, A Century of Light."

January 1, 2025
Kaneyama Town reaches its 100th anniversary

What has been born in these 100 years, what has been lost,
What remains unchanged, and what has changed moment by moment.

What kind of 100 years have the mountains, the trees, and the rivers with clear flowing water witnessed?

Do the mythical creatures passed down in the land
see this 100 years?

What kind of wind blows where people who think of Kaneyama's 100 years stand,
and what kind of sky can be seen?

In the autumn of 2024,
we will hold the "Centennial Festival" to celebrate Kaneyama's 100 years.

As we approach that day,
we will touch upon the four seasons of Kaneyama,
and the changes in the townscape,

the work and history of forestry,

and the lives and words of the people connected to the town.

【岡山後楽園】
岡山藩2代目藩主・池田綱政（つなまさ）が自ら憩いの場として築いた大庭園。季節の花が彩る広々とした園内は江戸時代さながらの別世界。1952年には歴史的文化遺産として“特別名勝”に指定され、ミシュラン・グリーンガイド・ジャポンでは三つ星の評価を得ています。

慶長2年（1597）、豊臣家五大老の一人・宇喜多秀家が築城した岡山城天守閣。三層六階の堂々たる天守閣は織田信長の安土城天主閣を模して築かれたと伝えられ、全国的にも珍しい不等辺五角形の天守台をしています。黒い下見板張りの外観から別名「烏城（うじょう）」と呼ばれています。

title: A Beautiful Moment in Okayama: Okayama Korakuen & Okayama Castle
description:
※This video was produced in 2021 and is published on YouTube as an archive.

【Okayama Korakuen】
Okayama Korakuen is a large garden built by the second lord of the Okayama domain, Ikeda Tsunamasa, as a place for his own relaxation. The spacious garden, adorned with seasonal flowers, is like a different world reminiscent of the Edo period. In 1952, it was designated as a 'Special Scenic Spot' as a historical cultural heritage, and it has received a three-star rating in the Michelin Green Guide Japan.
https://okayama-korakuen.jp/

【Okayama Castle】
Okayama Castle's main keep was built in 1597 by Ukita Hideie, one of the five elders of the Toyotomi clan. The magnificent three-story, six-floor main keep is said to have been modeled after Oda Nobunaga's Azuchi Castle, and it features a rare irregular pentagonal base. Its black wooden exterior has earned it the nickname 'Ujo' (Crow Castle).
https://kin-ujo.jp/

【Fantasy Garden & Ujo Peach Blossom Land】
Every year, during the limited periods of spring, summer, and autumn, Okayama Korakuen and Okayama Castle are beautifully illuminated with lights, and they open specially at night as 'Fantasy Garden' and 'Ujo Lantern Land'.

title: ココロに響く、岡山アートトリップ【full ver.】
description:
岡山県北・奈義町は、今注目のアートエリア。体感型現代美術館の先駈け「NagiMOCA」
はもちろん、秀峰・那岐山をはじめ、自然が生み出す景観そのものがアート。大自然の中で心を解放して向き合えば、五感を刺激する出会いがそこに。さぁ、次の旅は岡山へ。

【“映える美術館”が全国区で話題！ 奈義町アートトリップ】
来館者がSNSに投稿した写真が“映える！”と話題になり、全国区で注目を集めている「奈義町現代美術館（Nagi MOCA）」。まちのシンボルでもあるこの美術館を旅の目的地にして訪れる人が、今増えています。今回は、せっかく奈義町に行くならぜひとも立ち寄りたい、カフェ併設のギャラリーや企画展も行われる観光案内所など、アート要素を持ったスポットも一緒にご紹介。さぁ、アートな旅を楽しみに奈義町へトリップ！
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/okatabi/812/page


【奈義町現代美術館（NagiMOCA）】 
プリツカー賞受賞の建築家・磯崎新氏が手掛けた美術館。秀峰・那岐山を借景に、3組のアーティストの巨大作品＝空間を美術館として建築化しています。「太陽」、「月」、「大地」と名付けられた３つの展示室で構成されており、作品と建物が半永久的に一体化した公共建物としては世界初のもの。円筒形の展示室「太陽」内部は、写真映えするスポットしても人気です。
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11826

【PIZZERIA La gita】 
「奈義町現代美術館」と那岐山を望むピッツェリア。本場ナポリから取り寄せた石窯で焼き上げる、本格的なピッツァが堪能できます。 
https://pizza-lagita.com/

【cafe calme】
奈義町にあるレンタルギャラリー「gallery FIXA」に併設したカフェ。シンプルな空間で、コーヒーや焼き菓子など楽しめます。テイクアウトも可能。
https://www.gallery-fixa.com/

【屋敷の滝】
周囲を原生林に囲まれた、高さ40ｍの滝。戦国武将・延原弾正の屋敷跡があったというところから「屋敷の滝」と呼ばれています。
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11812

【菩提寺の大イチョウ】
浄土宗の開祖・法然上人が幼年時代に修行した寺として知られる「菩提寺」の境内にそびえる、推定樹齢900年を超えるイチョウの樹です。樹高約45ｍ、目通り周囲約12ｍの木は県下一の大樹で、国の天然記念物に指定されています。
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11832

title: A Heartfelt Art Trip in Okayama【full ver.】
description:
Nagi Town in northern Okayama Prefecture is an emerging art area. The pioneering experiential contemporary art museum "NagiMOCA" is just the beginning; the stunning views created by nature, including the majestic Mt. Nagi, are art in themselves. When you open your heart to the great outdoors, encounters that stimulate your five senses await. So, let’s make Okayama your next travel destination.

【“Instagrammable Museum” Gaining National Attention! Nagi Town Art Trip】
Photos posted by visitors on social media have become a hot topic for being "Instagrammable!" and have drawn national attention to the "Nagi Town Contemporary Art Museum (Nagi MOCA)." More and more people are choosing this museum, a symbol of the town, as their travel destination. This time, we will also introduce art-related spots such as a gallery with a café and a tourist information center that hosts special exhibitions, which you should definitely visit while in Nagi Town. Get ready for an art-filled trip to Nagi Town!
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/okatabi/812/page

【Nagi Town Contemporary Art Museum (NagiMOCA)】
Designed by Pritzker Prize-winning architect Arata Isozaki, this museum features the majestic Mt. Nagi as a backdrop and incorporates the large works of three artists into its architecture. It consists of three exhibition rooms named "Sun," "Moon," and "Earth," and is the world's first public building where the artworks and the structure are permanently integrated. The cylindrical exhibition room "Sun" is also popular as a photo spot.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11826

【PIZZERIA La gita】
A pizzeria overlooking the Nagi Mountain and the "Nagi Town Contemporary Art Museum." Enjoy authentic pizza baked in a stone oven imported from Naples.
https://pizza-lagita.com/

【cafe calme】
A café attached to the rental gallery "gallery FIXA" in Nagi Town. Enjoy coffee and baked goods in a simple space. Takeout is also available.
https://www.gallery-fixa.com/

【Yashiki no Taki (Yashiki Waterfall)】
A 40-meter tall waterfall surrounded by virgin forest. It is called "Yashiki no Taki" because it is said to be the site of the residence of the Sengoku warlord, Nobuhara Danjo.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11812

【Great Ginkgo Tree at Bodai-ji Temple】
This ginkgo tree, estimated to be over 900 years old, towers over the grounds of "Bodai-ji Temple," known as the place where the founder of the Jodo sect, Honen, trained in his youth. The tree stands about 45 meters tall with a circumference of about 12 meters, making it the largest tree in the prefecture and designated as a national natural monument.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11832

title: 岡山で日本刀の聖地を訪ね、匠の技に触れる旅【short ver.】
description:
鎌倉時代より日本刀の産地として栄えた、岡山県瀬戸内市長船町。この町にある、全国でも珍しい刀剣の博物館を訪ねます。勇壮かつ繊細な職方の技、刀剣ゆかりの寺院や地元の味。知れば知るほど奥深い、備前長船をめぐる一日。さぁ、次の旅は岡山へ。


【山鳥毛ラッピングタクシー】 
上杉謙信が所持した来歴等から、備前刀の最高峰のひとつにも数えられる国宝「山鳥毛」の特徴的な刃紋と和柄をあしらったデザインで、ドライバーは刀鍛冶をイメージした作務衣姿で乗務します。JR長船駅から「備前おさふね刀剣の里」までの往復料金と博物館の入館料がセット。1週間前までに予約が必要です。
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/news/591

【備前おさふね刀剣の里　備前長船刀剣博物館】 
鎌倉時代より日本刀の産地として栄えた瀬戸内市長船町にある、全国でも珍しい備前刀を中心に展示している博物館です。敷地内には鍛刀場があり、日本刀の古式鍛錬、刀装製作、刀身への彫刻、研ぎなどの、さまざまな日本刀に関する製作工程を実際に見学する事ができます。 
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11175

【ふれあい物産館】
「備前おさふね刀剣の里　備前長船刀剣博物館」に併設。刀剣類や備前小刀、刃物類を中心に、備前焼、工芸品など刀剣の里ゆかりの伝統美術作品を展示販売しています。お茶処では、地元の食材を使ったうどんやそばをはじめ、お守り刀の塩ソフトパフェやキンツバなどのスイーツも味わえます。
http://www.ikoi-okayama.com/token.html
 
【慈眼院】
備前長船刀匠の霊を供養する備前・刀工菩提寺です。江戸時代以降、水害の難を逃れて長船鍛冶の伝統を守り続けた刀匠・横山祐定の墓や、その後の刀工・横山元之進祐定が寄進した梵鐘（市指定文化財）が置かれています。
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11147

【備前福岡 一文字うどん】
備前福岡の刀工「福岡一文字」が名前の由来となっているセルフうどん屋。地元岡山産の小麦を丁寧に石臼で自家製粉した、風味豊かなうどんが味わえます。また、鎌倉時代からこの地に伝わり、備前ばら寿司の元祖と言われている地元の郷土料理、「どどめせ」も食べることができます。
http://ichimonji.ne.jp/

title: A Journey to the Sacred Place of Japanese Swords in Okayama, Experiencing the Artisan's Craft【short ver.】
description:
Nagaoka Town in Setouchi City, Okayama Prefecture, has flourished as a production area for Japanese swords since the Kamakura period. We will visit a rare sword museum located in this town. Experience the majestic yet delicate skills of the craftsmen, temples related to swords, and local flavors. The deeper you know, the more profound the day exploring Bizen Nagafune becomes. Now, let’s head to Okayama for the next trip.

【Yamatorige Wrapping Taxi】
Designed with the distinctive blade pattern and traditional Japanese patterns of the national treasure "Yamatorige," which is considered one of the highest peaks of Bizen swords due to its history of ownership by Uesugi Kenshin. The driver will be dressed in a samue, reminiscent of a swordsmith. The round-trip fare from JR Nagafune Station to "Bizen Osafune Sword Village" includes the museum entrance fee. Reservations are required one week in advance.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/news/591

【Bizen Osafune Sword Village - Bizen Nagafune Sword Museum】
This museum, located in Nagaoka Town, Setouchi City, which has flourished as a production area for Japanese swords since the Kamakura period, focuses on the rare Bizen swords. The premises include a swordsmithing workshop where you can actually observe various production processes related to Japanese swords, such as traditional forging, sword fittings production, engraving on blades, and polishing.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11175

【Fureai Bussan-kan】
Adjacent to the "Bizen Osafune Sword Village - Bizen Nagafune Sword Museum." It exhibits and sells traditional art pieces related to the sword village, focusing on swords, Bizen knives, and cutting tools, as well as Bizen pottery and crafts. In the tea room, you can enjoy local dishes such as udon and soba made with local ingredients, as well as sweets like salt soft serve parfaits and Kintsuba, which are amulets in the shape of swords.
http://www.ikoi-okayama.com/token.html

【Jigen-in】
A temple dedicated to the spirits of Bizen Nagafune swordsmiths. Since the Edo period, it has preserved the tradition of Nagafune smiths, avoiding the difficulties of flooding. It houses the grave of the swordsmith Yokoyama Yasutaka, who continued the tradition, and a bronze bell donated by the later swordsmith Yokoyama Motonoshin Yasutaka, which is designated as a cultural property by the city.
https://www.okayama-kanko.jp/spot/11147

【Bizen Fukuoka Ichimonji Udon】
A self-service udon shop named after the Bizen Fukuoka swordsmith "Fukuoka Ichimonji." You can enjoy flavorful udon made from locally sourced Okayama wheat, carefully ground in a stone mill. Additionally, you can taste "Dodome-se," a local dish said to be the origin of Bizen bara-zushi, which has been passed down since the Kamakura period.
http://ichimonji.ne.jp/

description:
日本三名園の一つ「岡山後楽園」と勇城「岡山城」の魅力発信のため、令和3年秋に開催した「マイベスト岡山後楽園・岡山城フォトコンテスト」入賞作品で作成した動画です。四季折々の魅力的なベストショットをぜひお楽しみください。昼間だけでなく、夜間のライトアップイベントの「幻想庭園」や「烏城灯源郷」まで様々な風景をご覧いただけます。
現在、岡山城は大規模改修工事により休館していますが、今年11月3日にリニューアルオープン予定です。リニューアルオープン後の岡山城にも乞うご期待！
