title: [Summer's Spectacular Toyama] Seeking Healing Beech Forests and Scenic Views, Off to 'Ugidake'!
description:
#Toyama #Ugidake #Hiking

The approximately 3km course from 'Ugidake Onsen Ski Resort Akatonbo Plaza' to 'Ugidake Summit' is called the 'Ugidake Walking Path' and is maintained as a popular hiking trail.

From spring to summer, you can enjoy hiking and collecting insects and plants, while in autumn, you can walk among the colorful foliage and enjoy birdwatching with a field guide in hand.

In the vicinity of the 8th station, the 'Nabeya Beech Forest' is filled with tall beech trees, creating a beautiful and healing space.

At the summit, which stands at 987m, there is a shrine dedicated to 'Ugidake Daimyojin', housing a statue of the deity Okuninushi riding a cow. Additionally, from the summit, you can enjoy a 360-degree panoramic view stretching from the Tateyama Mountain Range to Toyama Plain, Toyama Bay, Tonami Plain, and the Hakusan Mountain Range.

This video introduces the hiking experience from the 5th station 'Nibonsugi Trailhead' to the 'Summit'. *(Accessible by car to the 5th station: parking available)*

The distance from the 5th station to the summit is about 1.2km, taking approximately 40 minutes to ascend and 30 minutes to descend on foot.

Furthermore, if you proceed further south from the summit, you will find the 'Fukamichi Beech Forest'. This beech forest spans approximately 27ha and is home to about 1,200 beech trees, including large trees over 300 years old. The forest floor is characterized by clusters of Chishimazasa and Yukitsubaki. There are very few places in the prefecture with such a vast area of beech trees. (Designated as a cultural property by Toyama City in 1994)
*However, please be cautious when visiting the 'Fukamichi Beech Forest' area, as the paths are narrow and some walking paths are not well-maintained. Additionally, there is a possibility of encountering wild animals such as bears, so please take precautions such as carrying bear bells.*

description:
#TateyamaMountainRange #Toyama #TOYAMA

Winter in Toyama often brings cloudy or snowy (rainy) days, but the beauty on clear days is exceptional.

The majestic views of the Tateyama Mountain Range, with elevations of around 3,000 meters, unfold in everyday life.

From anywhere in Toyama City, if you look towards the east, you can enjoy the grand panorama of the Tateyama Mountain Range.

Driving along National Route 8 from west to east (Toyoda Higashi Intersection to Yuhou Ohashi), you can fully appreciate the magnificent Tateyama Mountain Range looming before you.

However, for those driving, please be careful not to be too mesmerized by the beauty.

title: 【ドローン空撮】続日本百名城「富山城」フルHD
description: 富山市の特別な許可を得て、富山城を空撮しました。いろんな角度から今まで見たことのない富山城をお楽しみください。佐々成政や富山藩主前田家の居城であった富山城は、城跡が富山城址公園として整備され、市民の憩いの場となっています。公園内に残る石垣や濠から当時の威容を見ることができます。また、富山城内は郷土博物館として、400年以上にわたる富山城の歴史を、模型や映像も使いながら分かりやすく紹介しています。

title: Drone Aerial Photography: Continued Japan's 100 Famous Castles 'Toyama Castle' Full HD
description: We obtained special permission from Toyama City to shoot aerial footage of Toyama Castle. Enjoy Toyama Castle from various angles like never before. Toyama Castle, which was the residence of Sasa Narimasa and the Maeda family of the Toyama domain, has its ruins preserved as Toyama Castle Park, a place for citizens to relax. You can see the grandeur of the castle from the remaining stone walls and moats in the park. Additionally, inside Toyama Castle, there is a local museum that clearly introduces the history of Toyama Castle over 400 years using models and videos.

description:
#富山　＃紅葉　＃富山観光

富山市の大沢野にある「寺家公園」は、紅葉の名所で知られています。

当地出身の医師加藤幸次郎氏が私財を投じ、京都の嵐山を模して故郷の里山に木石を配し、昭和５年から１０年の歳月をかけて完成された公園です。

つつじや桜・楓の名所で、富山県指定天然記念物に指定されている「アカガシの群生林」は有名です。また、総延長2.1kmの西国三十三観音巡拝路もあり、春の新緑、秋の紅葉の時期には、多くの家族連れが行楽に訪れています。

title: [Autumn Foliage Spot in Toyama] We went leaf peeping at the beloved autumn destination 'Jike Park'♪
description:
#Toyama #AutumnFoliage #ToyamaTourism

'Jike Park', located in Osawano, Toyama City, is known as a famous spot for autumn foliage.

The park was completed over a period of five to ten years, funded by local physician Kojiro Kato, who modeled it after Arashiyama in Kyoto, arranging trees and stones in his hometown's satoyama.

It is famous for its azaleas, cherry blossoms, and maple trees, and the 'Akagashi Grove', designated as a natural monument by Toyama Prefecture, is particularly well-known. Additionally, there is a 2.1 km pilgrimage route for the 33 Kannon of the Western Country, which attracts many families during the spring greenery and autumn foliage seasons.

*This video was filmed on November 17, 2021.

[Autumn Foliage Period] Mid to late November

title: 【飛騨高山】名料亭で眼福のひとときを。素踊り簡単解説付でご紹介します。
description:
一日限りの特別イベントに潜入レポート！

飛騨高山の名料亭「洲さき」にて谷口裕和氏の素踊りを拝見しました。
谷口氏はこの料亭で育ち、長年の鍛錬を経て、素踊りの名手として、
流派に属さない舞踊家として独立。現在は、東京と飛騨高山に稽古場を持ち、歌舞伎俳優市川中車さんをはじめ、未来の歌舞伎の担い手でもある尾上右近さん片岡千之助さん、市川團子さん、市川勸玄さん、市川ぼたんさんなどの指導を勤められています。

2023年12月4日（月）に日本橋三越本店の三越劇場にて18時半開演で
「別会 谷口裕和の會」が催されます。ご自分の目でご覧いただくと迫力が全く違いますので、これを機会にぜひ足を運んでご覧ください！

title: [Hida Takayama] A moment of visual delight at a renowned restaurant. Introducing with a simple explanation of the traditional dance.
description:
A report on a special one-day event!

I had the pleasure of witnessing Hirokazu Taniguchi's traditional dance at the renowned restaurant 'Susaki' in Hida Takayama.
Taniguchi grew up in this restaurant and, after years of training, became a master of traditional dance, establishing himself as an independent dancer not affiliated with any particular school. He currently has training studios in Tokyo and Hida Takayama, where he teaches future Kabuki performers such as Ichikawa Chusha, Onoue Ukon, Kataoka Chinosuke, Ichikawa Danco, Ichikawa Kangen, and Ichikawa Botan.

On December 4, 2023 (Monday), at 6:30 PM, 'Betsukai Hirokazu Taniguchi's Association' will be held at the Mitsukoshi Theater in Nihonbashi Mitsukoshi Main Store. The impact is completely different when you see it with your own eyes, so please take this opportunity to attend!

title: [ENG SUB] Guide to KABUKI Dance featuring Hirokazu Taniguchi
description:
About KABUKI
It is said that Kabuki began as a form of dance called kabuki-odori (meaning “wild and strange dancing”) that was popular around 400 years ago. The introduction of new elements such as music played on foreign instruments, complex stories and other qualities helped Kabuki steadily grow into a comprehensive form of theatre incorporating other entertainment styles and cultural elements. It was a favorite of the common people living in cities, and excellent playwrights and actors brought fresh creation and refinements to the art.

About KABUKI Dance [Su-Odori]
In Modern Japan, Kabuki Dance became independent from Kabuki, and many professional Kabuki Dance performers emerged and established active careers. It captured the fascination of many people, and created a surge in traditional arts. With a mastery that has been achieved over time, and a refinement that extends to its limits, Kabuki Dance can be described as the essence of traditional art.

title: [ENG SUB] 歌舞伎ダンスのガイド（田口宏和出演）
description:
歌舞伎について
歌舞伎は、約400年前に人気を博した「奇妙で野性的な踊り」を意味する歌舞伎踊りから始まったと言われています。外国の楽器で演奏される音楽、複雑な物語、その他の要素の導入により、歌舞伎は他のエンターテインメントスタイルや文化的要素を取り入れた包括的な演劇形式へと着実に成長しました。都市に住む一般の人々に好まれ、優れた劇作家や俳優がこの芸術に新しい創造と洗練をもたらしました。

歌舞伎ダンスについて [スオドリ]
現代日本では、歌舞伎ダンスは歌舞伎から独立し、多くのプロの歌舞伎ダンスパフォーマーが登場し、活躍するキャリアを確立しました。多くの人々の魅力を捉え、伝統芸術のブームを生み出しました。長い時間をかけて達成された熟練度と限界までの洗練により、歌舞伎ダンスは伝統芸術の本質と表現できます。

title: Sulfur Springs Effective for Skin! Akita's Hot Spring Resort 'Hikage Onsen'
description: Hello everyone. I finally started to feel the autumn atmosphere, so I went to a nice hot spring in Akita Prefecture. While there are many inns that boast of flowing hot spring water, this one is a hidden gem known as a 'medicinal bath effective for the skin.' It's located alone in the mountains of Akita, so in this day and age, I'm worried about bears. When I find myself alone in the outdoor bath, I used to think it was lucky, but now I can't relax without someone else around (laughs). But everyone, please rest assured. There is an indoor bath! Now, although there is an additional charge, the stone sauna here is also wonderful, with a radon level that surpasses the famous Tamagawa Onsen known for its effectiveness against cancer! You can stay in for an hour, so it warms you up from the core of your body. You can reserve the private bath twice, once on the same day and once the next morning, but this is actually a competitive situation, so I recommend arriving at the inn right at the 3 PM check-in time to make your reservation immediately. The drinks in the lounge are all-you-can-drink, and there is ice cream too, so I had a very comfortable time.

description: 楽山園の「春」を空から４K映像で撮影しました。ミュージシャンのMVやドラマや映画のロケ地としても使用されております。楽山園は、江戸時代初期に織田氏によって造られた小幡藩邸の庭園で、池泉回遊式の借景庭園です。名前の由来は、「知者ハ水ヲ楽シミ、仁者ハ山ヲ楽シム」という論語の故事から名付けられたと言われています。織田氏により築庭され、複数の茶屋を設け「庭園と茶事」を巧みに演出しています。西や南の山々を借景とした広がりのある空間構成は「庭園美」の極みと言えます。複数の茶屋を配していることから、織田氏と茶事との関連も深くうかがえ、歴史的・文化的にも高い価値がある庭園です。

title: Rakuzan-en Spring Scenery (Kanra Town, Gunma Prefecture)
description: We filmed the 'spring' of Rakuzan-en in 4K from the sky. It is also used as a filming location for musicians' music videos, dramas, and movies. Rakuzan-en is a garden of the Obata clan built by the Oda family in the early Edo period, and it is a borrowed scenery garden with a pond and walking paths. The name is said to be derived from a story in the Analects, 'The wise enjoy water, and the benevolent enjoy the mountains.' The garden was constructed by the Oda family, who set up multiple tea houses to skillfully stage 'gardening and tea ceremonies.' The expansive spatial composition, borrowing the mountains to the west and south, can be said to be the pinnacle of 'garden beauty.' The presence of multiple tea houses also suggests a deep connection between the Oda family and tea ceremonies, giving the garden high historical and cultural value.

title: 織田公公園（群馬県甘楽町）
description:
所在地：甘楽町大字小幡１４１６
甘楽町指定史跡：昭和３８年６月２０日   

甘楽町ホームページはこちら　→　https://www.town.kanra.lg.jp/index.html

崇福寺に、小幡藩主織田信雄から信富に至る７代の墓がある。
　元和元年（1615）信雄（織田信長の二男）は、大和松山（奈良県宇陀市）と上野（群馬県）小幡合わせて五万石の領主となり、子の信良が入封して小幡織田氏の藩政が始まった。
　３代信昌は、祖父信雄の遺命（死に際してのこした命令）により、松山三万石を後見役であった叔父の織田高長に譲り、小幡二万石のみとなった。
　その後、明和４年（1767）の事件で、出羽高畠（山形県高畠町）に移封されるまで、８代１５２年にわたり小幡藩を統治した。
　織田氏の墓石はいずれも五輪塔で、初代信雄から、信良－信昌－信久－信就－信右－信富の歴代順に並んでいて、大名家の墓所らしい風格を見せている。　
　織田氏は初め、轟の宝積寺を菩提寺（先祖の墓や位牌をまつる寺）としていたが、４代信久の時、崇福寺に移している。崇福寺は宝暦８年（1758）と明治４年（1871）の火災により、５代以下の墓石は火炎を受け破損している。

title: Oda Koen Park (Kanra Town, Gunma Prefecture)
description:
Location: 1416 Obata, Kanra Town
Designated Historical Site of Kanra Town: June 20, 1963

Visit the Kanra Town website here → https://www.town.kanra.lg.jp/index.html

At Suifukuji Temple, there are the graves of seven generations from Oda Nobuhiro, the lord of the Obata domain, to Nobutomi.
In the first year of Genna (1615), Nobuhiro (the second son of Oda Nobunaga) became the lord of a combined 50,000 koku in Yamato Matsuyama (Uda City, Nara Prefecture) and Obata (Gunma Prefecture), and his son Nobuyoshi entered the domain, marking the beginning of the Obata Oda clan's rule.
The third generation, Nobumasa, following the last wishes (orders left at the time of death) of his grandfather Nobuhiro, ceded 30,000 koku of Matsuyama to his uncle Oda Takanaga, becoming the lord of only 20,000 koku in Obata.
After that, until the incident in the fourth year of Meiwa (1767), they governed the Obata domain for 152 years across eight generations.
The gravestones of the Oda clan are all five-ring pagodas, arranged in order from the first generation Nobuhiro to Nobuyoshi, Nobumasa, Nobuhisa, Nobushige, Nobuemon, and Nobutomi, showcasing the dignified appearance typical of a feudal lord's burial site.
Initially, the Oda clan used the Hojuji Temple in Todoroki as their family temple (a temple for ancestral graves and memorial tablets), but during the time of the fourth generation Nobuhisa, they moved to Suifukuji Temple. Due to fires in the 8th year of Hōreki (1758) and the 4th year of Meiji (1871), the gravestones of the fifth generation and beyond were damaged by flames.

title: Kyoto Kamigamo Shrine: Niiname-sai on November 23
description: One of the oldest shrines in Kyoto, Kamigamo Shrine. The entire precinct is registered as a World Heritage Site, preserving the appearance unchanged since the Heian period. The Niiname-sai is held on November 23, where the Emperor offers newly harvested rice to the deities and prays in gratitude. Various autumn harvests are also offered at shrines nationwide, expressing gratitude for the harvest and prayers for the prosperity of the imperial family and national peace. Although it is now a national holiday known as Labor Thanksgiving Day, it is originally a festival day for the ancient harvest festival 'Niiname-sai'.

title: 串柿
description:
http://www.katsuragi-kanko.jp/kusigakinosato.html

串柿の里として400年の昔から歴史と伝統を育んできた四郷(しごう)。 のどかな山里からは紀ノ川の清流を眼下に国道24号沿いの町並みを見渡して、はるか雨引山、龍門山、高野山、大峰山を遠望できます。

東谷、平、滝、広口の四つの村を総称して四郷(しごう)といいます。
400年の昔から串柿の特産地として、現在に引き継がれています。

11月も秋が深まり、串柿作りが始まると農家の軒先や周囲の干場に柿の玉のれんが一斉に吊るされ山里は柿一色に染まります。
その見事な風景は晩秋の風物詩として全国に知られ、訪れる人々を楽しませています。また山沿いに点在する村からの展望は息をのむほど美しく、春から夏にかけての新緑の季節は心までも緑に染まります…

title: Kushigaki
description:
http://www.katsuragi-kanko.jp/kusigakinosato.html

Shigō has nurtured its history and tradition as a place of kushigaki (dried persimmons) for 400 years. From this tranquil mountain village, one can overlook the clear stream of the Kinokawa River below and gaze at the town along National Route 24, with distant views of Mount Amabiki, Mount Ryūmon, Mount Kōya, and Mount Ōmine.

The four villages of Higashitani, Hira, Taki, and Hirokuchi are collectively referred to as Shigō. For 400 years, it has been passed down as a specialty area for kushigaki.

As November deepens into autumn and the production of kushigaki begins, the eaves of farmers' houses and the surrounding drying areas are adorned with hanging strings of persimmons, dyeing the mountain village in shades of orange. This magnificent scenery is known nationwide as an autumnal spectacle, delighting visitors. Additionally, the views from the scattered villages along the mountains are breathtakingly beautiful, and the fresh green season from spring to summer colors the heart in green...

title: 天野の風景
description:
http://www.katsuragi-kanko.jp/amanonosato.html

■登場する風景
　・田園
　・丹生都比売神社
　・二つ鳥居
　・二つ鳥居から見た天野

標高450mの天野盆地は、四季折々の田園風景がひろがります。
また「歴史の里　天野」は1700年前の丹生明神や1200年前の
空海にまつわる史跡が数多く点在します。「にほんの里100選」にも
選ばれた天野は、まさに「癒しの里」です。

天野の里は、和歌山県北東部のかつらぎ町南部にあり、国道２４号線より南へ車で１５分、高野山のふもと標高約４５０ｍに
位置しています。四季折々のどかな田園風景が広がる天野盆地は、『にほんの里100選』にも選ばれています。
１９９８（平成元年）年には、環境庁（現環境省）から『ふるさと生きものの里』に認定され、初夏、
今なお清い流れを守る真国川では源氏ボタルの乱舞が見られ、豊かな自然に恵まれた地域です。
「日本の原風景」と謳われる地は多いですが、特に天野は四季折々の変化に富み、ことに
春の新緑、秋のまばゆいばかりの稲穂の波は美しく、まさに桃源郷を想わせます。

白洲正子さんは、著書「かくれ里」の一節で…
「まだかまだかと思ううち、峠を二つばかり越えたところで下り坂となり、
いきなり目の前が明るくなった。見渡す限り、まばゆいばかりの稲の波だ。
こんな山の天辺に、田圃があろうとは想像もしなかったが、それはまことに
「天野」の名にふさわしい天の一角に開けた広大な野原であった。もしかすると
高天原も、こういう地形のところを　いったのかも知れない」「ずいぶん方々旅を
したが、こんなに閑でうっとりするような山村を私は知らない」「できることなら
ここに隠居したい。桃源郷とは正にこういう所をいうのだろう」と記されました。

かつて空海を高野山にみちびいたとされる真言密教の守り神、
丹生都比売神社が鎮座する天野は、開山後、高野のかくれ里と呼ばれました。
高野山が女人禁制であったことから出家していつの日か逢えることを楽しみに、
高野の麓、天野に移り住む人も多く、それにまつわる多くの史跡が点在します。
また、源平時代の史跡もあり、まさに歴史ロマンの里・信仰の里
でもあります。

title: Amano Landscape
description:
http://www.katsuragi-kanko.jp/amanonosato.html

■Scenery Appearing
　・Rural Landscape
　・Niu Tohime Shrine
　・Two Torii Gates
　・Amano as Seen from the Two Torii Gates

At an elevation of 450m, the Amano Basin offers a rural landscape that changes with the seasons. 
Moreover, "Historical Village Amano" is dotted with numerous historical sites related to Niu Myojin from 1700 years ago and Kukai from 1200 years ago. Selected as one of the "100 Best Villages in Japan," Amano is truly a "Healing Village."

Amano is located in the southern part of Katsuragi Town in the northeastern part of Wakayama Prefecture, about 15 minutes by car south of National Route 24, at the foot of Mount Koya at an elevation of approximately 450m. The Amano Basin, with its tranquil rural scenery throughout the seasons, has also been selected as one of the "100 Best Villages in Japan." In 1998, it was certified as a "Hometown of Living Creatures" by the Environment Agency (now the Ministry of the Environment), and in early summer, the Genji Fireflies can be seen dancing in the still pure waters of the Makuni River, making it a region blessed with rich nature. 
While many places are praised as "Japan's Original Scenery," Amano, in particular, is rich in seasonal changes, especially the fresh greenery of spring and the dazzling waves of rice ears in autumn, evoking the image of a paradise.

Masako Shirase wrote in her book "Hidden Village":
"As I wondered when it would come, after crossing a couple of mountain passes, the descent began, and suddenly the view brightened. As far as the eye could see, there were dazzling waves of rice. I never imagined there would be rice fields at the top of such a mountain, but it was indeed a vast field that opened up in a corner of heaven worthy of the name 'Amano.' Perhaps Takamagahara was also a place with such terrain."
"I have traveled quite a bit, but I have never known such a quiet and enchanting mountain village. If possible, I would like to retire here. This is precisely what is meant by a paradise."

Amano, where the guardian deity of Shingon Esoteric Buddhism, Niu Tohime Shrine, is enshrined, is said to have guided Kukai to Mount Koya. After its establishment, it was called the hidden village of Koya. Since Mount Koya was off-limits to women, many people moved to Amano at the foot of Koya, looking forward to the day they could meet again, and many historical sites related to this can be found scattered throughout the area. Additionally, there are historical sites from the Genpei era, making it a place rich in historical romance and faith.

丹生酒殿神社
description: 当神社は丹生都比賣大神が紀の国三谷に御降臨あそばされてより氏神と称え奉られ、明治6年4月1日村社に列し、昭和10年6月18日上天野村官幣大社丹生都比賣神社の攝社として合併され、戦後独立、現在に至っている。一、丹生都比賣大神（右坐）。天照大御神の御妹であらせされ、稚日女命とも申し上げ、神代の昔、御子高野御子と共に大和地方や紀伊地方を御巡歴遊ばし、人民の為に農耕の事、糸をつむぎ機を織る事や煮焚の事など衣食の道をはじめ教え導かれ、特に木の川（紀の川）の水を以て酒を醸し奉りてより、丹生酒殿神社と称えられる。最後に天野の現地に御本居を御定め遊ばし、御鎮まりなされたのである。丹生と云う神社の多き事、伊都郡の郡名、和歌山県の県名など、皆御神恩や御名を忘れない為の永久への記念的称呼たることを思わねばなりません。二、高野御子大神（中坐）。丹生都比賣大神の御子神にましまして、高野山の名称も此の神の御名よりでたるものと伝えられ、狩場明神とも称えられている。三、誉田別大神（左坐）。元熊手八幡とも称し、鎌八幡宮とも称され、香川県讃岐国多度郡風ケ浦に鎮座ありしを弘法大師産土神の故を以って高野山に勧請せしを明治2年神佛分別の際、官費を要し当時の兄井村へ新殿を設立し遷座され、明治42年9月5日丹生酒殿神社境内の許可を受け、同年10月13日大字兄井鎮座八幡神社を当丹生酒殿神社に合祀されたのである。鎌八幡宮は、無病息災、子宝、受験諸々の願かけの御祭神として広く信仰され、昔は大和（奈良県）河内（大阪府）の信者も多かったと伝えられている。四、建御名方命（大国主神の御子）。

title: Niu Sakenomiya Shrine
description: This shrine has been revered as the guardian deity since the descent of Niu Tohime no Okami in the Kii region. It was designated as a village shrine on April 1, 1873, and merged as a branch shrine of the Kampei Taisha Niu Tohime Shrine in Amano Village on June 18, 1935, becoming independent after the war. 1. Niu Tohime no Okami (right seat). She is the younger sister of Amaterasu Omikami, also known as Wakihime no Mikoto. In ancient times, she traveled through the Yamato and Kii regions with her son, Takayama no Mikoto, teaching the people about agriculture, weaving, and cooking, and particularly brewing sake with the water of the Kino River, hence the name Niu Sakenomiya Shrine. Finally, she settled in Amano, where she resides. The many shrines named Niu, the name of the Ito District, and the name of Wakayama Prefecture are all memorial names to remember her divine grace. 2. Takayama no Mikoto (middle seat). He is the son of Niu Tohime no Okami, and it is said that the name of Mount Koya comes from this deity. 3. Honda no Wakatoshi no Okami (left seat). Also known as Kumade Hachiman and Kame Hachiman Shrine, it was originally located in Takamatsu, Kagawa Prefecture, and was moved to Mount Koya due to its association with Kobo Daishi. In 1869, during the separation of Shinto and Buddhism, a new shrine was established in the village of Anii, and on September 5, 1909, permission was granted to merge the Hachiman Shrine into Niu Sakenomiya Shrine on October 13 of the same year. Kame Hachiman Shrine is widely worshipped as a deity for health, childbearing, and various prayers, and it is said that many believers from Yamato (Nara Prefecture) and Kawachi (Osaka Prefecture) used to visit. 4. Takeminakata no Mikoto (son of Okuninushi no Kami).

title: 女神湖でSUPやろうよ! 斎藤リョーツさんも遊びに来てくれたよ!
description: 信州たてしなの白樺高原は標高1,530m 真夏でも湿度が少なくカラッとして暑くないので、夏にアクティビティやるのにぴったりなリゾートです。中でも女神湖は穏やかなでちょうど良いサイズでSUPにぴったり。ここで練習してうまくなっちゃいましょう! 親子で乗ったりペットと乗ったり湖から眺める蓼科山が最高です! 持ち込みOK(湖面使用料と保険代で1,300円/2時間)レンタルも可能(1艇レンタル、ライフジャケットレンタル+保険込)ガイドツアーも好評です。(2時間1名4,000円)

title: Let's do SUP at Megami Lake! Saito Ryotsu came to play too!
description: The Shirakaba Highlands in Tateshina, Nagano Prefecture, is at an altitude of 1,530m, and even in the height of summer, it has low humidity and is dry, making it a perfect resort for summer activities. Among them, Megami Lake is calm and just the right size for SUP. Let's practice here and get better! You can ride with your family or pets, and the view of Mount Tateshina from the lake is the best! Bring your own (lake surface usage fee and insurance cost is 1,300 yen for 2 hours). Rentals are also available (1 boat rental, life jacket rental + insurance included). Guided tours are also popular (4,000 yen for 2 hours per person).

title: 雪と雲海の白×蓼科ブルー
description: 白樺高原の蓼科第二牧場は秋の雲海スポットだけど冬だって条件合えば見ることができますよ! 雪原の白、雲海の白、晴天率の高い蓼科ブルーの青とのコントラストが最高! 2020〜21シーズンからは、牛乳専科もうもうさんも冬季営業開始 スキー行く前に、周辺にお泊りの際は、蓼科第二牧場をぜひチェックしてみてください。

title: Snow and Sea of Clouds White × Tateshina Blue
description: Tateshina Second Ranch in the Shirakaba Highlands is an autumn sea of clouds spot, but you can see it in winter if the conditions are right! The contrast between the white of the snowfield, the white of the sea of clouds, and the blue of Tateshina Blue, which has a high rate of clear weather, is the best! From the 2020-21 season, the milk specialty shop Moomoo-san will also start winter operations. If you're staying nearby before skiing, be sure to check out Tateshina Second Ranch.

title: 朝イチ×紅葉 ミラーレイク@女神湖
description: 毎年10月中旬〜11月初旬が白樺高原の紅葉の見頃になります。太陽が昇りきる前の早朝〜8時頃までは、湖面に紅葉や蓼科山が映るミラーレイクタイム。湖面の霧も幻想的。黄金のカラマツ、白樺湖の黄色い葉と白い樹のコントラスト。差し色の紅葉の絶妙な共演が楽しめます。

title: Morning × Autumn Leaves Mirror Lake @ Megami Lake
description: The best time to see the autumn leaves in the Shirakaba Highlands is from mid-October to early November each year. Before the sun rises, until around 8 a.m., you can enjoy the Mirror Lake time where the autumn leaves and Mt. Tateshina are reflected on the lake surface. The mist on the lake is also fantastic. You can enjoy the exquisite collaboration of the golden larch, the yellow leaves of Lake Shirakaba, and the white trees, with the accent colors of autumn leaves.

title: 蓼科第二牧場は雲海スポット!
description: 毎年9月下旬〜11月下旬、白樺高原の蓼科第二牧場では雲海が見れることが多いです。前の日の夜が晴れて放射冷却現象になると、雲海発生大チャンス! 7:30〜8:30が見頃。見下ろす佐久平がすっぽりと雲に隠れて、雲を突き抜け頭を出す浅間山の絶景に出会えます! 最高の雲海に出会うために、白樺高原に泊まりに来てくださいね!

title: Tateshina Second Ranch is a Sea of Clouds Spot!
description: From late September to late November every year, the Tateshina Second Ranch in the Shirakaba Highlands often offers views of sea of clouds. If the night before is clear and a radiative cooling phenomenon occurs, it’s a great chance to see the sea of clouds! The best time to see it is from 7:30 to 8:30. You can encounter the breathtaking view of Mount Asama peeking out above the clouds, while the Saku Plain below is completely hidden in the clouds! Please come and stay in the Shirakaba Highlands to experience the best sea of clouds!

小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館は、日本近代彫刻の巨匠・平櫛田中の作品を保存・展示し、ながくその功績を顕彰するとともに、市民文化の向上を図ることを目的として、昭和59年に平櫛田中の旧宅を公開し、「小平市平櫛田中館」として開館しました。その後、平成6年に展示館を新築し、平成17年に遺族から作品の寄贈を受けたことを機に、平成18年4月に館名を「小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館」へ変更し、現在に至っています。

主な美術館活動として、田中が遺した彫刻、書、資料を中心とする通常展示のほか、平櫛田中と関係の深い作家の作品紹介を中心とする特別展（2年に1回の隔年開催）を開催し、田中芸術への理解が深められるような企画・展示を行っています。

また、春と秋の2回開催するお茶会や、夏休みに小学生とその保護者を対象としたワークショップ「親子で美術館」もご好評いただいております。

近年では美術館ボランティアを組織し、市民との協働により美術館活動のさらなる活性化と充実を目指しております。

title: 平櫛田中の庭  - Japanese garden of Hirakushi Denchū  -
description:
今年も春がやってきました。

彫刻家・平櫛田中がこの地に移り住んできたのは、九十八歳の時でした。

それから先、二十年、三十年と彫刻を掘るために、クスノキを買って、周囲を驚かせました。

もしかしたら、平櫛田中は、今でもこの庭を眺めながら、彫刻を掘り続けているのかもしれません。

その優雅で且つ、力強いこの景色から、

何にも屈することのない平櫛田中の息遣いが聞こえるような気がします。


（詳細: https://kodaira-tourism.com/spot/5880/ ）
【小平市平櫛田中彫刻美術館】

平櫛田中彫刻美術館（ひらくしでんちゅうちょうこくびじゅつかん）は、
日本近代彫刻界の巨匠、彫刻家平櫛田中（文化勲章受章者、小平市名誉市民）の終えんの館を保存し、
広く市民の皆様に公開するため、昭和59年10月に開館しました。その後、平成6年2月に、貴重な木彫作品を展示、保存するため展示館を新築し、
2館併設の美術館として現在に至っています。
記念館は、国立能楽堂などを手がけた大江宏の設計による書院造の名建築。
玉川上水をのぞむ美しい庭園が魅力です。
展示館では、年間を通じて４回の企画展、特別展（隔年開催）を開催。
お茶会（春・秋）、親子で美術館など、各種のイベントを開催しています。
また、多機能端末で音声と画像による作品解説を楽しむことができるサービスもありますので、ぜひご来館ください。

※なるべく午後３時３０分までに入館してください。

title: Japanese garden of Hirakushi Denchū
description:
Spring has come again this year.

The sculptor Hirakushi Denchū moved to this place at the age of ninety-eight.

For the next twenty, thirty years, he bought camphor trees to carve sculptures, astonishing those around him.

Perhaps Hirakushi Denchū is still gazing at this garden, continuing to carve sculptures.

From this elegant yet powerful scenery,

I feel as if I can hear the breath of Hirakushi Denchū, who is unyielding to anything.

(Details: https://kodaira-tourism.com/spot/5880/)
【Kodaira City Hirakushi Denchū Sculpture Museum】

The Hirakushi Denchū Sculpture Museum was opened in October 1984 to preserve the residence of the master of modern Japanese sculpture, Hirakushi Denchū (recipient of the Order of Culture, honorary citizen of Kodaira City), and to widely open it to the public. In February 1994, a new exhibition hall was built to display and preserve valuable wooden sculptures, and it has since become a museum with two facilities.
The memorial hall is a beautiful building designed in the Shoin style by Hiroshi Oe, who also worked on the National Noh Theatre. The beautiful garden overlooking the Tamagawa Josui is a charm.
The exhibition hall hosts four planned exhibitions and special exhibitions (held every other year) throughout the year.
Various events such as tea ceremonies (spring and autumn) and family art museum activities are held.
Additionally, there is a service where you can enjoy audio and image explanations of the works using multifunctional terminals, so please visit us.

title: 【絶景茨城】神磯の鳥居-茨城県大洗町磯前神社｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: 神が降り立った地・神磯に立つ鳥居は海岸沿いの高台にある大洗磯前神社の鳥居の一つです。大洗磯前神社は856年創建とされる由緒ある神社で古くから家内安全・海上交通の守り神として信仰を集めています。鳥居が朝日に照らされた太平洋の荒波が岩礁に当たり白く砕ける瞬間はまさに神々しい光景です。

title: 【Scenic Ibaraki】Torii at Kamiso - Isozaki Shrine in Oarai Town, Ibaraki Prefecture
description: The torii gate standing in Kamiso, the land where gods descended, is one of the torii gates of Isozaki Shrine located on a high ground along the coast. Isozaki Shrine, believed to have been founded in 856, has long been revered as a guardian deity for family safety and maritime traffic. The moment when the torii gate is illuminated by the morning sun and the rough waves of the Pacific crash against the reefs, creating white foam, is truly a divine sight.

title: 【絶景茨城】鹿島神宮 | VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: Kashima Shrineは、日本建国・武道の神様である武甕槌大神を御祭神とする、神武天皇元年創建の由緒ある神社です。現在の社殿は徳川二代将軍の秀忠により、また奥宮は徳川家康、楼門は水戸初代藩主徳川頼房により奉納されたもので、いずれも重要文化財に指定されています。奥参道を進むと奥宮、鹿園、要石、御手洗池なども見ることが出来ます。

title: Kashima Shrine | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: Kashima Shrine is a historic shrine founded in the first year of Emperor Jinmu, dedicated to the deity Takemikazuchi no Kami, the god of Japan's founding and martial arts. The current shrine buildings were donated by Tokugawa Ieyasu, the second shogun Tokugawa Hidetada, and the first lord of Mito, Tokugawa Yorifusa, and are all designated as important cultural properties. As you proceed along the inner approach, you can also see the inner shrine, deer park, key stone, and purification pond.

title: 御岩神社【絶景茨城】
description: 常陸国最古の霊山と言われている御岩山の麓に鎮座する御岩神社。鳥居から少し歩くと日立市一の大きさと言われている御神木「三本杉」が現れます。また、縄文時代から人々の信仰の地であった御岩山には188の神々が宿るとされており、今も多くの人々が訪れます。

title: Oiwa Shrine【Scenic Ibaraki】
description: Oiwa Shrine is located at the foot of Oiwa Mountain, said to be the oldest sacred mountain in Hitachi Province. A short walk from the torii gate leads to the sacred tree 'Sanbon-sugi', which is said to be the largest in Hitachi City. Oiwa Mountain has been a place of worship since the Jomon period, and it is believed to house 188 deities, attracting many visitors even today.

title: Ibaraki's Spectacular Starry Sky | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:

The Satomi area in Hitachiota City, Ibaraki Prefecture. Located on a plateau, the air is clear, and on clear nights without the moon, you can see a sky full of stars. Captured the spectacular stars at the accommodation facility 'Plateau Satomi' equipped with an astronomical observation facility.

title: 【絶景茨城】袋田の滝 氷瀑｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description:
日本三大名瀑のひとつに数えられる「袋田の滝」。寒さの厳しい冬には滝全体が真っ白に凍結する姿を見せてくれます。

さらに、大子町の風物詩となった「大子来人～ダイゴライト～」では、自然と光が作り出す神秘の空間が、「袋田の滝」の新たな魅力を発見させてくれます。

title: 【Breathtaking Ibaraki】Fukuroda Falls Icefall｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
Fukuroda Falls, counted among Japan's three great waterfalls, showcases a completely frozen appearance in the harsh winter cold.

Additionally, the 'Daigo Light' event, which has become a local tradition in Daigo Town, creates a mystical space formed by nature and light, allowing visitors to discover new charms of 'Fukuroda Falls'.

title: 【絶景茨城】牛久大仏 ［4K］茨城県牛久市｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description:
牛久大仏は、浄土真宗東本願寺派本山東本願寺が事業主体。この浄土真宗の開祖が、親鸞聖人（1173年～1262年）です。親鸞は後鳥羽上皇の怒りを買い、1207年に越後国に流罪に処せられます。その4年後に赦免された後、常陸国（現在の茨城県）に入り、関東における布教の拠点としました。県内には親鸞ゆかりの寺や事跡が多く残っており、この牛久の地もそのひとつです。
事業構想は1983年に着手、1986年に工事が着工し、1992年12月に完成した。事業主体は浄土真宗東本願寺派本山東本願寺。
その姿は同派の本尊である阿弥陀如来像の形状を拡大したものである。
全高120m（像高100m、台座20m）を誇り、奈良の大仏（像高14.98m）が掌に乗り、アメリカ合衆国ニューヨーク州にある自由の女神像（全高93m、手を掲げた姿勢の像高さ46.05m）の実質的な像高（足元から頭頂までの高さ33.86m）の3倍近くの大きさである。

title: [Spectacular Ibaraki] Ushiku Daibutsu [4K] Ushiku City, Ibaraki Prefecture | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
The Ushiku Daibutsu is a project initiated by the Higashi Honganji sect of Jodo Shinshu. The founder of this Jodo Shinshu sect is Shinran Shonin (1173-1262). Shinran incurred the wrath of Emperor Go-Toba and was exiled to Echigo Province in 1207. Four years later, after being pardoned, he entered Hitachi Province (now Ibaraki Prefecture) and established a base for propagation in the Kanto region. Many temples and historical sites related to Shinran remain in the prefecture, and this area of Ushiku is one of them.
The project began in 1983, construction started in 1986, and it was completed in December 1992. The project was led by the Higashi Honganji sect of Jodo Shinshu.
Its form is an enlarged version of the Amida Nyorai statue, which is the principal object of worship of this sect.
Standing at a total height of 120 meters (100 meters for the statue and 20 meters for the pedestal), it is nearly three times the height of the Great Buddha of Nara (which is 14.98 meters tall) and the effective height of the Statue of Liberty in New York, USA (which has a total height of 93 meters and an effective statue height of 33.86 meters from feet to top of the head).

茨城県大子町十二所神社の参道にある百段階段を舞台に毎年開催される「百段階段でひなまつり」

description:
The 'Hina Matsuri at Hyakudankaidan' is held every year on the hundred-step staircase at Juunishoshrine in Daigo Town, Ibaraki Prefecture.

The hina dolls provided from all over the country are filled with various histories, and each one has its own unique personality.

description: KairakuenはKanazawaのKenrokuen、OkayamaのKorakuenとともに日本三名園のひとつに数えられており、毎年2月から3月にかけて「Mito Plum Festival」が開催されます。園内には約100品種3000本もの梅があり、春の訪れを告げるかのように可憐に咲き競います。様々な品種があるため「早咲き」「中咲き」「遅咲き」と長期間にわたり観梅を楽しむことができるのも魅力です。

title: 【Scenic Ibaraki】Kairakuen Plum Blossoms｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: Kairakuen is counted as one of Japan's three famous gardens along with Kenrokuen in Kanazawa and Korakuen in Okayama, and the 'Mito Plum Festival' is held every year from February to March. The garden has about 3,000 plum trees of approximately 100 varieties, blooming delicately as if to announce the arrival of spring. The variety of types allows visitors to enjoy plum viewing over a long period with 'early bloomers', 'mid bloomers', and 'late bloomers'.

日本三名園の一つ「偕楽園」。
水戸藩第九代藩主・徳川斉昭公によって創設されました。

都市公園としては、ニューヨーク市のセントラルパークに次いで世界第2位の面積を誇ります。
早春には約100品種、3,000本の梅の花が咲き誇り、梅の名所としても知られています。

表門から一の木戸を抜けると、孟宗竹利、大杉森、クマザサが茂る幽遠閑寂な「陰の世界」が広がります。
そして、その先に繋がるのは、好文亭が現れ見晴らしが良い「陽の世界」。
「陰」から「陽」へ、正しい順路で歩くと、偕楽園本来の姿を知ることができます。

title: Kairakuen, One of Japan's Three Famous Gardens, Mito City, Ibaraki Prefecture | Stunning Ibaraki -VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN-
description:
Date of shooting: 2016.03.08
Kairakuen, one of Japan's three famous gardens, was established by the ninth lord of the Mito domain, Tokugawa Nariaki.

It boasts the second largest area in the world for an urban park, following Central Park in New York City.
In early spring, about 100 varieties and 3,000 plum trees bloom, making it well-known as a plum blossom spot.

Passing through the main gate and the first gate, you enter a serene 'world of shadows' filled with bamboo, large cedar trees, and kumazasa.
Beyond that lies the 'world of light' with the Kobuntei pavilion offering a great view.
Walking the correct route from 'shadow' to 'light' allows you to understand the true nature of Kairakuen.

title: 【絶景茨城】ハス田｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description:
れんこん生産量日本一を誇る茨城県では、7月から8月にかけて霞ヶ浦周辺に広がる蓮の花が見られます。広大な湖のそばに咲き誇る蓮の花は、湖面に輝く太陽の光と共に人々を魅了します。

秋になると葉は茶色になり枯れ始めます。
れんこんの収穫では、れんこんを浮かび上がらせる「水掘り」を採用。れんこんの肌を傷つけないよう、掘り上げてから丁寧に泥を洗い落とします。ぷっくりとした団子状で柔らかな肉質、ほんのりとした甘みが魅力です。

霞ヶ浦の豊富な水資源と肥沃な土という自然条件により、日本中で愛される美味しいれんこんが育まれています。

title: [Spectacular Ibaraki] Lotus Fields | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
In Ibaraki Prefecture, which boasts the highest production of lotus root in Japan, lotus flowers can be seen blooming around Lake Kasumigaura from July to August. The lotus flowers blooming beside the vast lake captivate people with the sunlight shimmering on the water's surface.

In autumn, the leaves turn brown and begin to wither.
During the harvesting of lotus root, a method called "water digging" is employed to bring the lotus roots to the surface. Care is taken to wash off the mud gently after digging them up to avoid damaging the skin of the lotus root. Their plump, round shape and soft texture, along with a hint of sweetness, are truly appealing.

Thanks to the abundant water resources and fertile soil of Lake Kasumigaura, delicious lotus roots loved throughout Japan are cultivated.

#Kasumigaura #LotusRoot #Lotus #Ibaraki

title: [Spectacular Ibaraki / Japan Heritage] Kodokan [4K] Mito City, Ibaraki Prefecture | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
[Date of filming: 2015.5.27] Kodokan, a nationally designated special historic site and important cultural property located in Mito City, Ibaraki Prefecture. Established in 1842 by Tokugawa Nariaki, the 9th lord of the Mito domain, it is the largest domain school in Japan. The last shogun, Tokugawa Yoshinobu, also studied at this location during his childhood and lived in seclusion here after the restoration of imperial rule. This time, we were able to capture footage of parts that are usually not visible, such as the actual 'bird's-eye view' (chōkanzu), the interior of the Confucius Temple, and the monument of Kodokan housed in the Hakkadō.

Hitachi Seaside Park　（Japan）
Welcome to “Everywhere Blue World,” of sky blue, ocean blue, and nemophoila blue, which makes you feel refreshed.
With an area of about 190 ha, Hitachi seaside park boasts its wide variety of seasonal flower gardens such as narcissus and tulip in spring, nemophila and rose in early summer, zinnia in summer and kochia and cosmos in autumn.
An amusement park (cycling road, BMX course, athletic field, BBQ space) is set up as an annex.


國營常陸海濱公園　（日本）
面積約153.2公頃的園內，隨處可見大規模的花圃，春天是水仙、郁金香，初夏是粉蝶花(nemophila)、薔薇，夏天是百日菊（zinnia）,秋天是笤帚草、大波斯菊等等，四季都有特色各異的花草供遊客觀賞。
園內備有自行車路線，可乘自行車巡回觀賞。園內還有25種以上吸引人的“娛樂花園”、 ＢＭＸ路線和林間體育廣場、野餐廣場等等，供遊客盡情享受。


国营常陆海滨公园　　（日本）
面积约153.2公顷的园内，随处可见大规模的花圃，春季是水仙、郁金香，初夏是粉蝶花(nemophila)、蔷薇，夏天是百日菊（zinnia）,秋天是扫帚草、大波斯菊等等，四季都有特色各异的花草供游客观赏。
园内备有自行车专用线路，可乘自行车巡回观赏。园内还有25种以上吸引人的“娱乐花园”、 ＢＭＸ路线和林间体育广场、野餐广场等等，供游客尽情享受


국영 히타치 해변 공원　（일본）
개원 면적 약 190ha에 달하는 원내에는 이곳 저곳에 대규모 꽃밭이 있어, 봄에는 수선화, 튤립, 초여름에는 네모필라, 장미, 여름에는 백일홍, 가을에는 코키아(댑싸리)와 코스모스로 사계절마다의 꽃이 찾는 이들의 눈을 즐겁게 해 줍니다.
사이클링 코스도 정비되어 있어 자전거로 넓은 원내를 돌며 볼 수도 있습니다. 또한 25 종류 이상의 어트랙션을 즐길 수 있는 놀이공원 '프레저가든'외에 BMX 코스나 임간 애슬래틱 광장, 바베큐 광장등도 있어 끝없이즐길 수 있습니다.


Công viên ven biển Hitachi　（Nhật Bản）
Công viên Hitachi là một công viên đầy hoa với những bông hoa tuyệt vời nở quanh năm. Công viên này đặc biệt nổi tiếng với hoa Nemophilas. 
Vào khoảng tháng 5 hàng năm, khoảng 4.5 triệu bông hoa Nemophilas với đường kính bông hoa vào khoảng 3cm nở xanh cả sườn đồi.
Đặt biệt hơn nữa, khi đứng giữa đồi hoa Nemophilas,người ta có cảm giác như đang hòa mình vào đại dương xanh mênh mông tựa như bầu trời đang sa dần xuống mặt đất.

title: 【絶景茨城】 茨城の水辺　- Relaxation in IBARAKI -
description:
茨城の滝や渓谷などの水辺を紹介します。
【月待の滝】
大子町の月待の滝は久慈川の支流・大生瀬川がつくり出す、高さ17メートル・幅12メートルの三筋に流れ落ちる滝です。
水の後ろに回り込んで、滝を裏側から見ることができます。
夏には子どもの水遊び、秋は紅葉、冬は氷瀑と、季節に応じて様々な姿を見せてくれます。

【竜神峡】
常陸太田市の竜神峡は、奥久慈県立自然公園に位置するV字形の美しい渓谷です。竜神ダムの上に竜神峡のシンボル竜神大吊橋がかかります。峡谷のほぼ中央に位置する亀ヶ淵は清らかな水をたたえ、竜神ダムから歩いて訪れることができます。
冬はバードウォッチング，春から秋にかけては小鳥の声を聞きながらの自然散策に最適。遊歩道も整備されていて春のツツジから秋の紅葉まで楽しめます。

【花貫渓谷】
高萩市の花貫渓谷は、大小さまざまな淵と滝が連なり、四季折々の渓谷の自然を楽しむことができます。春の新緑と秋の紅葉、冬は雪景色。花貫渓谷では季節とともに移り変わる自然の姿を楽しむことができます。
上流の汐見滝吊り橋からは、眼下に勢いよく流れ落ちる汐見滝の姿や小さな淵をぬって流れる花貫川の清流に出会うことができます。下流の乙女滝・不動滝周辺では夏にかけては新緑が生い茂り花貫川を流れる水も空気も澄んでいて、清涼感を感じられるスポットです。秋は、紅葉と滝を同時に楽しむことが出来ます。

title: [Spectacular Ibaraki] The Waterside of Ibaraki - Relaxation in IBARAKI -
description:
Introducing the waterside of Ibaraki, including waterfalls and valleys.

[Tsukimachi Falls]
Tsukimachi Falls in Daigo Town is a waterfall that flows down in three streams, with a height of 17 meters and a width of 12 meters, created by the Oonase River, a tributary of the Kuji River. 
You can walk behind the water and see the waterfall from the back. 
In summer, it is a place for children's water play, in autumn, it showcases beautiful foliage, and in winter, it transforms into an icefall, presenting various appearances according to the seasons.

[Ryujin Gorge]
Ryujin Gorge in Hitachiota City is a beautiful V-shaped gorge located in the Oku-Kuji Prefectural Natural Park. The symbol of Ryujin Gorge, the Ryujin Big Suspension Bridge, spans over the Ryujin Dam. 
Kamega-uchi, located almost in the center of the gorge, holds clear water and can be visited by walking from the Ryujin Dam. 
In winter, it is perfect for bird watching, and from spring to autumn, it is ideal for nature walks while listening to the songs of small birds. 
The walking paths are well-maintained, allowing enjoyment from spring azaleas to autumn foliage.

[Hanakuni Gorge]
Hanakuni Gorge in Takahagi City features various pools and waterfalls, allowing you to enjoy the natural beauty of the gorge throughout the seasons. 
In spring, you can see fresh greenery, in autumn, beautiful foliage, and in winter, a snowy landscape. 
At Hanakuni Gorge, you can enjoy the changing natural scenery with the seasons. 
From the Shio-mi Falls suspension bridge upstream, you can encounter the powerful Shio-mi Falls flowing below and the clear waters of the Hanakuni River winding through small pools. 
Around the downstream areas of Otome Falls and Fudo Falls, lush greenery flourishes in summer, and both the water flowing in the Hanakuni River and the air are clear, making it a refreshing spot. 
In autumn, you can enjoy both the foliage and the waterfalls at the same time.

title: 西塩子の回り舞台【絶景茨城 】
description: 「西塩子の回り舞台」は茨城県の山里に江戸時代から続く農村歌舞伎の舞台で、現存する回り舞台としては日本で最も古い年代に属しています。一度は公演が途絶えた時期もあったものの、地域住民の努力により1997年に半世紀ぶりに復元しました。現在では3年に一度の開催（2025年はコロナ禍を経て6年ぶりの開催）となっています。この舞台は、毎回組み立てては解体する点が最大の特徴。地域住民総出で丸太と竹を組み立て、一夜限りの大舞台を出現させます。

title: Nishi Shio Ko's Rotating Stage【Scenic Ibaraki】
description: The 'Nishi Shio Ko's Rotating Stage' is a rural kabuki stage that has been in existence since the Edo period in the mountainous area of Ibaraki Prefecture, and it belongs to the oldest existing rotating stages in Japan. Although there was a period when performances ceased, it was restored in 1997 after half a century due to the efforts of local residents. Currently, it is held once every three years (the 2025 event will be the first in six years after the COVID-19 pandemic). The biggest feature of this stage is that it is assembled and disassembled each time. Local residents come together to construct a large stage using logs and bamboo for a one-night-only performance.

花貫渓谷は、渓谷にかかる汐見滝吊り橋からの眺めが素晴らしく、清流や汐見滝を楽しめるほか、秋には川沿いを華やかな紅葉が彩ります。

花園渓谷は、花園花貫県立自然公園に指定されている花園川上流一帯の渓谷で、麓には花園神社が立ちます。秋には色づいた紅葉が花園川に舞い落ち、ひときわ美しい風景を見せてくれます。

竜神大吊橋は、竜神ダムの湖面から高さ100mの位置に架かる橋です。橋の長さは歩行者専用として国内最大級の375mを誇り、橋の上からは四季折々のパノラマが広がります。

袋田の滝は日本三名瀑の一つです。滝が四段に落下することや、四季に一度ずつ訪れなければ本当の良さがわからないとも言われ、別名「四度の滝」とも呼ばれています。

title: [Spectacular Ibaraki] Autumn Leaves in Ibaraki | VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
We introduce the famous autumn foliage spots in Ibaraki Prefecture, featuring aerial shots.

Mount Tsukuba is a treasure trove of over 1,000 rare plant species, making it attractive for nature lovers throughout the year with activities like climbing and hiking.

The Hananuki Valley offers stunning views from the Shioimi Falls suspension bridge, where visitors can enjoy the clear stream and Shioimi Falls, while in autumn, the riverside is adorned with vibrant autumn leaves.

Hananora Valley is a gorge located in the upper reaches of the Hananora River, designated as Hananora Hananuki Prefectural Natural Park, with Hananora Shrine at its base. In autumn, the colorful leaves fall onto the Hananora River, creating an exceptionally beautiful landscape.

The Ryujin Big Suspension Bridge is a bridge that spans 100 meters above the surface of the Ryujin Dam lake. With a length of 375 meters, it boasts one of the largest pedestrian-only bridges in Japan, offering panoramic views of the changing seasons from the bridge.

Fukuroda Falls is one of Japan's three famous waterfalls. It is said that the waterfall's four-tiered drop and the need to visit each season to truly appreciate its beauty have earned it the nickname 'Four Times Falls.'

title: 松山城天守閣に行ってきました！
description: ここは、愛媛県松山市にある松山城です。松山城には、加藤嘉明の鎧や当時使われていた武器が展示されています。その他にも、武装服を試着できたり、松山城小天守復興の様子のビデオを視聴することもできます。そして、天守閣では360°のパノラマを見ることができます！RyoFさんが松山城入口までの景色を撮影しております！→https://youtu.be/T1l3eHh-TaQ

title: I visited Matsuyama Castle's Main Keep!
description: This is Matsuyama Castle located in Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture. Matsuyama Castle displays armor worn by Kato Yoshiaki and weapons used at that time. Additionally, you can try on armored clothing and watch a video of the restoration of the Matsuyama Castle's small keep. Furthermore, you can enjoy a 360° panorama from the main keep! RyoF has captured the scenery leading to the entrance of Matsuyama Castle! → https://youtu.be/T1l3eHh-TaQ

title: 大洲城に行ってきました！
description: ここは、愛媛県大洲市大洲９０３にある大洲城です。大洲城には、2004年に復元された天守をはじめ、国指定重要文化財に選定された4棟の櫓があります。そしてこの動画の最後には、愛媛県松山市を流れる宮前川にいたコガモを撮影しております。

title: I visited Ozu Castle!
description: This is Ozu Castle, located at 903 Ozu, Ozu City, Ehime Prefecture. Ozu Castle features a main keep that was restored in 2004, along with four turrets designated as Important Cultural Properties by the national government. At the end of this video, we also captured footage of a female teal that was in the Miyamae River flowing through Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture.

title: 大洲城 歓迎はたふり
description: このイベントは、愛媛県大洲市大洲９０３にある大洲城で行われている「大洲城 歓迎はたふり」です！大洲城では、JR四国の観光列車「伊予灘ものがたり」が鉄橋をゆっくり渡るとき、大洲城本丸からのぼり旗を振って、歓迎しています。開催日は毎週土・日・祝日、時間は15:16頃と16:25頃の２回です。参加無料です。 そしてこの動画の最後には、愛媛県松山市を流れる宮前川にいたコガモを撮影しております。

title: Ozu Castle Welcome Hataburi
description: This event is called 'Ozu Castle Welcome Hataburi' and takes place at Ozu Castle located at 903 Ozu, Ozu City, Ehime Prefecture! At Ozu Castle, we wave welcome flags from the main keep when the JR Shikoku sightseeing train 'Iyodan Monogatari' slowly crosses the bridge. The event is held every Saturday, Sunday, and public holiday, with two sessions at around 15:16 and 16:25. Participation is free. At the end of this video, we also captured a female duck (Kogamo) in the Miyamae River flowing through Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture.

description: この演武は、平成30年(2018年)1月28日に堀之内と松山城で行われた「第５回 全国城サミットin松山」です。この演武では、織田信長と豊臣秀吉と徳川家康の楽しい話を聞いて楽しめます！そして、演武終了後は、織田信長と豊臣秀吉と徳川家康と一緒に写真撮影ができます！ 丸亀城鉄砲隊の演武はこちら！→https://youtu.be/lgCToSMmet4

title: I went to see the performance of the Nagoya Omotenashi Busho-tai!
description: This performance took place on January 28, 2018, at Horinouchi and Matsuyama Castle during the "5th National Castle Summit in Matsuyama." In this performance, you can enjoy fun stories about Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Tokugawa Ieyasu! After the performance, you can take photos with Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Tokugawa Ieyasu! You can see the performance of the Marugame Castle Gun Corps here! → https://youtu.be/lgCToSMmet4

title: 丸亀城鉄砲隊の演武を見てきました！
description: このイベントは、愛媛県松山市の堀之内で行われた「第５回 全国城サミットin松山」の丸亀城鉄砲隊の演武です。この演武では、安土桃山時代に使われていた火縄銃の迫力を感じることができます。実際の安土桃山時代の迫力を感じてみて下さい！ 名古屋おもてなし武将隊の演武はこちら！→https://youtu.be/nSs7-jqvqVQ

title: I Went to See the Demonstration of the Marugame Castle Gun Corps!
description: This event is the demonstration of the Marugame Castle Gun Corps at the '5th National Castle Summit in Matsuyama' held in Horinouchi, Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture. In this demonstration, you can experience the power of the matchlock guns used during the Azuchi-Momoyama period. Feel the actual intensity of the Azuchi-Momoyama period! You can watch the performance of the Nagoya Hospitality Samurai Corps here! → https://youtu.be/nSs7-jqvqVQ

description:
ここは、愛媛県宇和島市にある宇和島城です。宇和島城は、標高80mの丘上に築かれた平山城です。伊達氏2代宗利が大改修し現在の形になってます。天守閣は国指定重要文化財です。 天守編→https://youtu.be/niqMlrwPq6M

title: I visited Uwajima Castle! (Castle Climbing Edition)
description:
This is Uwajima Castle located in Uwajima City, Ehime Prefecture. Uwajima Castle is a flatland castle built on a hill with an elevation of 80m. It was significantly renovated by the second generation of the Date clan, Muneyoshi, to take its current form. The main keep is designated as an important cultural property by the country. Main keep edition → https://youtu.be/niqMlrwPq6M

title: 愛媛県四国中央市「川之江城」に行ってみた！
description:
ここは、愛媛県四国中央市にある川之江城です。川之江は、昭和61年(1986年)に天守閣、涼櫓、櫓門、空塀などが整備された城で、瀬戸内の島々の眺望が素晴らしく、桜の名所として多くの観光客が訪れている場所です。皆さんも是非行ってみて下さい。

#川之江城 #城 #愛媛県四国中央市

title: I Went to Kawanoe Castle in Shikokuchuo City, Ehime Prefecture!
description: This is Kawanoe Castle located in Shikokuchuo City, Ehime Prefecture. Kawanoe is a castle that was developed in 1986 (Showa 61) with its main keep, cool turret, turret gate, and sky walls, offering a wonderful view of the islands of the Seto Inland Sea. It is a famous cherry blossom spot that attracts many tourists. Please make sure to visit!

title: 【しまなみ海道伯方島】探索！木浦城跡(伯方ふるさと歴史公園)！
description:
ここは、愛媛県今治市伯方町にある木浦城跡(伯方ふるさと歴史公園)です。木浦城跡(伯方ふるさと歴史公園)には、城や古墳があり、まさに歴史を感じることのできる公園です。

#しまなみ海道 #伯方島 #愛媛県今治市

title: Exploring the Kiu Castle Ruins (Hakaba Furusato History Park) on Shimanami Kaido Hakata Island!
description: This is the Kiu Castle Ruins (Hakaba Furusato History Park) located in Hakaba Town, Imabari City, Ehime Prefecture. The Kiu Castle Ruins (Hakaba Furusato History Park) features a castle and ancient tombs, making it a park where you can truly feel the history.

title: 天守閣からの景色は絶景！岩国城を探索してみた！
description:

#山口県岩国市 #城 #おしろ #お城 #景色 #絶景 #天守閣

title: The view from the castle tower is breathtaking! Exploring Iwakuni Castle!
description: This is Iwakuni Castle located in Iwakuni City, Yamaguchi Prefecture. It is famous for its views from the mountaintop and its display of Japanese swords.

title: 🌸 Edo: The Foundation of Modern Tokyo
description: Edo, the predecessor of Tokyo, grew into one of the world’s largest cities of its time. From the daily lives of its people blossomed a rich and unique culture—both tangible and intangible. Edo embraced elegance, flourished its culture, and welcomed diverse ideas and values. Arising from its openness, limitless imagination and daring ambition to take on challenges breathed life into the city. The heart of Edo flows continuously through Tokyo today. Shining its present and its future.

title: 🌸 江戸：現代東京の基盤
description: 江戸は東京の前身であり、当時の世界最大の都市の一つに成長しました。人々の日常生活から、豊かで独自の文化が花開きました—有形無形の両方で。江戸は優雅さを受け入れ、文化を栄えさせ、多様なアイデアや価値観を歓迎しました。その開放性から生まれた無限の想像力と挑戦する大胆な野心がこの街に命を吹き込みました。江戸の心は今日の東京を通じて流れ続けています。現在と未来を輝かせています。

title: Tokyo's Green Urban Development since Edo Period
description: Tokyo is always evolving. For over 400 years since the Edo period, the city has preserved its green spaces. I research urban design by observing pedestrians and speaking with residents and business owners. These green spaces are important for a happy city life. This mindset hasn’t changed since the Edo period. They help foster an enjoyable life where people can thrive. 100 years from now, we'll still make sure Tokyo is sustainable and exists in harmony with nature.

title: 江戸時代以来の東京の緑の都市開発
description: 東京は常に進化しています。江戸時代以来400年以上にわたり、都市は緑地を保護してきました。私は歩行者を観察し、住民や事業主と話すことで都市デザインを研究しています。これらの緑地は、幸せな都市生活にとって重要です。この考え方は江戸時代から変わっていません。人々が繁栄できる楽しい生活を育むのに役立ちます。100年後も、東京が持続可能で自然と調和して存在し続けることを確実にします。

title: Enchanting Tokyo HACHIJOJIMA Island (Full ver.)／八丈島
description:
Hachijojima Island, which is less than an hour’s flight from Tokyo, is an island where you can enjoy the great outdoors.
With one of the highest precipitation rates in Japan, Hachijojima has its own unique environment including giant ferns and potholes carved into the rock by ever-flowing spring water.
On the island, you can enjoy hiking as well as running and fishing.
After enjoying physical activities, visitors can relax in a natural hot spring surrounded by rich nature, making it the perfect environment for a refreshing weekend getaway.

Access
・Airplane (Haneda Airport-Hachijojima Airport) 3 flights/day [approximately 55 minutes, one way]
・Boat (Takeshiba Pier, Tokyo- Hachijojima, Sokodo or Yaene Port): Runs daily [10 hours and 20 minutes, one way]

Hachijojima Tourist Information
https://www.gotokyo.org/en/destinations/izu-and-ogasawara-islands/hachijojima-island/index.html

東京から飛行機で1時間弱で到着する八丈島は、大自然と向き合える島です。
日本でも降水量がトップクラスとなる八丈島は、巨大なシダ植物や、枯れることのない湧水によって岩盤が削られたポットホールなど独自の自然を育んでいます。
島ではトレッキングはもちろんランニングや釣りなども楽しめます。
身体を動かすアクティビティを楽しんだ後は、豊かな自然に囲まれた天然温泉でリラックスすることができ、週末のリフレッシュには最適な環境です。

アクセス
・飛行機（羽田空港－八丈島空港）：1日3便［片道約55分］
・船（東京・竹芝桟橋－八丈島・底土または八重根港）：毎日運航［片道約10時間20分］

八丈島観光情報
https://www.gotokyo.org/jp/destinations/izu-and-ogasawara-islands/hachijojima-island/index.html

title: Enchanting Tokyo AOGASHIMA Island (Full ver.)／青ヶ島
description:
Aogashima Island, located 358 kilometers (222 miles) south of urban Tokyo in the Pacific Ocean, was the only Japanese location selected as the “World’s Top 13 Most Beautiful Views to See Before you Die” by a US-based NGO, thereby attracting attention from around the world. The video “Enchanting Tokyo AOGASHIMA Island” introduces the unique landscape of the island, including the world-famous double caldera and geothermic “hingya” steam eruptions. The video also explores the island’s way of life and beliefs that coexist in harmony with nature. 

Access
・Helicopter (Hachijojima Airport-Aogashima Heliport): 1 flight/day [20 minutes, one way]
・Boat (Hachijojima, Sokodo or Yaene Port-Aogashima, Sanpo Port): 4-5 trips weekly [2 hours and 30 minutes, one way]

title: 【高画質】阿蘇山観音まつり
description:
令和5年4月13日、阿蘇市黒川の西巌殿寺で「阿蘇山観音まつり」が行われ、山伏姿の行者らが行う荒行「火渡り」「湯立て」に参加しようと、多くの参拝者が集まりました。

ヒノキの葉っぱなどでこしらえた護摩壇に火が入ると、山伏姿の行者らが厳かにお経を唱えながら、願いごとが書かれた護摩木を火に投げ入れて無病息災を祈願。そして燃え続ける火の上を裸足で渡る「火渡り」が行われました。

一般の参拝者は、火の勢いが衰えたあと、行者らに続いて灰の上を裸足で歩き、最後にはぐらぐらと煮えたぎった湯しぶきを浴びる荒行「湯立て」に参加して一年間の無病息災を祈りました。

この阿蘇山観音まつりは西南戦争で殉職した西巌殿寺の住職、厨亮俊僧の招魂祭として、命日である4月13日に例年行われています。

title: [High Quality] Aso Mountain Kannon Festival
description:
On April 13, 2023, the 'Aso Mountain Kannon Festival' was held at the Saigandaji Temple in Kurokawa, Aso City, where many worshippers gathered to participate in the ascetic practices of 'fire walking' and 'water purification' performed by practitioners dressed as yamabushi.

As the fire was lit on the goma altar made of hinoki leaves and other materials, the yamabushi solemnly chanted sutras while throwing goma sticks inscribed with their wishes into the flames, praying for good health and safety. Then, the 'fire walking' ritual was conducted, where participants walked barefoot over the burning fire.

After the intensity of the fire diminished, general worshippers followed the practitioners and walked barefoot over the ashes, ultimately participating in the intense 'water purification' ritual, where they were splashed with boiling water, praying for a year of good health and safety.

This Aso Mountain Kannon Festival is held annually on April 13, the anniversary of the death of the temple's priest, Ryojun Churi, who died in the Seinan War, as a memorial service for his spirit.

title: 千年の草原
description:

27万年前からの度重なる大噴火で出来たカルデラと呼ばれるくぼ地に、約5万人が暮らす、世界でも珍しい場所です。
カルデラの中央には、今も噴煙を上げる活火山阿蘇山がそびえ、その周辺には日本最大の草原地帯が広がります。
この唯一無二の空間は、国立公園、ユネスコ世界ジオパーク、世界農業遺産にも認定されています。

title: Thousand-Year Grassland
description:
Aso region in Kumamoto Prefecture, Kyushu.

This is a rare place in the world where about 50,000 people live in a caldera, a depression formed by repeated massive eruptions over the past 270,000 years.

At the center of the caldera stands the active volcano Mount Aso, which still emits smoke, and surrounding it is Japan's largest grassland area.

This unique space has been designated as a national park, a UNESCO Global Geopark, and a World Agricultural Heritage site.

title: [Nature 4K] 'Aso Aso Takana' High-Quality Healing Video
description:
A series capturing the rich landscapes of Aso with a 4K camera, 'SCENE of the ASO'.

Vol.7 features the spring delicacy of Aso, 'Aso Takana'.

Aso Takana is a variety of mustard plant from the Brassicaceae family, grown in the unique natural environment of Aso, characterized by significant temperature differences and volcanic ash-rich soil.
Seeds are sown in October, overwintering under the snow, and harvested from March to April. The harvesting method, where each stem is snapped by hand, is called 'Takana-ori'. On beautiful spring days, the sight of Takana-ori in the fields of Aso is commonly seen.
After harvesting, it is immediately pickled. By rubbing in salt and chili peppers, within a week, you can enjoy the crisp texture and delightful spiciness of the freshly pickled Takana.

Enjoy the sound of the snapping Takana during the harvest and the noise of rubbing in salt during the pickling process.

About 400 years ago, it is said that merchants from Omi brought the brewing techniques of sake to this region, marking the beginning of authentic sake production. 
In the Morioka area, there are nine traditional sake breweries that have been preserved over the years, continuing the legacy of the Nanbu Toji tradition while striving for new challenges in sake making. 
Experience the passion and love of Iwate's sake production from the toji (master brewers) and kurabito (brewery workers). 
And let's raise a glass with Iwate's sake. 
Welcome to the Land of Sake Iwate!

title: いわて短角牛の郷－平庭闘牛－
description:
いわて短角牛とは……
国内で牛肉として流通する牛のうち、わずか0.4％足らずという幻の和牛『日本短角種』。岩手県は日本短角種発祥の地といわれ、国内最大の産地でもあります。

岩手県久慈市では、東北地方唯一の闘牛大会が開催されています。
この地方では、古くは藩政時代（江戸時代）、沿岸部で生産された塩を、在来の「南部牛」に乗せて内陸の盛岡方面へ運んでいました（塩の道）。その隊列の先頭牛（ワガサ）を決めるため、牛に角突きをさせたのが闘牛の始まりとされています。
現在のように観光行事化されたのは昭和58年からです。（久慈市HPより）

※南部牛は、明治の開国により海外品種との交配が行われ、昭和32年に４番目の和牛「日本短角種」として品種登録。

title: Iwate Short-Horned Cattle - Hiraniwa Bullfighting -
description:
Iwate Short-Horned Cattle is...
Among the beef cattle distributed in Japan, the elusive wagyu 'Japanese Short-Horned Breed' accounts for only about 0.4%. Iwate Prefecture is said to be the birthplace of the Japanese Short-Horned Breed and is also the largest production area in the country.

In Kuji City, Iwate Prefecture, the only bullfighting tournament in the Tohoku region is held.
In this region, dating back to the feudal era (Edo period), salt produced along the coast was transported inland to Morioka on the backs of the native 'Nanbu Cattle' (Salt Road). It is said that bullfighting began when bulls were made to butt heads to determine the lead bull (Wagasa) of the procession.
The event became a tourist attraction starting in 1983. (From Kuji City HP)

*Nanbu Cattle were crossbred with foreign breeds due to the opening of Japan in the Meiji era, and were registered as the fourth wagyu breed 'Japanese Short-Horned Breed' in 1957.

title: [Excellent Award] 004 Morioka Castle Let's try 'Tojo'
description:
The Nanbu clan has an 800-year history. Morioka Castle, which served as their residence, is selected as one of Japan's 100 Famous Castles and is counted among the three famous castles of Tohoku. However, perhaps due to the absence of a main keep, its name recognition is weak. Still, Morioka Castle has its own charm! Even without a restored main keep, there is a place here where you can reflect on the Edo period!! With this sentiment in mind, we aimed to create a promotional video for Morioka Castle themed around 'Castle Climbing.' 
Additionally, we have included explanations in subtitles (in Japanese and English) for viewing on company PCs and smartphones.

description:

起伏の少ないコースなので、子どもの自然学習の場としても安心してお薦めできます。

title: Ogasawara Ishina Natural Cedar Walking Path [Summer Edition]
description:

In Niigata Prefecture, a walking path has been developed to allow visitors to safely view these magnificent natural cedars.
The course has little elevation change, making it a safe and recommended place for children's nature learning.

title: Asuka no Yu-sen Installation in Dogo, Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture
description: In the courtyard 'Hadaka Hiroba' of Dogo Onsen Bekkan Asuka no Yu-sen, approximately 230 flower photographs by Mika Ninagawa will be exhibited. It will be a large-scale installation that also utilizes the outdoor floor. The exhibition period is from October 27, 2021 (Wednesday) to February 29, 2024 (Thursday). Although it is nearing completion, it was in a no-entry state during the video shoot on October 25. This is likely a preparation period to firmly establish the works. From the 27th, it will be possible to enter. It goes without saying that Ms. Ninagawa's works, with their vivid colors, will stand out. A new photo spot in Dogo will be born. Let's take photos and liven up Dogo on social media like Instagram and Twitter. 'The energy of Ehime comes from Dogo!'

title: Uwajima Ushi-Oni Festival Fireworks Display (2023.7.23)
description:
I went to see the fireworks display at the Uwajima Ushi-Oni Festival.
It was about a 40-minute fireworks show from 8:30 to 9:10, but during that time, the main camera had some troubles and stopped recording due to overheating, making for a challenging 40 minutes. However, I managed to stitch together the footage that was captured into a video just under 9 minutes long.

As for my impressions of the fireworks, I thought they were generally positioned low, but then some went up to heights that far exceeded the frame, which seemed to be a bit of a challenge for the person filming. Although I was using a 360° camera, so I didn't miss the frame, there were many parts in the editing that had to be cropped out. The overall composition could have been better, I think.
It might be understandable since it was the first event in several years. I look forward to next year.

description:

title: 宇和島闘牛５月場所(2025.5.3)
description:
年に4回の 晴れ舞台のひとつ。
宇和島闘牛5月場所が2025年5月3日に行われました。
闘牛のルールは制限時間なしで牛同士が戦い、逃げた方が敗けというシンプルなものになっています。
お天気も良くゴールデンウィークということで入場者数は2400人を超える大入満員大盛況のうちに幕を閉じました。
2時間半に渡る長丁場でありましたが主な戦いの箇所をまとめました。
闘牛の魅力が少しでも伝われば良いかなと思っています。

One of the four big stages of the year.
The Uwajima Bullfighting May Tournament took place on May 3, 2025.
The rules of bullfighting are simple: bulls fight each other with no time limit, and the one that runs away loses.
The weather was fine, and it was Golden Week, so the event was a huge success, with over 2,400 attendees.
It was a long event lasting two and a half hours, but we have summarized the main fights.
We hope that we have been able to convey at least a little of the appeal of bullfighting.

title: 伊達なうわじまお城まつり(2025.5.4)
description: 宇和島市は５月４,５日と「伊達なうわじまお城まつり」が行われています。お休みが４日だけなんで「秀宗公入部伊達五十七騎大武者行列」を見に出かけて来ました。混雑が大嫌いなYoutuberなんでお城まつりは初参戦となります。GW真っ只中ということで観光客でごった返す中ワサワサと走り回って撮れ高が十分だしたのでお城山までの行列はパスして曲作りをするために帰宅しました。今回の姫は「塩見きら」さんでした。

title: The Date Uwajima Castle Festival (2025.5.4)
description: The Date Uwajima Castle Festival is being held on May 4th and 5th in Uwajima city. As I only have the 4th off, I went to see the Procession of 57 Date Knights and Lord Hidemune's Warriors. As a YouTuber who hates crowds, this was my first time taking part in a castle festival. As it was the middle of Golden Week, I was able to run around in the midst of the throngs of tourists and took enough photos, so I skipped the procession up to Shiroyama and went home to work on writing a song. The princess this time was Shiomi Kira.

title: 宇和島市 津島町 南楽園(2025.5.29)
description: 小雨の中、宇和島市津島町の日本庭園「南楽園」へ行ってきました。 ただいま夜間延長開園中で21:00まで園内を見ることができます。「竹灯籠の夕べ」ということで灯籠が飾られていたり花菖蒲がライトアップされています。開花状況ですが園のXによると3割程度とありますが29日時点で5割ほどではないかと感じました。週末が見ごろになるでしょう。

title: Uwajima City Tsushima Town Nanrakuen (2025.5.29)
description: I visited the Japanese garden 'Nanrakuen' in Tsushima Town, Uwajima City, in light rain. The garden is currently open until 21:00 for extended night hours. It is decorated with lanterns for the 'Bamboo Lantern Evening' and the irises are illuminated. According to the garden's X, the blooming status is about 30%, but I felt it was around 50% as of the 29th. It should be in full bloom by the weekend.

description: 和歌山からはじまり、大阪、奈良へと続く祈りの道、「葛城修験（かつらぎしゅげん）」。この峰々一帯は「葛城」と呼ばれ、多くの神々が住まう山として古来より人々に崇められてきました。修験道の開祖とされる役行者（えんのぎょうじゃ）が最初に修行の地として選んだのも、ここ葛城。修験者たちは今でもこの地で、巡礼の旅を続けています。

title: Japan Heritage 'Katsuragi Shugendo' PR Video 3-Minute Version
description: The path of prayer that begins in Wakayama and continues to Osaka and Nara, 'Katsuragi Shugendo'. This area of peaks is called 'Katsuragi' and has been revered by people since ancient times as a mountain where many deities reside. The founder of Shugendo, En no Gyoja, also chose Katsuragi as his first training ground. Practitioners of Shugendo continue their pilgrimage in this area even today.

title: Türkiye-Japonya zamanı aşan dostluk ～ Ertuğrul Fırkateyni ile başlayan dostluk bağı ～
description: 1890年（明治23年）9月16日に、オスマン帝国から日本へ初めて友好使節として「エルトゥールル艦」が送られました。任務を終えた艦は帰路の途中で和歌山県の大島地域（現在の串本）で岩に衝突し、沈没しました。この悲劇的な事故で587人の海軍士官が命を落としました。大島の人々の救助活動により69人が救出されました。この「エルトゥールル事故」は、その後、日本とトルコの友好関係の始まりとなりました。この事故から1年後、トルコの記念碑が建立され、その前で式典が行われました。それ以来、トルコ大使館と串本町の共催で5年ごとに大規模な式典が行われています。2015年6月6日には125周年の追悼式典が行われ、串本と和歌山はトルコとの関係をさらに深めました。

title: Turkey-Japan Friendship That Transcends Time ～ The Bond of Friendship Begun with the Ertuğrul Frigate ～
description: On September 16, 1890 (Meiji 23), the 'Ertuğrul Frigate' was sent from the Ottoman Empire to Japan as the first friendship envoy. After completing its mission, the frigate sank after hitting rocks in the Oshima region of Wakayama Prefecture (now Kushimoto) on its return journey. In this tragic accident, 587 sailors lost their lives. Thanks to the rescue efforts of the Oshima people, 69 individuals were saved. This 'Ertuğrul Accident' later became the catalyst for the formation of friendship ties between Japan and Turkey. A year after this incident, a Turkish monument was erected, and a ceremony was held in front of it. Since then, large ceremonies have been held every five years in collaboration with the Turkish Embassy and Kushimoto Municipality. On June 6, 2015, the 125th-anniversary memorial ceremonies were held, further developing the relationship between Kushimoto and Wakayama with Turkey.

title: Residence and Tulip Garden Public Viewing | Tulip Garden Embassy of the Netherlands in Japan
description:
#happydutchspring2022 #nlinjapan #tulips #netherlandsandyou #netherlandsinjapan

The Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Japan hosted a Residence and Tulip Garden Public Viewing last April 8 and 10, Friday and Sunday respectively. This is in view of welcoming the Dutch Spring this year, which features 70 kinds of tulips, the largest number ever.

“Tulips, the national flower of the Netherlands, along with other flowers, are a major export industry of the Netherlands. It is said that about 80% of the world's tulip fields are in the Netherlands. This year, the Ambassador's residence is decorated with about 13,000 tulips of 70 varieties, the largest number ever imported from the Netherlands.”- nlinjp.com

It is our pleasure to have joined and witnessed this event and we are pleased to share with you some of the lovely photos and videos we have captured during the said event.

A special Thank You to the Ambassador of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Japan for sharing and hosting this rare opportunity to the public. It is our pleasure to have seen these Tulip varieties in your Residence giving us the Netherlands’ spring feels while in Japan.

title: Places to Visit in Nikko Japan | Yudaki Falls | Travel Guide
description:
#nikko #yudakifalls #japantravel #japanvlog #visitjapanjp #mybestjapanmoments #japantour

Yudaki Falls is a waterfall in the Oku-Nikko area of Nikko City, Tochigi Prefecture. Measuring 50 meters (164 feet) high and 25 meters (82 feet) wide, it is one of the three major waterfalls in Oku-Nikko along with Kegon Falls and Ryuzu Falls. It flows down from the south shore of Lake Yuno-ko, which is located at the foot of Mt. Nikko-Shirane, one of Japan's 100 Major Mountains. There is Nikko Yumoto Onsen on the banks of Lake Yuno-ko, and the entire Yuno-ko area has hot springs all over the place, but it is not hot water but cold water that flows down the Yudaki despite of its name Yudaki aka Yutaki (Yu=hot water, daki/taki=waterfall). The water from the waterfall becomes the River Yukawa, which flows through one of Japan's most prominent wetland of high elevation, Senjo-gahara Marshland, then flows down the Ryuzu Falls to Lake Chuzenji-ko. A promenade is provided on the side of the Yudaki Falls, from where you can watch three points of the waterfall such as its mouth, basin and side. Watching the waterfall basin up close from the observation deck is expecially significant.

title: 日本の日光で訪れるべき場所 | 湯滝 | 旅行ガイド
description:
#nikko #yudakifalls #japantravel #japanvlog #visitjapanjp #mybestjapanmoments #japantour

湯滝は、栃木県日光市の奥日光エリアにある滝です。高さ50メートル（164フィート）、幅25メートル（82フィート）で、華厳の滝や竜頭の滝と並ぶ奥日光の三大滝の一つです。日本の100名山の一つである日光白根山の麓に位置する湯ノ湖の南岸から流れ落ちています。湯ノ湖の岸には日光湯元温泉があり、湯ノ湖エリア全体には温泉が点在していますが、湯滝はその名に反して温泉水ではなく冷水が流れています（湯=温水、滝=滝）。滝の水は湯川となり、日本の高地湿原の一つである仙女ヶ原湿原を流れ、竜頭の滝を経て中禅寺湖に流れ込みます。湯滝の側には遊歩道が整備されており、滝の口、盆地、側面など、滝の三つのポイントを観賞することができます。展望デッキから滝の盆地を間近で見ることは特に意義深い体験です。

Nikko (日光, Nikkō) is a town at the entrance to Nikko National Park, most famous for Toshogu, Japan's most lavishly decorated shrine and the mausoleum of Tokugawa Ieyasu, the founder of the Tokugawa shogunate.

Nikko had been a center of Shinto and Buddhist mountain worship for many centuries before Toshogu was built in the 1600s, and Nikko National Park continues to offer scenic, mountainous landscapes, lakes, waterfalls, hot springs, wild monkeys and hiking trails.

title: Chair Lift Ride at Mount Takao (Ascend) | Japan's Steepest Slope | 高尾山　チェアリフト
description:
#mttakao #chairlift #japan #mttakoadventures #steepestslopeinjapan #mttakaochairlift #japanadventures #mybestjapanmoments #visitjapanjp #viaggiatotravelservices

Mount Takao (高尾山, Takao-san) is a mountain in the city of Hachiōji, Tokyo, Japan. It is protected within Meiji no Mori Takao Quasi-National Park.

Standing 599 metres (1,965 ft) tall and located within an hour of downtown Tokyo, it is a popular hiking spot, with eight hiking courses and more than 2.5 million annual visitors. The Tama Forest Science Garden is also located at the mountain's base.

THE CHAIR LIFT RIDE

In addition to the cable car Mt. Takao also has a chair lift that you can ride to the midway point of the mountain!
The ride time is about 12 minutes so why not enjoy an aerial trip through the mountains?

The distance from “Sanroku Station” at the foot of the mountain to “Sanjo Station” in the middle is about 872m, which is shorter than the distance the cable car travels (The cable car travels a total of 1,020m).

Mount Takao (高尾山, Takao-san) is a mountain in the city of Hachiōji, Tokyo, Japan. It is protected within Meiji no Mori Takao Quasi-National Park.

Standing 599 metres (1,965 ft) tall and located within an hour of downtown Tokyo, it is a popular hiking spot, with eight hiking courses and more than 2.5 million annual visitors. The Tama Forest Science Garden is also located at the mountain's base.

Mount Takao is closely associated with the Shinto-Buddhist tengu, minor kami from Japanese folklore, and the daitengu Naigubu. title: Autumn at Shinobazu Pond | Boat Ride | Ueno Park | 不忍池　上野公園
description:
#shinobazupond #shinobazunoike #uenopark #autumn #boatride #boatpond #japan #tokyo ＃不忍池　＃上野公園

Come and join us as we show you the relaxing view of autumn at Shinobazu Pond.

Shinobazu no Ike which is found within the Ueno Park in Taito Ku Tokyo, is historically prominent and usually appears in Japanese history and works of art.

If you wanna ride a boat on the boat pond, make sure to wear a mask, sanitize your hands and let the staff check your temperature. Ticket machine is available at the entrance.

The price of boat ride varies with the type of boat you wanna ride on to. A Cycle boat costs 700 yen, maximum of 2 adults for 30 mins. Swan boat costs 800 yen maximum 3 adults for 30 mins. While a row boat costs 500 yen maximum of 3 adults for 30 mins.

Situated in the south of Ueno Park, the pond is divided in three sections. The Lotus Pond (蓮の池, Hasu no Ike), the Boat Pond (ボートの池, Bōto no Ike) and the third called Cormorant Pond (鵜の池, U no Ike).

The pond has a circumference of about 2 km and a surface area of about 1,100,000 sq meters. It hosts several dozens of types of migratory and stationary birds, whose number at times is over ten thousand. Among them particularly numerous are tufted ducks, pochard, and northern pintails. The pond also contains numerous species of fish, and the lotuses of Lotus Pond, which are grown fully in summer, cover the entire surface of the water, hiding it almost completely.

The event features colourful autumn leaves which stretch around Lake Kawaguchi area, and during daytime, the beautiful scenery can be enjoyed with the amazing view of Mt Fuji on the background.

The festival is centered around the “Momiji Corridor” or Momiji Kairo and is held from 9:00 in the morning. While the light up starts from sunset to 10:00 at night.

This is a walkway lined by over 60 maple trees with autumn colour leaves. The trees with red, yellow and orange leaves stretch for about 2km, displaying the stunning scenery.

title: Autumn at Ueno Park Tokyo | 上野公園
description:
#travelvlog #uenopark #uenotokyo #tokyojapan #autumnatuenopark

hey guys welcome to Ueno Park in Tokyo!

Ueno Park (上野公園, Ueno Kōen) is a large public park next to Ueno Station in central Tokyo. The park grounds were originally part of Kaneiji Temple, which used to be one of the city's largest and wealthiest temples and a family temple of the ruling Tokugawa clan during the Edo Period. Kaneiji stood in the northeast of the capital to protect the city from evil, much like Enryakuji Temple in Kyoto.

During the Boshin Civil War, which followed the Meiji Restoration in 1868, Kaneiji suffered nearly complete destruction in a battle between the victorious forces of the new Meiji government and loyalists of the overthrown shogunate. After the battle, the temple grounds were converted into one of Japan's first Western style parks and opened to the public in 1873. A statue of Saigo Takamori, one of the generals in the Battle of Ueno, stands near the park's southern entrance.

At the southwestern end of the park lies Shinobazu Pond, one of many reminders of Kaneiji Temple's former grandeur. The pond represents Lake Biwako (in a reference to Kaneiji's model, the Enryakuji Temple of Kyoto, which overlooks Lake Biwako). On an island in the middle of the pond stands Bentendo, a temple hall dedicated to the goddess of Benten.

Today Ueno Park is famous for the many museums found on its grounds, especially the Tokyo National Museum, the National Museum for Western Art, the Tokyo Metropolitan Art Museum and the National Science Museum. It is also home to Ueno Zoo, Japan's first zoological garden.

Additionally, Ueno Park is one of Tokyo's most popular and lively cherry blossom spots with more than 1000 cherry trees lining its central pathway. The cherry blossoms are usually in bloom during late March and early April and attract large numbers of hanami (cherry blossom viewing) parties.

title: Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome | Annual Halloween Pumpkin Month | Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse | Halloween Pumpkins
description:
#yumenoshimatropicalgreenhousedome #halloweentheme #pumpkinpatch #YumenoshimaTropicalGreenhouse #HalloweenPumpkins
Today we’re gonna explore the Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome.

The Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome was created to cover this broad theme of “the relationship between tropical plants and our lives.”
Enjoy the exotic scenery created by the wide variety of tropical plants in the large greenhouse. Learn about the plants and the tropics in the Movie Theater, Information Gallery, and Exhibition Hall. Take a full tour of the museum and learn about the relationship between tropical plants and human life without even realizing it.
Guided tours are offered on Saturdays, Sundays, national holidays, and during long vacations. Enjoy a fun tour while learning in detail about the plants in the greenhouse.

"The Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome (夢の島熱帯植物館, Yumenoshima Nettai Shokubutsukan), also sometimes called the Yumenoshima Tropical Plant Dome, is a botanical garden located at 3-2, Yumenoshima, Kōtō, Tokyo, Japan. It is operated by the Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association and open daily except Mondays; an admission fee is charged.

The greenhouse was established in 1988 in Yumenoshima ('Dream Island') Park, a reclaimed landfill and dumping ground in Tokyo Bay. Its three domes currently contain about 1,000 species of tropical and semitropical plants. The A Dome features rain forest with ferns and waterfall, B Dome represents a tropical village, and C Dome contains vegetation of the Ogasawara Islands. There is also a small carnivorous plant room.

The domes' plant collections include palms, orchids, aquatic plants, Pandanus, Hevea brasiliensis, Samanea saman, Barringtonia racemosa, Satakentia liukiuensis, Cyathea lepifera, C. mertensiana, C. spinulosa, and Dicksonia antarctica." -Wikipedia

Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome is celebrating their annual Halloween Pumpkin Month from end of September to First of November. You will see their Halloween theme all around the area, inside the museum and on their front lawn or garden are giant pumpkins where you and your kids can play around. Enjoy and shoot lovely Autumn and Halloween photos which will be a great memorabilia for you and your kids! 

10 minute walk from Shin-Kiba Station, which is 10 minutes from Tokyo Station on the Keiyo Line. Also accessible on the Yurakucho Line.

Fees:  Adults 250 yen,
Ages 65 yrs old and older 120 yen, 
Ages 13–15 yrs old 100 yen. 
Under 12 yrs old are FREE!

Address: 2 Chome-1 Yumenoshima, Koto City, Tokyo 136-0081

Phone Number: 03-3522-0281

title: Giant Halloween Pumpkins 2021 at Yumenoshima | Halloween Pumpkins | Halloween Party | Halloween Party 2021
description:
#yumenoshimahalloweenparty2021 #halloweenpumpkins #halloweenintokyo #halloween2021

Welcome back to Yumenoshima tropical greenhouse dome. As you can see on our last posted video, Daddy and I were here and we enjoyed much with the tropical plants in the dome. And since Jt was not with us that day, we went back here today and we will be enjoying with the giant Halloween pumpkins.

An exhibition of these giant ghost pumpkins, which they call Yumenoshima Halloween party, is celebrated and very popular every year. And since Halloween is just around the corner, this event is already happening right now. It started on the 22nd of September and will last until the 31st of October.

They will exhibit more than 100 giant ghost pumpkins weighing 50 to 100 kilograms. Can you imagine how heavy and big that is? These giant pumpkins were made in Hitachiomiya City, in Ibaraki Prefecture, in connection with Halloween.

With an admission fee of 250 yen for each adult, you can roam around the greenhouse dome, learn and enjoy the tropical plants which you barely see every day. Kids under 12 years old can enter free of charge. And for sure your toddlers will have fun with these giant ghost pumpkins all around the open garden. There will also be a photography area just inside the hall with the Halloween backdrops. So you better grab your favorite Halloween costumes and get ready for memorable photos.

You can also bring your own food and have a small picnic in the garden together with these ghost pumpkins, or you can just go to the cafeteria inside the hall and grab any food of your choice.

Event Date and Hours: 
September 22– Sunday, Tuesday–Sunday 9:30 – 17:00 (Last entry 16:00). Closed on Monday. If Monday is a public holiday they will open and close on Tuesday.

Cost: Fees: Adults 250 yen, Ages 65 and older 120 yen, Ages 13–15 100 yen Under 12 FREE!

Address: 2-1-2 Yumenoshima, Koto-ku
Phone: 03-3522-0281
Website: http://www.yumenoshima.jp/

Note: this is in Japanese language. You can use Google Chrome too as it has an automatic translator if you wish to view it in English.

Access: 10 minute walk from Shin-Kiba Station, which is 10 minutes from Tokyo Station on the Keiyo Line. Also accessible on the Yurakucho Line.

You can also access the Metro Tozai line’s Toyocho Station and take the Toei Bus going to Shinkiba, get off at the Yumenoshima Stop and from there you can walk 7 mins to Greenhouse Dome.

Notes: Nursing room and Diaper changing table located in the Botanical Garden. Please ask the staff for directions.
